verses.sa:
अग्रे बृहन्नुषसामूर्ध्वो अस्थान्निर्जगन्वान्तमसो ज्योतिषागात् ।
अग्निर्भानुना रुशता स्वङ्ग आ जातो विश्वा सद्मान्यप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
agre brihannushasamurdhvo asthannirjaganvantamaso jyotishagat |
agnirbhanuna rushata svanga a jato vishva sadmanyaprah ||
verses.en:
HIGH hath the Mighty risen before the dawning, and come to us with light from out the darkness.
Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.

verses.sa:
स जातो गर्भो असि रोदस्योरग्ने चारुर्विभृत ओषधीषु ।
चित्रः शिशुः परि तमांस्यक्तून्प्र मातृभ्यो अधि कनिक्रदद्गाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa jato garbho asi rodasyoragne charurvibhrita oshadhishu |
chitrah shishuh pari tamamsyaktunpra matribhyo adhi kanikradadgah ||
verses.en:
Thou, being born, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted among the plants in beauty, Agni!
The glooms of night thou, Brilliant Babe, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from thy Mothers.

verses.sa:
विष्णुरित्था परममस्य विद्वाञ्जातो बृहन्नभि पाति तृतीयम् ।
आसा यदस्य पयो अक्रत स्वं सचेतसो अभ्यर्चन्त्यत्र ॥
verses.rom:
vishnurittha paramamasya vidvanjato brihannabhi pati tritiyam |
asa yadasya payo akrata svam sachetaso abhyarchantyatra ||
verses.en:
Here, being manifested, lofty Visnu, full wise, protects his own supremest station.
When they have offered in his mouth their sweet milk, to him with one accord they sing forth praises.

verses.sa:
अत उ त्वा पितुभृतो जनित्रीरन्नावृधं प्रति चरन्त्यन्नैः ।
ता ईं प्रत्येषि पुनरन्यरूपा असि त्वं विक्षु मानुषीषु होता ॥
verses.rom:
ata u tva pitubhrito janitrirannavridham prati charantyannaih |
ta im pratyeshi punaranyarupa asi tvam vikshu manushishu hota ||
verses.en:
Thence bearing food the Mothers come to meet thee, with food for thee who givest food its increase.
These in their altered form again thou meetest. Thou art Invoking Priest in homes of mortals.

verses.sa:
होतारं चित्ररथमध्वरस्य यज्ञस्ययज्ञस्य केतुं रुशन्तम् ।
प्रत्यर्धिं देवस्यदेवस्य मह्ना श्रिया त्वग्निमतिथिं जनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
hotaram chitrarathamadhvarasya yajnasyayajnasya ketum rushantam |
pratyardhim devasyadevasya mahna shriya tvagnimatithim jananam ||
verses.en:
Priest of the holy rite, with car that glitters, refulgent Banner of each act of worship,
Sharing every God through might and glory, even Agni Guest of men I summon hither.

verses.sa:
स तु वस्त्राण्यध पेशनानि वसानो अग्निर्नाभा पृथिव्याः ।
अरुषो जातः पद इळायाः पुरोहितो राजन्यक्षीह देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu vastranyadha peshanani vasano agnirnabha prithivyah |
arusho jatah pada ilayah purohito rajanyakshiha devan ||
verses.en:
So Agni stands on earth's most central station, invested in well-decorated garments.
Born, red of hue, where men pour out libations, O King, as great High Priest bring the Gods hither.

verses.sa:
आ हि द्यावापृथिवी अग्न उभे सदा पुत्रो न मातरा ततन्थ ।
प्र याह्यच्छोशतो यविष्ठाथा वह सहस्येह देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
a hi dyavaprithivi agna ubhe sada putro na matara tatantha |
pra yahyachchhoshato yavishthatha vaha sahasyeha devan ||
verses.en:
Over the earth and over heaven, O Agni, thou, Son, hast ever spread above thy Parents.
Come, Youthfullest! to those who long to meet thee, and hither bring the Gods, O Mighty Victor.

verses.sa:
पिप्रीहि देवाँ उशतो यविष्ठ विद्वाँ ऋतूँरृतुपते यजेह ।
ये दैव्या ऋत्विजस्तेभिरग्ने त्वं होतॄणामस्यायजिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
piprihi devan ushato yavishtha vidvan ritunrritupate yajeha |
ye daivya ritvijastebhiragne tvam hotrinamasyayajishthah ||
verses.en:
GLADDEN the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons,
With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers.

verses.sa:
वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं जनानां मन्धातासि द्रविणोदा ऋतावा ।
स्वाहा वयं कृणवामा हवींषि देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन् ॥
verses.rom:
veshi hotramuta potram jananam mandhatasi dravinoda ritava |
svaha vayam krinavama havimshi devo devanyajatvagnirarhan ||
verses.en:
Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order.
Let us with Svaha offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनु प्रवोळ्हुम् ।
अग्निर्विद्वान्स यजात्सेदु होता सो अध्वरान्स ऋतून्कल्पयाति ॥
verses.rom:
a devanamapi panthamaganma yachchhaknavama tadanu pravolhum |
agnirvidvansa yajatsedu hota so adhvaransa ritunkalpayati ||
verses.en:
To the Gods' pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish.
Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.

verses.sa:
यद्वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः ।
अग्निष्टद्विश्वमा पृणाति विद्वान्येभिर्देवाँ ऋतुभिः कल्पयाति ॥
verses.rom:
yadvo vayam praminama vratani vidusham deva avidushtarasah |
agnishtadvishvama prinati vidvanyebhirdevan ritubhih kalpayati ||
verses.en:
When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge,
Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season.

verses.sa:
यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्त्यासः ।
अग्निष्टद्धोता क्रतुविद्विजानन्यजिष्ठो देवाँ ऋतुशो यजाति ॥
verses.rom:
yatpakatra manasa dinadaksha na yajnasya manvate martyasah |
agnishtaddhota kratuvidvijananyajishtho devan ritusho yajati ||
verses.en:
When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing,
Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषां ह्यध्वराणामनीकं चित्रं केतुं जनिता त्वा जजान ।
स आ यजस्व नृवतीरनु क्षा स्पार्हा इषः क्षुमतीर्विश्वजन्याः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvesham hyadhvaranamanikam chitram ketum janita tva jajana |
sa a yajasva nrivatiranu ksha sparha ishah kshumatirvishvajanyah ||
verses.en:
Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner:
So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा द्यावापृथिवी यं त्वापस्त्वष्टा यं त्वा सुजनिमा जजान ।
पन्थामनु प्रविद्वान्पितृयाणं द्युमदग्ने समिधानो वि भाहि ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva dyavaprithivi yam tvapastvashta yam tva sujanima jajana |
panthamanu pravidvanpitriyanam dyumadagne samidhano vi bhahi ||
verses.en:
Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvastar, maker of fair things, created,
Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.

verses.sa:
इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाँ अदर्शि ।
चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन् ॥
verses.rom:
ino rajannaratih samiddho raudro dakshaya sushuman adarshi |
chikidvi bhati bhasa brihatasiknimeti rushatimapajan ||
verses.en:
O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty.
He shines, all-knowing, with his lofty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning.

verses.sa:
कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसा भूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् ।
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति ॥
verses.rom:
krishnam yadenimabhi varpasa bhujjanayanyosham brihatah piturjam |
urdhvam bhanum suryasya stabhayandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhati ||
verses.en:
Having o'ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter,
Holding aloft the radiant light of Surya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.

verses.sa:
भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् ।
सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
bhadro bhadraya sachamana agatsvasaram jaro abhyeti pashchat |
supraketairdyubhiragnirvitishthanrushadbhirvarnairabhi ramamasthat ||
verses.en:
Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister.
Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitely shining garments.

verses.sa:
अस्य यामासो बृहतो न वग्नूनिन्धाना अग्नेः सख्युः शिवस्य ।
ईड्यस्य वृष्णो बृहतः स्वासो भामासो यामन्नक्तवश्चिकित्रे ॥
verses.rom:
asya yamaso brihato na vagnunindhana agneh sakhyuh shivasya |
idyasya vrishno brihatah svaso bhamaso yamannaktavashchikitre ||
verses.en:
His goings-forth kindle as 'twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni.
The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh.

verses.sa:
स्वना न यस्य भामासः पवन्ते रोचमानस्य बृहतः सुदिवः ।
ज्येष्ठेभिर्यस्तेजिष्ठैः क्रीळुमद्भिर्वर्षिष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्नक्षति द्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
svana na yasya bhamasah pavante rochamanasya brihatah sudivah |
jyeshthebhiryastejishthaih krilumadbhirvarshishthebhirbhanubhirnakshati dyam ||
verses.en:
Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent,
Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit.

verses.sa:
अस्य शुष्मासो ददृशानपवेर्जेहमानस्य स्वनयन्नियुद्भिः ।
प्रत्नेभिर्यो रुशद्भिर्देवतमो वि रेभद्भिररतिर्भाति विभ्वा ॥
verses.rom:
asya shushmaso dadrishanapaverjehamanasya svanayanniyudbhih |
pratnebhiryo rushadbhirdevatamo vi rebhadbhiraratirbhati vibhva ||
verses.en:
His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted.
He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining.

verses.sa:
स आ वक्षि महि न आ च सत्सि दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिर्युवत्योः ।
अग्निः सुतुकः सुतुकेभिरश्वै रभस्वद्भी रभस्वाँ एह गम्याः ॥
verses.rom:
sa a vakshi mahi na a cha satsi divasprithivyoraratiryuvatyoh |
agnih sutukah sutukebhirashvai rabhasvadbhi rabhasvan eha gamyah ||
verses.en:
So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven.
Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.

verses.sa:
प्र ते यक्षि प्र त इयर्मि मन्म भुवो यथा वन्द्यो नो हवेषु ।
धन्वन्निव प्रपा असि त्वमग्न इयक्षवे पूरवे प्रत्न राजन् ॥
verses.rom:
pra te yakshi pra ta iyarmi manma bhuvo yatha vandyo no haveshu |
dhanvanniva prapa asi tvamagna iyakshave purave pratna rajan ||
verses.en:
To thee will send praise and bring oblation, as thou hast merited lauds when we invoked thee.
A fountain in the desert art thou, Agni, O Ancient King, to man who fain would worship,

verses.sa:
यं त्वा जनासो अभि संचरन्ति गाव उष्णमिव व्रजं यविष्ठ ।
दूतो देवानामसि मर्त्यानामन्तर्महाँश्चरसि रोचनेन ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva janaso abhi samcharanti gava ushnamiva vrajam yavishtha |
duto devanamasi martyanamantarmahanshcharasi rochanena ||
verses.en:
Thou unto whom resort the gathered people, as the kine seek the warm stall, O Most Youthful.
Thou art the messenger of Gods and mortals, and goest glorious with thy light between them.

verses.sa:
शिशुं न त्वा जेन्यं वर्धयन्ती माता बिभर्ति सचनस्यमाना ।
धनोरधि प्रवता यासि हर्यञ्जिगीषसे पशुरिवावसृष्टः ॥
verses.rom:
shishum na tva jenyam vardhayanti mata bibharti sachanasyamana |
dhanoradhi pravata yasi haryanjigishase pashurivavasrishtah ||
verses.en:
Making thee grow as 'twere some noble infant, thy Mother nurtures thee with sweet affection.
Over the desert slopes thou passest longing, and seekest, like some beast set free, thy fodder.

verses.sa:
मूरा अमूर न वयं चिकित्वो महित्वमग्ने त्वमङ्ग वित्से ।
शये वव्रिश्चरति जिह्वयादन्रेरिह्यते युवतिं विश्पतिः सन् ॥
verses.rom:
mura amura na vayam chikitvo mahitvamagne tvamanga vitse |
shaye vavrishcharati jihvayadanrerihyate yuvatim vishpatih san ||
verses.en:
Foolish are we, O Wise and free from error: verily, Agni, thou dost know thy grandeur.
There lies the form: he moves and licks, and swallows, and, as House-Lord, kisses the Youthful Maiden.

verses.sa:
कूचिज्जायते सनयासु नव्यो वने तस्थौ पलितो धूमकेतुः ।
अस्नातापो वृषभो न प्र वेति सचेतसो यं प्रणयन्त मर्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
kuchijjayate sanayasu navyo vane tasthau palito dhumaketuh |
asnatapo vrishabho na pra veti sachetaso yam pranayanta martah ||
verses.en:
He rises ever fresh in ancient fuel: smoke-bannered, gray, he makes the wood his dwelling.
No swimmer, Steer, he presses through the waters, and to his place accordant mortals bear him.

verses.sa:
तनूत्यजेव तस्करा वनर्गू रशनाभिर्दशभिरभ्यधीताम् ।
इयं ते अग्ने नव्यसी मनीषा युक्ष्वा रथं न शुचयद्भिरङ्गैः ॥
verses.rom:
tanutyajeva taskara vanargu rashanabhirdashabhirabhyadhitam |
iyam te agne navyasi manisha yukshva ratham na shuchayadbhirangaih ||
verses.en:
Like thieves who risk their lives and haunt the forest, the twain with their ten girdles have secured him.
This is a new hymn meant for thee, O Agni: yoke as it were thy car with parts that glitter.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म च ते जातवेदो नमश्चेयं च गीः सदमिद्वर्धनी भूत् ।
रक्षा णो अग्ने तनयानि तोका रक्षोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
brahma cha te jatavedo namashcheyam cha gih sadamidvardhani bhut |
raksha no agne tanayani toka rakshota nastanvo aprayuchchhan ||
verses.en:
Homage and prayer are thine, O Jatavedas, and this my song shall evermore exalt thee.
Agni, protect our children and descendants, and guard with ever-watchful care our bodies.

verses.sa:
एकः समुद्रो धरुणो रयीणामस्मद्धृदो भूरिजन्मा वि चष्टे ।
सिषक्त्यूधर्निण्योरुपस्थ उत्सस्य मध्ये निहितं पदं वेः ॥
verses.rom:
ekah samudro dharuno rayinamasmaddhrido bhurijanma vi chashte |
sishaktyudharninyorupastha utsasya madhye nihitam padam veh ||
verses.en:
HE only is the Sea, holder of treasures: born many a time he views the hearts within us.
He hides him in the secret couple's bosom. The Bird dwells in the middle of the fountain.

verses.sa:
समानं नीळं वृषणो वसानाः सं जग्मिरे महिषा अर्वतीभिः ।
ऋतस्य पदं कवयो नि पान्ति गुहा नामानि दधिरे पराणि ॥
verses.rom:
samanam nilam vrishano vasanah sam jagmire mahisha arvatibhih |
ritasya padam kavayo ni panti guha namani dadhire parani ||
verses.en:
Inhabiting one dwelling-place in common, strong Stallions and the Mares have come together.
The sages guard the seat of Holy Order, and keep the highest names concealed within them.

verses.sa:
ऋतायिनी मायिनी सं दधाते मित्वा शिशुं जज्ञतुर्वर्धयन्ती ।
विश्वस्य नाभिं चरतो ध्रुवस्य कवेश्चित्तन्तुं मनसा वियन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
ritayini mayini sam dadhate mitva shishum jajnaturvardhayanti |
vishvasya nabhim charato dhruvasya kaveshchittantum manasa viyantah ||
verses.en:
The Holy Pair, of wondrous power, have coupled: they formed the Infant, they who bred produced him.
The central point of all that moves and moves not, the while they wove the Sage's thread with insight

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि वर्तनयः सुजातमिषो वाजाय प्रदिवः सचन्ते ।
अधीवासं रोदसी वावसाने घृतैरन्नैर्वावृधाते मधूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya hi vartanayah sujatamisho vajaya pradivah sachante |
adhivasam rodasi vavasane ghritairannairvavridhate madhunam ||
verses.en:
For tracks of Order and refreshing viands attend from ancient times the goodly Infant.
Wearing him as a mantle, Earth and Heaven grow strong by food of pleasant drink and fatness.

verses.sa:
सप्त स्वसॄररुषीर्वावशानो विद्वान्मध्व उज्जभारा दृशे कम् ।
अन्तर्येमे अन्तरिक्षे पुराजा इच्छन्वव्रिमविदत्पूषणस्य ॥
verses.rom:
sapta svasrirarushirvavashano vidvanmadhva ujjabhara drishe kam |
antaryeme antarikshe puraja ichchhanvavrimavidatpushanasya ||
verses.en:
He, calling loudly to the Seven red Sisters, hath, skilled in sweet drink, brought them to be looked on.
He, born of old, in middle air hath halted, and sought and found the covering robe of Pusan.

verses.sa:
सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामेकामिदभ्यंहुरो गात् ।
आयोर्ह स्कम्भ उपमस्य नीळे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ ॥
verses.rom:
sapta maryadah kavayastatakshustasamekamidabhyamhuro gat |
ayorha skambha upamasya nile patham visarge dharuneshu tasthau ||
verses.en:
Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned; to one of these may come the troubled mortal.
He standeth in the dwelling of the Highest, a Pillar, on sure ground where paths are parted.

verses.sa:
असच्च सच्च परमे व्योमन्दक्षस्य जन्मन्नदितेरुपस्थे ।
अग्निर्ह नः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य पूर्व आयुनि वृषभश्च धेनुः ॥
verses.rom:
asachcha sachcha parame vyomandakshasya janmannaditerupasthe |
agnirha nah prathamaja ritasya purva ayuni vrishabhashcha dhenuh ||
verses.en:
Not Being, Being in the highest heaven, in Aditi's bosom and in Daksa's birthplace,
Is Agni, our first-born of Holy Order, the Milch-cow and the Bull in life's beginning.

verses.sa:
अयं स यस्य शर्मन्नवोभिरग्नेरेधते जरिताभिष्टौ ।
ज्येष्ठेभिर्यो भानुभिरृषूणां पर्येति परिवीतो विभावा ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sa yasya sharmannavobhiragneredhate jaritabhishtau |
jyeshthebhiryo bhanubhirrishunam paryeti parivito vibhava ||
verses.en:
THIS is that Agni, he by whose protection, favour, and help. the singer is successful;
Who with the noblest flames of glowing fuel comes forth encompassed with far-spreading lustre.

verses.sa:
यो भानुभिर्विभावा विभात्यग्निर्देवेभिरृतावाजस्रः ।
आ यो विवाय सख्या सखिभ्योऽपरिह्वृतो अत्यो न सप्तिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo bhanubhirvibhava vibhatyagnirdevebhirritavajasrah |
a yo vivaya sakhya sakhibhyo'parihvrito atyo na saptih ||
verses.en:
Agni, the Holy One, the everlasting, who shines far beaming with celestial splendours;
He who hath come unto his friends with friendship, like a fleet steed who never trips or stumbles.

verses.sa:
ईशे यो विश्वस्या देववीतेरीशे विश्वायुरुषसो व्युष्टौ ।
आ यस्मिन्मना हवींष्यग्नावरिष्टरथ स्कभ्नाति शूषैः ॥
verses.rom:
ishe yo vishvasya devaviterishe vishvayurushaso vyushtau |
a yasminmana havimshyagnavarishtaratha skabhnati shushaih ||
verses.en:
He who is Lord of all divine oblation, shared by all living men at break of morning,
Agni to whom our offerings are devoted, in whom rests he whose car, through might, is scatheless.

verses.sa:
शूषेभिर्वृधो जुषाणो अर्कैर्देवाँ अच्छा रघुपत्वा जिगाति ।
मन्द्रो होता स जुह्वा यजिष्ठः सम्मिश्लो अग्निरा जिघर्ति देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
shushebhirvridho jushano arkairdevan achchha raghupatva jigati |
mandro hota sa juhva yajishthah sammishlo agnira jigharti devan ||
verses.en:
Increasing by his strength. while lauds content him, with easy flight unto the Gods he travels.
Agni the cheerful Priest, best Sacrificer, balms with his tongue the Gods with whom he mingles.

verses.sa:
तमुस्रामिन्द्रं न रेजमानमग्निं गीर्भिर्नमोभिरा कृणुध्वम् ।
आ यं विप्रासो मतिभिर्गृणन्ति जातवेदसं जुह्वं सहानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamusramindram na rejamanamagnim girbhirnamobhira krinudhvam |
a yam vipraso matibhirgrinanti jatavedasam juhvam sahanam ||
verses.en:
With songs and adorations bring ye hither Agni who stirs himself at dawn like Indra,
Whom sages laud with hymns as Jatavedas of those who wield the sacrificial ladle.

verses.sa:
सं यस्मिन्विश्वा वसूनि जग्मुर्वाजे नाश्वाः सप्तीवन्त एवैः ।
अस्मे ऊतीरिन्द्रवाततमा अर्वाचीना अग्न आ कृणुष्व ॥
verses.rom:
sam yasminvishva vasuni jagmurvaje nashvah saptivanta evaih |
asme utirindravatatama arvachina agna a krinushva ||
verses.en:
In whom all goodly treasures meet together, even as steeds and riders for the booty.
Inclining hither bring us help, O Agni, even assistance most desired by Indra.

verses.sa:
अधा ह्यग्ने मह्ना निषद्या सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूथ ।
तं ते देवासो अनु केतमायन्नधावर्धन्त प्रथमास ऊमाः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hyagne mahna nishadya sadyo jajnano havyo babhutha |
tam te devaso anu ketamayannadhavardhanta prathamasa umah ||
verses.en:
Yea, at thy birth, when thou hadst sat in glory, thou, Agni, wast the aim of invocations.
The Gods came near, obedient to thy summons, and thus attained their rank as chief Protectors.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति नो दिवो अग्ने पृथिव्या विश्वायुर्धेहि यजथाय देव ।
सचेमहि तव दस्म प्रकेतैरुरुष्या ण उरुभिर्देव शंसैः ॥
verses.rom:
svasti no divo agne prithivya vishvayurdhehi yajathaya deva |
sachemahi tava dasma praketairurushya na urubhirdeva shamsaih ||
verses.en:
O AGNI, shared by all men living bring us good luck for sacrifice from earth and heaven.
With us be thine intelligence, Wonder Worker! Protect us, God, with thy far-reaching blessings.

verses.sa:
इमा अग्ने मतयस्तुभ्यं जाता गोभिरश्वैरभि गृणन्ति राधः ।
यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानड्वसो दधानो मतिभिः सुजात ॥
verses.rom:
ima agne matayastubhyam jata gobhirashvairabhi grinanti radhah |
yada te marto anu bhogamanadvaso dadhano matibhih sujata ||
verses.en:
These hymns brought forth for thee, O Agni, laud thee for bounteous gifts, with cattle and with horses.
Good Lord, when man from thee hath gained enjoyment, by hymns, O nobly born, hath he obtained it.

verses.sa:
अग्निं मन्ये पितरमग्निमापिमग्निं भ्रातरं सदमित्सखायम् ।
अग्नेरनीकं बृहतः सपर्यं दिवि शुक्रं यजतं सूर्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
agnim manye pitaramagnimapimagnim bhrataram sadamitsakhayam |
agneranikam brihatah saparyam divi shukram yajatam suryasya ||
verses.en:
Agni I deem my Kinsman and my Father, count him my Brother and my Friend for ever.
I honour as the face of lofty Agni in heaven the bright and holy light of Surya.

verses.sa:
सिध्रा अग्ने धियो अस्मे सनुत्रीर्यं त्रायसे दम आ नित्यहोता ।
ऋतावा स रोहिदश्वः पुरुक्षुर्द्युभिरस्मा अहभिर्वाममस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
sidhra agne dhiyo asme sanutriryam trayase dama a nityahota |
ritava sa rohidashvah purukshurdyubhirasma ahabhirvamamastu ||
verses.en:
Effectual, Agni, are our prayers for profit. He whom, at home thou, Priest for ever, guardest
Is rich in food, drawn by red steeds, and holy: by day and night to him shall all be pleasant.

verses.sa:
द्युभिर्हितं मित्रमिव प्रयोगं प्रत्नमृत्विजमध्वरस्य जारम् ।
बाहुभ्यामग्निमायवोऽजनन्त विक्षु होतारं न्यसादयन्त ॥
verses.rom:
dyubhirhitam mitramiva prayogam pratnamritvijamadhvarasya jaram |
bahubhyamagnimayavo'jananta vikshu hotaram nyasadayanta ||
verses.en:
Men with their arms have generated Agni, helpful as some kind friend, adorned with splendours,
And stablished as Invoker mid the people the ancient Priest the sacrifice's lover.

verses.sa:
स्वयं यजस्व दिवि देव देवान्किं ते पाकः कृणवदप्रचेताः ।
यथायज ऋतुभिर्देव देवानेवा यजस्व तन्वं सुजात ॥
verses.rom:
svayam yajasva divi deva devankim te pakah krinavadaprachetah |
yathayaja ritubhirdeva devaneva yajasva tanvam sujata ||
verses.en:
Worship, thyself, O God, the Gods in heaven: what, void of knowledge, shall the fool avail thee?
As thou, O God, hast worshipped Gods by seasons, so, nobly-born! to thine own self pay worship.

verses.sa:
भवा नो अग्नेऽवितोत गोपा भवा वयस्कृदुत नो वयोधाः ।
रास्वा च नः सुमहो हव्यदातिं त्रास्वोत नस्तन्वो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
bhava no agne'vitota gopa bhava vayaskriduta no vayodhah |
rasva cha nah sumaho havyadatim trasvota nastanvo aprayuchchhan ||
verses.en:
Agni, be thou our Guardian and Protector bestow upon us life and vital vigour.
Accept, O Mighty One, the gifts we offer, and with unceasing care protect our bodies.

verses.sa:
प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ।
दिवश्चिदन्ताँ उपमाँ उदानळपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध ॥
verses.rom:
pra ketuna brihata yatyagnira rodasi vrishabho roraviti |
divashchidantan upaman udanalapamupasthe mahisho vavardha ||
verses.en:
AGNI advances with his lofty banner: the Bull is bellowing to the earth and heavens.
He hath attained the sky's supremest limits. the Steer hath waxen in the lap of waters.

verses.sa:
मुमोद गर्भो वृषभः ककुद्मानस्रेमा वत्सः शिमीवाँ अरावीत् ।
स देवतात्युद्यतानि कृण्वन्स्वेषु क्षयेषु प्रथमो जिगाति ॥
verses.rom:
mumoda garbho vrishabhah kakudmanasrema vatsah shimivan aravit |
sa devatatyudyatani krinvansveshu kshayeshu prathamo jigati ||
verses.en:
The Bull, the youngling with the hump, hath frolicked, the strong and never-ceasing Calf hath bellowed.
Bringing our offerings to the God's assembly, he moves as Chief in his own dwelling-places.

verses.sa:
आ यो मूर्धानं पित्रोररब्ध न्यध्वरे दधिरे सूरो अर्णः ।
अस्य पत्मन्नरुषीरश्वबुध्ना ऋतस्य योनौ तन्वो जुषन्त ॥
verses.rom:
a yo murdhanam pitrorarabdha nyadhvare dadhire suro arnah |
asya patmannarushirashvabudhna ritasya yonau tanvo jushanta ||
verses.en:
Him who hath grasped his Parents' head, they stablished at sacrifice a wave of heavenly lustre.
In his swift flight the red Dawns borne by horses refresh their bodies in the home of Order.

verses.sa:
उषौषो हि वसो अग्रमेषि त्वं यमयोरभवो विभावा ।
ऋताय सप्त दधिषे पदानि जनयन्मित्रं तन्वे स्वायै ॥
verses.rom:
ushausho hi vaso agrameshi tvam yamayorabhavo vibhava |
ritaya sapta dadhishe padani janayanmitram tanve svayai ||
verses.en:
For, Vasu thou precedest every Morning, and still hast been the Twins' illuminator.
For sacrifice, seven places thou retainest while for thine own self thou engenderest Mitra.

verses.sa:
भुवश्चक्षुर्मह ऋतस्य गोपा भुवो वरुणो यदृताय वेषि ।
भुवो अपां नपाज्जातवेदो भुवो दूतो यस्य हव्यं जुजोषः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvashchakshurmaha ritasya gopa bhuvo varuno yadritaya veshi |
bhuvo apam napajjatavedo bhuvo duto yasya havyam jujoshah ||
verses.en:
Thou art the Eye and Guard of mighty Order, and Varuna when to sacrifice thou comest.
Thou art the Waters' Child O Jatavedas, envoy of him whose offering thou acceptest.

verses.sa:
भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसे शिवाभिः ।
दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे स्वर्षां जिह्वामग्ने चकृषे हव्यवाहम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvo yajnasya rajasashcha neta yatra niyudbhih sachase shivabhih |
divi murdhanam dadhishe svarsham jihvamagne chakrishe havyavaham ||
verses.en:
Thou art the Leader of the rite and region, to which with thine auspicious teams thou leadest,
Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblationbearer, Agni.

verses.sa:
अस्य त्रितः क्रतुना वव्रे अन्तरिच्छन्धीतिं पितुरेवैः परस्य ।
सचस्यमानः पित्रोरुपस्थे जामि ब्रुवाण आयुधानि वेति ॥
verses.rom:
asya tritah kratuna vavre antarichchhandhitim piturevaih parasya |
sachasyamanah pitrorupasthe jami bruvana ayudhani veti ||
verses.en:
Through his wise insight Trita in the cavern, seeking as ever the Chief Sire's intention,
Carefully tended in his Parents' bosom, calling the weapons kin, goes forth to combat.

verses.sa:
स पित्र्याण्यायुधानि विद्वानिन्द्रेषित आप्त्यो अभ्ययुध्यत् ।
त्रिशीर्षाणं सप्तरश्मिं जघन्वान्त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिन्निः ससृजे त्रितो गाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa pitryanyayudhani vidvanindreshita aptyo abhyayudhyat |
trishirshanam saptarashmim jaghanvantvashtrasya chinnih sasrije trito gah ||
verses.en:
Well-skilled to use the weapons of his Father, Aptya, urged on by Indra, fought the battle.
Then Trita slew the foe seven-rayed, three-headed, and freed the cattle of the Son of Tvastar.

verses.sa:
भूरीदिन्द्र उदिनक्षन्तमोजोऽवाभिनत्सत्पतिर्मन्यमानम् ।
त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिद्विश्वरूपस्य गोनामाचक्राणस्त्रीणि शीर्षा परा वर्क् ॥
verses.rom:
bhuridindra udinakshantamojo'vabhinatsatpatirmanyamanam |
tvashtrasya chidvishvarupasya gonamachakranastrini shirsha para vark ||
verses.en:
Lord of the brave, Indra cleft him in pieces who sought to gain much strength and deemed him mighty.
He smote his three heads from his body, seizing the cattle of the omniform Son of Tvastar.

verses.sa:
आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन ।
महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
apo hi shtha mayobhuvasta na urje dadhatana |
mahe ranaya chakshase ||
verses.en:
YE, Waters, are beneficent: so help ye us to energy
That we may look on great delight.

verses.sa:
यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः ।
उशतीरिव मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vah shivatamo rasastasya bhajayateha nah |
ushatiriva matarah ||
verses.en:
Give us a portion of the sap, the most auspicious that ye have,
Like mothers in their longing love.

verses.sa:
तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ ।
आपो जनयथा च नः ॥
verses.rom:
tasma aram gamama vo yasya kshayaya jinvatha |
apo janayatha cha nah ||
verses.en:
To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye send us on;
And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये ।
शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no devirabhishtaya apo bhavantu pitaye |
sham yorabhi sravantu nah ||
verses.en:
The Waters. be to us for drink, Goddesses for our aid and bliss:
Let them stream to us health and strength.

verses.sa:
ईशाना वार्याणां क्षयन्तीश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
अपो याचामि भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ishana varyanam kshayantishcharshaninam |
apo yachami bheshajam ||
verses.en:
1 beg the Floods to give us balm, these Queens who rule o'er precious things,
And have supreme control of men.

verses.sa:
अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा ।
अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
apsu me somo abravidantarvishvani bheshaja |
agnim cha vishvashambhuvam ||
verses.en:
Within the Waters-Soma thus hath told me-dwell all balms that heal,
And Agni, he who blesseth all.

verses.sa:
आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम ।
ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
apah prinita bheshajam varutham tanve mama |
jyokcha suryam drishe ||
verses.en:
O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm,
So that I long may see the Sun.

verses.sa:
इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि ।
यद्वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
idamapah pra vahata yatkim cha duritam mayi |
yadvahamabhidudroha yadva shepa utanritam ||
verses.en:
Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought,
If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

verses.sa:
आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि ।
पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
apo adyanvacharisham rasena samagasmahi |
payasvanagna a gahi tam ma sam srija varchasa ||
verses.en:
The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come:
O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

verses.sa:
ओ चित्सखायं सख्या ववृत्यां तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवं जगन्वान् ।
पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि क्षमि प्रतरं दीध्यानः ॥
verses.rom:
o chitsakhayam sakhya vavrityam tirah puru chidarnavam jaganvan |
piturnapatama dadhita vedha adhi kshami prataram didhyanah ||
verses.en:
FAIN would I win my friend to kindly friendship. So may the Sage, come through the air's wide ocean,
Remembering the earth and days to follow, obtain a son, the issue of his father.

verses.sa:
न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत्सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति ।
महस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तार उर्विया परि ख्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
na te sakha sakhyam vashtyetatsalakshma yadvishurupa bhavati |
mahasputraso asurasya vira divo dhartara urviya pari khyan ||
verses.en:
Thy friend loves not the friendship which considers her who is near in kindred as stranger.
Sons of the mighty Asura, the Heroes, supporters of the heavens, see far around them.

verses.sa:
उशन्ति घा ते अमृतास एतदेकस्य चित्त्यजसं मर्त्यस्य ।
नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्वमा विविश्याः ॥
verses.rom:
ushanti gha te amritasa etadekasya chittyajasam martyasya |
ni te mano manasi dhayyasme janyuh patistanvama vivishyah ||
verses.en:
Yea, this the Immortals seek of thee with longing, progeny of the sole existing mortal.
Then let thy soul and mine be knit together, and as a loving husband take thy consort.

verses.sa:
न यत्पुरा चकृमा कद्ध नूनमृता वदन्तो अनृतं रपेम ।
गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नो नाभिः परमं जामि तन्नौ ॥
verses.rom:
na yatpura chakrima kaddha nunamrita vadanto anritam rapema |
gandharvo apsvapya cha yosha sa no nabhih paramam jami tannau ||
verses.en:
Shall we do now what we ne'er did aforetime? we who spake righteously now talk impurely?
Gandharva in the floods, the Dame of Waters-such is our bond, such our most lofty kinship.

verses.sa:
गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः ।
नकिरस्य प्र मिनन्ति व्रतानि वेद नावस्य पृथिवी उत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
garbhe nu nau janita dampati kardevastvashta savita vishvarupah |
nakirasya pra minanti vratani veda navasya prithivi uta dyauh ||
verses.en:
Even in the womb God Tvastar, Vivifier, shaping all forms, Creator, made us consorts.
None violates his holy ordinances: that we are his the heavens and earth acknowledge.

verses.sa:
को अस्य वेद प्रथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह प्र वोचत् ।
बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु ब्रव आहनो वीच्या नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
ko asya veda prathamasyahnah ka im dadarsha ka iha pra vochat |
brihanmitrasya varunasya dhama kadu brava ahano vichya nrin ||
verses.en:
Who knows that earliest day whereof thou speakest? Who hath beheld it? Who can here declare it?
Great is the Law of Varuna and Mitra. What, wanton! wilt thou say to men to tempt them?

verses.sa:
यमस्य मा यम्यं काम आगन्समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय ।
जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद्वृहेव रथ्येव चक्रा ॥
verses.rom:
yamasya ma yamyam kama agansamane yonau sahasheyyaya |
jayeva patye tanvam ririchyam vi chidvriheva rathyeva chakra ||
verses.en:
I, Yami, am possessed by love of Yama, that I may rest on the same couch beside him.
I as a wife would yield me to my husband. Like car-wheels let us speed to meet each other.

verses.sa:
न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां स्पश इह ये चरन्ति ।
अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तूयं तेन वि वृह रथ्येव चक्रा ॥
verses.rom:
na tishthanti na ni mishantyete devanam spasha iha ye charanti |
anyena madahano yahi tuyam tena vi vriha rathyeva chakra ||
verses.en:
They stand not still, they never close their eyelids, those sentinels of Gods who wander round us.
Not me-go quickly, wanton, with another, and hasten like a chariot wheel to meet him.

verses.sa:
रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत्सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन्मिमीयात् ।
दिवा पृथिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्य बिभृयादजामि ॥
verses.rom:
ratribhirasma ahabhirdashasyetsuryasya chakshurmuhurunmimiyat |
diva prithivya mithuna sabandhu yamiryamasya bibhriyadajami ||
verses.en:
May Surya's eye with days and nights endow him, and ever may his light spread out before him.
In heaven and earth the kindred Pair commingle. On Yam! be the unbrotherly act of Yama.

verses.sa:
आ घा ता गच्छानुत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कृणवन्नजामि ।
उप बर्बृहि वृषभाय बाहुमन्यमिच्छस्व सुभगे पतिं मत् ॥
verses.rom:
a gha ta gachchhanuttara yugani yatra jamayah krinavannajami |
upa barbrihi vrishabhaya bahumanyamichchhasva subhage patim mat ||
verses.en:
Sure there will come succeeding times when brothers and sisters will do acts unmeet for kinsfolk.
Not me, O fair one,-seek another husband, and make thine arm a pillow for thy consort.

verses.sa:
किं भ्रातासद्यदनाथं भवाति किमु स्वसा यन्निरृतिर्निगच्छात् ।
काममूता बह्वेतद्रपामि तन्वा मे तन्वं सं पिपृग्धि ॥
verses.rom:
kim bhratasadyadanatham bhavati kimu svasa yannirritirnigachchhat |
kamamuta bahvetadrapami tanva me tanvam sam piprigdhi ||
verses.en:
Is he a brother when no lord is left her? Is she a sister when Destruction cometh?
Forced by my love these many words I utter. Come near, and hold me in thy close embraces.

verses.sa:
न वा उ ते तन्वा तन्वं सं पपृच्यां पापमाहुर्यः स्वसारं निगच्छात् ।
अन्येन मत्प्रमुदः कल्पयस्व न ते भ्राता सुभगे वष्ट्येतत् ॥
verses.rom:
na va u te tanva tanvam sam paprichyam papamahuryah svasaram nigachchhat |
anyena matpramudah kalpayasva na te bhrata subhage vashtyetat ||
verses.en:
I will not fold mine arms about thy body: they call it sin when one comes near his sister.
Not me,-prepare thy pleasures with another: thy brother seeks not this from thee, O fair one.

verses.sa:
बतो बतासि यम नैव ते मनो हृदयं चाविदाम ।
अन्या किल त्वां कक्ष्येव युक्तं परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ॥
verses.rom:
bato batasi yama naiva te mano hridayam chavidama |
anya kila tvam kakshyeva yuktam pari shvajate libujeva vriksham ||
verses.en:
Alas! thou art indeed a weakling, Yama we find in thee no trace of heart or spirit.
As round the tree the woodbine clings, another will cling about thee girt as with a girdle.

verses.sa:
अन्यमू षु त्वं यम्यन्य उ त्वां परि ष्वजाते लिबुजेव वृक्षम् ।
तस्य वा त्वं मन इच्छा स वा तवाधा कृणुष्व संविदं सुभद्राम् ॥
verses.rom:
anyamu shu tvam yamyanya u tvam pari shvajate libujeva vriksham |
tasya va tvam mana ichchha sa va tavadha krinushva samvidam subhadram ||
verses.en:
Embrace another, Yami; let another, even as the woodbine rings the tree, enfold thee.
Win thou his heart and let him win thy fancy, and he shall form with thee a blest alliance.

verses.sa:
वृषा वृष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः ।
विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया स यज्ञियो यजतु यज्ञियाँ ऋतून् ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha vrishne duduhe dohasa divah payamsi yahvo aditeradabhyah |
vishvam sa veda varuno yatha dhiya sa yajniyo yajatu yajniyan ritun ||
verses.en:
THE Bull hath yielded for the Bull the milk of heaven: the Son of Aditi can never be deceived.
According to his wisdom Varuna knoweth all: may he, the Holy, hallow times for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
रपद्गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातु मे मनः ।
इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भ्राता नो ज्येष्ठः प्रथमो वि वोचति ॥
verses.rom:
rapadgandharvirapya cha yoshana nadasya nade pari patu me manah |
ishtasya madhye aditirni dhatu no bhrata no jyeshthah prathamo vi vochati ||
verses.en:
Gandharvi spake: may she, the Lady of the flood, amid the river's roaring leave my heart untouched.
May Aditi accomplish all that we desire, and may our eldest Brother tell us this as Chief.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु भद्रा क्षुमती यशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवे स्वर्वती ।
यदीमुशन्तमुशतामनु क्रतुमग्निं होतारं विदथाय जीजनन् ॥
verses.rom:
so chinnu bhadra kshumati yashasvatyusha uvasa manave svarvati |
yadimushantamushatamanu kratumagnim hotaram vidathaya jijanan ||
verses.en:
Yea, even this blessed Morning, rich in store of food, splendid, with heavenly lustre, hath shone out for man,
Since they, as was the wish of yearning Gods, brought forth that yearning Agni for the assembly as the Priest.

verses.sa:
अध त्यं द्रप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षणं विराभरदिषितः श्येनो अध्वरे ।
यदी विशो वृणते दस्ममार्या अग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत ॥
verses.rom:
adha tyam drapsam vibhvam vichakshanam virabharadishitah shyeno adhvare |
yadi visho vrinate dasmamarya agnim hotaramadha dhirajayata ||
verses.en:
And the fleet Falcon brought for sacrifice from afar this flowing Drop most excellent and keen of sight,
Then when the Aryan tribes chose as Invoking Priest Agni the Wonder-Worker, and the hymn rose up.

verses.sa:
सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषः स्वध्वरः ।
विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यं वाजं ससवाँ उपयासि भूरिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sadasi ranvo yavaseva pushyate hotrabhiragne manushah svadhvarah |
viprasya va yachchhashamana ukthyam vajam sasavan upayasi bhuribhih ||
verses.en:
Still art thou kind to him who feeds thee as with grass, and, skilled in sacrifice, offers thee holy gifts.
When thou, having received the sage's strengthening food with lauds, after long toil, comest with many more.

verses.sa:
उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हृत्त इष्यति ।
विवक्ति वह्निः स्वपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरो वेपते मती ॥
verses.rom:
udiraya pitara jara a bhagamiyakshati haryato hritta ishyati |
vivakti vahnih svapasyate makhastavishyate asuro vepate mati ||
verses.en:
Urge thou thy Parents, as a lover ' to delight: the Lovely One desires and craves it from his heart.
The priest calls out, the sacrificer shows his skill, the Asura tries his strength, and with the hymn is stirred.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अक्षत्सहसः सूनो अति स प्र शृण्वे ।
इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स द्युमाँ अमवान्भूषति द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste agne sumatim marto akshatsahasah suno ati sa pra shrinve |
isham dadhano vahamano ashvaira sa dyuman amavanbhushati dyun ||
verses.en:
Far-famed is he, the mortal man, O Agni, thou Son of Strength, who hath obtained thy favour.
He, gathering power, borne onward by his horses, makes his days lovely in his might and splendour.

verses.sa:
यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र ।
रत्ना च यद्विभजासि स्वधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तं वीतात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadagna esha samitirbhavati devi deveshu yajata yajatra |
ratna cha yadvibhajasi svadhavo bhagam no atra vasumantam vitat ||
verses.en:
When, Holy Agni, the divine assembly, the sacred synod mid the Gods, is gathered,
And when thou, Godlike One, dealest forth treasures, vouchsafe us, too, our portion of the riches.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi no agne sadane sadhasthe yukshva rathamamritasya dravitnum |
a no vaha rodasi devaputre makirdevanamapa bhuriha syah ||
verses.en:
Hear us, O Agni, in your common dwelling: harness thy rapid car of Amrta.
Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.

verses.sa:
द्यावा ह क्षामा प्रथमे ऋतेनाभिश्रावे भवतः सत्यवाचा ।
देवो यन्मर्तान्यजथाय कृण्वन्सीदद्धोता प्रत्यङ्स्वमसुं यन् ॥
verses.rom:
dyava ha kshama prathame ritenabhishrave bhavatah satyavacha |
devo yanmartanyajathaya krinvansidaddhota pratyansvamasum yan ||
verses.en:
HEAVEN and Earth, first by everlasting Order, speakers of truth, are near enough to hear us,
When the God, urging men to worship. sitteth as Priest, assuming all his vital vigour.

verses.sa:
देवो देवान्परिभूरृतेन वहा नो हव्यं प्रथमश्चिकित्वान् ।
धूमकेतुः समिधा भाऋजीको मन्द्रो होता नित्यो वाचा यजीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
devo devanparibhurritena vaha no havyam prathamashchikitvan |
dhumaketuh samidha bharijiko mandro hota nityo vacha yajiyan ||
verses.en:
As God comprising Gods by Law Eternal, bear, as the Chief who knoweth, our oblation,
Smoke-bannered with the fuel, radiant, joyous, better to praise and worship, Priest for ever.

verses.sa:
स्वावृग्देवस्यामृतं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्त उर्वी ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तत्ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनी दिव्यं घृतं वाः ॥
verses.rom:
svavrigdevasyamritam yadi gorato jataso dharayanta urvi |
vishve deva anu tatte yajurgurduhe yadeni divyam ghritam vah ||
verses.en:
When the cow's nectar wins the God completely, men here below are heaven's sustainers.
All the Gods came to this thy heavenly Yajus which from the motley Pair milked oil and water.

verses.sa:
अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घृतस्नू द्यावाभूमी शृणुतं रोदसी मे ।
अहा यद्द्यावोऽसुनीतिमयन्मध्वा नो अत्र पितरा शिशीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
archami vam vardhayapo ghritasnu dyavabhumi shrinutam rodasi me |
aha yaddyavo'sunitimayanmadhva no atra pitara shishitam ||
verses.en:
1 praise your work that ye may make me prosper: hear, Heaven and Earth, Twain Worlds that drop with fatness.
While days and nights go to the world of spirits, here let the Parents with sweet meath refresh us

verses.sa:
किं स्विन्नो राजा जगृहे कदस्याति व्रतं चकृमा को वि वेद ।
मित्रश्चिद्धि ष्मा जुहुराणो देवाञ्छ्लोको न यातामपि वाजो अस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
kim svinno raja jagrihe kadasyati vratam chakrima ko vi veda |
mitrashchiddhi shma juhurano devanchhloko na yatamapi vajo asti ||
verses.en:
Hath the King siezed us? How have we offended against his holy ordinance? Who knoweth?
For even Mitra mid the Gods is angry there are both song and strength for those who come not.

verses.sa:
दुर्मन्त्वत्रामृतस्य नाम सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपा भवाति ।
यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तमृष्व पाह्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
durmantvatramritasya nama salakshma yadvishurupa bhavati |
yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamrishva pahyaprayuchchhan ||
verses.en:
'Tis hard to understand the Immortal's nature, where she who is akin becomes a stranger.
Guard ceaselessly, great Agni, him who ponders Yama's name, easy to be comprehended.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते ।
सूर्ये ज्योतिरदधुर्मास्यक्तून्परि द्योतनिं चरतो अजस्रा ॥
verses.rom:
yasmindeva vidathe madayante vivasvatah sadane dharayante |
surye jyotiradadhurmasyaktunpari dyotanim charato ajasra ||
verses.en:
They in the synod where the Gods rejoice them, where they are seated in Vivasvan's dwelling,
Have given the Moon his beams, the Sun his splendour-the Two unweariedly maintain their brightness.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये न वयमस्य विद्म ।
मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान्सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmindeva manmani samcharantyapichye na vayamasya vidma |
mitro no atraditiranagansavita devo varunaya vochat ||
verses.en:
The counsel which the Gods meet to consider, their secret plan,-of that we have no knowledge.
There let God Savitar, Aditi, and Mitra proclaim to Varuna that we are sinless.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम् ।
आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi no agne sadane sadhasthe yukshva rathamamritasya dravitnum |
a no vaha rodasi devaputre makirdevanamapa bhuriha syah ||
verses.en:
Hear us, O Agni, in your comninn dwelling: harness thy rapid car, the car of Amrta.
Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities' Parents, hither: stay with us here, nor from the Gods be distant.

verses.sa:
युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिर्वि श्लोक एतु पथ्येव सूरेः ।
शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतस्य पुत्रा आ ये धामानि दिव्यानि तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
yuje vam brahma purvyam namobhirvi shloka etu pathyeva sureh |
shrinvantu vishve amritasya putra a ye dhamani divyani tasthuh ||
verses.en:
I YOKE with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway.
All Sons of Immortality shall hear it, all the possessors of celestial natures.

verses.sa:
यमे इव यतमाने यदैतं प्र वां भरन्मानुषा देवयन्तः ।
आ सीदतं स्वमु लोकं विदाने स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नः ॥
verses.rom:
yame iva yatamane yadaitam pra vam bharanmanusha devayantah |
a sidatam svamu lokam vidane svasasthe bhavatamindave nah ||
verses.en:
When speeding ye came nigh us like twin sisters, religious-hearted votaries brought you forward.
Take your place, ye who know your proper station: be near, be very near unto our Soma.

verses.sa:
पञ्च पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहं चतुष्पदीमन्वेमि व्रतेन ।
अक्षरेण प्रति मिम एतामृतस्य नाभावधि सं पुनामि ॥
verses.rom:
pancha padani rupo anvaroham chatushpadimanvemi vratena |
aksharena prati mima etamritasya nabhavadhi sam punami ||
verses.en:
Five paces have I risen from Earth. I follow her who hath four feet with devout observance.
This by the Sacred Syllable have I measured: I purify in the central place of Order,

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यः कमवृणीत मृत्युं प्रजायै कममृतं नावृणीत ।
बृहस्पतिं यज्ञमकृण्वत ऋषिं प्रियां यमस्तन्वं प्रारिरेचीत् ॥
verses.rom:
devebhyah kamavrinita mrityum prajayai kamamritam navrinita |
brihaspatim yajnamakrinvata rishim priyam yamastanvam prarirechit ||
verses.en:
He, for God's sake, chose death to be his portion. He chose not, for men's good, a life eternal
They sacrificed Brhaspati the Rsi. Yama delivered up his own dear body.

verses.sa:
सप्त क्षरन्ति शिशवे मरुत्वते पित्रे पुत्रासो अप्यवीवतन्नृतम् ।
उभे इदस्योभयस्य राजत उभे यतेते उभयस्य पुष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta ksharanti shishave marutvate pitre putraso apyavivatannritam |
ubhe idasyobhayasya rajata ubhe yatete ubhayasya pushyatah ||
verses.en:
The Seven flow to the Youth on whom the Maruts wait: the Sons unto the Father brought the sacrifice.
Both these are his, as his they are the Lords of both: both toil; belonging unto both they prosper well.

verses.sa:
परेयिवांसं प्रवतो महीरनु बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानम् ।
वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा दुवस्य ॥
verses.rom:
pareyivamsam pravato mahiranu bahubhyah panthamanupaspashanam |
vaivasvatam samgamanam jananam yamam rajanam havisha duvasya ||
verses.en:
HONOUR the King with thine oblations, Yama, Vivasvan's Son, who gathers men together,
Who travelled to the lofty heights above us, who searches out and shows the path to many.

verses.sa:
यमो नो गातुं प्रथमो विवेद नैषा गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ ।
यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुरेना जज्ञानाः पथ्या अनु स्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
yamo no gatum prathamo viveda naisha gavyutirapabhartava u |
yatra nah purve pitarah pareyurena jajnanah pathya anu svah ||
verses.en:
Yama first found for us a place to dwell in: this pasture never can be taken from Us.
Men born on earth tread their own paths that lead them whither our ancient Fathers have departed.

verses.sa:
मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङ्गिरोभिर्बृहस्पतिर्ऋक्वभिर्वावृधानः ।
याँश्च देवा वावृधुर्ये च देवान्स्वाहान्ये स्वधयान्ये मदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
matali kavyairyamo angirobhirbrihaspatirrikvabhirvavridhanah |
yanshcha deva vavridhurye cha devansvahanye svadhayanye madanti ||
verses.en:
Mitali prospers there with Kavyas, Yama with Angiras' sons, Brhaspati with Rkvans:
Exalters of the Gods, by Gods exalted, some joy in praise and some in our oblation.

verses.sa:
इमं यम प्रस्तरमा हि सीदाङ्गिरोभिः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
आ त्वा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन्हविषा मादयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
imam yama prastarama hi sidangirobhih pitribhih samvidanah |
a tva mantrah kavishasta vahantvena rajanhavisha madayasva ||
verses.en:
Come, seat thee on this bed of grass, O Yama, in company with Angirases and Fathers.
Let texts recited by the sages bring thee O King, let this oblation make thee joyful.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरोभिरा गहि यज्ञियेभिर्यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व ।
विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता तेऽस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्य ॥
verses.rom:
angirobhira gahi yajniyebhiryama vairupairiha madayasva |
vivasvantam huve yah pita te'sminyajne barhishya nishadya ||
verses.en:
Come, Yama, with the Angirases the Holy, rejoice thee here with children of Virupa.
To sit on sacred grass at this our worship, I call Vivasvan, too, thy Father hither.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः ।
तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
angiraso nah pitaro navagva atharvano bhrigavah somyasah |
tesham vayam sumatau yajniyanamapi bhadre saumanase syama ||
verses.en:
Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrgus who deserve the Soma.
May these, the Holy, look on us with favour, may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्व्येभिर्यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेयुः ।
उभा राजाना स्वधया मदन्ता यमं पश्यासि वरुणं च देवम् ॥
verses.rom:
prehi prehi pathibhih purvyebhiryatra nah purve pitarah pareyuh |
ubha rajana svadhaya madanta yamam pashyasi varunam cha devam ||
verses.en:
Go forth, go forth upon the ancient pathways whereon our sires of old have gone before us.
'Mere shalt thou look on both the Kings enjoying their sacred food, God Varuna and Yama.

verses.sa:
सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योमन् ।
हित्वायावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गच्छस्व तन्वा सुवर्चाः ॥
verses.rom:
sam gachchhasva pitribhih sam yameneshtapurtena parame vyoman |
hitvayavadyam punarastamehi sam gachchhasva tanva suvarchah ||
verses.en:
Meet Yama, meet the Fathers, meet the merit of free or ordered acts, in highest heaven.
Leave sin and evil, seek anew thy dwelling, and bright with glory wear another body.

verses.sa:
अपेत वीत वि च सर्पतातोऽस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन् ।
अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
apeta vita vi cha sarpatato'sma etam pitaro lokamakran |
ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvyaktam yamo dadatyavasanamasmai ||
verses.en:
Go hence, depart ye, fly in all directions: this place for him the Fathers have provided.
Yama bestows on him a place to rest in adorned with days and beams of light and waters.

verses.sa:
अति द्रव सारमेयौ श्वानौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा ।
अथा पितॄन्सुविदत्राँ उपेहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ati drava sarameyau shvanau chaturakshau shabalau sadhuna patha |
atha pitrinsuvidatran upehi yamena ye sadhamadam madanti ||
verses.en:
Run and outspeed the two dogs, Sarama's offspring, brindled, four-eyed, upon thy happy pathway.
Draw nigh then to the gracious-minded Fathers where they rejoice in company with Yama.

verses.sa:
यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिरक्षी नृचक्षसौ ।
ताभ्यामेनं परि देहि राजन्स्वस्ति चास्मा अनमीवं च धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
yau te shvanau yama rakshitarau chaturakshau pathirakshi nrichakshasau |
tabhyamenam pari dehi rajansvasti chasma anamivam cha dhehi ||
verses.en:
And those two dogs of thine, Yama, the watchers, four-eyed, who look on men and guard the pathway,-
Entrust this man, O King, to their protection, and with prosperity and health endow him.

verses.sa:
उरूणसावसुतृपा उदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनाँ अनु ।
तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
urunasavasutripa udumbalau yamasya dutau charato janan anu |
tavasmabhyam drishaye suryaya punardatamasumadyeha bhadram ||
verses.en:
Dark-hued, insatiate, with distended nostrils, Yama's two envoys roam among the People;
May they restore to us a fair existence here and to-day, that we may see the sunlight.

verses.sa:
यमाय सोमं सुनुत यमाय जुहुता हविः ।
यमं ह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः ॥
verses.rom:
yamaya somam sunuta yamaya juhuta havih |
yamam ha yajno gachchhatyagniduto aramkritah ||
verses.en:
To Yama pour the Soma, bring to Yama consecrated gifts:
To Yama sacrifice prepared and heralded by Agni goes.

verses.sa:
यमाय घृतवद्धविर्जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत ।
स नो देवेष्वा यमद्दीर्घमायुः प्र जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yamaya ghritavaddhavirjuhota pra cha tishthata |
sa no deveshva yamaddirghamayuh pra jivase ||
verses.en:
Offer to Yama holy gifts enriched with butter, and draw near:
So may he grant that we may live long days of life among the Gods.

verses.sa:
यमाय मधुमत्तमं राज्ञे हव्यं जुहोतन ।
इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yamaya madhumattamam rajne havyam juhotana |
idam nama rishibhyah purvajebhyah purvebhyah pathikridbhyah ||
verses.en:
Offer to Yama, to the King, oblation very rich in meath:
Bow down before the Rsis of the ancient times, who made this path in days of old.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पतति षळुर्वीरेकमिद्बृहत् ।
त्रिष्टुब्गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आहिता ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukebhih patati shalurvirekamidbrihat |
trishtubgayatri chhandamsi sarva ta yama ahita ||
verses.en:
Into the six Expanses flies the Great One in Trkadrukas.
The Gayatri, the Trstup, all metres in Yama are contained.

verses.sa:
उदीरतामवर उत्परास उन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः ।
असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
udiratamavara utparasa unmadhyamah pitarah somyasah |
asum ya iyuravrika ritajnaste no'vantu pitaro haveshu ||
verses.en:
MAY they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma-
May they who have attained the life of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.

verses.sa:
इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो य उपरास ईयुः ।
ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषत्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु विक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
idam pitribhyo namo astvadya ye purvaso ya uparasa iyuh |
ye parthive rajasya nishatta ye va nunam suvrijanasu vikshu ||
verses.en:
Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed,
Those who have rested in the earthly region, and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.

verses.sa:
आहं पितॄन्सुविदत्राँ अवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः ।
बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
aham pitrinsuvidatran avitsi napatam cha vikramanam cha vishnoh |
barhishado ye svadhaya sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihagamishthah ||
verses.en:
1 have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, I have gained son and progeny from Visnu.
They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

verses.sa:
बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्यर्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम् ।
त आ गतावसा शंतमेनाथा नः शं योररपो दधात ॥
verses.rom:
barhishadah pitara utyarvagima vo havya chakrima jushadhvam |
ta a gatavasa shamtamenatha nah sham yorarapo dadhata ||
verses.en:
Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come, help us: these offerings have we made for you; accept them.
So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.

verses.sa:
उपहूताः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येषु निधिषु प्रियेषु ।
त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
upahutah pitarah somyaso barhishyeshu nidhishu priyeshu |
ta a gamantu ta iha shruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasman ||
verses.en:
May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations.
Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sa:
आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येमं यज्ञमभि गृणीत विश्वे ।
मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम ॥
verses.rom:
achya janu dakshinato nishadyemam yajnamabhi grinita vishve |
ma himsishta pitarah kena chinno yadva agah purushata karama ||
verses.en:
Bowing your bended knees and seated southward, accept this sacrifice of ours with favour.
Punish us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.

verses.sa:
आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात ॥
verses.rom:
asinaso aruninamupasthe rayim dhatta dashushe martyaya |
putrebhyah pitarastasya vasvah pra yachchhata ta ihorjam dadhata ||
verses.en:
Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings, give riches to the man who brings oblations.
Grant to your sons a portion of that treasure, and, present, give them energy, ye Fathers.

verses.sa:
ये नः पूर्वे पितरः सोम्यासोऽनूहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः ।
तेभिर्यमः संरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ye nah purve pitarah somyaso'nuhire somapitham vasishthah |
tebhiryamah samrarano havimshyushannushadbhih pratikamamattu ||
verses.en:
Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet,-
With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

verses.sa:
ये तातृषुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविद स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः ।
आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ्सत्यैः कव्यैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
ye tatrishurdevatra jehamana hotravida stomatashtaso arkaih |
agne yahi suvidatrebhirarvansatyaih kavyaih pitribhirgharmasadbhih ||
verses.en:
Come to us, Agni, with the gracious Fathers who dwell in glowing light, the very Kavyas,
Who thirsted mid the Gods, who hasten hither, oblation winners, theme of singers' praises.

verses.sa:
ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं दधानाः ।
आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः परैः पूर्वैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
ye satyaso havirado havishpa indrena devaih saratham dadhanah |
agne yahi sahasram devavandaih paraih purvaih pitribhirgharmasadbhih ||
verses.en:
Come, Agni, come with countless ancient Fathers, dwellers in light, primeval, God-adorers,
Eaters and drinkers of oblations, truthful, who travel with the Deities and Indra.

verses.sa:
अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
अत्ता हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिष्यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं दधातन ॥
verses.rom:
agnishvattah pitara eha gachchhata sadahsadah sadata supranitayah |
atta havimshi prayatani barhishyatha rayim sarvaviram dadhatana ||
verses.en:
Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place.
Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न ईळितो जातवेदोऽवाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वी ।
प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagna ilito jatavedo'vaddhavyani surabhini kritvi |
pradah pitribhyah svadhaya te akshannaddhi tvam deva prayata havimshi ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni Jatavedas, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant,
And give them to the Fathers who did cat them with Svadha. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

verses.sa:
ये चेह पितरो ये च नेह याँश्च विद्म याँ उ च न प्रविद्म ।
त्वं वेत्थ यति ते जातवेदः स्वधाभिर्यज्ञं सुकृतं जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
ye cheha pitaro ye cha neha yanshcha vidma yan u cha na pravidma |
tvam vettha yati te jatavedah svadhabhiryajnam sukritam jushasva ||
verses.en:
Thou, Jatavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent,
Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not: accept the sacrifice well prepared with portions.

verses.sa:
ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते ।
तेभिः स्वराळसुनीतिमेतां यथावशं तन्वं कल्पयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
ye agnidagdha ye anagnidagdha madhye divah svadhaya madayante |
tebhih svaralasunitimetam yathavasham tanvam kalpayasva ||
verses.en:
They who, consumed by fire or not cremated, joy in their offering in the midst of heaven,-
Grant them, O Sovran Lord, the world of spirits and their own body, as thy pleasure wills it.

verses.sa:
मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शोचो मास्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम् ।
यदा शृतं कृणवो जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्र हिणुतात्पितृभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
mainamagne vi daho mabhi shocho masya tvacham chikshipo ma shariram |
yada shritam krinavo jatavedo'themenam pra hinutatpitribhyah ||
verses.en:
Burn him not up, nor quite consume him, Agni: let not his body or his skin be scattered.
O Jatavedas, when thou hast matured him, then send him on his way unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
शृतं यदा करसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं परि दत्तात्पितृभ्यः ।
यदा गच्छात्यसुनीतिमेतामथा देवानां वशनीर्भवाति ॥
verses.rom:
shritam yada karasi jatavedo'themenam pari dattatpitribhyah |
yada gachchhatyasunitimetamatha devanam vashanirbhavati ||
verses.en:
When thou hast made him ready, Jatavedas, then do thou give him over to the Fathers.
When he attains unto the life that waits him, he shall become the Deities' controller.

verses.sa:
सूर्यं चक्षुर्गच्छतु वातमात्मा द्यां च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मणा ।
अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः ॥
verses.rom:
suryam chakshurgachchhatu vatamatma dyam cha gachchha prithivim cha dharmana |
apo va gachchha yadi tatra te hitamoshadhishu prati tishtha shariraih ||
verses.en:
The Sun receive thine eye, the Wind thy spirit; go, as thy merit is, to earth or heaven.
Go, if it be thy lot, unto the waters; go, make thine home in plants with all thy members.

verses.sa:
अजो भागस्तपसा तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः ।
यास्ते शिवास्तन्वो जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनं सुकृतामु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajo bhagastapasa tam tapasva tam te shochistapatu tam te archih |
yaste shivastanvo jatavedastabhirvahainam sukritamu lokam ||
verses.en:
Thy portion is the goat: with heat consume him: let thy fierce flame, thy glowing splendour, burn him
With thine auspicious forms, o Jatavedas, bear this man to the region of the pious.

verses.sa:
अव सृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधाभिः ।
आयुर्वसान उप वेतु शेषः सं गच्छतां तन्वा जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
ava srija punaragne pitribhyo yasta ahutashcharati svadhabhih |
ayurvasana upa vetu sheshah sam gachchhatam tanva jatavedah ||
verses.en:
Again, O Agni, to the Fathers send him who, offered in thee, goes with our oblations.
Wearing new life let him increase his offspring: let him rejoin a body, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
यत्ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः ।
अग्निष्टद्विश्वादगदं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणाँ आविवेश ॥
verses.rom:
yatte krishnah shakuna atutoda pipilah sarpa uta va shvapadah |
agnishtadvishvadagadam krinotu somashcha yo brahmanan avivesha ||
verses.en:
What wound soe'er the dark bird hath inflicted, the emmet, or the serpent, or the jackal,
May Agni who devoureth all things heal it and Soma who hath passed into the Brahmans.

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं प्रोर्णुष्व पीवसा मेदसा च ।
नेत्त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधृग्विधक्ष्यन्पर्यङ्खयाते ॥
verses.rom:
agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva sam prornushva pivasa medasa cha |
nettva dhrishnurharasa jarhrishano dadhrigvidhakshyanparyankhayate ||
verses.en:
Shield thee with flesh against the flames of Agni, encompass thee about with fat and marrow,
So will the Bold One, eager to attack thee with fierce glow fail to girdle and consume thee.

verses.sa:
इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम् ।
एष यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन्देवा अमृता मादयन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
imamagne chamasam ma vi jihvarah priyo devanamuta somyanam |
esha yashchamaso devapanastasmindeva amrita madayante ||
verses.en:
Forbear, O Agni, to upset this ladle: the Gods and they who merit Soma love it.
This ladle, this which serves the Gods to drink from, in this the Immortal Deities rejoice them.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः ।
इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
kravyadamagnim pra hinomi duram yamarajno gachchhatu ripravahah |
ihaivayamitaro jataveda devebhyo havyam vahatu prajanan ||
verses.en:
1 send afar flesh eating Agni, bearing off stains may he depart to Yama's subjects.
But let this other Jatavedas carry oblation to the Gods, for he is skillful.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः क्रव्यात्प्रविवेश वो गृहमिमं पश्यन्नितरं जातवेदसम् ।
तं हरामि पितृयज्ञाय देवं स घर्ममिन्वात्परमे सधस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnih kravyatpravivesha vo grihamimam pashyannitaram jatavedasam |
tam harami pitriyajnaya devam sa gharmaminvatparame sadhasthe ||
verses.en:
I choose as God for Father-worship Agni, flesh-eater, who hath past within your dwelling,
While looking on this other Jatavedas. Let him light flames in the supreme assembly.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः क्रव्यवाहनः पितॄन्यक्षदृतावृधः ।
प्रेदु हव्यानि वोचति देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्य आ ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnih kravyavahanah pitrinyakshadritavridhah |
predu havyani vochati devebhyashcha pitribhya a ||
verses.en:
With offerings meet let Agni bring the Fathers who support the Law.
Let him announce oblations paid to Fathers and to Deities.

verses.sa:
उशन्तस्त्वा नि धीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि ।
उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन्हविषे अत्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
ushantastva ni dhimahyushantah samidhimahi |
ushannushata a vaha pitrinhavishe attave ||
verses.en:
Right gladly would we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow.
Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to cat the food of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापया पुनः ।
कियाम्ब्वत्र रोहतु पाकदूर्वा व्यल्कशा ॥
verses.rom:
yam tvamagne samadahastamu nirvapaya punah |
kiyambvatra rohatu pakadurva vyalkasha ||
verses.en:
Cool, Agni, and again refresh the spot which thou hast scorched and burnt.
Here let the water-lily grow, and tender grass and leafy herb.

verses.sa:
शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादिके ह्लादिकावति ।
मण्डूक्या सु सं गम इमं स्वग्निं हर्षय ॥
verses.rom:
shitike shitikavati hladike hladikavati |
mandukya su sam gama imam svagnim harshaya ||
verses.en:
O full of coolness, thou cool Plant, full of fresh moisture, freshening Herb,
Come hither with the female frog: fill with delight this Agni here.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं कृणोतीतीदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति ।
यमस्य माता पर्युह्यमाना महो जाया विवस्वतो ननाश ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta duhitre vahatum krinotitidam vishvam bhuvanam sameti |
yamasya mata paryuhyamana maho jaya vivasvato nanasha ||
verses.en:
TVASTAR prepares the bridal of his Daughter: all the world hears the tidings and assembles.
But Yama's Mother, Spouse of great Vivasvan, vanished as she was carried to her dwelling.

verses.sa:
अपागूहन्नमृतां मर्त्येभ्यः कृत्वी सवर्णामददुर्विवस्वते ।
उताश्विनावभरद्यत्तदासीदजहादु द्वा मिथुना सरण्यूः ॥
verses.rom:
apaguhannamritam martyebhyah kritvi savarnamadadurvivasvate |
utashvinavabharadyattadasidajahadu dva mithuna saranyuh ||
verses.en:
From mortal men they hid the Immortal Lady, made one like her and gave her to Vivasvan.
Saranyu brought to him the Asvin brothers, and then deserted both twinned pairs of children.

verses.sa:
पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्र विद्वाननष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
स त्वैतेभ्यः परि ददत्पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रियेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pusha tvetashchyavayatu pra vidvananashtapashurbhuvanasya gopah |
sa tvaitebhyah pari dadatpitribhyo'gnirdevebhyah suvidatriyebhyah ||
verses.en:
Guard of the world, whose cattle ne'er are injured, may Pusan bear thee hence, for he hath knowledge.
May he consign thee to these Fathers' keeping, and to the gracious Gods let Agni give thee.

verses.sa:
आयुर्विश्वायुः परि पासति त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात् ।
यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र ते ययुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
ayurvishvayuh pari pasati tva pusha tva patu prapathe purastat |
yatrasate sukrito yatra te yayustatra tva devah savita dadhatu ||
verses.en:
May Ayu, giver of all life, protect thee, and bear thee forward on the distant pathway.
Thither let Savitar the God transport thee, where dwell the pious who have passed-before thee.

verses.sa:
पूषेमा आशा अनु वेद सर्वाः सो अस्माँ अभयतमेन नेषत् ।
स्वस्तिदा आघृणिः सर्ववीरोऽप्रयुच्छन्पुर एतु प्रजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
pushema asha anu veda sarvah so asman abhayatamena neshat |
svastida aghrinih sarvaviro'prayuchchhanpura etu prajanan ||
verses.en:
Pusan knows all these realms: may he conduct us by ways that are most free from fear and danger.
Giver of blessings, glowing, all-heroic, may he, the wise and watchful, go before us.

verses.sa:
प्रपथे पथामजनिष्ट पूषा प्रपथे दिवः प्रपथे पृथिव्याः ।
उभे अभि प्रियतमे सधस्थे आ च परा च चरति प्रजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
prapathe pathamajanishta pusha prapathe divah prapathe prithivyah |
ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe a cha para cha charati prajanan ||
verses.en:
Pusan was born to move on distant pathways, on the road far from earth and far from heaven.
To both most wonted places of assembly he travels and returns with perfect knowledge.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
सरस्वतीं सुकृतो अह्वयन्त सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात् ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatim devayanto havante sarasvatimadhvare tayamane |
sarasvatim sukrito ahvayanta sarasvati dashushe varyam dat ||
verses.en:
The pious call Sarasvati, they worship Sarasvati while sacrifice proceedeth.
The pious called Sarasvati aforetime. Sarasvati send bliss to him who giveth.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथ स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयस्वानमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvati ya saratham yayatha svadhabhirdevi pitribhirmadanti |
asadyasminbarhishi madayasvanamiva isha a dhehyasme ||
verses.en:
Sarasvati, who camest with the Fathers, with them rejoicing thee in our oblations,
Seated upon this sacred grass be joyful, and give us strengthening food that brings no sickness.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं यां पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
सहस्रार्घमिळो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvatim yam pitaro havante dakshina yajnamabhinakshamanah |
sahasrarghamilo atra bhagam rayasposham yajamaneshu dhehi ||
verses.en:
Thou, called on as Sarasvati by Fathers who come right forward to our solemn service,
Give food and wealth to present sacrificers, a portion, worth a thousand, of refreshment.

verses.sa:
आपो अस्मान्मातरः शुन्धयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु ।
विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि ॥
verses.rom:
apo asmanmatarah shundhayantu ghritena no ghritapvah punantu |
vishvam hi ripram pravahanti devirudidabhyah shuchira puta emi ||
verses.en:
The Mother Floods shall make us bright and shining, cleansers of holy oil, with oil shall cleanse us:
For, Goddesses, they bear off all defilement: I, rise up from them purified and brightened.

verses.sa:
द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द प्रथमाँ अनु द्यूनिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः ।
समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः ॥
verses.rom:
drapsashchaskanda prathaman anu dyunimam cha yonimanu yashcha purvah |
samanam yonimanu samcharantam drapsam juhomyanu sapta hotrah ||
verses.en:
Through days of earliest date the Drop descended on this place and on that which was before it.
I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop which still to one same place is moving.

verses.sa:
यस्ते द्रप्स स्कन्दति यस्ते अंशुर्बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् ।
अध्वर्योर्वा परि वा यः पवित्रात्तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste drapsa skandati yaste amshurbahuchyuto dhishanaya upasthat |
adhvaryorva pari va yah pavitrattam te juhomi manasa vashatkritam ||
verses.en:
The Drop that falls, thy stalk which arms have shaken, which from the bosom of the press hath fallen,
Or from the Adhvaryu's purifying filter, I offer thee with heart and cry of Vasat!

verses.sa:
यस्ते द्रप्स स्कन्नो यस्ते अंशुरवश्च यः परः स्रुचा ।
अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः सं तं सिञ्चतु राधसे ॥
verses.rom:
yaste drapsa skanno yaste amshuravashcha yah parah srucha |
ayam devo brihaspatih sam tam sinchatu radhase ||
verses.en:
That fallen Drop of thine, the stalk which from the ladle fell away,
This present God Brhaspati shall pour it forth to make us rich.

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन्मामकं वचः ।
अपां पयस्वदित्पयस्तेन मा सह शुन्धत ॥
verses.rom:
payasvatiroshadhayah payasvanmamakam vachah |
apam payasvaditpayastena ma saha shundhata ||
verses.en:
The plants of earth are rich in milk, and rich in milk is this my speech;
And rich in milk the essence of the Waters: make me pure therewith.

verses.sa:
परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्ते स्व इतरो देवयानात् ।
चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान् ॥
verses.rom:
param mrityo anu parehi pantham yaste sva itaro devayanat |
chakshushmate shrinvate te bravimi ma nah prajam ririsho mota viran ||
verses.en:
Go hence, O Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from that which Gods are wont to travel.
To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest: Touch not our offspring, injure not our heroes.

verses.sa:
मृत्योः पदं योपयन्तो यदैत द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ।
आप्यायमानाः प्रजया धनेन शुद्धाः पूता भवत यज्ञियासः ॥
verses.rom:
mrityoh padam yopayanto yadaita draghiya ayuh prataram dadhanah |
apyayamanah prajaya dhanena shuddhah puta bhavata yajniyasah ||
verses.en:
As ye have come effacing Mrtyu's footstep, to further times prolonging your existence,
May ye be rich in children and possessions. cleansed, purified, and meet for sacrificing.

verses.sa:
इमे जीवा वि मृतैराववृत्रन्नभूद्भद्रा देवहूतिर्नो अद्य ।
प्राञ्चो अगाम नृतये हसाय द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ॥
verses.rom:
ime jiva vi mritairavavritrannabhudbhadra devahutirno adya |
prancho agama nritaye hasaya draghiya ayuh prataram dadhanah ||
verses.en:
Divided from the dead are these, the living: now be our calling on the Gods successful.
We have gone forth for dancing and for laughter, to further times prolonging our existence.

verses.sa:
इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरो अर्थमेतम् ।
शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीरन्तर्मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन ॥
verses.rom:
imam jivebhyah paridhim dadhami maisham nu gadaparo arthametam |
shatam jivantu sharadah puruchirantarmrityum dadhatam parvatena ||
verses.en:
Here I erect this rampart for the living; let none of these, none other, reach this limit.
May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may they bury Death beneath this mountain.

verses.sa:
यथाहान्यनुपूर्वं भवन्ति यथ ऋतव ऋतुभिर्यन्ति साधु ।
यथा न पूर्वमपरो जहात्येवा धातरायूंषि कल्पयैषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathahanyanupurvam bhavanti yatha ritava ritubhiryanti sadhu |
yatha na purvamaparo jahatyeva dhatarayumshi kalpayaisham ||
verses.en:
As the days follow days in close succession, as with the seasons duly come the seasons,
As each successor fails not his foregoer, so form the lives of these, O great Ordainer.

verses.sa:
आ रोहतायुर्जरसं वृणाना अनुपूर्वं यतमाना यति ष्ठ ।
इह त्वष्टा सुजनिमा सजोषा दीर्घमायुः करति जीवसे वः ॥
verses.rom:
a rohatayurjarasam vrinana anupurvam yatamana yati shtha |
iha tvashta sujanima sajosha dirghamayuh karati jivase vah ||
verses.en:
Live your full lives up! find old age delightful, all of you striving one behind the other.
May Tvastar, maker of fair things, be gracious and lengthen out the days of your existence.

verses.sa:
इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं विशन्तु ।
अनश्रवोऽनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे ॥
verses.rom:
ima nariravidhavah supatniranjanena sarpisha sam vishantu |
anashravo'namivah suratna a rohantu janayo yonimagre ||
verses.en:
Let these unwidowed dames with noble husbands adorn themselves with fragrant balm and unguent.
Decked with fair jewels, tearless, free from sorrow, first let the dames go up to where he lieth.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्व नार्यभि जीवलोकं गतासुमेतमुप शेष एहि ।
हस्तग्राभस्य दिधिषोस्तवेदं पत्युर्जनित्वमभि सं बभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
udirshva naryabhi jivalokam gatasumetamupa shesha ehi |
hastagrabhasya didhishostavedam patyurjanitvamabhi sam babhutha ||
verses.en:
Rise, come unto the world of life, O woman: come, he is lifeless by whose side thou liest.
Wifehood with this thy husband was thy portion, who took thy hand and wooed thee as a lover.

verses.sa:
धनुर्हस्तादाददानो मृतस्यास्मे क्षत्राय वर्चसे बलाय ।
अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुवीरा विश्वा स्पृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
dhanurhastadadadano mritasyasme kshatraya varchase balaya |
atraiva tvamiha vayam suvira vishva spridho abhimatirjayema ||
verses.en:
From his dead hand I take the bow be carried, that it may be our power and might and glory.
There art thou, there; and here with noble heroes may we o'ercome all hosts that fight against us.

verses.sa:
उप सर्प मातरं भूमिमेतामुरुव्यचसं पृथिवीं सुशेवाम् ।
ऊर्णम्रदा युवतिर्दक्षिणावत एषा त्वा पातु निरृतेरुपस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
upa sarpa mataram bhumimetamuruvyachasam prithivim sushevam |
urnamrada yuvatirdakshinavata esha tva patu nirriterupasthat ||
verses.en:
Betake thee to the lap of Earth the Mother, of Earth far-spreading, very kind and gracious.
Young Dame, wool-soft unto the guerdon giver, may she preserve thee from Destruction's bosom.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चस्व पृथिवि मा नि बाधथाः सूपायनास्मै भव सूपवञ्चना ।
माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाभ्येनं भूम ऊर्णुहि ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhvanchasva prithivi ma ni badhathah supayanasmai bhava supavanchana |
mata putram yatha sichabhyenam bhuma urnuhi ||
verses.en:
Heave thyself, Earth, nor press thee downward heavily: afford him easy access, gently tending him.
Cover him, as a mother wraps her skirt about her child, O Earth.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चमाना पृथिवी सु तिष्ठतु सहस्रं मित उप हि श्रयन्ताम् ।
ते गृहासो घृतश्चुतो भवन्तु विश्वाहास्मै शरणाः सन्त्वत्र ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhvanchamana prithivi su tishthatu sahasram mita upa hi shrayantam |
te grihaso ghritashchuto bhavantu vishvahasmai sharanah santvatra ||
verses.en:
Now let the heaving earth be free from motion: yea,- let a thousand clods remain above him.
Be they to him a home distilling fatness, here let them ever be his place of refuge.

verses.sa:
उत्ते स्तभ्नामि पृथिवीं त्वत्परीमं लोगं निदधन्मो अहं रिषम् ।
एतां स्थूणां पितरो धारयन्तु तेऽत्रा यमः सादना ते मिनोतु ॥
verses.rom:
utte stabhnami prithivim tvatparimam logam nidadhanmo aham risham |
etam sthunam pitaro dharayantu te'tra yamah sadana te minotu ||
verses.en:
I stay the earth from thee, while over thee I place this piece of earth. May I be free from injury.
Here let the Fathers keep this pillar firm for thee, and there let Yama make thee an abiding-place.

verses.sa:
प्रतीचीने मामहनीष्वाः पर्णमिवा दधुः ।
प्रतीचीं जग्रभा वाचमश्वं रशनया यथा ॥
verses.rom:
pratichine mamahanishvah parnamiva dadhuh |
pratichim jagrabha vachamashvam rashanaya yatha ||
verses.en:
Even as an arrow's feathers, they have set me on a fitting day.
The fit word have I caught and held as 'twere a courser with the rein.

verses.sa:
नि वर्तध्वं मानु गातास्मान्सिषक्त रेवतीः ।
अग्नीषोमा पुनर्वसू अस्मे धारयतं रयिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni vartadhvam manu gatasmansishakta revatih |
agnishoma punarvasu asme dharayatam rayim ||
verses.en:
TURN, go not farther on your way: visit us, O ye Wealthy Ones.
Agni and Soma, ye who bring riches again, secure us wealth.

verses.sa:
पुनरेना नि वर्तय पुनरेना न्या कुरु ।
इन्द्र एणा नि यच्छत्वग्निरेना उपाजतु ॥
verses.rom:
punarena ni vartaya punarena nya kuru |
indra ena ni yachchhatvagnirena upajatu ||
verses.en:
Make these return to us again, bring them beside us once again.
May. Indra give them back to us, and Agni drive them hither-ward.

verses.sa:
पुनरेता नि वर्तन्तामस्मिन्पुष्यन्तु गोपतौ ।
इहैवाग्ने नि धारयेह तिष्ठतु या रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
punareta ni vartantamasminpushyantu gopatau |
ihaivagne ni dharayeha tishthatu ya rayih ||
verses.en:
Let them return to us again: under this herdsman let them feed.
Do thou, O Agni, keep them here, and let the wealth we have remain.

verses.sa:
यन्नियानं न्ययनं संज्ञानं यत्परायणम् ।
आवर्तनं निवर्तनं यो गोपा अपि तं हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
yanniyanam nyayanam samjnanam yatparayanam |
avartanam nivartanam yo gopa api tam huve ||
verses.en:
1 call upon their herdsman, him who knoweth well their coming nigh,
Their parting and their home-return, and watcheth their approach and rest.

verses.sa:
य उदानड्व्ययनं य उदानट् परायणम् ।
आवर्तनं निवर्तनमपि गोपा नि वर्तताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya udanadvyayanam ya udanat parayanam |
avartanam nivartanamapi gopa ni vartatam ||
verses.en:
Yea, let the herdsman, too, return, who marketh well their driving-forth;
Marketh their wandering away, their turning back and coming home.

verses.sa:
आ निवर्त नि वर्तय पुनर्न इन्द्र गा देहि ।
जीवाभिर्भुनजामहै ॥
verses.rom:
a nivarta ni vartaya punarna indra ga dehi |
jivabhirbhunajamahai ||
verses.en:
Home-leader, lead them home to us; Indra, restore to us our kine:
We will rejoice in them alive.

verses.sa:
परि वो विश्वतो दध ऊर्जा घृतेन पयसा ।
ये देवाः के च यज्ञियास्ते रय्या सं सृजन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
pari vo vishvato dadha urja ghritena payasa |
ye devah ke cha yajniyaste rayya sam srijantu nah ||
verses.en:
1 offer you on every side butter and milk and strengthening food.
May all the Holy Deities pour down on us a flood of wealth.

verses.sa:
आ निवर्तन वर्तय नि निवर्तन वर्तय ।
भूम्याश्चतस्रः प्रदिशस्ताभ्य एना नि वर्तय ॥
verses.rom:
a nivartana vartaya ni nivartana vartaya |
bhumyashchatasrah pradishastabhya ena ni vartaya ||
verses.en:
O thou Home-leader, lead them home, restore them thou who bringest home.
Four are the quarters of the earth; from these bring back to us our kine,

verses.sa: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनः ॥
verses.rom: bhadram no api vataya manah ||
