verses.en: SEND unto us a good and happy mind.

verses.sa:
अग्निमीळे भुजां यविष्ठं शासा मित्रं दुर्धरीतुम् ।
यस्य धर्मन्स्वरेनीः सपर्यन्ति मातुरूधः ॥
verses.rom:
agnimile bhujam yavishtham shasa mitram durdharitum |
yasya dharmansvarenih saparyanti maturudhah ||
verses.en:
I worship Agni, Youthfullest of Gods, resistless, Friend of laws;
Under whose guard and heavenly light the Spotted seek the Mother's breast:

verses.sa:
यमासा कृपनीळं भासाकेतुं वर्धयन्ति ।
भ्राजते श्रेणिदन् ॥
verses.rom:
yamasa kripanilam bhasaketum vardhayanti |
bhrajate shrenidan ||
verses.en:
Whom with their mouth they magnify, bannered with flame and homed in light.
He glitters with his row of teeth.

verses.sa:
अर्यो विशां गातुरेति प्र यदानड्दिवो अन्तान् ।
कविरभ्रं दीद्यानः ॥
verses.rom:
aryo visham gatureti pra yadanaddivo antan |
kavirabhram didyanah ||
verses.en:
Kind, Furtherer of men, he comes, when he hath reached the ends of heaven,
Sage, giving splendour to the clouds.

verses.sa:
जुषद्धव्या मानुषस्योर्ध्वस्तस्थावृभ्वा यज्ञे ।
मिन्वन्सद्म पुर एति ॥
verses.rom:
jushaddhavya manushasyordhvastasthavribhva yajne |
minvansadma pura eti ||
verses.en:
To taste man's offerings, he, the Strong, hath risen erect at sacrifice:
Fixing his dwelling he proceeds.

verses.sa:
स हि क्षेमो हविर्यज्ञः श्रुष्टीदस्य गातुरेति ।
अग्निं देवा वाशीमन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi kshemo haviryajnah shrushtidasya gatureti |
agnim deva vashimantam ||
verses.en:
Here are oblation, worship, rest: rapidly comes his furtherance.
To sword-armed Agni come the Gods.

verses.sa:
यज्ञासाहं दुव इषेऽग्निं पूर्वस्य शेवस्य ।
अद्रेः सूनुमायुमाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasaham duva ishe'gnim purvasya shevasya |
adreh sunumayumahuh ||
verses.en:
With service for chief bliss I seek the Lord of Sacrifice, Agni, whom
They call the Living, Son of Cloud.

verses.sa:
नरो ये के चास्मदा विश्वेत्ते वाम आ स्युः ।
अग्निं हविषा वर्धन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
naro ye ke chasmada vishvette vama a syuh |
agnim havisha vardhantah ||
verses.en:
Blest evermore be all the men who come from us, who magnify
Agni with sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa:
कृष्णः श्वेतोऽरुषो यामो अस्य ब्रध्न ऋज्र उत शोणो यशस्वान् ।
हिरण्यरूपं जनिता जजान ॥
verses.rom:
krishnah shveto'rusho yamo asya bradhna rijra uta shono yashasvan |
hiranyarupam janita jajana ||
verses.en:
The path he treads is black and white and red, and striped, and brown, crimson, and glorious.
His sire begat him bright with hues of gold.

verses.sa:
एवा ते अग्ने विमदो मनीषामूर्जो नपादमृतेभिः सजोषाः ।
गिर आ वक्षत्सुमतीरियान इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः ॥
verses.rom:
eva te agne vimado manishamurjo napadamritebhih sajoshah |
gira a vakshatsumatiriyana ishamurjam sukshitim vishvamabhah ||
verses.en:
Thus with his thoughts, O Son of Strength, O Agni, hath Vimada, accordant with the Immortals,
Offered thee hymns, soliciting thy favour. Thou hast brought all food, strength, a prosperous dwelling.

verses.sa:
आग्निं न स्ववृक्तिभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ।
यज्ञाय स्तीर्णबर्हिषे वि वो मदे शीरं पावकशोचिषं विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
agnim na svavriktibhirhotaram tva vrinimahe |
yajnaya stirnabarhishe vi vo made shiram pavakashochisham vivakshase ||
verses.en:
WITH offerings of our own we choose thee, Agni, as Invoking Priest,
For sacrifice with trimmed grass,-at your glad carouse-piercing and brightly shining. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वामु ते स्वाभुवः शुम्भन्त्यश्वराधसः ।
वेति त्वामुपसेचनी वि वो मद ऋजीतिरग्न आहुतिर्विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamu te svabhuvah shumbhantyashvaradhasah |
veti tvamupasechani vi vo mada rijitiragna ahutirvivakshase ||
verses.en:
The wealthy ones adorn thee, they who bring us horses as their gift:
The sprinkling ladle, Agni,-at your glad carouse -and glowing offering taste thee. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वे धर्माण आसते जुहूभिः सिञ्चतीरिव ।
कृष्णा रूपाण्यर्जुना वि वो मदे विश्वा अधि श्रियो धिषे विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tve dharmana asate juhubhih sinchatiriva |
krishna rupanyarjuna vi vo made vishva adhi shriyo dhishe vivakshase ||
verses.en:
The holy statutes rest by thee, as 'twere with ladles that o'erflow.
Black and white-gleaming colours,-at your glad carouse-all glories thou assumest. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
यमग्ने मन्यसे रयिं सहसावन्नमर्त्य ।
तमा नो वाजसातये वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु चित्रमा भरा विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
yamagne manyase rayim sahasavannamartya |
tama no vajasataye vi vo made yajneshu chitrama bhara vivakshase ||
verses.en:
O Agni, what thou deemest wealth, Victorious and Immortal One!
Bring thou to give us vigour,-at your glad carouse -splendid at sacrifices. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जातो अथर्वणा विदद्विश्वानि काव्या ।
भुवद्दूतो विवस्वतो वि वो मदे प्रियो यमस्य काम्यो विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjato atharvana vidadvishvani kavya |
bhuvadduto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kamyo vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Skilled in all lore is Agni, he whom erst Atharvan brought to life.
He was Vivasvan's envoy, at your glad carouse-the well-loved friend of Yama, Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञेष्वीळतेऽग्ने प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
त्वं वसूनि काम्या वि वो मदे विश्वा दधासि दाशुषे विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yajneshvilate'gne prayatyadhvare |
tvam vasuni kamya vi vo made vishva dadhasi dashushe vivakshase ||
verses.en:
At sacrifices they adore thee, Agni, when the rite proceeds.
All fair and lovely treasures-at your glad carouse-thou givest him who offers. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञेष्वृत्विजं चारुमग्ने नि षेदिरे ।
घृतप्रतीकं मनुषो वि वो मदे शुक्रं चेतिष्ठमक्षभिर्विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yajneshvritvijam charumagne ni shedire |
ghritapratikam manusho vi vo made shukram chetishthamakshabhirvivakshase ||
verses.en:
Men, Agni, have established thee as welcome Priest at holy rites,
Thee whose face shines with butter,-at your glad carouse-bright, with eyes most observant. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषोरु प्रथयसे बृहत् ।
अभिक्रन्दन्वृषायसे वि वो मदे गर्भं दधासि जामिषु विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
agne shukrena shochishoru prathayase brihat |
abhikrandanvrishayase vi vo made garbham dadhasi jamishu vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Wide and aloft thou spreadest thee, O Agni, with thy brilliant flame.
A Bull art thou when bellowing,-at your glad carouse-thou dost impregn the Sisters. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
कुह श्रुत इन्द्रः कस्मिन्नद्य जने मित्रो न श्रूयते ।
ऋषीणां वा यः क्षये गुहा वा चर्कृषे गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
kuha shruta indrah kasminnadya jane mitro na shruyate |
rishinam va yah kshaye guha va charkrishe gira ||
verses.en:
WHERE is famed Indra heard of? With what folk is he renowned to-day as Mitra is,-
Who in the home of Rsis and in secret is extolled with song?

verses.sa:
इह श्रुत इन्द्रो अस्मे अद्य स्तवे वज्र्यृचीषमः ।
मित्रो न यो जनेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या ॥
verses.rom:
iha shruta indro asme adya stave vajryrichishamah |
mitro na yo janeshva yashashchakre asamya ||
verses.en:
Even here is Indra famed, and among us this day the glorious Thunderer is praised,
He who like Mitra mid the folk hath won complete and full renown.

verses.sa:
महो यस्पतिः शवसो असाम्या महो नृम्णस्य तूतुजिः ।
भर्ता वज्रस्य धृष्णोः पिता पुत्रमिव प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
maho yaspatih shavaso asamya maho nrimnasya tutujih |
bharta vajrasya dhrishnoh pita putramiva priyam ||
verses.en:
He who is Sovran Lord of great and perfect strength, exerter of heroic might,
Who bears the fearless thunder as a father bears his darling son.

verses.sa:
युजानो अश्वा वातस्य धुनी देवो देवस्य वज्रिवः ।
स्यन्ता पथा विरुक्मता सृजान स्तोष्यध्वनः ॥
verses.rom:
yujano ashva vatasya dhuni devo devasya vajrivah |
syanta patha virukmata srijana stoshyadhvanah ||
verses.en:
Harnessing to thy car, as God, two blustering Steeds Of the Wind-God, O Thunderer,
That speed along the shining path, thou making ways art glorified.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्या चिद्वातस्याश्वागा ऋज्रा त्मना वहध्यै ।
ययोर्देवो न मर्त्यो यन्ता नकिर्विदाय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tya chidvatasyashvaga rijra tmana vahadhyai |
yayordevo na martyo yanta nakirvidayyah ||
verses.en:
Even to these dark Steeds of Wind thou of thyself hast come to ride,
Of which no driver may be found, none, be he God or mortal man.

verses.sa:
अध ग्मन्तोशना पृच्छते वां कदर्था न आ गृहम् ।
आ जग्मथुः पराकाद्दिवश्च ग्मश्च मर्त्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
adha gmantoshana prichchhate vam kadartha na a griham |
a jagmathuh parakaddivashcha gmashcha martyam ||
verses.en:
When ye approach, men ask you, thee and Usana: Why come ye to our dwelling-place?
Why are ye come to mortal man from distant realms of earth and heaven?

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्र पृक्षसेऽस्माकं ब्रह्मोद्यतम् ।
तत्त्वा याचामहेऽवः शुष्णं यद्धन्नमानुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
a na indra prikshase'smakam brahmodyatam |
tattva yachamahe'vah shushnam yaddhannamanusham ||
verses.en:
O Indra, thou shalt speak us fair: our holy prayer is offered up.
We pray to thee for help as thou didst strike the monster Susna dead.

verses.sa:
अकर्मा दस्युरभि नो अमन्तुरन्यव्रतो अमानुषः ।
त्वं तस्यामित्रहन्वधर्दासस्य दम्भय ॥
verses.rom:
akarma dasyurabhi no amanturanyavrato amanushah |
tvam tasyamitrahanvadhardasasya dambhaya ||
verses.en:
Around us is the Dasyu, riteless, void of sense, inhuman, keeping alien laws.
Baffle, thou Slayer of the foe, the weapon which this Dasa wields.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र शूर शूरैरुत त्वोतासो बर्हणा ।
पुरुत्रा ते वि पूर्तयो नवन्त क्षोणयो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra shura shurairuta tvotaso barhana |
purutra te vi purtayo navanta kshonayo yatha ||
verses.en:
Hero with Heroes, thou art ours: yea, strong are they whom thou dost help.
In many a place are thy full gifts, and men, like vassals, sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
त्वं तान्वृत्रहत्ये चोदयो नॄन्कार्पाणे शूर वज्रिवः ।
गुहा यदी कवीनां विशां नक्षत्रशवसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tanvritrahatye chodayo nrinkarpane shura vajrivah |
guha yadi kavinam visham nakshatrashavasam ||
verses.en:
Urge thou these heroes on to slay the enemy, brave Thunderer! in the fight with swords.
Even when hid among the tribes of Sages numerous as stars.

verses.sa:
मक्षू ता त इन्द्र दानाप्नस आक्षाणे शूर वज्रिवः ।
यद्ध शुष्णस्य दम्भयो जातं विश्वं सयावभिः ॥
verses.rom:
makshu ta ta indra danapnasa akshane shura vajrivah |
yaddha shushnasya dambhayo jatam vishvam sayavabhih ||
verses.en:
Swift come those gifts of thine whose hand is prompt to rend and burn, O Hero Thunder-armed:
As thou with thy Companions didst destroy the whole of Susna's brood.

verses.sa:
माकुध्र्यगिन्द्र शूर वस्वीरस्मे भूवन्नभिष्टयः ।
वयंवयं त आसां सुम्ने स्याम वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
makudhryagindra shura vasvirasme bhuvannabhishtayah |
vayamvayam ta asam sumne syama vajrivah ||
verses.en:
Let not thine excellent assistance come to us, O Hero Indra, profitless.
May we, may we enjoy the bliss of these thy favours, Thunderer!

verses.sa:
अस्मे ता त इन्द्र सन्तु सत्याहिंसन्तीरुपस्पृशः ।
विद्याम यासां भुजो धेनूनां न वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
asme ta ta indra santu satyahimsantirupasprishah |
vidyama yasam bhujo dhenunam na vajrivah ||
verses.en:
May those soft impulses of thine, O Indra, be fruitful and innocent to us.
May we know these whose treasures are like those of milch-kine, Thunderer!

verses.sa:
अहस्ता यदपदी वर्धत क्षाः शचीभिर्वेद्यानाम् ।
शुष्णं परि प्रदक्षिणिद्विश्वायवे नि शिश्नथः ॥
verses.rom:
ahasta yadapadi vardhata kshah shachibhirvedyanam |
shushnam pari pradakshinidvishvayave ni shishnathah ||
verses.en:
That Earth, through power of knowing things that may be known, handless and footless yet might thrive,
Thou slewest, turning to the right, Susna for every living man.

verses.sa:
पिबापिबेदिन्द्र शूर सोमं मा रिषण्यो वसवान वसुः सन् ।
उत त्रायस्व गृणतो मघोनो महश्च रायो रेवतस्कृधी नः ॥
verses.rom:
pibapibedindra shura somam ma rishanyo vasavana vasuh san |
uta trayasva grinato maghono mahashcha rayo revataskridhi nah ||
verses.en:
Drink, drink the Soma, Hero Indra; be not withheld as thou art good, O Treasure-giver.
Preserve the singers and our liberal princes, and make us wealthy with abundant riches.

verses.sa:
यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणं हरीणां रथ्यं विव्रतानाम् ।
प्र श्मश्रु दोधुवदूर्ध्वथा भूद्वि सेनाभिर्दयमानो वि राधसा ॥
verses.rom:
yajamaha indram vajradakshinam harinam rathyam vivratanam |
pra shmashru dodhuvadurdhvatha bhudvi senabhirdayamano vi radhasa ||
verses.en:
INDRA, whose right hand wields the bolt, we worship, driver of Bay Steeds seeking sundered courses.
Shaking his beard with might he hath arisen, casting his weapons forth and dealing bounties.

verses.sa:
हरी न्वस्य या वने विदे वस्विन्द्रो मघैर्मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ।
ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षाः पत्यते शवोऽव क्ष्णौमि दासस्य नाम चित् ॥
verses.rom:
hari nvasya ya vane vide vasvindro maghairmaghava vritraha bhuvat |
ribhurvaja ribhukshah patyate shavo'va kshnaumi dasasya nama chit ||
verses.en:
The treasure which his Bay Steeds found at sacrifice,-this wealth made opulent Indra slayer of the foe.
Rbhu, Rbhuksan, Vaja-he is Lord of Might. The Dasa's very name I utterly destroy.

verses.sa:
यदा वज्रं हिरण्यमिदथा रथं हरी यमस्य वहतो वि सूरिभिः ।
आ तिष्ठति मघवा सनश्रुत इन्द्रो वाजस्य दीर्घश्रवसस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yada vajram hiranyamidatha ratham hari yamasya vahato vi suribhih |
a tishthati maghava sanashruta indro vajasya dirghashravasaspatih ||
verses.en:
When, with the Princes, Maghavari, famed of old, comes nigh the thunderbolt of gold, and the Controller's car
Which his two Tawny Coursers draw, then Indra is the Sovran Lord of power whose glory spreads afar.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु वृष्टिर्यूथ्या स्वा सचाँ इन्द्रः श्मश्रूणि हरिताभि प्रुष्णुते ।
अव वेति सुक्षयं सुते मधूदिद्धूनोति वातो यथा वनम् ॥
verses.rom:
so chinnu vrishtiryuthya sva sachan indrah shmashruni haritabhi prushnute |
ava veti sukshayam sute madhudiddhunoti vato yatha vanam ||
verses.en:
With him too is this rain of his that comes like herds: Indra throws drops of moisture on his yellow beard.
When the sweet juice is shed he seeks the pleasant place, and stirs the worshipper as wind disturbs the wood.

verses.sa:
यो वाचा विवाचो मृध्रवाचः पुरू सहस्राशिवा जघान ।
तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसि पितेव यस्तविषीं वावृधे शवः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vacha vivacho mridhravachah puru sahasrashiva jaghana |
tattadidasya paumsyam grinimasi piteva yastavishim vavridhe shavah ||
verses.en:
We laud and praise his several deeds of valour who, father like, with power hath made us stronger;
Who with his voice slew many thousand wicked ones who spake in varied manners with contemptuous cries.

verses.sa:
स्तोमं त इन्द्र विमदा अजीजनन्नपूर्व्यं पुरुतमं सुदानवे ।
विद्मा ह्यस्य भोजनमिनस्य यदा पशुं न गोपाः करामहे ॥
verses.rom:
stomam ta indra vimada ajijanannapurvyam purutamam sudanave |
vidma hyasya bhojanaminasya yada pashum na gopah karamahe ||
verses.en:
Indra, the Vimadas have formed for thee a laud, copious, unparalleled, for thee Most Bountiful.
We know the good we gain from him the Mighty One when we attract him as a herdsman calls the kine.

verses.sa:
माकिर्न एना सख्या वि यौषुस्तव चेन्द्र विमदस्य च ऋषेः ।
विद्मा हि ते प्रमतिं देव जामिवदस्मे ते सन्तु सख्या शिवानि ॥
verses.rom:
makirna ena sakhya vi yaushustava chendra vimadasya cha risheh |
vidma hi te pramatim deva jamivadasme te santu sakhya shivani ||
verses.en:
Ne'er may this bond of friendship be dissevered, the Rsi Vimada's and thine, O Indra.
We know thou carest for us as a brother with us, O God, be thine auspicious friendship.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सोममिमं पिब मधुमन्तं चमू सुतम् ।
अस्मे रयिं नि धारय वि वो मदे सहस्रिणं पुरूवसो विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
indra somamimam piba madhumantam chamu sutam |
asme rayim ni dharaya vi vo made sahasrinam puruvaso vivakshase ||
verses.en:
O INDRA, drink this Soma, pressed out in the mortar, full of sweets.
Send down to us great riches,-at your glad carouse-in thousands, O Most healthy. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञेभिरुक्थैरुप हव्येभिरीमहे ।
शचीपते शचीनां वि वो मदे श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यं विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yajnebhirukthairupa havyebhirimahe |
shachipate shachinam vi vo made shreshtham no dhehi varyam vivakshase ||
verses.en:
To thee with sacrifices, with oblations, and with lauds we come.
Lord of all strength and power, grant-at your glad carouse-the best choice worthy treasure. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
यस्पतिर्वार्याणामसि रध्रस्य चोदिता ।
इन्द्र स्तोतॄणामविता वि वो मदे द्विषो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
yaspatirvaryanamasi radhrasya chodita |
indra stotrinamavita vi vo made dvisho nah pahyamhaso vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Thou who art Lord of precious boons, inciter even of the churl.
Guardian of singers, Indra,-at your glad carouse-save us from woe and hatred. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
युवं शक्रा मायाविना समीची निरमन्थतम् ।
विमदेन यदीळिता नासत्या निरमन्थतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam shakra mayavina samichi niramanthatam |
vimadena yadilita nasatya niramanthatam ||
verses.en:
Strong, Lords of Magic power, ye Twain churned the united worlds apart,
When ye, implored by Vimada, Nasatyas, forced apart the pair.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा अकृपन्त समीच्योर्निष्पतन्त्योः ।
नासत्यावब्रुवन्देवाः पुनरा वहतादिति ॥
verses.rom:
vishve deva akripanta samichyornishpatantyoh |
nasatyavabruvandevah punara vahataditi ||
verses.en:
When the united pair were rent asunder all the Gods complained.
The Gods to the Nasatyas cried, Bring these together once again.

verses.sa:
मधुमन्मे परायणं मधुमत्पुनरायनम् ।
ता नो देवा देवतया युवं मधुमतस्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
madhumanme parayanam madhumatpunarayanam |
ta no deva devataya yuvam madhumataskritam ||
verses.en:
Sweet be my going forth, and rich in sweets be my approach to home.
So, through your Deity, both Gods, enrich us with all pleasantness.

verses.sa:
भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुम् ।
अधा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणन्गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram no api vataya mano dakshamuta kratum |
adha te sakhye andhaso vi vo made ranangavo na yavase vivakshase ||
verses.en:
SEND us a good and happy mind, send energy and mental power.
Then-at your glad carouse-let men joy in thy love, Sweet juice! as kine in pasture. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
हृदिस्पृशस्त आसते विश्वेषु सोम धामसु ।
अधा कामा इमे मम वि वो मदे वि तिष्ठन्ते वसूयवो विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
hridisprishasta asate vishveshu soma dhamasu |
adha kama ime mama vi vo made vi tishthante vasuyavo vivakshase ||
verses.en:
rn all thy forms, O Soma, rest thy powers that influence the heart.
So also these my longings-at your glad carouse-spread themselves seeking riches. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
उत व्रतानि सोम ते प्राहं मिनामि पाक्या ।
अधा पितेव सूनवे वि वो मदे मृळा नो अभि चिद्वधाद्विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
uta vratani soma te praham minami pakya |
adha piteva sunave vi vo made mrila no abhi chidvadhadvivakshase ||
verses.en:
Even if, O Soma, I neglect thy laws through my simplicity,
Be gracious-at your glad carouse-as sire to son. Preserve us even from slaughter. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
समु प्र यन्ति धीतयः सर्गासोऽवताँ इव ।
क्रतुं नः सोम जीवसे वि वो मदे धारया चमसाँ इव विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
samu pra yanti dhitayah sargaso'vatan iva |
kratum nah soma jivase vi vo made dharaya chamasan iva vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Our songs in concert go to thee as streams of water to the wells.
Soma, that we may live, grant-at your glad carouse-full powers of mind, like beakers. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये सोम शक्तिभिर्निकामासो व्यृण्विरे ।
गृत्सस्य धीरास्तवसो वि वो मदे व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनं विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tava tye soma shaktibhirnikamaso vyrinvire |
gritsasya dhirastavaso vi vo made vrajam gomantamashvinam vivakshase ||
verses.en:
O Soma, through thy might who art skillful and strong, these longing men,
These sages, have thrown open-at your glad carouse-the stall of kine and horses. Thou art waxing great

verses.sa:
पशुं नः सोम रक्षसि पुरुत्रा विष्ठितं जगत् ।
समाकृणोषि जीवसे वि वो मदे विश्वा सम्पश्यन्भुवना विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
pashum nah soma rakshasi purutra vishthitam jagat |
samakrinoshi jivase vi vo made vishva sampashyanbhuvana vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Our herds thou guardest, Soma, and the moving world spread far and wide.
Thou fittest them for living,-at your glad carouse-looking upon all beings. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो गोपा अदाभ्यो भव ।
सेध राजन्नप स्रिधो वि वो मदे मा नो दुःशंस ईशता विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nah soma vishvato gopa adabhyo bhava |
sedha rajannapa sridho vi vo made ma no duhshamsa ishata vivakshase ||
verses.en:
On all sides, Soma, be to us a Guardian ne'er to be deceived.
King, drive away our foemen-at your glad carouse:-let not the wicked rule us. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वं नः सोम सुक्रतुर्वयोधेयाय जागृहि ।
क्षेत्रवित्तरो मनुषो वि वो मदे द्रुहो नः पाह्यंहसो विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nah soma sukraturvayodheyaya jagrihi |
kshetravittaro manusho vi vo made druho nah pahyamhaso vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Be watchful, Soma, passing wise, to give us store of vital strength.
More skilled than man to guide us,-at your glad carouse-save us from harm and sorrow. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो वृत्रहन्तमेन्द्रस्येन्दो शिवः सखा ।
यत्सीं हवन्ते समिथे वि वो मदे युध्यमानास्तोकसातौ विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no vritrahantamendrasyendo shivah sakha |
yatsim havante samithe vi vo made yudhyamanastokasatau vivakshase ||
verses.en:
Chief slayer of our foemen, thou, Indu, art Indra's gracious Friend,
When warriors invoke him-at your glad carouse -in fight, to win them offspring. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
अयं घ स तुरो मद इन्द्रस्य वर्धत प्रियः ।
अयं कक्षीवतो महो वि वो मदे मतिं विप्रस्य वर्धयद्विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam gha sa turo mada indrasya vardhata priyah |
ayam kakshivato maho vi vo made matim viprasya vardhayadvivakshase ||
verses.en:
Victorious is this gladdening drink: to Indra dear it grows in strength.
This-at your glad carouse -enhanced the mighty hymn of the great sage Kaksivan. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
अयं विप्राय दाशुषे वाजाँ इयर्ति गोमतः ।
अयं सप्तभ्य आ वरं वि वो मदे प्रान्धं श्रोणं च तारिषद्विवक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vipraya dashushe vajan iyarti gomatah |
ayam saptabhya a varam vi vo made prandham shronam cha tarishadvivakshase ||
verses.en:
This to the sage who offers gifts brings power that comes from wealth in kine.
This, better than the seven, hath-at your glad carouse-furthered the blind, the cripple. Thou art waxing great.

verses.sa:
प्र ह्यच्छा मनीषा स्पार्हा यन्ति नियुतः ।
प्र दस्रा नियुद्रथः पूषा अविष्टु माहिनः ॥
verses.rom:
pra hyachchha manisha sparha yanti niyutah |
pra dasra niyudrathah pusha avishtu mahinah ||
verses.en:
FORWARD upon their way proceed the ready teams, the lovely songs.
Further them glorious Pusan with yoked chariot, and the Mighty Twain!

verses.sa:
यस्य त्यन्महित्वं वाताप्यमयं जनः ।
विप्र आ वंसद्धीतिभिश्चिकेत सुष्टुतीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tyanmahitvam vatapyamayam janah |
vipra a vamsaddhitibhishchiketa sushtutinam ||
verses.en:
With sacred hymns let this man here, this singer, win the God to whom
Belong this majesty and might. He hath observed our eulogies.

verses.sa:
स वेद सुष्टुतीनामिन्दुर्न पूषा वृषा ।
अभि प्सुरः प्रुषायति व्रजं न आ प्रुषायति ॥
verses.rom:
sa veda sushtutinamindurna pusha vrisha |
abhi psurah prushayati vrajam na a prushayati ||
verses.en:
Pusan the Strong hath knowledge of sweet praises even as Indu hath.
He dews our corn with moisture, he bedews the pasture of our kine.

verses.sa:
मंसीमहि त्वा वयमस्माकं देव पूषन् ।
मतीनां च साधनं विप्राणां चाधवम् ॥
verses.rom:
mamsimahi tva vayamasmakam deva pushan |
matinam cha sadhanam vipranam chadhavam ||
verses.en:
We will bethink ourselves of thee, O Pusan, O thou God, as One.
Who brings fulfilment of our hymns, and stirs the singer and the sage.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यर्धिर्यज्ञानामश्वहयो रथानाम् ।
ऋषिः स यो मनुर्हितो विप्रस्य यावयत्सखः ॥
verses.rom:
pratyardhiryajnanamashvahayo rathanam |
rishih sa yo manurhito viprasya yavayatsakhah ||
verses.en:
joint-sharer of each sacrifice, the driver of the chariot steeds;
The Rsi who is good to man, the singer's Friend and faithful Guard.

verses.sa:
आधीषमाणायाः पतिः शुचायाश्च शुचस्य च ।
वासोवायोऽवीनामा वासांसि मर्मृजत् ॥
verses.rom:
adhishamanayah patih shuchayashcha shuchasya cha |
vasovayo'vinama vasamsi marmrijat ||
verses.en:
One who is Lord of Suca, Lord of Suca caring for herself:
Weaving the raiment of the sheep and making raiment beautiful.

verses.sa:
इनो वाजानां पतिरिनः पुष्टीनां सखा ।
प्र श्मश्रु हर्यतो दूधोद्वि वृथा यो अदाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ino vajanam patirinah pushtinam sakha |
pra shmashru haryato dudhodvi vritha yo adabhyah ||
verses.en:
The mighty Lord of spoil and wealth, Strong Friend of all prosperity;
He with light movement shakes his beard, lovely and ne'er to be deceived.

verses.sa:
आ ते रथस्य पूषन्नजा धुरं ववृत्युः ।
विश्वस्यार्थिनः सखा सनोजा अनपच्युतः ॥
verses.rom:
a te rathasya pushannaja dhuram vavrityuh |
vishvasyarthinah sakha sanoja anapachyutah ||
verses.en:
O Pusan, may those goats of thine turn hitherward thy chariot-pole.
Friend of all suppliants; art thou, born in old time, and arm and sure.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमूर्जा रथं पूषा अविष्टु माहिनः ।
भुवद्वाजानां वृध इमं नः शृणवद्धवम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamurja ratham pusha avishtu mahinah |
bhuvadvajanam vridha imam nah shrinavaddhavam ||
verses.en:
May the majestic Pusan speed our chariot with his power and might.
May he increase our store of wealth and listen to this call of ours.

verses.sa:
असत्सु मे जरितः साभिवेगो यत्सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षम् ।
अनाशीर्दामहमस्मि प्रहन्ता सत्यध्वृतं वृजिनायन्तमाभुम् ॥
verses.rom:
asatsu me jaritah sabhivego yatsunvate yajamanaya shiksham |
anashirdamahamasmi prahanta satyadhvritam vrijinayantamabhum ||
verses.en:
THIS, singer, is my firm determination, to aid the worshipper who pours the Soma.
I slay the man who brings no milk oblation, unrighteous, powerful, the truth's perverter.

verses.sa:
यदीदहं युधये संनयान्यदेवयून्तन्वा शूशुजानान् ।
अमा ते तुम्रं वृषभं पचानि तीव्रं सुतं पञ्चदशं नि षिञ्चम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadidaham yudhaye samnayanyadevayuntanva shushujanan |
ama te tumram vrishabham pachani tivram sutam panchadasham ni shincham ||
verses.en:
Then Will I, when I lead my friends to battle against the radiant persons of the godless,
Prepare for thee at home a vigorous bullock, and pour for thee the fifteen-fold strong juices.

verses.sa:
नाहं तं वेद य इति ब्रवीत्यदेवयून्समरणे जघन्वान् ।
यदावाख्यत्समरणमृघावदादिद्ध मे वृषभा प्र ब्रुवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
naham tam veda ya iti bravityadevayunsamarane jaghanvan |
yadavakhyatsamaranamrighavadadiddha me vrishabha pra bruvanti ||
verses.en:
I know not him who sayeth and declareth that he hath slain the godless in the battle.
Soon as they see the furious combat raging, men speak forth praises of my vigorous horses.

verses.sa:
यदज्ञातेषु वृजनेष्वासं विश्वे सतो मघवानो म आसन् ।
जिनामि वेत्क्षेम आ सन्तमाभुं प्र तं क्षिणां पर्वते पादगृह्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadajnateshu vrijaneshvasam vishve sato maghavano ma asan |
jinami vetkshema a santamabhum pra tam kshinam parvate padagrihya ||
verses.en:
While yet my deeds of might were unrecorded, all passed for Maghavans though I existed.
The potent one who dwelt in peace I conquered, grasped by the foot and slew him on the mountain.

verses.sa:
न वा उ मां वृजने वारयन्ते न पर्वतासो यदहं मनस्ये ।
मम स्वनात्कृधुकर्णो भयात एवेदनु द्यून्किरणः समेजात् ॥
verses.rom:
na va u mam vrijane varayante na parvataso yadaham manasye |
mama svanatkridhukarno bhayata evedanu dyunkiranah samejat ||
verses.en:
None hinder me in mine heroic exploits, no, not the mountains when I will and purpose.
Even the deaf will tremble at my roaring, and every day will dust be agitated.

verses.sa:
दर्शन्न्वत्र शृतपाँ अनिन्द्रान्बाहुक्षदः शरवे पत्यमानान् ।
घृषुं वा ये निनिदुः सखायमध्यू न्वेषु पवयो ववृत्युः ॥
verses.rom:
darshannvatra shritapan anindranbahukshadah sharave patyamanan |
ghrishum va ye niniduh sakhayamadhyu nveshu pavayo vavrityuh ||
verses.en:
To see the Indraless oblation-drinkers, mean offerers, o'ertaken by destruction!
Then shall the fellies of my car pass over those who have blamed my joyous Friend and scorned him.

verses.sa:
अभूर्वौक्षीर्व्यु आयुरानड्दर्षन्नु पूर्वो अपरो नु दर्षत् ।
द्वे पवस्ते परि तं न भूतो यो अस्य पारे रजसो विवेष ॥
verses.rom:
abhurvaukshirvyu ayuranaddarshannu purvo aparo nu darshat |
dve pavaste pari tam na bhuto yo asya pare rajaso vivesha ||
verses.en:
Thou wast, thou grewest to full vital vigour: an earlier saw, a later one shall see thee.
Two canopies, as 'twere, are round about him who reacheth to the limit of this region.

verses.sa:
गावो यवं प्रयुता अर्यो अक्षन्ता अपश्यं सहगोपाश्चरन्तीः ।
हवा इदर्यो अभितः समायन्कियदासु स्वपतिश्छन्दयाते ॥
verses.rom:
gavo yavam prayuta aryo akshanta apashyam sahagopashcharantih |
hava idaryo abhitah samayankiyadasu svapatishchhandayate ||
verses.en:
The freed kine eat the barley of the pious. 1 saw them as they wandered with the herdsman.
The calling of the pious rang around them. What portion will these kine afford their owner?

verses.sa:
सं यद्वयं यवसादो जनानामहं यवाद उर्वज्रे अन्तः ।
अत्रा युक्तोऽवसातारमिच्छादथो अयुक्तं युनजद्ववन्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
sam yadvayam yavasado jananamaham yavada urvajre antah |
atra yukto'vasataramichchhadatho ayuktam yunajadvavanvan ||
verses.en:
When we who cat the grass of men are gathered I am with barley-eaters in the corn-land.
There shall the captor yoke the yokeless bullock, and he who hath been yoked seek one to loose him.

verses.sa:
अत्रेदु मे मंससे सत्यमुक्तं द्विपाच्च यच्चतुष्पात्संसृजानि ।
स्त्रीभिर्यो अत्र वृषणं पृतन्यादयुद्धो अस्य वि भजानि वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
atredu me mamsase satyamuktam dvipachcha yachchatushpatsamsrijani |
stribhiryo atra vrishanam pritanyadayuddho asya vi bhajani vedah ||
verses.en:
There wilt thou hold as true my spoken purpose, to bring together quadrupeds. and bipeds.
I will divide, without a fight, his riches who warreth here, against the Bull, with women.

verses.sa:
यस्यानक्षा दुहिता जात्वास कस्तां विद्वाँ अभि मन्याते अन्धाम् ।
कतरो मेनिं प्रति तं मुचाते य ईं वहाते य ईं वा वरेयात् ॥
verses.rom:
yasyanaksha duhita jatvasa kastam vidvan abhi manyate andham |
kataro menim prati tam muchate ya im vahate ya im va vareyat ||
verses.en:
When a man's daughter hath been ever eyeless, who, knowing, will be wroth with her for blindness?
Which of the two will loose on him his anger-the man who leads her home or he who woos her?

verses.sa:
कियती योषा मर्यतो वधूयोः परिप्रीता पन्यसा वार्येण ।
भद्रा वधूर्भवति यत्सुपेशाः स्वयं सा मित्रं वनुते जने चित् ॥
verses.rom:
kiyati yosha maryato vadhuyoh pariprita panyasa varyena |
bhadra vadhurbhavati yatsupeshah svayam sa mitram vanute jane chit ||
verses.en:
How many a maid is pleasing to the suitor who fain would marry for her splendid riches?
If the girl be both good and fair of feature, she finds, herself, a friend among the people.

verses.sa:
पत्तो जगार प्रत्यञ्चमत्ति शीर्ष्णा शिरः प्रति दधौ वरूथम् ।
आसीन ऊर्ध्वामुपसि क्षिणाति न्यङ्ङुत्तानामन्वेति भूमिम् ॥
verses.rom:
patto jagara pratyanchamatti shirshna shirah prati dadhau varutham |
asina urdhvamupasi kshinati nyannuttanamanveti bhumim ||
verses.en:
His feet have grasped: he eats the man who meets him. Around his head he sets the head for shelter.
Sitting anear and right above he smites us, and follows earth that lies spread out beneath him.

verses.sa:
बृहन्नच्छायो अपलाशो अर्वा तस्थौ माता विषितो अत्ति गर्भः ।
अन्यस्या वत्सं रिहती मिमाय कया भुवा नि दधे धेनुरूधः ॥
verses.rom:
brihannachchhayo apalasho arva tasthau mata vishito atti garbhah |
anyasya vatsam rihati mimaya kaya bhuva ni dadhe dhenurudhah ||
verses.en:
High, leafless, shadowless, and swift is Heaven: the Mother stands, the Youngling, loosed, is feeding.
Loud hath she lowed, licking Another's offspring. In what world hath the Cow laid down her udder?

verses.sa:
सप्त वीरासो अधरादुदायन्नष्टोत्तरात्तात्समजग्मिरन्ते ।
नव पश्चातात्स्थिविमन्त आयन्दश प्राक्सानु वि तिरन्त्यश्नः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta viraso adharadudayannashtottarattatsamajagmirante |
nava pashchatatsthivimanta ayandasha praksanu vi tirantyashnah ||
verses.en:
Seven heroes from the nether part ascended, and from the upper part came eight together.
Nine from behind came armed with winnowing-baskets: ten from the front pressed o'er the rock's high ridges.

verses.sa:
दशानामेकं कपिलं समानं तं हिन्वन्ति क्रतवे पार्याय ।
गर्भं माता सुधितं वक्षणास्ववेनन्तं तुषयन्ती बिभर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
dashanamekam kapilam samanam tam hinvanti kratave paryaya |
garbham mata sudhitam vakshanasvavenantam tushayanti bibharti ||
verses.en:
One of the ten, the tawny, shared in common, they send to execute their final purpose.
The Mother carries on her breast the Infant of noble form and soothes it while it knows not.

verses.sa:
पीवानं मेषमपचन्त वीरा न्युप्ता अक्षा अनु दीव आसन् ।
द्वा धनुं बृहतीमप्स्वन्तः पवित्रवन्ता चरतः पुनन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
pivanam meshamapachanta vira nyupta aksha anu diva asan |
dva dhanum brihatimapsvantah pavitravanta charatah punanta ||
verses.en:
The Heroes dressed with fire the fatted weather: the dice were thrown by way of sport and gaming.
Two reach the plain amid the heavenly waters, hallowing and with means of purifying.

verses.sa:
वि क्रोशनासो विष्वञ्च आयन्पचाति नेमो नहि पक्षदर्धः ।
अयं मे देवः सविता तदाह द्र्वन्न इद्वनवत्सर्पिरन्नः ॥
verses.rom:
vi kroshanaso vishvancha ayanpachati nemo nahi pakshadardhah |
ayam me devah savita tadaha drvanna idvanavatsarpirannah ||
verses.en:
Crying aloud they ran in all directions: One half of them will cook, and not the other.
To me hath Savitar, this God, declared it: He will perform, whose food is wood and butter.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं ग्रामं वहमानमारादचक्रया स्वधया वर्तमानम् ।
सिषक्त्यर्यः प्र युगा जनानां सद्यः शिश्ना प्रमिनानो नवीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
apashyam gramam vahamanamaradachakraya svadhaya vartamanam |
sishaktyaryah pra yuga jananam sadyah shishna praminano naviyan ||
verses.en:
I saw a troop advancing from the distance moved, not by wheels but their own God-like nature.
The Friendly One seeks human generations, destroying, still new bands of evil beings.

verses.sa:
एतौ मे गावौ प्रमरस्य युक्तौ मो षु प्र सेधीर्मुहुरिन्ममन्धि ।
आपश्चिदस्य वि नशन्त्यर्थं सूरश्च मर्क उपरो बभूवान् ॥
verses.rom:
etau me gavau pramarasya yuktau mo shu pra sedhirmuhurinmamandhi |
apashchidasya vi nashantyartham surashcha marka uparo babhuvan ||
verses.en:
These my two Bulls, even Pramara's, are harnessed: drive them not far; here let them often linger.
The waters even shall aid him to his object, and the all-cleansing Sun who is above us.

verses.sa:
अयं यो वज्रः पुरुधा विवृत्तोऽवः सूर्यस्य बृहतः पुरीषात् ।
श्रव इदेना परो अन्यदस्ति तदव्यथी जरिमाणस्तरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yo vajrah purudha vivritto'vah suryasya brihatah purishat |
shrava idena paro anyadasti tadavyathi jarimanastaranti ||
verses.en:
This is the thunderbolt which often whirleth down from the lofty misty realm of Surya.
Beyond this realm there is another glory so through old age they pass and feel no sorrow.

verses.sa:
वृक्षेवृक्षे नियता मीमयद्गौस्ततो वयः प्र पतान्पूरुषादः ।
अथेदं विश्वं भुवनं भयात इन्द्राय सुन्वदृषये च शिक्षत् ॥
verses.rom:
vrikshevrikshe niyata mimayadgaustato vayah pra patanpurushadah |
athedam vishvam bhuvanam bhayata indraya sunvadrishaye cha shikshat ||
verses.en:
Bound fast to,every tree the cow is lowing, and thence the man-consuming birds are flying,
Then all this world, though pressing juice for Indra and strengthening the Rsi, is affrighted.

verses.sa:
देवानां माने प्रथमा अतिष्ठन्कृन्तत्रादेषामुपरा उदायन् ।
त्रयस्तपन्ति पृथिवीमनूपा द्वा बृबूकं वहतः पुरीषम् ॥
verses.rom:
devanam mane prathama atishthankrintatradeshamupara udayan |
trayastapanti prithivimanupa dva bribukam vahatah purisham ||
verses.en:
In the Gods' mansion stood the first-created, and from their separation came the later.
Three warm the Earth while holding stores of water, and Two of these convey the murmuring moisture.

verses.sa:
सा ते जीवातुरुत तस्य विद्धि मा स्मैतादृगप गूहः समर्ये ।
आविः स्वः कृणुते गूहते बुसं स पादुरस्य निर्णिजो न मुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sa te jivaturuta tasya viddhi ma smaitadrigapa guhah samarye |
avih svah krinute guhate busam sa padurasya nirnijo na muchyate ||
verses.en:
This is thy life: and do thou mark and know it. As such, hide not thyself in time of battle.
He manifests the light and hides the vapour: his foot is never free from robes that veil it.

verses.sa:
विश्वो ह्यन्यो अरिराजगाम ममेदह श्वशुरो ना जगाम ।
जक्षीयाद्धाना उत सोमं पपीयात्स्वाशितः पुनरस्तं जगायात् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvo hyanyo arirajagama mamedaha shvashuro na jagama |
jakshiyaddhana uta somam papiyatsvashitah punarastam jagayat ||
verses.en:
Now all my other friends are here assembled: my Sire-in-law alone hath not come hither.
So might he eat the grain and drink the Soma, and, satisfied, return unto; his dwelling.

verses.sa:
स रोरुवद्वृषभस्तिग्मशृङ्गो वर्ष्मन्तस्थौ वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः ।
विश्वेष्वेनं वृजनेषु पामि यो मे कुक्षी सुतसोमः पृणाति ॥
verses.rom:
sa roruvadvrishabhastigmashringo varshmantasthau varimanna prithivyah |
vishveshvenam vrijaneshu pami yo me kukshi sutasomah prinati ||
verses.en:
Loud belloweth the Bull whose horns are sharpened: upon the height above earth's breadth he standeth.
That man I guard and save in all his troubles who fills my flanks when he hath shed the Soma.

verses.sa:
अद्रिणा ते मन्दिन इन्द्र तूयान्सुन्वन्ति सोमान्पिबसि त्वमेषाम् ।
पचन्ति ते वृषभाँ अत्सि तेषां पृक्षेण यन्मघवन्हूयमानः ॥
verses.rom:
adrina te mandina indra tuyansunvanti somanpibasi tvamesham |
pachanti te vrishabhan atsi tesham prikshena yanmaghavanhuyamanah ||
verses.en:
Men with the stone press out for thee, O Indra, strong, gladdening Soma, and thereof thou drinkest.
Bulls they dress for thee, and of these thou eatest when, Maghavan, with food thou art invited.

verses.sa:
इदं सु मे जरितरा चिकिद्धि प्रतीपं शापं नद्यो वहन्ति ।
लोपाशः सिंहं प्रत्यञ्चमत्साः क्रोष्टा वराहं निरतक्त कक्षात् ॥
verses.rom:
idam su me jaritara chikiddhi pratipam shapam nadyo vahanti |
lopashah simham pratyanchamatsah kroshta varaham niratakta kakshat ||
verses.en:
Resolve for me, O singer, this my riddle: The rivers send their swelling water backward:
The fox steals up to the approaching lion: the jackal drives the wild-boar from the brushwood.

verses.sa:
कथा त एतदहमा चिकेतं गृत्सस्य पाकस्तवसो मनीषाम् ।
त्वं नो विद्वाँ ऋतुथा वि वोचो यमर्धं ते मघवन्क्षेम्या धूः ॥
verses.rom:
katha ta etadahama chiketam gritsasya pakastavaso manisham |
tvam no vidvan ritutha vi vocho yamardham te maghavankshemya dhuh ||
verses.en:
How shall I solve this riddle, I, the simple, declare the thought of thee the Wise and Mighty?
Tell us, well knowing, as befits the season: Whitherward is thy prosperous car advancing?

verses.sa:
एवा हि मां तवसं वर्धयन्ति दिवश्चिन्मे बृहत उत्तरा धूः ।
पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि साकमशत्रुं हि मा जनिता जजान ॥
verses.rom:
eva hi mam tavasam vardhayanti divashchinme brihata uttara dhuh |
puru sahasra ni shishami sakamashatrum hi ma janita jajana ||
verses.en:
Thus do they magnify me, me the mighty higher than even high heaven is my car-pole.
I all at once demolish many thousands: my Sire begot me with no foe to match me.

verses.sa:
एवा हि मां तवसं जज्ञुरुग्रं कर्मन्कर्मन्वृषणमिन्द्र देवाः ।
वधीं वृत्रं वज्रेण मन्दसानोऽप व्रजं महिना दाशुषे वम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva hi mam tavasam jajnurugram karmankarmanvrishanamindra devah |
vadhim vritram vajrena mandasano'pa vrajam mahina dashushe vam ||
verses.en:
Yea, and the Gods have known me also, Indra, as mighty, fierce and strong in every exploit.
Exulting with the bolt I slaughtered Vrtra, and for the offerer open with might the cow-stall.

verses.sa:
देवास आयन्परशूँरबिभ्रन्वना वृश्चन्तो अभि विड्भिरायन् ।
नि सुद्र्वं दधतो वक्षणासु यत्रा कृपीटमनु तद्दहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
devasa ayanparashunrabibhranvana vrishchanto abhi vidbhirayan |
ni sudrvam dadhato vakshanasu yatra kripitamanu taddahanti ||
verses.en:
The Deities approached, they carried axes; splitting the wood they came with their attendants.
They laid good timber in the fire-receivers, and burnt the grass up where they found it growing.

verses.sa:
शशः क्षुरं प्रत्यञ्चं जगाराद्रिं लोगेन व्यभेदमारात् ।
बृहन्तं चिदृहते रन्धयानि वयद्वत्सो वृषभं शूशुवानः ॥
verses.rom:
shashah kshuram pratyancham jagaradrim logena vyabhedamarat |
brihantam chidrihate randhayani vayadvatso vrishabham shushuvanah ||
verses.en:
The hare hath swallowed up the opposing razor: I sundered with a clod the distant mountain.
The great will I make subject to the little: the calf shall wax in strength and cat the bullock.

verses.sa:
सुपर्ण इत्था नखमा सिषायावरुद्धः परिपदं न सिंहः ।
निरुद्धश्चिन्महिषस्तर्ष्यावान्गोधा तस्मा अयथं कर्षदेतत् ॥
verses.rom:
suparna ittha nakhama sishayavaruddhah paripadam na simhah |
niruddhashchinmahishastarshyavangodha tasma ayatham karshadetat ||
verses.en:
There hath the strong-winged eagle left his talon, as a snared lion leaves the trap that caught him.
Even the wild steer in his thirst is captured: the leather strap still holds his foot entangled.

verses.sa:
तेभ्यो गोधा अयथं कर्षदेतद्ये ब्रह्मणः प्रतिपीयन्त्यन्नैः ।
सिम उक्ष्णोऽवसृष्टाँ अदन्ति स्वयं बलानि तन्वः शृणानाः ॥
verses.rom:
tebhyo godha ayatham karshadetadye brahmanah pratipiyantyannaih |
sima ukshno'vasrishtan adanti svayam balani tanvah shrinanah ||
verses.en:
So may the leather strap their foot entangle who fatten on the viands of the Brahman.
They all devour the bulls set free to wander, while they themselves destroy their bodies' vigour.

verses.sa:
एते शमीभिः सुशमी अभूवन्ये हिन्विरे तन्वः सोम उक्थैः ।
नृवद्वदन्नुप नो माहि वाजान्दिवि श्रवो दधिषे नाम वीरः ॥
verses.rom:
ete shamibhih sushami abhuvanye hinvire tanvah soma ukthaih |
nrivadvadannupa no mahi vajandivi shravo dadhishe nama virah ||
verses.en:
They were well occupied with holy duties who sped in person with their lauds to Soma.
Speaking like man, mete to us wealth and booty: in heaven thou hast the name and fame of Hero.

verses.sa:
वने न वा यो न्यधायि चाकञ्छुचिर्वां स्तोमो भुरणावजीगः ।
यस्येदिन्द्रः पुरुदिनेषु होता नृणां नर्यो नृतमः क्षपावान् ॥
verses.rom:
vane na va yo nyadhayi chakanchhuchirvam stomo bhuranavajigah |
yasyedindrah purudineshu hota nrinam naryo nritamah kshapavan ||
verses.en:
As sits the young bird on the tree rejoicing, ye, swift Pair, have been roused by clear laudation,
Whose Herald-Priest through many days is Indra, earth's Guardian, Friend of men, the best of Heroes.

verses.sa:
प्र ते अस्या उषसः प्रापरस्या नृतौ स्याम नृतमस्य नृणाम् ।
अनु त्रिशोकः शतमावहन्नॄन्कुत्सेन रथो यो असत्ससवान् ॥
verses.rom:
pra te asya ushasah praparasya nritau syama nritamasya nrinam |
anu trishokah shatamavahannrinkutsena ratho yo asatsasavan ||
verses.en:
May we, when this Dawn and the next dance hither, be thy best servants, most heroic Hero!
Let the victorious car with triple splendour bring hitherward the hundred chiefs with Kutsa.

verses.sa:
कस्ते मद इन्द्र रन्त्यो भूद्दुरो गिरो अभ्युग्रो वि धाव ।
कद्वाहो अर्वागुप मा मनीषा आ त्वा शक्यामुपमं राधो अन्नैः ॥
verses.rom:
kaste mada indra rantyo bhudduro giro abhyugro vi dhava |
kadvaho arvagupa ma manisha a tva shakyamupamam radho annaih ||
verses.en:
What was the gladdening draught that pleased thee, Indra? Speed through our doors to songs, for thou art mighty.
Why comest thou to me, what gift attracts thee? Fain would I bring thee food most meet to offer.

verses.sa:
कदु द्युम्नमिन्द्र त्वावतो नॄन्कया धिया करसे कन्न आगन् ।
मित्रो न सत्य उरुगाय भृत्या अन्ने समस्य यदसन्मनीषाः ॥
verses.rom:
kadu dyumnamindra tvavato nrinkaya dhiya karase kanna agan |
mitro na satya urugaya bhritya anne samasya yadasanmanishah ||
verses.en:
Indra, what fame hath one like thee mid heroes? With what plan wilt thou act? Why hast thou sought us?
As a true Friend, Wide-Strider! to sustain us, since food absorbs the thought of each among us.

verses.sa:
प्रेरय सूरो अर्थं न पारं ये अस्य कामं जनिधा इव ग्मन् ।
गिरश्च ये ते तुविजात पूर्वीर्नर इन्द्र प्रतिशिक्षन्त्यन्नैः ॥
verses.rom:
preraya suro artham na param ye asya kamam janidha iva gman |
girashcha ye te tuvijata purvirnara indra pratishikshantyannaih ||
verses.en:
Speed happily those, as Surya ends his journey, who meet his wish as bridegrooms meet their spouses;
Men who present, O Indra strong by nature, with food the many songs that tell thy praises.

verses.sa:
मात्रे नु ते सुमिते इन्द्र पूर्वी द्यौर्मज्मना पृथिवी काव्येन ।
वराय ते घृतवन्तः सुतासः स्वाद्मन्भवन्तु पीतये मधूनि ॥
verses.rom:
matre nu te sumite indra purvi dyaurmajmana prithivi kavyena |
varaya te ghritavantah sutasah svadmanbhavantu pitaye madhuni ||
verses.en:
Thine are two measures, Indra, wide-well meted, heaven for thy majesty, earth for thy wisdom.
Here for thy choice are Somas mixed with butter: may the sweet meath be pleasant for thy drinking.

verses.sa:
आ मध्वो अस्मा असिचन्नमत्रमिन्द्राय पूर्णं स हि सत्यराधाः ।
स वावृधे वरिमन्ना पृथिव्या अभि क्रत्वा नर्यः पौंस्यैश्च ॥
verses.rom:
a madhvo asma asichannamatramindraya purnam sa hi satyaradhah |
sa vavridhe varimanna prithivya abhi kratva naryah paumsyaishcha ||
verses.en:
They have poured out a bowl to him, to Indra, full of sweet juice, for faithful is his bounty.
O'er earth's expanse hath he grown great by wisdom, the Friend of man, and by heroic exploits.

verses.sa:
व्यानळिन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा आस्मै यतन्ते सख्याय पूर्वीः ।
आ स्मा रथं न पृतनासु तिष्ठ यं भद्रया सुमत्या चोदयासे ॥
verses.rom:
vyanalindrah pritanah svoja asmai yatante sakhyaya purvih |
a sma ratham na pritanasu tishtha yam bhadraya sumatya chodayase ||
verses.en:
Indra hath conquered in his wars, the Mighty: men strive in multitudes to win his friendship.
Ascend thy chariot as it were in battle, which thou shalt drive to us with gracious favour.

verses.sa:
प्र देवत्रा ब्रह्मणे गातुरेत्वपो अच्छा मनसो न प्रयुक्ति ।
महीं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिं पृथुज्रयसे रीरधा सुवृक्तिम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra devatra brahmane gaturetvapo achchha manaso na prayukti |
mahim mitrasya varunasya dhasim prithujrayase riradha suvriktim ||
verses.en:
As 'twere with swift exertion of the spirit, let the priest speed to the celestial Waters,
The glorious food of Varuna and Mitra. To him who spreadeth far this laud I offer.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवो हविष्मन्तो हि भूताच्छाप इतोशतीरुशन्तः ।
अव याश्चष्टे अरुणः सुपर्णस्तमास्यध्वमूर्मिमद्या सुहस्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryavo havishmanto hi bhutachchhapa itoshatirushantah |
ava yashchashte arunah suparnastamasyadhvamurmimadya suhastah ||
verses.en:
Adhvaryus, he ye ready with oblations,, and come with longing to the longing Waters,
Down on which looks the. purple-tinted Eagle. Pour ye that flowing wave this day, deft-handed.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवोऽप इता समुद्रमपां नपातं हविषा यजध्वम् ।
स वो दददूर्मिमद्या सुपूतं तस्मै सोमं मधुमन्तं सुनोत ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryavo'pa ita samudramapam napatam havisha yajadhvam |
sa vo dadadurmimadya suputam tasmai somam madhumantam sunota ||
verses.en:
Go to the reservoir, O ye Adhvaryus worship the Waters' Child with your oblations.
A consecrated wave he now will give you, so press for him the Soma rich in sweetness.

verses.sa:
यो अनिध्मो दीदयदप्स्वन्तर्यं विप्रास ईळते अध्वरेषु ।
अपां नपान्मधुमतीरपो दा याभिरिन्द्रो वावृधे वीर्याय ॥
verses.rom:
yo anidhmo didayadapsvantaryam viprasa ilate adhvareshu |
apam napanmadhumatirapo da yabhirindro vavridhe viryaya ||
verses.en:
He who shines bright in floods, unfed with fuel, whom sages worship at their sacrifices:
Give waters rich in sweets, Child of the Waters, even those which gave heroic might to Indra:

verses.sa:
याभिः सोमो मोदते हर्षते च कल्याणीभिर्युवतिभिर्न मर्यः ।
ता अध्वर्यो अपो अच्छा परेहि यदासिञ्चा ओषधीभिः पुनीतात् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih somo modate harshate cha kalyanibhiryuvatibhirna maryah |
ta adhvaryo apo achchha parehi yadasincha oshadhibhih punitat ||
verses.en:
Those in which Soma joys and is delighted, as a young man with fair and pleasant damsels.
Go thou unto those Waters, O Adhvaryu, and purify with herbs what thou infusest.

verses.sa:
एवेद्यूने युवतयो नमन्त यदीमुशन्नुशतीरेत्यच्छ ।
सं जानते मनसा सं चिकित्रेऽध्वर्यवो धिषणापश्च देवीः ॥
verses.rom:
evedyune yuvatayo namanta yadimushannushatiretyachchha |
sam janate manasa sam chikitre'dhvaryavo dhishanapashcha devih ||
verses.en:
So maidens bow before the youthful gallant who comes with love to them who yearn to meet him.
In heart accordant and in wish one-minded are the Adhvaryus and the heavenly Waters.

verses.sa:
यो वो वृताभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकं यो वो मह्या अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चत् ।
तस्मा इन्द्राय मधुमन्तमूर्मिं देवमादनं प्र हिणोतनापः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vo vritabhyo akrinodu lokam yo vo mahya abhishasteramunchat |
tasma indraya madhumantamurmim devamadanam pra hinotanapah ||
verses.en:
He who made room for you when fast imprisoned, who freed you from the mighty imprecation,-
Even to that Indra send the meath-rich current, the wave that gratifies the Gods, O Waters.

verses.sa:
प्रास्मै हिनोत मधुमन्तमूर्मिं गर्भो यो वः सिन्धवो मध्व उत्सः ।
घृतपृष्ठमीड्यमध्वरेष्वापो रेवतीः शृणुता हवं मे ॥
verses.rom:
prasmai hinota madhumantamurmim garbho yo vah sindhavo madhva utsah |
ghritaprishthamidyamadhvareshvapo revatih shrinuta havam me ||
verses.en:
Send forth to him the meath-rich wave, O Rivers, which is your offspring and a well of sweetness,
Oil-balmed, to be implored at sacrifices. Ye wealthy Waters, hear mine invocation.

verses.sa:
तं सिन्धवो मत्सरमिन्द्रपानमूर्मिं प्र हेत य उभे इयर्ति ।
मदच्युतमौशानं नभोजां परि त्रितन्तुं विचरन्तमुत्सम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam sindhavo matsaramindrapanamurmim pra heta ya ubhe iyarti |
madachyutamaushanam nabhojam pari tritantum vicharantamutsam ||
verses.en:
Send forth the rapture-giving wave, O Rivers, which Indra drinks, which sets the Twain in motion;
The well that springeth from the clouds, desirous, that wandereth triple-formed, distilling transport.

verses.sa:
आवर्वृततीरध नु द्विधारा गोषुयुधो न नियवं चरन्तीः ।
ऋषे जनित्रीर्भुवनस्य पत्नीरपो वन्दस्व सवृधः सयोनीः ॥
verses.rom:
avarvritatiradha nu dvidhara goshuyudho na niyavam charantih |
rishe janitrirbhuvanasya patnirapo vandasva savridhah sayonih ||
verses.en:
These winding Streams which with their double current, like cattle-raiders, seek the lower pastures,-
Waters which dwell together, thrive together, Queens, Mothers of the world, these, Rsi, honour.

verses.sa:
हिनोता नो अध्वरं देवयज्या हिनोत ब्रह्म सनये धनानाम् ।
ऋतस्य योगे वि ष्यध्वमूधः श्रुष्टीवरीर्भूतनास्मभ्यमापः ॥
verses.rom:
hinota no adhvaram devayajya hinota brahma sanaye dhananam |
ritasya yoge vi shyadhvamudhah shrushtivarirbhutanasmabhyamapah ||
verses.en:
Send forth our sacrifice with holy worship send forth the hymn and prayer for gain of riches.
For need of sacrifice disclose the udder. Give gracious hearing to our call, O Waters.

verses.sa:
आपो रेवतीः क्षयथा हि वस्वः क्रतुं च भद्रं बिभृथामृतं च ।
रायश्च स्थ स्वपत्यस्य पत्नीः सरस्वती तद्गृणते वयो धात् ॥
verses.rom:
apo revatih kshayatha hi vasvah kratum cha bhadram bibhrithamritam cha |
rayashcha stha svapatyasya patnih sarasvati tadgrinate vayo dhat ||
verses.en:
For, wealthy Waters, ye control all treasures: ye bring auspicious intellect and Amrta.
Ye are the Queens of independent riches Sarasvati give full life to the singer!

verses.sa:
प्रति यदापो अदृश्रमायतीर्घृतं पयांसि बिभ्रतीर्मधूनि ।
अध्वर्युभिर्मनसा संविदाना इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरन्तीः ॥
verses.rom:
prati yadapo adrishramayatirghritam payamsi bibhratirmadhuni |
adhvaryubhirmanasa samvidana indraya somam sushutam bharantih ||
verses.en:
When I behold the Waters coming hither, carrying with them milk and meath and butter,
Bearing the well-pressed Soma juice to Indra, they harmonize in spirit with Adhvaryus.

verses.sa:
एमा अग्मन्रेवतीर्जीवधन्या अध्वर्यवः सादयता सखायः ।
नि बर्हिषि धत्तन सोम्यासोऽपां नप्त्रा संविदानास एनाः ॥
verses.rom:
ema agmanrevatirjivadhanya adhvaryavah sadayata sakhayah |
ni barhishi dhattana somyaso'pam naptra samvidanasa enah ||
verses.en:
Rich, they are come with wealth for living beings, O friends, Adhvaryus, seat them in their places.
Seat them on holy grass, ye Soma-bringers in harmony with the Offspring of the Waters.

verses.sa:
आग्मन्नाप उशतीर्बर्हिरेदं न्यध्वरे असदन्देवयन्तीः ।
अध्वर्यवः सुनुतेन्द्राय सोममभूदु वः सुशका देवयज्या ॥
verses.rom:
agmannapa ushatirbarhiredam nyadhvare asadandevayantih |
adhvaryavah sunutendraya somamabhudu vah sushaka devayajya ||
verses.en:
Now to this grass are come the longing Waters: the Pious Ones are seated at our worship.
Adhvaryus, press the Soma juice for Indra so will the service of the Gods be easy.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवानामुप वेतु शंसो विश्वेभिस्तुरैरवसे यजत्रः ।
तेभिर्वयं सुषखायो भवेम तरन्तो विश्वा दुरिता स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
a no devanamupa vetu shamso vishvebhisturairavase yajatrah |
tebhirvayam sushakhayo bhavema taranto vishva durita syama ||
verses.en:
MAY benediction of the Gods approach us, holy, to aid us with all rapid succours.
Therewith may we be happily befriended, and pass triumphant over all our troubles.

verses.sa:
परि चिन्मर्तो द्रविणं ममन्यादृतस्य पथा नमसा विवासेत् ।
उत स्वेन क्रतुना सं वदेत श्रेयांसं दक्षं मनसा जगृभ्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
pari chinmarto dravinam mamanyadritasya patha namasa vivaset |
uta svena kratuna sam vadeta shreyamsam daksham manasa jagribhyat ||
verses.en:
A man should think on wealth and strive to win it by adoration on the path of Order,
Counsel himself with his own mental insight, and grasp still nobler vigour with his spirit.

verses.sa:
अधायि धीतिरससृग्रमंशास्तीर्थे न दस्ममुप यन्त्यूमाः ।
अभ्यानश्म सुवितस्य शूषं नवेदसो अमृतानामभूम ॥
verses.rom:
adhayi dhitirasasrigramamshastirthe na dasmamupa yantyumah |
abhyanashma suvitasya shusham navedaso amritanamabhuma ||
verses.en:
The hymn is formed, poured are the allotted portions: as to a ford friends come unto the Wondrous.
We have obtained the power of case and comfort, we have become acquainted, with Immortals.

verses.sa:
नित्यश्चाकन्यात्स्वपतिर्दमूना यस्मा उ देवः सविता जजान ।
भगो वा गोभिरर्यमेमनज्यात्सो अस्मै चारुश्छदयदुत स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
nityashchakanyatsvapatirdamuna yasma u devah savita jajana |
bhago va gobhiraryamemanajyatso asmai charushchhadayaduta syat ||
verses.en:
Pleased be the Eternal Lord who loves the household with this man whom God Savitar created.
May Bhaga Aryaman grace him with cattle: may he appear to him, and be, delightful.

verses.sa:
इयं सा भूया उषसामिव क्षा यद्ध क्षुमन्तः शवसा समायन् ।
अस्य स्तुतिं जरितुर्भिक्षमाणा आ नः शग्मास उप यन्तु वाजाः ॥
verses.rom:
iyam sa bhuya ushasamiva ksha yaddha kshumantah shavasa samayan |
asya stutim jariturbhikshamana a nah shagmasa upa yantu vajah ||
verses.en:
Like the Dawns' dwelling-place be this assembly, where in their might men rich in food have gathered.
Striving to share the praises of this singer. To us come strengthening and effectual riches!

verses.sa:
अस्येदेषा सुमतिः पप्रथानाभवत्पूर्व्या भूमना गौः ।
अस्य सनीळा असुरस्य योनौ समान आ भरणे बिभ्रमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
asyedesha sumatih paprathanabhavatpurvya bhumana gauh |
asya sanila asurasya yonau samana a bharane bibhramanah ||
verses.en:
This Bull's most gracious far-extended favour existed first of all in full abundance.
By his support they are maintained in common who in the Asura's mansion dwell together.

verses.sa:
किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः ।
संतस्थाने अजरे इतऊती अहानि पूर्वीरुषसो जरन्त ॥
verses.rom:
kim svidvanam ka u sa vriksha asa yato dyavaprithivi nishtatakshuh |
samtasthane ajare itauti ahani purvirushaso jaranta ||
verses.en:
What was the tree, what wood, in sooth, produced it, from which they fashioned forth the Earth and Heaven?
These Twain stand fast and wax not old for ever: these have sung praise to many a day and morning.

verses.sa:
नैतावदेना परो अन्यदस्त्युक्षा स द्यावापृथिवी बिभर्ति ।
त्वचं पवित्रं कृणुत स्वधावान्यदीं सूर्यं न हरितो वहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
naitavadena paro anyadastyuksha sa dyavaprithivi bibharti |
tvacham pavitram krinuta svadhavanyadim suryam na harito vahanti ||
verses.en:
Not only here is this: more is beyond us. He is the Bull, the Heaven's and Earth's supporter.
With power divine he makes his skin a filter, when the Bay Coursers bear him on as Surya.

verses.sa:
स्तेगो न क्षामत्येति पृथ्वीं मिहं न वातो वि ह वाति भूम ।
मित्रो यत्र वरुणो अज्यमानोऽग्निर्वने न व्यसृष्ट शोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
stego na kshamatyeti prithvim miham na vato vi ha vati bhuma |
mitro yatra varuno ajyamano'gnirvane na vyasrishta shokam ||
verses.en:
He passes o'er the broad earth like a Stega: he penetrates the world as Wind the mist-cloud.
He, balmed with oil, near Varuna and Mitra, like Agni in the wood, hath shot forth splendour.

verses.sa:
स्तरीर्यत्सूत सद्यो अज्यमाना व्यथिरव्यथीः कृणुत स्वगोपा ।
पुत्रो यत्पूर्वः पित्रोर्जनिष्ट शम्यां गौर्जगार यद्ध पृच्छान् ॥
verses.rom:
stariryatsuta sadyo ajyamana vyathiravyathih krinuta svagopa |
putro yatpurvah pitrorjanishta shamyam gaurjagara yaddha prichchhan ||
verses.en:
When suddenly called the cow that erst was barren, she, self-protected, ended all her troubles.
Earth, when the first son sprang from sire and mother, cast up the game, that which men were seeking.

verses.sa:
उत कण्वं नृषदः पुत्रमाहुरुत श्यावो धनमादत्त वाजी ।
प्र कृष्णाय रुशदपिन्वतोधरृतमत्र नकिरस्मा अपीपेत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta kanvam nrishadah putramahuruta shyavo dhanamadatta vaji |
pra krishnaya rushadapinvatodharritamatra nakirasma apipet ||
verses.en:
To Nrsad's son they gave the name of Kainva, and he the brown-hued courser won the treasure.
For him dark-coloured streamed the shining udder: none made it swell for him. Thus Order willed it.

verses.sa:
प्र सु ग्मन्ता धियसानस्य सक्षणि वरेभिर्वराँ अभि षु प्रसीदतः ।
अस्माकमिन्द्र उभयं जुजोषति यत्सोम्यस्यान्धसो बुबोधति ॥
verses.rom:
pra su gmanta dhiyasanasya sakshani varebhirvaran abhi shu prasidatah |
asmakamindra ubhayam jujoshati yatsomyasyandhaso bubodhati ||
verses.en:
FORTH speed the Pair to bring the meditating God, benevolent with boons sent in return for boons.
May Indra graciously accept both gifts from us, when he hath knowledge of the flowing Soma juice.

verses.sa:
वीन्द्र यासि दिव्यानि रोचना वि पार्थिवानि रजसा पुरुष्टुत ।
ये त्वा वहन्ति मुहुरध्वराँ उप ते सु वन्वन्तु वग्वनाँ अराधसः ॥
verses.rom:
vindra yasi divyani rochana vi parthivani rajasa purushtuta |
ye tva vahanti muhuradhvaran upa te su vanvantu vagvanan aradhasah ||
verses.en:
Thou wanderest far, O Indra, through the spheres of light and realms of earth, the region, thou whom many praise!
Let those who often bring their solemn rites conquer the noisy babblers who present no gifts.

verses.sa:
तदिन्मे छन्त्सद्वपुषो वपुष्टरं पुत्रो यज्जानं पित्रोरधीयति ।
जाया पतिं वहति वग्नुना सुमत्पुंस इद्भद्रो वहतुः परिष्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tadinme chhantsadvapusho vapushtaram putro yajjanam pitroradhiyati |
jaya patim vahati vagnuna sumatpumsa idbhadro vahatuh parishkritah ||
verses.en:
More beautiful than beauty must this seem to me, when the son duly careth for his parents' line.
The wife attracts the husband: with a shout of joy the man's auspicious marriage is performed aright.

verses.sa:
तदित्सधस्थमभि चारु दीधय गावो यच्छासन्वहतुं न धेनवः ।
माता यन्मन्तुर्यूथस्य पूर्व्याभि वाणस्य सप्तधातुरिज्जनः ॥
verses.rom:
taditsadhasthamabhi charu didhaya gavo yachchhasanvahatum na dhenavah |
mata yanmanturyuthasya purvyabhi vanasya saptadhaturijjanah ||
verses.en:
This beauteous place of meeting have I looked upon, where, like milch-cows, the kine order the marriage train;
Where the Herd's Mother counts as first and best of all, and round her are the seven-toned people of the choir.

verses.sa:
प्र वोऽच्छा रिरिचे देवयुष्पदमेको रुद्रेभिर्याति तुर्वणिः ।
जरा वा येष्वमृतेषु दावने परि व ऊमेभ्यः सिञ्चता मधु ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo'chchha ririche devayushpadameko rudrebhiryati turvanih |
jara va yeshvamriteshu davane pari va umebhyah sinchata madhu ||
verses.en:
The Pious One hath reached your place before the rest: One only moves victorious with the Rudras' band.
To these your helpers pour our meath, Immortal Gods, with whom your song of praise hath power to win their gifts.

verses.sa:
निधीयमानमपगूळ्हमप्सु प्र मे देवानां व्रतपा उवाच ।
इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अनु हि त्वा चचक्ष तेनाहमग्ने अनुशिष्ट आगाम् ॥
verses.rom:
nidhiyamanamapagulhamapsu pra me devanam vratapa uvacha |
indro vidvan anu hi tva chachaksha tenahamagne anushishta agam ||
verses.en:
He who maintains the Laws of God informed me that thou wast lying hidden in the waters.
Indra, who knoweth well, beheld and showed thee. By him instructed am I come, O Agni.

verses.sa:
अक्षेत्रवित्क्षेत्रविदं ह्यप्राट् स प्रैति क्षेत्रविदानुशिष्टः ।
एतद्वै भद्रमनुशासनस्योत स्रुतिं विन्दत्यञ्जसीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
akshetravitkshetravidam hyaprat sa praiti kshetravidanushishtah |
etadvai bhadramanushasanasyota srutim vindatyanjasinam ||
verses.en:
The stranger asks the way of him who knows it: taught by the skillful guide he travels onward.
This is, in truth, the blessing of instruction: he finds the path that leads directly forward.

verses.sa:
अद्येदु प्राणीदममन्निमाहापीवृतो अधयन्मातुरूधः ।
एमेनमाप जरिमा युवानमहेळन्वसुः सुमना बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
adyedu pranidamamannimahapivrito adhayanmaturudhah |
emenamapa jarima yuvanamahelanvasuh sumana babhuva ||
verses.en:
Even now he breathed: these days hath he remembered. Concealed, he sucked the bosom of his Mother.
Yet in his youth old age hath come upon him: he hath grown gracious, good, and free from anger.

verses.sa:
एतानि भद्रा कलश क्रियाम कुरुश्रवण ददतो मघानि ।
दान इद्वो मघवानः सो अस्त्वयं च सोमो हृदि यं बिभर्मि ॥
verses.rom:
etani bhadra kalasha kriyama kurushravana dadato maghani |
dana idvo maghavanah so astvayam cha somo hridi yam bibharmi ||
verses.en:
O Kalasa, all these blessings will we bring them, O Kurusravana, who give rich presents.
May he, O wealthy princes, and this Soma which I am bearing in my heart, reward you.

verses.sa:
प्र मा युयुज्रे प्रयुजो जनानां वहामि स्म पूषणमन्तरेण ।
विश्वे देवासो अध मामरक्षन्दुःशासुरागादिति घोष आसीत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra ma yuyujre prayujo jananam vahami sma pushanamantarena |
vishve devaso adha mamarakshanduhshasuragaditi ghosha asit ||
verses.en:
THE urgings of the people have impelled me, and by the nearest way I bring you Pusan.
The Universal Gods have brought me safely. The cry was heard, Behold, Dubsasu cometh!

verses.sa:
सं मा तपन्त्यभितः सपत्नीरिव पर्शवः ।
नि बाधते अमतिर्नग्नता जसुर्वेर्न वेवीयते मतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sam ma tapantyabhitah sapatniriva parshavah |
ni badhate amatirnagnata jasurverna veviyate matih ||
verses.en:
The ribs that compass me give pain and trouble me like rival wives.
Indigence, nakedness, exhaustion press me sore: my mind is fluttering like a bird's.

verses.sa:
मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्य स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो ।
सकृत्सु नो मघवन्निन्द्र मृळयाधा पितेव नो भव ॥
verses.rom:
musho na shishna vyadanti madhya stotaram te shatakrato |
sakritsu no maghavannindra mrilayadha piteva no bhava ||
verses.en:
As rats eat weavers' threads, cares are consuming me, thy singer, Gatakratu, me.
Have mercy on us once, O Indra, Bounteous Lord: be thou a Father unto us.

verses.sa:
कुरुश्रवणमावृणि राजानं त्रासदस्यवम् ।
मंहिष्ठं वाघतामृषिः ॥
verses.rom:
kurushravanamavrini rajanam trasadasyavam |
mamhishtham vaghatamrishih ||
verses.en:
I the priests' Rsi chose as prince most liberal Kurusravana,
The son of Trasadasyu's son,

verses.sa:
यस्य मा हरितो रथे तिस्रो वहन्ति साधुया ।
स्तवै सहस्रदक्षिणे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya ma harito rathe tisro vahanti sadhuya |
stavai sahasradakshine ||
verses.en:
Whose three bays harnessed to the car bear me straight onward: I will laud
The giver of a thousand meeds,

verses.sa:
यस्य प्रस्वादसो गिर उपमश्रवसः पितुः ।
क्षेत्रं न रण्वमूचुषे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya prasvadaso gira upamashravasah pituh |
kshetram na ranvamuchushe ||
verses.en:
The sire of Upamasravas, even him whose words were passing sweet,
As a fair field is to its lord.

verses.sa:
अधि पुत्रोपमश्रवो नपान्मित्रातिथेरिहि ।
पितुष्टे अस्मि वन्दिता ॥
verses.rom:
adhi putropamashravo napanmitratitherihi |
pitushte asmi vandita ||
verses.en:
Mark, Upamasravas, his son, mark, grandson of Mitratithi:
I am thy father's eulogist.

verses.sa:
यदीशीयामृतानामुत वा मर्त्यानाम् ।
जीवेदिन्मघवा मम ॥
verses.rom:
yadishiyamritanamuta va martyanam |
jivedinmaghava mama ||
verses.en:
If I controlled Immortal Gods, yea, even were I Lord of men,
My liberal prince were living still.

verses.sa:
न देवानामति व्रतं शतात्मा चन जीवति ।
तथा युजा वि वावृते ॥
verses.rom:
na devanamati vratam shatatma chana jivati |
tatha yuja vi vavrite ||
verses.en:
None lives, even had he hundred lives, beyond the statute of the Gods
So am I parted from my friend.

verses.sa:
प्रावेपा मा बृहतो मादयन्ति प्रवातेजा इरिणे वर्वृतानाः ।
सोमस्येव मौजवतस्य भक्षो विभीदको जागृविर्मह्यमच्छान् ॥
verses.rom:
pravepa ma brihato madayanti pravateja irine varvritanah |
somasyeva maujavatasya bhaksho vibhidako jagrivirmahyamachchhan ||
verses.en:
SPRUNG from tall trees on windy heights, these rollers transport me as they turn upon the table.
The enlivening Vibhīdaka has pleased me like the draught of Soma from Mūjavant.

verses.sa:
न मा मिमेथ न जिहीळ एषा शिवा सखिभ्य उत मह्यमासीत् ।
अक्षस्याहमेकपरस्य हेतोरनुव्रतामप जायामरोधम् ॥
verses.rom:
na ma mimetha na jihila esha shiva sakhibhya uta mahyamasit |
akshasyahamekaparasya hetoranuvratamapa jayamarodham ||
verses.en:
She never vexed me nor was angry with me, but was ever gracious to my friends and me.
For a dice which scored one too much, I drive away my own devoted wife.

verses.sa:
द्वेष्टि श्वश्रूरप जाया रुणद्धि न नाथितो विन्दते मर्डितारम् ।
अश्वस्येव जरतो वस्न्यस्य नाहं विन्दामि कितवस्य भोगम् ॥
verses.rom:
dveshti shvashrurapa jaya runaddhi na nathito vindate marditaram |
ashvasyeva jarato vasnyasya naham vindami kitavasya bhogam ||
verses.en:
My wife drives me away, her mother hates me: the wretched man finds none to give him comfort.
[They say:] "I find no more use in a gambler than in an aged horse which is for sale."

verses.sa:
अन्ये जायां परि मृशन्त्यस्य यस्यागृधद्वेदने वाज्यक्षः ।
पिता माता भ्रातर एनमाहुर्न जानीमो नयता बद्धमेतम् ॥
verses.rom:
anye jayam pari mrishantyasya yasyagridhadvedane vajyakshah |
pita mata bhratara enamahurna janimo nayata baddhametam ||
verses.en:
Others embrace the wife of him whose riches the victorious dice have coveted:
Father and mother and brothers say about him [to the landlord's men]: "We know him not: tie him up and take him away."

verses.sa:
यदादीध्ये न दविषाण्येभिः परायद्भ्योऽव हीये सखिभ्यः ।
न्युप्ताश्च बभ्रवो वाचमक्रतँ एमीदेषां निष्कृतं जारिणीव ॥
verses.rom:
yadadidhye na davishanyebhih parayadbhyo'va hiye sakhibhyah |
nyuptashcha babhravo vachamakratan emidesham nishkritam jariniva ||
verses.en:
When I resolve "I will not play with them, I will remain behind when my friends [= fellow-gamblers] depart [to play]",
and the brown dice, thrown on the board, have rattled, like a fond girl I seek the place of meeting.

verses.sa:
सभामेति कितवः पृच्छमानो जेष्यामीति तन्वा शूशुजानः ।
अक्षासो अस्य वि तिरन्ति कामं प्रतिदीव्ने दधत आ कृतानि ॥
verses.rom:
sabhameti kitavah prichchhamano jeshyamiti tanva shushujanah |
akshaso asya vi tiranti kamam pratidivne dadhata a kritani ||
verses.en:
The gamester seeks the gambling-house, and wonders, his body all afire, "Will I be lucky?"
The dice run against his desire, giving the best throws to his adversary.

verses.sa:
अक्षास इदङ्कुशिनो नितोदिनो निकृत्वानस्तपनास्तापयिष्णवः ।
कुमारदेष्णा जयतः पुनर्हणो मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः कितवस्य बर्हणा ॥
verses.rom:
akshasa idankushino nitodino nikritvanastapanastapayishnavah |
kumaradeshna jayatah punarhano madhva sampriktah kitavasya barhana ||
verses.en:
Dice, verily, are armed with goads and driving-hooks, deceiving and tormenting, causing grievous woe.
They give gifts like boys [do], and then snatch them back from the winner,
[they are] sweetened [as] with honey with magic power over the gambler.

verses.sa:
त्रिपञ्चाशः क्रीळति व्रात एषां देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मा ।
उग्रस्य चिन्मन्यवे ना नमन्ते राजा चिदेभ्यो नम इत्कृणोति ॥
verses.rom:
tripanchashah krilati vrata esham deva iva savita satyadharma |
ugrasya chinmanyave na namante raja chidebhyo nama itkrinoti ||
verses.en:
Their troop of three-times-fifty plays [as undefeatably] as Savitr the god whose ways are faithful.
They bend not even to the anger of the mighty: the King himself pays homage and reveres them.

verses.sa:
नीचा वर्तन्त उपरि स्फुरन्त्यहस्तासो हस्तवन्तं सहन्ते ।
दिव्या अङ्गारा इरिणे न्युप्ताः शीताः सन्तो हृदयं निर्दहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
nicha vartanta upari sphurantyahastaso hastavantam sahante |
divya angara irine nyuptah shitah santo hridayam nirdahanti ||
verses.en:
Downward they roll, and then spring quickly upward, and, handless, force the man with hands to serve them.
Cast on the board, like lumps of magic charcoal, though cold themselves they burn the heart to ashes.

verses.sa:
जाया तप्यते कितवस्य हीना माता पुत्रस्य चरतः क्व स्वित् ।
ऋणावा बिभ्यद्धनमिच्छमानोऽन्येषामस्तमुप नक्तमेति ॥
verses.rom:
jaya tapyate kitavasya hina mata putrasya charatah kva svit |
rinava bibhyaddhanamichchhamano'nyeshamastamupa naktameti ||
verses.en:
The gambler's wife is left forlorn and wretched: the mother mourns the son who wanders homeless.
In constant fear, in debt, and seeking money, he goes by night to the home of others [probably to steal].

verses.sa:
स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वाय कितवं ततापान्येषां जायां सुकृतं च योनिम् ।
पूर्वाह्णे अश्वान्युयुजे हि बभ्रून्सो अग्नेरन्ते वृषलः पपाद ॥
verses.rom:
striyam drishtvaya kitavam tatapanyesham jayam sukritam cha yonim |
purvahne ashvanyuyuje hi babhrunso agnerante vrishalah papada ||
verses.en:
Sad is the gambler when he sees a woman, another man's wife, and his well-ordered dwelling.
He yokes the brown horses [= the dice] in the early morning, and in the evening he sinks down beside [his] fire, a beggar.

verses.sa:
यो वः सेनानीर्महतो गणस्य राजा व्रातस्य प्रथमो बभूव ।
तस्मै कृणोमि न धना रुणध्मि दशाहं प्राचीस्तदृतं वदामि ॥
verses.rom:
yo vah senanirmahato ganasya raja vratasya prathamo babhuva |
tasmai krinomi na dhana runadhmi dashaham prachistadritam vadami ||
verses.en:
To the great captain of your mighty army [of dice], who has become the host's imperial leader,
To him I show [my] ten [extended fingers]: "I speak the truth: No wealth am I withholding."

verses.sa:
अक्षैर्मा दीव्यः कृषिमित्कृषस्व वित्ते रमस्व बहु मन्यमानः ।
तत्र गावः कितव तत्र जाया तन्मे वि चष्टे सवितायमर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
akshairma divyah krishimitkrishasva vitte ramasva bahu manyamanah |
tatra gavah kitava tatra jaya tanme vi chashte savitayamaryah ||
verses.en:
"Play not with dice, [but] cultivate your corn-land. Enjoy the gain, and deem that wealth sufficient.
There are your cattle, there your wife, O gambler": So this good Savitr himself has told me.

verses.sa:
मित्रं कृणुध्वं खलु मृळता नो मा नो घोरेण चरताभि धृष्णु ।
नि वो नु मन्युर्विशतामरातिरन्यो बभ्रूणां प्रसितौ न्वस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
mitram krinudhvam khalu mrilata no ma no ghorena charatabhi dhrishnu |
ni vo nu manyurvishatamaratiranyo babhrunam prasitau nvastu ||
verses.en:
Make me your friend: show us some little mercy. Do not forcibly bewitch us with magic power.
Let your wrath [and] emnity now come to rest. Let the brown [dice] now snare some other captive.

verses.sa:
अबुध्रमु त्य इन्द्रवन्तो अग्नयो ज्योतिर्भरन्त उषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
मही द्यावापृथिवी चेततामपोऽद्या देवानामव आ वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
abudhramu tya indravanto agnayo jyotirbharanta ushaso vyushtishu |
mahi dyavaprithivi chetatamapo'dya devanamava a vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
THESE fires associate with Indra are awake, bringing their light when first the Dawn begins to shine.
May Heaven and Earth, great Pair, observe our holy work. We claim for us this day the favour of the Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्योरव आ वृणीमहे मातॄन्सिन्धून्पर्वताञ्छर्यणावतः ।
अनागास्त्वं सूर्यमुषासमीमहे भद्रं सोमः सुवानो अद्या कृणोतु नः ॥
verses.rom:
divasprithivyorava a vrinimahe matrinsindhunparvatanchharyanavatah |
anagastvam suryamushasamimahe bhadram somah suvano adya krinotu nah ||
verses.en:
Yea, for ourselves we claim the grace of Heaven and Earth, of Saryanavan, of the Hills and Mother Streams.
For innocence we pray to Surya and to Dawn. So may the flowing Soma bring us bliss to-day.

verses.sa:
द्यावा नो अद्य पृथिवी अनागसो मही त्रायेतां सुविताय मातरा ।
उषा उच्छन्त्यप बाधतामघं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
dyava no adya prithivi anagaso mahi trayetam suvitaya matara |
usha uchchhantyapa badhatamagham svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
May the great Twain, the Mothers, Heaven and Earth, this day preserve us free from sin for peace and happiness.
May Morning sending forth her light drive sin afar. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
इयं न उस्रा प्रथमा सुदेव्यं रेवत्सनिभ्यो रेवती व्युच्छतु ।
आरे मन्युं दुर्विदत्रस्य धीमहि स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
iyam na usra prathama sudevyam revatsanibhyo revati vyuchchhatu |
are manyum durvidatrasya dhimahi svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
May this first Dawn bring us the host of gracious Gods: rich, may it richly shine for us who strive for wealth.
The wrath of the malignant may we keep afar. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
प्र याः सिस्रते सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिर्भरन्तीरुषसो व्युष्टिषु ।
भद्रा नो अद्य श्रवसे व्युच्छत स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
pra yah sisrate suryasya rashmibhirjyotirbharantirushaso vyushtishu |
bhadra no adya shravase vyuchchhata svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Dawns, who come forward with the bright beams of the Sun, and at your earliest flushing bring to us the light,
Shine ye on us to-day auspicious, for renown. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
अनमीवा उषस आ चरन्तु न उदग्नयो जिहतां ज्योतिषा बृहत् ।
आयुक्षातामश्विना तूतुजिं रथं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
anamiva ushasa a charantu na udagnayo jihatam jyotisha brihat |
ayukshatamashvina tutujim ratham svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Free from all sickness may the Mornings come to us, and let our fires mount upward with a lofty blaze.
The Asvin Pair have harnessed their swift-moving car. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठं नो अद्य सवितर्वरेण्यं भागमा सुव स हि रत्नधा असि ।
रायो जनित्रीं धिषणामुप ब्रुवे स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
shreshtham no adya savitarvarenyam bhagama suva sa hi ratnadha asi |
rayo janitrim dhishanamupa bruve svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Send us to-day a portion choice and excellent, O Savitar, for thou art he who dealeth wealth.
I cry to Dhisana, Mother of opulence. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
पिपर्तु मा तदृतस्य प्रवाचनं देवानां यन्मनुष्या अमन्महि ।
विश्वा इदुस्रा स्पळुदेति सूर्यः स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
pipartu ma tadritasya pravachanam devanam yanmanushya amanmahi |
vishva idusra spaludeti suryah svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Further me this declaring of Eternal Law, the Law of Gods, as we mortals acknowledge it!
The Sun goes up beholding all the rays of morn. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
अद्वेषो अद्य बर्हिष स्तरीमणि ग्राव्णां योगे मन्मनः साध ईमहे ।
आदित्यानां शर्मणि स्था भुरण्यसि स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
advesho adya barhisha starimani gravnam yoge manmanah sadha imahe |
adityanam sharmani stha bhuranyasi svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
This day we pray with innocence in strewing grass, adjusting pressing-stones, and perfecting the hymn.
Thou in the Adityas' keeping movest restlessly. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
आ नो बर्हिः सधमादे बृहद्दिवि देवाँ ईळे सादया सप्त होतॄन् ।
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
a no barhih sadhamade brihaddivi devan ile sadaya sapta hotrin |
indram mitram varunam sataye bhagam svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
To our great holy grass I bid the Gods at morn to banquet, and will seat them as the seven priests,-
Varuna, Indra, Mitra, Bhaga for our gain. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये वृधे नो यज्ञमवता सजोषसः ।
बृहस्पतिं पूषणमश्विना भगं स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ta aditya a gata sarvatataye vridhe no yajnamavata sajoshasah |
brihaspatim pushanamashvina bhagam svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Come hither, O Adityas, for our perfect weal: accordant help our sacrifice that we may thrive.
Pusan, Brhaspati, Bhaga, both Asvins, and enkindled Agni we implore for happiness.

verses.sa:
तन्नो देवा यच्छत सुप्रवाचनं छर्दिरादित्याः सुभरं नृपाय्यम् ।
पश्वे तोकाय तनयाय जीवसे स्वस्त्यग्निं समिधानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tanno deva yachchhata supravachanam chhardiradityah subharam nripayyam |
pashve tokaya tanayaya jivase svastyagnim samidhanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Adityas, Gods, vouchsafe that this our home may be praise-worthy, prosperous, our heroes' sure defence,
For cattle, for our sons, for progeny, for life. We pray to kindled Agni for felicity.

verses.sa:
विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः ।
विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
vishve adya maruto vishva uti vishve bhavantvagnayah samiddhah |
vishve no deva avasa gamantu vishvamastu dravinam vajo asme ||
verses.en:
This day may all the Maruts, all he near us with aid: may all our fires be well enkindled.
May all Gods come to us with gracious favour. May spoil and wealth he ours, and all possessions.

verses.sa:
यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं त्रायध्वे यं पिपृथात्यंहः ।
यो वो गोपीथे न भयस्य वेद ते स्याम देववीतये तुरासः ॥
verses.rom:
yam devaso'vatha vajasatau yam trayadhve yam piprithatyamhah |
yo vo gopithe na bhayasya veda te syama devavitaye turasah ||
verses.en:
He whom ye aid, O Deities, in battle, whom ye protect and rescue from affliction,
Who fears no danger at your milk-libation, -such may we be to feast the Gods, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
उषासानक्ता बृहती सुपेशसा द्यावाक्षामा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
इन्द्रं हुवे मरुतः पर्वताँ अप आदित्यान्द्यावापृथिवी अपः स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
ushasanakta brihati supeshasa dyavakshama varuno mitro aryama |
indram huve marutah parvatan apa adityandyavaprithivi apah svah ||
verses.en:
THERE are the Dawn and Night, the grand and beauteous Pair, Earth, Heaven, and Varuna, Mitra, and Aryaman.
Indra I call, the Maruts, Mountains, and the Floods, Adityas, Heaven and Earth, the Waters, and the Sky.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च नः पृथिवी च प्रचेतस ऋतावरी रक्षतामंहसो रिषः ।
मा दुर्विदत्रा निरृतिर्न ईशत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
dyaushcha nah prithivi cha prachetasa ritavari rakshatamamhaso rishah |
ma durvidatra nirritirna ishata taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
May Dyaus and Prthivi, wise, true to Holy Law, keep us in safety from distress and injury.
Let not malignant Nirrti rule over us. We crave to-day this gracious favour of the Gods.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मान्नो अदितिः पात्वंहसो माता मित्रस्य वरुणस्य रेवतः ।
स्वर्वज्ज्योतिरवृकं नशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasmanno aditih patvamhaso mata mitrasya varunasya revatah |
svarvajjyotiravrikam nashimahi taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Mother of Mitra and of opulent Varuna, may Aditi preserve us safe from all distress.
May we obtain the light of heaven without a foe. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
ग्रावा वदन्नप रक्षांसि सेधतु दुष्वप्न्यं निरृतिं विश्वमत्रिणम् ।
आदित्यं शर्म मरुतामशीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
grava vadannapa rakshamsi sedhatu dushvapnyam nirritim vishvamatrinam |
adityam sharma marutamashimahi taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
May ringing press-stones keep the Raksasas afar, ill dream, and Nirrti, and each voracious fiend.
May the Adityas and the Maruts shelter us. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रो बर्हिः सीदतु पिन्वतामिळा बृहस्पतिः सामभिरृक्वो अर्चतु ।
सुप्रकेतं जीवसे मन्म धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
endro barhih sidatu pinvatamila brihaspatih samabhirrikvo archatu |
supraketam jivase manma dhimahi taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Full flow libations; on our grass let Indra sit; Brhaspati the singer laud with Sama hymns!
Wise be our hearts' imaginings that we may live. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
दिविस्पृशं यज्ञमस्माकमश्विना जीराध्वरं कृणुतं सुम्नमिष्टये ।
प्राचीनरश्मिमाहुतं घृतेन तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
divisprisham yajnamasmakamashvina jiradhvaram krinutam sumnamishtaye |
