prachinarashmimahutam ghritena taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Ye Asvins, make our sacrifice ascend to heaven, and animate the rite that it may send us bliss,
Offered with holy oil, with forward-speeding rein. We crave the gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
उप ह्वये सुहवं मारुतं गणं पावकमृष्वं सख्याय शम्भुवम् ।
रायस्पोषं सौश्रवसाय धीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
upa hvaye suhavam marutam ganam pavakamrishvam sakhyaya shambhuvam |
rayasposham saushravasaya dhimahi taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Hither I call the band of Maruts, swift to hear, great, purifying, bringing bliss, to he our Friends.
May we increase our wealth to glorify our name. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
अपां पेरुं जीवधन्यं भरामहे देवाव्यं सुहवमध्वरश्रियम् ।
सुरश्मिं सोममिन्द्रियं यमीमहि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
apam perum jivadhanyam bharamahe devavyam suhavamadhvarashriyam |
surashmim somamindriyam yamimahi taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
We bring the Stay of Life, who makes the waters swell, swift-hearing, Friend of Gods, who waits on sacrifice.
May we control that Power, Soma whose rays are bright. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
सनेम तत्सुसनिता सनित्वभिर्वयं जीवा जीवपुत्रा अनागसः ।
ब्रह्मद्विषो विष्वगेनो भरेरत तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
sanema tatsusanita sanitvabhirvayam jiva jivaputra anagasah |
brahmadvisho vishvageno bharerata taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Alive ourselves, with living sons, devoid of guilt, may we win this with winners by fair means to win.
Let the prayer-haters bear our sin to every side. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
ये स्था मनोर्यज्ञियास्ते शृणोतन यद्वो देवा ईमहे तद्ददातन ।
जैत्रं क्रतुं रयिमद्वीरवद्यशस्तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ye stha manoryajniyaste shrinotana yadvo deva imahe taddadatana |
jaitram kratum rayimadviravadyashastaddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Hear us, O ye who claim the worship of mankind, and give us, O ye Gods, the gift for which we pray,
Victorious wisdom, fame with heroes and with wealth. We crave to-day this gracious favour of the Gods.

verses.sa:
महदद्य महतामा वृणीमहेऽवो देवानां बृहतामनर्वणाम् ।
यथा वसु वीरजातं नशामहै तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
mahadadya mahatama vrinimahe'vo devanam brihatamanarvanam |
yatha vasu virajatam nashamahai taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
We crave the gracious favour of the Gods to-day, great favour of great Gods, sublime and free from foes,
That we may gain rich treasure sprung from hero sons. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
महो अग्नेः समिधानस्य शर्मण्यनागा मित्रे वरुणे स्वस्तये ।
श्रेष्ठे स्याम सवितुः सवीमनि तद्देवानामवो अद्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
maho agneh samidhanasya sharmanyanaga mitre varune svastaye |
shreshthe syama savituh savimani taddevanamavo adya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
In great enkindled Agni's keeping, and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna.
May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sa:
ये सवितुः सत्यसवस्य विश्वे मित्रस्य व्रते वरुणस्य देवाः ।
ते सौभगं वीरवद्गोमदप्नो दधातन द्रविणं चित्रमस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ye savituh satyasavasya vishve mitrasya vrate varunasya devah |
te saubhagam viravadgomadapno dadhatana dravinam chitramasme ||
verses.en:
All ye, the Gods whom Savitar the Father of truth, and Varuna and Mitra govern,
Give us prosperity with hero children, and opulence in kine and various treasure.

verses.sa:
सविता पश्चातात्सविता पुरस्तात्सवितोत्तरात्तात्सविताधरात्तात् ।
सविता नः सुवतु सर्वतातिं सविता नो रासतां दीर्घमायुः ॥
verses.rom:
savita pashchatatsavita purastatsavitottarattatsavitadharattat |
savita nah suvatu sarvatatim savita no rasatam dirghamayuh ||
verses.en:
Savitar, Savitar from east and westward, Savitar, Savitar from north and southward,
Savitar send us perfect health and comfort, Savitar let our days of life be lengthened!

verses.sa:
नमो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य चक्षसे महो देवाय तदृतं सपर्यत ।
दूरेदृशे देवजाताय केतवे दिवस्पुत्राय सूर्याय शंसत ॥
verses.rom:
namo mitrasya varunasya chakshase maho devaya tadritam saparyata |
duredrishe devajataya ketave divasputraya suryaya shamsata ||
verses.en:
Do homage unto Varuna's and Mitra's Eye: offer this solemn worship to the Mighty God,
Who seeth far away, the Ensign, born of Gods. Sing praises unto Surya, to the Son of Dyaus.

verses.sa:
सा मा सत्योक्तिः परि पातु विश्वतो द्यावा च यत्र ततनन्नहानि च ।
विश्वमन्यन्नि विशते यदेजति विश्वाहापो विश्वाहोदेति सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa ma satyoktih pari patu vishvato dyava cha yatra tatanannahani cha |
vishvamanyanni vishate yadejati vishvahapo vishvahodeti suryah ||
verses.en:
May this my truthful speech guard me on every side wherever heaven and earth and days are spread abroad.
All else that is in motion finds a place of rest: the waters ever flow and ever mounts the Sun.

verses.sa:
न ते अदेवः प्रदिवो नि वासते यदेतशेभिः पतरै रथर्यसि ।
प्राचीनमन्यदनु वर्तते रज उदन्येन ज्योतिषा यासि सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
na te adevah pradivo ni vasate yadetashebhih patarai ratharyasi |
prachinamanyadanu vartate raja udanyena jyotisha yasi surya ||
verses.en:
No godless man from time remotest draws thee down when thou art driving forth with winged dappled Steeds.
One lustre waits upon thee moving to the cast, and, Surya, thou arisest with a different light.

verses.sa:
येन सूर्य ज्योतिषा बाधसे तमो जगच्च विश्वमुदियर्षि भानुना ।
तेनास्मद्विश्वामनिरामनाहुतिमपामीवामप दुष्वप्न्यं सुव ॥
verses.rom:
yena surya jyotisha badhase tamo jagachcha vishvamudiyarshi bhanuna |
tenasmadvishvamaniramanahutimapamivamapa dushvapnyam suva ||
verses.en:
O Surya, with the light whereby thou scatterest gloom, and with thy ray impellest every moving thing,
Keep far from us all feeble, worthless sacrifice, and drive away disease and every evil dream.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य हि प्रेषितो रक्षसि व्रतमहेळयन्नुच्चरसि स्वधा अनु ।
यदद्य त्वा सूर्योपब्रवामहै तं नो देवा अनु मंसीरत क्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasya hi preshito rakshasi vratamahelayannuchcharasi svadha anu |
yadadya tva suryopabravamahai tam no deva anu mamsirata kratum ||
verses.en:
Sent forth thou guardest well the Universe's law, and in thy wonted way arisest free from wrath.
When Surya, we address our prayers to thee to-day, may the Gods favour this our purpose and desire.

verses.sa:
तं नो द्यावापृथिवी तन्न आप इन्द्रः शृण्वन्तु मरुतो हवं वचः ।
मा शूने भूम सूर्यस्य संदृशि भद्रं जीवन्तो जरणामशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
tam no dyavaprithivi tanna apa indrah shrinvantu maruto havam vachah |
ma shune bhuma suryasya samdrishi bhadram jivanto jaranamashimahi ||
verses.en:
This invocation, these our words may Heaven and Earth, and Indra and the Waters and the Maruts hear.
Ne'er may we suffer want in presence of the Sun, and, living happy lives, may we attain old age.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहा त्वा सुमनसः सुचक्षसः प्रजावन्तो अनमीवा अनागसः ।
उद्यन्तं त्वा मित्रमहो दिवेदिवे ज्योग्जीवाः प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
vishvaha tva sumanasah suchakshasah prajavanto anamiva anagasah |
udyantam tva mitramaho divedive jyogjivah prati pashyema surya ||
verses.en:
Cheerful in spirit, evermore, and keen of sight, with store of children, free from sickness and from sin,
Long-living, may we look, O Surya, upon thee uprising day by day, thou great as Mitra is!

verses.sa:
महि ज्योतिर्बिभ्रतं त्वा विचक्षण भास्वन्तं चक्षुषेचक्षुषे मयः ।
आरोहन्तं बृहतः पाजसस्परि वयं जीवाः प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
mahi jyotirbibhratam tva vichakshana bhasvantam chakshushechakshushe mayah |
arohantam brihatah pajasaspari vayam jivah prati pashyema surya ||
verses.en:
Surya, may we live long and look upon thee still, thee, O Far-seeing One, bringing the glorious light,
The radiant God, the spring of joy to every eye, as thou art mounting up o'er the high shining flood.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते विश्वा भुवनानि केतुना प्र चेरते नि च विशन्ते अक्तुभिः ।
अनागास्त्वेन हरिकेश सूर्याह्नाह्ना नो वस्यसावस्यसोदिहि ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te vishva bhuvanani ketuna pra cherate ni cha vishante aktubhih |
anagastvena harikesha suryahnahna no vasyasavasyasodihi ||
verses.en:
Thou by whose lustre all the world of life comes forth, and by thy beams again returns unto its rest,
O Surya with the golden hair, ascend for us day after day, still bringing purer innocence.

verses.sa:
शं नो भव चक्षसा शं नो अह्ना शं भानुना शं हिमा शं घृणेन ।
यथा शमध्वञ्छमसद्दुरोणे तत्सूर्य द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhava chakshasa sham no ahna sham bhanuna sham hima sham ghrinena |
yatha shamadhvanchhamasaddurone tatsurya dravinam dhehi chitram ||
verses.en:
Bless us with shine, bless us with perfect daylight, bless us with cold, with fervent heat and lustre.
Bestow on us, O Surya, varied riches, to bless us in our home and when we travel.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं देवा उभयाय जन्मने शर्म यच्छत द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ।
अदत्पिबदूर्जयमानमाशितं तदस्मे शं योररपो दधातन ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam deva ubhayaya janmane sharma yachchhata dvipade chatushpade |
adatpibadurjayamanamashitam tadasme sham yorarapo dadhatana ||
verses.en:
Gods, to our living creatures of both kinds vouchsafe protection, both to bipeds and to quadrupeds,
That they may drink and eat invigorating food. So grant us health and strength and perfect innocence.

verses.sa:
यद्वो देवाश्चकृम जिह्वया गुरु मनसो वा प्रयुती देवहेळनम् ।
अरावा यो नो अभि दुच्छुनायते तस्मिन्तदेनो वसवो नि धेतन ॥
verses.rom:
yadvo devashchakrima jihvaya guru manaso va prayuti devahelanam |
arava yo no abhi duchchhunayate tasmintadeno vasavo ni dhetana ||
verses.en:
If by some grievous sin we have provoked the Gods, O Deities, with the tongue or thoughtlessness of heart,
That guilt, O Vasus, lay upon the Evil One, on him who ever leads us into deep distress.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्न इन्द्र पृत्सुतौ यशस्वति शिमीवति क्रन्दसि प्राव सातये ।
यत्र गोषाता धृषितेषु खादिषु विष्वक्पतन्ति दिद्यवो नृषाह्ये ॥
verses.rom:
asminna indra pritsutau yashasvati shimivati krandasi prava sataye |
yatra goshata dhrishiteshu khadishu vishvakpatanti didyavo nrishahye ||
verses.en:
O INDRA, in this battle great and glorious, in this loud din of war help us to victory,
Where in the strife for kine among bold ring-decked men arrows fly all around and heroes are subdued.

verses.sa:
स नः क्षुमन्तं सदने व्यूर्णुहि गोअर्णसं रयिमिन्द्र श्रवाय्यम् ।
स्याम ते जयतः शक्र मेदिनो यथा वयमुश्मसि तद्वसो कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah kshumantam sadane vyurnuhi goarnasam rayimindra shravayyam |
syama te jayatah shakra medino yatha vayamushmasi tadvaso kridhi ||
verses.en:
At home disclose to us opulence rich in food, streaming with milk, O Indra, meet to be renowned.
Sakra, may we be thine, the friendly Conqueror's: even as we desire, O Vasu, so do thou.

verses.sa:
यो नो दास आर्यो वा पुरुष्टुतादेव इन्द्र युधये चिकेतति ।
अस्माभिष्टे सुषहाः सन्तु शत्रवस्त्वया वयं तान्वनुयाम संगमे ॥
verses.rom:
yo no dasa aryo va purushtutadeva indra yudhaye chiketati |
asmabhishte sushahah santu shatravastvaya vayam tanvanuyama samgame ||
verses.en:
The godless man, much-lauded Indra, whether he be Dasa or be Arya, who would war with us,-
Easy to conquer he for thee, with us, these foes: with thee may we subdue them in the clash of fight.

verses.sa:
यो दभ्रेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भूरिभिर्यो अभीके वरिवोविन्नृषाह्ये ।
तं विखादे सस्निमद्य श्रुतं नरमर्वाञ्चमिन्द्रमवसे करामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yo dabhrebhirhavyo yashcha bhuribhiryo abhike varivovinnrishahye |
tam vikhade sasnimadya shrutam naramarvanchamindramavase karamahe ||
verses.en:
Him who must be invoked by many and by few, who standeth nigh with comfort in the war of men,
Indra, famed Hero, winner in the deadly strife, let us bring hitherward to-day to favour us.

verses.sa:
स्ववृजं हि त्वामहमिन्द्र शुश्रवानानुदं वृषभ रध्रचोदनम् ।
प्र मुञ्चस्व परि कुत्सादिहा गहि किमु त्वावान्मुष्कयोर्बद्ध आसते ॥
verses.rom:
svavrijam hi tvamahamindra shushravananudam vrishabha radhrachodanam |
pra munchasva pari kutsadiha gahi kimu tvavanmushkayorbaddha asate ||
verses.en:
For, Indra, I have heard thee called Self. capturer, One, Steer! who never yields, who urges even the churl.
Release thyself from Kutsa and come hither. How shall one like thee sit still bound that he may not move?

verses.sa:
यो वां परिज्मा सुवृदश्विना रथो दोषामुषासो हव्यो हविष्मता ।
शश्वत्तमासस्तमु वामिदं वयं पितुर्न नाम सुहवं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yo vam parijma suvridashvina ratho doshamushaso havyo havishmata |
shashvattamasastamu vamidam vayam piturna nama suhavam havamahe ||
verses.en:
As 'twere the name of father, easy to invoke, we all assembled here invoke this Car of yours,
Asvins, your swiftly-rolling circumambient Car which he who worships must invoke at eve and dawn.

verses.sa:
चोदयतं सूनृताः पिन्वतं धिय उत्पुरंधीरीरयतं तदुश्मसि ।
यशसं भागं कृणुतं नो अश्विना सोमं न चारुं मघवत्सु नस्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
chodayatam sunritah pinvatam dhiya utpuramdhirirayatam tadushmasi |
yashasam bhagam krinutam no ashvina somam na charum maghavatsu naskritam ||
verses.en:
Awake all pleasant strains and let the hymns flow forth: raise up abundant fulness: this is our desire.
Asvins, bestow on us a glorious heritage, and give our princes treasure fair as Soma is.

verses.sa:
अमाजुरश्चिद्भवथो युवं भगोऽनाशोश्चिदवितारापमस्य चित् ।
अन्धस्य चिन्नासत्या कृशस्य चिद्युवामिदाहुर्भिषजा रुतस्य चित् ॥
verses.rom:
amajurashchidbhavatho yuvam bhago'nashoshchidavitarapamasya chit |
andhasya chinnasatya krishasya chidyuvamidahurbhishaja rutasya chit ||
verses.en:
Ye are the bliss of her who groweth old at home, and helpers of the slow although he linger last.
Men call you too, Nasatyas, healers of the blind, the thin and feeble, and the man with broken bones.

verses.sa:
युवं च्यवानं सनयं यथा रथं पुनर्युवानं चरथाय तक्षथुः ।
निष्टौग्र्यमूहथुरद्भ्यस्परि विश्वेत्ता वां सवनेषु प्रवाच्या ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam chyavanam sanayam yatha ratham punaryuvanam charathaya takshathuh |
nishtaugryamuhathuradbhyaspari vishvetta vam savaneshu pravachya ||
verses.en:
Ye made Cyavana, weak and worn with length of days, young again, like a car, that he had power to move.
Ye lifted up the son of Tugra from the floods. At our libations must all these your acts be praised.

verses.sa:
पुराणा वां वीर्या प्र ब्रवा जनेऽथो हासथुर्भिषजा मयोभुवा ।
ता वां नु नव्याववसे करामहेऽयं नासत्या श्रदरिर्यथा दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
purana vam virya pra brava jane'tho hasathurbhishaja mayobhuva |
ta vam nu navyavavase karamahe'yam nasatya shradariryatha dadhat ||
verses.en:
We will declare among the folk your ancient deeds heroic; yea, ye were Physicians bringing health.
You, you who must be lauded, will we bring for aid, so that this foe of ours, O Asvins, may believe.

verses.sa:
इयं वामह्वे शृणुतं मे अश्विना पुत्रायेव पितरा मह्यं शिक्षतम् ।
अनापिरज्ञा असजात्यामतिः पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरव स्पृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyam vamahve shrinutam me ashvina putrayeva pitara mahyam shikshatam |
anapirajna asajatyamatih pura tasya abhishasterava spritam ||
verses.en:
Listen to me, O Asvins; I have cried to you. Give me-your aid as sire and mother aid their son.
Poor, without kin or friend or ties of blood am I. Save me before it be too late, from this my curse.

verses.sa:
युवं रथेन विमदाय शुन्ध्युवं न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषणाम् ।
युवं हवं वध्रिमत्या अगच्छतं युवं सुषुतिं चक्रथुः पुरंधये ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam rathena vimadaya shundhyuvam nyuhathuh purumitrasya yoshanam |
yuvam havam vadhrimatya agachchhatam yuvam sushutim chakrathuh puramdhaye ||
verses.en:
Ye, mounted on your chariot brought to Vimada the comely maid of Purumitra as a bride.
Ye, came unto the calling of the weakling's dame, and granted noble offspring to the happy wife.

verses.sa:
युवं विप्रस्य जरणामुपेयुषः पुनः कलेरकृणुतं युवद्वयः ।
युवं वन्दनमृश्यदादुदूपथुर्युवं सद्यो विश्पलामेतवे कृथः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam viprasya jaranamupeyushah punah kalerakrinutam yuvadvayah |
yuvam vandanamrishyadadudupathuryuvam sadyo vishpalametave krithah ||
verses.en:
Ye gave again the vigour of his youthful life to the sage Kali when old age was coming nigh.
Ye rescued Vandana and raised him from the pit, and in a moment gave Vispala power to move.

verses.sa:
युवं ह रेभं वृषणा गुहा हितमुदैरयतं ममृवांसमश्विना ।
युवमृबीसमुत तप्तमत्रय ओमन्वन्तं चक्रथुः सप्तवध्रये ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha rebham vrishana guha hitamudairayatam mamrivamsamashvina |
yuvamribisamuta taptamatraya omanvantam chakrathuh saptavadhraye ||
verses.en:
Ye Asvins Twain, endowed with manly strength, brought forth Reblia when hidden in the cave and well-nigh dead,
Freed Saptavadliri, and for Atri caused the pit heated with fire to be a pleasant resting-place.

verses.sa:
युवं श्वेतं पेदवेऽश्विनाश्वं नवभिर्वाजैर्नवती च वाजिनम् ।
चर्कृत्यं ददथुर्द्रावयत्सखं भगं न नृभ्यो हव्यं मयोभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam shvetam pedave'shvinashvam navabhirvajairnavati cha vajinam |
charkrityam dadathurdravayatsakham bhagam na nribhyo havyam mayobhuvam ||
verses.en:
On Pedu ye bestowed, Asvins, a courser white, mighty with nine-and-ninety varied gifts of strength,
A horse to be renowned, who bore his friend at speed, joy-giving, Bhaga-like to be invoked of men.

verses.sa:
न तं राजानावदिते कुतश्चन नांहो अश्नोति दुरितं नकिर्भयम् ।
यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी पुरोरथं कृणुथः पत्न्या सह ॥
verses.rom:
na tam rajanavadite kutashchana namho ashnoti duritam nakirbhayam |
yamashvina suhava rudravartani puroratham krinuthah patnya saha ||
verses.en:
From no side, ye Two Kings whom none may check or stay, doth grief, distress, or danger come u on the man
Whom, Asvins swift to hear, borne on your glowing path, ye with your Consort make the foremost in the race.

verses.sa:
आ तेन यातं मनसो जवीयसा रथं यं वामृभवश्चक्रुरश्विना ।
यस्य योगे दुहिता जायते दिव उभे अहनी सुदिने विवस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
a tena yatam manaso javiyasa ratham yam vamribhavashchakrurashvina |
yasya yoge duhita jayate diva ubhe ahani sudine vivasvatah ||
verses.en:
Come on that Chariot which the Rbhus wrought for you, the Chariot, Asvins, that is speedier than thought,
At harnessing whereof Heaven's Daughter springs to birth, and from Vivasvan come auspicious Night and Day.

verses.sa:
ता वर्तिर्यातं जयुषा वि पर्वतमपिन्वतं शयवे धेनुमश्विना ।
वृकस्य चिद्वर्तिकामन्तरास्याद्युवं शचीभिर्ग्रसिताममुञ्चतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta vartiryatam jayusha vi parvatamapinvatam shayave dhenumashvina |
vrikasya chidvartikamantarasyadyuvam shachibhirgrasitamamunchatam ||
verses.en:
Come, Conquerors of the sundered mountain, to our home, Asvins who made the cow stream milk for Sayu's sake,
Ye who delivered even from the wolf's deep throat and set again at liberty the swallowed quail.

verses.sa:
एतं वां स्तोममश्विनावकर्मातक्षाम भृगवो न रथम् ।
न्यमृक्षाम योषणां न मर्ये नित्यं न सूनुं तनयं दधानाः ॥
verses.rom:
etam vam stomamashvinavakarmatakshama bhrigavo na ratham |
nyamrikshama yoshanam na marye nityam na sunum tanayam dadhanah ||
verses.en:
We have prepared this laud for you, O Asvins, and, like the Bhrgus, as a car have framed it,
Have decked it as a maid to meet the bridegroom, and brought it as a son, our stay for ever.

verses.sa:
रथं यान्तं कुह को ह वां नरा प्रति द्युमन्तं सुविताय भूषति ।
प्रातर्यावाणं विभ्वं विशेविशे वस्तोर्वस्तोर्वहमानं धिया शमि ॥
verses.rom:
ratham yantam kuha ko ha vam nara prati dyumantam suvitaya bhushati |
prataryavanam vibhvam vishevishe vastorvastorvahamanam dhiya shami ||
verses.en:
YOUR radiant Chariot-whither goes it on its way?-who decks it for you, Heroes, for its happy course,
Starting at daybreak, visiting each morning every house, borne hitherward through prayer unto the sacrifice?

verses.sa:
कुह स्विद्दोषा कुह वस्तोरश्विना कुहाभिपित्वं करतः कुहोषतुः ।
को वां शयुत्रा विधवेव देवरं मर्यं न योषा कृणुते सधस्थ आ ॥
verses.rom:
kuha sviddosha kuha vastorashvina kuhabhipitvam karatah kuhoshatuh |
ko vam shayutra vidhaveva devaram maryam na yosha krinute sadhastha a ||
verses.en:
Where are ye, Asvins, in the evening, where at morn? Where is your halting place, where rest ye for the night?
Who brings you homeward, as the widow bed ward draws her husband's brother, as the bride attracts the groom?

verses.sa:
प्रातर्जरेथे जरणेव कापया वस्तोर्वस्तोर्यजता गच्छथो गृहम् ।
कस्य ध्वस्रा भवथः कस्य वा नरा राजपुत्रेव सवनाव गच्छथः ॥
verses.rom:
pratarjarethe jaraneva kapaya vastorvastoryajata gachchhatho griham |
kasya dhvasra bhavathah kasya va nara rajaputreva savanava gachchhathah ||
verses.en:
Early ye sing forth praise as with a herald's voice, and, meet for worship, go each morning to the house.
Whom do ye ever bring to ruin? Unto whose libations come ye, Heroes, like two Sons of Kings?

verses.sa:
युवां मृगेव वारणा मृगण्यवो दोषा वस्तोर्हविषा नि ह्वयामहे ।
युवं होत्रामृतुथा जुह्वते नरेषं जनाय वहथः शुभस्पती ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam mrigeva varana mriganyavo dosha vastorhavisha ni hvayamahe |
yuvam hotramritutha juhvate naresham janaya vahathah shubhaspati ||
verses.en:
Even as hunters follow two wild elephants, we with oblations call you down at morn and eve.
To folk who pay you offierings at appointed times, Chiefs, Lords of splendour, ye bring food to strengthen them.

verses.sa:
युवां ह घोषा पर्यश्विना यती राज्ञ ऊचे दुहिता पृच्छे वां नरा ।
भूतं मे अह्न उत भूतमक्तवेऽश्वावते रथिने शक्तमर्वते ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha ghosha paryashvina yati rajna uche duhita prichchhe vam nara |
bhutam me ahna uta bhutamaktave'shvavate rathine shaktamarvate ||
verses.en:
To you, O Asvins, came the daughter of a King, Ghosa, and said, O Heroes, this I beg of you:
Be near me in the day, he near me in the night: help me to gain a car-borne chieftain rich in steeds.

verses.sa:
युवं कवी ष्ठः पर्यश्विना रथं विशो न कुत्सो जरितुर्नशायथः ।
युवोर्ह मक्षा पर्यश्विना मध्वासा भरत निष्कृतं न योषणा ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam kavi shthah paryashvina ratham visho na kutso jariturnashayathah |
yuvorha maksha paryashvina madhvasa bharata nishkritam na yoshana ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, ye are wise: as Kutsa comes to men, bring your car nigh the folk of him who sings your praise.
The bee, O Asvins, bears your honey in her mouth, as the maid carries it purified in her hand.

verses.sa:
युवं ह भुज्युं युवमश्विना वशं युवं शिञ्जारमुशनामुपारथुः ।
युवो ररावा परि सख्यमासते युवोरहमवसा सुम्नमा चके ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha bhujyum yuvamashvina vasham yuvam shinjaramushanamuparathuh |
yuvo rarava pari sakhyamasate yuvorahamavasa sumnama chake ||
verses.en:
To Bhujyu and to Vasa ye come near with help, O Asvins, to Sinjara and to Usana.
Your worshipper secures your friendship for himself. Through your protection I desire felicity.

verses.sa:
युवं ह कृशं युवमश्विना शयुं युवं विधन्तं विधवामुरुष्यथः ।
युवं सनिभ्य स्तनयन्तमश्विनाप व्रजमूर्णुथः सप्तास्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam ha krisham yuvamashvina shayum yuvam vidhantam vidhavamurushyathah |
yuvam sanibhya stanayantamashvinapa vrajamurnuthah saptasyam ||
verses.en:
Krsa and Sayu ye protect, ye Asvins Twain: ye Two assist the widow and the worshipper;
And ye throw open, Asvins, unto those who win the cattle-stall that thunders with its serenfold mouth.

verses.sa:
जनिष्ट योषा पतयत्कनीनको वि चारुहन्वीरुधो दंसना अनु ।
आस्मै रीयन्ते निवनेव सिन्धवोऽस्मा अह्ने भवति तत्पतित्वनम् ॥
verses.rom:
janishta yosha patayatkaninako vi charuhanvirudho damsana anu |
asmai riyante nivaneva sindhavo'sma ahne bhavati tatpatitvanam ||
verses.en:
The Woman hath brought forth, the Infant hath appeared, the plants of wondrous beauty straightway have sprung up.
To him the rivers run as down a deep descent, and he this day becomes their master and their lord.

verses.sa:
जीवं रुदन्ति वि मयन्ते अध्वरे दीर्घामनु प्रसितिं दीधियुर्नरः ।
वामं पितृभ्यो य इदं समेरिरे मयः पतिभ्यो जनयः परिष्वजे ॥
verses.rom:
jivam rudanti vi mayante adhvare dirghamanu prasitim didhiyurnarah |
vamam pitribhyo ya idam samerire mayah patibhyo janayah parishvaje ||
verses.en:
They mourn the living, cry aloud, at sacrifice: the men have set their thoughts upon a distant cast.
A lovely thing for fathers who have gathered here,-a joy to husbands,-are the wives their arms shall clasp

verses.sa:
न तस्य विद्म तदु षु प्र वोचत युवा ह यद्युवत्याः क्षेति योनिषु ।
प्रियोस्रियस्य वृषभस्य रेतिनो गृहं गमेमाश्विना तदुश्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
na tasya vidma tadu shu pra vochata yuva ha yadyuvatyah ksheti yonishu |
priyosriyasya vrishabhasya retino griham gamemashvina tadushmasi ||
verses.en:
Of this we have no knowledge. Tall it forth to us, now the youth rests within the chambers of the bride.
Fain would we reach the dwelling of the vigorous Steer who loves the kine, O Asvins: this is our desire.

verses.sa:
आ वामगन्सुमतिर्वाजिनीवसू न्यश्विना हृत्सु कामा अयंसत ।
अभूतं गोपा मिथुना शुभस्पती प्रिया अर्यम्णो दुर्याँ अशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
a vamagansumatirvajinivasu nyashvina hritsu kama ayamsata |
abhutam gopa mithuna shubhaspati priya aryamno duryan ashimahi ||
verses.en:
Your favouring grace hath come, ye Lords of ample wealth: Asvins, our longings are stored up within your hearts.
Ye, Lords of splendour, have become our twofold guard: may we as welcome friends reach Aryaman's abode.

verses.sa:
ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ धत्तं रयिं सहवीरं वचस्यवे ।
कृतं तीर्थं सुप्रपाणं शुभस्पती स्थाणुं पथेष्ठामप दुर्मतिं हतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta mandasana manusho durona a dhattam rayim sahaviram vachasyave |
kritam tirtham suprapanam shubhaspati sthanum patheshthamapa durmatim hatam ||
verses.en:
Even so, rejoicing in the dwelling-place of man, give hero sons and riches to the eloquent.
Make a ford, Lords of splendour, where men well may drink: remove the spiteful tree-stump standing in the path.

verses.sa:
क्व स्विदद्य कतमास्वश्विना विक्षु दस्रा मादयेते शुभस्पती ।
क ईं नि येमे कतमस्य जग्मतुर्विप्रस्य वा यजमानस्य वा गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
kva svidadya katamasvashvina vikshu dasra madayete shubhaspati |
ka im ni yeme katamasya jagmaturviprasya va yajamanasya va griham ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, Wonder-Workers, Lords of lustre, where and with what folk do ye delight yourselves to-day?
Who hath detained them with him? Whither are they gone? Unto what sage's or what worshipper's abode?

verses.sa:
समानमु त्यं पुरुहूतमुक्थ्यं रथं त्रिचक्रं सवना गनिग्मतम् ।
परिज्मानं विदथ्यं सुवृक्तिभिर्वयं व्युष्टा उषसो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
samanamu tyam puruhutamukthyam ratham trichakram savana ganigmatam |
parijmanam vidathyam suvriktibhirvayam vyushta ushaso havamahe ||
verses.en:
THAT general Car of yours, invoked by many a man, that comes to our libations, three-wheeled, meet for lauds,
That circumambient Car, worthy of sacrifice, we call with our pure hymns at earliest flush of dawn.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्युजं नासत्याधि तिष्ठथः प्रातर्यावाणं मधुवाहनं रथम् ।
विशो येन गच्छथो यज्वरीर्नरा कीरेश्चिद्यज्ञं होतृमन्तमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
prataryujam nasatyadhi tishthathah prataryavanam madhuvahanam ratham |
visho yena gachchhatho yajvarirnara kireshchidyajnam hotrimantamashvina ||
verses.en:
Ye, O Nasatyas, mount that early-harnessed Car, that travels early, laden with its freight of balm,
Wherewith ye, Heroes, visit clans who sacrifice, even the poor man's worship where the priest attends.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्युं वा मधुपाणिं सुहस्त्यमग्निधं वा धृतदक्षं दमूनसम् ।
विप्रस्य वा यत्सवनानि गच्छथोऽत आ यातं मधुपेयमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryum va madhupanim suhastyamagnidham va dhritadaksham damunasam |
viprasya va yatsavanani gachchhatho'ta a yatam madhupeyamashvina ||
verses.en:
If to the deft Adhvaryu with the meath in hand, or to the Kindler firm in strength, the household friend,
Or to the sage's poured libations ye approach, come thence, O Asvins, now to drink the offered meath.

verses.sa:
अस्तेव सु प्रतरं लायमस्यन्भूषन्निव प्र भरा स्तोममस्मै ।
वाचा विप्रास्तरत वाचमर्यो नि रामय जरितः सोम इन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
asteva su prataram layamasyanbhushanniva pra bhara stomamasmai |
vacha viprastarata vachamaryo ni ramaya jaritah soma indram ||
verses.en:
EVEN as an archer shoots afar his arrow, offer the laud to him with meet adornment.
Quell with your voice the wicked's voice, O sages. Singer, make Indra rest beside the Soma.

verses.sa:
दोहेन गामुप शिक्षा सखायं प्र बोधय जरितर्जारमिन्द्रम् ।
कोशं न पूर्णं वसुना न्यृष्टमा च्यावय मघदेयाय शूरम् ॥
verses.rom:
dohena gamupa shiksha sakhayam pra bodhaya jaritarjaramindram |
kosham na purnam vasuna nyrishtama chyavaya maghadeyaya shuram ||
verses.en:
Draw thy Friend to thee like a cow at milking: O Singer, wake up Indra as a lover.
Make thou the Hero haste to give us riches even as a vessel filled brimful with treasure.

verses.sa:
किमङ्ग त्वा मघवन्भोजमाहुः शिशीहि मा शिशयं त्वा शृणोमि ।
अप्नस्वती मम धीरस्तु शक्र वसुविदं भगमिन्द्रा भरा नः ॥
verses.rom:
kimanga tva maghavanbhojamahuh shishihi ma shishayam tva shrinomi |
apnasvati mama dhirastu shakra vasuvidam bhagamindra bhara nah ||
verses.en:
Why, Maghavan, do they call thee Bounteous; Giver? Quicken me: thou, I hear, art he who quickens.
Sakra, let my intelligence be active, and bring us luck that finds great wealth, O Indra.

verses.sa:
त्वां जना ममसत्येष्विन्द्र संतस्थाना वि ह्वयन्ते समीके ।
अत्रा युजं कृणुते यो हविष्मान्नासुन्वता सख्यं वष्टि शूरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam jana mamasatyeshvindra samtasthana vi hvayante samike |
atra yujam krinute yo havishmannasunvata sakhyam vashti shurah ||
verses.en:
Standing, in battle for their rights, together, the people, Indra, in the fray invoke thee.
Him who brings gifts the Hero makes his comrade: with him who pours no juice he seeks not friendship.

verses.sa:
धनं न स्यन्द्रं बहुलं यो अस्मै तीव्रान्सोमाँ आसुनोति प्रयस्वान् ।
तस्मै शत्रून्सुतुकान्प्रातरह्नो नि स्वष्ट्रान्युवति हन्ति वृत्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhanam na syandram bahulam yo asmai tivransoman asunoti prayasvan |
tasmai shatrunsutukanpratarahno ni svashtranyuvati hanti vritram ||
verses.en:
Whoso with plenteous food for him expresses strong Somas as much quickly-coming treasure,
For him he overthrows in early morning his swift well-weaponed foes, and slays the tyrant.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्वयं दधिमा शंसमिन्द्रे यः शिश्राय मघवा काममस्मे ।
आराच्चित्सन्भयतामस्य शत्रुर्न्यस्मै द्युम्ना जन्या नमन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvayam dadhima shamsamindre yah shishraya maghava kamamasme |
arachchitsanbhayatamasya shatrurnyasmai dyumna janya namantam ||
verses.en:
He unto whom we offer praises, Indra, Maghavan, who hath joined to ours his wishes,-
Before him even afar the foe must tremble: low before him must bow all human glories.

verses.sa:
आराच्छत्रुमप बाधस्व दूरमुग्रो यः शम्बः पुरुहूत तेन ।
अस्मे धेहि यवमद्गोमदिन्द्र कृधी धियं जरित्रे वाजरत्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
arachchhatrumapa badhasva duramugro yah shambah puruhuta tena |
asme dhehi yavamadgomadindra kridhi dhiyam jaritre vajaratnam ||
verses.en:
With thy fierce bolt, O God invoked of many, drive to a distance from afar the foeman.
O Indra, give us wealth in corn and cattle, and make thy singer's prayer gain strength and riches.

verses.sa:
प्र यमन्तर्वृषसवासो अग्मन्तीव्राः सोमा बहुलान्तास इन्द्रम् ।
नाह दामानं मघवा नि यंसन्नि सुन्वते वहति भूरि वामम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yamantarvrishasavaso agmantivrah soma bahulantasa indram |
naha damanam maghava ni yamsanni sunvate vahati bhuri vamam ||
verses.en:
Indra, the swallower of strong libations rich in the boons they bring, the potent Somas,
He, Maghavan, will not restrict his bounty he brings much wealth unto the Soma-presser.

verses.sa:
उत प्रहामतिदीव्या जयाति कृतं यच्छ्वघ्नी विचिनोति काले ।
यो देवकामो न धना रुणद्धि समित्तं राया सृजति स्वधावान् ॥
verses.rom:
uta prahamatidivya jayati kritam yachchhvaghni vichinoti kale |
yo devakamo na dhana runaddhi samittam raya srijati svadhavan ||
verses.en:
Yea, by superior play he wins advantage, when he, a gambler, piles his gains in season.
Celestial-natured, he o'erwhelms with riches the devotee who keeps not back his treasure.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
gobhishtaremamatim durevam yavena kshudham puruhuta vishvam |
vayam rajabhih prathama dhananyasmakena vrijanena jayema ||
verses.en:
O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.
May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirnah pari patu pashchadutottarasmadadharadaghayoh |
indrah purastaduta madhyato nah sakha sakhibhyo varivah krinotu ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners!
May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
अच्छा म इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्विदः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत ।
परि ष्वजन्ते जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
achchha ma indram matayah svarvidah sadhrichirvishva ushatiranushata |
pari shvajante janayo yatha patim maryam na shundhyum maghavanamutaye ||
verses.en:
IN perfect unison all yearning hymns of mine that find the light of heaven have sung forth Indra's praise.
As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.

verses.sa:
न घा त्वद्रिगप वेति मे मनस्त्वे इत्कामं पुरुहूत शिश्रय ।
राजेव दस्म नि षदोऽधि बर्हिष्यस्मिन्सु सोमेऽवपानमस्तु ते ॥
verses.rom:
na gha tvadrigapa veti me manastve itkamam puruhuta shishraya |
rajeva dasma ni shado'dhi barhishyasminsu some'vapanamastu te ||
verses.en:
Directed unto thee my spirit never strays, for I have set my hopes on thee, O Much-invoked!
Sit, Wonderful! as King upon the sacred grass, and let thy drinking-place be by the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विषूवृदिन्द्रो अमतेरुत क्षुधः स इद्रायो मघवा वस्व ईशते ।
तस्येदिमे प्रवणे सप्त सिन्धवो वयो वर्धन्ति वृषभस्य शुष्मिणः ॥
verses.rom:
vishuvridindro amateruta kshudhah sa idrayo maghava vasva ishate |
tasyedime pravane sapta sindhavo vayo vardhanti vrishabhasya shushminah ||
verses.en:
From indigence and hunger Indra turns away: Maghavan hath dominion over precious wealth.
These the Seven Rivers flowing on their downward path increase the vital vigour of the potent Steer.

verses.sa:
वयो न वृक्षं सुपलाशमासदन्सोमास इन्द्रं मन्दिनश्चमूषदः ।
प्रैषामनीकं शवसा दविद्युतद्विदत्स्वर्मनवे ज्योतिरार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayo na vriksham supalashamasadansomasa indram mandinashchamushadah |
praishamanikam shavasa davidyutadvidatsvarmanave jyotiraryam ||
verses.en:
As on the fair-leafed tree rest birds, to Indra flow the gladdening Soma juices that the bowls contain.
Their face that glows with splendour through their mighty power hath found the shine of heaven for man, the Aryas' light.

verses.sa:
कृतं न श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति देवने संवर्गं यन्मघवा सूर्यं जयत् ।
न तत्ते अन्यो अनु वीर्यं शकन्न पुराणो मघवन्नोत नूतनः ॥
verses.rom:
kritam na shvaghni vi chinoti devane samvargam yanmaghava suryam jayat |
na tatte anyo anu viryam shakanna purano maghavannota nutanah ||
verses.en:
As in the game a gambler piles his winnings, so Maghavan, sweeping all together, gained the Sun
This mighty deed of thine none other could achieve, none, Maghavan, before thee, none in recent time.

verses.sa:
विशंविशं मघवा पर्यशायत जनानां धेना अवचाकशद्वृषा ।
यस्याह शक्रः सवनेषु रण्यति स तीव्रैः सोमैः सहते पृतन्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
vishamvisham maghava paryashayata jananam dhena avachakashadvrisha |
yasyaha shakrah savaneshu ranyati sa tivraih somaih sahate pritanyatah ||
verses.en:
Maghavan came by turns to all the tribes of men: the Steer took notice of the people's songs of praise.
The man in whose libations Sakra hath delight by means of potent Somas vanquisheth his foes.

verses.sa:
आपो न सिन्धुमभि यत्समक्षरन्सोमास इन्द्रं कुल्या इव ह्रदम् ।
वर्धन्ति विप्रा महो अस्य सादने यवं न वृष्टिर्दिव्येन दानुना ॥
verses.rom:
apo na sindhumabhi yatsamaksharansomasa indram kulya iva hradam |
vardhanti vipra maho asya sadane yavam na vrishtirdivyena danuna ||
verses.en:
When Soma streams together unto Indra flow like waters to the river, rivulets to the lake,
In place of sacrifice sages exalt his might, as the rain swells the corn by moisture sent from heaven.

verses.sa:
वृषा न क्रुद्धः पतयद्रजस्स्वा यो अर्यपत्नीरकृणोदिमा अपः ।
स सुन्वते मघवा जीरदानवेऽविन्दज्ज्योतिर्मनवे हविष्मते ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha na kruddhah patayadrajassva yo aryapatnirakrinodima apah |
sa sunvate maghava jiradanave'vindajjyotirmanave havishmate ||
verses.en:
He rushes through the region like a furious Bull, he who hath made these floods the dames of worthy lords.
This Maghavan hath found light for the man who brings oblation, sheds the juice, and promptly pours his gifts.

verses.sa:
उज्जायतां परशुर्ज्योतिषा सह भूया ऋतस्य सुदुघा पुराणवत् ।
वि रोचतामरुषो भानुना शुचिः स्वर्ण शुक्रं शुशुचीत सत्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ujjayatam parashurjyotisha saha bhuya ritasya sudugha puranavat |
vi rochatamarusho bhanuna shuchih svarna shukram shushuchita satpatih ||
verses.en:
Let the keen axe come forth together with the light: here be, as erst, the teeming cow of sacrifice.
Let the Red God shine bright with his refulgent ray, and let the Lord of heroes glow like heaven's clear sheen.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
gobhishtaremamatim durevam yavena kshudham puruhuta vishvam |
vayam rajabhih prathama dhananyasmakena vrijanena jayema ||
verses.en:
O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.
May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirnah pari patu pashchadutottarasmadadharadaghayoh |
indrah purastaduta madhyato nah sakha sakhibhyo varivah krinotu ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners.
May Indra from the front, and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
आ यात्विन्द्रः स्वपतिर्मदाय यो धर्मणा तूतुजानस्तुविष्मान् ।
प्रत्वक्षाणो अति विश्वा सहांस्यपारेण महता वृष्ण्येन ॥
verses.rom:
a yatvindrah svapatirmadaya yo dharmana tutujanastuvishman |
pratvakshano ati vishva sahamsyaparena mahata vrishnyena ||
verses.en:
MAY Sovran Indra come to the carousal, he who by Holy Law is strong and active,
The overcomer of all conquering forces with his great steer-like power that hath no limit.

verses.sa:
सुष्ठामा रथः सुयमा हरी ते मिम्यक्ष वज्रो नृपते गभस्तौ ।
शीभं राजन्सुपथा याह्यर्वाङ्वर्धाम ते पपुषो वृष्ण्यानि ॥
verses.rom:
sushthama rathah suyama hari te mimyaksha vajro nripate gabhastau |
shibham rajansupatha yahyarvanvardhama te papusho vrishnyani ||
verses.en:
Firm-seated is thy car, thy Steeds are docile; thy hand, O King, holds, firmly grasped, the thunder.
On thy fair path, O Lord of men, come quickly: we will increase thy powers when thou hast drunken.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रवाहो नृपतिं वज्रबाहुमुग्रमुग्रासस्तविषास एनम् ।
प्रत्वक्षसं वृषभं सत्यशुष्ममेमस्मत्रा सधमादो वहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
endravaho nripatim vajrabahumugramugrasastavishasa enam |
pratvakshasam vrishabham satyashushmamemasmatra sadhamado vahantu ||
verses.en:
Let strong and mighty Steeds who bear this Mighty Indra, the Lord of men, whose arm wields thunder,
Bring unto us, as sharers of our banquet, the Steer of conquering might, of real vigour.

verses.sa:
एवा पतिं द्रोणसाचं सचेतसमूर्ज स्कम्भं धरुण आ वृषायसे ।
ओजः कृष्व सं गृभाय त्वे अप्यसो यथा केनिपानामिनो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
eva patim dronasacham sachetasamurja skambham dharuna a vrishayase |
ojah krishva sam gribhaya tve apyaso yatha kenipanamino vridhe ||
verses.en:
So like a Bull thou rushest to the Lord who loves the trough, the Sage, the prop of vigour, in the vat,
Prepare thine energies, collect them in thyself: be for our profit as the Master of the wise.

verses.sa:
गमन्नस्मे वसून्या हि शंसिषं स्वाशिषं भरमा याहि सोमिनः ।
त्वमीशिषे सास्मिन्ना सत्सि बर्हिष्यनाधृष्या तव पात्राणि धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
gamannasme vasunya hi shamsisham svashisham bharama yahi sominah |
tvamishishe sasminna satsi barhishyanadhrishya tava patrani dharmana ||
verses.en:
May precious treasures come to us-so will I pray. Come to the votary's gift offered with beauteous laud.
Thou art the Lord, as such sit on this holy grass: thy vessels are inviolate as Law commands.

verses.sa:
पृथक्प्रायन्प्रथमा देवहूतयोऽकृण्वत श्रवस्यानि दुष्टरा ।
न ये शेकुर्यज्ञियां नावमारुहमीर्मैव ते न्यविशन्त केपयः ॥
verses.rom:
prithakprayanprathama devahutayo'krinvata shravasyani dushtara |
na ye shekuryajniyam navamaruhamirmaiva te nyavishanta kepayah ||
verses.en:
Far went our earliest invocation of the Gods, and won us glories that can never be surpassed.
They who could not ascend the ship of sacrifice, sink down in desolation, trembling with alarm.

verses.sa:
एवैवापागपरे सन्तु दूढ्योऽश्वा येषां दुर्युज आयुयुज्रे ।
इत्था ये प्रागुपरे सन्ति दावने पुरूणि यत्र वयुनानि भोजना ॥
verses.rom:
evaivapagapare santu dudhyo'shva yesham duryuja ayuyujre |
ittha ye pragupare santi davane puruni yatra vayunani bhojana ||
verses.en:
So be the others, evil-hearted, far away, whose horses, difficult to harness, have been yoked.
Here in advance men stand anear to offer gifts, by whom full many a work that brings reward is done.

verses.sa:
गिरीँरज्रान्रेजमानाँ अधारयद्द्यौः क्रन्ददन्तरिक्षाणि कोपयत् ।
समीचीने धिषणे वि ष्कभायति वृष्णः पीत्वा मद उक्थानि शंसति ॥
verses.rom:
girinrajranrejamanan adharayaddyauh krandadantarikshani kopayat |
samichine dhishane vi shkabhayati vrishnah pitva mada ukthani shamsati ||
verses.en:
He firmly fixed the plains and mountains as they shook. Dyaus thundered forth and made the air's mid-region quake.
He stays apart the two confronting bowls; he sings lauds in the potent Soma's joy when he hath drunk.

verses.sa:
इमं बिभर्मि सुकृतं ते अङ्कुशं येनारुजासि मघवञ्छफारुजः ।
अस्मिन्सु ते सवने अस्त्वोक्यं सुत इष्टौ मघवन्बोध्याभगः ॥
verses.rom:
imam bibharmi sukritam te ankusham yenarujasi maghavanchhapharujah |
asminsu te savane astvokyam suta ishtau maghavanbodhyabhagah ||
verses.en:
I bear this deftly-fashioned goad of thine, wherewith thou, Maghavan, shalt break the strikers with the hoof.
At this libation mayst thou be well satisfied. Partake the juice, partake the worship, Maghavan.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वाम् ।
वयं राजभिः प्रथमा धनान्यस्माकेन वृजनेना जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
gobhishtaremamatim durevam yavena kshudham puruhuta vishvam |
vayam rajabhih prathama dhananyasmakena vrijanena jayema ||
verses.en:
O Much-invoked, may we subdue all famine and evil want with store of grain and cattle.
May we allied, as first in rank, with princes obtain possessions by our own exertion.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirnah pari patu pashchadutottarasmadadharadaghayoh |
indrah purastaduta madhyato nah sakha sakhibhyo varivah krinotu ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati protect us from the rearward, and from above, and from below, from sinners.
May Indra from the front and from the centre, as Friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

verses.sa:
दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरस्मद्द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः ।
तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रमिन्धान एनं जरते स्वाधीः ॥
verses.rom:
divaspari prathamam jajne agnirasmaddvitiyam pari jatavedah |
tritiyamapsu nrimana ajasramindhana enam jarate svadhih ||
verses.en:
FIRST Agni sprang to life from out of Heaven: the second time from us came Jatavedas.
Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him the Eternal.

verses.sa:
विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा ।
विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आजगन्थ ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te agne tredha trayani vidma te dhama vibhrita purutra |
vidma te nama paramam guha yadvidma tamutsam yata ajagantha ||
verses.en:
Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided.
We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.

verses.sa:
समुद्रे त्वा नृमणा अप्स्वन्तर्नृचक्षा ईधे दिवो अग्न ऊधन् ।
तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवांसमपामुपस्थे महिषा अवर्धन् ॥
verses.rom:
samudre tva nrimana apsvantarnrichaksha idhe divo agna udhan |
tritiye tva rajasi tasthivamsamapamupasthe mahisha avardhan ||
verses.en:
The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven,
There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Steers increased thee in the water's bosom.

verses.sa:
अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन् ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauh kshama rerihadvirudhah samanjan |
sadyo jajnano vi himiddho akhyada rodasi bhanuna bhatyantah ||
verses.en:
Agni roared out, like Dyaus what time he thunders: he licked the ground about the plants he flickered.
At once, when born, he looked around enkindled, and lightened heaven and earth within with splendour.

verses.sa:
श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः ।
वसुः सूनुः सहसो अप्सु राजा वि भात्यग्र उषसामिधानः ॥
verses.rom:
shrinamudaro dharuno rayinam manishanam prarpanah somagopah |
vasuh sunuh sahaso apsu raja vi bhatyagra ushasamidhanah ||
verses.en:
The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma,
Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भ आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः ।
वीळुं चिदद्रिमभिनत्परायञ्जना यदग्निमयजन्त पञ्च ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha a rodasi aprinajjayamanah |
vilum chidadrimabhinatparayanjana yadagnimayajanta pancha ||
verses.en:
Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, be sprang to life and filled the earth and heavens.
Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.

verses.sa:
उशिक्पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि ।
इयर्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
ushikpavako aratih sumedha marteshvagniramrito ni dhayi |
iyarti dhumamarusham bharibhraduchchhukrena shochisha dyaminakshan ||
verses.en:
So among mortals was Immortal Agni stablished as holy wise and willing envoy.
He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heavens with radiant lustre.

verses.sa:
दृशानो रुक्म उर्विया व्यद्यौद्दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः ।
अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौर्जनयत्सुरेताः ॥
verses.rom:
drishano rukma urviya vyadyauddurmarshamayuh shriye ruchanah |
agniramrito abhavadvayobhiryadenam dyaurjanayatsuretah ||
verses.en:
Like gold to look on, far he shone refulgent, beaming imperishable life for glory,
Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अद्य कृणवद्भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवन्तमग्ने ।
प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छाभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ ॥
verses.rom:
yaste adya krinavadbhadrashoche'pupam deva ghritavantamagne |
pra tam naya prataram vasyo achchhabhi sumnam devabhaktam yavishtha ||
verses.en:
Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, prepares a cake, O Agni, mixt with butter,
Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.

verses.sa:
आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्न उक्थउक्थ आ भज शस्यमाने ।
प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः ॥
verses.rom:
a tam bhaja saushravaseshvagna ukthauktha a bhaja shasyamane |
priyah surye priyo agna bhavatyujjatena bhinadadujjanitvaih ||
verses.en:
Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every song of praise sung forth enrich him.
Dear let him be to Surya, dear to Agni, preeminent with son and children's children.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने यजमाना अनु द्यून्विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि ।
त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne yajamana anu dyunvishva vasu dadhire varyani |
tvaya saha dravinamichchhamana vrajam gomantamushijo vi vavruh ||
verses.en:
While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing.
Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.

verses.sa:
अस्ताव्यग्निर्नरां सुशेवो वैश्वानर ऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः ।
अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् ॥
verses.rom:
astavyagnirnaram sushevo vaishvanara rishibhih somagopah |
adveshe dyavaprithivi huvema deva dhatta rayimasme suviram ||
verses.en:
Agni, the Friend of men, the Soma's keeper, Vaisvanara, hath been lauded by the Rsis.
We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.

verses.sa:
प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्वा सीददपामुपस्थे ।
दधिर्यो धायि स ते वयांसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
pra hota jato mahannabhovinnrishadva sidadapamupasthe |
dadhiryo dhayi sa te vayamsi yanta vasuni vidhate tanupah ||
verses.en:
STABLISHED for thee, to lend thee vital forces, Giver of wealth, Guard of his servant's body.
The Great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, Abider with men, is seated in the lap of waters.

verses.sa:
इमं विधन्तो अपां सधस्थे पशुं न नष्टं पदैरनु ग्मन् ।
गुहा चतन्तमुशिजो नमोभिरिच्छन्तो धीरा भृगवोऽविन्दन् ॥
verses.rom:
imam vidhanto apam sadhasthe pashum na nashtam padairanu gman |
guha chatantamushijo namobhirichchhanto dhira bhrigavo'vindan ||
verses.en:
Worshipping, seeking him with adoration like some lost creature followed by its footprints,
Wise Bhrgus, yearning in their hearts, pursued him, and found him lurking where the floods are gathered.

verses.sa:
इमं त्रितो भूर्यविन्ददिच्छन्वैभूवसो मूर्धन्यघ्न्यायाः ।
स शेवृधो जात आ हर्म्येषु नाभिर्युवा भवति रोचनस्य ॥
verses.rom:
imam trito bhuryavindadichchhanvaibhuvaso murdhanyaghnyayah |
sa shevridho jata a harmyeshu nabhiryuva bhavati rochanasya ||
verses.en:
On the Cow's forehead, with laborious searching, Trita, the offspring of Vibhiavas, found him.
Born in our houses, Youthful, joy-bestower, he now becomes the central point of brightness.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारमुशिजो नमोभिः प्राञ्चं यज्ञं नेतारमध्वराणाम् ।
विशामकृण्वन्नरतिं पावकं हव्यवाहं दधतो मानुषेषु ॥
verses.rom:
mandram hotaramushijo namobhih prancham yajnam netaramadhvaranam |
vishamakrinvannaratim pavakam havyavaham dadhato manusheshu ||
verses.en:
Yearning, with homage, they have set and made him blithe Priest among mankind, oblation-bearer,
Leader of rites and Purifier, envoy of men, as sacrifice that still advances.

verses.sa:
प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरा अमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् ।
नयन्तो गर्भं वनां धियं धुर्हिरिश्मश्रुं नार्वाणं धनर्चम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra bhurjayantam maham vipodham mura amuram puram darmanam |
nayanto garbham vanam dhiyam dhurhirishmashrum narvanam dhanarcham ||
verses.en:
The foolish brought the ne'er-bewildered forward, great, Victor, Song-inspirer, Fort-destroyer.
Leading the Youth gold-bearded, like a courser gleaming with wealth, they turned their hymn to profit.

verses.sa:
नि पस्त्यासु त्रित स्तभूयन्परिवीतो योनौ सीददन्तः ।
अतः संगृभ्या विशां दमूना विधर्मणायन्त्रैरीयते नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
ni pastyasu trita stabhuyanparivito yonau sidadantah |
atah samgribhya visham damuna vidharmanayantrairiyate nrin ||
verses.en:
Holding his station firmly in the houses, Trita sat down within his home surrounded
Thence, as Law bids, departs the Tribes' Companion having collected men with no compulsion.

verses.sa:
अस्याजरासो दमामरित्रा अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः ।
श्वितीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवो वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः ॥
verses.rom:
asyajaraso damamaritra archaddhumaso agnayah pavakah |
shvitichayah shvatraso bhuranyavo vanarshado vayavo na somah ||
verses.en:
His are the fires, eternal, purifying, that make the houses move, whose smoke is shining,
White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and sitting in the wood; like winds are Somas.

verses.sa:
प्र जिह्वया भरते वेपो अग्निः प्र वयुनानि चेतसा पृथिव्याः ।
तमायवः शुचयन्तं पावकं मन्द्रं होतारं दधिरे यजिष्ठम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra jihvaya bharate vepo agnih pra vayunani chetasa prithivyah |
tamayavah shuchayantam pavakam mandram hotaram dadhire yajishtham ||
verses.en:
The tongue of Agni bears away the praise song, and, through his care for Earth, her operations.
Him, bright and radiant, living men have stablished as their blithe Priest, the Chief of Sacrificers.

verses.sa:
द्यावा यमग्निं पृथिवी जनिष्टामापस्त्वष्टा भृगवो यं सहोभिः ।
ईळेन्यं प्रथमं मातरिश्वा देवास्ततक्षुर्मनवे यजत्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
dyava yamagnim prithivi janishtamapastvashta bhrigavo yam sahobhih |
ilenyam prathamam matarishva devastatakshurmanave yajatram ||
verses.en:
That Agni, him whom Heaven and Earth engendered, the Waters. Tvastar, and with might, the Bhrgus,
Him Matarisvan and the Gods have fashioned holy for man and first to be entreated.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहं पुरुस्पृहो मानुषासो यजत्रम् ।
स यामन्नग्ने स्तुवते वयो धाः प्र देवयन्यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva deva dadhire havyavaham puruspriho manushaso yajatram |
sa yamannagne stuvate vayo dhah pra devayanyashasah sam hi purvih ||
verses.en:
Agni, whom Gods have made oblation bearer, and much-desiring men regard as holy,
Give life to him who lauds thee when he worships, and then shall glorious men in troops adore thee.

verses.sa:
जगृभ्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् ।
विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
jagribhma te dakshinamindra hastam vasuyavo vasupate vasunam |
vidma hi tva gopatim shura gonamasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
THY right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing for treasure, Treasure-Lord of treasures!
Because we know thee, Hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधं स्ववसं सुनीथं चतुःसमुद्रं धरुणं रयीणाम् ।
चर्कृत्यं शंस्यं भूरिवारमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
svayudham svavasam sunitham chatuhsamudram dharunam rayinam |
charkrityam shamsyam bhurivaramasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
Wealth, fully armed, good guard and kind protector, sprung from four seas, the prop and stay of treasures,
Fraught with great bounties, meet for praise and glory; vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
सुब्रह्माणं देववन्तं बृहन्तमुरुं गभीरं पृथुबुध्नमिन्द्र ।
श्रुतऋषिमुग्रमभिमातिषाहमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
subrahmanam devavantam brihantamurum gabhiram prithubudhnamindra |
shrutarishimugramabhimatishahamasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
Wealth, with good Brahmans, Indra! God-attended, high, wide, and deep, arid based on broad foundations,
Strong, with famed Rsis, conquering our foemen: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
सनद्वाजं विप्रवीरं तरुत्रं धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षम् ।
दस्युहनं पूर्भिदमिन्द्र सत्यमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
sanadvajam vipraviram tarutram dhanaspritam shushuvamsam sudaksham |
dasyuhanam purbhidamindra satyamasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
Victorious, winning strength, with hero sages, confirmed in power, most useful, wealth-attracting,
True, Indra! crushing forts and slaying Dasyus: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
अश्वावन्तं रथिनं वीरवन्तं सहस्रिणं शतिनं वाजमिन्द्र ।
भद्रव्रातं विप्रवीरं स्वर्षामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavantam rathinam viravantam sahasrinam shatinam vajamindra |
bhadravratam vipraviram svarshamasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
Wealthy in heroes and in cars and horses, strength hundredfold and thousand fold, O Indra,
With manly sages, happy troops, light-winning: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
प्र सप्तगुमृतधीतिं सुमेधां बृहस्पतिं मतिरच्छा जिगाति ।
य आङ्गिरसो नमसोपसद्योऽस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
pra saptagumritadhitim sumedham brihaspatim matirachchha jigati |
ya angiraso namasopasadyo'smabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
To Saptagu the sage, the holy-minded, to him, Brhaspati, the song approaches,
Angiras' Son who must be met with homage: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
वनीवानो मम दूतास इन्द्रं स्तोमाश्चरन्ति सुमतीरियानाः ।
हृदिस्पृशो मनसा वच्यमाना अस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
vanivano mama dutasa indram stomashcharanti sumatiriyanah |
hridisprisho manasa vachyamana asmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
My lauds, like envoys, craving loving-kindness, go forth to Indra with their strong entreaty,
Moving his heart and uttered by my spirit: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा यामि दद्धि तन्न इन्द्र बृहन्तं क्षयमसमं जनानाम् ।
अभि तद्द्यावापृथिवी गृणीतामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom:
yattva yami daddhi tanna indra brihantam kshayamasamam jananam |
abhi taddyavaprithivi grinitamasmabhyam chitram vrishanam rayim dah ||
verses.en:
Grant us the boon for which I pray, O Indra, a spacious home unmatched among the people.
To this may Heaven and Earth accord approval: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.

verses.sa:
अहं भुवं वसुनः पूर्व्यस्पतिरहं धनानि सं जयामि शश्वतः ।
मां हवन्ते पितरं न जन्तवोऽहं दाशुषे वि भजामि भोजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham bhuvam vasunah purvyaspatiraham dhanani sam jayami shashvatah |
mam havante pitaram na jantavo'ham dashushe vi bhajami bhojanam ||

verses.sa:
अहमिन्द्रो रोधो वक्षो अथर्वणस्त्रिताय गा अजनयमहेरधि ।
अहं दस्युभ्यः परि नृम्णमा ददे गोत्रा शिक्षन्दधीचे मातरिश्वने ॥
verses.rom:
ahamindro rodho vaksho atharvanastritaya ga ajanayamaheradhi |
aham dasyubhyah pari nrimnama dade gotra shikshandadhiche matarishvane ||

verses.sa:
मह्यं त्वष्टा वज्रमतक्षदायसं मयि देवासोऽवृजन्नपि क्रतुम् ।
ममानीकं सूर्यस्येव दुष्टरं मामार्यन्ति कृतेन कर्त्वेन च ॥
verses.rom:
mahyam tvashta vajramatakshadayasam mayi devaso'vrijannapi kratum |
mamanikam suryasyeva dushtaram mamaryanti kritena kartvena cha ||

verses.sa:
अहमेतं गव्ययमश्व्यं पशुं पुरीषिणं सायकेना हिरण्ययम् ।
पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि दाशुषे यन्मा सोमास उक्थिनो अमन्दिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
ahametam gavyayamashvyam pashum purishinam sayakena hiranyayam |
puru sahasra ni shishami dashushe yanma somasa ukthino amandishuh ||

verses.sa:
अहमिन्द्रो न परा जिग्य इद्धनं न मृत्यवेऽव तस्थे कदा चन ।
सोममिन्मा सुन्वन्तो याचता वसु न मे पूरवः सख्ये रिषाथन ॥
verses.rom:
ahamindro na para jigya iddhanam na mrityave'va tasthe kada chana |
somaminma sunvanto yachata vasu na me puravah sakhye rishathana ||

verses.sa:
अहमेताञ्छाश्वसतो द्वाद्वेन्द्रं ये वज्रं युधयेऽकृण्वत ।
आह्वयमानाँ अव हन्मनाहनं दृळ्हा वदन्ननमस्युर्नमस्विनः ॥
verses.rom:
ahametanchhashvasato dvadvendram ye vajram yudhaye'krinvata |
ahvayamanan ava hanmanahanam drilha vadannanamasyurnamasvinah ||

verses.sa:
अभीदमेकमेको अस्मि निष्षाळभी द्वा किमु त्रयः करन्ति ।
खले न पर्षान्प्रति हन्मि भूरि किं मा निन्दन्ति शत्रवोऽनिन्द्राः ॥
verses.rom:
abhidamekameko asmi nishshalabhi dva kimu trayah karanti |
khale na parshanprati hanmi bhuri kim ma nindanti shatravo'nindrah ||

verses.sa:
अहं गुङ्गुभ्यो अतिथिग्वमिष्करमिषं न वृत्रतुरं विक्षु धारयम् ।
यत्पर्णयघ्न उत वा करञ्जहे प्राहं महे वृत्रहत्ये अशुश्रवि ॥
verses.rom:
aham gungubhyo atithigvamishkaramisham na vritraturam vikshu dharayam |
yatparnayaghna uta va karanjahe praham mahe vritrahatye ashushravi ||

verses.sa:
प्र मे नमी साप्य इषे भुजे भूद्गवामेषे सख्या कृणुत द्विता ।
दिद्युं यदस्य समिथेषु मंहयमादिदेनं शंस्यमुक्थ्यं करम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra me nami sapya ishe bhuje bhudgavameshe sakhya krinuta dvita |
didyum yadasya samitheshu mamhayamadidenam shamsyamukthyam karam ||

verses.sa:
प्र नेमस्मिन्ददृशे सोमो अन्तर्गोपा नेममाविरस्था कृणोति ।
स तिग्मशृङ्गं वृषभं युयुत्सन्द्रुहस्तस्थौ बहुले बद्धो अन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
pra nemasmindadrishe somo antargopa nemamavirastha krinoti |
sa tigmashringam vrishabham yuyutsandruhastasthau bahule baddho antah ||

verses.sa:
आदित्यानां वसूनां रुद्रियाणां देवो देवानां न मिनामि धाम ।
ते मा भद्राय शवसे ततक्षुरपराजितमस्तृतमषाळ्हम् ॥
verses.rom:
adityanam vasunam rudriyanam devo devanam na minami dhama |
te ma bhadraya shavase tatakshuraparajitamastritamashalham ||

prose.en:
1. I WAS the first possessor of all precious gear: the wealth of every man I win and gather up.
On me as on a Father living creatures call; I deal enjoyment to thou man who offers gifts.

2. I, Indra, am Atharvan's stay and firm support: I brought forth kine to Trita from the Dragon's grasp.
I stripped the Dasyus of their manly might, and gave the cattle-stalls to Matarigvan and Dadhyac.

3. For me hath Tvastar forged the iron thunderbolt: in me the Gods have centred intellectual power.
My sheen is like the Sun's insufferably bright: men honour me as Lord for past and future deeds.

4. I won myself these herdi of cattle, steeds and kine, and gold in ample store, with my destructive bolt.
I give full many a thousand to the worshipper, what time the Somas and the lauds have made me glad.

5. Indra am I none ever wins my wealth from me never at any time am I a thrall to death.
Pressing the Soma, ask riches from me alone: ye, Purus, in my friendship shall not suffer harm.

6. These, breathing loud in fury, two and two, who caused Indra to bring his bolt of thunder to the fray,
The challengers, I struck with deadly weapon down: firm stand what words the God speaks to his worshippers.
This One by stronger might I conquered singly; yea, also two: shall three prevail against me?
Like many sheaves upon the floor I thrash them. How can my foes, the Indraless, revile me?

8. Against the Gungus I made Atithigva strong, and kept him mid the folk like Vrtra-conquering strength,
When I won glory in the great foe-slaying fight, in battle where Karanja fell, and Parnaya.

9. With food for mine enjoyment Sapya Nami came: he joined me as a friend of old in search of kine.
As I bestowed on him an arrow for the fight I made him worthy of the song apd hymn of praise.

10. One of the two hath Soma, seen within it; the Herdsman with the bone shows forth the other.
He, fain to fight the Bull whose horns were sharpened, stood fettered in the demon's ample region.

11. I, as a God, ne'er violate the statutes of Gods, of Vasus, Rudriyas, Adityas.
These Gods have formed me for auspicious vigour, unconquered and invincible for ever.

verses.sa:
अहं दां गृणते पूर्व्यं वस्वहं ब्रह्म कृणवं मह्यं वर्धनम् ।
अहं भुवं यजमानस्य चोदितायज्वनः साक्षि विश्वस्मिन्भरे ॥
verses.rom:
aham dam grinate purvyam vasvaham brahma krinavam mahyam vardhanam |
aham bhuvam yajamanasya choditayajvanah sakshi vishvasminbhare ||
verses.en:
I HAVE enriched the singer with surpassing wealth; I have allowed the holy hymn to strengthen me.
I, furtherer of him who offers sacrifice, have conquered in each fight the men who worship not.

verses.sa:
मां धुरिन्द्रं नाम देवता दिवश्च ग्मश्चापां च जन्तवः ।
अहं हरी वृषणा विव्रता रघू अहं वज्रं शवसे धृष्ण्वा ददे ॥
verses.rom:
mam dhurindram nama devata divashcha gmashchapam cha jantavah |
aham hari vrishana vivrata raghu aham vajram shavase dhrishnva dade ||
verses.en:
The People of the heavens, the waters, and the earth have stablished me among the Gods with Indra's name.
I took unto myself the two swift vigorous Bays that speed on divers paths, and the fierce bolt for strength.

verses.sa:
अहमत्कं कवये शिश्नथं हथैरहं कुत्समावमाभिरूतिभिः ।
अहं शुष्णस्य श्नथिता वधर्यमं न यो रर आर्यं नाम दस्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
ahamatkam kavaye shishnatham hathairaham kutsamavamabhirutibhih |
aham shushnasya shnathita vadharyamam na yo rara aryam nama dasyave ||
verses.en:
With deadly blows I smote Atka for Kavi's sake; I guarded Kutsa well with these saving helps.
As Susna's slayer I brandished the dart of death: I gave not up the Aryan name to Dasyu foes.

verses.sa:
अहं पितेव वेतसूँरभिष्टये तुग्रं कुत्साय स्मदिभं च रन्धयम् ।
अहं भुवं यजमानस्य राजनि प्र यद्भरे तुजये न प्रियाधृषे ॥
verses.rom:
aham piteva vetasunrabhishtaye tugram kutsaya smadibham cha randhayam |
aham bhuvam yajamanasya rajani pra yadbhare tujaye na priyadhrishe ||
verses.en:
Smadibha, Tugra, and the Vetasus I gave as prey to Kutsa, father-like, to succour him.
I was a worthy King to rule the worshipper, when I gave Tuji dear inviolable gifts.

verses.sa:
अहं रन्धयं मृगयं श्रुतर्वणे यन्माजिहीत वयुना चनानुषक् ।
अहं वेशं नम्रमायवेऽकरमहं सव्याय पड्गृभिमरन्धयम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham randhayam mrigayam shrutarvane yanmajihita vayuna chananushak |
aham vesham namramayave'karamaham savyaya padgribhimarandhayam ||
verses.en:
I gave up Mrgaya to Srutarvan as his prey because he ever followed me and kept my laws.
For Ayu's sake I caused Veta to bend and bow, and into Savya's hand delivered Padgrbhi.

verses.sa:
अहं स यो नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं सं वृत्रेव दासं वृत्रहारुजम् ।
यद्वर्धयन्तं प्रथयन्तमानुषग्दूरे पारे रजसो रोचनाकरम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham sa yo navavastvam brihadratham sam vritreva dasam vritraharujam |
yadvardhayantam prathayantamanushagdure pare rajaso rochanakaram ||
verses.en:
1, I crushed Navavastva of the lofty car, the Dasa, as the Vrtra-slayer kills the fiends;
When straightway on the region's farthest edge I brought the God who makes the lights to broaden and increase.

verses.sa:
अहं सूर्यस्य परि याम्याशुभिः प्रैतशेभिर्वहमान ओजसा ।
यन्मा सावो मनुष आह निर्णिज ऋधक्कृषे दासं कृत्व्यं हथैः ॥
verses.rom:
aham suryasya pari yamyashubhih praitashebhirvahamana ojasa |
yanma savo manusha aha nirnija ridhakkrishe dasam kritvyam hathaih ||
verses.en:
I travel round about borne onward in my might by the fleet-footed dappled Horses of the Sun.
When man's libation calls me to the robe of state I soon repel the powerful Dasyu with my blows.

verses.sa:
अहं सप्तहा नहुषो नहुष्टरः प्राश्रावयं शवसा तुर्वशं यदुम् ।
अहं न्यन्यं सहसा सहस्करं नव व्राधतो नवतिं च वक्षयम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham saptaha nahusho nahushtarah prashravayam shavasa turvasham yadum |
aham nyanyam sahasa sahaskaram nava vradhato navatim cha vakshayam ||
verses.en:
Stronger am I than Nabus, I who slew the seven: I glorified with might Yadu and Turvaga.
I brought another low, with strength I bent his strength: I let the mighty nine-and-ninety wax in power.

verses.sa:
अहं सप्त स्रवतो धारयं वृषा द्रवित्न्वः पृथिव्यां सीरा अधि ।
अहमर्णांसि वि तिरामि सुक्रतुर्युधा विदं मनवे गातुमिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
aham sapta sravato dharayam vrisha dravitnvah prithivyam sira adhi |
ahamarnamsi vi tirami sukraturyudha vidam manave gatumishtaye ||
verses.en:
Bull over all the streams that flow along the earth, I took the Seven Rivers as mine own domain.
I, gifted with great wisdom, spread the floods abroad: by war I found for man the way to high success.

verses.sa:
अहं तदासु धारयं यदासु न देवश्चन त्वष्टाधारयद्रुशत् ।
स्पार्हं गवामूधस्सु वक्षणास्वा मधोर्मधु श्वात्र्यं सोममाशिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham tadasu dharayam yadasu na devashchana tvashtadharayadrushat |
sparham gavamudhassu vakshanasva madhormadhu shvatryam somamashiram ||
verses.en:
I set within these cows the white milk which no God, not even Tvastar's self, had there deposited,-
Much-longed-for, in the breasts, the udders of the kine, the savoury sweets of meath, the milk and Soma juice.

verses.sa:
एवा देवाँ इन्द्रो विव्ये नॄन्प्र च्यौत्नेन मघवा सत्यराधाः ।
विश्वेत्ता ते हरिवः शचीवोऽभि तुरासः स्वयशो गृणन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
eva devan indro vivye nrinpra chyautnena maghava satyaradhah |
vishvetta te harivah shachivo'bhi turasah svayasho grinanti ||
verses.en:
Even thus hath Indra Maghavan, truly bounteous, sped Gods and men with mighty operation.
The pious glorify all these thine exploits, Lord of Bay Coursers, Strong, and self resplendent.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे मन्दमानायान्धसोऽर्चा विश्वानराय विश्वाभुवे ।
इन्द्रस्य यस्य सुमखं सहो महि श्रवो नृम्णं च रोदसी सपर्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe mandamanayandhaso'rcha vishvanaraya vishvabhuve |
indrasya yasya sumakham saho mahi shravo nrimnam cha rodasi saparyatah ||
verses.en:
I LAUD your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is shared by all men, who created all;
Indra, whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु सख्या नर्य इन स्तुतश्चर्कृत्य इन्द्रो मावते नरे ।
विश्वासु धूर्षु वाजकृत्येषु सत्पते वृत्रे वाप्स्वभि शूर मन्दसे ॥
verses.rom:
so chinnu sakhya narya ina stutashcharkritya indro mavate nare |
vishvasu dhurshu vajakrityeshu satpate vritre vapsvabhi shura mandase ||
verses.en:
He with his friend is active, lauded, good to man, Indra who must be glorified by one like me.
Hero, Lord of the brave, all cars are thy delight, warring with Vrtra, or for waters, or for spoil.

verses.sa:
के ते नर इन्द्र ये त इषे ये ते सुम्नं सधन्यमियक्षान् ।
के ते वाजायासुर्याय हिन्विरे के अप्सु स्वासूर्वरासु पौंस्ये ॥
verses.rom:
ke te nara indra ye ta ishe ye te sumnam sadhanyamiyakshan |
ke te vajayasuryaya hinvire ke apsu svasurvarasu paumsye ||
verses.en:
Who are the men whom thou wilt further, Indra, who strive to win thy bliss allied with riches?
Who urged thee forward to exert thy power divine, to valour, in the war for waters on their fields?

verses.sa:
भुवस्त्वमिन्द्र ब्रह्मणा महान्भुवो विश्वेषु सवनेषु यज्ञियः ।
भुवो नॄँश्च्यौत्नो विश्वस्मिन्भरे ज्येष्ठश्च मन्त्रो विश्वचर्षणे ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvastvamindra brahmana mahanbhuvo vishveshu savaneshu yajniyah |
bhuvo nrinshchyautno vishvasminbhare jyeshthashcha mantro vishvacharshane ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, through the holy prayer art mighty, worthy of sacrifice at all libations.
In every fight thou castest heroes on the ground: thou art the noblest song, O Lord of all the folk.

verses.sa:
अवा नु कं ज्यायान्यज्ञवनसो महीं त ओमात्रां कृष्टयो विदुः ।
असो नु कमजरो वर्धाश्च विश्वेदेता सवना तूतुमा कृषे ॥
verses.rom:
ava nu kam jyayanyajnavanaso mahim ta omatram krishtayo viduh |
aso nu kamajaro vardhashcha vishvedeta savana tutuma krishe ||
verses.en:
Help now, as Highest, those who toil at sacrifice: well do the people know thy great protecting might.
Thou shalt be everlasting, Giver of success yea, on all these libations thou bestowest strength.

verses.sa:
एता विश्वा सवना तूतुमा कृषे स्वयं सूनो सहसो यानि दधिषे ।
वराय ते पात्रं धर्मणे तना यज्ञो मन्त्रो ब्रह्मोद्यतं वचः ॥
verses.rom:
eta vishva savana tutuma krishe svayam suno sahaso yani dadhishe |
varaya te patram dharmane tana yajno mantro brahmodyatam vachah ||
verses.en:
All these libations thou makest effectual, of which thou art thyself supporter, Son of Power.
Therefore thy vessel is to be esteemed the best, sacrifice, holy text, prayer, and exalted speech.

verses.sa:
ये ते विप्र ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा वसूनां च वसुनश्च दावने ।
प्र ते सुम्नस्य मनसा पथा भुवन्मदे सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye te vipra brahmakritah sute sacha vasunam cha vasunashcha davane |
pra te sumnasya manasa patha bhuvanmade sutasya somyasyandhasah ||
verses.en:
They who with flowing Soma pray to thee, O Sage, to pour on them thy gifts of opulence and wealth,
May they come forward, through their spirit, on the path of bliss, in the wild joy of Soma juice effused.

verses.sa:
महत्तदुल्बं स्थविरं तदासीद्येनाविष्टितः प्रविवेशिथापः ।
विश्वा अपश्यद्बहुधा ते अग्ने जातवेदस्तन्वो देव एकः ॥
verses.rom:
mahattadulbam sthaviram tadasidyenavishtitah praviveshithapah |
vishva apashyadbahudha te agne jatavedastanvo deva ekah ||
verses.en:
LARGE was that covering, and firm of texture, folded wherein thou enteredst the waters.
One Deity alone, O Jatavedas Agni, saw all thy forms in sundry places.

verses.sa:
को मा ददर्श कतमः स देवो यो मे तन्वो बहुधा पर्यपश्यत् ।
क्वाह मित्रावरुणा क्षियन्त्यग्नेर्विश्वाः समिधो देवयानीः ॥
verses.rom:
ko ma dadarsha katamah sa devo yo me tanvo bahudha paryapashyat |
kvaha mitravaruna kshiyantyagnervishvah samidho devayanih ||
verses.en:
What God hath seen me? Who of all their number clearly beheld my forms in many places?
Where lie, then, all the sacred logs of Agni that lead him God-ward, Varuna and Mitra?

verses.sa:
ऐच्छाम त्वा बहुधा जातवेदः प्रविष्टमग्ने अप्स्वोषधीषु ।
तं त्वा यमो अचिकेच्चित्रभानो दशान्तरुष्यादतिरोचमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
aichchhama tva bahudha jatavedah pravishtamagne apsvoshadhishu |
tam tva yamo achikechchitrabhano dashantarushyadatirochamanam ||
verses.en:
In many places, Agni Jatavedas, we sought thee hidden in the plants and waters.
Then Yama marked thee, God of wondrous splendour! effulgent from thy tenfold secret dwelling,

verses.sa:
होत्रादहं वरुण बिभ्यदायं नेदेव मा युनजन्नत्र देवाः ।
तस्य मे तन्वो बहुधा निविष्टा एतमर्थं न चिकेताहमग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
hotradaham varuna bibhyadayam nedeva ma yunajannatra devah |
tasya me tanvo bahudha nivishta etamartham na chiketahamagnih ||
verses.en:
I fled in fear from sacrificial worship, Varuna, lest the Gods should thus engage me.
Thus were my forms laid down in many places. This, as my goal, I Agni saw before me.

verses.sa:
एहि मनुर्देवयुर्यज्ञकामोऽरंकृत्या तमसि क्षेष्यग्ने ।
सुगान्पथः कृणुहि देवयानान्वह हव्यानि सुमनस्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
ehi manurdevayuryajnakamo'ramkritya tamasi ksheshyagne |
suganpathah krinuhi devayananvaha havyani sumanasyamanah ||
verses.en:
Come; man is pious and would fain do worship, he waits prepared: in gloom thou, Agni, dwellest.
Make pathways leading God-ward clear and easy, and bear oblations with a kindly spirit.

verses.sa:
अग्नेः पूर्वे भ्रातरो अर्थमेतं रथीवाध्वानमन्वावरीवुः ।
तस्माद्भिया वरुण दूरमायं गौरो न क्षेप्नोरविजे ज्यायाः ॥
verses.rom:
agneh purve bhrataro arthametam rathivadhvanamanvavarivuh |
tasmadbhiya varuna duramayam gauro na kshepnoravije jyayah ||
verses.en:
This goal mine elder brothers erst selected, as he who drives a car the way to travel.
So,Varuna, I fled afar through terror, as flies the wild-bull from an archer's bowstring.

verses.sa:
कुर्मस्त आयुरजरं यदग्ने यथा युक्तो जातवेदो न रिष्याः ।
अथा वहासि सुमनस्यमानो भागं देवेभ्यो हविषः सुजात ॥
verses.rom:
kurmasta ayurajaram yadagne yatha yukto jatavedo na rishyah |
atha vahasi sumanasyamano bhagam devebhyo havishah sujata ||
verses.en:
We give thee life unwasting, Jatavedas, so that, employed, thou never shalt be injured.
So, nobly born! shalt thou with kindly spirit bear to the Gods their share of men's oblations.

verses.sa:
प्रयाजान्मे अनुयाजाँश्च केवलानूर्जस्वन्तं हविषो दत्त भागम् ।
घृतं चापां पुरुषं चौषधीनामग्नेश्च दीर्घमायुरस्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
prayajanme anuyajanshcha kevalanurjasvantam havisho datta bhagam |
ghritam chapam purusham chaushadhinamagneshcha dirghamayurastu devah ||
verses.en:
Grant me the first oblations and the latter, entire, my forceful shares of holy presents,
The soul of plants, the fatness of the waters, and let there be long life, ye Gods, to Agni.

verses.sa:
तव प्रयाजा अनुयाजाश्च केवल ऊर्जस्वन्तो हविषः सन्तु भागाः ।
तवाग्ने यज्ञोऽयमस्तु सर्वस्तुभ्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
tava prayaja anuyajashcha kevala urjasvanto havishah santu bhagah |
tavagne yajno'yamastu sarvastubhyam namantam pradishashchatasrah ||
verses.en:
Thine be the first oblations and the latter, entire, thy forceful shares of holy presents.
Let all this sacrifice be thine, O Agni, and let the world's four regions bow before thee.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः शास्तन मा यथेह होता वृतो मनवै यन्निषद्य ।
प्र मे ब्रूत भागधेयं यथा वो येन पथा हव्यमा वो वहानि ॥
verses.rom:
vishve devah shastana ma yatheha hota vrito manavai yannishadya |
pra me bruta bhagadheyam yatha vo yena patha havyama vo vahani ||
verses.en:
INSTRUCT me, all ye Gods, how I, elected your Priest, must seat me here, and how address you.
Instruct me how to deal to each his portion, and by what ' path to bring you man's oblation.

verses.sa:
अहं होता न्यसीदं यजीयान्विश्वे देवा मरुतो मा जुनन्ति ।
अहरहरश्विनाध्वर्यवं वां ब्रह्मा समिद्भवति साहुतिर्वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham hota nyasidam yajiyanvishve deva maruto ma junanti |
aharaharashvinadhvaryavam vam brahma samidbhavati sahutirvam ||
verses.en:
I sit as Priest most skilled in sacrificing: the Maruts and all Deities impel me.
Asvins, each day yours is the Adhvaryu's duty: Brahman and wood are here: 'tis yours to offer.

verses.sa:
अयं यो होता किरु स यमस्य कमप्यूहे यत्समञ्जन्ति देवाः ।
अहरहर्जायते मासिमास्यथा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yo hota kiru sa yamasya kamapyuhe yatsamanjanti devah |
aharaharjayate masimasyatha deva dadhire havyavaham ||
verses.en:
Who is the Priest? Is he the Priest of Yama? On whom is thrust this God-appointed honour?
He springs to life each month, each day that passes; so Gods have made him their oblation-bearer.

verses.sa:
मां देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहमपम्लुक्तं बहु कृच्छ्रा चरन्तम् ।
अग्निर्विद्वान्यज्ञं नः कल्पयाति पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम् ॥
verses.rom:
mam deva dadhire havyavahamapamluktam bahu krichchhra charantam |
agnirvidvanyajnam nah kalpayati panchayamam trivritam saptatantum ||
verses.en:
The Gods have made me bearer of oblations, who slipped away and passed through many troubles.
Wise Agni shall ordain for us the worship, whether five-wayed, threefold, or seven-threaded.

verses.sa:
आ वो यक्ष्यमृतत्वं सुवीरं यथा वो देवा वरिवः कराणि ।
आ बाह्वोर्वज्रमिन्द्रस्य धेयामथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयाति ॥
verses.rom:
a vo yakshyamritatvam suviram yatha vo deva varivah karani |
a bahvorvajramindrasya dheyamathema vishvah pritana jayati ||
verses.en:
So will I win you strength and life for ever. O Gods, that I may give you room and freedom.
To Indra's arms would I consign the thunder; in all these battles shall he then be victor.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् ।
औक्षन्घृतैरस्तृणन्बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयन्त ॥
verses.rom:
trini shata tri sahasranyagnim trimshachcha deva nava chasaparyan |
aukshanghritairastrinanbarhirasma adiddhotaram nyasadayanta ||
verses.en:
The Deities three hundred and thirty-nine, have served and honoured Agni,
Strewn sacred grass, anointed him with butter, and seated him as Priest, the Gods' Invoker.

verses.sa:
यमैच्छाम मनसा सोऽयमागाद्यज्ञस्य विद्वान्परुषश्चिकित्वान् ।
स नो यक्षद्देवताता यजीयान्नि हि षत्सदन्तरः पूर्वो अस्मत् ॥
verses.rom:
yamaichchhama manasa so'yamagadyajnasya vidvanparushashchikitvan |
sa no yakshaddevatata yajiyanni hi shatsadantarah purvo asmat ||
verses.en:
HE hath arrived, he whom we sought with longing, who skilled in sacrifice well knows its courses.
Let him discharge his sacrificial duties: let him sit down as Friend who was before Us.

verses.sa:
अराधि होता निषदा यजीयानभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि हि ख्यत् ।
यजामहै यज्ञियान्हन्त देवाँ ईळामहा ईड्याँ आज्येन ॥
verses.rom:
aradhi hota nishada yajiyanabhi prayamsi sudhitani hi khyat |
yajamahai yajniyanhanta devan ilamaha idyan ajyena ||
verses.en:
Best Priest, he hath been won by being seated, for he hath looked on the well-ordered viands.
Come, let us worship Gods who must be worshipped, and pouring oil, laud those who should be lauded.

verses.sa:
साध्वीमकर्देववीतिं नो अद्य यज्ञस्य जिह्वामविदाम गुह्याम् ।
स आयुरागात्सुरभिर्वसानो भद्रामकर्देवहूतिं नो अद्य ॥
verses.rom:
sadhvimakardevavitim no adya yajnasya jihvamavidama guhyam |
sa ayuragatsurabhirvasano bhadramakardevahutim no adya ||
verses.en:
Now hath he made the feast of Gods effective: now have we found the secret tongue of worship.
Now hath he come, sweet, robed in vital vigour, and made our calling on the Gods effective.

verses.sa:
तदद्य वाचः प्रथमं मसीय येनासुराँ अभि देवा असाम ।
ऊर्जाद उत यज्ञियासः पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadadya vachah prathamam masiya yenasuran abhi deva asama |
urjada uta yajniyasah pancha jana mama hotram jushadhvam ||
verses.en:
This prelude of my speech I now will utter, whereby we Gods may quell our Asura foemen.
Eaters of strengthening food who merit worship, O ye Five Tribes, be pleased with mine oblation.

verses.sa:
पञ्च जना मम होत्रं जुषन्तां गोजाता उत ये यज्ञियासः ।
पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
pancha jana mama hotram jushantam gojata uta ye yajniyasah |
prithivi nah parthivatpatvamhaso'ntariksham divyatpatvasman ||
verses.en:
May the Five Tribes be pleased with mine oblation, and the Cow's Sons and all who merit worship.
From earthly trouble may the earth protect us, and air's mid realm from woe that comes from heaven.

verses.sa:
तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान् ।
अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tantum tanvanrajaso bhanumanvihi jyotishmatah patho raksha dhiya kritan |
anulbanam vayata joguvamapo manurbhava janaya daivyam janam ||
verses.en:
Spinning the thread, follow the region's splendid light: guard thou the path ways well which wisdom hath prepared.
