Weave ye the knotless labour of the bards who sing: be Manu thou, and bring the Heavenly People forth.

verses.sa:
अक्षानहो नह्यतनोत सोम्या इष्कृणुध्वं रशना ओत पिंशत ।
अष्टावन्धुरं वहताभितो रथं येन देवासो अनयन्नभि प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
akshanaho nahyatanota somya ishkrinudhvam rashana ota pimshata |
ashtavandhuram vahatabhito ratham yena devaso anayannabhi priyam ||
verses.en:
Lovers of Soma, bind the chariot traces fast: set ye the reins in order and embellish them.
Bring hitherward the car with seats where eight may sit, whereon the Gods have brought the treasure that we love.

verses.sa:
अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्र तरता सखायः ।
अत्रा जहाम ये असन्नशेवाः शिवान्वयमुत्तरेमाभि वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmanvati riyate sam rabhadhvamuttishthata pra tarata sakhayah |
atra jahama ye asannashevah shivanvayamuttaremabhi vajan ||
verses.en:
Here flows Asmanvati: hold fast each other, keep yourselves up, and pass, my friends, the river.
There let us leave the Powers that brought no profit, and cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा माया वेदपसामपस्तमो बिभ्रत्पात्रा देवपानानि शंतमा ।
शिशीते नूनं परशुं स्वायसं येन वृश्चादेतशो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta maya vedapasamapastamo bibhratpatra devapanani shamtama |
shishite nunam parashum svayasam yena vrishchadetasho brahmanaspatih ||
verses.en:
Tvastar, most deft of workmen, knew each magic art, bringing most blessed bowls that hold the drink of Gods.
His axe, wrought of good metal, he is sharpening now, wherewith the radiant Brahmanaspati will cut.

verses.sa:
सतो नूनं कवयः सं शिशीत वाशीभिर्याभिरमृताय तक्षथ ।
विद्वांसः पदा गुह्यानि कर्तन येन देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
sato nunam kavayah sam shishita vashibhiryabhiramritaya takshatha |
vidvamsah pada guhyani kartana yena devaso amritatvamanashuh ||
verses.en:
Now, O ye Sapient Ones, make ye the axes sharp wherewith ye fashion bowls to hold the Amrta.
Knowing the secret places make ye ready that whereby the Gods have gotten immortality.

verses.sa:
गर्भे योषामदधुर्वत्समासन्यपीच्येन मनसोत जिह्वया ।
स विश्वाहा सुमना योग्या अभि सिषासनिर्वनते कार इज्जितिम् ॥
verses.rom:
garbhe yoshamadadhurvatsamasanyapichyena manasota jihvaya |
sa vishvaha sumana yogya abhi sishasanirvanate kara ijjitim ||
verses.en:
Ye with a secret tongue and dark intention laid the maiden deep within, the calf within the mouth.
They evermore are near us with their gracious help: successful is the song that strives for victory.

verses.sa:
तां सु ते कीर्तिं मघवन्महित्वा यत्त्वा भीते रोदसी अह्वयेताम् ।
प्रावो देवाँ आतिरो दासमोजः प्रजायै त्वस्यै यदशिक्ष इन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
tam su te kirtim maghavanmahitva yattva bhite rodasi ahvayetam |
pravo devan atiro dasamojah prajayai tvasyai yadashiksha indra ||
verses.en:
I SING thy fame that, Maghavan, through thy Greatness the heavens and earth invoked thee in their terror,
Thou, aiding Gods, didst quell the power of Dasas, what time thou holpest many a race, O Indra.

verses.sa:
यदचरस्तन्वा वावृधानो बलानीन्द्र प्रब्रुवाणो जनेषु ।
मायेत्सा ते यानि युद्धान्याहुर्नाद्य शत्रुं ननु पुरा विवित्से ॥
verses.rom:
yadacharastanva vavridhano balanindra prabruvano janeshu |
mayetsa te yani yuddhanyahurnadya shatrum nanu pura vivitse ||
verses.en:
When thou wast roaming, waxen strong in body, telling thy might, Indra, among the people,
All that men called thy battles was illusion: no foe hast thou to-day, nor erst hast found one.

verses.sa:
क उ नु ते महिमनः समस्यास्मत्पूर्व ऋषयोऽन्तमापुः ।
यन्मातरं च पितरं च साकमजनयथास्तन्वः स्वायाः ॥
verses.rom:
ka u nu te mahimanah samasyasmatpurva rishayo'ntamapuh |
yanmataram cha pitaram cha sakamajanayathastanvah svayah ||
verses.en:
Who are the Rsis, then, who comprehended before our time the bounds of all thy greatness?
For from thy body thou hast generated at the same time the Mother and the Father.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि ते असुर्याणि नामादाभ्यानि महिषस्य सन्ति ।
त्वमङ्ग तानि विश्वानि वित्से येभिः कर्माणि मघवञ्चकर्थ ॥
verses.rom:
chatvari te asuryani namadabhyani mahishasya santi |
tvamanga tani vishvani vitse yebhih karmani maghavanchakartha ||
verses.en:
Thou, Mighty Steer, hast four supremest natures, Asura natures that may ne'er be injured.
All these, O Maghavan, thou surely knowest, wherewith thou hast performed thy great achievements.

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वा दधिषे केवलानि यान्याविर्या च गुहा वसूनि ।
काममिन्मे मघवन्मा वि तारीस्त्वमाज्ञाता त्वमिन्द्रासि दाता ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishva dadhishe kevalani yanyavirya cha guha vasuni |
kamaminme maghavanma vi taristvamajnata tvamindrasi data ||
verses.en:
Thou hast all treasures in thy sole possession, treasures made manifest and treasures hidden.
Defer not thou, O Maghavan, my longing: thou, art Director, Indra, thou art Giver.

verses.sa:
यो अदधाज्ज्योतिषि ज्योतिरन्तर्यो असृजन्मधुना सं मधूनि ।
अध प्रियं शूषमिन्द्राय मन्म ब्रह्मकृतो बृहदुक्थादवाचि ॥
verses.rom:
yo adadhajjyotishi jyotirantaryo asrijanmadhuna sam madhuni |
adha priyam shushamindraya manma brahmakrito brihadukthadavachi ||
verses.en:
To him who set the light in things of splendour, and with all sweetness blent essential sweetness,
To Indra hath this welcome hymn that strengthens been uttered by the votary Brhaduktha.

verses.sa:
दूरे तन्नाम गुह्यं पराचैर्यत्त्वा भीते अह्वयेतां वयोधै ।
उदस्तभ्नाः पृथिवीं द्यामभीके भ्रातुः पुत्रान्मघवन्तित्विषाणः ॥
verses.rom:
dure tannama guhyam parachairyattva bhite ahvayetam vayodhai |
udastabhnah prithivim dyamabhike bhratuh putranmaghavantitvishanah ||
verses.en:
FAR is that secret name by which, in terror, the worlds invoked thee and thou gavest vigour
The earth and heaven thou settest near each other, and Maghavan, madest bright thy Brother's Children.

verses.sa:
महत्तन्नाम गुह्यं पुरुस्पृग्येन भूतं जनयो येन भव्यम् ।
प्रत्नं जातं ज्योतिर्यदस्य प्रियं प्रियाः समविशन्त पञ्च ॥
verses.rom:
mahattannama guhyam purusprigyena bhutam janayo yena bhavyam |
pratnam jatam jyotiryadasya priyam priyah samavishanta pancha ||
verses.en:
Great is that secret name and far-extending, whereby thou madest all that is and shall be.
The Five Tribes whom he loveth well have entered the light he loveth that was made aforetime.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी अपृणादोत मध्यं पञ्च देवाँ ऋतुशः सप्तसप्त ।
चतुस्त्रिंशता पुरुधा वि चष्टे सरूपेण ज्योतिषा विव्रतेन ॥
verses.rom:
a rodasi aprinadota madhyam pancha devan ritushah saptasapta |
chatustrimshata purudha vi chashte sarupena jyotisha vivratena ||
verses.en:
He filled the heaven and earth and all between them, Gods five times sevenfold in their proper seasons.
With four-and-thirty lights he looks around him, lights of one colour though their ways are divers.

verses.sa:
यदुष औच्छः प्रथमा विभानामजनयो येन पुष्टस्य पुष्टम् ।
यत्ते जामित्वमवरं परस्या महन्महत्या असुरत्वमेकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadusha auchchhah prathama vibhanamajanayo yena pushtasya pushtam |
yatte jamitvamavaram parasya mahanmahatya asuratvamekam ||
verses.en:
As first among the lights, O Dawn, thou shonest, whereby thou broughtest forth the Stay of Increase,
Great art thou, matchless is thine Asura nature, who, high above, art kin to those beneath thee.

verses.sa:
विधुं दद्राणं समने बहूनां युवानं सन्तं पलितो जगार ।
देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान ॥
verses.rom:
vidhum dadranam samane bahunam yuvanam santam palito jagara |
devasya pashya kavyam mahitvadya mamara sa hyah samana ||
verses.en:
The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him.
Behold the Gods' high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.

verses.sa:
शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीळः ।
यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता ॥
verses.rom:
shakmana shako arunah suparna a yo mahah shurah sanadanilah |
yachchiketa satyamittanna mogham vasu sparhamuta jetota data ||
verses.en:
Strong is the Red Bird in his strength, great Hero, who from of old hath had no nest to dwell in.
That which he knows is truth and never idle: he wins and gives the wealth desired of many.

verses.sa:
ऐभिर्ददे वृष्ण्या पौंस्यानि येभिरौक्षद्वृत्रहत्याय वज्री ।
ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋतेकर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
aibhirdade vrishnya paumsyani yebhiraukshadvritrahatyaya vajri |
ye karmanah kriyamanasya mahna ritekarmamudajayanta devah ||
verses.en:
Through these the Thunderer gained strong manly vigour, through whom he waxed in power to smite down Vrtra,-
Who through the might of Indra's operation came forth as Gods in course of Law and Order.

verses.sa:
युजा कर्माणि जनयन्विश्वौजा अशस्तिहा विश्वमनास्तुराषाट् ।
पीत्वी सोमस्य दिव आ वृधानः शूरो निर्युधाधमद्दस्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
yuja karmani janayanvishvauja ashastiha vishvamanasturashat |
pitvi somasya diva a vridhanah shuro niryudhadhamaddasyun ||
verses.en:
All-strong, performing works with his companion, All-marking, rapid Victor, Curse-averter,
The Hero, waxing, after draughts of Soma, blew far from heaven the Dasyus with his weapon.

verses.sa:
इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व ।
संवेशने तन्वश्चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे ॥
verses.rom:
idam ta ekam para u ta ekam tritiyena jyotisha sam vishasva |
samveshane tanvashcharuredhi priyo devanam parame janitre ||
verses.en:
HERE is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and he therewith united.
Uniting with a body be thou welcome, dear to the Gods in their sublimest birthplace.

verses.sa:
तनूष्टे वाजिन्तन्वं नयन्ती वाममस्मभ्यं धातु शर्म तुभ्यम् ।
अह्रुतो महो धरुणाय देवान्दिवीव ज्योतिः स्वमा मिमीयाः ॥
verses.rom:
tanushte vajintanvam nayanti vamamasmabhyam dhatu sharma tubhyam |
ahruto maho dharunaya devandiviva jyotih svama mimiyah ||
verses.en:
Bearing thy body, Vajin, may thy body afford us blessing and thyself protection.
Unswerving, stablish as it were in heaven thine own light as the mighty God's supporter.

verses.sa:
वाज्यसि वाजिनेना सुवेनीः सुवित स्तोमं सुवितो दिवं गाः ।
सुवितो धर्म प्रथमानु सत्या सुवितो देवान्सुवितोऽनु पत्म ॥
verses.rom:
vajyasi vajinena suvenih suvita stomam suvito divam gah |
suvito dharma prathamanu satya suvito devansuvito'nu patma ||
verses.en:
Strong Steed art thou: go to the yearning Maidens with vigour, happily go to heaven and praises:
Fly happily to the Gods with easy passage, according to the first and faithful statutes.

verses.sa:
महिम्न एषां पितरश्चनेशिरे देवा देवेष्वदधुरपि क्रतुम् ।
समविव्यचुरुत यान्यत्विषुरैषां तनूषु नि विविशुः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
mahimna esham pitarashchaneshire deva deveshvadadhurapi kratum |
samavivyachuruta yanyatvishuraisham tanushu ni vivishuh punah ||
verses.en:
Part of their grandeur have the Fathers also gained: the Gods have seated mental power in them as Gods.
They have embraced within themselves all energies, which, issuing forth, again into their bodies pass.

verses.sa:
सहोभिर्विश्वं परि चक्रमू रजः पूर्वा धामान्यमिता मिमानाः ।
तनूषु विश्वा भुवना नि येमिरे प्रासारयन्त पुरुध प्रजा अनु ॥
verses.rom:
sahobhirvishvam pari chakramu rajah purva dhamanyamita mimanah |
tanushu vishva bhuvana ni yemire prasarayanta purudha praja anu ||
verses.en:
They strode through all the region with victorious might, establishing the old immeasurable laws.
They compassed in their bodies all existing things, and streamed forth offspring in many successive forms.

verses.sa:
द्विधा सूनवोऽसुरं स्वर्विदमास्थापयन्त तृतीयेन कर्मणा ।
स्वां प्रजां पितरः पित्र्यं सह आवरेष्वदधुस्तन्तुमाततम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvidha sunavo'suram svarvidamasthapayanta tritiyena karmana |
svam prajam pitarah pitryam saha avareshvadadhustantumatatam ||
verses.en:
In two ways have the sons established in his place the Asura who finds the light, by the third act,
As fathers, they have set their heritage on earth, their offspring, as a thread continuously spun out.

verses.sa:
नावा न क्षोदः प्रदिशः पृथिव्याः स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा ।
स्वां प्रजां बृहदुक्थो महित्वावरेष्वदधादा परेषु ॥
verses.rom:
nava na kshodah pradishah prithivyah svastibhirati durgani vishva |
svam prajam brihaduktho mahitvavareshvadadhada pareshu ||
verses.en:
As in a ship through billows, so through regions of air, with blessings, through toils and troubles
Hath Brhaduktha brought his seed with glory, and placed it here and in the realms beyond us.

verses.sa:
मा प्र गाम पथो वयं मा यज्ञादिन्द्र सोमिनः ।
मान्त स्थुर्नो अरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ma pra gama patho vayam ma yajnadindra sominah |
manta sthurno aratayah ||
verses.en:
LET us not, Indra, leave the path, the Soma-presser's sacrifice:
Let no malignity dwell with us.

verses.sa:
यो यज्ञस्य प्रसाधनस्तन्तुर्देवेष्वाततः ।
तमाहुतं नशीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
yo yajnasya prasadhanastanturdeveshvatatah |
tamahutam nashimahi ||
verses.en:
May we obtain, completely wrought, the thread spun out to reach the Gods,
That perfecteth the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
मनो न्वा हुवामहे नाराशंसेन सोमेन ।
पितॄणां च मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
mano nva huvamahe narashamsena somena |
pitrinam cha manmabhih ||
verses.en:
We call the spirit hither with the Soma of our parted sires,
Yea, with the Fathers' holy hymns.

verses.sa:
आ त एतु मनः पुनः क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे ।
ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
a ta etu manah punah kratve dakshaya jivase |
jyokcha suryam drishe ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit come to thee again for wisdom, energy, and lire,
That thou mayst long behold the sun!

verses.sa:
पुनर्नः पितरो मनो ददातु दैव्यो जनः ।
जीवं व्रातं सचेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
punarnah pitaro mano dadatu daivyo janah |
jivam vratam sachemahi ||
verses.en:
O Fathers, may the Heavenly Folk give us our spirit once again,
That we may be with those who live.

verses.sa:
वयं सोम व्रते तव मनस्तनूषु बिभ्रतः ।
प्रजावन्तः सचेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
vayam soma vrate tava manastanushu bibhratah |
prajavantah sachemahi ||
verses.en:
O Soma with the spirit still within us, blest with progeny,
May we be busied in the law.

verses.sa:
यत्ते यमं वैवस्वतं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte yamam vaivasvatam mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
THY spirit, that went far away to Yama to Vivasvan's Son,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते दिवं यत्पृथिवीं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte divam yatprithivim mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away, that passed away to earth and heaven,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते भूमिं चतुर्भृष्टिं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte bhumim chaturbhrishtim mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away, away to the four-eyed earth,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते चतस्रः प्रदिशो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte chatasrah pradisho mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away to the four quarters of the world,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते समुद्रमर्णवं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte samudramarnavam mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away, away unto the billowy sea,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते मरीचीः प्रवतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte marichih pravato mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away to beams of light that flash and flow,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते अपो यदोषधीर्मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte apo yadoshadhirmano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away, went to the waters and the plants,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते सूर्यं यदुषसं मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte suryam yadushasam mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away, that visited the Sun and Dawn.
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते पर्वतान्बृहतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte parvatanbrihato mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away, away to lofty mountain heights,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते विश्वमिदं जगन्मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte vishvamidam jaganmano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away into this All, that lives and moves,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते पराः परावतो मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte parah paravato mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away to distant realms beyond our ken,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
यत्ते भूतं च भव्यं च मनो जगाम दूरकम् ।
तत्त आ वर्तयामसीह क्षयाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yatte bhutam cha bhavyam cha mano jagama durakam |
tatta a vartayamasiha kshayaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Thy spirit, that went far away to all that is and is to be,
We cause to come to thee again that thou mayst live and sojourn here.

verses.sa:
प्र तार्यायुः प्रतरं नवीय स्थातारेव क्रतुमता रथस्य ।
अध च्यवान उत्तवीत्यर्थं परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra taryayuh prataram naviya sthatareva kratumata rathasya |
adha chyavana uttavityartham parataram su nirritirjihitam ||
verses.en:
His life hath been renewed and carried forward as two men, car-borne, by the skillful driver.
One falls, then seeks the goal with quickened vigour. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
सामन्नु राये निधिमन्न्वन्नं करामहे सु पुरुध श्रवांसि ।
ता नो विश्वानि जरिता ममत्तु परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
samannu raye nidhimannvannam karamahe su purudha shravamsi |
ta no vishvani jarita mamattu parataram su nirritirjihitam ||
verses.en:
Here is the psalm for wealth, and food, in plenty: let us do many deeds to bring us glory.
All these our doings shall delight the singer. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
अभी ष्वर्यः पौंस्यैर्भवेम द्यौर्न भूमिं गिरयो नाज्रान् ।
ता नो विश्वानि जरिता चिकेत परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shvaryah paumsyairbhavema dyaurna bhumim girayo najran |
ta no vishvani jarita chiketa parataram su nirritirjihitam ||
verses.en:
May we o'ercome our foes with acts of valour, as heaven is over earth, hills over lowlands.
All these our deeds the singer hath considered. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
मो षु णः सोम मृत्यवे परा दाः पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ।
द्युभिर्हितो जरिमा सू नो अस्तु परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu nah soma mrityave para dah pashyema nu suryamuchcharantam |
dyubhirhito jarima su no astu parataram su nirritirjihitam ||
verses.en:
Give us not up as prey to death, O Sorna still let us look upon the Sun arising.
Let our old age with passing days be kindly. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.

verses.sa:
असुनीते मनो अस्मासु धारय जीवातवे सु प्र तिरा न आयुः ।
रारन्धि नः सूर्यस्य संदृशि घृतेन त्वं तन्वं वर्धयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
asunite mano asmasu dharaya jivatave su pra tira na ayuh |
rarandhi nah suryasya samdrishi ghritena tvam tanvam vardhayasva ||
verses.en:
O Asuniti, keep the soul within us, and make the days we have to live yet longer.
Grant that we still may look upon the sunlight: strengthen thy body with the oil we bring thee.

verses.sa:
असुनीते पुनरस्मासु चक्षुः पुनः प्राणमिह नो धेहि भोगम् ।
ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यमुच्चरन्तमनुमते मृळया नः स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
asunite punarasmasu chakshuh punah pranamiha no dhehi bhogam |
jyokpashyema suryamuchcharantamanumate mrilaya nah svasti ||
verses.en:
Give us our sight again, O Asuniti, give us again our breath and our enjoyment.
Long may we look upon the Sun uprising; O Anumati, favour thou and bless us.

verses.sa:
पुनर्नो असुं पृथिवी ददातु पुनर्द्यौर्देवी पुनरन्तरिक्षम् ।
पुनर्नः सोमस्तन्वं ददातु पुनः पूषा पथ्यां या स्वस्तिः ॥
verses.rom:
punarno asum prithivi dadatu punardyaurdevi punarantariksham |
punarnah somastanvam dadatu punah pusha pathyam ya svastih ||
verses.en:
May Earth restore to us our vital spirit, may Heaven the Goddess and mid-air restore it.
May Soma give us once again our body, and Pusan show the Path of peace and comfort.

verses.sa:
शं रोदसी सुबन्धवे यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा ।
भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत् ॥
verses.rom:
sham rodasi subandhave yahvi ritasya matara |
bharatamapa yadrapo dyauh prithivi kshama rapo mo shu te kim chanamamat ||
verses.en:
May both Worlds bless Subandhu, young Mothers of everlasting Law.
May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.

verses.sa:
अव द्वके अव त्रिका दिवश्चरन्ति भेषजा ।
क्षमा चरिष्ण्वेककं भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत् ॥
verses.rom:
ava dvake ava trika divashcharanti bheshaja |
kshama charishnvekakam bharatamapa yadrapo dyauh prithivi kshama rapo mo shu te kim chanamamat ||
verses.en:
Health-giving medicines descend sent down from heaven in twos and threes,
Or wandering singly on the earth. May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रेरय गामनड्वाहं य आवहदुशीनराण्या अनः ।
भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत् ॥
verses.rom:
samindreraya gamanadvaham ya avahadushinaranya anah |
bharatamapa yadrapo dyauh prithivi kshama rapo mo shu te kim chanamamat ||
verses.en:
Drive forward thou the wagon-ox, O Indra, which brought Usinarani's wagon hither.
May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.

verses.sa:
आ जनं त्वेषसंदृशं माहीनानामुपस्तुतम् ।
अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः ॥
verses.rom:
a janam tveshasamdrisham mahinanamupastutam |
aganma bibhrato namah ||
verses.en:
BRINGING our homage we have come to one magnificent in look.
Glorified of the mighty Gods

verses.sa:
असमातिं नितोशनं त्वेषं निययिनं रथम् ।
भजेरथस्य सत्पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
asamatim nitoshanam tvesham niyayinam ratham |
bhajerathasya satpatim ||
verses.en:
To Asamati, spring of gifts, lord of the brave, a radiant car,
The conqueror of Bhajeratha

verses.sa:
यो जनान्महिषाँ इवातितस्थौ पवीरवान् ।
उतापवीरवान्युधा ॥
verses.rom:
yo jananmahishan ivatitasthau paviravan |
utapaviravanyudha ||
verses.en:
Who, when the spear hath armed his hand, or even weaponless o'erthrows
Men strong as buffaloes in fight;

verses.sa:
यस्येक्ष्वाकुरुप व्रते रेवान्मराय्येधते ।
दिवीव पञ्च कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyekshvakurupa vrate revanmarayyedhate |
diviva pancha krishtayah ||
verses.en:
Him in whose service flourishes Iksvaku, rich and dazzling-bright.
As the Five Tribes that are in heaven.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्षत्रासमातिषु रथप्रोष्ठेषु धारय ।
दिवीव सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
indra kshatrasamatishu rathaproshtheshu dharaya |
diviva suryam drishe ||
verses.en:
Indra, support the princely power of Rathaprosthas matched by none,
Even as the Sun for all to see.

verses.sa:
अगस्त्यस्य नद्भ्यः सप्ती युनक्षि रोहिता ।
पणीन्न्यक्रमीरभि विश्वान्राजन्नराधसः ॥
verses.rom:
agastyasya nadbhyah sapti yunakshi rohita |
paninnyakramirabhi vishvanrajannaradhasah ||
verses.en:
Thou for Agastya's sister's sons yokest thy pair of ruddy steeds.
Thou troddest niggards under foot, all those, O King, who brought no gifts.

verses.sa:
अयं मातायं पितायं जीवातुरागमत् ।
इदं तव प्रसर्पणं सुबन्धवेहि निरिहि ॥
verses.rom:
ayam matayam pitayam jivaturagamat |
idam tava prasarpanam subandhavehi nirihi ||
verses.en:
This is the mother, this the sire, this one hath come to be thy life.
What brings thee forth is even this. Now come, Subandhu, get thee forth.

verses.sa:
यथा युगं वरत्रया नह्यन्ति धरुणाय कम् ।
एवा दाधार ते मनो जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
yatha yugam varatraya nahyanti dharunaya kam |
eva dadhara te mano jivatave na mrityave'tho arishtatataye ||
verses.en:
As with the leather thong they bind the chariot yoke to hold it fast,
So have I held thy spirit fast, held it for life and not for death, held it for thy security.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधारेमान्वनस्पतीन् ।
एवा दाधार ते मनो जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
yatheyam prithivi mahi dadharemanvanaspatin |
eva dadhara te mano jivatave na mrityave'tho arishtatataye ||
verses.en:
Even as this earth, the mighty earth, holds fast the monarchs of the wood.
So have I held thy spirit fast, held it for life and not for death, held it for thy security.

verses.sa:
यमादहं वैवस्वतात्सुबन्धोर्मन आभरम् ।
जीवातवे न मृत्यवेऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
yamadaham vaivasvatatsubandhormana abharam |
jivatave na mrityave'tho arishtatataye ||
verses.en:
Subandlin's spirit I have brought from Yarna, from Vivasvan's Son,
Brought it for life and not for death, yea, brought it for security.

verses.sa:
न्यग्वातोऽव वाति न्यक्तपति सूर्यः ।
नीचीनमघ्न्या दुहे न्यग्भवतु ते रपः ॥
verses.rom:
nyagvato'va vati nyaktapati suryah |
nichinamaghnya duhe nyagbhavatu te rapah ||
verses.en:
The wind blows downward from on high, downward the Sun-God sends his heat,
Downward the milch-cow pours her milk: so downward go thy pain and grief.

verses.sa:
अयं मे हस्तो भगवानयं मे भगवत्तरः ।
अयं मे विश्वभेषजोऽयं शिवाभिमर्शनः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam me hasto bhagavanayam me bhagavattarah |
ayam me vishvabheshajo'yam shivabhimarshanah ||
verses.en:
Felicitous is this mine hand, yet more felicitous is this.
This hand contains all healing balms, and this makes whole with gentle touch.

verses.sa:
इदमित्था रौद्रं गूर्तवचा ब्रह्म क्रत्वा शच्यामन्तराजौ ।
क्राणा यदस्य पितरा मंहनेष्ठाः पर्षत्पक्थे अहन्ना सप्त होतॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
idamittha raudram gurtavacha brahma kratva shachyamantarajau |
krana yadasya pitara mamhaneshthah parshatpakthe ahanna sapta hotrin ||

verses.sa:
स इद्दानाय दभ्याय वन्वञ्च्यवानः सूदैरमिमीत वेदिम् ।
तूर्वयाणो गूर्तवचस्तमः क्षोदो न रेत इतऊति सिञ्चत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa iddanaya dabhyaya vanvanchyavanah sudairamimita vedim |
turvayano gurtavachastamah kshodo na reta itauti sinchat ||

verses.sa:
मनो न येषु हवनेषु तिग्मं विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता ।
आ यः शर्याभिस्तुविनृम्णो अस्याश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तौ ॥
verses.rom:
mano na yeshu havaneshu tigmam vipah shachya vanutho dravanta |
a yah sharyabhistuvinrimno asyashrinitadisham gabhastau ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णा यद्गोष्वरुणीषु सीदद्दिवो नपाताश्विना हुवे वाम् ।
वीतं मे यज्ञमा गतं मे अन्नं ववन्वांसा नेषमस्मृतध्रू ॥
verses.rom:
krishna yadgoshvarunishu sidaddivo napatashvina huve vam |
vitam me yajnama gatam me annam vavanvamsa neshamasmritadhru ||

verses.sa:
प्रथिष्ट यस्य वीरकर्ममिष्णदनुष्ठितं नु नर्यो अपौहत् ।
पुनस्तदा वृहति यत्कनाया दुहितुरा अनुभृतमनर्वा ॥
verses.rom:
prathishta yasya virakarmamishnadanushthitam nu naryo apauhat |
punastada vrihati yatkanaya duhitura anubhritamanarva ||

verses.sa:
मध्या यत्कर्त्वमभवदभीके कामं कृण्वाने पितरि युवत्याम् ।
मनानग्रेतो जहतुर्वियन्ता सानौ निषिक्तं सुकृतस्य योनौ ॥
verses.rom:
madhya yatkartvamabhavadabhike kamam krinvane pitari yuvatyam |
mananagreto jahaturviyanta sanau nishiktam sukritasya yonau ||

verses.sa:
पिता यत्स्वां दुहितरमधिष्कन्क्ष्मया रेतः संजग्मानो नि षिञ्चत् ।
स्वाध्योऽजनयन्ब्रह्म देवा वास्तोष्पतिं व्रतपां निरतक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
pita yatsvam duhitaramadhishkankshmaya retah samjagmano ni shinchat |
svadhyo'janayanbrahma deva vastoshpatim vratapam niratakshan ||

verses.sa:
स ईं वृषा न फेनमस्यदाजौ स्मदा परैदप दभ्रचेताः ।
सरत्पदा न दक्षिणा परावृङ्न ता नु मे पृशन्यो जगृभ्रे ॥
verses.rom:
sa im vrisha na phenamasyadajau smada paraidapa dabhrachetah |
saratpada na dakshina paravrinna ta nu me prishanyo jagribhre ||

verses.sa:
मक्षू न वह्निः प्रजाया उपब्दिरग्निं न नग्न उप सीददूधः ।
सनितेध्मं सनितोत वाजं स धर्ता जज्ञे सहसा यवीयुत् ॥
verses.rom:
makshu na vahnih prajaya upabdiragnim na nagna upa sidadudhah |
sanitedhmam sanitota vajam sa dharta jajne sahasa yaviyut ||

verses.sa:
मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवग्वा ऋतं वदन्त ऋतयुक्तिमग्मन् ।
द्विबर्हसो य उप गोपमागुरदक्षिणासो अच्युता दुदुक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
makshu kanayah sakhyam navagva ritam vadanta ritayuktimagman |
dvibarhaso ya upa gopamaguradakshinaso achyuta dudukshan ||

verses.sa:
मक्षू कनायाः सख्यं नवीयो राधो न रेत ऋतमित्तुरण्यन् ।
शुचि यत्ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः ॥
verses.rom:
makshu kanayah sakhyam naviyo radho na reta ritamitturanyan |
shuchi yatte rekna ayajanta sabardughayah paya usriyayah ||

verses.sa:
पश्वा यत्पश्चा वियुता बुधन्तेति ब्रवीति वक्तरी रराणः ।
वसोर्वसुत्वा कारवोऽनेहा विश्वं विवेष्टि द्रविणमुप क्षु ॥
verses.rom:
pashva yatpashcha viyuta budhanteti braviti vaktari raranah |
vasorvasutva karavo'neha vishvam viveshti dravinamupa kshu ||

verses.sa:
तदिन्न्वस्य परिषद्वानो अग्मन्पुरू सदन्तो नार्षदं बिभित्सन् ।
वि शुष्णस्य संग्रथितमनर्वा विदत्पुरुप्रजातस्य गुहा यत् ॥
verses.rom:
tadinnvasya parishadvano agmanpuru sadanto narshadam bibhitsan |
vi shushnasya samgrathitamanarva vidatpuruprajatasya guha yat ||

verses.sa:
भर्गो ह नामोत यस्य देवाः स्वर्ण ये त्रिषधस्थे निषेदुः ।
अग्निर्ह नामोत जातवेदाः श्रुधी नो होतरृतस्य होताध्रुक् ॥
verses.rom:
bhargo ha namota yasya devah svarna ye trishadhasthe nisheduh |
agnirha namota jatavedah shrudhi no hotarritasya hotadhruk ||

verses.sa:
उत त्या मे रौद्रावर्चिमन्ता नासत्याविन्द्र गूर्तये यजध्यै ।
मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषे रराणा मन्दू हितप्रयसा विक्षु यज्यू ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya me raudravarchimanta nasatyavindra gurtaye yajadhyai |
manushvadvriktabarhishe rarana mandu hitaprayasa vikshu yajyu ||

verses.sa:
अयं स्तुतो राजा वन्दि वेधा अपश्च विप्रस्तरति स्वसेतुः ।
स कक्षीवन्तं रेजयत्सो अग्निं नेमिं न चक्रमर्वतो रघुद्रु ॥
verses.rom:
ayam stuto raja vandi vedha apashcha viprastarati svasetuh |
sa kakshivantam rejayatso agnim nemim na chakramarvato raghudru ||

verses.sa:
स द्विबन्धुर्वैतरणो यष्टा सबर्धुं धेनुमस्वं दुहध्यै ।
सं यन्मित्रावरुणा वृञ्ज उक्थैर्ज्येष्ठेभिरर्यमणं वरूथैः ॥
verses.rom:
sa dvibandhurvaitarano yashta sabardhum dhenumasvam duhadhyai |
sam yanmitravaruna vrinja ukthairjyeshthebhiraryamanam varuthaih ||

verses.sa:
तद्बन्धुः सूरिर्दिवि ते धियंधा नाभानेदिष्ठो रपति प्र वेनन् ।
सा नो नाभिः परमास्य वा घाहं तत्पश्चा कतिथश्चिदास ॥
verses.rom:
tadbandhuh surirdivi te dhiyamdha nabhanedishtho rapati pra venan |
sa no nabhih paramasya va ghaham tatpashcha katithashchidasa ||

verses.sa:
इयं मे नाभिरिह मे सधस्थमिमे मे देवा अयमस्मि सर्वः ।
द्विजा अह प्रथमजा ऋतस्येदं धेनुरदुहज्जायमाना ॥
verses.rom:
iyam me nabhiriha me sadhasthamime me deva ayamasmi sarvah |
dvija aha prathamaja ritasyedam dhenuraduhajjayamana ||

verses.sa:
अधासु मन्द्रो अरतिर्विभावाव स्यति द्विवर्तनिर्वनेषाट् ।
ऊर्ध्वा यच्छ्रेणिर्न शिशुर्दन्मक्षू स्थिरं शेवृधं सूत माता ॥
verses.rom:
adhasu mandro aratirvibhavava syati dvivartanirvaneshat |
urdhva yachchhrenirna shishurdanmakshu sthiram shevridham suta mata ||

verses.sa:
अधा गाव उपमातिं कनाया अनु श्वान्तस्य कस्य चित्परेयुः ।
श्रुधि त्वं सुद्रविणो नस्त्वं याळाश्वघ्नस्य वावृधे सूनृताभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha gava upamatim kanaya anu shvantasya kasya chitpareyuh |
shrudhi tvam sudravino nastvam yalashvaghnasya vavridhe sunritabhih ||

verses.sa:
अध त्वमिन्द्र विद्ध्यस्मान्महो राये नृपते वज्रबाहुः ।
रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीननेहसस्ते हरिवो अभिष्टौ ॥
verses.rom:
adha tvamindra viddhyasmanmaho raye nripate vajrabahuh |
raksha cha no maghonah pahi surinanehasaste harivo abhishtau ||

verses.sa:
अध यद्राजाना गविष्टौ सरत्सरण्युः कारवे जरण्युः ।
विप्रः प्रेष्ठः स ह्येषां बभूव परा च वक्षदुत पर्षदेनान् ॥
verses.rom:
adha yadrajana gavishtau saratsaranyuh karave jaranyuh |
viprah preshthah sa hyesham babhuva para cha vakshaduta parshadenan ||

verses.sa:
अधा न्वस्य जेन्यस्य पुष्टौ वृथा रेभन्त ईमहे तदू नु ।
सरण्युरस्य सूनुरश्वो विप्रश्चासि श्रवसश्च सातौ ॥
verses.rom:
adha nvasya jenyasya pushtau vritha rebhanta imahe tadu nu |
saranyurasya sunurashvo viprashchasi shravasashcha satau ||

verses.sa:
युवोर्यदि सख्यायास्मे शर्धाय स्तोमं जुजुषे नमस्वान् ।
विश्वत्र यस्मिन्ना गिरः समीचीः पूर्वीव गातुर्दाशत्सूनृतायै ॥
verses.rom:
yuvoryadi sakhyayasme shardhaya stomam jujushe namasvan |
vishvatra yasminna girah samichih purviva gaturdashatsunritayai ||

verses.sa:
स गृणानो अद्भिर्देववानिति सुबन्धुर्नमसा सूक्तैः ।
वर्धदुक्थैर्वचोभिरा हि नूनं व्यध्वैति पयस उस्रियायाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa grinano adbhirdevavaniti subandhurnamasa suktaih |
vardhadukthairvachobhira hi nunam vyadhvaiti payasa usriyayah ||

verses.sa:
त ऊ षु णो महो यजत्रा भूत देवास ऊतये सजोषाः ।
ये वाजाँ अनयता वियन्तो ये स्था निचेतारो अमूराः ॥
verses.rom:
ta u shu no maho yajatra bhuta devasa utaye sajoshah |
ye vajan anayata viyanto ye stha nichetaro amurah ||

prose.en:
1. THE welcome speaker in the storm of battle uttered with might this prayer to win the Asvins,
When the most liberal God, for Paktha, rescued his parents, and assailed the seven Hotras.

2. Cyavana, purposing deceptive presents, with all ingredients, made the altar ready.
Most sweet-voiced Turvayana poured oblations like floods of widely fertilizing water.

3. To his oblations, swift as thought, ye hurried, and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered.
With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant.

4. I call on you the Sons of Dyaus, the Asvins, that a dark cow to my red kine be added.
Enjoy my sacrifice, come to my viands contented, not deceiving expectation. '
10. Uttering praise to suit the rite Navagvas came speedily to win the damsel's friendship.
They who approached the twice-strong stable's keeper, meedless would milk the rocks that naught had shaken.
11. Swift was new friendship with the maid they quickly accepted it as genuine seed and bounty.
Milk which the cow Sabardugha had yielded was the bright heritage which to thee they offered.
12. When afterwards they woke- and missed the cattle, the speaker thus in joyful mood addressed them:
Matchless are singers throulgh the Vasu's nature; he bringeth them all food and all possessions.
13. His followers then who dwelt in sundry places came and desired too slay the son of Nrsad.
Resistless foe, be found the hidden treasure of Susna multiplied in numerous offspring.
14. Thou, called Effulgence, in whose threefold dwelling, as in the light of heaven, the Gods are sitting,
Thou who art called Agni or Jatavedas, Priest, hear us, guileless Priest of holy worship.
15. And, Indra, bring, that I may laud and serve them, those Two resplendent glorious Nasatyas,
Blithe, bounteous, man-like, to the sacrificer, honoured among our men with offered viands.
16. This King is praised and honoured as Ordainer: himself the bridge, the Sage speeds o'er the waters.
He hath stirred up Kaksivan, stirred up Agni, as the steed's swift wheel drives the felly onward.
17. Vaitarana, doubly kinsman, sacrificer, shall milk the cow who ne'er hath calved, Sabardhu,
When I encompass Varuna and Mitra with lauds, and Aryaman in safest shelter.
18. Their kin, the Prince in heaven, thy nearest kinsman, turning his thought to thee thus speaks in kindness:
This is our highest bond: I am his offspring. How many others came ere I succeeded?
19. Here is my kinship, here the place I dwell in: these are my Gods; I in full strength am present.
Twice-born am I, the first-born Son of Order: the Cow milked this when first she had her being.
20. So mid these tribes he rests, the friendly envoy, borne on two paths, refulgent Lord of fuel.
When, like a line, the Babe springs up erectly, his Mother straight hath borne him strong to bless us.
21. Then went the milch-kine forth to please the damsel, and for the good of every man that liveth.
Hear us, O wealthy Lord; begin our worship. Thou hast grown mighty through Asvaghna's virtues.
22. And take thou notice of us also, Indra, for ample riches, King whose arm wields thunder!
Protect our wealthy nobles, guard our princes unmenaced near thee, Lord of Tawny Coursers.
23. When he goes forth, ye Pair of Kings, for booty, speeding to war and praise to please the singer,-
I was the dearest sage of those about him,-let him lead these away and bring them safely.
24. Now for this noble man's support and comfort, singing with easy voice we thus implore thee:
Impetuous be his son and fleet his courser: and may I be his priest to win him glory.
25. If, for our strength, the priest with adoration to win your friendship made the laud accepted,
That laud shall be a branching road to virtue for every one to whom the songs are suited.
26. Glorified thus, with holy hymns and homage:-Of noble race, with Waters, God-attended
May he enrich us for our prayers and praises: now can the cow be milked; the path is open.
27. Be to us, then, ye Gods who merit worship, be ye of one accord our strong protection,
Who went on various ways and brought us vigour, ye who are undeceivable explorers.

verses.sa:
ये यज्ञेन दक्षिणया समक्ता इन्द्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमानश ।
तेभ्यो भद्रमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye yajnena dakshinaya samakta indrasya sakhyamamritatvamanasha |
tebhyo bhadramangiraso vo astu prati gribhnita manavam sumedhasah ||
verses.en:
YE, who, adorned with guerdon through the sacrifice, have won you Indra's friendship and eternal life,
Even to you be happiness, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
य उदाजन्पितरो गोमयं वस्वृतेनाभिन्दन्परिवत्सरे वलम् ।
दीर्घायुत्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
ya udajanpitaro gomayam vasvritenabhindanparivatsare valam |
dirghayutvamangiraso vo astu prati gribhnita manavam sumedhasah ||
verses.en:
The Fathers, who drave forth the wealth in cattle, have in the year's courses cleft Vala by Eternal Law:
A lengthened life be yours, O ye Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
य ऋतेन सूर्यमारोहयन्दिव्यप्रथयन्पृथिवीं मातरं वि ।
सुप्रजास्त्वमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
ya ritena suryamarohayandivyaprathayanprithivim mataram vi |
suprajastvamangiraso vo astu prati gribhnita manavam sumedhasah ||
verses.en:
Ye raised the Sun to heaven by everlasting Law, and spread broad earth, the Mother, out on every side.
Fair wealth of progeny be yours, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
अयं नाभा वदति वल्गु वो गृहे देवपुत्रा ऋषयस्तच्छृणोतन ।
सुब्रह्मण्यमङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam nabha vadati valgu vo grihe devaputra rishayastachchhrinotana |
subrahmanyamangiraso vo astu prati gribhnita manavam sumedhasah ||
verses.en:
This kinsman in your dwelling place speaks pleasant words: give car to this, ye Rsis, children of the Gods.
High Brahman dignity be yours, Angirases. Welcome the son of Manu, ye who are most wise.

verses.sa:
विरूपास इदृषयस्त इद्गम्भीरवेपसः ।
ते अङ्गिरसः सूनवस्ते अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे ॥
verses.rom:
virupasa idrishayasta idgambhiravepasah |
te angirasah sunavaste agneh pari jajnire ||
verses.en:
Distinguished by their varied form, these Rsis have been deeply moved.
These are the sons of Angirases: from Agni have they sprung to life.

verses.sa:
ये अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे विरूपासो दिवस्परि ।
नवग्वो नु दशग्वो अङ्गिरस्तमो सचा देवेषु मंहते ॥
verses.rom:
ye agneh pari jajnire virupaso divaspari |
navagvo nu dashagvo angirastamo sacha deveshu mamhate ||
verses.en:
Distinguished by their varied form, they sprang from Agni, from the sky.
Navagva and Dasagva, noblest Angiras, he giveth bounty with the Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण युजा निः सृजन्त वाघतो व्रजं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
सहस्रं मे ददतो अष्टकर्ण्यः श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत ॥
verses.rom:
indrena yuja nih srijanta vaghato vrajam gomantamashvinam |
sahasram me dadato ashtakarnyah shravo deveshvakrata ||
verses.en:
With Indra for associate the priests have cleared the stable full of steeds and kine,
Giving to me a thousand with their eight marked cars, they gained renown among the Gods.

verses.sa:
प्र नूनं जायतामयं मनुस्तोक्मेव रोहतु ।
यः सहस्रं शताश्वं सद्यो दानाय मंहते ॥
verses.rom:
pra nunam jayatamayam manustokmeva rohatu |
yah sahasram shatashvam sadyo danaya mamhate ||
verses.en:
May this man's sons be multiplied; like springing corn may Manu grow,
Who gives at once in bounteous gift a thousand kine, a hundred steeds.

verses.sa:
न तमश्नोति कश्चन दिव इव सान्वारभम् ।
सावर्ण्यस्य दक्षिणा वि सिन्धुरिव पप्रथे ॥
verses.rom:
na tamashnoti kashchana diva iva sanvarabham |
savarnyasya dakshina vi sindhuriva paprathe ||
verses.en:
No one attains to him, as though a man would grasp the heights of heaven.
Savarnya's sacrificial meed hath broadened like an ample flood.

verses.sa:
उत दासा परिविषे स्मद्दिष्टी गोपरीणसा ।
यदुस्तुर्वश्च मामहे ॥
verses.rom:
uta dasa parivishe smaddishti goparinasa |
yadusturvashcha mamahe ||
verses.en:
Yadu and Turva, too, have given two Dasas, well-disposed, to serve,
Together with great store of kine.

verses.sa:
सहस्रदा ग्रामणीर्मा रिषन्मनुः सूर्येणास्य यतमानैतु दक्षिणा ।
सावर्णेर्देवाः प्र तिरन्त्वायुर्यस्मिन्नश्रान्ता असनाम वाजम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrada gramanirma rishanmanuh suryenasya yatamanaitu dakshina |
savarnerdevah pra tirantvayuryasminnashranta asanama vajam ||
verses.en:
Blest be the hamlet's chief, most liberal Manu, and may his bounty rival that of Surya.
May the God let Ssvarni's life be lengthened, with whom, unwearied, we have lived and prospered.

verses.sa:
परावतो ये दिधिषन्त आप्यं मनुप्रीतासो जनिमा विवस्वतः ।
ययातेर्ये नहुष्यस्य बर्हिषि देवा आसते ते अधि ब्रुवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
paravato ye didhishanta apyam manupritaso janima vivasvatah |
yayaterye nahushyasya barhishi deva asate te adhi bruvantu nah ||
verses.en:
MAY they who would assume kinship from far away, Vivasvan's generations, dearly loved of men,
Even the Gods who sit upon the sacred grass of Nahusa's son Yayati, bless and comfort us.

verses.sa:
विश्वा हि वो नमस्यानि वन्द्या नामानि देवा उत यज्ञियानि वः ।
ये स्थ जाता अदितेरद्भ्यस्परि ये पृथिव्यास्ते म इह श्रुता हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishva hi vo namasyani vandya namani deva uta yajniyani vah |
ye stha jata aditeradbhyaspari ye prithivyaste ma iha shruta havam ||
verses.en:
For worthy of obeisance, Gods, are all your names, worthy of adoration and of sacrifice.
Ye who were born from waters, and from Aditi, and from the earth, do ye here listen to my call.

verses.sa:
येभ्यो माता मधुमत्पिन्वते पयः पीयूषं द्यौरदितिरद्रिबर्हाः ।
उक्थशुष्मान्वृषभरान्स्वप्नसस्ताँ आदित्याँ अनु मदा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yebhyo mata madhumatpinvate payah piyusham dyauraditiradribarhah |
ukthashushmanvrishabharansvapnasastan adityan anu mada svastaye ||
verses.en:
I will rejoice in these Adityas for my weal, for whom the Mother pours forth water rich in balm,
And Dyaus the Infinite, firm as a rock, sweet milk,-Gods active, strong through lauds, whose might the Bull upholds.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षसो अनिमिषन्तो अर्हणा बृहद्देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः ।
ज्योतीरथा अहिमाया अनागसो दिवो वर्ष्माणं वसते स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
nrichakshaso animishanto arhana brihaddevaso amritatvamanashuh |
jyotiratha ahimaya anagaso divo varshmanam vasate svastaye ||
verses.en:
Looking on men, ne'er slumbering, they by their deserts attained as Gods to lofty immortality.
Borne on refulgent cars, sinless, with serpents' powers, they robe them, for our welfare, in the height of heaven.

verses.sa:
सम्राजो ये सुवृधो यज्ञमाययुरपरिह्वृता दधिरे दिवि क्षयम् ।
ताँ आ विवास नमसा सुवृक्तिभिर्महो आदित्याँ अदितिं स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
samrajo ye suvridho yajnamayayuraparihvrita dadhire divi kshayam |
tan a vivasa namasa suvriktibhirmaho adityan aditim svastaye ||
verses.en:
Great Kings who bless us, who have come to sacrifice, who, ne'er assailed, have set their mansion in the sky,
These I invite with adoration and with hymns, mighty Adityas, Aditi, for happiness.

verses.sa:
को व स्तोमं राधति यं जुजोषथ विश्वे देवासो मनुषो यति ष्ठन ।
को वोऽध्वरं तुविजाता अरं करद्यो नः पर्षदत्यंहः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
ko va stomam radhati yam jujoshatha vishve devaso manusho yati shthana |
ko vo'dhvaram tuvijata aram karadyo nah parshadatyamhah svastaye ||
verses.en:
Who offereth to you the laud that ye accept, O ye All-Gods of Manu, many as ye are?
Who, Mighty Ones, will prepare for you the sacrifice to bear us over trouble to felicity?

verses.sa:
येभ्यो होत्रां प्रथमामायेजे मनुः समिद्धाग्निर्मनसा सप्त होतृभिः ।
त आदित्या अभयं शर्म यच्छत सुगा नः कर्त सुपथा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yebhyo hotram prathamamayeje manuh samiddhagnirmanasa sapta hotribhih |
ta aditya abhayam sharma yachchhata suga nah karta supatha svastaye ||
verses.en:
Ye to whom Manu, by seven priests, with kindled fire, offered the first oblation with his heart and soul,
Vouchsafe us, ye Adityas, sheitcr free from fear, and make us good and easy paths to happiness.

verses.sa:
य ईशिरे भुवनस्य प्रचेतसो विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च मन्तवः ।
ते नः कृतादकृतादेनसस्पर्यद्या देवासः पिपृता स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
ya ishire bhuvanasya prachetaso vishvasya sthaturjagatashcha mantavah |
te nah kritadakritadenasasparyadya devasah piprita svastaye ||
verses.en:
Wise Deities, who have dominion o'er the world, ye thinkers over all that moves not and that moves,
Save us from uncommitted and committed sin, preserve us from all sin to-day for happiness.

verses.sa:
भरेष्विन्द्रं सुहवं हवामहेऽंहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनम् ।
अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
bhareshvindram suhavam havamahe'mhomucham sukritam daivyam janam |
agnim mitram varunam sataye bhagam dyavaprithivi marutah svastaye ||
verses.en:
In battles we invoke Indra still swift to hear, and all the holy Host of Heaven who banish grief,
Agni, Mitra, and Varuna that we may gain, Dyays, Bhaga, Maruts, Prthivi for happiness:

verses.sa:
सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम् ।
दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
sutramanam prithivim dyamanehasam susharmanamaditim supranitim |
daivim navam svaritramanagasamasravantima ruhema svastaye ||
verses.en:
Mightily-saving Earth, incomparable Heaven the good guide Aditi who gives secure defense
The well-oared heavenly Ship that lets no waters in, free from defect, will we ascend for happiness.

verses.sa:
विश्वे यजत्रा अधि वोचतोतये त्रायध्वं नो दुरेवाया अभिह्रुतः ।
सत्यया वो देवहूत्या हुवेम शृण्वतो देवा अवसे स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
vishve yajatra adhi vochatotaye trayadhvam no durevaya abhihrutah |
satyaya vo devahutya huvema shrinvato deva avase svastaye ||
verses.en:
Bless us, all Holy Ones, that we may have your help, guard and protect us from malignant injury.
With fruitful invocation may we call on you, Gods, who give ear to us for grace, for happiness.

verses.sa:
अपामीवामप विश्वामनाहुतिमपारातिं दुर्विदत्रामघायतः ।
आरे देवा द्वेषो अस्मद्युयोतनोरु णः शर्म यच्छता स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
apamivamapa vishvamanahutimaparatim durvidatramaghayatah |
are deva dvesho asmadyuyotanoru nah sharma yachchhata svastaye ||
verses.en:
Keep all disease afar and sordid sacrifice, keep off the wicked man's malicious enmity.
Keep far away from us all hatred, O ye Gods, and give us ample shelter for our happiness.

verses.sa:
अरिष्टः स मर्तो विश्व एधते प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि ।
यमादित्यासो नयथा सुनीतिभिरति विश्वानि दुरिता स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
arishtah sa marto vishva edhate pra prajabhirjayate dharmanaspari |
yamadityaso nayatha sunitibhirati vishvani durita svastaye ||
verses.en:
Untouched by any evil, every mortal thrives, and, following the Law, spreads in his progeny.
Whom ye with your good guidance, O Adityas, lead safely through all his pain and grief to happiness.

verses.sa:
यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं शूरसाता मरुतो हिते धने ।
प्रातर्यावाणं रथमिन्द्र सानसिमरिष्यन्तमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yam devaso'vatha vajasatau yam shurasata maruto hite dhane |
prataryavanam rathamindra sanasimarishyantama ruhema svastaye ||
verses.en:
That which ye guard and grace in battle, O ye Gods, ye Maruts, where the prize is wealth, where heroes win,
That conquering Car, O Indra, that sets forth at dawn, that never breaks, may we ascend for happiness.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति नः पथ्यासु धन्वसु स्वस्त्यप्सु वृजने स्वर्वति ।
स्वस्ति नः पुत्रकृथेषु योनिषु स्वस्ति राये मरुतो दधातन ॥
verses.rom:
svasti nah pathyasu dhanvasu svastyapsu vrijane svarvati |
svasti nah putrakritheshu yonishu svasti raye maruto dadhatana ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe us blessing in our paths and desert tracts, blessing in waters and in battle, for the light;
Blessing upon the wombs that bring male children forth, and blessing, O ye Maruts, for the gain of wealth.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तिरिद्धि प्रपथे श्रेष्ठा रेक्णस्वत्यभि या वाममेति ।
सा नो अमा सो अरणे नि पातु स्वावेशा भवतु देवगोपा ॥
verses.rom:
svastiriddhi prapathe shreshtha reknasvatyabhi ya vamameti |
sa no ama so arane ni patu svavesha bhavatu devagopa ||
verses.en:
The noblest Svasti with abundant riches, who comes to what is good by distant pathway,-
May she at home and far away preserve us, and dwell with us under the Gods' protection

verses.sa:
एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।
ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥
verses.rom:
eva plateh sunuravivridhadvo vishva aditya adite manishi |
ishanaso naro amartyenastavi jano divyo gayena ||
verses.en:
Thus hath the thoughtful sage, the son of Plati, praised you, O Aditi and all Adityas,
Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.

verses.sa:
कथा देवानां कतमस्य यामनि सुमन्तु नाम शृण्वतां मनामहे ।
को मृळाति कतमो नो मयस्करत्कतम ऊती अभ्या ववर्तति ॥
verses.rom:
katha devanam katamasya yamani sumantu nama shrinvatam manamahe |
ko mrilati katamo no mayaskaratkatama uti abhya vavartati ||
verses.en:
WHAT God, of those who hear, is he whose well-praised name we may record in this our sacrifice; and how?
Who will be gracious? Who of many give us bliss? Who out of all the Host will come to lend us aid?

verses.sa:
क्रतूयन्ति क्रतवो हृत्सु धीतयो वेनन्ति वेनाः पतयन्त्या दिशः ।
न मर्डिता विद्यते अन्य एभ्यो देवेषु मे अधि कामा अयंसत ॥
verses.rom:
kratuyanti kratavo hritsu dhitayo venanti venah patayantya dishah |
na mardita vidyate anya ebhyo deveshu me adhi kama ayamsata ||
verses.en:
The will and thoughts within my breast exert their power: they yearn with love, and fly to all the regions round.
None other comforter is found save only these: my longings and my hopes are fixt upon the Gods.

verses.sa:
नरा वा शंसं पूषणमगोह्यमग्निं देवेद्धमभ्यर्चसे गिरा ।
सूर्यामासा चन्द्रमसा यमं दिवि त्रितं वातमुषसमक्तुमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
nara va shamsam pushanamagohyamagnim deveddhamabhyarchase gira |
suryamasa chandramasa yamam divi tritam vatamushasamaktumashvina ||
verses.en:
To Narasamsa and to Pusan I sing forth, unconcealable Agni kindled by the Gods.
To Sun and Moon, two Moons, to Yama in the heaven, to Trita, Vata, Dawn, Night, and the Atvins Twain.

verses.sa:
कथा कविस्तुवीरवान्कया गिरा बृहस्पतिर्वावृधते सुवृक्तिभिः ।
अज एकपात्सुहवेभिरृक्वभिरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो हवीमनि ॥
verses.rom:
katha kavistuviravankaya gira brihaspatirvavridhate suvriktibhih |
aja ekapatsuhavebhirrikvabhirahih shrinotu budhnyo havimani ||
verses.en:
How is the Sage extolled whom the loud singers praise? What voice, what hymn is used to laud Brhaspati?
May Aja-Ekapad with Rkvans swift to hear, and Ahi of the Deep listen unto our call.

verses.sa:
दक्षस्य वादिते जन्मनि व्रते राजाना मित्रावरुणा विवाससि ।
अतूर्तपन्थाः पुरुरथो अर्यमा सप्तहोता विषुरूपेषु जन्मसु ॥
verses.rom:
dakshasya vadite janmani vrate rajana mitravaruna vivasasi |
aturtapanthah pururatho aryama saptahota vishurupeshu janmasu ||
verses.en:
Aditi, to the birth of Daksa and the vow thou summonest the Kings Mitra and Varuna.
With course unchecked, with many chariots Aryaman comes with the seven priests to tribes of varied sort.

verses.sa:
ते नो अर्वन्तो हवनश्रुतो हवं विश्वे शृण्वन्तु वाजिनो मितद्रवः ।
सहस्रसा मेधसाताविव त्मना महो ये धनं समिथेषु जभ्रिरे ॥
verses.rom:
te no arvanto havanashruto havam vishve shrinvantu vajino mitadravah |
sahasrasa medhasataviva tmana maho ye dhanam samitheshu jabhrire ||
verses.en:
May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeding on their way;
Winners of thousands where the priestly meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race.

verses.sa:
प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं पुरंधिं स्तोमैः कृणुध्वं सख्याय पूषणम् ।
ते हि देवस्य सवितुः सवीमनि क्रतुं सचन्ते सचितः सचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo vayum rathayujam puramdhim stomaih krinudhvam sakhyaya pushanam |
te hi devasya savituh savimani kratum sachante sachitah sachetasah ||
verses.en:
Bring ye Purandbi, bring Vayu who yokes his steeds, for friendship bring ye Pusan with your songs of praise:
They with one mind, one thought attend the sacrifice, urged by the favouring aid of Savitar the God.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त सस्रा नद्यो महीरपो वनस्पतीन्पर्वताँ अग्निमूतये ।
कृशानुमस्तॄन्तिष्यं सधस्थ आ रुद्रं रुद्रेषु रुद्रियं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
trih sapta sasra nadyo mahirapo vanaspatinparvatan agnimutaye |
krishanumastrintishyam sadhastha a rudram rudreshu rudriyam havamahe ||
verses.en:
The thrice-seven wandering Rivers, yea, the mighty floods, the forest trees, the mountains, Agni to our aid,
Krsanu, Tisya, archers to our gathering-place, and Rudra strong amid the Rudras we invoke.

verses.sa:
सरस्वती सरयुः सिन्धुरूर्मिभिर्महो महीरवसा यन्तु वक्षणीः ।
देवीरापो मातरः सूदयित्न्वो घृतवत्पयो मधुमन्नो अर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvati sarayuh sindhururmibhirmaho mahiravasa yantu vakshanih |
devirapo matarah sudayitnvo ghritavatpayo madhumanno archata ||
verses.en:
Let the great Streams come hither with their mighty help, Sindhu, Sarasvati, and Sarayu with waves.
Ye Goddess Floods, ye Mothers, animating all, promise us water rich in fatness and in balm.

verses.sa:
उत माता बृहद्दिवा शृणोतु नस्त्वष्टा देवेभिर्जनिभिः पिता वचः ।
ऋभुक्षा वाजो रथस्पतिर्भगो रण्वः शंसः शशमानस्य पातु नः ॥
verses.rom:
uta mata brihaddiva shrinotu nastvashta devebhirjanibhih pita vachah |
ribhuksha vajo rathaspatirbhago ranvah shamsah shashamanasya patu nah ||
verses.en:
And let Brhaddiva, the Mother, hear our call, and Tvastar, Father, with the Goddesses and Dames.
Rbhuksan, Vaja, Bhaga, and Rathaspati, and the sweet speech of him who labours guard us well!

verses.sa:
रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयो भद्रा रुद्राणां मरुतामुपस्तुतिः ।
गोभिः ष्याम यशसो जनेष्वा सदा देवास इळया सचेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
ranvah samdrishtau pituman iva kshayo bhadra rudranam marutamupastutih |
gobhih shyama yashaso janeshva sada devasa ilaya sachemahi ||
verses.en:
Pleasant to look on as a dwelling rich in food is the blest favour of the Maruts, Rudra's Sons.
May we be famed among the folk for wealth in kine. and ever come to you, ye Gods, with sacred food.

verses.sa:
यां मे धियं मरुत इन्द्र देवा अददात वरुण मित्र यूयम् ।
तां पीपयत पयसेव धेनुं कुविद्गिरो अधि रथे वहाथ ॥
verses.rom:
yam me dhiyam maruta indra deva adadata varuna mitra yuyam |
tam pipayata payaseva dhenum kuvidgiro adhi rathe vahatha ||
verses.en:
The thought which ye, O Maruts, Indra and ye Gods have given to me, and ye, Mitra and Varuna,-
Cause this to grow and swell like a milch cow with milk. Will ye not bear away my songs upon your car?

verses.sa:
कुविदङ्ग प्रति यथा चिदस्य नः सजात्यस्य मरुतो बुबोधथ ।
नाभा यत्र प्रथमं संनसामहे तत्र जामित्वमदितिर्दधातु नः ॥
verses.rom:
kuvidanga prati yatha chidasya nah sajatyasya maruto bubodhatha |
nabha yatra prathamam samnasamahe tatra jamitvamaditirdadhatu nah ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, do ye never, never recollect and call again to mind this our relationship?
When next we meet together at the central point, even there shall Aditi confirm our brotherhood.

verses.sa:
ते हि द्यावापृथिवी मातरा मही देवी देवाञ्जन्मना यज्ञिये इतः ।
उभे बिभृत उभयं भरीमभिः पुरू रेतांसि पितृभिश्च सिञ्चतः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi dyavaprithivi matara mahi devi devanjanmana yajniye itah |
ubhe bibhrita ubhayam bharimabhih puru retamsi pitribhishcha sinchatah ||
verses.en:
The Mothers, Heaven and Earth, those mighty Goddesses, worthy of sacrifice, ecune with the race of Gods.
These Two with their support uphold both Gods and men, and with the Fathers pour the copious genial stream.

verses.sa:
वि षा होत्रा विश्वमश्नोति वार्यं बृहस्पतिररमतिः पनीयसी ।
ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदवीवशन्त मतिभिर्मनीषिणः ॥
verses.rom:
vi sha hotra vishvamashnoti varyam brihaspatiraramatih paniyasi |
grava yatra madhushuduchyate brihadavivashanta matibhirmanishinah ||
verses.en:
This invocation wins all good that we desire Brhaspati, highly-praised Aramati, are here,
Even where the stone that presses meath rings loudly out, and where the sages make their voices heard with hymns.

verses.sa:
एवा कविस्तुवीरवाँ ऋतज्ञा द्रविणस्युर्द्रविणसश्चकानः ।
उक्थेभिरत्र मतिभिश्च विप्रोऽपीपयद्गयो दिव्यानि जन्म ॥
verses.rom:
eva kavistuviravan ritajna dravinasyurdravinasashchakanah |
ukthebhiratra matibhishcha vipro'pipayadgayo divyani janma ||
verses.en:
Thus hath the sage, skilled in loud singers' duties, desiring riches, yearning after treasure,
Gaya, the priestly singer, with his praises and hymns contented the Celestial people.

verses.sa:
एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।
ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥
verses.rom:
eva plateh sunuravivridhadvo vishva aditya adite manishi |
ishanaso naro amartyenastavi jano divyo gayena ||
verses.en:
Thus hath the thoughtful sage the son of Plati, praised you, O Aaiti and all Adityas.
Men are made rich by those who are Immortal: the Heavenly Folk have been extolled by Gaya.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा वायुः पूषा सरस्वती सजोषसः ।
आदित्या विष्णुर्मरुतः स्वर्बृहत्सोमो रुद्रो अदितिर्ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirindro varuno mitro aryama vayuh pusha sarasvati sajoshasah |
aditya vishnurmarutah svarbrihatsomo rudro aditirbrahmanaspatih ||
verses.en:
MAY Agni, Indra, Mitra, Varuna consent, Aryaman, Vayu, Pusan, and Sarasvati,
Adityas, Maruts, Visnu, Soma, lofty Sky, Rudra and Aditi, and Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पती मिथो हिन्वाना तन्वा समोकसा ।
अन्तरिक्षं मह्या पप्रुरोजसा सोमो घृतश्रीर्महिमानमीरयन् ॥
verses.rom:
indragni vritrahatyeshu satpati mitho hinvana tanva samokasa |
antariksham mahya paprurojasa somo ghritashrirmahimanamirayan ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, Hero-lords when Vrtra fell, dwelling together, speeding emulously on,
And Soma blent with oil, putting his greatness forth, have with their power filled full the mighty firmament.

verses.sa:
तेषां हि मह्ना महतामनर्वणां स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यृतज्ञा ऋतावृधाम् ।
ये अप्सवमर्णवं चित्रराधसस्ते नो रासन्तां महये सुमित्र्याः ॥
verses.rom:
tesham hi mahna mahatamanarvanam stoman iyarmyritajna ritavridham |
ye apsavamarnavam chitraradhasaste no rasantam mahaye sumitryah ||
verses.en:
Skilled in the Law I lift the hymn of praise to these, Law-strengtheners, unassailed, and great in majesty.
These in their wondrous bounty send the watery sea: may they as kindly Friends send gifts to make us great.

verses.sa:
स्वर्णरमन्तरिक्षाणि रोचना द्यावाभूमी पृथिवीं स्कम्भुरोजसा ।
पृक्षा इव महयन्तः सुरातयो देवा स्तवन्ते मनुषाय सूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
svarnaramantarikshani rochana dyavabhumi prithivim skambhurojasa |
priksha iva mahayantah suratayo deva stavante manushaya surayah ||
verses.en:
They with their might have stayed Heaven, Earth, and Prthivi, the Lord of Light, the firmament, -the lustrous spheres.
Even as fleet-foot steeds who make their masters glad, the princely Gods are praised, most bountiful to man.

verses.sa:
मित्राय शिक्ष वरुणाय दाशुषे या सम्राजा मनसा न प्रयुच्छतः ।
ययोर्धाम धर्मणा रोचते बृहद्ययोरुभे रोदसी नाधसी वृतौ ॥
verses.rom:
mitraya shiksha varunaya dashushe ya samraja manasa na prayuchchhatah |
yayordhama dharmana rochate brihadyayorubhe rodasi nadhasi vritau ||
verses.en:
Bring gifts to Mitra and to Varuna who, Lords of all, in spirit never fail the worshipper,
Whose statute shines on high through everlasting Law, whose places of sure refuge are the heavens and earth.

verses.sa:
या गौर्वर्तनिं पर्येति निष्कृतं पयो दुहाना व्रतनीरवारतः ।
सा प्रब्रुवाणा वरुणाय दाशुषे देवेभ्यो दाशद्धविषा विवस्वते ॥
verses.rom:
ya gaurvartanim paryeti nishkritam payo duhana vrataniravaratah |
sa prabruvana varunaya dashushe devebhyo dashaddhavisha vivasvate ||
verses.en:
The cow who yielding milk goes her appointed way hither to us as leader of holy rites,
Speaking aloud to Varuna and the worshipper, shall with oblation serve Vivasvan and the Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवक्षसो अग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृध ऋतस्य योनिं विमृशन्त आसते ।
द्यां स्कभित्व्यप आ चक्रुरोजसा यज्ञं जनित्वी तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥
verses.rom:
divakshaso agnijihva ritavridha ritasya yonim vimrishanta asate |
dyam skabhitvyapa a chakrurojasa yajnam janitvi tanvi ni mamrijuh ||
verses.en:
The Gods whose tongue is Agni dwell in heaven, and sit, aiders of Law, reflecting, in the seat of Law.
They propped up heaven and then brought waters with their might, got sacrifice and in a body made it fair.

verses.sa:
परिक्षिता पितरा पूर्वजावरी ऋतस्य योना क्षयतः समोकसा ।
द्यावापृथिवी वरुणाय सव्रते घृतवत्पयो महिषाय पिन्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
parikshita pitara purvajavari ritasya yona kshayatah samokasa |
dyavaprithivi varunaya savrate ghritavatpayo mahishaya pinvatah ||
verses.en:
Born in the oldest time, the Parents dwelling round are sharers of one mansion in the home of Law.
Bound by their common vow Dyaus, Prthivi stream forth the moisture rich in oil to Varuna the Steer.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यावाता वृषभा पुरीषिणेन्द्रवायू वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
देवाँ आदित्याँ अदितिं हवामहे ये पार्थिवासो दिव्यासो अप्सु ये ॥
verses.rom:
parjanyavata vrishabha purishinendravayu varuno mitro aryama |
devan adityan aditim havamahe ye parthivaso divyaso apsu ye ||
verses.en:
Parjanya, Vata, mighty, senders of the rain, Indra and Vayu, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
We call on Aditi, Adityas, and the Gods, those who are on the earth, in waters, and in heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टारं वायुमृभवो य ओहते दैव्या होतारा उषसं स्वस्तये ।
बृहस्पतिं वृत्रखादं सुमेधसमिन्द्रियं सोमं धनसा उ ईमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tvashtaram vayumribhavo ya ohate daivya hotara ushasam svastaye |
brihaspatim vritrakhadam sumedhasamindriyam somam dhanasa u imahe ||
verses.en:
Tvastar and Vayu, those who count as Rbhus, both celestial Hotar-priests, and Dawn for happiness,
Winners of wealth, we call, and wise Brhaspati, destroyer of our foes, and Soma Indra's Friend.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म गामश्वं जनयन्त ओषधीर्वनस्पतीन्पृथिवीं पर्वताँ अपः ।
सूर्यं दिवि रोहयन्तः सुदानव आर्या व्रता विसृजन्तो अधि क्षमि ॥
verses.rom:
brahma gamashvam janayanta oshadhirvanaspatinprithivim parvatan apah |
suryam divi rohayantah sudanava arya vrata visrijanto adhi kshami ||
verses.en:
They generated prayer, the cow, the horse, the plants, the forest trees, the earth, the waters, and the hills.
These very bounteous Gods made the Sun mount to heaven, and spread the righteous laws of Aryas o'er the land.

verses.sa:
भुज्युमंहसः पिपृथो निरश्विना श्यावं पुत्रं वध्रिमत्या अजिन्वतम् ।
कमद्युवं विमदायोहथुर्युवं विष्णाप्वं विश्वकायाव सृजथः ॥
verses.rom:
bhujyumamhasah pipritho nirashvina shyavam putram vadhrimatya ajinvatam |
kamadyuvam vimadayohathuryuvam vishnapvam vishvakayava srijathah ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, ye delivered Bhujyu from distress, ye animated Syava, Vadhrmati's son.
To Vimada ye brought his consort Kamadyu, and gave his lost Visnapu back to Visvaka.

verses.sa:
पावीरवी तन्यतुरेकपादजो दिवो धर्ता सिन्धुरापः समुद्रियः ।
विश्वे देवासः शृणवन्वचांसि मे सरस्वती सह धीभिः पुरंध्या ॥
verses.rom:
paviravi tanyaturekapadajo divo dharta sindhurapah samudriyah |
vishve devasah shrinavanvachamsi me sarasvati saha dhibhih puramdhya ||
verses.en:
Thunder, the lightning's daughter, Aja-Ekapad, heaven's bearer, Sindhu, and the waters of the sea:
Hear all the Gods my words, Sarasvati give ear together with Purandhi and with Holy Thoughts.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवाः सह धीभिः पुरंध्या मनोर्यजत्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
रातिषाचो अभिषाचः स्वर्विदः स्वर्गिरो ब्रह्म सूक्तं जुषेरत ॥
verses.rom:
vishve devah saha dhibhih puramdhya manoryajatra amrita ritajnah |
ratishacho abhishachah svarvidah svargiro brahma suktam jusherata ||
verses.en:
With Holy Thoughts and with Purandhi may all Gods, knowing the Law immortal, Manu's Holy Ones,
Boon-givers, favourers, finders of light, and Heaven, with gracious love accept my songs, my prayer, my hymn.

verses.sa:
देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।
ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
devanvasishtho amritanvavande ye vishva bhuvanabhi pratasthuh |
te no rasantamurugayamadya yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Immortal Gods have I, Vasistha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings.
May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
देवान्हुवे बृहच्छ्रवसः स्वस्तये ज्योतिष्कृतो अध्वरस्य प्रचेतसः ।
ये वावृधुः प्रतरं विश्ववेदस इन्द्रज्येष्ठासो अमृता ऋतावृधः ॥
verses.rom:
devanhuve brihachchhravasah svastaye jyotishkrito adhvarasya prachetasah |
ye vavridhuh prataram vishvavedasa indrajyeshthaso amrita ritavridhah ||
verses.en:
I CALL the Gods of lofty glory for our weal, the makers of the light, well-skilled in sacrifice;
Those who have waxen mightily, Masters of all wealth, Immortal, strengthening Law, the Gods whom Indra leads.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रप्रसूता वरुणप्रशिष्टा ये सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषो भागमानशुः ।
मरुद्गणे वृजने मन्म धीमहि माघोने यज्ञं जनयन्त सूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
indraprasuta varunaprashishta ye suryasya jyotisho bhagamanashuh |
marudgane vrijane manma dhimahi maghone yajnam janayanta surayah ||
verses.en:
For the strong band of Maruts will we frame a hymn: the chiefs shall bring forth sacrifice for Indra's troop,
Who, sent by Indra and advised by Varuna, have gotten for themselves a share of Surya's light

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वसुभिः परि पातु नो गयमादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।
रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्देवो मृळयाति नस्त्वष्टा नो ग्नाभिः सुविताय जिन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
indro vasubhih pari patu no gayamadityairno aditih sharma yachchhatu |
rudro rudrebhirdevo mrilayati nastvashta no gnabhih suvitaya jinvatu ||
verses.en:
May Indra with the Vasus keep our dwelling safe, and Aditi with Adityas lend us sure defence.
May the God Rudra with the Rudras favour us, and Tvastar with the Dames further us to success.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्द्यावापृथिवी ऋतं महदिन्द्राविष्णू मरुतः स्वर्बृहत् ।
देवाँ आदित्याँ अवसे हवामहे वसून्रुद्रान्सवितारं सुदंससम् ॥
verses.rom:
aditirdyavaprithivi ritam mahadindravishnu marutah svarbrihat |
devan adityan avase havamahe vasunrudransavitaram sudamsasam ||
verses.en:
Aditi, Heaven and Earth, the great eternal Law, Indra, Visnu, the Maruts, and the lofty Sky.
We call upon Adityas, on the Gods, for help, on Vasus, Rudras, Savitar of wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
सरस्वान्धीभिर्वरुणो धृतव्रतः पूषा विष्णुर्महिमा वायुरश्विना ।
ब्रह्मकृतो अमृता विश्ववेदसः शर्म नो यंसन्त्रिवरूथमंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sarasvandhibhirvaruno dhritavratah pusha vishnurmahima vayurashvina |
brahmakrito amrita vishvavedasah sharma no yamsantrivaruthamamhasah ||
verses.en:
With Holy Thoughts Sarasvan, firm-lawed Varuna, great Vayu, Pusan, Visnu, and the Asvins Twain,
Lords of all wealth, Immortal, furtherers of prayer, grant us a triply-guarding refuge from distress.

verses.sa:
वृषा यज्ञो वृषणः सन्तु यज्ञिया वृषणो देवा वृषणो हविष्कृतः ।
वृषणा द्यावापृथिवी ऋतावरी वृषा पर्जन्यो वृषणो वृषस्तुभः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha yajno vrishanah santu yajniya vrishano deva vrishano havishkritah |
vrishana dyavaprithivi ritavari vrisha parjanyo vrishano vrishastubhah ||
verses.en:
Strong be the sacrifice, strong be the Holy Ones, strong the preparers of oblation, strong the Gods.
Mighty be Heaven and Earth, true to eternal Law, strong be Parjanya, strong be they who laud the Strong.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा वृषणा वाजसातये पुरुप्रशस्ता वृषणा उप ब्रुवे ।
यावीजिरे वृषणो देवयज्यया ता नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसतः ॥
verses.rom:
agnishoma vrishana vajasataye puruprashasta vrishana upa bruve |
yavijire vrishano devayajyaya ta nah sharma trivarutham vi yamsatah ||
verses.en:
To win us strength I glorify the Mighty Twain, Agni and Soma, Mighty Ones whom many laud.
May these vouchsafe us shelter with a triple guard, these whom the strong have served in worship of the Gods.

verses.sa:
धृतव्रताः क्षत्रिया यज्ञनिष्कृतो बृहद्दिवा अध्वराणामभिश्रियः ।
अग्निहोतार ऋतसापो अद्रुहोऽपो असृजन्ननु वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
dhritavratah kshatriya yajnanishkrito brihaddiva adhvaranamabhishriyah |
agnihotara ritasapo adruho'po asrijannanu vritraturye ||
verses.en:
Potent, with firm-fixt laws, arranging sacrifice, visiting solemn rites in splendour of the day,
Obeying Order, these whose priest is Agni, free from falsehood, poured the waters out when Vrtra died.

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्नभि व्रताप ओषधीर्वनिनानि यज्ञिया ।
अन्तरिक्षं स्वरा पप्रुरूतये वशं देवासस्तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥
verses.rom:
dyavaprithivi janayannabhi vratapa oshadhirvaninani yajniya |
antariksham svara paprurutaye vasham devasastanvi ni mamrijuh ||
verses.en:
The Holy Ones engendered, for their several laws, the heavens and earth, the waters, and the plants and trees.
They filled the firmament with heavenly light for help: the Gods embodied Wish and made it beautiful.

verses.sa:
धर्तारो दिव ऋभवः सुहस्ता वातापर्जन्या महिषस्य तन्यतोः ।
आप ओषधीः प्र तिरन्तु नो गिरो भगो रातिर्वाजिनो यन्तु मे हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhartaro diva ribhavah suhasta vataparjanya mahishasya tanyatoh |
apa oshadhih pra tirantu no giro bhago ratirvajino yantu me havam ||
verses.en:
May they who bear up heaven, the Rbhus deft of hand, and Vata and Parjanya of the thundering Bull,
The waters and the plants, promote the songs we sing: come Bhaga, Rati, and the Vaijns to my call.

verses.sa:
समुद्रः सिन्धू रजो अन्तरिक्षमज एकपात्तनयित्नुरर्णवः ।
अहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणवद्वचांसि मे विश्वे देवास उत सूरयो मम ॥
verses.rom:
samudrah sindhu rajo antarikshamaja ekapattanayitnurarnavah |
ahirbudhnyah shrinavadvachamsi me vishve devasa uta surayo mama ||
verses.en:
Sindhu, the sea, the region, and the firmament, the thunder, and the ocean, Aja-Ekapad,
The Dragon of the Deep, shall listen to my words, and all the Deities and Princes shall give ear.

verses.sa:
स्याम वो मनवो देववीतये प्राञ्चं नो यज्ञं प्र णयत साधुया ।
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुदानव इमा ब्रह्म शस्यमानानि जिन्वत ॥
verses.rom:
syama vo manavo devavitaye prancham no yajnam pra nayata sadhuya |
aditya rudra vasavah sudanava ima brahma shasyamanani jinvata ||
verses.en:
May we, be yours, we men, to entertain the Gods: further our sacrifice and give it full success.
Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, givers of good gifts, quicken the holy hymns which we are singing now

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा पुरोहित ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेमि साधुया ।
क्षेत्रस्य पतिं प्रतिवेशमीमहे विश्वान्देवाँ अमृताँ अप्रयुच्छतः ॥
verses.rom:
daivya hotara prathama purohita ritasya panthamanvemi sadhuya |
kshetrasya patim prativeshamimahe vishvandevan amritan aprayuchchhatah ||
verses.en:
I follow with success upon the path of Law the two celestial Hotars, Priests of oldest time.
We pray to him who dwelleth near, Guard of the Field, to all Immortal Gods who never are remiss.

verses.sa:
वसिष्ठासः पितृवद्वाचमक्रत देवाँ ईळाना ऋषिवत्स्वस्तये ।
प्रीता इव ज्ञातयः काममेत्यास्मे देवासोऽव धूनुता वसु ॥
verses.rom:
vasishthasah pitrivadvachamakrata devan ilana rishivatsvastaye |
prita iva jnatayah kamametyasme devaso'va dhunuta vasu ||
verses.en:
Vasistha's sons have raised their voices, like their sire. Rsi-like praying to the Gods for happiness.
Like friendly-minded kinsmen, come at our desire, O Gods, and shake down treasures on us from above.

verses.sa:
देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।
ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
devanvasishtho amritanvavande ye vishva bhuvanabhi pratasthuh |
te no rasantamurugayamadya yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Immortal Gods have I, Vasistha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings.
May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
इमां धियं सप्तशीर्ष्णीं पिता न ऋतप्रजातां बृहतीमविन्दत् ।
तुरीयं स्विज्जनयद्विश्वजन्योऽयास्य उक्थमिन्द्राय शंसन् ॥
verses.rom:
imam dhiyam saptashirshnim pita na ritaprajatam brihatimavindat |
turiyam svijjanayadvishvajanyo'yasya ukthamindraya shamsan ||
verses.en:
THIS holy hymn, sublime and seven headed, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered.
Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra.

verses.sa:
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋजु दीध्याना दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः ।
विप्रं पदमङ्गिरसो दधाना यज्ञस्य धाम प्रथमं मनन्त ॥
verses.rom:
ritam shamsanta riju didhyana divasputraso asurasya virah |
vipram padamangiraso dadhana yajnasya dhama prathamam mananta ||
verses.en:
Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes,
Angirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute.

verses.sa:
हंसैरिव सखिभिर्वावदद्भिरश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन् ।
बृहस्पतिरभिकनिक्रदद्गा उत प्रास्तौदुच्च विद्वाँ अगायत् ॥
verses.rom:
hamsairiva sakhibhirvavadadbhirashmanmayani nahana vyasyan |
brihaspatirabhikanikradadga uta prastauduchcha vidvan agayat ||
verses.en:
Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stony barriers of the prison,
Brhaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them.

verses.sa:
अवो द्वाभ्यां पर एकया गा गुहा तिष्ठन्तीरनृतस्य सेतौ ।
बृहस्पतिस्तमसि ज्योतिरिच्छन्नुदुस्रा आकर्वि हि तिस्र आवः ॥
verses.rom:
avo dvabhyam para ekaya ga guha tishthantiranritasya setau |
brihaspatistamasi jyotirichchhannudusra akarvi hi tisra avah ||
verses.en:
Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood.
Brhaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent.

verses.sa:
विभिद्या पुरं शयथेमपाचीं निस्त्रीणि साकमुदधेरकृन्तत् ।
बृहस्पतिरुषसं सूर्यं गामर्कं विवेद स्तनयन्निव द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
vibhidya puram shayathemapachim nistrini sakamudadherakrintat |
brihaspatirushasam suryam gamarkam viveda stanayanniva dyauh ||
verses.en:
When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters.
Brhaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the Sun, the cow, the lightning.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वलं रक्षितारं दुघानां करेणेव वि चकर्ता रवेण ।
स्वेदाञ्जिभिराशिरमिच्छमानोऽरोदयत्पणिमा गा अमुष्णात् ॥
verses.rom:
indro valam rakshitaram dughanam kareneva vi chakarta ravena |
svedanjibhirashiramichchhamano'rodayatpanima ga amushnat ||
verses.en:
As with a hand, so with his roaring Indra cleft Vala through, the guardian of the cattle.
Seeking the milk-draught with sweat shining comrades he stole the Pani's kine and left him weeping.

verses.sa:
स ईं सत्येभिः सखिभिः शुचद्भिर्गोधायसं वि धनसैरदर्दः ।
ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्वृषभिर्वराहैर्घर्मस्वेदेभिर्द्रविणं व्यानट् ॥
verses.rom:
sa im satyebhih sakhibhih shuchadbhirgodhayasam vi dhanasairadardah |
brahmanaspatirvrishabhirvarahairgharmasvedebhirdravinam vyanat ||
verses.en:
He with bright faithful Friends, winners of booty, hath rent the milker of the cows asunder.
Brhaspati with wild boars strong and mighty, sweating with heat, hath gained a rich possession.

verses.sa:
ते सत्येन मनसा गोपतिं गा इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः ।
बृहस्पतिर्मिथोअवद्यपेभिरुदुस्रिया असृजत स्वयुग्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
te satyena manasa gopatim ga iyanasa ishanayanta dhibhih |
brihaspatirmithoavadyapebhirudusriya asrijata svayugbhih ||
verses.en:
They, longing for the kine, with faithful spirit incited with their hymns the Lord of cattle.
Brhaspati freed the radiant cows with comrades self-yoked, averting shame from one another.

verses.sa:
तं वर्धयन्तो मतिभिः शिवाभिः सिंहमिव नानदतं सधस्थे ।
बृहस्पतिं वृषणं शूरसातौ भरेभरे अनु मदेम जिष्णुम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam vardhayanto matibhih shivabhih simhamiva nanadatam sadhasthe |
brihaspatim vrishanam shurasatau bharebhare anu madema jishnum ||
verses.en:
In our assembly with auspicious praises exalting him who roareth like a lion,
Maywe, in every fight where heroes conquer, rejoice in strong Brhaspati the Victor.

verses.sa:
यदा वाजमसनद्विश्वरूपमा द्यामरुक्षदुत्तराणि सद्म ।
बृहस्पतिं वृषणं वर्धयन्तो नाना सन्तो बिभ्रतो ज्योतिरासा ॥
verses.rom:
yada vajamasanadvishvarupama dyamarukshaduttarani sadma |
brihaspatim vrishanam vardhayanto nana santo bibhrato jyotirasa ||
verses.en:
When he had won him every sort of booty and gone to heaven and its most lofty mansions,
Men praised Brhaspati the Mighty, bringing the light within their mouths from sundry places.

verses.sa:
सत्यामाशिषं कृणुता वयोधै कीरिं चिद्ध्यवथ स्वेभिरेवैः ।
पश्चा मृधो अप भवन्तु विश्वास्तद्रोदसी शृणुतं विश्वमिन्वे ॥
verses.rom:
satyamashisham krinuta vayodhai kirim chiddhyavatha svebhirevaih |
pashcha mridho apa bhavantu vishvastadrodasi shrinutam vishvaminve ||
verses.en:
Fulfil the prayer that begs for vital vigour: aid in your wonted manner even the humble.
Let all our foes be turned and driven backward. Hear this, O Heaven and Earth, ye All-producers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य वि मूर्धानमभिनदर्बुदस्य ।
अहन्नहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धून्देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः ॥
verses.rom:
indro mahna mahato arnavasya vi murdhanamabhinadarbudasya |
ahannahimarinatsapta sindhundevairdyavaprithivi pravatam nah ||
verses.en:
Indra with mighty strength cleft asunder the head of Arbuda the watery monster,
Slain Ahi, and set free the Seven Rivers. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect us.

verses.sa:
उदप्रुतो न वयो रक्षमाणा वावदतो अभ्रियस्येव घोषाः ।
गिरिभ्रजो नोर्मयो मदन्तो बृहस्पतिमभ्यर्का अनावन् ॥
verses.rom:
udapruto na vayo rakshamana vavadato abhriyasyeva ghoshah |
giribhrajo normayo madanto brihaspatimabhyarka anavan ||
verses.en:
LIKE birds who keep their watch, plashing in water, like the loud voices of the thundering rain-cloud,
Like merry streamlets bursting from the mountain, thus to Brhaspati our hymns have sounded.

verses.sa:
सं गोभिराङ्गिरसो नक्षमाणो भग इवेदर्यमणं निनाय ।
जने मित्रो न दम्पती अनक्ति बृहस्पते वाजयाशूँरिवाजौ ॥
verses.rom:
sam gobhirangiraso nakshamano bhaga ivedaryamanam ninaya |
jane mitro na dampati anakti brihaspate vajayashunrivajau ||
verses.en:
The Son of Angirases, meeting the cattle, as Bhaga, brought in Aryaman among us.
As Friend of men he decks the wife and husband: as for the race, Brhaspati, nerve our coursers.

verses.sa:
साध्वर्या अतिथिनीरिषिरा स्पार्हाः सुवर्णा अनवद्यरूपाः ।
बृहस्पतिः पर्वतेभ्यो वितूर्या निर्गा ऊपे यवमिव स्थिविभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sadhvarya atithinirishira sparhah suvarna anavadyarupah |
brihaspatih parvatebhyo viturya nirga upe yavamiva sthivibhyah ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati, having won them from the mountains, strewed down, like barley out of winnowing- baskets,
The vigorous, wandering cows who aid the pious, desired of all, of blameless form, well-coloured.

verses.sa:
आप्रुषायन्मधुन ऋतस्य योनिमवक्षिपन्नर्क उल्कामिव द्योः ।
बृहस्पतिरुद्धरन्नश्मनो गा भूम्या उद्नेव वि त्वचं बिभेद ॥
verses.rom:
aprushayanmadhuna ritasya yonimavakshipannarka ulkamiva dyoh |
brihaspatiruddharannashmano ga bhumya udneva vi tvacham bibheda ||
verses.en:
As the Sun dews with meath the seat of Order, and casts a flaming meteor down from heaven.
So from the rock Brhaspati forced the cattle, and cleft the earth's skin as it were with water.

verses.sa:
अप ज्योतिषा तमो अन्तरिक्षादुद्नः शीपालमिव वात आजत् ।
बृहस्पतिरनुमृश्या वलस्याभ्रमिव वात आ चक्र आ गाः ॥
verses.rom:
apa jyotisha tamo antarikshadudnah shipalamiva vata ajat |
brihaspatiranumrishya valasyabhramiva vata a chakra a gah ||
verses.en:
Forth from mid air with light he drave the darkness, as the gale blows a lily from the fiver.
Like the wind grasping at the cloud of Vala, Brhaspati gathered to himself the cattle,

verses.sa:
यदा वलस्य पीयतो जसुं भेद्बृहस्पतिरग्नितपोभिरर्कैः ।
दद्भिर्न जिह्वा परिविष्टमाददाविर्निधीँरकृणोदुस्रियाणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yada valasya piyato jasum bhedbrihaspatiragnitapobhirarkaih |
dadbhirna jihva parivishtamadadavirnidhinrakrinodusriyanam ||
