verses.en:
Brhaspati, when he with fiery lightnings cleft through the weapon of reviling Vala,
Consumed.him as tongues cat what teeth have compassed: he threw the prisons of the red cows open.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिरमत हि त्यदासां नाम स्वरीणां सदने गुहा यत् ।
आण्डेव भित्त्वा शकुनस्य गर्भमुदुस्रियाः पर्वतस्य त्मनाजत् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatiramata hi tyadasam nama svarinam sadane guha yat |
andeva bhittva shakunasya garbhamudusriyah parvatasya tmanajat ||
verses.en:
That secret name borne by the lowing cattle within the cave Brhaspati discovered,
And drave, himself, the bright kine from the mountain, like a bird's young after the egg's disclosure.

verses.sa:
अश्नापिनद्धं मधु पर्यपश्यन्मत्स्यं न दीन उदनि क्षियन्तम् ।
निष्टज्जभार चमसं न वृक्षाद्बृहस्पतिर्विरवेणा विकृत्य ॥
verses.rom:
ashnapinaddham madhu paryapashyanmatsyam na dina udani kshiyantam |
nishtajjabhara chamasam na vrikshadbrihaspatirviravena vikritya ||
verses.en:
He looked around on rock-imprisoned sweetness as one who eyes a fish in scanty water.
Brhaspati, cleaving through with varied clamour, brought it forth like a bowl from out the timber.

verses.sa:
सोषामविन्दत्स स्वः सो अग्निं सो अर्केण वि बबाधे तमांसि ।
बृहस्पतिर्गोवपुषो वलस्य निर्मज्जानं न पर्वणो जभार ॥
verses.rom:
soshamavindatsa svah so agnim so arkena vi babadhe tamamsi |
brihaspatirgovapusho valasya nirmajjanam na parvano jabhara ||
verses.en:
He found the light of heaven, and fire, and Morning: with lucid rays he forced apart the darkness.
As from a joint, Brhaspati took the marrow of Vala as he gloried in his cattle.

verses.sa:
हिमेव पर्णा मुषिता वनानि बृहस्पतिनाकृपयद्वलो गाः ।
अनानुकृत्यमपुनश्चकार यात्सूर्यामासा मिथ उच्चरातः ॥
verses.rom:
himeva parna mushita vanani brihaspatinakripayadvalo gah |
ananukrityamapunashchakara yatsuryamasa mitha uchcharatah ||
verses.en:
As trees for foliage robbed by winter, Vala mourned for the cows Brhaspati had taken.
He did a deed ne'er done, ne'er to be equalled, whereby the Sun and Moon ascend alternate.

verses.sa:
अभि श्यावं न कृशनेभिरश्वं नक्षत्रेभिः पितरो द्यामपिंशन् ।
रात्र्यां तमो अदधुर्ज्योतिरहन्बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद्गाः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shyavam na krishanebhirashvam nakshatrebhih pitaro dyamapimshan |
ratryam tamo adadhurjyotirahanbrihaspatirbhinadadrim vidadgah ||
verses.en:
Like a dark steed adorned with pearl, the Fathers have decorated heaven With constellations.
They set the light in day, in night the darkness. Brhaspati cleft the rock and found the cattle.

verses.sa:
इदमकर्म नमो अभ्रियाय यः पूर्वीरन्वानोनवीति ।
बृहस्पतिः स हि गोभिः सो अश्वैः स वीरेभिः स नृभिर्नो वयो धात् ॥
verses.rom:
idamakarma namo abhriyaya yah purviranvanonaviti |
brihaspatih sa hi gobhih so ashvaih sa virebhih sa nribhirno vayo dhat ||
verses.en:
This homage have we offered to the Cloud God who thunders out to many in succession.
May this Brhaspati vouchsafe us fulness of life with kine and horses, men, and heroes.

verses.sa:
भद्रा अग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य संदृशो वामी प्रणीतिः सुरणा उपेतयः ।
यदीं सुमित्रा विशो अग्र इन्धते घृतेनाहुतो जरते दविद्युतत् ॥
verses.rom:
bhadra agnervadhryashvasya samdrisho vami pranitih surana upetayah |
yadim sumitra visho agra indhate ghritenahuto jarate davidyutat ||
verses.en:
Auspicious is the aspect of Vadhryasva's fire good is its guidance, pleasant are its visitings.
When first the people Of Sumitra kindle it, with butter poured thereon it crackles and shines bright.

verses.sa:
घृतमग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वर्धनं घृतमन्नं घृतम्वस्य मेदनम् ।
घृतेनाहुत उर्विया वि पप्रथे सूर्य इव रोचते सर्पिरासुतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritamagnervadhryashvasya vardhanam ghritamannam ghritamvasya medanam |
ghritenahuta urviya vi paprathe surya iva rochate sarpirasutih ||
verses.en:
Butter is that which makes Vadhryaiva's fire growstrong: the butter is its food, the butter makes it fat.
It spreads abroad when butter hath been offered it, and balmed with streams of butter shines forth like the Sun.

verses.sa:
यत्ते मनुर्यदनीकं सुमित्रः समीधे अग्ने तदिदं नवीयः ।
स रेवच्छोच स गिरो जुषस्व स वाजं दर्षि स इह श्रवो धाः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte manuryadanikam sumitrah samidhe agne tadidam naviyah |
sa revachchhocha sa giro jushasva sa vajam darshi sa iha shravo dhah ||
verses.en:
Still newest is this face of thine, O Agni, which Manu and Sumitra have enkindled.
So richly shine, accept our songs with favour, so give us strengthening food, so send us glory.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा पूर्वमीळितो वध्र्यश्वः समीधे अग्ने स इदं जुषस्व ।
स न स्तिपा उत भवा तनूपा दात्रं रक्षस्व यदिदं ते अस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva purvamilito vadhryashvah samidhe agne sa idam jushasva |
sa na stipa uta bhava tanupa datram rakshasva yadidam te asme ||
verses.en:
Accept this offering, Agni, whom aforetime Vadhryasva, hath entreated and enkindled.
Guard well our homes and ople, guard our bodies, protect thy girt to us which thou hast granted.

verses.sa:
भवा द्युम्नी वाध्र्यश्वोत गोपा मा त्वा तारीदभिमातिर्जनानाम् ।
शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनः सुमित्रः प्र नु वोचं वाध्र्यश्वस्य नाम ॥
verses.rom:
bhava dyumni vadhryashvota gopa ma tva taridabhimatirjananam |
shura iva dhrishnushchyavanah sumitrah pra nu vocham vadhryashvasya nama ||
verses.en:
Be splendid, guard us Kinsman of Vadhryasva: let not the enmity of men o'ercome thee,
Like the bold hero Cyavana, I Sumitra tell forth the title of Vadhryaiva's Kinsman.

verses.sa:
समज्र्या पर्वत्या वसूनि दासा वृत्राण्यार्या जिगेथ ।
शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनो जनानां त्वमग्ने पृतनायूँरभि ष्याः ॥
verses.rom:
samajrya parvatya vasuni dasa vritranyarya jigetha |
shura iva dhrishnushchyavano jananam tvamagne pritanayunrabhi shyah ||
verses.en:
All treasures hast thou won, of plains and mountains, and quelled the Dasas' and Aryas' hatred.
Like the bold hero Cyavana, O Agni, mayst thou subdue the men who long for battle.

verses.sa:
दीर्घतन्तुर्बृहदुक्षायमग्निः सहस्रस्तरीः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा ।
द्युमान्द्युमत्सु नृभिर्मृज्यमानः सुमित्रेषु दीदयो देवयत्सु ॥
verses.rom:
dirghatanturbrihadukshayamagnih sahasrastarih shatanitha ribhva |
dyumandyumatsu nribhirmrijyamanah sumitreshu didayo devayatsu ||
verses.en:
Deft Agni hath a lengthened thread, tall oxen, a thousand heifers, numberless devices.
Decked by the men, splendid among the splendid, shine brightly forth amid devout Sumitras.

verses.sa:
त्वे धेनुः सुदुघा जातवेदोऽसश्चतेव समना सबर्धुक् ।
त्वं नृभिर्दक्षिणावद्भिरग्ने सुमित्रेभिरिध्यसे देवयद्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
tve dhenuh sudugha jatavedo'sashchateva samana sabardhuk |
tvam nribhirdakshinavadbhiragne sumitrebhiridhyase devayadbhih ||
verses.en:
Thine is the teeming cow, O Jatavedas, who pours at once her ceaseless flow, Sabardhuk,
Thou. art lit up by men enriched with guerdon, O Agni, by the pious-souled Sumitras.

verses.sa:
देवाश्चित्ते अमृता जातवेदो महिमानं वाध्र्यश्व प्र वोचन् ।
यत्सम्पृच्छं मानुषीर्विश आयन्त्वं नृभिरजयस्त्वावृधेभिः ॥
verses.rom:
devashchitte amrita jatavedo mahimanam vadhryashva pra vochan |
yatsamprichchham manushirvisha ayantvam nribhirajayastvavridhebhih ||
verses.en:
Even Immortal Gods, O Jatavedas, Vadhryasva's Kinsman, have declared thy grandeur.
When human tribes drew near with supplication thou conqueredst with men whom thou hadst strengthened.

verses.sa:
पितेव पुत्रमबिभरुपस्थे त्वामग्ने वध्र्यश्वः सपर्यन् ।
जुषाणो अस्य समिधं यविष्ठोत पूर्वाँ अवनोर्व्राधतश्चित् ॥
verses.rom:
piteva putramabibharupasthe tvamagne vadhryashvah saparyan |
jushano asya samidham yavishthota purvan avanorvradhatashchit ||
verses.en:
Like as a father bears his son, O Agni, Vadhryasva bare thee in his lap and served thee.
Thou, Youngest God, having enjoyed his fuel, didst vanquish those of old though they were mighty.

verses.sa:
शश्वदग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य शत्रून्नृभिर्जिगाय सुतसोमवद्भिः ।
समनं चिददहश्चित्रभानोऽव व्राधन्तमभिनद्वृधश्चित् ॥
verses.rom:
shashvadagnirvadhryashvasya shatrunnribhirjigaya sutasomavadbhih |
samanam chidadahashchitrabhano'va vradhantamabhinadvridhashchit ||
verses.en:
Vadhryasva's Agni evermore hath vanquished his foes with heroes who had pressed the Soma.
Lord of bright rays, thou burntest up the battle, subduing, as our help, e'en mighty foemen.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वृत्रहा सनकात्प्रेद्धो नमसोपवाक्यः ।
स नो अजामीँरुत वा विजामीनभि तिष्ठ शर्धतो वाध्र्यश्व ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagnirvadhryashvasya vritraha sanakatpreddho namasopavakyah |
sa no ajaminruta va vijaminabhi tishtha shardhato vadhryashva ||
verses.en:
This Agni of Vadhryasva, Vrtra-slayer, lit from of old, must be invoked with homage.
As such assail our enemies, Vadhryasva, whether the foes be strangers or be kinsmen.

verses.sa:
इमां मे अग्ने समिधं जुषस्वेळस्पदे प्रति हर्या घृताचीम् ।
वर्ष्मन्पृथिव्याः सुदिनत्वे अह्नामूर्ध्वो भव सुक्रतो देवयज्या ॥
verses.rom:
imam me agne samidham jushasvelaspade prati harya ghritachim |
varshmanprithivyah sudinatve ahnamurdhvo bhava sukrato devayajya ||
verses.en:
ENJOY, O Agni, this my Fuel, welcome the oil-filled ladle where we pour libation.
Rise up for worship of the Gods, wise Agni, on the earth's height, while days are bright with beauty.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामग्रयावेह यातु नराशंसो विश्वरूपेभिरश्वैः ।
ऋतस्य पथा नमसा मियेधो देवेभ्यो देवतमः सुषूदत् ॥
verses.rom:
a devanamagrayaveha yatu narashamso vishvarupebhirashvaih |
ritasya patha namasa miyedho devebhyo devatamah sushudat ||
verses.en:
May he who goes before the Gods come hither with steeds whose shapes are varied, Narasarhsa.
May he, most Godlike, speed our offered viands with homage God-ward on the path of Order.

verses.sa:
शश्वत्तममीळते दूत्याय हविष्मन्तो मनुष्यासो अग्निम् ।
वहिष्ठैरश्वैः सुवृता रथेना देवान्वक्षि नि षदेह होता ॥
verses.rom:
shashvattamamilate dutyaya havishmanto manushyaso agnim |
vahishthairashvaih suvrita rathena devanvakshi ni shadeha hota ||
verses.en:
Men with oblations laud most constant Agni, and pray him to perform an envoy's duty.
With lightly-rolling car and best draught-horses, bring the Gods hither and sit down as Hotar.

verses.sa:
वि प्रथतां देवजुष्टं तिरश्चा दीर्घं द्राघ्मा सुरभि भूत्वस्मे ।
अहेळता मनसा देव बर्हिरिन्द्रज्येष्ठाँ उशतो यक्षि देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
vi prathatam devajushtam tirashcha dirgham draghma surabhi bhutvasme |
ahelata manasa deva barhirindrajyeshthan ushato yakshi devan ||
verses.en:
May the delight of Gods spread out transversely: may it be with us long in length and fragrant.
O Holy Grass divine, with friendly spirit bring thou the willing Gods whose Chief is Indra.

verses.sa:
दिवो वा सानु स्पृशता वरीयः पृथिव्या वा मात्रया वि श्रयध्वम् ।
उशतीर्द्वारो महिना महद्भिर्देवं रथं रथयुर्धारयध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
divo va sanu sprishata variyah prithivya va matraya vi shrayadhvam |
ushatirdvaro mahina mahadbhirdevam ratham rathayurdharayadhvam ||
verses.en:
Touch ye the far-extending height of heaven or spring apart to suit the wide earth's measure.
Yearning, ye Doors, with those sublime in greatness, seize eagerly the heavenly Car that cometh.

verses.sa:
देवी दिवो दुहितरा सुशिल्पे उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
आ वां देवास उशती उशन्त उरौ सीदन्तु सुभगे उपस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
devi divo duhitara sushilpe ushasanakta sadatam ni yonau |
a vam devasa ushati ushanta urau sidantu subhage upasthe ||
verses.en:
Here in this shrine may Dawn and Night, the Daughters of Heaven, the skillful Goddesses, be seated.
In your wide lap, auspicious, willing Ladies may the Gods seat them with a willing spirit.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा बृहदग्निः समिद्धः प्रिया धामान्यदितेरुपस्थे ।
पुरोहितावृत्विजा यज्ञे अस्मिन्विदुष्टरा द्रविणमा यजेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo grava brihadagnih samiddhah priya dhamanyaditerupasthe |
purohitavritvija yajne asminvidushtara dravinama yajetham ||
verses.en:
Up stands the stone, high burns the fire enkindled: Aditi's lap contains the Friendly Natures
Ye Two Chief Priests who serve at this our worship, may ye, more skilled, win for us rich possessions.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरिदं वरीय आ सीदत चकृमा वः स्योनम् ।
मनुष्वद्यज्ञं सुधिता हवींषीळा देवी घृतपदी जुषन्त ॥
verses.rom:
tisro devirbarhiridam variya a sidata chakrima vah syonam |
manushvadyajnam sudhita havimshila devi ghritapadi jushanta ||
verses.en:
On our wide grass, Three Goddesses be seated: for you have we prepared and made it pleasant.
May Ila, she whose foot drops oil, the Goddess, taste, man-like, sacrifice and well-set presents.

verses.sa:
देव त्वष्टर्यद्ध चारुत्वमानड्यदङ्गिरसामभवः सचाभूः ।
स देवानां पाथ उप प्र विद्वाँ उशन्यक्षि द्रविणोदः सुरत्नः ॥
verses.rom:
deva tvashtaryaddha charutvamanadyadangirasamabhavah sachabhuh |
sa devanam patha upa pra vidvan ushanyakshi dravinodah suratnah ||
verses.en:
Since thou, God Tvastar, hast made beauty perfect, since thou hast been the Angirases' Companion,
Willing, most wealthy, Giver of possessions, grant us the Gods' assembly, thou who knowest.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते रशनया नियूया देवानां पाथ उप वक्षि विद्वान् ।
स्वदाति देवः कृणवद्धवींष्यवतां द्यावापृथिवी हवं मे ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate rashanaya niyuya devanam patha upa vakshi vidvan |
svadati devah krinavaddhavimshyavatam dyavaprithivi havam me ||
verses.en:
Well-knowing, binding with thy cord, bring hither, Lord of the Wood, the Deities' assembly.
The God prepare and season our oblations may Heaven and Earth be gracious to my calling.

verses.sa:
आग्ने वह वरुणमिष्टये न इन्द्रं दिवो मरुतो अन्तरिक्षात् ।
सीदन्तु बर्हिर्विश्व आ यजत्राः स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne vaha varunamishtaye na indram divo maruto antarikshat |
sidantu barhirvishva a yajatrah svaha deva amrita madayantam ||
verses.en:
Agni, bring hither Varuna to help us, Indra from heaven, from air's mid-realm the Maruts.
On sacred grass all Holy ones be seated and let the Immortal Gods rejoice in Svaha.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते प्रथमं वाचो अग्रं यत्प्रैरत नामधेयं दधानाः ।
यदेषां श्रेष्ठं यदरिप्रमासीत्प्रेणा तदेषां निहितं गुहाविः ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate prathamam vacho agram yatprairata namadheyam dadhanah |
yadesham shreshtham yadaripramasitprena tadesham nihitam guhavih ||
verses.en:
WHEN-men, Brhaspati, giving names to objects, sent out Vak's first and earliest utterances,
All that was excellent and spotless, treasured within them, was disclosed through their affection.

verses.sa:
सक्तुमिव तितउना पुनन्तो यत्र धीरा मनसा वाचमक्रत ।
अत्रा सखायः सख्यानि जानते भद्रैषां लक्ष्मीर्निहिताधि वाचि ॥
verses.rom:
saktumiva titauna punanto yatra dhira manasa vachamakrata |
atra sakhayah sakhyani janate bhadraisham lakshmirnihitadhi vachi ||
verses.en:
Where, like men cleansing corn-flour in a cribble, the wise in spirit have created language,
Friends see and recognize the marks of friendship: their speech retains the blessed sign imprinted.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन वाचः पदवीयमायन्तामन्वविन्दन्नृषिषु प्रविष्टाम् ।
तामाभृत्या व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा तां सप्त रेभा अभि सं नवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
yajnena vachah padaviyamayantamanvavindannrishishu pravishtam |
tamabhritya vyadadhuh purutra tam sapta rebha abhi sam navante ||
verses.en:
With sacrifice the trace of Vak they followed, and found her harbouring within the Rsis.
They brought her, dealt her forth in many places: seven singers make her tones resound in concert.

verses.sa:
उत त्वः पश्यन्न ददर्श वाचमुत त्वः शृण्वन्न शृणोत्येनाम् ।
उतो त्वस्मै तन्वं वि सस्रे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvah pashyanna dadarsha vachamuta tvah shrinvanna shrinotyenam |
uto tvasmai tanvam vi sasre jayeva patya ushati suvasah ||
verses.en:
One man hath ne'er seen Vak, and yet he seeth: one man hath hearing but hath never heard her.
But to another hath she shown her beauty as a fond well-dressed woman to her husband.

verses.sa:
उत त्वं सख्ये स्थिरपीतमाहुर्नैनं हिन्वन्त्यपि वाजिनेषु ।
अधेन्वा चरति माययैष वाचं शुश्रुवाँ अफलामपुष्पाम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvam sakhye sthirapitamahurnainam hinvantyapi vajineshu |
adhenva charati mayayaisha vacham shushruvan aphalamapushpam ||
verses.en:
One man they call a laggard, dull in friendship: they never urge him on to deeds of valour.
He wanders on in profitless illusion: the Voice he heard yields neither fruit, nor blossom.

verses.sa:
यस्तित्याज सचिविदं सखायं न तस्य वाच्यपि भागो अस्ति ।
यदीं शृणोत्यलकं शृणोति नहि प्रवेद सुकृतस्य पन्थाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yastityaja sachividam sakhayam na tasya vachyapi bhago asti |
yadim shrinotyalakam shrinoti nahi praveda sukritasya pantham ||
verses.en:
No part in Vak hath he who hath abandoned his own dear friend who knows the truth of friendship.
Even if he hears her still in vain he listens: naught knows he of the path of righteous action.

verses.sa:
अक्षण्वन्तः कर्णवन्तः सखायो मनोजवेष्वसमा बभूवुः ।
आदघ्नास उपकक्षास उ त्वे ह्रदा इव स्नात्वा उ त्वे ददृश्रे ॥
verses.rom:
akshanvantah karnavantah sakhayo manojaveshvasama babhuvuh |
adaghnasa upakakshasa u tve hrada iva snatva u tve dadrishre ||
verses.en:
Unequal in the quickness of their spirit are friends endowed alike with eyes and hearing.
Some look like tanks that reach the mouth or shoulder, others like pools of water fit to bathe in.

verses.sa:
हृदा तष्टेषु मनसो जवेषु यद्ब्राह्मणाः संयजन्ते सखायः ।
अत्राह त्वं वि जहुर्वेद्याभिरोहब्रह्माणो वि चरन्त्यु त्वे ॥
verses.rom:
hrida tashteshu manaso javeshu yadbrahmanah samyajante sakhayah |
atraha tvam vi jahurvedyabhirohabrahmano vi charantyu tve ||
verses.en:
When friendly Brahmans sacrifice together with mental impulse which the heart hath fashioned,
They leave one far behind through their attainments, and some who count as Brahmans wander elsewhere.

verses.sa:
इमे ये नार्वाङ्न परश्चरन्ति न ब्राह्मणासो न सुतेकरासः ।
त एते वाचमभिपद्य पापया सिरीस्तन्त्रं तन्वते अप्रजज्ञयः ॥
verses.rom:
ime ye narvanna parashcharanti na brahmanaso na sutekarasah |
ta ete vachamabhipadya papaya siristantram tanvate aprajajnayah ||
verses.en:
Those men who step not back and move not forward, nor Brahmans nor preparers of libations,
Having attained to Vak in sinful fashion spin out their thread in ignorance like spinsters.

verses.sa:
सर्वे नन्दन्ति यशसागतेन सभासाहेन सख्या सखायः ।
किल्बिषस्पृत्पितुषणिर्ह्येषामरं हितो भवति वाजिनाय ॥
verses.rom:
sarve nandanti yashasagatena sabhasahena sakhya sakhayah |
kilbishaspritpitushanirhyeshamaram hito bhavati vajinaya ||
verses.en:
All friends are joyful in the friend who cometh in triumph, having conquered in assembly.
He is their blame-averter, food-provider prepared is he and fit for deed of vigour.

verses.sa:
ऋचां त्वः पोषमास्ते पुपुष्वान्गायत्रं त्वो गायति शक्वरीषु ।
ब्रह्मा त्वो वदति जातविद्यां यज्ञस्य मात्रां वि मिमीत उ त्वः ॥
verses.rom:
richam tvah poshamaste pupushvangayatram tvo gayati shakvarishu |
brahma tvo vadati jatavidyam yajnasya matram vi mimita u tvah ||
verses.en:
One plies his constant task reciting verses. one sings the holy psalm in Sakvari measures.
One more, the Brahman, tells the lore of being, and one lays down the rules of sacrificing.

verses.sa:
देवानां नु वयं जाना प्र वोचाम विपन्यया ।
उक्थेषु शस्यमानेषु यः पश्यादुत्तरे युगे ॥
verses.rom:
devanam nu vayam jana pra vochama vipanyaya |
uktheshu shasyamaneshu yah pashyaduttare yuge ||
verses.en:
LET US with tuneful skill proclaim these generations of the Gods,
That one may see them when these hymns are chanted in a future age.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणस्पतिरेता सं कर्मार इवाधमत् ।
देवानां पूर्व्ये युगेऽसतः सदजायत ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanaspatireta sam karmara ivadhamat |
devanam purvye yuge'satah sadajayata ||
verses.en:
These Brahmanaspati produced with blast and smelting, like a Smith,
Existence, in an earlier age of Gods, from Non-existence sprang.

verses.sa:
देवानां युगे प्रथमेऽसतः सदजायत ।
तदाशा अन्वजायन्त तदुत्तानपदस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
devanam yuge prathame'satah sadajayata |
tadasha anvajayanta taduttanapadaspari ||
verses.en:
Existence, in the earliest age of Gods, from Non-existence sprang.
Thereafter were the regions born. This sprang from the Productive Power.

verses.sa:
भूर्जज्ञ उत्तानपदो भुव आशा अजायन्त ।
अदितेर्दक्षो अजायत दक्षाद्वदितिः परि ॥
verses.rom:
bhurjajna uttanapado bhuva asha ajayanta |
aditerdaksho ajayata dakshadvaditih pari ||
verses.en:
Earth sprang from the Productive Power the regions from the earth were born.
Daksa was born of Aditi, and Aditi was Daksa's Child.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्ह्यजनिष्ट दक्ष या दुहिता तव ।
तां देवा अन्वजायन्त भद्रा अमृतबन्धवः ॥
verses.rom:
aditirhyajanishta daksha ya duhita tava |
tam deva anvajayanta bhadra amritabandhavah ||
verses.en:
For Aditi, O Daksa, she who is thy Daughter, was brought forth.
After her were the blessed Gods born sharers of immortal life.

verses.sa:
यद्देवा अदः सलिले सुसंरब्धा अतिष्ठत ।
अत्रा वो नृत्यतामिव तीव्रो रेणुरपायत ॥
verses.rom:
yaddeva adah salile susamrabdha atishthata |
atra vo nrityatamiva tivro renurapayata ||
verses.en:
When ye, O Gods, in yonder deep close clasping one another stood,
Thence, as of dancers, from your feet a thickening cloud of dust arose.

verses.sa:
यद्देवा यतयो यथा भुवनान्यपिन्वत ।
अत्रा समुद्र आ गूळ्हमा सूर्यमजभर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
yaddeva yatayo yatha bhuvananyapinvata |
atra samudra a gulhama suryamajabhartana ||
verses.en:
When, O ye Gods, like Yatis, ye caused all existing things to grow,
Then ye brought Surya forward who was lying hidden in the sea.

verses.sa:
अष्टौ पुत्रासो अदितेर्ये जातास्तन्वस्परि ।
देवाँ उप प्रैत्सप्तभिः परा मार्ताण्डमास्यत् ॥
verses.rom:
ashtau putraso aditerye jatastanvaspari |
devan upa praitsaptabhih para martandamasyat ||
verses.en:
Eight are the Sons of Aditi who from her body sprang to life.
With seven she went to meet the Gods she cast Martanda far away.

verses.sa:
सप्तभिः पुत्रैरदितिरुप प्रैत्पूर्व्यं युगम् ।
प्रजायै मृत्यवे त्वत्पुनर्मार्ताण्डमाभरत् ॥
verses.rom:
saptabhih putrairaditirupa praitpurvyam yugam |
prajayai mrityave tvatpunarmartandamabharat ||
verses.en:
So with her Seven Sons Aditi went forth to meet the earlier age.
She brought Martanda thitherward to spring to life and die again.

verses.sa:
जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः ।
अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा ॥
verses.rom:
janishtha ugrah sahase turaya mandra ojishtho bahulabhimanah |
avardhannindram marutashchidatra mata yadviram dadhanaddhanishtha ||
verses.en:
THOU wast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage.
There, even there, the Maruts strengthened Indra when. his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.

verses.sa:
द्रुहो निषत्ता पृशनी चिदेवैः पुरू शंसेन वावृधुष्ट इन्द्रम् ।
अभीवृतेव ता महापदेन ध्वान्तात्प्रपित्वादुदरन्त गर्भाः ॥
verses.rom:
druho nishatta prishani chidevaih puru shamsena vavridhushta indram |
abhivriteva ta mahapadena dhvantatprapitvadudaranta garbhah ||
verses.en:
There with fiend's ways e'en Prsni was seated: with much laudation they exalted Indra.
As if encompassed by the Mighty-footed, from darkness, near at hand, forth came the Children.

verses.sa:
ऋष्वा ते पादा प्र यज्जिगास्यवर्धन्वाजा उत ये चिदत्र ।
त्वमिन्द्र सालावृकान्सहस्रमासन्दधिषे अश्विना ववृत्याः ॥
verses.rom:
rishva te pada pra yajjigasyavardhanvaja uta ye chidatra |
tvamindra salavrikansahasramasandadhishe ashvina vavrityah ||
verses.en:
High are thy feet when on thy way thou goest: the strength thou foundest here hath lent thee vigour.
Thousand hyenas in thy mouth thou holdest. O Indra, mayst thou turn the Asvins hither.

verses.sa:
समना तूर्णिरुप यासि यज्ञमा नासत्या सख्याय वक्षि ।
वसाव्यामिन्द्र धारयः सहस्राश्विना शूर ददतुर्मघानि ॥
verses.rom:
samana turnirupa yasi yajnama nasatya sakhyaya vakshi |
vasavyamindra dharayah sahasrashvina shura dadaturmaghani ||
verses.en:
Speeding at once to sacrifice thou comest for friendship thou art bringing both Nasatyas.
Thou hadst a thousand treasures in possession. The Asvins, O thou Hero, gave thee riches.

verses.sa:
मन्दमान ऋतादधि प्रजायै सखिभिरिन्द्र इषिरेभिरर्थम् ।
आभिर्हि माया उप दस्युमागान्मिहः प्र तम्रा अवपत्तमांसि ॥
verses.rom:
mandamana ritadadhi prajayai sakhibhirindra ishirebhirartham |
abhirhi maya upa dasyumaganmihah pra tamra avapattamamsi ||
verses.en:
Glad, for the race that rests on holy Order, with friends who hasten to their goal, hath Indra
With these his magic powers assailed the Dasyu: he cast away the gloomy mists, the darkness.

verses.sa:
सनामाना चिद्ध्वसयो न्यस्मा अवाहन्निन्द्र उषसो यथानः ।
ऋष्वैरगच्छः सखिभिर्निकामैः साकं प्रतिष्ठा हृद्या जघन्थ ॥
verses.rom:
sanamana chiddhvasayo nyasma avahannindra ushaso yathanah |
rishvairagachchhah sakhibhirnikamaih sakam pratishtha hridya jaghantha ||
verses.en:
Two of like name for him didst thou demolish, as Indra striking down the car of Usas.
With thy beloved lofty Friends thou camest, and with the assurance of thine heart thou slewest.

verses.sa:
त्वं जघन्थ नमुचिं मखस्युं दासं कृण्वान ऋषये विमायम् ।
त्वं चकर्थ मनवे स्योनान्पथो देवत्राञ्जसेव यानान् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam jaghantha namuchim makhasyum dasam krinvana rishaye vimayam |
tvam chakartha manave syonanpatho devatranjaseva yanan ||
verses.en:
War-loving Namuci thou smotest, robbing the Dasa of his magic for the Rsi.
For man thou madest ready pleasant pathways, paths leading as it were directly God-ward.

verses.sa:
त्वमेतानि पप्रिषे वि नामेशान इन्द्र दधिषे गभस्तौ ।
अनु त्वा देवाः शवसा मदन्त्युपरिबुध्नान्वनिनश्चकर्थ ॥
verses.rom:
tvametani paprishe vi nameshana indra dadhishe gabhastau |
anu tva devah shavasa madantyuparibudhnanvaninashchakartha ||
verses.en:
These names of thine thou hast fulfilled completely: as Lord, thou boldest in thine arm, O Indra.
In thee, through thy great might, the Gods are joyful: the roots of trees hast thou directed upward.

verses.sa:
चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् ।
पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु ॥
verses.rom:
chakram yadasyapsva nishattamuto tadasmai madhvichchachchhadyat |
prithivyamatishitam yadudhah payo goshvadadha oshadhishu ||
verses.en:
May the sweet Soma juices make him happy to cast his quoit that lies in depth of waters.
Thou from the udder which o'er earth is fastened hast poured the milk into the kine and herbage.

verses.sa:
अश्वादियायेति यद्वदन्त्योजसो जातमुत मन्य एनम् ।
मन्योरियाय हर्म्येषु तस्थौ यतः प्रजज्ञ इन्द्रो अस्य वेद ॥
verses.rom:
ashvadiyayeti yadvadantyojaso jatamuta manya enam |
manyoriyaya harmyeshu tasthau yatah prajajna indro asya veda ||
verses.en:
When others call him offspring of the Courser, my meaning is that Mighty Power produced him.
He came from Manyu and remained in houses: whence he hath sprung is known to Indra only.

verses.sa:
वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः ।
अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्यस्मान्निधयेव बद्धान् ॥
verses.rom:
vayah suparna upa sedurindram priyamedha rishayo nadhamanah |
apa dhvantamurnuhi purdhi chakshurmumugdhyasmannidhayeva baddhan ||
verses.en:
Like birds of beauteous wing the Priyamedhas, Rsis, imploring, have come nigh to Indra:
Dispel the darkness and fill full our vision deliver us as men whom snares entangle.

verses.sa:
वसूनां वा चर्कृष इयक्षन्धिया वा यज्ञैर्वा रोदस्योः ।
अर्वन्तो वा ये रयिमन्तः सातौ वनुं वा ये सुश्रुणं सुश्रुतो धुः ॥
verses.rom:
vasunam va charkrisha iyakshandhiya va yajnairva rodasyoh |
arvanto va ye rayimantah satau vanum va ye sushrunam sushruto dhuh ||
verses.en:
I AM prepared to laud with song or worship the Noble Ones who are in earth and heaven,
Or Coursers who have triumphed in, the contest, or those who famed, have won the prize with glory.

verses.sa:
हव एषामसुरो नक्षत द्यां श्रवस्यता मनसा निंसत क्षाम् ।
चक्षाणा यत्र सुविताय देवा द्यौर्न वारेभिः कृणवन्त स्वैः ॥
verses.rom:
hava eshamasuro nakshata dyam shravasyata manasa nimsata ksham |
chakshana yatra suvitaya deva dyaurna varebhih krinavanta svaih ||
verses.en:
Their call, the call of Gods, went up to heaven: they kissed the ground with glory-seeking spirit,
There where the Gods look on for happy fortune, and like the kindly heavens bestow their bounties.

verses.sa:
इयमेषाममृतानां गीः सर्वताता ये कृपणन्त रत्नम् ।
धियं च यज्ञं च साधन्तस्ते नो धान्तु वसव्यमसामि ॥
verses.rom:
iyameshamamritanam gih sarvatata ye kripananta ratnam |
dhiyam cha yajnam cha sadhantaste no dhantu vasavyamasami ||
verses.en:
This is the song of those Immortal Beings who long for treasures in their full perfection.
May these, completing prayers and sacrifices, bestow upon us wealth where naught is wanting.

verses.sa:
आ तत्त इन्द्रायवः पनन्ताभि य ऊर्वं गोमन्तं तितृत्सान् ।
सकृत्स्वं ये पुरुपुत्रां महीं सहस्रधारां बृहतीं दुदुक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
a tatta indrayavah panantabhi ya urvam gomantam titritsan |
sakritsvam ye puruputram mahim sahasradharam brihatim dudukshan ||
verses.en:
Those living men extolled thy deed, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle,
Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose Sons are many and her streams past number.

verses.sa:
शचीव इन्द्रमवसे कृणुध्वमनानतं दमयन्तं पृतन्यून् ।
ऋभुक्षणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिं भर्ता यो वज्रं नर्यं पुरुक्षुः ॥
verses.rom:
shachiva indramavase krinudhvamananatam damayantam pritanyun |
ribhukshanam maghavanam suvriktim bharta yo vajram naryam purukshuh ||
verses.en:
Sacivan, win to your assistance Indra who never bends, who overcomes his foemen.
Rbhuksan, Maghavan, the hymn's upholder, who, rich in food, bears man's kind friend, the thunder.

verses.sa:
यद्वावान पुरुतमं पुराषाळा वृत्रहेन्द्रो नामान्यप्राः ।
अचेति प्रासहस्पतिस्तुविष्मान्यदीमुश्मसि कर्तवे करत्तत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadvavana purutamam purashala vritrahendro namanyaprah |
acheti prasahaspatistuvishmanyadimushmasi kartave karattat ||
verses.en:
Since he who won of old anew hath triumphed, Indra hath earned his name of Vrtra-slayer.
He hath appeared, the mighty Lord of Conquest. What we would have him do let him accomplish.

verses.sa:
प्र सु व आपो महिमानमुत्तमं कारुर्वोचाति सदने विवस्वतः ।
प्र सप्तसप्त त्रेधा हि चक्रमुः प्र सृत्वरीणामति सिन्धुरोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
pra su va apo mahimanamuttamam karurvochati sadane vivasvatah |
pra saptasapta tredha hi chakramuh pra sritvarinamati sindhurojasa ||
verses.en:
THE singer, O ye Waters in Vivasvan's place, shall tell your grandeur forth that is beyond compare.
The Rivers have come forward triply, seven and seven. Sindhu in might surpasses all the streams that flow.

verses.sa:
प्र तेऽरदद्वरुणो यातवे पथः सिन्धो यद्वाजाँ अभ्यद्रवस्त्वम् ।
भूम्या अधि प्रवता यासि सानुना यदेषामग्रं जगतामिरज्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
pra te'radadvaruno yatave pathah sindho yadvajan abhyadravastvam |
bhumya adhi pravata yasi sanuna yadeshamagram jagatamirajyasi ||
verses.en:
Varuna cut the channels for thy forward course, O Sindhu, when thou rannest on to win the race.
Thou speedest o'er precipitous ridges of the earth, when thou art Lord and Leader of these moving floods.

verses.sa:
दिवि स्वनो यतते भूम्योपर्यनन्तं शुष्ममुदियर्ति भानुना ।
अभ्रादिव प्र स्तनयन्ति वृष्टयः सिन्धुर्यदेति वृषभो न रोरुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
divi svano yatate bhumyoparyanantam shushmamudiyarti bhanuna |
abhradiva pra stanayanti vrishtayah sindhuryadeti vrishabho na roruvat ||
verses.en:
His roar is lifted up to heaven above the earth: he puts forth endless vigour with a flash of light.
Like floods of rain that fall- in thunder from the cloud, so Sindhu rushes on bellowing like a bull.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा सिन्धो शिशुमिन्न मातरो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः ।
राजेव युध्वा नयसि त्वमित्सिचौ यदासामग्रं प्रवतामिनक्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva sindho shishuminna mataro vashra arshanti payaseva dhenavah |
rajeva yudhva nayasi tvamitsichau yadasamagram pravataminakshasi ||
verses.en:
Like mothers to their calves, like milch kine with their milk, so, Sindhu, unto thee the roaring rivers run.
Thou leadest as a warrior king thine army's wings what time thou comest in the van of these swift streams.

verses.sa:
इमं मे गङ्गे यमुने सरस्वति शुतुद्रि स्तोमं सचता परुष्ण्या ।
असिक्न्या मरुद्वृधे वितस्तयार्जीकीये शृणुह्या सुषोमया ॥
verses.rom:
imam me gange yamune sarasvati shutudri stomam sachata parushnya |
asiknya marudvridhe vitastayarjikiye shrinuhya sushomaya ||
verses.en:
Favour ye this my laud, O Ganga, Yamuna, O Sutudri, Parusni and Sarasvati:
With Asikni, Vitasta, O Marudvrdha, O Arjikiya with Susoma hear my call.

verses.sa:
तृष्टामया प्रथमं यातवे सजूः सुसर्त्वा रसया श्वेत्या त्या ।
त्वं सिन्धो कुभया गोमतीं क्रुमुं मेहत्न्वा सरथं याभिरीयसे ॥
verses.rom:
trishtamaya prathamam yatave sajuh susartva rasaya shvetya tya |
tvam sindho kubhaya gomatim krumum mehatnva saratham yabhiriyase ||
verses.en:
First with Trstama thou art eager to flow forth, with Rasa, and Susartu, and with Svetya here,
With Kubha; and with these, Sindhu and Mehatnu, thou seekest in thy course Krumu and Gomati.

verses.sa:
ऋजीत्येनी रुशती महित्वा परि ज्रयांसि भरते रजांसि ।
अदब्धा सिन्धुरपसामपस्तमाश्वा न चित्रा वपुषीव दर्शता ॥
verses.rom:
rijityeni rushati mahitva pari jrayamsi bharate rajamsi |
adabdha sindhurapasamapastamashva na chitra vapushiva darshata ||
verses.en:
Flashing and whitely-gleaming in her mightiness, she moves along her ample volumes through the realms,
Most active of the active, Sindhu unrestrained, like to a dappled mare, beautiful, fair to see.

verses.sa:
स्वश्वा सिन्धुः सुरथा सुवासा हिरण्ययी सुकृता वाजिनीवती ।
ऊर्णावती युवतिः सीलमावत्युताधि वस्ते सुभगा मधुवृधम् ॥
verses.rom:
svashva sindhuh suratha suvasa hiranyayi sukrita vajinivati |
urnavati yuvatih silamavatyutadhi vaste subhaga madhuvridham ||
verses.en:
Rich in good steeds is Sindhu, rich in cars and robes, rich in gold, nobly-fashioned, rich in ample wealth.
Blest Silamavati and young Urnavati invest themselves with raiment rich in store of sweets.

verses.sa:
सुखं रथं युयुजे सिन्धुरश्विनं तेन वाजं सनिषदस्मिन्नाजौ ।
महान्ह्यस्य महिमा पनस्यतेऽदब्धस्य स्वयशसो विरप्शिनः ॥
verses.rom:
sukham ratham yuyuje sindhurashvinam tena vajam sanishadasminnajau |
mahanhyasya mahima panasyate'dabdhasya svayashaso virapshinah ||
verses.en:
Sindhu hath yoked her car, light-rolling, drawn by steeds, and with that car shall she win booty in this fight.
So have I praised its power, mighty and unrestrained, of independent glory, roaring as it runs.

verses.sa:
आ व ऋञ्जस ऊर्जां व्युष्टिष्विन्द्रं मरुतो रोदसी अनक्तन ।
उभे यथा नो अहनी सचाभुवा सदःसदो वरिवस्यात उद्भिदा ॥
verses.rom:
a va rinjasa urjam vyushtishvindram maruto rodasi anaktana |
ubhe yatha no ahani sachabhuva sadahsado varivasyata udbhida ||
verses.en:
I GRASP at you when power and strength begin to dawn: bedew ye, Indra and the Maruts, Heaven and Earth,
That Day and Night, in every hall of sacrifice, may wait on us and bless us when they first spring forth.

verses.sa:
तदु श्रेष्ठं सवनं सुनोतनात्यो न हस्तयतो अद्रिः सोतरि ।
विदद्ध्यर्यो अभिभूति पौंस्यं महो राये चित्तरुते यदर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
tadu shreshtham savanam sunotanatyo na hastayato adrih sotari |
vidaddhyaryo abhibhuti paumsyam maho raye chittarute yadarvatah ||
verses.en:
Press the libation out, most excellent of all: the Pressing-stone is grasped like a hand-guided steed.
So let it win the valour that subdues the foe, and the fleet courser's might that speeds to ample wealth.

verses.sa:
तदिद्ध्यस्य सवनं विवेरपो यथा पुरा मनवे गातुमश्रेत् ।
गोअर्णसि त्वाष्ट्रे अश्वनिर्णिजि प्रेमध्वरेष्वध्वराँ अशिश्रयुः ॥
verses.rom:
tadiddhyasya savanam viverapo yatha pura manave gatumashret |
goarnasi tvashtre ashvanirniji premadhvareshvadhvaran ashishrayuh ||
verses.en:
Juice that this Stone pours out removes defect of ours, as in old time it brought prosperity to man.
At sacrifices they established holy rites on Tvastar's milk-blent juice bright with the hue of steeds.

verses.sa:
अप हत रक्षसो भङ्गुरावत स्कभायत निरृतिं सेधतामतिम् ।
आ नो रयिं सर्ववीरं सुनोतन देवाव्यं भरत श्लोकमद्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
apa hata rakshaso bhanguravata skabhayata nirritim sedhatamatim |
a no rayim sarvaviram sunotana devavyam bharata shlokamadrayah ||
verses.en:
Drive ye the treacherous demons far away from us: keep Nirrti afar and banish Penury.
Pour riches forth for us with troops of hero sons, and bear ye up, O Stones, the song that visits Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिदा वोऽमवत्तरेभ्यो विभ्वना चिदाश्वपस्तरेभ्यः ।
वायोश्चिदा सोमरभस्तरेभ्योऽग्नेश्चिदर्च पितुकृत्तरेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
divashchida vo'mavattarebhyo vibhvana chidashvapastarebhyah |
vayoshchida somarabhastarebhyo'gneshchidarcha pitukrittarebhyah ||
verses.en:
To you who are more mighty than the heavens themselves, who, finishing your task with more than Vibhvan's speed,
More rapidly than Vayu seize the Soma juice, better than Agni give us food, to you I sing.

verses.sa:
भुरन्तु नो यशसः सोत्वन्धसो ग्रावाणो वाचा दिविता दिवित्मता ।
नरो यत्र दुहते काम्यं मध्वाघोषयन्तो अभितो मिथस्तुरः ॥
verses.rom:
bhurantu no yashasah sotvandhaso gravano vacha divita divitmata |
naro yatra duhate kamyam madhvaghoshayanto abhito mithasturah ||
verses.en:
Stirred be the glorious Stones: let it press out the juice, the Stone with heavenly song that reaches up to heaven,
There where the men draw forth the meath for which they long, sending their voice around in rivalry of speed.

verses.sa:
सुन्वन्ति सोमं रथिरासो अद्रयो निरस्य रसं गविषो दुहन्ति ते ।
दुहन्त्यूधरुपसेचनाय कं नरो हव्या न मर्जयन्त आसभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sunvanti somam rathiraso adrayo nirasya rasam gavisho duhanti te |
duhantyudharupasechanaya kam naro havya na marjayanta asabhih ||
verses.en:
The Stones press out the Soma, swift as car-borne men, and, eager for the spoil, drain forth the sap thereof
To fill the beaker, they exhaust the udder's store, as the men purify oblations with their lips.

verses.sa:
एते नरः स्वपसो अभूतन य इन्द्राय सुनुथ सोममद्रयः ।
वामंवामं वो दिव्याय धाम्ने वसुवसु वः पार्थिवाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
ete narah svapaso abhutana ya indraya sunutha somamadrayah |
vamamvamam vo divyaya dhamne vasuvasu vah parthivaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
Ye, present men, have been most skillful in your work, even ye, O Stones who pressed Soma for Indra's drink.
May all ye have of fair go to the Heavenly Race, and all your treasure to the earthly worshipper.

verses.sa:
अभ्रप्रुषो न वाचा प्रुषा वसु हविष्मन्तो न यज्ञा विजानुषः ।
सुमारुतं न ब्रह्माणमर्हसे गणमस्तोष्येषां न शोभसे ॥
verses.rom:
abhraprusho na vacha prusha vasu havishmanto na yajna vijanushah |
sumarutam na brahmanamarhase ganamastoshyesham na shobhase ||
verses.en:
As with their voice from cloud they sprinkle treasure so are the wise man's liberal sacrifices.
I praise their Company that merits worship as the good Maruts' priest to pay them honour.

verses.sa:
श्रिये मर्यासो अञ्जीँरकृण्वत सुमारुतं न पूर्वीरति क्षपः ।
दिवस्पुत्रास एता न येतिर आदित्यासस्ते अक्रा न वावृधुः ॥
verses.rom:
shriye maryaso anjinrakrinvata sumarutam na purvirati kshapah |
divasputrasa eta na yetira adityasaste akra na vavridhuh ||
verses.en:
The youths have wrought their ornaments for glory through many nights,-this noble band of Maruts.
Like stags the Sons of Dyatis have striven onward, the Sons of Aditi grown strong like pillars.

verses.sa:
प्र ये दिवः पृथिव्या न बर्हणा त्मना रिरिच्रे अभ्रान्न सूर्यः ।
पाजस्वन्तो न वीराः पनस्यवो रिशादसो न मर्या अभिद्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye divah prithivya na barhana tmana ririchre abhranna suryah |
pajasvanto na virah panasyavo rishadaso na marya abhidyavah ||
verses.en:
They who extend beyond the earth and heaven, by their own mass, as from the cloud spreads Surya;
Like mighty Heroes covetous of glory, like heavenly gallants who destroy the wicked.

verses.sa:
युष्माकं बुध्ने अपां न यामनि विथुर्यति न मही श्रथर्यति ।
विश्वप्सुर्यज्ञो अर्वागयं सु वः प्रयस्वन्तो न सत्राच आ गत ॥
verses.rom:
yushmakam budhne apam na yamani vithuryati na mahi shratharyati |
vishvapsuryajno arvagayam su vah prayasvanto na satracha a gata ||
verses.en:
When ye come nigh, as in the depth of waters, the earth is loosened, as it were, and shaken.
This your all-feeding sacrifice approaches: come all united, fraught, as 'twere with viands.

verses.sa:
यूयं धूर्षु प्रयुजो न रश्मिभिर्ज्योतिष्मन्तो न भासा व्युष्टिषु ।
श्येनासो न स्वयशसो रिशादसः प्रवासो न प्रसितासः परिप्रुषः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam dhurshu prayujo na rashmibhirjyotishmanto na bhasa vyushtishu |
shyenaso na svayashaso rishadasah pravaso na prasitasah pariprushah ||
verses.en:
Ye are like horses fastened to the chariot poles, luminous with your beams, with splendour as at dawn;
Like self-bright falcons, punishers of wicked men, like hovering birds urged forward, scattering rain around.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्वहध्वे मरुतः पराकाद्यूयं महः संवरणस्य वस्वः ।
विदानासो वसवो राध्यस्याराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोत ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadvahadhve marutah parakadyuyam mahah samvaranasya vasvah |
vidanaso vasavo radhyasyarachchiddveshah sanutaryuyota ||
verses.en:
When ye come forth, O Maruts, from the distance, from the great treasury of rich possessions,
Knowing, O Vasus, boons that should be granted, even from afar drive back the men who hate us.

verses.sa:
य उदृचि यज्ञे अध्वरेष्ठा मरुद्भ्यो न मानुषो ददाशत् ।
रेवत्स वयो दधते सुवीरं स देवानामपि गोपीथे अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ya udrichi yajne adhvareshtha marudbhyo na manusho dadashat |
revatsa vayo dadhate suviram sa devanamapi gopithe astu ||
verses.en:
He who, engaged in the rite's final duty brings, as a man, oblation to the Maruts,
Wins him life's wealthy fulness, blest with heroes: he shall be present, too, where Gods drink Soma.

verses.sa:
ते हि यज्ञेषु यज्ञियास ऊमा आदित्येन नाम्ना शम्भविष्ठाः ।
ते नोऽवन्तु रथतूर्मनीषां महश्च यामन्नध्वरे चकानाः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi yajneshu yajniyasa uma adityena namna shambhavishthah |
te no'vantu rathaturmanisham mahashcha yamannadhvare chakanah ||
verses.en:
For these are helps adored at sacrifices, bringing good fortune by their name Adityas.
Speeding on cars let them protect our praises, delighting in our sacrifice and worship.

verses.sa:
विप्रासो न मन्मभिः स्वाध्यो देवाव्यो न यज्ञैः स्वप्नसः ।
राजानो न चित्राः सुसंदृशः क्षितीनां न मर्या अरेपसः ॥
verses.rom:
vipraso na manmabhih svadhyo devavyo na yajnaih svapnasah |
rajano na chitrah susamdrishah kshitinam na marya arepasah ||
verses.en:
Ye by your hymns are like high-thoughted singers, skillful, inviting Gods with sacrifices;
Fair to behold, like Kings, with bright adornment, like spotless gallants, leaders of the people:

verses.sa:
अग्निर्न ये भ्राजसा रुक्मवक्षसो वातासो न स्वयुजः सद्यऊतयः ।
प्रज्ञातारो न ज्येष्ठाः सुनीतयः सुशर्माणो न सोमा ऋतं यते ॥
verses.rom:
agnirna ye bhrajasa rukmavakshaso vataso na svayujah sadyautayah |
prajnataro na jyeshthah sunitayah susharmano na soma ritam yate ||
verses.en:
Like fire with flashing flame, breast-bound with chains of gold, like tempest-blasts, self-moving, swift to lend your aid;
As best of all foreknowers, excellent to guide, like Somas, good to guard the man who follows Law.

verses.sa:
वातासो न ये धुनयो जिगत्नवोऽग्नीनां न जिह्वा विरोकिणः ।
वर्मण्वन्तो न योधाः शिमीवन्तः पितॄणां न शंसाः सुरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
vataso na ye dhunayo jigatnavo'gninam na jihva virokinah |
varmanvanto na yodhah shimivantah pitrinam na shamsah suratayah ||
verses.en:
Shakers of all, like gales of wind they travel, like tongues of burning fires in their effulgence.
Mighty are they as warriors clad in armour, and, like the Fathers' prayers, Most Bounteous Givers.

verses.sa:
रथानां न येऽराः सनाभयो जिगीवांसो न शूरा अभिद्यवः ।
वरेयवो न मर्या घृतप्रुषोऽभिस्वर्तारो अर्कं न सुष्टुभः ॥
verses.rom:
rathanam na ye'rah sanabhayo jigivamso na shura abhidyavah |
vareyavo na marya ghritaprusho'bhisvartaro arkam na sushtubhah ||
verses.en:
Like spokes of car-wheels in one nave united, ever victorious like heavenly Heroes,
Shedding their precious balm like youthful suitors, they raise their voice and chant their psalm as singers.

verses.sa:
अश्वासो न ये ज्येष्ठास आशवो दिधिषवो न रथ्यः सुदानवः ।
आपो न निम्नैरुदभिर्जिगत्नवो विश्वरूपा अङ्गिरसो न सामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvaso na ye jyeshthasa ashavo didhishavo na rathyah sudanavah |
apo na nimnairudabhirjigatnavo vishvarupa angiraso na samabhih ||
verses.en:
They who are fleet to travel like the noblest steeds, long to obtain the prize like bounteous charioteers,
Like waters speeding on with their precipitous floods, like omniform Angirases with Sama-hymns.

verses.sa:
ग्रावाणो न सूरयः सिन्धुमातर आदर्दिरासो अद्रयो न विश्वहा ।
शिशूला न क्रीळयः सुमातरो महाग्रामो न यामन्नुत त्विषा ॥
verses.rom:
gravano na surayah sindhumatara adardiraso adrayo na vishvaha |
shishula na krilayah sumataro mahagramo na yamannuta tvisha ||
verses.en:
Born from the stream, like press-stones are the Princes, for ever like the stones that crush in pieces;
Sons of a beauteous Dame, like playful children, like a great host upon the march with splendour.

verses.sa:
उषसां न केतवोऽध्वरश्रियः शुभंयवो नाञ्जिभिर्व्यश्वितन् ।
सिन्धवो न ययियो भ्राजदृष्टयः परावतो न योजनानि ममिरे ॥
verses.rom:
ushasam na ketavo'dhvarashriyah shubhamyavo nanjibhirvyashvitan |
sindhavo na yayiyo bhrajadrishtayah paravato na yojanani mamire ||
verses.en:
Like rays of Dawn, the visitors of sacrifice, they shine with ornaments as eager to be bright.
Like rivers hasting on, glittering with their spears, from far away they measure out the distances.

verses.sa:
सुभागान्नो देवाः कृणुता सुरत्नानस्मान्स्तोतॄन्मरुतो वावृधानाः ।
अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गात सनाद्धि वो रत्नधेयानि सन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
subhaganno devah krinuta suratnanasmanstotrinmaruto vavridhanah |
adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gata sanaddhi vo ratnadheyani santi ||
verses.en:
Gods, send us happiness and make us wealthy, letting us singers prosper, O ye Maruts.
Bethink you of our praise and of our friendship: ye from of old have riches to vouchsafe us.

verses.sa:
अपश्यमस्य महतो महित्वममर्त्यस्य मर्त्यासु विक्षु ।
नाना हनू विभृते सं भरेते असिन्वती बप्सती भूर्यत्तः ॥
verses.rom:
apashyamasya mahato mahitvamamartyasya martyasu vikshu |
nana hanu vibhrite sam bharete asinvati bapsati bhuryattah ||
verses.en:
I HAVE beheld the might of this Great Being. Immortal in the midst of tribes of mortals.
His jaws now open and now shut together: much they devour, insatiately chewing.

verses.sa:
गुहा शिरो निहितमृधगक्षी असिन्वन्नत्ति जिह्वया वनानि ।
अत्राण्यस्मै पड्भिः सं भरन्त्युत्तानहस्ता नमसाधि विक्षु ॥
verses.rom:
guha shiro nihitamridhagakshi asinvannatti jihvaya vanani |
atranyasmai padbhih sam bharantyuttanahasta namasadhi vikshu ||
verses.en:
His eyes are turned away, his head is hidden: unsated with his tongue he eats the fuel.
With hands upraised, with reverence in the houses, for him they quickly bring his food together.

verses.sa:
प्र मातुः प्रतरं गुह्यमिच्छन्कुमारो न वीरुधः सर्पदुर्वीः ।
ससं न पक्वमविदच्छुचन्तं रिरिह्वांसं रिप उपस्थे अन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
pra matuh prataram guhyamichchhankumaro na virudhah sarpadurvih |
sasam na pakvamavidachchhuchantam ririhvamsam ripa upasthe antah ||
verses.en:
Seeking, as 'twere, his Mother's secret bosom, he, like a child, creeps on through wide-spread bushes.
One he finds glowing like hot food made ready, and kissing deep within the earth's realms.

verses.sa:
तद्वामृतं रोदसी प्र ब्रवीमि जायमानो मातरा गर्भो अत्ति ।
नाहं देवस्य मर्त्यश्चिकेताग्निरङ्ग विचेताः स प्रचेताः ॥
verses.rom:
tadvamritam rodasi pra bravimi jayamano matara garbho atti |
naham devasya martyashchiketagniranga vichetah sa prachetah ||
verses.en:
This holy Law I tell you, Earth and Heaven: the Infant at his birth devours his Parents.
No knowledge of the God have I, a mortal. Yea, Agni knoweth best, for he hath wisdom.

verses.sa:
यो अस्मा अन्नं तृष्वादधात्याज्यैर्घृतैर्जुहोति पुष्यति ।
तस्मै सहस्रमक्षभिर्वि चक्षेऽग्ने विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo asma annam trishvadadhatyajyairghritairjuhoti pushyati |
tasmai sahasramakshabhirvi chakshe'gne vishvatah pratyannasi tvam ||
verses.en:
This man who quickly gives him food, who offers his gifts of oil and butter and supports him, -
Him with his thousand eyes he closely looks on: thou showest him thy face from all sides, Agni.

verses.sa:
किं देवेषु त्यज एनश्चकर्थाग्ने पृच्छामि नु त्वामविद्वान् ।
अक्रीळन्क्रीळन्हरिरत्तवेऽदन्वि पर्वशश्चकर्त गामिवासिः ॥
verses.rom:
kim deveshu tyaja enashchakarthagne prichchhami nu tvamavidvan |
akrilankrilanharirattave'danvi parvashashchakarta gamivasih ||
verses.en:
Agni, hast thou committed sin or treason among the Gods? In ignorance I ask thee.
Playing, not playing, he gold-hued and toothless, hath cut his food up as the knife a victim.

verses.sa:
विषूचो अश्वान्युयुजे वनेजा ऋजीतिभी रशनाभिर्गृभीतान् ।
चक्षदे मित्रो वसुभिः सुजातः समानृधे पर्वभिर्वावृधानः ॥
verses.rom:
vishucho ashvanyuyuje vaneja rijitibhi rashanabhirgribhitan |
chakshade mitro vasubhih sujatah samanridhe parvabhirvavridhanah ||
verses.en:
He born in wood hath yoked his horses rushing in all directions, held with reins that glitter.
The well-born friend hath carved his food with Vasus: in all his limbs he hath increased and prospered.

verses.sa:
अग्निः सप्तिं वाजम्भरं ददात्यग्निर्वीरं श्रुत्यं कर्मनिष्ठाम् ।
अग्नी रोदसी वि चरत्समञ्जन्नग्निर्नारीं वीरकुक्षिं पुरंधिम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnih saptim vajambharam dadatyagnirviram shrutyam karmanishtham |
agni rodasi vi charatsamanjannagnirnarim virakukshim puramdhim ||
verses.en:
AGNI bestows the fleet prize-winning courser: Agni, the hero famed and firm in duty.
Agni pervades and decks the earth and heaven, and fills the fruitful dame who teems with heroes.

verses.sa:
अग्नेरप्नसः समिदस्तु भद्राग्निर्मही रोदसी आ विवेश ।
अग्निरेकं चोदयत्समत्स्वग्निर्वृत्राणि दयते पुरूणि ॥
verses.rom:
agnerapnasah samidastu bhadragnirmahi rodasi a vivesha |
agnirekam chodayatsamatsvagnirvritrani dayate puruni ||
verses.en:
Blest be the wood that feeds the active Agni: within the two great worlds hath Agni entered.
Agni impels a single man to battle, and with him rends in pieces many a foeman.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ह त्यं जरतः कर्णमावाग्निरद्भ्यो निरदहज्जरूथम् ।
अग्निरत्रिं घर्म उरुष्यदन्तरग्निर्नृमेधं प्रजयासृजत्सम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirha tyam jaratah karnamavagniradbhyo niradahajjarutham |
agniratrim gharma urushyadantaragnirnrimedham prajayasrijatsam ||
verses.en:
Agni rejoiced the car of him who praised him, and from the waters burnt away Jarutha.
Agni saved Atri in the fiery cave, and made Nrmedha rich with troops of children.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्दाद्द्रविणं वीरपेशा अग्निरृषिं यः सहस्रा सनोति ।
अग्निर्दिवि हव्यमा ततानाग्नेर्धामानि विभृता पुरुत्रा ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdaddravinam virapesha agnirrishim yah sahasra sanoti |
agnirdivi havyama tatanagnerdhamani vibhrita purutra ||
verses.en:
Agni hath granted wealth that decks the hero, and sent the sage who wins a thousand cattle.
Agni hath made oblations rise to heaven: to every place are Agni's laws extended.

verses.sa:
अग्निमुक्थैरृषयो वि ह्वयन्तेऽग्निं नरो यामनि बाधितासः ।
अग्निं वयो अन्तरिक्षे पतन्तोऽग्निः सहस्रा परि याति गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnimukthairrishayo vi hvayante'gnim naro yamani badhitasah |
agnim vayo antarikshe patanto'gnih sahasra pari yati gonam ||
verses.en:
With songs of praise the Rsis call on Agni; on Agni, heroes worsted in the foray.
Birds flying in the region call on Agni around a thousand cattle Agni wanders.

verses.sa:
अग्निं विश ईळते मानुषीर्या अग्निं मनुषो नहुषो वि जाताः ।
अग्निर्गान्धर्वीं पथ्यामृतस्याग्नेर्गव्यूतिर्घृत आ निषत्ता ॥
verses.rom:
agnim visha ilate manushirya agnim manusho nahusho vi jatah |
agnirgandharvim pathyamritasyagnergavyutirghrita a nishatta ||
verses.en:
Races of human birth pay Agni worship, men who have sprung from Nahus' line adore him.
Stablished in holy oil is Agni's pasture, on the Gandharva path of Law and Order.

verses.sa:
अग्नये ब्रह्म ऋभवस्ततक्षुरग्निं महामवोचामा सुवृक्तिम् ।
अग्ने प्राव जरितारं यविष्ठाग्ने महि द्रविणमा यजस्व ॥
verses.rom:
agnaye brahma ribhavastatakshuragnim mahamavochama suvriktim |
agne prava jaritaram yavishthagne mahi dravinama yajasva ||
verses.en:
The Rbhus fabricated prayer for Agni, and we with mighty hymns have called on Agni.
Agni, Most Youthful God, protect the singer: win us by worship, Agni, great possessions.

verses.sa:
य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि जुह्वदृषिर्होता न्यसीदत्पिता नः ।
स आशिषा द्रविणमिच्छमानः प्रथमच्छदवराँ आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
ya ima vishva bhuvanani juhvadrishirhota nyasidatpita nah |
sa ashisha dravinamichchhamanah prathamachchhadavaran a vivesha ||
verses.en:
HE who sate down as Hotar-priest, the Rsi, our Father, offering up all things existing,-
He, seeking through his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.

verses.sa:
किं स्विदासीदधिष्ठानमारम्भणं कतमत्स्वित्कथासीत् ।
यतो भूमिं जनयन्विश्वकर्मा वि द्यामौर्णोन्महिना विश्वचक्षाः ॥
verses.rom:
kim svidasidadhishthanamarambhanam katamatsvitkathasit |
yato bhumim janayanvishvakarma vi dyamaurnonmahina vishvachakshah ||
verses.en:
What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that supported him? How was it?
Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens.

verses.sa:
विश्वतश्चक्षुरुत विश्वतोमुखो विश्वतोबाहुरुत विश्वतस्पात् ।
सं बाहुभ्यां धमति सं पतत्रैर्द्यावाभूमी जनयन्देव एकः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvatashchakshuruta vishvatomukho vishvatobahuruta vishvataspat |
sam bahubhyam dhamati sam patatrairdyavabhumi janayandeva ekah ||
verses.en:
He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides,
He, the Sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them, with his arms as wings, together.

verses.sa:
किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः ।
मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेदु तद्यदध्यतिष्ठद्भुवनानि धारयन् ॥
verses.rom:
kim svidvanam ka u sa vriksha asa yato dyavaprithivi nishtatakshuh |
manishino manasa prichchhatedu tadyadadhyatishthadbhuvanani dharayan ||
verses.en:
What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven?
Ye thoughtful men inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.

verses.sa:
या ते धामानि परमाणि यावमा या मध्यमा विश्वकर्मन्नुतेमा ।
शिक्षा सखिभ्यो हविषि स्वधावः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वं वृधानः ॥
verses.rom:
ya te dhamani paramani yavama ya madhyama vishvakarmannutema |
shiksha sakhibhyo havishi svadhavah svayam yajasva tanvam vridhanah ||
verses.en:
Nine highest, lowest, sacrificial natures, and these thy mid-most here, O Visvakarman,
Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessed, and come thyself, exalted, to our worship.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
vishvakarmanhavisha vavridhanah svayam yajasva prithivimuta dyam |
muhyantvanye abhito janasa ihasmakam maghava surirastu ||
verses.en:
Bring thou thyself, exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship.
Let other men around us live in folly here let us have a rich and liberal patron.

verses.sa:
वाचस्पतिं विश्वकर्माणमूतये मनोजुवं वाजे अद्या हुवेम ।
स नो विश्वानि हवनानि जोषद्विश्वशम्भूरवसे साधुकर्मा ॥
verses.rom:
vachaspatim vishvakarmanamutaye manojuvam vaje adya huvema |
sa no vishvani havanani joshadvishvashambhuravase sadhukarma ||
verses.en:
Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman.
May he hear kindly all our invocations who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous.

verses.sa:
चक्षुषः पिता मनसा हि धीरो घृतमेने अजनन्नम्नमाने ।
यदेदन्ता अददृहन्त पूर्व आदिद्द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakshushah pita manasa hi dhiro ghritamene ajanannamnamane |
yadedanta adadrihanta purva adiddyavaprithivi aprathetam ||
verses.en:
THE Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness.
Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मा विमना आद्विहाया धाता विधाता परमोत संदृक् ।
तेषामिष्टानि समिषा मदन्ति यत्रा सप्तऋषीन्पर एकमाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvakarma vimana advihaya dhata vidhata paramota samdrik |
teshamishtani samisha madanti yatra saptarishinpara ekamahuh ||
verses.en:
Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence.
Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only One, beyond the Seven Rsis.

verses.sa:
यो नः पिता जनिता यो विधाता धामानि वेद भुवनानि विश्वा ।
यो देवानां नामधा एक एव तं सम्प्रश्नं भुवना यन्त्यन्या ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah pita janita yo vidhata dhamani veda bhuvanani vishva |
yo devanam namadha eka eva tam samprashnam bhuvana yantyanya ||
verses.en:
Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races and all things existing,
Even he alone, the Deities' name-giver, him other beings seek for information.

verses.sa:
त आयजन्त द्रविणं समस्मा ऋषयः पूर्वे जरितारो न भूना ।
असूर्ते सूर्ते रजसि निषत्ते ये भूतानि समकृण्वन्निमानि ॥
verses.rom:
ta ayajanta dravinam samasma rishayah purve jaritaro na bhuna |
asurte surte rajasi nishatte ye bhutani samakrinvannimani ||
verses.en:
To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,-Rsis of old, in numerous troops, as singers,
Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all these things that have existence.

verses.sa:
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्या परो देवेभिरसुरैर्यदस्ति ।
कं स्विद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समपश्यन्त विश्वे ॥
verses.rom:
paro diva para ena prithivya paro devebhirasurairyadasti |
kam svidgarbham prathamam dadhra apo yatra devah samapashyanta vishve ||
verses.en:
That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the Asuras and Gods had being,-
What was the germ primeval which the waters received where all the Gods were seen together?

verses.sa:
तमिद्गर्भं प्रथमं दध्र आपो यत्र देवाः समगच्छन्त विश्वे ।
अजस्य नाभावध्येकमर्पितं यस्मिन्विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
tamidgarbham prathamam dadhra apo yatra devah samagachchhanta vishve |
ajasya nabhavadhyekamarpitam yasminvishvani bhuvanani tasthuh ||
verses.en:
The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the Gods were gathered all together.
It rested set upon the Unborn's navel, that One wherein abide all things existing.

verses.sa:
न तं विदाथ य इमा जजानान्यद्युष्माकमन्तरं बभूव ।
नीहारेण प्रावृता जल्प्या चासुतृप उक्थशासश्चरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
na tam vidatha ya ima jajananyadyushmakamantaram babhuva |
niharena pravrita jalpya chasutripa ukthashasashcharanti ||
verses.en:
Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another thing hath risen up among you.
Enwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn-chanters wander and are discontented.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मन्योऽविधद्वज्र सायक सह ओजः पुष्यति विश्वमानुषक् ।
साह्याम दासमार्यं त्वया युजा सहस्कृतेन सहसा सहस्वता ॥
verses.rom:
yaste manyo'vidhadvajra sayaka saha ojah pushyati vishvamanushak |
sahyama dasamaryam tvaya yuja sahaskritena sahasa sahasvata ||
verses.en:
HE who hath reverenced thee, Manyu, destructive bolt, breeds for himself forthwith all conquering energy.
Arya and Dasa will we conquer with thine aid, with thee the Conqueror, with conquest conquest-sped.

verses.sa:
मन्युरिन्द्रो मन्युरेवास देवो मन्युर्होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।
मन्युं विश ईळते मानुषीर्याः पाहि नो मन्यो तपसा सजोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
manyurindro manyurevasa devo manyurhota varuno jatavedah |
manyum visha ilate manushiryah pahi no manyo tapasa sajoshah ||
verses.en:
Manyu was Indra, yea, the God, was Manyu, Manyu was Hotar, Varuna, Jatavedas.
The tribes of human lineage worship Manyu. Accordant with thy fervour, Manyu, guard us.

verses.sa:
अभीहि मन्यो तवसस्तवीयान्तपसा युजा वि जहि शत्रून् ।*
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहा च विश्वा वसून्या भरा त्वं नः ॥
verses.rom:
abhihi manyo tavasastaviyantapasa yuja vi jahi shatrun |*
amitraha vritraha dasyuha cha vishva vasunya bhara tvam nah ||
verses.en:
Come hither, Manyu, mightier than the mighty; chase, with thy fervour for ally, our foemen.
Slayer of foes, of Vrtra, and of Dasyu, bring thou to us all kinds of wealth and treasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि मन्यो अभिभूत्योजाः स्वयम्भूर्भामो अभिमातिषाहः ।
विश्वचर्षणिः सहुरिः सहावानस्मास्वोजः पृतनासु धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi manyo abhibhutyojah svayambhurbhamo abhimatishahah |
vishvacharshanih sahurih sahavanasmasvojah pritanasu dhehi ||
verses.en:
For thou art, Manyu, of surpassing vigour, fierce, queller of the foe, and self-existent,
Shared by all men, victorious, subduer: vouchsafe to us superior strength in battles.

verses.sa:
अभागः सन्नप परेतो अस्मि तव क्रत्वा तविषस्य प्रचेतः ।
तं त्वा मन्यो अक्रतुर्जिहीळाहं स्वा तनूर्बलदेयाय मेहि ॥
verses.rom:
abhagah sannapa pareto asmi tava kratva tavishasya prachetah |
tam tva manyo akraturjihilaham sva tanurbaladeyaya mehi ||
verses.en:
I have departed, still without a portion, wise God! according to thy will, the Mighty.
I, feeble man, was wroth thee, O Manyu I am myself; come thou to give me vigour.

verses.sa:
अयं ते अस्म्युप मेह्यर्वाङ्प्रतीचीनः सहुरे विश्वधायः ।
मन्यो वज्रिन्नभि मामा ववृत्स्व हनाव दस्यूँरुत बोध्यापेः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te asmyupa mehyarvanpratichinah sahure vishvadhayah |
manyo vajrinnabhi mama vavritsva hanava dasyunruta bodhyapeh ||
verses.en:
Come hither. I am all thine own; advancing turn thou to me, Victorious, All-supporter!
Come to me, Manyu, Wielder of the Thunder: bethink thee of thy friend, and slay the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रेहि दक्षिणतो भवा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ।
जुहोमि ते धरुणं मध्वो अग्रमुभा उपांशु प्रथमा पिबाव ॥
verses.rom:
abhi prehi dakshinato bhava me'dha vritrani janghanava bhuri |
juhomi te dharunam madhvo agramubha upamshu prathama pibava ||
verses.en:
Approach, and on my right hand hold thy station: so shall we slay a multitude of foemen.
The best of meath I offer to support thee: may we be first to drink thereof in quiet.

verses.sa:
त्वया मन्यो सरथमारुजन्तो हर्षमाणासो धृषिता मरुत्वः ।
तिग्मेषव आयुधा संशिशाना अभि प्र यन्तु नरो अग्निरूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya manyo sarathamarujanto harshamanaso dhrishita marutvah |
tigmeshava ayudha samshishana abhi pra yantu naro agnirupah ||
verses.en:
BORNE on with thee, O Manyu girt by Maruts, let our brave men, impetuous, bursting forward,
March on, like flames of fire in form, exulting, with pointed arrows, sharpening their weapons.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिव मन्यो त्विषितः सहस्व सेनानीर्नः सहुरे हूत एधि ।
हत्वाय शत्रून्वि भजस्व वेद ओजो मिमानो वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
verses.rom:
agniriva manyo tvishitah sahasva senanirnah sahure huta edhi |
hatvaya shatrunvi bhajasva veda ojo mimano vi mridho nudasva ||
verses.en:
Flashing like fire, be thou, O conquering Manyu, invoked, O Victor, as our army's leader.
Slay thou our foes, distribute their possessions: show forth thy vigour, scatter those who hate us.

verses.sa:
सहस्व मन्यो अभिमातिमस्मे रुजन्मृणन्प्रमृणन्प्रेहि शत्रून् ।
उग्रं ते पाजो नन्वा रुरुध्रे वशी वशं नयस एकज त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasva manyo abhimatimasme rujanmrinanpramrinanprehi shatrun |
ugram te pajo nanva rurudhre vashi vasham nayasa ekaja tvam ||
verses.en:
O Manyu, overcome thou our assailant on! breaking, slaying, crushing down the foemen.
They have not hindered thine impetuous vigour: Mighty, Sole born! thou makest them thy subjects.

verses.sa:
एको बहूनामसि मन्यवीळितो विशंविशं युधये सं शिशाधि ।
अकृत्तरुक्त्वया युजा वयं द्युमन्तं घोषं विजयाय कृण्महे ॥
verses.rom:
eko bahunamasi manyavilito vishamvisham yudhaye sam shishadhi |
akrittaruktvaya yuja vayam dyumantam ghosham vijayaya krinmahe ||
verses.en:
Alone or many thou art worshipped, Manyu: sharpen the spirit of each clan for battle.
With thee to aid, O thou of perfect splendour, we will uplift the glorious shout for conquest.

verses.sa:
विजेषकृदिन्द्र इवानवब्रवोऽस्माकं मन्यो अधिपा भवेह ।
प्रियं ते नाम सहुरे गृणीमसि विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आबभूथ ॥
verses.rom:
vijeshakridindra ivanavabravo'smakam manyo adhipa bhaveha |
priyam te nama sahure grinimasi vidma tamutsam yata ababhutha ||
verses.en:
Unyielding bringing victory like Indra, O Manyu, be thou here our Sovran Ruler.
To thy dear name, O Victor, we sing praises: we know the spring from which thou art come hither.

verses.sa:
आभूत्या सहजा वज्र सायक सहो बिभर्ष्यभिभूत उत्तरम् ।
क्रत्वा नो मन्यो सह मेद्येधि महाधनस्य पुरुहूत संसृजि ॥
verses.rom:
abhutya sahaja vajra sayaka saho bibharshyabhibhuta uttaram |
kratva no manyo saha medyedhi mahadhanasya puruhuta samsriji ||
verses.en:
Twin-born with power, destructive bolt of thunder, the highest conquering might is thine, Subduer!
Be friendly to its in thy spirit, Manyu, O Much-invoked, in shock of mighty battle.

verses.sa:
संसृष्टं धनमुभयं समाकृतमस्मभ्यं दत्तां वरुणश्च मन्युः ।
भियं दधाना हृदयेषु शत्रवः पराजितासो अप नि लयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
samsrishtam dhanamubhayam samakritamasmabhyam dattam varunashcha manyuh |
bhiyam dadhana hridayeshu shatravah parajitaso apa ni layantam ||
verses.en:
For spoil let Varuna and Manyu give us the wealth of both sides gathered and collected;
And let our enemies with stricken spirits, o'erwhelmed with terror, slink away defeated.

verses.sa:
सत्येनोत्तभिता भूमिः सूर्येणोत्तभिता द्यौः ।
ऋतेनादित्यास्तिष्ठन्ति दिवि सोमो अधि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
satyenottabhita bhumih suryenottabhita dyauh |
ritenadityastishthanti divi somo adhi shritah ||
verses.en:
TRUTH is the base that bears the earth; by Surya are the heavens sustained.
By Law the Adityas stand secure, and Soma holds his place in heaven.

verses.sa:
सोमेनादित्या बलिनः सोमेन पृथिवी मही ।
अथो नक्षत्राणामेषामुपस्थे सोम आहितः ॥
verses.rom:
somenaditya balinah somena prithivi mahi |
atho nakshatranameshamupasthe soma ahitah ||
verses.en:
By Soma are the Adityas strong, by Soma mighty is the earth.
Thus Soma in the midst of all these constellations hath his place.

verses.sa:
सोमं मन्यते पपिवान्यत्सम्पिंषन्त्योषधिम् ।
सोमं यं ब्रह्माणो विदुर्न तस्याश्नाति कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
somam manyate papivanyatsampimshantyoshadhim |
somam yam brahmano vidurna tasyashnati kashchana ||
verses.en:
One thinks, when they have brayed the plant, that he hath drunk the Soma's juice;
Of him whom Brahmans truly know as Soma no one ever tastes.

verses.sa:
आच्छद्विधानैर्गुपितो बार्हतैः सोम रक्षितः ।
ग्राव्णामिच्छृण्वन्तिष्ठसि न ते अश्नाति पार्थिवः ॥
verses.rom:
achchhadvidhanairgupito barhataih soma rakshitah |
gravnamichchhrinvantishthasi na te ashnati parthivah ||
verses.en:
Soma, secured by sheltering rules, guarded by hymns in Brhati,
Thou standest listening to the stones none tastes of thee who dwells on earth.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा देव प्रपिबन्ति तत आ प्यायसे पुनः ।
वायुः सोमस्य रक्षिता समानां मास आकृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yattva deva prapibanti tata a pyayase punah |
vayuh somasya rakshita samanam masa akritih ||
verses.en:
When they begin to drink thee then, O God, thou swellest out again.
Vayu is Soma's guardian God. The Moon is that which shapes the years.

verses.sa:
रैभ्यासीदनुदेयी नाराशंसी न्योचनी ।
सूर्याया भद्रमिद्वासो गाथयैति परिष्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
raibhyasidanudeyi narashamsi nyochani |
suryaya bhadramidvaso gathayaiti parishkritam ||
verses.en:
Raibhi was her dear bridal friend, and Narasamsi led her home.
Lovely was Surya's robe: she came to that which Gatha had adorned.

verses.sa:
चित्तिरा उपबर्हणं चक्षुरा अभ्यञ्जनम् ।
द्यौर्भूमिः कोश आसीद्यदयात्सूर्या पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
chittira upabarhanam chakshura abhyanjanam |
dyaurbhumih kosha asidyadayatsurya patim ||
verses.en:
Thought was the pillow of her couch, sight was the unguent for her eyes:
Her treasury was earth and heaven when Surya went unto her Lord.

verses.sa:
स्तोमा आसन्प्रतिधयः कुरीरं छन्द ओपशः ।
सूर्याया अश्विना वराग्निरासीत्पुरोगवः ॥
verses.rom:
stoma asanpratidhayah kuriram chhanda opashah |
suryaya ashvina varagnirasitpurogavah ||
verses.en:
Hymns were the cross-bars of the pole, Kurira-metre decked the car:
The bridesmen were the Asvin Pair Agni was leader of the train.

verses.sa:
सोमो वधूयुरभवदश्विनास्तामुभा वरा ।
सूर्यां यत्पत्ये शंसन्तीं मनसा सविताददात् ॥
verses.rom:
somo vadhuyurabhavadashvinastamubha vara |
suryam yatpatye shamsantim manasa savitadadat ||
verses.en:
Soma was he who wooed the maid: the groomsmen were both Asvins, when
The Sun-God Savitar bestowed his willing Surya on her Lord.

verses.sa:
मनो अस्या अन आसीद्द्यौरासीदुत च्छदिः ।
शुक्रावनड्वाहावास्तां यदयात्सूर्या गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
mano asya ana asiddyaurasiduta chchhadih |
shukravanadvahavastam yadayatsurya griham ||
verses.en:
Her spirit was the bridal car; the covering thereof was heaven:
Bright were both Steers that drew it when Surya approached her husband's, home.

verses.sa:
ऋक्सामाभ्यामभिहितौ गावौ ते सामनावितः ।
श्रोत्रं ते चक्रे आस्तां दिवि पन्थाश्चराचारः ॥
verses.rom:
riksamabhyamabhihitau gavau te samanavitah |
shrotram te chakre astam divi panthashcharacharah ||
verses.en:
Thy Steers were steady, kept in place by holy verse and Sama-hymn:
All car were thy two chariot wheels: thy path was tremulous in the sky,

verses.sa:
शुची ते चक्रे यात्या व्यानो अक्ष आहतः ।
अनो मनस्मयं सूर्यारोहत्प्रयती पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuchi te chakre yatya vyano aksha ahatah |
ano manasmayam suryarohatprayati patim ||
verses.en:
Clean, as thou wentest, were thy wheels wind, was the axle fastened there.
Surya, proceeding to her Lord, mounted a spirit-fashioned car.

verses.sa:
सूर्याया वहतुः प्रागात्सविता यमवासृजत् ।
अघासु हन्यन्ते गावोऽर्जुन्योः पर्युह्यते ॥
verses.rom:
suryaya vahatuh pragatsavita yamavasrijat |
aghasu hanyante gavo'rjunyoh paryuhyate ||
verses.en:
The bridal pomp of Surya, which Savitar started, moved along.
In Magha days are oxen slain, in Arjuris they wed the bride.

verses.sa:
यदश्विना पृच्छमानावयातं त्रिचक्रेण वहतुं सूर्यायाः ।
विश्वे देवा अनु तद्वामजानन्पुत्रः पितराववृणीत पूषा ॥
verses.rom:
yadashvina prichchhamanavayatam trichakrena vahatum suryayah |
vishve deva anu tadvamajananputrah pitaravavrinita pusha ||
verses.en:
When on your three-wheeled chariot, O Asvins, ye came as wooers unto Surya's bridal,
Then all the Gods agreed to your proposal Pusan as Son elected you as Fathers.

verses.sa:
यदयातं शुभस्पती वरेयं सूर्यामुप ।
क्वैकं चक्रं वामासीत्क्व देष्ट्राय तस्थथुः ॥
verses.rom:
yadayatam shubhaspati vareyam suryamupa |
kvaikam chakram vamasitkva deshtraya tasthathuh ||
verses.en:
O ye Two Lords of lustre, then when ye to Surya's wooing came,
Where was one chariot wheel of yours? Where stood ye for die Sire's command?

verses.sa:
द्वे ते चक्रे सूर्ये ब्रह्माण ऋतुथा विदुः ।
अथैकं चक्रं यद्गुहा तदद्धातय इद्विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
dve te chakre surye brahmana ritutha viduh |
athaikam chakram yadguha tadaddhataya idviduh ||
verses.en:
The Brahmans, by their seasons, know, O Surya, those two wheels of thine:
One kept concealed, those only who are skilled in highest truths have learned.

verses.sa:
सूर्यायै देवेभ्यो मित्राय वरुणाय च ।
ये भूतस्य प्रचेतस इदं तेभ्योऽकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
suryayai devebhyo mitraya varunaya cha |
ye bhutasya prachetasa idam tebhyo'karam namah ||
verses.en:
To Surya and the Deities, to Mitra and to Varuna.
Who know aright the thing that is, this adoration have I paid.

verses.sa:
पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीळन्तौ परि यातो अध्वरम् ।
विश्वान्यन्यो भुवनाभिचष्ट ऋतूँरन्यो विदधज्जायते पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
purvaparam charato mayayaitau shishu krilantau pari yato adhvaram |
vishvanyanyo bhuvanabhichashta ritunranyo vidadhajjayate punah ||

verses.sa:
नवोनवो भवति जायमानोऽह्नां केतुरुषसामेत्यग्रम् ।
भागं देवेभ्यो वि दधात्यायन्प्र चन्द्रमास्तिरते दीर्घमायुः ॥
verses.rom:
navonavo bhavati jayamano'hnam keturushasametyagram |
bhagam devebhyo vi dadhatyayanpra chandramastirate dirghamayuh ||
verses.en:
He, born afresh, is new and new for ever ensign of days he goes before the Mornings
Coming, he orders f6r the Gods their portion. The Moon prolongs the days of our existence.

verses.sa:
सुकिंशुकं शल्मलिं विश्वरूपं हिरण्यवर्णं सुवृतं सुचक्रम् ।
आ रोह सूर्ये अमृतस्य लोकं स्योनं पत्ये वहतुं कृणुष्व ॥
verses.rom:
sukimshukam shalmalim vishvarupam hiranyavarnam suvritam suchakram |
a roha surye amritasya lokam syonam patye vahatum krinushva ||
verses.en:
Mount this, all-shaped, gold-hued, with strong wheels, fashioned of Kimsuka and Salmali, light-rolling,
Bound for the world of life immortal, Surya: make for thy lord a happy bridal journey.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्वातः पतिवती ह्येषा विश्वावसुं नमसा गीर्भिरीळे ।
अन्यामिच्छ पितृषदं व्यक्तां स ते भागो जनुषा तस्य विद्धि ॥
verses.rom:
udirshvatah pativati hyesha vishvavasum namasa girbhirile |
anyamichchha pitrishadam vyaktam sa te bhago janusha tasya viddhi ||
verses.en:
Rise up from hence: this maiden hath a husband. I laud Visvavasu with hymns and homage.
Seek in her father's home another fair one, and find the portion from of old assigned thee.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्वातो विश्वावसो नमसेळा महे त्वा ।
अन्यामिच्छ प्रफर्व्यं सं जायां पत्या सृज ॥
verses.rom:
udirshvato vishvavaso namasela mahe tva |
anyamichchha prapharvyam sam jayam patya srija ||
verses.en:
Rise up from hence, Visvavasu: with reverence we worship thee.
Seek thou another willing maid, and with her husband leave the bride.

verses.sa:
अनृक्षरा ऋजवः सन्तु पन्था येभिः सखायो यन्ति नो वरेयम् ।
समर्यमा सं भगो नो निनीयात्सं जास्पत्यं सुयममस्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
anrikshara rijavah santu pantha yebhih sakhayo yanti no vareyam |
samaryama sam bhago no niniyatsam jaspatyam suyamamastu devah ||
verses.en:
Straight in direction be the paths, and thornless, whereon our fellows travel to the wooing.
Let Aryaman and Bhaga lead us: perfect, O Gods, the union of the wife and husband.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा मुञ्चामि वरुणस्य पाशाद्येन त्वाबध्नात्सविता सुशेवः ।
ऋतस्य योनौ सुकृतस्य लोकेऽरिष्टां त्वा सह पत्या दधामि ॥
verses.rom:
pra tva munchami varunasya pashadyena tvabadhnatsavita sushevah |
ritasya yonau sukritasya loke'rishtam tva saha patya dadhami ||
verses.en:
Now from the noose of Varuna I free thee, wherewith Most Blessed Savitar hath bound thee.
In Law's seat, to the world of virtuous action, I give thee up uninjured with thy consort.

verses.sa:
प्रेतो मुञ्चामि नामुतः सुबद्धाममुतस्करम् ।
यथेयमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रा सुभगासति ॥
verses.rom:
preto munchami namutah subaddhamamutaskaram |
yatheyamindra midhvah suputra subhagasati ||
verses.en:
Hence, and not thence, I send these free. I make thee softly fettered there.
That, Bounteous Indra, she may live blest in her fortune and her sons.

verses.sa:
पूषा त्वेतो नयतु हस्तगृह्याश्विना त्वा प्र वहतां रथेन ।
गृहान्गच्छ गृहपत्नी यथासो वशिनी त्वं विदथमा वदासि ॥
verses.rom:
pusha tveto nayatu hastagrihyashvina tva pra vahatam rathena |
grihangachchha grihapatni yathaso vashini tvam vidathama vadasi ||
verses.en:
Let Pusan take thy hand and hence conduct thee; may the two Asvins on their car transport thee.
Go to the house to be the household's mistress and speak as lady ito thy gathered people.

verses.sa:
इह प्रियं प्रजया ते समृध्यतामस्मिन्गृहे गार्हपत्याय जागृहि ।
एना पत्या तन्वं सं सृजस्वाधा जिव्री विदथमा वदाथः ॥
verses.rom:
iha priyam prajaya te samridhyatamasmingrihe garhapatyaya jagrihi |
ena patya tanvam sam srijasvadha jivri vidathama vadathah ||
verses.en:
Happy be thou and prosper with thy children here: be vigilant to rule thy household in this home.
Closely unite thy body with this; man, thy lord. So shall ye, full of years, address your company.

verses.sa:
नीललोहितं भवति कृत्यासक्तिर्व्यज्यते ।
एधन्ते अस्या ज्ञातयः पतिर्बन्धेषु बध्यते ॥
verses.rom:
nilalohitam bhavati krityasaktirvyajyate |
edhante asya jnatayah patirbandheshu badhyate ||
verses.en:
Her hue is blue and red: the fiend who clingeth close is driven off.
Well thrive the kinsmen of this bride the husband is bound fast in bonds.

verses.sa:
परा देहि शामुल्यं ब्रह्मभ्यो वि भजा वसु ।
कृत्यैषा पद्वती भूत्व्या जाया विशते पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
para dehi shamulyam brahmabhyo vi bhaja vasu |
krityaisha padvati bhutvya jaya vishate patim ||
verses.en:
Give thou the woollen robe away: deal treasure to the Brahman priests.
This female fiend hath got her feet, and as a wife attends her lord.

verses.sa:
अश्रीरा तनूर्भवति रुशती पापयामुया ।
पतिर्यद्वध्वो वाससा स्वमङ्गमभिधित्सते ॥
verses.rom:
ashrira tanurbhavati rushati papayamuya |
patiryadvadhvo vasasa svamangamabhidhitsate ||
verses.en:
Unlovely is his body when it glistens with this wicked fiend,
What time the husband wraps about his limbs the garment of his wife.

verses.sa:
ये वध्वश्चन्द्रं वहतुं यक्ष्मा यन्ति जनादनु ।
पुनस्तान्यज्ञिया देवा नयन्तु यत आगताः ॥
verses.rom:
ye vadhvashchandram vahatum yakshma yanti janadanu |
punastanyajniya deva nayantu yata agatah ||
verses.en:
Consumptions, from her people, which follow the bride's resplendent train,-
These let the Holy Gods again bear to the place from which they came.

verses.sa:
मा विदन्परिपन्थिनो य आसीदन्ति दम्पती ।
सुगेभिर्दुर्गमतीतामप द्रान्त्वरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ma vidanparipanthino ya asidanti dampati |
sugebhirdurgamatitamapa drantvaratayah ||
verses.en:
Let not the highway thieves who lie in ambush find the wedded pair.
By pleasant ways let them escape the danger, and let foes depart.

verses.sa:
सुमङ्गलीरियं वधूरिमां समेत पश्यत ।
सौभाग्यमस्यै दत्त्वायाथास्तं वि परेतन ॥
verses.rom:
sumangaliriyam vadhurimam sameta pashyata |
saubhagyamasyai dattvayathastam vi paretana ||
verses.en:
Signs of good fortune mark the bride come all of you and look at her.
Wish her prosperity, and then return unto your homes again.

verses.sa:
तृष्टमेतत्कटुकमेतदपाष्ठवद्विषवन्नैतदत्तवे ।
सूर्यां यो ब्रह्मा विद्यात्स इद्वाधूयमर्हति ॥
verses.rom:
trishtametatkatukametadapashthavadvishavannaitadattave |
suryam yo brahma vidyatsa idvadhuyamarhati ||
verses.en:
Pungent is this, and bitter this, filled, as it were, with arrow-barbs, Empoisoned and not fit for use.
The Brahman who knows Surya well deserves the garment of the bride.

verses.sa:
आशसनं विशसनमथो अधिविकर्तनम् ।
सूर्यायाः पश्य रूपाणि तानि ब्रह्मा तु शुन्धति ॥
verses.rom:
ashasanam vishasanamatho adhivikartanam |
suryayah pashya rupani tani brahma tu shundhati ||
verses.en:
The fringe, the cloth that decks her head, and then the triply parted robe,-
Behold the hues which Surya wears these doth the Brahman purify.

verses.sa:
गृभ्णामि ते सौभगत्वाय हस्तं मया पत्या जरदष्टिर्यथासः ।
भगो अर्यमा सविता पुरंधिर्मह्यं त्वादुर्गार्हपत्याय देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
gribhnami te saubhagatvaya hastam maya patya jaradashtiryathasah |
bhago aryama savita puramdhirmahyam tvadurgarhapatyaya devah ||
verses.en:
I take thy hand in mine for happy fortune that thou mayst reach old age with me thy husband.
Gods, Aryaman, Bhaga, Savitar, Purandhi, have given thee to be my household's mistress.

verses.sa:
तां पूषञ्छिवतमामेरयस्व यस्यां बीजं मनुष्या वपन्ति ।
या न ऊरू उशती विश्रयाते यस्यामुशन्तः प्रहराम शेपम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam pushanchhivatamamerayasva yasyam bijam manushya vapanti |
ya na uru ushati vishrayate yasyamushantah praharama shepam ||
verses.en:
O Pusan, send her on as most auspicious, her who shall be the sharer of my pleasures;
Her who shall twine her loving arms about me, and welcome all my love and mine embraces.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमग्रे पर्यवहन्सूर्यां वहतुना सह ।
पुनः पतिभ्यो जायां दा अग्ने प्रजया सह ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyamagre paryavahansuryam vahatuna saha |
punah patibhyo jayam da agne prajaya saha ||
verses.en:
For thee, with bridal train, they, first, escorted Surya to her home.
Give to the husband in return, Agni, the wife with progeny.

verses.sa:
पुनः पत्नीमग्निरदादायुषा सह वर्चसा ।
दीर्घायुरस्या यः पतिर्जीवाति शरदः शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
punah patnimagniradadayusha saha varchasa |
dirghayurasya yah patirjivati sharadah shatam ||
verses.en:
Agni hath given the bride again with splendour and with ample life.
Long lived be he who is her lord; a hundred autumns let him live.

verses.sa:
सोमः प्रथमो विविदे गन्धर्वो विविद उत्तरः ।*
तृतीयो अग्निष्टे पतिस्तुरीयस्ते मनुष्यजाः ॥
verses.rom:
somah prathamo vivide gandharvo vivida uttarah |*
tritiyo agnishte patisturiyaste manushyajah ||
verses.en:
Soma obtained her first of all; next the Gandharva was her lord.
Agni was thy third husband: now one born of woman is thy fourth.

verses.sa:
सोमो ददद्गन्धर्वाय गन्धर्वो दददग्नये ।
रयिं च पुत्राँश्चादादग्निर्मह्यमथो इमाम् ॥
verses.rom:
somo dadadgandharvaya gandharvo dadadagnaye |
rayim cha putranshchadadagnirmahyamatho imam ||
verses.en:
Soma to the Gandharva, and to Agni the Gandharva gave:
And Agni hath bestowed on me riches and sons and this my spouse.

verses.sa:
इहैव स्तं मा वि यौष्टं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतम् ।
क्रीळन्तौ पुत्रैर्नप्तृभिर्मोदमानौ स्वे गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva stam ma vi yaushtam vishvamayurvyashnutam |
krilantau putrairnaptribhirmodamanau sve grihe ||
verses.en:
Be ye not parted; dwell ye here reach the full time of human life.
With sons and grandsons sport and play, rejoicing in your own abode.

verses.sa:
आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिराजरसाय समनक्त्वर्यमा ।
अदुर्मङ्गलीः पतिलोकमा विश शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
a nah prajam janayatu prajapatirajarasaya samanaktvaryama |
adurmangalih patilokama visha sham no bhava dvipade sham chatushpade ||
verses.en:
So may Prajapati bring children forth to us; may Aryaman adorn us till old age come nigh.
