Not inauspicious enter thou thy husband's house: bring blessing to our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
अघोरचक्षुरपतिघ्न्येधि शिवा पशुभ्यः सुमनाः सुवर्चाः ।
वीरसूर्देवकामा स्योना शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
aghorachakshurapatighnyedhi shiva pashubhyah sumanah suvarchah |
virasurdevakama syona sham no bhava dvipade sham chatushpade ||
verses.en:
Not evil-eyed, no slayer of thy husband, bring weal to cattle, radiant, gentlehearted;
Loving the Gods, delightful, bearing heroes, bring blessing to our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
इमां त्वमिन्द्र मीढ्वः सुपुत्रां सुभगां कृणु ।
दशास्यां पुत्राना धेहि पतिमेकादशं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
imam tvamindra midhvah suputram subhagam krinu |
dashasyam putrana dhehi patimekadasham kridhi ||
verses.en:
O Bounteous Indra, make this bride blest in her sons and fortunate.
Vouchsafe to her ten sons, and make her husband the eleventh man.

verses.sa:
सम्राज्ञी श्वशुरे भव सम्राज्ञी श्वश्र्वां भव ।
ननान्दरि सम्राज्ञी भव सम्राज्ञी अधि देवृषु ॥
verses.rom:
samrajni shvashure bhava samrajni shvashrvam bhava |
nanandari samrajni bhava samrajni adhi devrishu ||
verses.en:
Over thy husband's father and thy husband's mother bear full sway.
Over the sister of thy lord, over his brothers rule supreme.

verses.sa:
समञ्जन्तु विश्वे देवाः समापो हृदयानि नौ ।
सं मातरिश्वा सं धाता समु देष्ट्री दधातु नौ ॥
verses.rom:
samanjantu vishve devah samapo hridayani nau |
sam matarishva sam dhata samu deshtri dadhatu nau ||
verses.en:
So may the Universal Gods, so may the Waters join our hearts.
May Matarisvan, Dhatar, and Destri together bind us close.

verses.sa:
वि हि सोतोरसृक्षत नेन्द्रं देवममंसत ।
यत्रामदद्वृषाकपिरर्यः पुष्टेषु मत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
vi hi sotorasrikshata nendram devamamamsata |
yatramadadvrishakapiraryah pushteshu matsakha vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
परा हीन्द्र धावसि वृषाकपेरति व्यथिः ।
नो अह प्र विन्दस्यन्यत्र सोमपीतये विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
para hindra dhavasi vrishakaperati vyathih |
no aha pra vindasyanyatra somapitaye vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
किमयं त्वां वृषाकपिश्चकार हरितो मृगः ।
यस्मा इरस्यसीदु न्वर्यो वा पुष्टिमद्वसु विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
kimayam tvam vrishakapishchakara harito mrigah |
yasma irasyasidu nvaryo va pushtimadvasu vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
यमिमं त्वं वृषाकपिं प्रियमिन्द्राभिरक्षसि ।
श्वा न्वस्य जम्भिषदपि कर्णे वराहयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
yamimam tvam vrishakapim priyamindrabhirakshasi |
shva nvasya jambhishadapi karne varahayurvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
प्रिया तष्टानि मे कपिर्व्यक्ता व्यदूदुषत् ।
शिरो न्वस्य राविषं न सुगं दुष्कृते भुवं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
priya tashtani me kapirvyakta vyadudushat |
shiro nvasya ravisham na sugam dushkrite bhuvam vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
न मत्स्त्री सुभसत्तरा न सुयाशुतरा भुवत् ।
न मत्प्रतिच्यवीयसी न सक्थ्युद्यमीयसी विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
na matstri subhasattara na suyashutara bhuvat |
na matpratichyaviyasi na sakthyudyamiyasi vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
उवे अम्ब सुलाभिके यथेवाङ्ग भविष्यति ।
भसन्मे अम्ब सक्थि मे शिरो मे वीव हृष्यति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
uve amba sulabhike yathevanga bhavishyati |
bhasanme amba sakthi me shiro me viva hrishyati vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
किं सुबाहो स्वङ्गुरे पृथुष्टो पृथुजाघने ।
किं शूरपत्नि नस्त्वमभ्यमीषि वृषाकपिं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
kim subaho svangure prithushto prithujaghane |
kim shurapatni nastvamabhyamishi vrishakapim vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
अवीरामिव मामयं शरारुरभि मन्यते ।
उताहमस्मि वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी मरुत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
aviramiva mamayam shararurabhi manyate |
utahamasmi virinindrapatni marutsakha vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
संहोत्रं स्म पुरा नारी समनं वाव गच्छति ।
वेधा ऋतस्य वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी महीयते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
samhotram sma pura nari samanam vava gachchhati |
vedha ritasya virinindrapatni mahiyate vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्राणीमासु नारिषु सुभगामहमश्रवम् ।
नह्यस्या अपरं चन जरसा मरते पतिर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
indranimasu narishu subhagamahamashravam |
nahyasya aparam chana jarasa marate patirvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
नाहमिन्द्राणि रारण सख्युर्वृषाकपेरृते ।
यस्येदमप्यं हविः प्रियं देवेषु गच्छति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
nahamindrani rarana sakhyurvrishakaperrite |
yasyedamapyam havih priyam deveshu gachchhati vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
वृषाकपायि रेवति सुपुत्र आदु सुस्नुषे ।
घसत्त इन्द्र उक्षणः प्रियं काचित्करं हविर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishakapayi revati suputra adu susnushe |
ghasatta indra ukshanah priyam kachitkaram havirvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
उक्ष्णो हि मे पञ्चदश साकं पचन्ति विंशतिम् ।
उताहमद्मि पीव इदुभा कुक्षी पृणन्ति मे विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
ukshno hi me panchadasha sakam pachanti vimshatim |
utahamadmi piva idubha kukshi prinanti me vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
वृषभो न तिग्मशृङ्गोऽन्तर्यूथेषु रोरुवत् ।
मन्थस्त इन्द्र शं हृदे यं ते सुनोति भावयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishabho na tigmashringo'ntaryutheshu roruvat |
manthasta indra sham hride yam te sunoti bhavayurvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
न सेशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या कपृत् ।
सेदीशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
na seshe yasya rambate'ntara sakthya kaprit |
sedishe yasya romasham nishedusho vijrimbhate vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
न सेशे यस्य रोमशं निषेदुषो विजृम्भते ।
सेदीशे यस्य रम्बतेऽन्तरा सक्थ्या कपृद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
na seshe yasya romasham nishedusho vijrimbhate |
sedishe yasya rambate'ntara sakthya kapridvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
अयमिन्द्र वृषाकपिः परस्वन्तं हतं विदत् ।
असिं सूनां नवं चरुमादेधस्यान आचितं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamindra vrishakapih parasvantam hatam vidat |
asim sunam navam charumadedhasyana achitam vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
अयमेमि विचाकशद्विचिन्वन्दासमार्यम् ।
पिबामि पाकसुत्वनोऽभि धीरमचाकशं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamemi vichakashadvichinvandasamaryam |
pibami pakasutvano'bhi dhiramachakasham vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
धन्व च यत्कृन्तत्रं च कति स्वित्ता वि योजना ।
नेदीयसो वृषाकपेऽस्तमेहि गृहाँ उप विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
dhanva cha yatkrintatram cha kati svitta vi yojana |
nediyaso vrishakape'stamehi grihan upa vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
पुनरेहि वृषाकपे सुविता कल्पयावहै ।
य एष स्वप्ननंशनोऽस्तमेषि पथा पुनर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
punarehi vrishakape suvita kalpayavahai |
ya esha svapnanamshano'stameshi patha punarvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
यदुदञ्चो वृषाकपे गृहमिन्द्राजगन्तन ।
क्व स्य पुल्वघो मृगः कमगञ्जनयोपनो विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
yadudancho vrishakape grihamindrajagantana |
kva sya pulvagho mrigah kamaganjanayopano vishvasmadindra uttarah ||

verses.sa:
पर्शुर्ह नाम मानवी साकं ससूव विंशतिम् ।
भद्रं भल त्यस्या अभूद्यस्या उदरमामयद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
parshurha nama manavi sakam sasuva vimshatim |
bhadram bhala tyasya abhudyasya udaramamayadvishvasmadindra uttarah ||

prose.en:
1. MEN have abstained from pouring juice they count not Indra as a God.
Where at the votary's store my friend Vrsakapi hath drunk his fill. Supreme is Indra over all.

2. Thou, Indra, heedless passest by the ill Vrsakapi hath wrought;
Yet nowhere else thou findest place wherein to drink the Soma juice. Supreme is Indra over all.

3. What hath he done to injure thee, this tawny beast Vrsakapi,
With whom thou art so angry now? What is the votary's foodful store? Supreme is Indra over all.

4. Soon may the hound who hunts the boar seize him and bite him in the car,
O Indra, that Vrsakapi whom thou protectest as a friend, Supreme is Indra over all.

5. Kapi hath marred the beauteous things, all deftly wrought, that were my joy.
In pieces will I rend his head; the sinner's portion shall be woe. Supreme is Indra over all.

6. No Dame hath ampler charms than 1, or greater wealth of love's delights.
None with more ardour offers all her beauty to her lord's embrace. Supreme is Indra over all.

7. Mother whose love is quickly won, I say what verily will be.
My breast, O Mother, and my head and both my hips seem quivering. Supreme is Indra over all.

8. Dame with the lovely hands and arms, with broad hair-plaits add ample hips,
Why, O thou Hero's wife, art thou angry with our Vrsakapi? Supreme is Indra over all.

9. This noxious creature looks on me as one bereft of hero's love,
Yet Heroes for my sons have I, the Maruts' Friend and Indra's Queen. Supreme is Indra over all.

10. From olden time the matron goes to feast and general sacrifice.
Mother of Heroes, Indra's Queen, the rite's ordainer is extolled. Supreme is Indra over all.

11. So have I heard Indrani called most fortunate among these Dames,
For never shall her Consort die in future time through length of days. Supreme is Indra overall.

12. Never, Indralni, have I joyed without my friend Vrsakapi,
Whose welcome offering here, made pure with water, goeth to the Gods. Supreme is Indra over all.

13. Wealthy Vrsakapayi, blest with sons and consorts of thy sons,

14. The planets and satellites whose motion is seen to be destroyed in the sky are thirty-five.
In the beginning, all the planets and satellites were dependent on the last part of Revati Tara, they started moving according to the divine law, separated from Revati Tara.

15. Like as a bull with pointed horn, loud bellowing amid the herds,
Sweet to thine heart, O Indra, is the brew which she who tends thee pours. Supreme is Indra over all.

18. O Indra this Vrsakapi hath found a slain wild animal,
Dresser, and new-made pan, and knife, and wagon with a load of wood. Supreme is Indra over all.

19. Distinguishing the Dasa and the Arya, viewing all, I go.
I look upon the wise, and drink the simple votary's Soma juice. Supreme is Indra over all.

20. The desert plains and steep descents, how many leagues in length they spread!
Go to the nearest houses, go unto thine home, Vrsakapi. Supreme is Indra over all.

21. Turn thee again Vrsakapi: we twain will bring thee happiness.
Thou goest homeward on thy way along this path which leads to sleep. Supreme is Indra over all.

22. When, Indra and Vrsakapi, ye travelled upward to your home,
Where was that noisome beast, to whom went it, the beast that troubles man? Supreme is Indra over all.

23. Daughter of Manu, Parsu bare a score of children at a birth.
Her portion verily was bliss although her burthen caused her grief.

verses.sa:
रक्षोहणं वाजिनमा जिघर्मि मित्रं प्रथिष्ठमुप यामि शर्म ।
शिशानो अग्निः क्रतुभिः समिद्धः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
rakshohanam vajinama jigharmi mitram prathishthamupa yami sharma |
shishano agnih kratubhih samiddhah sa no diva sa rishah patu naktam ||
verses.en:
I BALM with oil the mighty Raksas-slayer; to the most famous Friend I come for shelter
Enkindled, sharpened by our rites, may Agni protect us in the day and night from evil.

verses.sa:
अयोदंष्ट्रो अर्चिषा यातुधानानुप स्पृश जातवेदः समिद्धः ।
आ जिह्वया मूरदेवान्रभस्व क्रव्यादो वृक्त्व्यपि धत्स्वासन् ॥
verses.rom:
ayodamshtro archisha yatudhananupa sprisha jatavedah samiddhah |
a jihvaya muradevanrabhasva kravyado vriktvyapi dhatsvasan ||
verses.en:
O Jatavedas with the teeth of iron, enkindled with thy flame attack the demons.
Seize with thy longue the foolish gods' adorers: rend, put within thy mouth the raw-flesh caters.

verses.sa:
उभोभयाविन्नुप धेहि दंष्ट्रा हिंस्रः शिशानोऽवरं परं च ।
उतान्तरिक्षे परि याहि राजञ्जम्भैः सं धेह्यभि यातुधानान् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhobhayavinnupa dhehi damshtra himsrah shishano'varam param cha |
utantarikshe pari yahi rajanjambhaih sam dhehyabhi yatudhanan ||
verses.en:
Apply thy teeth, the upper and the lower, thou who hast both, enkindled and destroying.
Roam also in the air, O King, around us, and with thy jaws assail the wicked spirits.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैरिषूः संनममानो अग्ने वाचा शल्याँ अशनिभिर्दिहानः ।
ताभिर्विध्य हृदये यातुधानान्प्रतीचो बाहून्प्रति भङ्ध्येषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairishuh samnamamano agne vacha shalyan ashanibhirdihanah |
tabhirvidhya hridaye yatudhananpraticho bahunprati bhandhyesham ||
verses.en:
Bending thy shafts through sacrifices, Agni, whetting their points with song as if with whetstones,
Pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas, and break their arms uplifted to attack thee.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वचं यातुधानस्य भिन्धि हिंस्राशनिर्हरसा हन्त्वेनम् ।
प्र पर्वाणि जातवेदः शृणीहि क्रव्यात्क्रविष्णुर्वि चिनोतु वृक्णम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne tvacham yatudhanasya bhindhi himsrashanirharasa hantvenam |
pra parvani jatavedah shrinihi kravyatkravishnurvi chinotu vriknam ||
verses.en:
Pierce through the Yatudhana's skin, O Agni; let the destroying dart with fire consume him.
Rend his joints, Jatavedas, let the cater of flesh, flesh-seeking, track his mangled body.

verses.sa:
यत्रेदानीं पश्यसि जातवेदस्तिष्ठन्तमग्न उत वा चरन्तम् ।
यद्वान्तरिक्षे पथिभिः पतन्तं तमस्ता विध्य शर्वा शिशानः ॥
verses.rom:
yatredanim pashyasi jatavedastishthantamagna uta va charantam |
yadvantarikshe pathibhih patantam tamasta vidhya sharva shishanah ||
verses.en:
Where now thou seest Agni Jatavedas, one of these demons standing still or roaming,
Or flying on those paths in air's mid region, sharpen the shaft and as an archer pierce him.

verses.sa:
उतालब्धं स्पृणुहि जातवेद आलेभानादृष्टिभिर्यातुधानात् ।
अग्ने पूर्वो नि जहि शोशुचान आमादः क्ष्विङ्कास्तमदन्त्वेनीः ॥
verses.rom:
utalabdham sprinuhi jataveda alebhanadrishtibhiryatudhanat |
agne purvo ni jahi shoshuchana amadah kshvinkastamadantvenih ||
verses.en:
Tear from the evil spirit, Jatavedas, what he hath seized and with his spears hath captured.
Blazing before him strike him down, O Agni; let spotted carrion-eating kites devour him.

verses.sa:
इह प्र ब्रूहि यतमः सो अग्ने यो यातुधानो य इदं कृणोति ।
तमा रभस्व समिधा यविष्ठ नृचक्षसश्चक्षुषे रन्धयैनम् ॥
verses.rom:
iha pra bruhi yatamah so agne yo yatudhano ya idam krinoti |
tama rabhasva samidha yavishtha nrichakshasashchakshushe randhayainam ||
verses.en:
Here tell this forth, O Agni: whosoever is, he himself, or acteth as, a demon,
Him grasp, O thou Most Youthful, with thy fuel. to the Mati-seer's eye give him as booty.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णेनाग्ने चक्षुषा रक्ष यज्ञं प्राञ्चं वसुभ्यः प्र णय प्रचेतः ।
हिंस्रं रक्षांस्यभि शोशुचानं मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना नृचक्षः ॥
verses.rom:
tikshnenagne chakshusha raksha yajnam prancham vasubhyah pra naya prachetah |
himsram rakshamsyabhi shoshuchanam ma tva dabhanyatudhana nrichakshah ||
verses.en:
With keen glance guard the sacrifice, O Agni: thou Sage, conduct it onward to the Vasus.
Let not the fiends, O Man-beholder, harm thee burning against the Raksasas to slay them.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षा रक्षः परि पश्य विक्षु तस्य त्रीणि प्रति शृणीह्यग्रा ।
तस्याग्ने पृष्टीर्हरसा शृणीहि त्रेधा मूलं यातुधानस्य वृश्च ॥
verses.rom:
nrichaksha rakshah pari pashya vikshu tasya trini prati shrinihyagra |
tasyagne prishtirharasa shrinihi tredha mulam yatudhanasya vrishcha ||
verses.en:
Look on the fiend mid men, as Man-beholder: rend thou his three extremities in pieces.
Demolish with thy flame his ribs, O Agni, the Yatudhana's root destroy thou triply.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्यातुधानः प्रसितिं त एत्वृतं यो अग्ने अनृतेन हन्ति ।
तमर्चिषा स्फूर्जयञ्जातवेदः समक्षमेनं गृणते नि वृङ्धि ॥
verses.rom:
triryatudhanah prasitim ta etvritam yo agne anritena hanti |
tamarchisha sphurjayanjatavedah samakshamenam grinate ni vrindhi ||
verses.en:
Thrice, Agni, let thy noose surround the demon who with his falsehood injures Holy Order.
Loud roaring with thy flame, O Jatavedas, crush him and cast him down before the singer.

verses.sa:
तदग्ने चक्षुः प्रति धेहि रेभे शफारुजं येन पश्यसि यातुधानम् ।
अथर्ववज्ज्योतिषा दैव्येन सत्यं धूर्वन्तमचितं न्योष ॥
verses.rom:
tadagne chakshuh prati dhehi rebhe shapharujam yena pashyasi yatudhanam |
atharvavajjyotisha daivyena satyam dhurvantamachitam nyosha ||
verses.en:
Lead thou the worshipper that eye, O Agni, wherewith thou lookest on the hoof-armed demon.
With light celestial in Atharvan's manner burn up the foot who ruins truth with falsehood.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने अद्य मिथुना शपातो यद्वाचस्तृष्टं जनयन्त रेभाः ।
मन्योर्मनसः शरव्या जायते या तया विध्य हृदये यातुधानान् ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne adya mithuna shapato yadvachastrishtam janayanta rebhah |
manyormanasah sharavya jayate ya taya vidhya hridaye yatudhanan ||
verses.en:
Agni, what curse the pair this day have uttered, what heated word the worshippers have spoken,
Each arrowy taunt sped from the angry spirit,-pierce to the heart therewith the Yatudhanas.

verses.sa:
परा शृणीहि तपसा यातुधानान्पराग्ने रक्षो हरसा शृणीहि ।
परार्चिषा मूरदेवाञ्छृणीहि परासुतृपो अभि शोशुचानः ॥
verses.rom:
para shrinihi tapasa yatudhananparagne raksho harasa shrinihi |
pararchisha muradevanchhrinihi parasutripo abhi shoshuchanah ||
verses.en:
With fervent heat exterminate the demons; destroy the fiends with burning flame, O Agni.
Destroy with fire the foolish gods' adorers; blaze and destroy the insatiable monsters.

verses.sa:
पराद्य देवा वृजिनं शृणन्तु प्रत्यगेनं शपथा यन्तु तृष्टाः ।
वाचास्तेनं शरव ऋच्छन्तु मर्मन्विश्वस्यैतु प्रसितिं यातुधानः ॥
verses.rom:
paradya deva vrijinam shrinantu pratyagenam shapatha yantu trishtah |
vachastenam sharava richchhantu marmanvishvasyaitu prasitim yatudhanah ||
verses.en:
May Gods destroy this day the evil-doer may each hot curse of his return and blast him.
Let arrows pierce the liar in his vitals, and Visva's net enclose the Yatudhana.

verses.sa:
यः पौरुषेयेण क्रविषा समङ्क्ते यो अश्व्येन पशुना यातुधानः ।
यो अघ्न्याया भरति क्षीरमग्ने तेषां शीर्षाणि हरसापि वृश्च ॥
verses.rom:
yah paurusheyena kravisha samankte yo ashvyena pashuna yatudhanah |
yo aghnyaya bharati kshiramagne tesham shirshani harasapi vrishcha ||
verses.en:
The fiend who smears himself with flesh of cattle, with flesh of horses and of human bodies,
Who steals the milch-cow's milk away, O Agni,-tear off the heads of such with fiery fury.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरीणं पय उस्रियायास्तस्य माशीद्यातुधानो नृचक्षः ।
पीयूषमग्ने यतमस्तितृप्सात्तं प्रत्यञ्चमर्चिषा विध्य मर्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsarinam paya usriyayastasya mashidyatudhano nrichakshah |
piyushamagne yatamastitripsattam pratyanchamarchisha vidhya marman ||
verses.en:
The cow gives milk each year, O Man-regarder: let not the Yatudhana ever taste it.
If one would glut him with the biesting, Agni, pierce with thy flame his vitals as he meets thee.

verses.sa:
विषं गवां यातुधानाः पिबन्त्वा वृश्च्यन्तामदितये दुरेवाः ।
परैनान्देवः सविता ददातु परा भागमोषधीनां जयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
visham gavam yatudhanah pibantva vrishchyantamaditaye durevah |
parainandevah savita dadatu para bhagamoshadhinam jayantam ||
verses.en:
Let the fiends drink the poison of the cattle; may Aditi cast off the evildoers.
May the God Savitar give them up to ruin, and be their share of plants and herbs denied them.

verses.sa:
सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षांसि पृतनासु जिग्युः ।
अनु दह सहमूरान्क्रव्यादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः ॥
verses.rom:
sanadagne mrinasi yatudhananna tva rakshamsi pritanasu jigyuh |
anu daha sahamurankravyado ma te hetya mukshata daivyayah ||
verses.en:
Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Raksasas in fight o'ercome thee.
Burn up the foolish ones, the flesh-devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अधरादुदक्तात्त्वं पश्चादुत रक्षा पुरस्तात् ।
प्रति ते ते अजरासस्तपिष्ठा अघशंसं शोशुचतो दहन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne adharadudaktattvam pashchaduta raksha purastat |
prati te te ajarasastapishtha aghashamsam shoshuchato dahantu ||
verses.en:
Guard us, O Agni, from above and under, protect us from behind us and before us;
And may thy flames, most fierce and never wasting, glowing with fervent heat, consume the sinner.

verses.sa:
पश्चात्पुरस्तादधरादुदक्तात्कविः काव्येन परि पाहि राजन् ।
सखे सखायमजरो जरिम्णेऽग्ने मर्ताँ अमर्त्यस्त्वं नः ॥
verses.rom:
pashchatpurastadadharadudaktatkavih kavyena pari pahi rajan |
sakhe sakhayamajaro jarimne'gne martan amartyastvam nah ||
verses.en:
From rear, from front, from under, from above us, O King, protect us as a Sage with wisdom.
Guard to old age thy friend, O Friend, Eternal: O Agni, as Immortal, guard us mortals.

verses.sa:
परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि ।
धृषद्वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावताम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari tvagne puram vayam vipram sahasya dhimahi |
dhrishadvarnam divedive hantaram bhanguravatam ||
verses.en:
We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage,
Of hero lineage, day by day, destroyer of our treacherous foes.

verses.sa:
विषेण भङ्गुरावतः प्रति ष्म रक्षसो दह ।
अग्ने तिग्मेन शोचिषा तपुरग्राभिरृष्टिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishena bhanguravatah prati shma rakshaso daha |
agne tigmena shochisha tapuragrabhirrishtibhih ||
verses.en:
Burn with thy poison turned against the treacherous brood of Raksasas,
O Agni, with thy sharpened glow, with lances armed with points of flame.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्ने मिथुना दह यातुधाना किमीदिना ।
सं त्वा शिशामि जागृह्यदब्धं विप्र मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagne mithuna daha yatudhana kimidina |
sam tva shishami jagrihyadabdham vipra manmabhih ||
verses.en:
Burn thou the paired Kimidins, burn, Agni, the Yatudhana pairs.
I sharpen thee, Infallible, with hymns. O Sage, be vigilant.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणीहि विश्वतः प्रति ।
यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं वि रुज वीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagne harasa harah shrinihi vishvatah prati |
yatudhanasya rakshaso balam vi ruja viryam ||
verses.en:
Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame demolish them on every side.
Break thou the Yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the Raksasa.

verses.sa:
हविष्पान्तमजरं स्वर्विदि दिविस्पृश्याहुतं जुष्टमग्नौ ।
तस्य भर्मणे भुवनाय देवा धर्मणे कं स्वधया पप्रथन्त ॥
verses.rom:
havishpantamajaram svarvidi divisprishyahutam jushtamagnau |
tasya bharmane bhuvanaya deva dharmane kam svadhaya paprathanta ||
verses.en:
DEAR, ageless sacrificial drink is offered in light-discovering, heaven-pervading Agni.
The Gods spread forth through his Celestial Nature, that he might bear the world up and sustain it.

verses.sa:
गीर्णं भुवनं तमसापगूळ्हमाविः स्वरभवज्जाते अग्नौ ।
तस्य देवाः पृथिवी द्यौरुतापोऽरणयन्नोषधीः सख्ये अस्य ॥
verses.rom:
girnam bhuvanam tamasapagulhamavih svarabhavajjate agnau |
tasya devah prithivi dyaurutapo'ranayannoshadhih sakhye asya ||
verses.en:
The world was swallowed and concealed in darkness: Agni was born, and light became apparent.
The Deities, the broad earth, and the heavens, and plants, and waters gloried in his friendship.

verses.sa:
देवेभिर्न्विषितो यज्ञियेभिरग्निं स्तोषाण्यजरं बृहन्तम् ।
यो भानुना पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामाततान रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ॥
verses.rom:
devebhirnvishito yajniyebhiragnim stoshanyajaram brihantam |
yo bhanuna prithivim dyamutemamatatana rodasi antariksham ||
verses.en:
Inspired by Gods who claim our adoration, I now will laud Eternal Lofty Agni,
Him who hath spread abroad the earth with lustre, this heaven, and both the worlds, and air's mid-region.

verses.sa:
यो होतासीत्प्रथमो देवजुष्टो यं समाञ्जन्नाज्येना वृणानाः ।
स पतत्रीत्वरं स्था जगद्यच्छ्वात्रमग्निरकृणोज्जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
yo hotasitprathamo devajushto yam samanjannajyena vrinanah |
sa patatritvaram stha jagadyachchhvatramagnirakrinojjatavedah ||
verses.en:
Earliest Priest whom all the Gods accepted, and chose him, and anointed him with butter,
He swiftly made all things that fly, stand, travel, all that hath motion, Agni Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
यज्जातवेदो भुवनस्य मूर्धन्नतिष्ठो अग्ने सह रोचनेन ।
तं त्वाहेम मतिभिर्गीर्भिरुक्थैः स यज्ञियो अभवो रोदसिप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
yajjatavedo bhuvanasya murdhannatishtho agne saha rochanena |
tam tvahema matibhirgirbhirukthaih sa yajniyo abhavo rodasiprah ||
verses.en:
Because thou, Agni, Jatavedas, stoodest at the world's head with thy refulgent splendour,
We sent thee forth with hymns and songs and praises: thou filledst heaven and earth, God meet for worship.

verses.sa:
मूर्धा भुवो भवति नक्तमग्निस्ततः सूर्यो जायते प्रातरुद्यन् ।
मायामू तु यज्ञियानामेतामपो यत्तूर्णिश्चरति प्रजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
murdha bhuvo bhavati naktamagnistatah suryo jayate pratarudyan |
mayamu tu yajniyanametamapo yatturnishcharati prajanan ||
verses.en:
Head of the world is Agni in the night-time; then, as the Sun, at morn springs up and rises.
Then to his task goes the prompt Priest foreknowing the wondrous power of Gods who must be honoured.

verses.sa:
दृशेन्यो यो महिना समिद्धोऽरोचत दिवियोनिर्विभावा ।
तस्मिन्नग्नौ सूक्तवाकेन देवा हविर्विश्व आजुहवुस्तनूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
drishenyo yo mahina samiddho'rochata diviyonirvibhava |
tasminnagnau suktavakena deva havirvishva ajuhavustanupah ||
verses.en:
Lovely is he who, kindled in his greatness, hath shone forth, seated in the heavens, refulgent.
With resonant hymns all Gods who guard our bodies have offered up oblation in this Agni.

verses.sa:
सूक्तवाकं प्रथममादिदग्निमादिद्धविरजनयन्त देवाः ।
स एषां यज्ञो अभवत्तनूपास्तं द्यौर्वेद तं पृथिवी तमापः ॥
verses.rom:
suktavakam prathamamadidagnimadiddhavirajanayanta devah |
sa esham yajno abhavattanupastam dyaurveda tam prithivi tamapah ||
verses.en:
First the Gods brought the hymnal into being; then they engendered Agni, then oblation.
He was their sacrifice that guards our bodies: him the heavens know, the earth, the waters know him.

verses.sa:
यं देवासोऽजनयन्ताग्निं यस्मिन्नाजुहवुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
सो अर्चिषा पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामृजूयमानो अतपन्महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yam devaso'janayantagnim yasminnajuhavurbhuvanani vishva |
so archisha prithivim dyamutemamrijuyamano atapanmahitva ||
verses.en:
He, Agni, whom the Gods have generated, in whom they offered up all worlds and creatures,
He with his bright glow heated earth and heaven, urging himself right onward in his grandeur.

verses.sa:
स्तोमेन हि दिवि देवासो अग्निमजीजनञ्छक्तिभी रोदसिप्राम् ।
तमू अकृण्वन्त्रेधा भुवे कं स ओषधीः पचति विश्वरूपाः ॥
verses.rom:
stomena hi divi devaso agnimajijananchhaktibhi rodasipram |
tamu akrinvantredha bhuve kam sa oshadhih pachati vishvarupah ||
verses.en:
Then by the laud the Gods engendered Agni in heaven, who fills both worlds through strength and vigour.
They made him to appear in threefold essence: he ripens plants of every form and nature.

verses.sa:
यदेदेनमदधुर्यज्ञियासो दिवि देवाः सूर्यमादितेयम् ।
यदा चरिष्णू मिथुनावभूतामादित्प्रापश्यन्भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yadedenamadadhuryajniyaso divi devah suryamaditeyam |
yada charishnu mithunavabhutamaditprapashyanbhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en:
What time the Gods, whose due is worship, set him as Surya, Son of Aditi, in heaven,
When the Pair, ever wandering, sprang to being, all creatures that existed looked upon them.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्मा अग्निं भुवनाय देवा वैश्वानरं केतुमह्नामकृण्वन् ।
आ यस्ततानोषसो विभातीरपो ऊर्णोति तमो अर्चिषा यन् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasma agnim bhuvanaya deva vaishvanaram ketumahnamakrinvan |
a yastatanoshaso vibhatirapo urnoti tamo archisha yan ||
verses.en:
For all the world of life the Gods made Agni Vaisvanara to be the days' bright Banner,-
Him who hath spread abroad the radiant Mornings, and, coming with his light, unveils the darkness.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरं कवयो यज्ञियासोऽग्निं देवा अजनयन्नजुर्यम् ।
नक्षत्रं प्रत्नममिनच्चरिष्णु यक्षस्याध्यक्षं तविषं बृहन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaram kavayo yajniyaso'gnim deva ajanayannajuryam |
nakshatram pratnamaminachcharishnu yakshasyadhyaksham tavisham brihantam ||
verses.en:
The wise and holy Deities engendered Agni Vaisvanara whom age ne'er touches.
The Ancient Star that wanders on for ever, lofty and. strong, Lord of the Living Being.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरं विश्वहा दीदिवांसं मन्त्रैरग्निं कविमच्छा वदामः ।
यो महिम्ना परिबभूवोर्वी उतावस्तादुत देवः परस्तात् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaram vishvaha didivamsam mantrairagnim kavimachchha vadamah |
yo mahimna paribabhuvorvi utavastaduta devah parastat ||
verses.en:
We call upon the Sage with holy verses, Agni Vaisvanara the ever-beaming,
Who hath surpassed both heaven and earth in greatness: lie is a God below, a God above us.

verses.sa:
द्वे स्रुती अशृणवं पितॄणामहं देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
ताभ्यामिदं विश्वमेजत्समेति यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं च ॥
verses.rom:
dve sruti ashrinavam pitrinamaham devanamuta martyanam |
tabhyamidam vishvamejatsameti yadantara pitaram mataram cha ||
verses.en:
I have heard mention of two several pathways, ways of the Fathers and of Gods and mortals.
On these two paths each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.

verses.sa:
द्वे समीची बिभृतश्चरन्तं शीर्षतो जातं मनसा विमृष्टम् ।
स प्रत्यङ्विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थावप्रयुच्छन्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः ॥
verses.rom:
dve samichi bibhritashcharantam shirshato jatam manasa vimrishtam |
sa pratyanvishva bhuvanani tasthavaprayuchchhantaranirbhrajamanah ||
verses.en:
These two united paths bear him who journeys born from the head and pondered with the spirit
He stands directed to all things existing, hasting, unresting in his fiery splendour.

verses.sa:
यत्रा वदेते अवरः परश्च यज्ञन्योः कतरो नौ वि वेद ।
आ शेकुरित्सधमादं सखायो नक्षन्त यज्ञं क इदं वि वोचत् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra vadete avarah parashcha yajnanyoh kataro nau vi veda |
a shekuritsadhamadam sakhayo nakshanta yajnam ka idam vi vochat ||
verses.en:
Which of us twain knows where they speak together, upper and lower of the two rite-leaders?
Our friends have helped to gather our assembly. They came to sacrifice; who will announce it?

verses.sa:
कत्यग्नयः कति सूर्यासः कत्युषासः कत्यु स्विदापः ।
नोपस्पिजं वः पितरो वदामि पृच्छामि वः कवयो विद्मने कम् ॥
verses.rom:
katyagnayah kati suryasah katyushasah katyu svidapah |
nopaspijam vah pitaro vadami prichchhami vah kavayo vidmane kam ||
verses.en:
How many are the Fires and Suns in number? What is the number of the Dawns and Waters?
Not jestingly I speak to you, O Fathers. Sages, I ask you this for information.

verses.sa:
यावन्मात्रमुषसो न प्रतीकं सुपर्ण्यो वसते मातरिश्वः ।
तावद्दधात्युप यज्ञमायन्ब्राह्मणो होतुरवरो निषीदन् ॥
verses.rom:
yavanmatramushaso na pratikam suparnyo vasate matarishvah |
tavaddadhatyupa yajnamayanbrahmano hoturavaro nishidan ||
verses.en:
As great as is the fair-winged Morning's presence to him who dwells beside us, Matarisvan!
Is what the Brahman does when he approaches to sacrifice and sits below the Hotar.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं स्तवा नृतमं यस्य मह्ना विबबाधे रोचना वि ज्मो अन्तान् ।
आ यः पप्रौ चर्षणीधृद्वरोभिः प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचानो महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
indram stava nritamam yasya mahna vibabadhe rochana vi jmo antan |
a yah paprau charshanidhridvarobhih pra sindhubhyo ririchano mahitva ||
verses.en:
I WILL extol the most heroic Indra who with his might forced earth and sky asunder;
Who hath filled all with width as man's Upholder, surpassing floods and rivers in his greatness.

verses.sa:
स सूर्यः पर्युरू वरांस्येन्द्रो ववृत्याद्रथ्येव चक्रा ।
अतिष्ठन्तमपस्यं न सर्गं कृष्णा तमांसि त्विष्या जघान ॥
verses.rom:
sa suryah paryuru varamsyendro vavrityadrathyeva chakra |
atishthantamapasyam na sargam krishna tamamsi tvishya jaghana ||
verses.en:
Surya is he: throughout the wide expanses shall Indra turn him, swift as car-wheels, hither,
Like a stream resting not but ever active he hath destroyed, with light, the black hued darkness.

verses.sa:
समानमस्मा अनपावृदर्च क्ष्मया दिवो असमं ब्रह्म नव्यम् ।
वि यः पृष्ठेव जनिमान्यर्य इन्द्रश्चिकाय न सखायमीषे ॥
verses.rom:
samanamasma anapavridarcha kshmaya divo asamam brahma navyam |
vi yah prishtheva janimanyarya indrashchikaya na sakhayamishe ||
verses.en:
To him I sing a holy prayer, incessant new, matchless, common to the earth and heaven,
Who marks, as they were backs, all living creatures: ne'er doth he fail a friend, the noble Indra.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रेरयं सगरस्य बुध्नात् ।
यो अक्षेणेव चक्रिया शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
indraya giro anishitasarga apah prerayam sagarasya budhnat |
yo aksheneva chakriya shachibhirvishvaktastambha prithivimuta dyam ||
verses.en:
I will send forth my songs in flow unceasing, like water from the ocean's depth, to Indra.
Who to his car on both its sides securely hath fixed the earth and heaven as with an axle.

verses.sa:
आपान्तमन्युस्तृपलप्रभर्मा धुनिः शिमीवाञ्छरुमाँ ऋजीषी ।
सोमो विश्वान्यतसा वनानि नार्वागिन्द्रं प्रतिमानानि देभुः ॥
verses.rom:
apantamanyustripalaprabharma dhunih shimivanchharuman rijishi |
somo vishvanyatasa vanani narvagindram pratimanani debhuh ||
verses.en:
Rousing with draughts, the Shaker, rushing onward, impetuous, very strong, armed as with arrows
Is Soma; forest trees and all the bushes deceive not Indra with their offered likeness.

verses.sa:
न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी न धन्व नान्तरिक्षं नाद्रयः सोमो अक्षाः ।
यदस्य मन्युरधिनीयमानः शृणाति वीळु रुजति स्थिराणि ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya dyavaprithivi na dhanva nantariksham nadrayah somo akshah |
yadasya manyuradhiniyamanah shrinati vilu rujati sthirani ||
verses.en:
Soma hath flowed to him whom naught can equal, the earth, the heavens, the firmament, the mountains,-
When heightened in his ire his indignation shatters the firm and breaks the strong in pieces.

verses.sa:
जघान वृत्रं स्वधितिर्वनेव रुरोज पुरो अरदन्न सिन्धून् ।
बिभेद गिरिं नवमिन्न कुम्भमा गा इन्द्रो अकृणुत स्वयुग्भिः ॥
verses.rom:
jaghana vritram svadhitirvaneva ruroja puro aradanna sindhun |
bibheda girim navaminna kumbhama ga indro akrinuta svayugbhih ||
verses.en:
As an axe fells the tree so be slew Vrtra, brake down the strongholds and dug out the rivers.
He cleft the mountain like a new-made pitcher. Indra brought forth the kine with his Companions.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदृणया इन्द्र धीरोऽसिर्न पर्व वृजिना शृणासि ।
प्र ये मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम युजं न जना मिनन्ति मित्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadrinaya indra dhiro'sirna parva vrijina shrinasi |
pra ye mitrasya varunasya dhama yujam na jana minanti mitram ||
verses.en:
Wise art thou, Punisher of guilt, O Indra. The sword lops limbs, thou smitest down the sinner,
The men who injure, as it were a comrade, the lofty Law of Varuna and Mitra.

verses.sa:
प्र ये मित्रं प्रार्यमणं दुरेवाः प्र संगिरः प्र वरुणं मिनन्ति ।
न्यमित्रेषु वधमिन्द्र तुम्रं वृषन्वृषाणमरुषं शिशीहि ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye mitram praryamanam durevah pra samgirah pra varunam minanti |
nyamitreshu vadhamindra tumram vrishanvrishanamarusham shishihi ||
verses.en:
Men who lead evil lives, who break agreements, and injure Varuna, Aryaman and Mitra,-
Against these foes, O Mighty Indra, sharpen, as furious death, thy Bull of fiery colour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दिव इन्द्र ईशे पृथिव्या इन्द्रो अपामिन्द्र इत्पर्वतानाम् ।
इन्द्रो वृधामिन्द्र इन्मेधिराणामिन्द्रः क्षेमे योगे हव्य इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
indro diva indra ishe prithivya indro apamindra itparvatanam |
indro vridhamindra inmedhiranamindrah ksheme yoge havya indrah ||
verses.en:
Indra is Sovran Lord of Earth and Heaven, Indra is Lord of waters and of mountains.
Indra is Lord of prosperers and sages Indra must be invoked in rest and effort.

verses.sa:
प्राक्तुभ्य इन्द्रः प्र वृधो अहभ्यः प्रान्तरिक्षात्प्र समुद्रस्य धासेः ।
प्र वातस्य प्रथसः प्र ज्मो अन्तात्प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचे प्र क्षितिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
praktubhya indrah pra vridho ahabhyah prantarikshatpra samudrasya dhaseh |
pra vatasya prathasah pra jmo antatpra sindhubhyo ririche pra kshitibhyah ||
verses.en:
Vaster than days and nights, Giver of increase, vaster than firmament and flood of ocean,
Vaster than bounds of earth and wind's extension, vaster than rivers and our lands is Indra.

verses.sa:
प्र शोशुचत्या उषसो न केतुरसिन्वा ते वर्ततामिन्द्र हेतिः ।
अश्मेव विध्य दिव आ सृजानस्तपिष्ठेन हेषसा द्रोघमित्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
pra shoshuchatya ushaso na keturasinva te vartatamindra hetih |
ashmeva vidhya diva a srijanastapishthena heshasa droghamitran ||
verses.en:
Forward, as herald of refulgent Morning, let thine insatiate arrow fly, O Indra.
And pierce, as 'twere a stone launched forth from heaven, with hottest blaze the men who love deception.

verses.sa:
अन्वह मासा अन्विद्वनान्यन्वोषधीरनु पर्वतासः ।
अन्विन्द्रं रोदसी वावशाने अन्वापो अजिहत जायमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
anvaha masa anvidvananyanvoshadhiranu parvatasah |
anvindram rodasi vavashane anvapo ajihata jayamanam ||
verses.en:
Him, verily, the moons, the mountains followed, the tall trees followed and the plants and herbage.
Yearning with love both Worlds approached, the Waters waited on Indra when he first had being.

verses.sa:
कर्हि स्वित्सा त इन्द्र चेत्यासदघस्य यद्भिनदो रक्ष एषत् ।
मित्रक्रुवो यच्छसने न गावः पृथिव्या आपृगमुया शयन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
karhi svitsa ta indra chetyasadaghasya yadbhinado raksha eshat |
mitrakruvo yachchhasane na gavah prithivya aprigamuya shayante ||
verses.en:
Where was the vengeful dart when thou, O Indra, clavest the demon ever beat on outrage?
When fiends lay there upon the ground extended like cattle in the place of immolation?

verses.sa:
शत्रूयन्तो अभि ये नस्ततस्रे महि व्राधन्त ओगणास इन्द्र ।
अन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्तां सुज्योतिषो अक्तवस्ताँ अभि ष्युः ॥
verses.rom:
shatruyanto abhi ye nastatasre mahi vradhanta oganasa indra |
andhenamitrastamasa sachantam sujyotisho aktavastan abhi shyuh ||
verses.en:
Those who are set in enmity against us, the Oganas, O Indra, waxen mighty,-
Let blinding darkness follow those our foemen, while these shall have bright shining nights to light them.

verses.sa:
पुरूणि हि त्वा सवना जनानां ब्रह्माणि मन्दन्गृणतामृषीणाम् ।
इमामाघोषन्नवसा सहूतिं तिरो विश्वाँ अर्चतो याह्यर्वाङ् ॥
verses.rom:
puruni hi tva savana jananam brahmani mandangrinatamrishinam |
imamaghoshannavasa sahutim tiro vishvan archato yahyarvan ||
verses.en:
May plentiful libations of the people, and singing Rsis' holy prayers rejoice thee.
Hearing with love this common invocation, come unto us, pass by all those who praise thee.

verses.sa:
एवा ते वयमिन्द्र भुञ्जतीनां विद्याम सुमतीनां नवानाम् ।
विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विश्वामित्रा उत त इन्द्र नूनम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva te vayamindra bhunjatinam vidyama sumatinam navanam |
vidyama vastoravasa grinanto vishvamitra uta ta indra nunam ||
verses.en:
O Indra, thus may we be made partakers of thy new favours that shall bring us profit.
Singing with love, may we the Visvamitras win daylight even now through thee, O Indra.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ।
स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrashirsha purushah sahasrakshah sahasrapat |
sa bhumim vishvato vritvatyatishthaddashangulam ||
verses.en:
A THOUSAND heads hath Purusa, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet.
On every side pervading earth he fills a space ten fingers wide.

verses.sa:
पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् ।
उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति ॥
verses.rom:
purusha evedam sarvam yadbhutam yachcha bhavyam |
utamritatvasyeshano yadannenatirohati ||
verses.en:
This Purusa is all that yet hath been and all that is to be;
The Lord of Immortality which waxes greater still by food.

verses.sa:
एतावानस्य महिमातो ज्यायाँश्च पूरुषः ।
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
etavanasya mahimato jyayanshcha purushah |
pado'sya vishva bhutani tripadasyamritam divi ||
verses.en:
So mighty is his greatness; yea, greater than this is Purusa.
All creatures are one-fourth of him, three-fourths eternal life in heaven.

verses.sa:
त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत्पुनः ।
ततो विष्वङ्व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि ॥
verses.rom:
tripadurdhva udaitpurushah pado'syehabhavatpunah |
tato vishvanvyakramatsashananashane abhi ||
verses.en:
With three-fourths Purusa went up: one fourth of him again was here.
Thence he strode out to every side over what  not and what .

verses.sa:
तस्माद्विराळजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः ।
स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadviralajayata virajo adhi purushah |
sa jato atyarichyata pashchadbhumimatho purah ||
verses.en:
From him Viraj was born; again Purusa from Viraj was born.
As soon as he was born he spread eastward and westward o'er the earth.

verses.sa:
यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत ।
वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः ॥
verses.rom:
yatpurushena havisha deva yajnamatanvata |
vasanto asyasidajyam grishma idhmah sharaddhavih ||
verses.en:
When Gods prepared the sacrifice with Purusa as their offering,
Its oil was spring, the holy gift was autumn; summer was the wood.

verses.sa:
तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्पुरुषं जातमग्रतः ।
तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
tam yajnam barhishi praukshanpurusham jatamagratah |
tena deva ayajanta sadhya rishayashcha ye ||
verses.en:
They balmed as victim on the grass Purusa born in earliest time.
With him the Deities and all Sadhyas and Rsis sacrificed.

verses.sa:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः सम्भृतं पृषदाज्यम् ।
पशून् ताँश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्यान्ग्राम्याश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadyajnatsarvahutah sambhritam prishadajyam |
pashun tanshchakre vayavyanaranyangramyashcha ye ||
verses.en:
From that great general sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up.
He formed the creatures of-the air, and animals both wild and tame.

verses.sa:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadyajnatsarvahuta richah samani jajnire |
chhandamsi jajnire tasmadyajustasmadajayata ||
verses.en:
From that great general sacrifice Rcas and Sama-hymns were born:
Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.

verses.sa:
तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः ।
गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadashva ajayanta ye ke chobhayadatah |
gavo ha jajnire tasmattasmajjata ajavayah ||
verses.en:
From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth:
From it were generated kine, from it the goats and sheep were born.

verses.sa:
यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् ।
मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू का ऊरू पादा उच्येते ॥
verses.rom:
yatpurusham vyadadhuh katidha vyakalpayan |
mukham kimasya kau bahu ka uru pada uchyete ||
verses.en:
When they divided Purusa how many portions did they make?
What do they call his mouth, his arms? What do they call his thighs and feet?

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः ।
ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत ॥
verses.rom:
brahmano'sya mukhamasidbahu rajanyah kritah |
uru tadasya yadvaishyah padbhyam shudro ajayata ||
verses.en:
The Brahman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Rajanya made.
His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sudra was produced.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत ।
मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत ॥
verses.rom:
chandrama manaso jatashchakshoh suryo ajayata |
mukhadindrashchagnishcha pranadvayurajayata ||
verses.en:
The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth;
Indra and Agni from his mouth were born, and Vayu from his breath.

verses.sa:
नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत ।
पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ अकल्पयन् ॥
verses.rom:
nabhya asidantariksham shirshno dyauh samavartata |
padbhyam bhumirdishah shrotrattatha lokan akalpayan ||
verses.en:
Forth from his navel came mid-air the sky was fashioned from his head
Earth from his feet, and from his car the regions. Thus they formed the worlds.

verses.sa:
सप्तास्यासन्परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः ।
देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन्पुरुषं पशुम् ॥
verses.rom:
saptasyasanparidhayastrih sapta samidhah kritah |
deva yadyajnam tanvana abadhnanpurusham pashum ||
verses.en:
Seven fencing-sticks had he, thrice seven layers of fuel were prepared,
When the Gods, offering sacrifice, bound, as their victim, Purusa.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnena yajnamayajanta devastani dharmani prathamanyasan |
te ha nakam mahimanah sachanta yatra purve sadhyah santi devah ||
verses.en:
Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim these were the earliest holy ordinances.
The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sidhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sa:
सं जागृवद्भिर्जरमाण इध्यते दमे दमूना इषयन्निळस्पदे ।
विश्वस्य होता हविषो वरेण्यो विभुर्विभावा सुषखा सखीयते ॥
verses.rom:
sam jagrivadbhirjaramana idhyate dame damuna ishayannilaspade |
vishvasya hota havisho varenyo vibhurvibhava sushakha sakhiyate ||
verses.en:
BRISK, at the place of Ila, hymned by men who wake, our own familiar Friend is kindled in the house;
Hotar of all oblation, worthy of our choice, Lord, beaming, trusty friend to one who loveth him.

verses.sa:
स दर्शतश्रीरतिथिर्गृहेगृहे वनेवने शिश्रिये तक्ववीरिव ।
जनंजनं जन्यो नाति मन्यते विश आ क्षेति विश्यो विशंविशम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa darshatashriratithirgrihegrihe vanevane shishriye takvaviriva |
janamjanam janyo nati manyate visha a ksheti vishyo vishamvisham ||
verses.en:
He, excellent in glory, guest in every house, finds like a swift-winged bird a home in every tree.
Benevolent to men, he scorns no living man: Friend to the tribes of men he dwells with every tribe.

verses.sa:
सुदक्षो दक्षैः क्रतुनासि सुक्रतुरग्ने कविः काव्येनासि विश्ववित् ।
वसुर्वसूनां क्षयसि त्वमेक इद्द्यावा च यानि पृथिवी च पुष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
sudaksho dakshaih kratunasi sukraturagne kavih kavyenasi vishvavit |
vasurvasunam kshayasi tvameka iddyava cha yani prithivi cha pushyatah ||
verses.en:
Most sage with insight, passing skillful with thy powers art thou, O Agni, wise with wisdom, knowing all.
As Vasu, thou alone art Lord of all good things, of all the treasures that the heavens and earth produce.

verses.sa:
प्रजानन्नग्ने तव योनिमृत्वियमिळायास्पदे घृतवन्तमासदः ।
आ ते चिकित्र उषसामिवेतयोऽरेपसः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः ॥
verses.rom:
prajanannagne tava yonimritviyamilayaspade ghritavantamasadah |
a te chikitra ushasamivetayo'repasah suryasyeva rashmayah ||
verses.en:
Foreknowing well, O Agni, thou in Ila's place hast occupied thy regular station balmed with oil.
Marked are thy comings like the comings of the Dawns, the rays of him who shineth spotless as the Sun.

verses.sa:
तव श्रियो वर्ष्यस्येव विद्युतश्चित्राश्चिकित्र उषसां न केतवः ।
यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमास्ये ॥
verses.rom:
tava shriyo varshyasyeva vidyutashchitrashchikitra ushasam na ketavah |
yadoshadhirabhisrishto vanani cha pari svayam chinushe annamasye ||
verses.en:
Thy glories are, as lightnings from the rainy cloud, marked, many-hued, like heralds of the Dawns' approach,
When, loosed to wander over plants and forest trees, thou crammest by thyself thy food into thy mouth.

verses.sa:
तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः ।
तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा ॥
verses.rom:
tamoshadhirdadhire garbhamritviyam tamapo agnim janayanta matarah |
tamitsamanam vaninashcha virudho'ntarvatishcha suvate cha vishvaha ||
verses.en:
Him, duly coming as their germ, have plants received: this Agni have maternal Waters brought to life.
So in like manner do the forest trees and plants bear him within them and produce him evermore.

verses.sa:
वातोपधूत इषितो वशाँ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे ।
आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो यथा पृथक्छर्धांस्यग्ने अजराणि धक्षतः ॥
verses.rom:
vatopadhuta ishito vashan anu trishu yadanna vevishadvitishthase |
a te yatante rathyo yatha prithakchhardhamsyagne ajarani dhakshatah ||
verses.en:
When, sped and urged by wind, thou spreadest thee abroad, swift piercing through thy food according to thy will,
Thy never-ceasing blazes, longing to consume, like men on chariots, Agni, strive on every side.

verses.sa:
मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निं होतारं परिभूतमं मतिम् ।
तमिदर्भे हविष्या समानमित्तमिन्महे वृणते नान्यं त्वत् ॥
verses.rom:
medhakaram vidathasya prasadhanamagnim hotaram paribhutamam matim |
tamidarbhe havishya samanamittaminmahe vrinate nanyam tvat ||
verses.en:
Agni, the Hotar-priest who fills the assembly full, Waker of knowledge, chief Controller of the thought,-
Him, yea, none other than thyself, doth man elect at sacrificial offerings great and small alike.

verses.sa:
त्वामिदत्र वृणते त्वायवो होतारमग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः ।
यद्देवयन्तो दधति प्रयांसि ते हविष्मन्तो मनवो वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamidatra vrinate tvayavo hotaramagne vidatheshu vedhasah |
yaddevayanto dadhati prayamsi te havishmanto manavo vriktabarhishah ||
verses.en:
Here, Api, the arrangers, those attached to thee, elect thee as their Priest in sacred gatherings,
When men with strewn clipt grass and sacrificial gifts offer thee entertainment, piously inclined.

verses.sa:
तवाग्ने होत्रं तव पोत्रमृत्वियं तव नेष्ट्रं त्वमग्निदृतायतः ।
तव प्रशास्त्रं त्वमध्वरीयसि ब्रह्मा चासि गृहपतिश्च नो दमे ॥
verses.rom:
tavagne hotram tava potramritviyam tava neshtram tvamagnidritayatah |
tava prashastram tvamadhvariyasi brahma chasi grihapatishcha no dame ||
verses.en:
Thine is the Herald's task and Cleanser's duly timed; Leader art thou, and Kindler for the pious man.
Thou art Director, thou the ministering Priest: thou art the Brahman, Lord and Master in our home.

verses.sa:
यस्तुभ्यमग्ने अमृताय मर्त्यः समिधा दाशदुत वा हविष्कृति ।
तस्य होता भवसि यासि दूत्यमुप ब्रूषे यजस्यध्वरीयसि ॥
verses.rom:
yastubhyamagne amritaya martyah samidha dashaduta va havishkriti |
tasya hota bhavasi yasi dutyamupa brushe yajasyadhvariyasi ||
verses.en:
When mortal man presents to thee Immortal God, Agni, his fuel or his sacrificial gift,
Then thou art his Adhvaryu, Hotar, messenger, callest the Gods and orderest the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इमा अस्मै मतयो वाचो अस्मदाँ ऋचो गिरः सुष्टुतयः समग्मत ।
वसूयवो वसवे जातवेदसे वृद्धासु चिद्वर्धनो यासु चाकनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ima asmai matayo vacho asmadan richo girah sushtutayah samagmata |
vasuyavo vasave jatavedase vriddhasu chidvardhano yasu chakanat ||
verses.en:
From us these hymns in concert have gone forth to him, these. holy words, these Rcas, songs and eulogies,
Eager for wealth, to Jatavedas fain for wealth: when they have waxen strong they please their Strengthener.

verses.sa:
इमां प्रत्नाय सुष्टुतिं नवीयसीं वोचेयमस्मा उशते शृणोतु नः ।
भूया अन्तरा हृद्यस्य निस्पृशे जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासाः ॥
verses.rom:
imam pratnaya sushtutim naviyasim vocheyamasma ushate shrinotu nah |
bhuya antara hridyasya nisprishe jayeva patya ushati suvasah ||
verses.en:
This newest eulogy will I speak forth to him, the Ancient One who loves it. May he hear our voice.
May it come near his heart and make it stir with love, as a fond well-dressed matron clings about her lord.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्नश्वास ऋषभास उक्षणो वशा मेषा अवसृष्टास आहुताः ।
कीलालपे सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे हृदा मतिं जनये चारुमग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
yasminnashvasa rishabhasa ukshano vasha mesha avasrishtasa ahutah |
kilalape somaprishthaya vedhase hrida matim janaye charumagnaye ||
verses.en:
He in whom horses, bulls, oxen, and barren cows, and rams, when duly set apart, are offered up,-
To Agni, Soma-sprinkled, drinker of sweet juice, Disposer, with my heart I bring a fair hymn forth.

verses.sa:
अहाव्यग्ने हविरास्ये ते स्रुचीव घृतं चम्वीव सोमः ।
वाजसनिं रयिमस्मे सुवीरं प्रशस्तं धेहि यशसं बृहन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahavyagne havirasye te sruchiva ghritam chamviva somah |
vajasanim rayimasme suviram prashastam dhehi yashasam brihantam ||
verses.en:
Into thy mouth is poured the offering, Agni, as Soma into cup, oil into ladle.
Vouchsafe us wealth. strength-winning, blest with heroes, wealth lofty, praised by men, and full of splendour.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य वो रथ्यं विश्पतिं विशां होतारमक्तोरतिथिं विभावसुम् ।
शोचञ्छुष्कासु हरिणीषु जर्भुरद्वृषा केतुर्यजतो द्यामशायत ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya vo rathyam vishpatim visham hotaramaktoratithim vibhavasum |
shochanchhushkasu harinishu jarbhuradvrisha keturyajato dyamashayata ||
verses.en:
I PRAISE your Charioteer of sacrifice, the Lord of men, Priest of the tribes, refulgent, Guest of night.
Blazing amid dry plants, snatching amid the green, the Strong, the Holy Herald hath attained to heaven.

verses.sa:
इममञ्जस्पामुभये अकृण्वत धर्माणमग्निं विदथस्य साधनम् ।
अक्तुं न यह्वमुषसः पुरोहितं तनूनपातमरुषस्य निंसते ॥
verses.rom:
imamanjaspamubhaye akrinvata dharmanamagnim vidathasya sadhanam |
aktum na yahvamushasah purohitam tanunapatamarushasya nimsate ||
verses.en:
Him, Agni, Gods and men have made their chief support, who drinks the fatness and completes the sacrifice.
With kisses they caress the Grandson of the Red, like the swift ray of light, the Household Priest of Dawn.

verses.sa:
बळस्य नीथा वि पणेश्च मन्महे वया अस्य प्रहुता आसुरत्तवे ।
यदा घोरासो अमृतत्वमाशतादिज्जनस्य दैव्यस्य चर्किरन् ॥
verses.rom:
balasya nitha vi paneshcha manmahe vaya asya prahuta asurattave |
yada ghoraso amritatvamashatadijjanasya daivyasya charkiran ||
verses.en:
Yea, we discriminate his and the niggard's ways: his branches evermore are sent forth to consume.
When his terrific flames have reached the Immortal's world, then men remember and extol the Heavenly Folk.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि प्रसितिर्द्यौरुरु व्यचो नमो मह्यरमतिः पनीयसी ।
इन्द्रो मित्रो वरुणः सं चिकित्रिरेऽथो भगः सविता पूतदक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya hi prasitirdyaururu vyacho namo mahyaramatih paniyasi |
indro mitro varunah sam chikitrire'tho bhagah savita putadakshasah ||
verses.en:
For then the net of Law, Dyaus, and the wide expanse, Earth, Worship, and Devotion meet for highest praise,
Varuna, Indra, Mitra were of one accord, and Savitar and Bhaga, Lords of holy might.

verses.sa:
प्र रुद्रेण ययिना यन्ति सिन्धवस्तिरो महीमरमतिं दधन्विरे ।
येभिः परिज्मा परियन्नुरु ज्रयो वि रोरुवज्जठरे विश्वमुक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
pra rudrena yayina yanti sindhavastiro mahimaramatim dadhanvire |
yebhih parijma pariyannuru jrayo vi roruvajjathare vishvamukshate ||
verses.en:
Onward, with ever-roaming Rudra, speed the floods: over Aramati the Mighty have they run.
With them Parijman, moving round his vast domain, loud bellowing, bedews all things that are within.

verses.sa:
क्राणा रुद्रा मरुतो विश्वकृष्टयो दिवः श्येनासो असुरस्य नीळयः ।
तेभिश्चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमेन्द्रो देवेभिरर्वशेभिरर्वशः ॥
verses.rom:
krana rudra maruto vishvakrishtayo divah shyenaso asurasya nilayah |
tebhishchashte varuno mitro aryamendro devebhirarvashebhirarvashah ||
verses.en:
Straightway the Rudras, Maruts visiting all men, Falcons of Dyaus, home-dwellers with the Asura,-
Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman look on with these, and the swift-moving Indra with swift-moving Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रे भुजं शशमानास आशत सूरो दृशीके वृषणश्च पौंस्ये ।
प्र ये न्वस्यार्हणा ततक्षिरे युजं वज्रं नृषदनेषु कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
indre bhujam shashamanasa ashata suro drishike vrishanashcha paumsye |
pra ye nvasyarhana tatakshire yujam vajram nrishadaneshu karavah ||
verses.en:
With Indra have they found enjoyment, they who toil, in the light's beauty, in the very Strong One's strength;
The singers who in men's assemblies forged for him, according to his due, his friend the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
सूरश्चिदा हरितो अस्य रीरमदिन्द्रादा कश्चिद्भयते तवीयसः ।
भीमस्य वृष्णो जठरादभिश्वसो दिवेदिवे सहुरि स्तन्नबाधितः ॥
verses.rom:
surashchida harito asya riramadindrada kashchidbhayate taviyasah |
bhimasya vrishno jatharadabhishvaso divedive sahuri stannabadhitah ||
verses.en:
Even the Sun's Bay Coursers hath lie held in check: each one fears Indra as the mightiest of all.
Unhindered, from the air's vault thunders day by day the loud triumphant breathing of the fearful Bull.

verses.sa:
स्तोमं वो अद्य रुद्राय शिक्वसे क्षयद्वीराय नमसा दिदिष्टन ।
येभिः शिवः स्ववाँ एवयावभिर्दिवः सिषक्ति स्वयशा निकामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
stomam vo adya rudraya shikvase kshayadviraya namasa didishtana |
yebhih shivah svavan evayavabhirdivah sishakti svayasha nikamabhih ||
verses.en:
With humble adoration show this day your song of praise to mighty Rudra, Ruler of the brave:
With whom, the Eager Ones, going their ordered course, he comes from heaven Self-bright, auspicious, strong to guard.

verses.sa:
ते हि प्रजाया अभरन्त वि श्रवो बृहस्पतिर्वृषभः सोमजामयः ।
यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमो वि धारयद्देवा दक्षैर्भृगवः सं चिकित्रिरे ॥
verses.rom:
te hi prajaya abharanta vi shravo brihaspatirvrishabhah somajamayah |
yajnairatharva prathamo vi dharayaddeva dakshairbhrigavah sam chikitrire ||
verses.en:
For these have spread abroad the fame of human kind, the Bull Brhaspati and Soma's brotherhood.
Atharvan first by sacrifices made men sure: through skill the Bhrgus were esteemed of all as Gods.

verses.sa:
ते हि द्यावापृथिवी भूरिरेतसा नराशंसश्चतुरङ्गो यमोऽदितिः ।
देवस्त्वष्टा द्रविणोदा ऋभुक्षणः प्र रोदसी मरुतो विष्णुरर्हिरे ॥
verses.rom:
te hi dyavaprithivi bhuriretasa narashamsashchaturango yamo'ditih |
devastvashta dravinoda ribhukshanah pra rodasi maruto vishnurarhire ||
verses.en:
For these, the Earth and Heaven with their abundant seed, four-bodied Narasmsa, Yama, Aditi,
God Tvastar Wealth-bestower, the Rbhuksanas, Rodasi, Maruts, Visnu, claim and merit praise.

verses.sa:
उत स्य न उशिजामुर्विया कविरहिः शृणोतु बुध्न्यो हवीमनि ।
सूर्यामासा विचरन्ता दिविक्षिता धिया शमीनहुषी अस्य बोधतम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya na ushijamurviya kavirahih shrinotu budhnyo havimani |
suryamasa vicharanta divikshita dhiya shaminahushi asya bodhatam ||
verses.en:
And may he too give car, the Sage, from far away, the Dragon of the Deep, to this our yearning call.
Ye Sun and Moon who dwell in heaven and move in turn, and with your thought, O Earth and Sky, observe this well.

verses.sa:
प्र नः पूषा चरथं विश्वदेव्योऽपां नपादवतु वायुरिष्टये ।
आत्मानं वस्यो अभि वातमर्चत तदश्विना सुहवा यामनि श्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra nah pusha charatham vishvadevyo'pam napadavatu vayurishtaye |
atmanam vasyo abhi vatamarchata tadashvina suhava yamani shrutam ||
verses.en:
Dear to all Gods, may Pasan guard the ways we go, the Waters' child and Vayu help us to success.
Sing lauds for your great bliss to Wind, the breath of all: ye Asvins prompt to hear, hear this upon your way.

verses.sa:
विशामासामभयानामधिक्षितं गीर्भिरु स्वयशसं गृणीमसि ।
ग्नाभिर्विश्वाभिरदितिमनर्वणमक्तोर्युवानं नृमणा अधा पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishamasamabhayanamadhikshitam girbhiru svayashasam grinimasi |
gnabhirvishvabhiraditimanarvanamaktoryuvanam nrimana adha patim ||
verses.en:
With hymns of praise we sing him who is throned as Lord over these fearless tribes, the Self-resplendent One.
We praise Night's youthful Lord benevolent to men, the foeless One, the free, with all celestial Dames.

verses.sa:
रेभदत्र जनुषा पूर्वो अङ्गिरा ग्रावाण ऊर्ध्वा अभि चक्षुरध्वरम् ।
येभिर्विहाया अभवद्विचक्षणः पाथः सुमेकं स्वधितिर्वनन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
rebhadatra janusha purvo angira gravana urdhva abhi chakshuradhvaram |
yebhirvihaya abhavadvichakshanah pathah sumekam svadhitirvananvati ||
verses.en:
By reason of his birth here Angiras first sang: the pressing-stones upraised beheld the sacrifice-
The stones through which the Sage became exceeding vast, and the sharp axe obtains in fight the beauteous place.

verses.sa:
महि द्यावापृथिवी भूतमुर्वी नारी यह्वी न रोदसी सदं नः ।
तेभिर्नः पातं सह्यस एभिर्नः पातं शूषणि ॥
verses.rom:
mahi dyavaprithivi bhutamurvi nari yahvi na rodasi sadam nah |
tebhirnah patam sahyasa ebhirnah patam shushani ||
verses.en:
MIGHTY are ye, and far-extended, Heaven and Earth: both Worlds are evermore to us like two young Dames.
Guard us thereby from stronger foe; guard us hereby to give us strength.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेयज्ञे स मर्त्यो देवान्सपर्यति ।
यः सुम्नैर्दीर्घश्रुत्तम आविवासत्येनान् ॥
verses.rom:
yajneyajne sa martyo devansaparyati |
yah sumnairdirghashruttama avivasatyenan ||
verses.en:
In each succeeding sacrifice that mortal honoureth the Gods,
He who, most widely known and famed for happiness, inviteth them.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषामिरज्यवो देवानां वार्महः ।
विश्वे हि विश्वमहसो विश्वे यज्ञेषु यज्ञियाः ॥
verses.rom:
vishveshamirajyavo devanam varmahah |
vishve hi vishvamahaso vishve yajneshu yajniyah ||
verses.en:
Ye who are Rulers over all, great is your sovran power as Gods.
Ye all possess all majesty: all must be served in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ते घा राजानो अमृतस्य मन्द्रा अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः परिज्मा ।
कद्रुद्रो नृणां स्तुतो मरुतः पूषणो भगः ॥
verses.rom:
te gha rajano amritasya mandra aryama mitro varunah parijma |
kadrudro nrinam stuto marutah pushano bhagah ||
verses.en:
These are the joyous Kings of Immortality, Parijman, Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuna.
What else is Rudra, praised of men? the Maruts, Bhaga, Pusana?

verses.sa:
उत नो नक्तमपां वृषण्वसू सूर्यामासा सदनाय सधन्या ।
सचा यत्साद्येषामहिर्बुध्नेषु बुध्न्यः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no naktamapam vrishanvasu suryamasa sadanaya sadhanya |
sacha yatsadyeshamahirbudhneshu budhnyah ||
verses.en:
Come also to our dwelling, Lords of ample wealth, common partakers of our waters, Sun and Moon,
When the great Dragon of the Deep hath settled down upon their floors.

verses.sa:
उत नो देवावश्विना शुभस्पती धामभिर्मित्रावरुणा उरुष्यताम् ।
महः स राय एषतेऽति धन्वेव दुरिता ॥
verses.rom:
uta no devavashvina shubhaspati dhamabhirmitravaruna urushyatam |
mahah sa raya eshate'ti dhanveva durita ||
verses.en:
And let the Asvins, Lords of splendour, set us free,- both Gods, and, with their Laws, Mitra and Varuna.
Through woes, as over desert lands, he speeds to ample opulence.

verses.sa:
उत नो रुद्रा चिन्मृळतामश्विना विश्वे देवासो रथस्पतिर्भगः ।
ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षणः परिज्मा विश्ववेदसः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no rudra chinmrilatamashvina vishve devaso rathaspatirbhagah |
ribhurvaja ribhukshanah parijma vishvavedasah ||
verses.en:
Yea, let the Asvins Twain he gracious unto us, even Rudras, and all Gods, Bhaga, Rathaspati;
Parijman, Rbhu, Vaja, O Lords of all wealth Rbhuksanas.

verses.sa:
ऋभुरृभुक्षा ऋभुर्विधतो मद आ ते हरी जूजुवानस्य वाजिना ।
दुष्टरं यस्य साम चिदृधग्यज्ञो न मानुषः ॥
verses.rom:
ribhurribhuksha ribhurvidhato mada a te hari jujuvanasya vajina |
dushtaram yasya sama chidridhagyajno na manushah ||
verses.en:
Prompt is Rbhuksan, prompt the worshipper's strong drink: may thy fleet Bay Steeds, thine who speedest on, approach.
Not mans but God's is sacrifice whose psalm is unassailable.

verses.sa:
कृधी नो अह्रयो देव सवितः स च स्तुषे मघोनाम् ।
सहो न इन्द्रो वह्निभिर्न्येषां चर्षणीनां चक्रं रश्मिं न योयुवे ॥
verses.rom:
kridhi no ahrayo deva savitah sa cha stushe maghonam |
saho na indro vahnibhirnyesham charshaninam chakram rashmim na yoyuve ||
verses.en:
O God Savitar, harmed by none, lauded, give us a place among wealthy princes.
With his Car-steeds at once 'hath our Indra guided the reins and the car of these men.

verses.sa:
ऐषु द्यावापृथिवी धातं महदस्मे वीरेषु विश्वचर्षणि श्रवः ।
पृक्षं वाजस्य सातये पृक्षं रायोत तुर्वणे ॥
verses.rom:
aishu dyavaprithivi dhatam mahadasme vireshu vishvacharshani shravah |
priksham vajasya sataye priksham rayota turvane ||
verses.en:
To these men present here, O Heaven and Earth, to us grant lofty fame extending over all mankind.
Give us a steed to win us strength, a steed with wealth for victory.

verses.sa:
एतं शंसमिन्द्रास्मयुष्ट्वं कूचित्सन्तं सहसावन्नभिष्टये ।
सदा पाह्यभिष्टये मेदतां वेदता वसो ॥
verses.rom:
etam shamsamindrasmayushtvam kuchitsantam sahasavannabhishtaye |
sada pahyabhishtaye medatam vedata vaso ||
verses.en:
This speaker, Indra-for thou art our Friend-wherever he may be, guard thou, Victor! for help, ever for help
Thy wisdom, Vasu! prosper him.

verses.sa:
एतं मे स्तोमं तना न सूर्ये द्युतद्यामानं वावृधन्त नृणाम् ।
संवननं नाश्व्यं तष्टेवानपच्युतम् ॥
verses.rom:
etam me stomam tana na surye dyutadyamanam vavridhanta nrinam |
samvananam nashvyam tashtevanapachyutam ||
verses.en:
So have they strengthened this mine hymn which seems to take its bright path to the Sun, and reconciles the men:
Thus forms a carpenter the yoke of horses, not to be displaced.

verses.sa:
वावर्त येषां राया युक्तैषां हिरण्ययी ।
नेमधिता न पौंस्या वृथेव विष्टान्ता ॥
verses.rom:
vavarta yesham raya yuktaisham hiranyayi |
nemadhita na paumsya vritheva vishtanta ||
verses.en:
Whose chariot-seat hath come again laden with wealth and bright with gold,
Lightly, with piercing ends, as 'twere two ranks of heroes ranged for fight.

verses.sa:
प्र तद्दुःशीमे पृथवाने वेने प्र रामे वोचमसुरे मघवत्सु ।
ये युक्त्वाय पञ्च शतास्मयु पथा विश्राव्येषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra tadduhshime prithavane vene pra rame vochamasure maghavatsu |
ye yuktvaya pancha shatasmayu patha vishravyesham ||
verses.en:
This to Duhsima Prthavana have I sung, to Vena, Rama, to the nobles, and the King.
They yoked five hundred, and their love of us was famed upon their way.

verses.sa:
अधीन्न्वत्र सप्ततिं च सप्त च ।
सद्यो दिदिष्ट तान्वः सद्यो दिदिष्ट पार्थ्यः सद्यो दिदिष्ट मायवः ॥
verses.rom:
adhinnvatra saptatim cha sapta cha |
sadyo didishta tanvah sadyo didishta parthyah sadyo didishta mayavah ||
verses.en:
Besides, they showed us seven -and-seventy horses here.
Tanva at once displayed his gift, Parthya at once displayed his gift; and straightway Mayava showed his.

verses.sa:
प्रैते वदन्तु प्र वयं वदाम ग्रावभ्यो वाचं वदता वदद्भ्यः ।
यदद्रयः पर्वताः साकमाशवः श्लोकं घोषं भरथेन्द्राय सोमिनः ॥
verses.rom:
praite vadantu pra vayam vadama gravabhyo vacham vadata vadadbhyah |
yadadrayah parvatah sakamashavah shlokam ghosham bharathendraya sominah ||
verses.en:
LET these speak loudly forth; let us speak out aloud: to the loud speaking Pressing-stones address the speech;
When, rich with Soma juice, Stones of the mountain, ye, united, swift to Indra bring the sound of praise.

verses.sa:
एते वदन्ति शतवत्सहस्रवदभि क्रन्दन्ति हरितेभिरासभिः ।
विष्ट्वी ग्रावाणः सुकृतः सुकृत्यया होतुश्चित्पूर्वे हविरद्यमाशत ॥
verses.rom:
ete vadanti shatavatsahasravadabhi krandanti haritebhirasabhih |
vishtvi gravanah sukritah sukrityaya hotushchitpurve haviradyamashata ||
verses.en:
They speak out like a hundred, like a thousand men: they cry aloud to us with their green-tinted mouths,
While, pious Stones, they ply their task with piety, and, even before the Hotar, taste the offered food.

verses.sa:
एते वदन्त्यविदन्नना मधु न्यूङ्खयन्ते अधि पक्व आमिषि ।
वृक्षस्य शाखामरुणस्य बप्सतस्ते सूभर्वा वृषभाः प्रेमराविषुः ॥
verses.rom:
ete vadantyavidannana madhu nyunkhayante adhi pakva amishi |
vrikshasya shakhamarunasya bapsataste subharva vrishabhah premaravishuh ||
verses.en:
Loudly they speak, for they have found the savoury meath: they make a humming sound over the meat prepared.
As they devour the branch of the Red-coloured Tree, these, the well-pastured Bulls, have uttered bellowings.

verses.sa:
बृहद्वदन्ति मदिरेण मन्दिनेन्द्रं क्रोशन्तोऽविदन्नना मधु ।
संरभ्या धीराः स्वसृभिरनर्तिषुराघोषयन्तः पृथिवीमुपब्दिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
brihadvadanti madirena mandinendram kroshanto'vidannana madhu |
samrabhya dhirah svasribhiranartishuraghoshayantah prithivimupabdibhih ||
verses.en:
They cry aloud, with strong exhilarating drink, calling on Indra now, for they have found the meath.
Bold, with the sisters they have danced, embraced by them, making the earth reecho with their ringing sound.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णा वाचमक्रतोप द्यव्याखरे कृष्णा इषिरा अनर्तिषुः ।
न्यङ्नि यन्त्युपरस्य निष्कृतं पुरू रेतो दधिरे सूर्यश्वितः ॥
verses.rom:
suparna vachamakratopa dyavyakhare krishna ishira anartishuh |
nyanni yantyuparasya nishkritam puru reto dadhire suryashvitah ||
verses.en:
The Eagles have sent forth their cry aloft in heaven; in the sky's vault the dark impetuous ones have danced.
Then downward to the nether stone's fixt place they sink, and, splendid as the Sun, effuse their copious stream.

verses.sa:
उग्रा इव प्रवहन्तः समायमुः साकं युक्ता वृषणो बिभ्रतो धुरः ।
यच्छ्वसन्तो जग्रसाना अराविषुः शृण्व एषां प्रोथथो अर्वतामिव ॥
verses.rom:
ugra iva pravahantah samayamuh sakam yukta vrishano bibhrato dhurah |
yachchhvasanto jagrasana aravishuh shrinva esham prothatho arvatamiva ||
verses.en:
Like strong ones drawing, they have put forth all their strength: the Bulls, harnessed together, bear the chariot-poles.
When they have bellowed, panting, swallowing their food, the sound of their loud snorting is like that of steeds.

verses.sa:
दशावनिभ्यो दशकक्ष्येभ्यो दशयोक्त्रेभ्यो दशयोजनेभ्यः ।
दशाभीशुभ्यो अर्चताजरेभ्यो दश धुरो दश युक्ता वहद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
dashavanibhyo dashakakshyebhyo dashayoktrebhyo dashayojanebhyah |
dashabhishubhyo archatajarebhyo dasha dhuro dasha yukta vahadbhyah ||
verses.en:
To these who have ten workers and a tenfold girth, to these who have ten yoke-straps and ten binding thongs,
To these who bear ten reins, the eternal, sing ye praise, to these who bear ten car-poles, ten when they are yoked.

verses.sa:
ते अद्रयो दशयन्त्रास आशवस्तेषामाधानं पर्येति हर्यतम् ।
त ऊ सुतस्य सोम्यस्यान्धसोऽंशोः पीयूषं प्रथमस्य भेजिरे ॥
verses.rom:
te adrayo dashayantrasa ashavasteshamadhanam paryeti haryatam |
ta u sutasya somyasyandhaso'mshoh piyusham prathamasya bhejire ||
verses.en:
These Stones with ten conductors, rapid in their course, with lovely revolution travel round and round.
They have been first to drink the flowing Soma juice, first to enjoy the milky fluid of the stalk.

verses.sa:
ते सोमादो हरी इन्द्रस्य निंसतेऽंशुं दुहन्तो अध्यासते गवि ।
तेभिर्दुग्धं पपिवान्सोम्यं मध्विन्द्रो वर्धते प्रथते वृषायते ॥
verses.rom:
te somado hari indrasya nimsate'mshum duhanto adhyasate gavi |
tebhirdugdham papivansomyam madhvindro vardhate prathate vrishayate ||
verses.en:
These Soma-eaters kiss Indra's Bay-coloured Steeds: draining. the stalk they sit upon the ox's hide.
Indra, when he hath drunk Soma-nicath drawn by them, waxes in strength, is famed, is mighty as a Bull.

verses.sa:
वृषा वो अंशुर्न किला रिषाथनेळावन्तः सदमित्स्थनाशिताः ।
रैवत्येव महसा चारव स्थन यस्य ग्रावाणो अजुषध्वमध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha vo amshurna kila rishathanelavantah sadamitsthanashitah |
raivatyeva mahasa charava sthana yasya gravano ajushadhvamadhvaram ||
verses.en:
Strong is your stalk; ye, verily, never shall be harmed; ye have refreshment, ye are ever satisfied.
Fair are ye, as it were, through splendour of his wealth, his in whose sacrifice, O Stones, ye find delight.

verses.sa:
तृदिला अतृदिलासो अद्रयोऽश्रमणा अशृथिता अमृत्यवः ।
अनातुरा अजरा स्थामविष्णवः सुपीवसो अतृषिता अतृष्णजः ॥
verses.rom:
tridila atridilaso adrayo'shramana ashrithita amrityavah |
anatura ajara sthamavishnavah supivaso atrishita atrishnajah ||
verses.en:
Bored deep, but not pierced through with holes, are ye, O Stones, not loosened, never weary, and exempt from death,
Eternal, undiseased, moving in sundry ways, unthirsting, full of fatness, void of all desire.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा एव वः पितरो युगेयुगे क्षेमकामासः सदसो न युञ्जते ।
अजुर्यासो हरिषाचो हरिद्रव आ द्यां रवेण पृथिवीमशुश्रवुः ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva eva vah pitaro yugeyuge kshemakamasah sadaso na yunjate |
ajuryaso harishacho haridrava a dyam ravena prithivimashushravuh ||
verses.en:
Your fathers, verily, stand firm from age to age: they, loving rest, are not dissevered from their seat.
Untouched by time, ne'er lacking green plants and green trees, they with their voice have caused the heavens and earth to hear.

verses.sa:
तदिद्वदन्त्यद्रयो विमोचने यामन्नञ्जस्पा इव घेदुपब्दिभिः ।
वपन्तो बीजमिव धान्याकृतः पृञ्चन्ति सोमं न मिनन्ति बप्सतः ॥
verses.rom:
tadidvadantyadrayo vimochane yamannanjaspa iva ghedupabdibhih |
vapanto bijamiva dhanyakritah princhanti somam na minanti bapsatah ||
verses.en:
This, this the Stones proclaim, what time they are disjoined, and when with ringing sounds they move and drink the balm.
Like tillers of the ground when they are sowing seed, they mix the Soma, nor, devouring, diminish it.

verses.sa:
सुते अध्वरे अधि वाचमक्रता क्रीळयो न मातरं तुदन्तः ।
वि षू मुञ्चा सुषुवुषो मनीषां वि वर्तन्तामद्रयश्चायमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
sute adhvare adhi vachamakrata krilayo na mataram tudantah |
vi shu muncha sushuvusho manisham vi vartantamadrayashchayamanah ||
verses.en:
They have raised high their voice for juice, for sacrifice, striking the Mother earth as though they danced thereon.
So loose thou too his thought who hath effused the sap, and let the Stones which we are honouring be disjoined.

verses.sa:
हये जाये मनसा तिष्ठ घोरे वचांसि मिश्रा कृणवावहै नु ।
न नौ मन्त्रा अनुदितास एते मयस्करन्परतरे चनाहन् ॥
verses.rom:
haye jaye manasa tishtha ghore vachamsi mishra krinavavahai nu |
na nau mantra anuditasa ete mayaskaranparatare chanahan ||
verses.en:
Ho there, my consort! Stay, thou fierce-souled lady, and let us reason for a while together.
Such thoughts as these of ours, while yet unspoken in days gone by have never brought us comfort.

verses.sa:
किमेता वाचा कृणवा तवाहं प्राक्रमिषमुषसामग्रियेव ।
पुरूरवः पुनरस्तं परेहि दुरापना वात इवाहमस्मि ॥
verses.rom:
kimeta vacha krinava tavaham prakramishamushasamagriyeva |
pururavah punarastam parehi durapana vata ivahamasmi ||
verses.en:
What am I now to do with this thy saying? I have gone from thee like the first of Mornings.
Pururavas, return thou to thy dwelling: I, like the wind, am difficult to capture.

verses.sa:
इषुर्न श्रिय इषुधेरसना गोषाः शतसा न रंहिः ।
अवीरे क्रतौ वि दविद्युतन्नोरा न मायुं चितयन्त धुनयः ॥
verses.rom:
ishurna shriya ishudherasana goshah shatasa na ramhih |
avire kratau vi davidyutannora na mayum chitayanta dhunayah ||
verses.en:
Like a shaft sent for glory from the quiver, or swift-steed winning cattle winning hundreds.
The lightning seemed to flash, as cowards planned it. The minstrels bleated like a lamb in trouble.

verses.sa:
सा वसु दधती श्वशुराय वय उषो यदि वष्ट्यन्तिगृहात् ।
अस्तं ननक्षे यस्मिञ्चाकन्दिवा नक्तं श्नथिता वैतसेन ॥
verses.rom:
sa vasu dadhati shvashuraya vaya usho yadi vashtyantigrihat |
astam nanakshe yasminchakandiva naktam shnathita vaitasena ||
verses.en:
Giving her husband's father life and riches, from the near dwelling, when her lover craved her,
She sought the home wherein she found her pleasure, accepting day and night her lord's embraces.

verses.sa:
त्रिः स्म माह्नः श्नथयो वैतसेनोत स्म मेऽव्यत्यै पृणासि ।
पुरूरवोऽनु ते केतमायं राजा मे वीर तन्वस्तदासीः ॥
verses.rom:
trih sma mahnah shnathayo vaitasenota sma me'vyatyai prinasi |
pururavo'nu te ketamayam raja me vira tanvastadasih ||
verses.en:
Thrice in the day didst thou embrace thy consort, though coldly she received thy fond caresses.
To thy desires, Pururavas, I yielded: so wast thou king, O hero, of my body.

verses.sa:
या सुजूर्णिः श्रेणिः सुम्नआपिर्ह्रदेचक्षुर्न ग्रन्थिनी चरण्युः ।
ता अञ्जयोऽरुणयो न सस्रुः श्रिये गावो न धेनवोऽनवन्त ॥
verses.rom:
ya sujurnih shrenih sumnaapirhradechakshurna granthini charanyuh |
ta anjayo'runayo na sasruh shriye gavo na dhenavo'navanta ||
verses.en:
The maids Sujirni, Sreni, Sumne-api, Charanyu, Granthini, and Hradecaksus,-
These like red kine have hastened forth, the bright ones, and like milch-cows have lowed in emulation.

verses.sa:
समस्मिञ्जायमान आसत ग्ना उतेमवर्धन्नद्यः स्वगूर्ताः ।
महे यत्त्वा पुरूरवो रणायावर्धयन्दस्युहत्याय देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
samasminjayamana asata gna utemavardhannadyah svagurtah |
mahe yattva pururavo ranayavardhayandasyuhatyaya devah ||
verses.en:
While he was born the Dames sate down together, the Rivers with free kindness gave him nurture;
And then, Pururavas, the Gods increased thee for mighty battle, to destroy the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
सचा यदासु जहतीष्वत्कममानुषीषु मानुषो निषेवे ।
अप स्म मत्तरसन्ती न भुज्युस्ता अत्रसन्रथस्पृशो नाश्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
sacha yadasu jahatishvatkamamanushishu manusho nisheve |
apa sma mattarasanti na bhujyusta atrasanrathasprisho nashvah ||
verses.en:
When I, a mortal, wooed to mine embraces these heavenly nymphs who laid aside their raiment,
Like a scared snake they fled from me in terror, like chariot horses when the car has touched them.

verses.sa:
यदासु मर्तो अमृतासु निस्पृक्सं क्षोणीभिः क्रतुभिर्न पृङ्क्ते ।
ता आतयो न तन्वः शुम्भत स्वा अश्वासो न क्रीळयो दन्दशानाः ॥
verses.rom:
yadasu marto amritasu nispriksam kshonibhih kratubhirna prinkte |
ta atayo na tanvah shumbhata sva ashvaso na krilayo dandashanah ||
verses.en:
When, loving these Immortal Ones, the mortal hath converse with the nymphs as they allow him.
Like swans they show the beauty of their bodies, like horses in their play they bite and nibble.

verses.sa:
विद्युन्न या पतन्ती दविद्योद्भरन्ती मे अप्या काम्यानि ।
जनिष्टो अपो नर्यः सुजातः प्रोर्वशी तिरत दीर्घमायुः ॥
verses.rom:
vidyunna ya patanti davidyodbharanti me apya kamyani |
janishto apo naryah sujatah prorvashi tirata dirghamayuh ||
verses.en:
She who flashed brilliant as the falling lightning brought me delicious presents from the waters.
Now from the flood be born a strong young hero May Uruvasi prolong her life for ever

verses.sa:
जज्ञिष इत्था गोपीथ्याय हि दधाथ तत्पुरूरवो म ओजः ।
अशासं त्वा विदुषी सस्मिन्नहन्न म आशृणोः किमभुग्वदासि ॥
verses.rom:
jajnisha ittha gopithyaya hi dadhatha tatpururavo ma ojah |
ashasam tva vidushi sasminnahanna ma ashrinoh kimabhugvadasi ||
verses.en:
Thy birth hath made me drink from earthly milch-kine: this power, Pururavas, hast thou vouchsafed me.
I knew, and, warned thee, on that day. Thou wouldst not hear me. What sayest thou, when naught avails thee?

verses.sa:
कदा सूनुः पितरं जात इच्छाच्चक्रन्नाश्रु वर्तयद्विजानन् ।
को दम्पती समनसा वि यूयोदध यदग्निः श्वशुरेषु दीदयत् ॥
verses.rom:
kada sunuh pitaram jata ichchhachchakrannashru vartayadvijanan |
ko dampati samanasa vi yuyodadha yadagnih shvashureshu didayat ||
verses.en:
When will the son be born and seek his father? Mourner-like, will he weep when first he knows him?
Who shall divide the accordant wife and husband, while fire is shining with thy consort's parents?

verses.sa:
प्रति ब्रवाणि वर्तयते अश्रु चक्रन्न क्रन्ददाध्ये शिवायै ।
प्र तत्ते हिनवा यत्ते अस्मे परेह्यस्तं नहि मूर मापः ॥
verses.rom:
prati bravani vartayate ashru chakranna krandadadhye shivayai |
pra tatte hinava yatte asme parehyastam nahi mura mapah ||
verses.en:
I will console him when his tears are falling: he shall not weep and cry for care that blesses.
That which is thine, between us, will I send thee. Go home again, thou fool; thou hast not won me.

verses.sa:
सुदेवो अद्य प्रपतेदनावृत्परावतं परमां गन्तवा उ ।
अधा शयीत निरृतेरुपस्थेऽधैनं वृका रभसासो अद्युः ॥
verses.rom:
sudevo adya prapatedanavritparavatam paramam gantava u |
adha shayita nirriterupasthe'dhainam vrika rabhasaso adyuh ||
verses.en:
Thy lover shall flee forth this day for ever, to seek, without return, the farthest distance.
Then let his bed be in Destruction's bosom, and there let fierce rapacious wolves devour him.

verses.sa:
पुरूरवो मा मृथा मा प्र पप्तो मा त्वा वृकासो अशिवास उ क्षन् ।
न वै स्त्रैणानि सख्यानि सन्ति सालावृकाणां हृदयान्येता ॥
verses.rom:
pururavo ma mritha ma pra papto ma tva vrikaso ashivasa u kshan |
na vai strainani sakhyani santi salavrikanam hridayanyeta ||
verses.en:
Nay, do not die, Pururavas, nor vanish: let not the evil-omened wolves devour thee.
With women there can be no lasting friendship: hearts of hyenas are the hearts of women.

verses.sa:
यद्विरूपाचरं मर्त्येष्ववसं रात्रीः शरदश्चतस्रः ।
घृतस्य स्तोकं सकृदह्न आश्नां तादेवेदं तातृपाणा चरामि ॥
verses.rom:
yadvirupacharam martyeshvavasam ratrih sharadashchatasrah |
ghritasya stokam sakridahna ashnam tadevedam tatripana charami ||
verses.en:
When amid men in altered shape I sojourned, and through four autumns spent the nights among them,
I tasted once a day a drop of butter; and even now with that am I am contented.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षप्रां रजसो विमानीमुप शिक्षाम्युर्वशीं वसिष्ठः ।
उप त्वा रातिः सुकृतस्य तिष्ठान्नि वर्तस्व हृदयं तप्यते मे ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshapram rajaso vimanimupa shikshamyurvashim vasishthah |
upa tva ratih sukritasya tishthanni vartasva hridayam tapyate me ||
verses.en:
I, her best love, call Urvasi to meet me, her who fills air and measures out the region.
Let the gift brought by piety approach thee. Turn thou to me again: my heart is troubled.

verses.sa:
इति त्वा देवा इम आहुरैळ यथेमेतद्भवसि मृत्युबन्धुः ।
प्रजा ते देवान्हविषा यजाति स्वर्ग उ त्वमपि मादयासे ॥
verses.rom:
iti tva deva ima ahuraila yathemetadbhavasi mrityubandhuh |
praja te devanhavisha yajati svarga u tvamapi madayase ||
verses.en:
Thus speak these Gods to thee, O son of Ila: As death hath verily got thee for his subject,
Thy sons shall serve the Gods with their oblation, and thou, moreover, shalt rejoice in Svarga.

verses.sa:
