प्र ते महे विदथे शंसिषं हरी प्र ते वन्वे वनुषो हर्यतं मदम् ।
घृतं न यो हरिभिश्चारु सेचत आ त्वा विशन्तु हरिवर्पसं गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
pra te mahe vidathe shamsisham hari pra te vanve vanusho haryatam madam |
ghritam na yo haribhishcharu sechata a tva vishantu harivarpasam girah ||
verses.en:
In the great synod will I laud thy two Bay Steeds: I prize the sweet strong drink of thee the Warrior-God,
His who pours lovely oil as 'twere with yellow drops. Let my songs enter thee whose form hath golden tints.

verses.sa:
हरिं हि योनिमभि ये समस्वरन्हिन्वन्तो हरी दिव्यं यथा सदः ।
आ यं पृणन्ति हरिभिर्न धेनव इन्द्राय शूषं हरिवन्तमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
harim hi yonimabhi ye samasvaranhinvanto hari divyam yatha sadah |
a yam prinanti haribhirna dhenava indraya shusham harivantamarchata ||
verses.en:
Ye who in concert sing unto the gold hued place, like Bay Steeds driving onward to the heavenly seat,
For Indra laud ye strength allied with Tawny Steeds, laud him whom cows content as 'twere with yellow drops.

verses.sa:
सो अस्य वज्रो हरितो य आयसो हरिर्निकामो हरिरा गभस्त्योः ।
द्युम्नी सुशिप्रो हरिमन्युसायक इन्द्रे नि रूपा हरिता मिमिक्षिरे ॥
verses.rom:
so asya vajro harito ya ayaso harirnikamo harira gabhastyoh |
dyumni sushipro harimanyusayaka indre ni rupa harita mimikshire ||
verses.en:
His is that thunderbolt, of iron, golden hued, gold-coloured, very dear, and yellow in his arms;
Bright with strong teeth, destroying with its tawny rage. In Indra are set fast all forms of golden hue.

verses.sa:
दिवि न केतुरधि धायि हर्यतो विव्यचद्वज्रो हरितो न रंह्या ।
तुददहिं हरिशिप्रो य आयसः सहस्रशोका अभवद्धरिम्भरः ॥
verses.rom:
divi na keturadhi dhayi haryato vivyachadvajro harito na ramhya |
tudadahim harishipro ya ayasah sahasrashoka abhavaddharimbharah ||
verses.en:
As if a lovely ray were laid upon the sky, the golden thunderbolt spread out as in a race.
That iron bolt with yellow jaw smote Ahi down. A thousand flames had he who bore the tawny-hued.

verses.sa:
त्वंत्वमहर्यथा उपस्तुतः पूर्वेभिरिन्द्र हरिकेश यज्वभिः ।
त्वं हर्यसि तव विश्वमुक्थ्यमसामि राधो हरिजात हर्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamtvamaharyatha upastutah purvebhirindra harikesha yajvabhih |
tvam haryasi tava vishvamukthyamasami radho harijata haryatam ||
verses.en:
Thou, thou, when praised by men who sacrificed of old. hadst pleasure in their lauds, O Indra golden-haired.
All that befits thy song of praise thou welcomest, the perfect pleasant gift, O Golden-hued from birth.

verses.sa:
ता वज्रिणं मन्दिनं स्तोम्यं मद इन्द्रं रथे वहतो हर्यता हरी ।
पुरूण्यस्मै सवनानि हर्यत इन्द्राय सोमा हरयो दधन्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
ta vajrinam mandinam stomyam mada indram rathe vahato haryata hari |
purunyasmai savanani haryata indraya soma harayo dadhanvire ||
verses.en:
These two dear Bays bring hither Indra on his car, Thunder-armed, joyous, meet for laud, to drink his fill.
Many libations flow for him who loveth them: to Indra have the gold-hued Soma juices run.

verses.sa:
अरं कामाय हरयो दधन्विरे स्थिराय हिन्वन्हरयो हरी तुरा ।
अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्जोषमीयते सो अस्य कामं हरिवन्तमानशे ॥
verses.rom:
aram kamaya harayo dadhanvire sthiraya hinvanharayo hari tura |
arvadbhiryo haribhirjoshamiyate so asya kamam harivantamanashe ||
verses.en:
The gold-hued drops have flowed to gratify his wish: the yellow drops have urged the swift Bays to the Strong.
He who speeds on with Bay Steeds even as he lists hath satisfied his longing for the golden drops.

verses.sa:
हरिश्मशारुर्हरिकेश आयसस्तुरस्पेये यो हरिपा अवर्धत ।
अर्वद्भिर्यो हरिभिर्वाजिनीवसुरति विश्वा दुरिता पारिषद्धरी ॥
verses.rom:
harishmasharurharikesha ayasasturaspeye yo haripa avardhata |
arvadbhiryo haribhirvajinivasurati vishva durita parishaddhari ||
verses.en:
At the swift draught the Soma-drinker waxed in might, the Iron One with yellow beard and yellow hair.
He, Lord of Tawny Coursers, Lord of fleet-foot Mares, will bear his Bay Steeds safely over all distress.

verses.sa:
स्रुवेव यस्य हरिणी विपेततुः शिप्रे वाजाय हरिणी दविध्वतः ।
प्र यत्कृते चमसे मर्मृजद्धरी पीत्वा मदस्य हर्यतस्यान्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
sruveva yasya harini vipetatuh shipre vajaya harini davidhvatah |
pra yatkrite chamase marmrijaddhari pitva madasya haryatasyandhasah ||
verses.en:
His yellow-coloured jaws, like ladles move apart, what time, for strength, he makes the yellow-tinted stir,
When, while the bowl stands there, he grooms his Tawny Steeds, when he hath drunk strong drink, the sweet juice that he loves.

verses.sa:
उत स्म सद्म हर्यतस्य पस्त्योरत्यो न वाजं हरिवाँ अचिक्रदत् ।
मही चिद्धि धिषणाहर्यदोजसा बृहद्वयो दधिषे हर्यतश्चिदा ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma sadma haryatasya pastyoratyo na vajam harivan achikradat |
mahi chiddhi dhishanaharyadojasa brihadvayo dadhishe haryatashchida ||
verses.en:
Yea, to the Dear One's seat in homes of heaven and earth the Bay Steeds' Lord hath whinnied like a horse for food.
Then the great wish hath seized upon him mightily, and the Beloved One hath gained high power of life,

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी हर्यमाणो महित्वा नव्यंनव्यं हर्यसि मन्म नु प्रियम् ।
प्र पस्त्यमसुर हर्यतं गोराविष्कृधि हरये सूर्याय ॥
verses.rom:
a rodasi haryamano mahitva navyamnavyam haryasi manma nu priyam |
pra pastyamasura haryatam goravishkridhi haraye suryaya ||
verses.en:
Thou, comprehending with thy might the earth and heaven, acceptest the dear hymn for ever new and new.
O Asura, disclose thou and make visible the Cow's beloved home to the bright golden Sun.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा हर्यन्तं प्रयुजो जनानां रथे वहन्तु हरिशिप्रमिन्द्र ।
पिबा यथा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वो हर्यन्यज्ञं सधमादे दशोणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
a tva haryantam prayujo jananam rathe vahantu harishipramindra |
piba yatha pratibhritasya madhvo haryanyajnam sadhamade dashonim ||
verses.en:
O Indra, let the eager wishes of the folk bring thee, delightful, golden-visored, on thy car,
That, pleased with sacrifice wherein ten fingers toil, thou mayest, at the feast, drink of our offered meath.

verses.sa:
अपाः पूर्वेषां हरिवः सुतानामथो इदं सवनं केवलं ते ।
ममद्धि सोमं मधुमन्तमिन्द्र सत्रा वृषञ्जठर आ वृषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
apah purvesham harivah sutanamatho idam savanam kevalam te |
mamaddhi somam madhumantamindra satra vrishanjathara a vrishasva ||
verses.en:
Juices aforetime, Lord of Bays, thou drankest; and thine especially is this libation.
Gladden thee, Indra, with the meath-rich Soma: pour it down ever, Mighty One! within thee.

verses.sa:
या ओषधीः पूर्वा जाता देवेभ्यस्त्रियुगं पुरा ।
मनै नु बभ्रूणामहं शतं धामानि सप्त च ॥
verses.rom:
ya oshadhih purva jata devebhyastriyugam pura |
manai nu babhrunamaham shatam dhamani sapta cha ||
verses.en:
HERBS that sprang up in time of old, three ages earlier than the Gods,-
Of these, whose hue is brown, will I declare the hundred powers and seven.

verses.sa:
शतं वो अम्ब धामानि सहस्रमुत वो रुहः ।
अधा शतक्रत्वो यूयमिमं मे अगदं कृत ॥
verses.rom:
shatam vo amba dhamani sahasramuta vo ruhah |
adha shatakratvo yuyamimam me agadam krita ||
verses.en:
Ye, Mothers, have a hundred homes, yea, and a thousand are your growths.
Do ye who have a thousand powers free this my patient from disease.

verses.sa:
ओषधीः प्रति मोदध्वं पुष्पवतीः प्रसूवरीः ।
अश्वा इव सजित्वरीर्वीरुधः पारयिष्ण्वः ॥
verses.rom:
oshadhih prati modadhvam pushpavatih prasuvarih |
ashva iva sajitvarirvirudhah parayishnvah ||
verses.en:
Be glad and joyful in the Plants, both blossoming and bearing fruit,
Plants that will lead us to success like mares who conquer in the race.

verses.sa:
ओषधीरिति मातरस्तद्वो देवीरुप ब्रुवे ।
सनेयमश्वं गां वास आत्मानं तव पूरुष ॥
verses.rom:
oshadhiriti matarastadvo devirupa bruve |
saneyamashvam gam vasa atmanam tava purusha ||
verses.en:
Plants, by this name I speak to you, Mothers, to you the Goddesses:
Steed, cow, and garment may I win, win back thy very self, O man.

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता ।
गोभाज इत्किलासथ यत्सनवथ पूरुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvatthe vo nishadanam parne vo vasatishkrita |
gobhaja itkilasatha yatsanavatha purusham ||
verses.en:
The Holy Fig tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna tree:
Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

verses.sa:
यत्रौषधीः समग्मत राजानः समिताविव ।
विप्रः स उच्यते भिषग्रक्षोहामीवचातनः ॥
verses.rom:
yatraushadhih samagmata rajanah samitaviva |
viprah sa uchyate bhishagrakshohamivachatanah ||
verses.en:
He who hath store of Herbs at hand like Kings amid a crowd of men,-
Physician/Vaidya is that Bipra/sage's name, fiend-slayer, chaser of disease.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीं सोमावतीमूर्जयन्तीमुदोजसम् ।
आवित्सि सर्वा ओषधीरस्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
ashvavatim somavatimurjayantimudojasam |
avitsi sarva oshadhirasma arishtatataye ||
verses.en:
Herbs rich in Soma, rich in steeds, in nourishments, in strengthening power,-
All these have I provided here, that this man may be whole again.

verses.sa:
उच्छुष्मा ओषधीनां गावो गोष्ठादिवेरते ।
धनं सनिष्यन्तीनामात्मानं तव पूरुष ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhushma oshadhinam gavo goshthadiverate |
dhanam sanishyantinamatmanam tava purusha ||
verses.en:
The healing virtues of the Plants stream forth like cattle from the stall,-
Plants that shall win me store of wealth, and save thy vital breath, O man.

verses.sa:
इष्कृतिर्नाम वो माताथो यूयं स्थ निष्कृतीः ।
सीराः पतत्रिणी स्थन यदामयति निष्कृथ ॥
verses.rom:
ishkritirnama vo matatho yuyam stha nishkritih |
sirah patatrini sthana yadamayati nishkritha ||
verses.en:
Reliever is your mother's name, and hence Restorers are ye called.
Rivers are ye with wings that fly: keep far whatever brings disease.

verses.sa:
अति विश्वाः परिष्ठा स्तेन इव व्रजमक्रमुः ।
ओषधीः प्राचुच्यवुर्यत्किं च तन्वो रपः ॥
verses.rom:
ati vishvah parishtha stena iva vrajamakramuh |
oshadhih prachuchyavuryatkim cha tanvo rapah ||
verses.en:
Over all fences have they passed, as steals a thief into the fold.
The Plants have driven from the frame whatever malady was there.

verses.sa:
यदिमा वाजयन्नहमोषधीर्हस्त आदधे ।
आत्मा यक्ष्मस्य नश्यति पुरा जीवगृभो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
yadima vajayannahamoshadhirhasta adadhe |
atma yakshmasya nashyati pura jivagribho yatha ||
verses.en:
When, bringing back the vanished strength, I hold these herbs within my hand,
The spirit of disease departs ere he can seize upon the life.

verses.sa:
यस्यौषधीः प्रसर्पथाङ्गमङ्गं परुष्परुः ।
ततो यक्ष्मं वि बाधध्व उग्रो मध्यमशीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
yasyaushadhih prasarpathangamangam parushparuh |
tato yakshmam vi badhadhva ugro madhyamashiriva ||
verses.en:
He through whose frame, O Plants, ye creep member by member, joint by joint,-
From him ye drive away disease like some strong arbiter of strife.

verses.sa:
साकं यक्ष्म प्र पत चाषेण किकिदीविना ।
साकं वातस्य ध्राज्या साकं नश्य निहाकया ॥
verses.rom:
sakam yakshma pra pata chashena kikidivina |
sakam vatasya dhrajya sakam nashya nihakaya ||
verses.en:
Fly, Spirit of Disease, begone, with the blue jay and kingfisher.
Fly with the wind's impetuous speed, vanish together with the storm.

verses.sa:
अन्या वो अन्यामवत्वन्यान्यस्या उपावत ।
ताः सर्वाः संविदाना इदं मे प्रावता वचः ॥
verses.rom:
anya vo anyamavatvanyanyasya upavata |
tah sarvah samvidana idam me pravata vachah ||
verses.en:
Help every one the other, lend assistance each of you to each,
All of you be accordant, give furtherance to this speech of mine.

verses.sa:
याः फलिनीर्या अफला अपुष्पा याश्च पुष्पिणीः ।
बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yah phalinirya aphala apushpa yashcha pushpinih |
brihaspatiprasutasta no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en:
Let fruitful Plants, and fruitless, those that blossom, and the blossomless,
Urged onward by Brhaspati, release us from our pain and grief;

verses.sa:
मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्यादथो वरुण्यादुत ।
अथो यमस्य पड्बीशात्सर्वस्माद्देवकिल्बिषात् ॥
verses.rom:
munchantu ma shapathyadatho varunyaduta |
atho yamasya padbishatsarvasmaddevakilbishat ||
verses.en:
Release me from the curse's plague and woe that comes from Varuna;
Free me from Yama's fetter, from sin and offence against the Gods.

verses.sa:
अवपतन्तीरवदन्दिव ओषधयस्परि ।
यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः ॥
verses.rom:
avapatantiravadandiva oshadhayaspari |
yam jivamashnavamahai na sa rishyati purushah ||
verses.en:
What time, descending from the sky, the Plants flew earthward, thus they spake:
No evil shall befall the man whom while he liveth we pervade,

verses.sa:
या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः ।
तासां त्वमस्युत्तमारं कामाय शं हृदे ॥
verses.rom:
ya oshadhih somarajnirbahvih shatavichakshanah |
tasam tvamasyuttamaram kamaya sham hride ||
verses.en:
Of all the many Plants whose King is, Soma, Plants of hundred forms,
Thou art the Plant most excellent, prompt to the wish, sweet to the heart.

verses.sa:
या ओषधीः सोमराज्ञीर्विष्ठिताः पृथिवीमनु ।
बृहस्पतिप्रसूता अस्यै सं दत्त वीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya oshadhih somarajnirvishthitah prithivimanu |
brihaspatiprasuta asyai sam datta viryam ||
verses.en:
O all ye various Herbs whose King is Soma, that o'erspread the earth,
Urged onward by Brhaspati, combine your virtue in this Plant.

verses.sa:
मा वो रिषत्खनिता यस्मै चाहं खनामि वः ।
द्विपच्चतुष्पदस्माकं सर्वमस्त्वनातुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma vo rishatkhanita yasmai chaham khanami vah |
dvipachchatushpadasmakam sarvamastvanaturam ||
verses.en:
Unharmed be he who digs you up, unharmed the man for whom I dig:
And let no malady attack biped or quadruped of ours.

verses.sa:
याश्चेदमुपशृण्वन्ति याश्च दूरं परागताः ।
सर्वाः संगत्य वीरुधोऽस्यै सं दत्त वीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yashchedamupashrinvanti yashcha duram paragatah |
sarvah samgatya virudho'syai sam datta viryam ||
verses.en:
All Plants that hear this speech, and those that have departed far away,
Come all assembled and confer your healing power upon this Herb.

verses.sa:
ओषधयः सं वदन्ते सोमेन सह राज्ञा ।
यस्मै कृणोति ब्राह्मणस्तं राजन्पारयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
oshadhayah sam vadante somena saha rajna |
yasmai krinoti brahmanastam rajanparayamasi ||
verses.en:
With Soma as their Sovran Lord the Plants hold colloquy and say:
O King, we save from death the man whose cure a Brahman undertakes.

verses.sa:
त्वमुत्तमास्योषधे तव वृक्षा उपस्तयः ।
उपस्तिरस्तु सोऽस्माकं यो अस्माँ अभिदासति ॥
verses.rom:
tvamuttamasyoshadhe tava vriksha upastayah |
upastirastu so'smakam yo asman abhidasati ||
verses.en:
Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant thy vassals are the trees.
Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते प्रति मे देवतामिहि मित्रो वा यद्वरुणो वासि पूषा ।
आदित्यैर्वा यद्वसुभिर्मरुत्वान्स पर्जन्यं शंतनवे वृषाय ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate prati me devatamihi mitro va yadvaruno vasi pusha |
adityairva yadvasubhirmarutvansa parjanyam shamtanave vrishaya ||
verses.en:
COME, be thou Mitra, Varuna, or Pusan, come, O Brhaspati, to mine oblation:
With Maruts, Vasus, or Adityas, make thou Parjanya pour for Santanu his rain-drops.

verses.sa:
आ देवो दूतो अजिरश्चिकित्वान्त्वद्देवापे अभि मामगच्छत् ।
प्रतीचीनः प्रति मामा ववृत्स्व दधामि ते द्युमतीं वाचमासन् ॥
verses.rom:
a devo duto ajirashchikitvantvaddevape abhi mamagachchhat |
pratichinah prati mama vavritsva dadhami te dyumatim vachamasan ||
verses.en:
The God, intelligent, the speedy envoy whom thou hast sent hath come to me, Devapi:
Address thyself to me and turn thee hither within thy lips will I put brilliant language.

verses.sa:
अस्मे धेहि द्युमतीं वाचमासन्बृहस्पते अनमीवामिषिराम् ।
यया वृष्टिं शंतनवे वनाव दिवो द्रप्सो मधुमाँ आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
asme dhehi dyumatim vachamasanbrihaspate anamivamishiram |
yaya vrishtim shamtanave vanava divo drapso madhuman a vivesha ||
verses.en:
Within my mouth, Brhaspati, deposit speech lucid, vigorous, and free from weakness,
Thereby to win for Santanu the rain-fall. The meath-rich drop from heaven hath passed within it.

verses.sa:
आ नो द्रप्सा मधुमन्तो विशन्त्विन्द्र देह्यधिरथं सहस्रम् ।
नि षीद होत्रमृतुथा यजस्व देवान्देवापे हविषा सपर्य ॥
verses.rom:
a no drapsa madhumanto vishantvindra dehyadhiratham sahasram |
ni shida hotramritutha yajasva devandevape havisha saparya ||
verses.en:
Let the sweet drops descend on us, O Indra: give us enough to lade a thousand wagons.
Sit to thy Hotar task; pay worship duly, and serve the Gods, Devapi, with oblation.

verses.sa:
आर्ष्टिषेणो होत्रमृषिर्निषीदन्देवापिर्देवसुमतिं चिकित्वान् ।
स उत्तरस्मादधरं समुद्रमपो दिव्या असृजद्वर्ष्या अभि ॥
verses.rom:
arshtisheno hotramrishirnishidandevapirdevasumatim chikitvan |
sa uttarasmadadharam samudramapo divya asrijadvarshya abhi ||
verses.en:
Knowing the God's good-will, Devapi, Rsi, the son of Rstisena, sate as Hotar.
He hath brought down from heaven's most lofty summit the ocean of the rain, celestial waters.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्समुद्रे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्नापो देवेभिर्निवृता अतिष्ठन् ।
ता अद्रवन्नार्ष्टिषेणेन सृष्टा देवापिना प्रेषिता मृक्षिणीषु ॥
verses.rom:
asminsamudre adhyuttarasminnapo devebhirnivrita atishthan |
ta adravannarshtishenena srishta devapina preshita mrikshinishu ||
verses.en:
Gathered together in that highest ocean, the waters stood by deities obstructed.
They hurried down set free by Arstisena, in gaping clefts, urged onward by Devapi.

verses.sa:
यद्देवापिः शंतनवे पुरोहितो होत्राय वृतः कृपयन्नदीधेत् ।
देवश्रुतं वृष्टिवनिं रराणो बृहस्पतिर्वाचमस्मा अयच्छत् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddevapih shamtanave purohito hotraya vritah kripayannadidhet |
devashrutam vrishtivanim rarano brihaspatirvachamasma ayachchhat ||
verses.en:
When as chief priest for Santanu, Devapi, chosen for Hotar's duty, prayed beseeching,
Graciously pleased Brhaspati vouchsafed him a voice that reached the Gods and won the waters.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा देवापिः शुशुचानो अग्न आर्ष्टिषेणो मनुष्यः समीधे ।
विश्वेभिर्देवैरनुमद्यमानः प्र पर्जन्यमीरया वृष्टिमन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva devapih shushuchano agna arshtisheno manushyah samidhe |
vishvebhirdevairanumadyamanah pra parjanyamiraya vrishtimantam ||
verses.en:
O Agni whom Devapi Arstisena, the mortal man, hath kindled in his glory,
Joying in him with all the Gods together, urge on the sender of the rain, Parjanya.

verses.sa:
त्वां पूर्व ऋषयो गीर्भिरायन्त्वामध्वरेषु पुरुहूत विश्वे ।
सहस्राण्यधिरथान्यस्मे आ नो यज्ञं रोहिदश्वोप याहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam purva rishayo girbhirayantvamadhvareshu puruhuta vishve |
sahasranyadhirathanyasme a no yajnam rohidashvopa yahi ||
verses.en:
All ancient Rsis with their songs approached thee, even thee, O Much-invoked, at sacrifices.
We have provided wagon-loads in thousands: come to the solemn rite, Lord of Red Horses.

verses.sa:
एतान्यग्ने नवतिर्नव त्वे आहुतान्यधिरथा सहस्रा ।
तेभिर्वर्धस्व तन्वः शूर पूर्वीर्दिवो नो वृष्टिमिषितो रिरीहि ॥
verses.rom:
etanyagne navatirnava tve ahutanyadhiratha sahasra |
tebhirvardhasva tanvah shura purvirdivo no vrishtimishito ririhi ||
verses.en:
The wagon-loads, the nine-and-ninety thousand, these have been offered up to thee, O Agni.
Hero, with these increase thy many bodies, and, stimulated, send us rain from heaven.

verses.sa:
एतान्यग्ने नवतिं सहस्रा सं प्र यच्छ वृष्ण इन्द्राय भागम् ।
विद्वान्पथ ऋतुशो देवयानानप्यौलानं दिवि देवेषु धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
etanyagne navatim sahasra sam pra yachchha vrishna indraya bhagam |
vidvanpatha ritusho devayananapyaulanam divi deveshu dhehi ||
verses.en:
Give thou these ninety thousand loads, O Agni, to Indra, to the Bull, to be his portion.
Knowing the paths which Deities duly travel, set mid the Gods in heaven Aulana also.

verses.sa:
अग्ने बाधस्व वि मृधो वि दुर्गहापामीवामप रक्षांसि सेध ।
अस्मात्समुद्राद्बृहतो दिवो नोऽपां भूमानमुप नः सृजेह ॥
verses.rom:
agne badhasva vi mridho vi durgahapamivamapa rakshamsi sedha |
asmatsamudradbrihato divo no'pam bhumanamupa nah srijeha ||
verses.en:
O Agni, drive afar our foes, our troubles chase malady away and wicked demons.
From this air-ocean, from the lofty heavens, send down on us a mighty flood of waters.

verses.sa:
कं नश्चित्रमिषण्यसि चिकित्वान्पृथुग्मानं वाश्रं वावृधध्यै ।
कत्तस्य दातु शवसो व्युष्टौ तक्षद्वज्रं वृत्रतुरमपिन्वत् ॥
verses.rom:
kam nashchitramishanyasi chikitvanprithugmanam vashram vavridhadhyai |
kattasya datu shavaso vyushtau takshadvajram vritraturamapinvat ||
verses.en:
WHAT Splendid One, Loud-voiced, Far striding, dost thou, well knowing, urge us to exalt with praises?
What give we him? When his might dawned, he fashioned the Vrtra-slaying bolt, and sent us waters.

verses.sa:
स हि द्युता विद्युता वेति साम पृथुं योनिमसुरत्वा ससाद ।
स सनीळेभिः प्रसहानो अस्य भ्रातुर्न ऋते सप्तथस्य मायाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi dyuta vidyuta veti sama prithum yonimasuratva sasada |
sa sanilebhih prasahano asya bhraturna rite saptathasya mayah ||
verses.en:
He goes to end his work with lightning flashes: wide is the seat his Asura glory gives him.
With his Companions, not without his Brother, he quells Saptatha's magic devices.

verses.sa:
स वाजं यातापदुष्पदा यन्स्वर्षाता परि षदत्सनिष्यन् ।
अनर्वा यच्छतदुरस्य वेदो घ्नञ्छिश्नदेवाँ अभि वर्पसा भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vajam yatapadushpada yansvarshata pari shadatsanishyan |
anarva yachchhatadurasya vedo ghnanchhishnadevan abhi varpasa bhut ||
verses.en:
On most auspicious path he goes to battle he toiled to win heaven's light, full fain to gain it;
He seized the hundred-gated castle's treasure by craft, unchecked, and slew the lustful demons.

verses.sa:
स यह्व्योऽवनीर्गोष्वर्वा जुहोति प्रधन्यासु सस्रिः ।
अपादो यत्र युज्यासोऽरथा द्रोण्यश्वास ईरते घृतं वाः ॥
verses.rom:
sa yahvyo'vanirgoshvarva juhoti pradhanyasu sasrih |
apado yatra yujyaso'ratha dronyashvasa irate ghritam vah ||
verses.en:
Fighting for kine, the prize of war, and I roaming among the berd be brings the young streams hither,
Where, footless, joined, without a car to bear them, with jars for steeds, they pour their flood like butter.

verses.sa:
स रुद्रेभिरशस्तवार ऋभ्वा हित्वी गयमारेअवद्य आगात् ।
वम्रस्य मन्ये मिथुना विवव्री अन्नमभीत्यारोदयन्मुषायन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa rudrebhirashastavara ribhva hitvi gayamareavadya agat |
vamrasya manye mithuna vivavri annamabhityarodayanmushayan ||
verses.en:
Bold, unsolicited for wealth, with Rudras he came, the Blameless, having left his dwelling,
Came, seized the food of Vamra and his consort, and left the couple weeping and unsheltered.

verses.sa:
स इद्दासं तुवीरवं पतिर्दन्षळक्षं त्रिशीर्षाणं दमन्यत् ।
अस्य त्रितो न्वोजसा वृधानो विपा वराहमयोअग्रया हन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa iddasam tuviravam patirdanshalaksham trishirshanam damanyat |
asya trito nvojasa vridhano vipa varahamayoagraya han ||
verses.en:
Lord of the dwelling, he subdued the demon who roared aloud, six-eyed and triple-headed.
Trta, made stronger by the might he lent him, struck down the boar with shaft whose point was iron.

verses.sa:
स द्रुह्वणे मनुष ऊर्ध्वसान आ साविषदर्शसानाय शरुम् ।
स नृतमो नहुषोऽस्मत्सुजातः पुरोऽभिनदर्हन्दस्युहत्ये ॥
verses.rom:
sa druhvane manusha urdhvasana a savishadarshasanaya sharum |
sa nritamo nahusho'smatsujatah puro'bhinadarhandasyuhatye ||
verses.en:
He raised himself on high and shot his arrow against the guileful and oppressive foeman.
Strong, glorious, manliest, for us he shattered the forts of Nabus when he slew the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
सो अभ्रियो न यवस उदन्यन्क्षयाय गातुं विदन्नो अस्मे ।
उप यत्सीददिन्दुं शरीरैः श्येनोऽयोपाष्टिर्हन्ति दस्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
so abhriyo na yavasa udanyankshayaya gatum vidanno asme |
upa yatsidadindum shariraih shyeno'yopashtirhanti dasyun ||
verses.en:
He, like a cloud that rains upon the pasture, hath found for us the way to dwell in safety.
When the Hawk comes in body to the Soma, armed with his iron claws he slays the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
स व्राधतः शवसानेभिरस्य कुत्साय शुष्णं कृपणे परादात् ।
अयं कविमनयच्छस्यमानमत्कं यो अस्य सनितोत नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vradhatah shavasanebhirasya kutsaya shushnam kripane paradat |
ayam kavimanayachchhasyamanamatkam yo asya sanitota nrinam ||
verses.en:
He with his potent Friends gave up the mighty, gave Gusnia up to Kutsa for affliction.
He led the lauded Kavi, he delivered Atka as prey to him and to his heroes.

verses.sa:
अयं दशस्यन्नर्येभिरस्य दस्मो देवेभिर्वरुणो न मायी ।
अयं कनीन ऋतुपा अवेद्यमिमीताररुं यश्चतुष्पात् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam dashasyannaryebhirasya dasmo devebhirvaruno na mayi |
ayam kanina ritupa avedyamimitararum yashchatushpat ||
verses.en:
He, with his Gods who love mankind, the Wondrous, giving like Varuna who works with magic,
Was known, yet young as guardian of the seasons; and he quelled Araru, four-footed demon.

verses.sa:
अस्य स्तोमेभिरौशिज ऋजिश्वा व्रजं दरयद्वृषभेण पिप्रोः ।
सुत्वा यद्यजतो दीदयद्गीः पुर इयानो अभि वर्पसा भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
asya stomebhiraushija rijishva vrajam darayadvrishabhena piproh |
sutva yadyajato didayadgih pura iyano abhi varpasa bhut ||
verses.en:
Through lauds of him hath Ausija Rjisvan burst, with the Mighty's aid, the stall of Pipru.
When the saint pressed the juice and shone as singer, he seized the forts and with his craft subdued them.

verses.sa:
एवा महो असुर वक्षथाय वम्रकः पड्भिरुप सर्पदिन्द्रम् ।
स इयानः करति स्वस्तिमस्मा इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिं विश्वमाभाः ॥
verses.rom:
eva maho asura vakshathaya vamrakah padbhirupa sarpadindram |
sa iyanah karati svastimasma ishamurjam sukshitim vishvamabhah ||
verses.en:
So, swiftly Asura, for exaltation, hath the great Vamraka come nigh to Indra.
He will, when supplicated, bring him blessing: he hath brought all, food, strength, a happy dwelling.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र दृह्य मघवन्त्वावदिद्भुज इह स्तुतः सुतपा बोधि नो वृधे ।
देवेभिर्नः सविता प्रावतु श्रुतमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
indra drihya maghavantvavadidbhuja iha stutah sutapa bodhi no vridhe |
devebhirnah savita pravatu shrutama sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Be, like thyself, O Indra, strong for our delight: here lauded, aid us, Maghavan, drinker of the juice.
Savitar with the Gods protect us: hear ye Twain. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
भराय सु भरत भागमृत्वियं प्र वायवे शुचिपे क्रन्ददिष्टये ।
गौरस्य यः पयसः पीतिमानश आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
bharaya su bharata bhagamritviyam pra vayave shuchipe krandadishtaye |
gaurasya yah payasah pitimanasha a sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Bring swift, for offering, the snare that suits the time, to the pure-drinker Vayu, roaring as he goes,
To him who hath approached the draught of shining milk. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवः सविता साविषद्वय ऋजूयते यजमानाय सुन्वते ।
यथा देवान्प्रतिभूषेम पाकवदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
a no devah savita savishadvaya rijuyate yajamanaya sunvate |
yatha devanpratibhushema pakavada sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
May Savitar the God send us full life, to each who sacrifices, lives aright and pours the juice
That we with simple hearts may wait upon the Gods. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो अस्मे सुमना अस्तु विश्वहा राजा सोमः सुवितस्याध्येतु नः ।
यथायथा मित्रधितानि संदधुरा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
indro asme sumana astu vishvaha raja somah suvitasyadhyetu nah |
yathayatha mitradhitani samdadhura sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
May Indra evermore be gracious unto us, and may King Soma meditate our happiness,
Even as men secure the comfort of a friend. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र उक्थेन शवसा परुर्दधे बृहस्पते प्रतरीतास्यायुषः ।
यज्ञो मनुः प्रमतिर्नः पिता हि कमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
indra ukthena shavasa parurdadhe brihaspate prataritasyayushah |
yajno manuh pramatirnah pita hi kama sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Indra hath given the body with its song and strength: Brhaspati, thou art the lengthener of life.
The sacrifice is Manu, Providence, our Sire. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नु सुकृतं दैव्यं सहोऽग्निर्गृहे जरिता मेधिरः कविः ।
यज्ञश्च भूद्विदथे चारुरन्तम आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya nu sukritam daivyam saho'gnirgrihe jarita medhirah kavih |
yajnashcha bhudvidathe charurantama a sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Indra possesseth might celestial nobly formed: the singer in the hotise is Agni, prudent Sage.
lie is the sacrifice in synod, fair, most near. We ask for freedom and complete felicity,

verses.sa:
न वो गुहा चकृम भूरि दुष्कृतं नाविष्ट्यं वसवो देवहेळनम् ।
माकिर्नो देवा अनृतस्य वर्पस आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
na vo guha chakrima bhuri dushkritam navishtyam vasavo devahelanam |
makirno deva anritasya varpasa a sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Not often have we sinned against you secretly, nor, Vasus, have we openly provoked the Gods.
Not one of its, ye Gods, hath worn an alien shape. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
अपामीवां सविता साविषन्न्यग्वरीय इदप सेधन्त्वद्रयः ।
ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
apamivam savita savishannyagvariya idapa sedhantvadrayah |
grava yatra madhushuduchyate brihada sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
May Savitar remove from us our malady, and may the Mountains keep it far away from where
The press-stone as it sheds the meath rings loudly forth. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो ग्रावा वसवोऽस्तु सोतरि विश्वा द्वेषांसि सनुतर्युयोत ।
स नो देवः सविता पायुरीड्य आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo grava vasavo'stu sotari vishva dveshamsi sanutaryuyota |
sa no devah savita payuridya a sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Ye Vasus, let the stone, the presser stand erect: avert all enmities and keep them far remote.
Our guard to be adored is Savitar this God. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जं गावो यवसे पीवो अत्तन ऋतस्य याः सदने कोशे अङ्ग्ध्वे ।
तनूरेव तन्वो अस्तु भेषजमा सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
urjam gavo yavase pivo attana ritasya yah sadane koshe angdhve |
tanureva tanvo astu bheshajama sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Eat strength and fatness in the pasture, kine, who are balmed at the reservoir and at the seat of Law.
So let your body be our body's medicine. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
क्रतुप्रावा जरिता शश्वतामव इन्द्र इद्भद्रा प्रमतिः सुतावताम् ।
पूर्णमूधर्दिव्यं यस्य सिक्तय आ सर्वतातिमदितिं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
kratuprava jarita shashvatamava indra idbhadra pramatih sutavatam |
purnamudhardivyam yasya siktaya a sarvatatimaditim vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
The singer fills the spirit: all mens, love hath he. Indra takes kindly care of those who pour the juice.
For his libation is the heavenly udder full. We ask for freedom and complete felicity.

verses.sa:
चित्रस्ते भानुः क्रतुप्रा अभिष्टिः सन्ति स्पृधो जरणिप्रा अधृष्टाः ।
रजिष्ठया रज्या पश्व आ गोस्तूतूर्षति पर्यग्रं दुवस्युः ॥
verses.rom:
chitraste bhanuh kratupra abhishtih santi spridho jaranipra adhrishtah |
rajishthaya rajya pashva a gostuturshati paryagram duvasyuh ||
verses.en:
Wondrous thy spirit-filling light, triumphant; thy hosts save from decay and are resistless.
The pious votary by straightest pathway speeds to possess the best of all the cattle.

verses.sa:
उद्बुध्यध्वं समनसः सखायः समग्निमिन्ध्वं बहवः सनीळाः ।
दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीमिन्द्रावतोऽवसे नि ह्वये वः ॥
verses.rom:
udbudhyadhvam samanasah sakhayah samagnimindhvam bahavah sanilah |
dadhikramagnimushasam cha devimindravato'vase ni hvaye vah ||
verses.en:
WAKE with one mind, my friends, and kindle Agni, ye who are many and who dwell together.
Agni and Dadhikras and Dawn the Goddess, you, Gods with Indra, I call down to help us.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रा कृणुध्वं धिय आ तनुध्वं नावमरित्रपरणीं कृणुध्वम् ।
इष्कृणुध्वमायुधारं कृणुध्वं प्राञ्चं यज्ञं प्र णयता सखायः ॥
verses.rom:
mandra krinudhvam dhiya a tanudhvam navamaritraparanim krinudhvam |
ishkrinudhvamayudharam krinudhvam prancham yajnam pra nayata sakhayah ||
verses.en:
Make pleasant hymns, spin out your songs and praises: build ye a ship equipped with oars for transport.
Prepare the implements, make all things ready, and let the sacrifice, my friends, go forward.

verses.sa:
युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनुध्वं कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम् ।
गिरा च श्रुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीय इत्सृण्यः पक्वमेयात् ॥
verses.rom:
yunakta sira vi yuga tanudhvam krite yonau vapateha bijam |
gira cha shrushtih sabhara asanno nediya itsrinyah pakvameyat ||
verses.en:
Lay on the yokes, and fasten well the traces: formed is the furrow, sow the seed within it.
Through song may we find bearing fraught with plenty: near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.

verses.sa:
सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक् ।
धीरा देवेषु सुम्नया ॥
verses.rom:
sira yunjanti kavayo yuga vi tanvate prithak |
dhira deveshu sumnaya ||
verses.en: Wise, through desire of bliss from Gods, the skillful bind the traces fast, And lay the yokes on either side.

verses.sa:
निराहावान्कृणोतन सं वरत्रा दधातन ।
सिञ्चामहा अवतमुद्रिणं वयं सुषेकमनुपक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
nirahavankrinotana sam varatra dadhatana |
sinchamaha avatamudrinam vayam sushekamanupakshitam ||
verses.en:
Arrange the buckets in their place securely fasten on the straps.
We will pour forth the well that hath a copious stream, fair-flowing well that never fails.

verses.sa:
इष्कृताहावमवतं सुवरत्रं सुषेचनम् ।
उद्रिणं सिञ्चे अक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ishkritahavamavatam suvaratram sushechanam |
udrinam sinche akshitam ||
verses.en:
I pour the water from the well with pails prepared and goodly straps,
Unfailing, full, with plenteous stream.

verses.sa:
प्रीणीताश्वान्हितं जयाथ स्वस्तिवाहं रथमित्कृणुध्वम् ।
द्रोणाहावमवतमश्मचक्रमंसत्रकोशं सिञ्चता नृपाणम् ॥
verses.rom:
prinitashvanhitam jayatha svastivaham rathamitkrinudhvam |
dronahavamavatamashmachakramamsatrakosham sinchata nripanam ||
verses.en:
Refresh the horses, win the prize before you: equip a chariot fraught with happy fortune.
Pour forth the well with stone wheel, wooden buckets, the drink of heroes, with the trough for armour.

verses.sa:
व्रजं कृणुध्वं स हि वो नृपाणो वर्म सीव्यध्वं बहुला पृथूनि ।
पुरः कृणुध्वमायसीरधृष्टा मा वः सुस्रोच्चमसो दृंहता तम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrajam krinudhvam sa hi vo nripano varma sivyadhvam bahula prithuni |
purah krinudhvamayasiradhrishta ma vah susrochchamaso drimhata tam ||
verses.en:
Prepare the cow-stall, for there drink your heroes: stitch ye the coats of armour, wide and many.
Make iron forts, secure from all assailants let not your pitcher leak: stay it securely.

verses.sa:
आ वो धियं यज्ञियां वर्त ऊतये देवा देवीं यजतां यज्ञियामिह ।
सा नो दुहीयद्यवसेव गत्वी सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः ॥
verses.rom:
a vo dhiyam yajniyam varta utaye deva devim yajatam yajniyamiha |
sa no duhiyadyavaseva gatvi sahasradhara payasa mahi gauh ||
verses.en:
Hither, for help, I turn the holy heavenly mind of you the Holy Gods, that longs for sacrifice.
May it pour milk for us, even as a stately cow who, having sought the pasture, yields a thousand streams.

verses.sa:
आ तू षिञ्च हरिमीं द्रोरुपस्थे वाशीभिस्तक्षताश्मन्मयीभिः ।
परि ष्वजध्वं दश कक्ष्याभिरुभे धुरौ प्रति वह्निं युनक्त ॥
verses.rom:
a tu shincha harimim drorupasthe vashibhistakshatashmanmayibhih |
pari shvajadhvam dasha kakshyabhirubhe dhurau prati vahnim yunakta ||
verses.en:
Pour golden juice within the wooden vessel: with stone-made axes fashion ye and form it.
Embrace and compass it with tenfold girdle, and to both chariot-poles attach the car-horse.

verses.sa:
उभे धुरौ वह्निरापिब्दमानोऽन्तर्योनेव चरति द्विजानिः ।
वनस्पतिं वन आस्थापयध्वं नि षू दधिध्वमखनन्त उत्सम् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe dhurau vahnirapibdamano'ntaryoneva charati dvijanih |
vanaspatim vana asthapayadhvam ni shu dadhidhvamakhananta utsam ||
verses.en:
Between both poles the car-horse goes pressed closely, as in his dwelling moves the doubly-wedded.
Lay in the wood the Soviran of the Forest, and sink the well although ye do not dig it.

verses.sa:
कपृन्नरः कपृथमुद्दधातन चोदयत खुदत वाजसातये ।
निष्टिग्र्यः पुत्रमा च्यावयोतय इन्द्रं सबाध इह सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
kaprinnarah kaprithamuddadhatana chodayata khudata vajasataye |
nishtigryah putrama chyavayotaya indram sabadha iha somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Indra is he, O men, who gives us happiness: sport, urge the giver of delight to win us strength
Bring quickly down, O priests, hither to give us aid, to drink the Soma, Indra Son of Nistigri.

verses.sa:
प्र ते रथं मिथूकृतमिन्द्रोऽवतु धृष्णुया ।
अस्मिन्नाजौ पुरुहूत श्रवाय्ये धनभक्षेषु नोऽव ॥
verses.rom:
pra te ratham mithukritamindro'vatu dhrishnuya |
asminnajau puruhuta shravayye dhanabhaksheshu no'va ||
verses.en:
FOR thee may Indra boldly speed the car that works on either side.
Favour us, Much-invoked! in this most glorious fight against the raiders of our wealth.

verses.sa:
उत्स्म वातो वहति वासोऽस्या अधिरथं यदजयत्सहस्रम् ।
रथीरभून्मुद्गलानी गविष्टौ भरे कृतं व्यचेदिन्द्रसेना ॥
verses.rom:
utsma vato vahati vaso'sya adhiratham yadajayatsahasram |
rathirabhunmudgalani gavishtau bhare kritam vyachedindrasena ||
verses.en:
Loose in the wind the woman's robe was streaming what time she won a car-load worth a thousand.
The charioteer in fight was Mudgalani: she Indra's dart, heaped up the prize of battle.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्यच्छ जिघांसतो वज्रमिन्द्राभिदासतः ।
दासस्य वा मघवन्नार्यस्य वा सनुतर्यवया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
antaryachchha jighamsato vajramindrabhidasatah |
dasasya va maghavannaryasya va sanutaryavaya vadham ||
verses.en:
O Indra, cast thy bolt among assailants who would slaughter us:
The weapon both of Dasa and of Arya foe keep far away, O Maghavan.

verses.sa:
उद्नो ह्रदमपिबज्जर्हृषाणः कूटं स्म तृंहदभिमातिमेति ।
प्र मुष्कभारः श्रव इच्छमानोऽजिरं बाहू अभरत्सिषासन् ॥
verses.rom:
udno hradamapibajjarhrishanah kutam sma trimhadabhimatimeti |
pra mushkabharah shrava ichchhamano'jiram bahu abharatsishasan ||
verses.en:
The bull in joy had drunk a lake of water. His shattering horn encountered an opponent.
Swiftly, in vigorous strength, eager for glory, he stretched his forefeet, fain to win and triumph.

verses.sa:
न्यक्रन्दयन्नुपयन्त एनममेहयन्वृषभं मध्य आजेः ।
तेन सूभर्वं शतवत्सहस्रं गवां मुद्गलः प्रधने जिगाय ॥
verses.rom:
nyakrandayannupayanta enamamehayanvrishabham madhya ajeh |
tena subharvam shatavatsahasram gavam mudgalah pradhane jigaya ||
verses.en:
They came anear the bull; they made him thunder, made him pour rain down ere the fight was ended.
And Mudgala thereby won in the contest well-pastured kine in hundreds and in thousands.

verses.sa:
ककर्दवे वृषभो युक्त आसीदवावचीत्सारथिरस्य केशी ।
दुधेर्युक्तस्य द्रवतः सहानस ऋच्छन्ति ष्मा निष्पदो मुद्गलानीम् ॥
verses.rom:
kakardave vrishabho yukta asidavavachitsarathirasya keshi |
dudheryuktasya dravatah sahanasa richchhanti shma nishpado mudgalanim ||
verses.en:
In hope of victory that bull was harnessed: Kesi the driver urged him on with shouting.
As he ran swiftly with the car behind him his lifted heels pressed close on Mudgalani.

verses.sa:
उत प्रधिमुदहन्नस्य विद्वानुपायुनग्वंसगमत्र शिक्षन् ।
इन्द्र उदावत्पतिमघ्न्यानामरंहत पद्याभिः ककुद्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
uta pradhimudahannasya vidvanupayunagvamsagamatra shikshan |
indra udavatpatimaghnyanamaramhata padyabhih kakudman ||
verses.en:
Deftly for him he stretched the car-pole forward, guided the bull thereto and firmly yoked him.
Indra vouchsafed the lord of cows his favour: with mighty steps the buffalo ran onward.

verses.sa:
शुनमष्ट्राव्यचरत्कपर्दी वरत्रायां दार्वानह्यमानः ।
नृम्णानि कृण्वन्बहवे जनाय गाः पस्पशानस्तविषीरधत्त ॥
verses.rom:
shunamashtravyacharatkapardi varatrayam darvanahyamanah |
nrimnani krinvanbahave janaya gah paspashanastavishiradhatta ||
verses.en:
Touched by the goad the shaggy beast went nobly, bound to the pole by the yoke's thong of leather.
Performing deeds of might for many people, he, looking on the cows, gained strength and vigour.

verses.sa:
इमं तं पश्य वृषभस्य युञ्जं काष्ठाया मध्ये द्रुघणं शयानम् ।
येन जिगाय शतवत्सहस्रं गवां मुद्गलः पृतनाज्येषु ॥
verses.rom:
imam tam pashya vrishabhasya yunjam kashthaya madhye drughanam shayanam |
yena jigaya shatavatsahasram gavam mudgalah pritanajyeshu ||
verses.en:
Here look upon this mace, this bull's companion, now lying midway on the field of battle.
Therewith hath Mudgala in ordered contest won for cattle for himself, a hundred thousand.

verses.sa:
आरे अघा को न्वित्था ददर्श यं युञ्जन्ति तम्वा स्थापयन्ति ।
नास्मै तृणं नोदकमा भरन्त्युत्तरो धुरो वहति प्रदेदिशत् ॥
verses.rom:
are agha ko nvittha dadarsha yam yunjanti tamva sthapayanti |
nasmai trinam nodakama bharantyuttaro dhuro vahati pradedishat ||
verses.en:
Far is the evil: who hath here beheld it? Hither they bring the bull whom they are yoking..
To this they give not either food or water. Reaching beyond the pole it gives directions.

verses.sa:
परिवृक्तेव पतिविद्यमानट् पीप्याना कूचक्रेणेव सिञ्चन् ।
एषैष्या चिद्रथ्या जयेम सुमङ्गलं सिनवदस्तु सातम् ॥
verses.rom:
parivrikteva patividyamanat pipyana kuchakreneva sinchan |
eshaishya chidrathya jayema sumangalam sinavadastu satam ||
verses.en:
Like one forsaken, she hath found a husband, and teemed as if her breast were full and flowing.
With swiftly-racing chariot may we conquer, and rich and blessed be our gains in battle.

verses.sa:
त्वं विश्वस्य जगतश्चक्षुरिन्द्रासि चक्षुषः ।
वृषा यदाजिं वृषणा सिषाससि चोदयन्वध्रिणा युजा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishvasya jagatashchakshurindrasi chakshushah |
vrisha yadajim vrishana sishasasi chodayanvadhrina yuja ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, art the mark whereon the eyes of all life rest, when thou,
A Bull who drivest with thy bull, wilt win the race together with thy weakling friend.

verses.sa:
आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
संक्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतं सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ashuh shishano vrishabho na bhimo ghanaghanah kshobhanashcharshaninam |
samkrandano'nimisha ekavirah shatam sena ajayatsakamindrah ||
verses.en:
SWIFT, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people,
With eyes that close not, bellowing, Sole Hero, Indra. subdued at once a hundred armies.

verses.sa:
संक्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना ।
तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा ॥
verses.rom:
samkrandanenanimishena jishnuna yutkarena dushchyavanena dhrishnuna |
tadindrena jayata tatsahadhvam yudho nara ishuhastena vrishna ||
verses.en:
With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to overthrow, Rouser of battle,
Indra. the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.

verses.sa:
स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी संस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन ।
संसृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्युग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता ॥
verses.rom:
sa ishuhastaih sa nishangibhirvashi samsrashta sa yudha indro ganena |
samsrishtajitsomapa bahushardhyugradhanva pratihitabhirasta ||
verses.en:
He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band rings hosts together,
Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ अपबाधमानः ।
प्रभञ्जन्त्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate pari diya rathena rakshohamitran apabadhamanah |
prabhanjantsenah pramrino yudha jayannasmakamedhyavita rathanam ||
verses.en:
Brhaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen.
Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies.

verses.sa:
बलविज्ञाय स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान्वाजी सहमान उग्रः ।
अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित् ॥
verses.rom:
balavijnaya sthavirah pravirah sahasvanvaji sahamana ugrah |
abhiviro abhisatva sahoja jaitramindra rathama tishtha govit ||
verses.en:
Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing,
The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra.

verses.sa:
गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा ।
इमं सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
gotrabhidam govidam vajrabahum jayantamajma pramrinantamojasa |
imam sajata anu virayadhvamindram sakhayo anu sam rabhadhvam ||
verses.en:
Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it.-
Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.

verses.sa:
अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः ।
दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाळयुध्योऽस्माकं सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gotrani sahasa gahamano'dayo virah shatamanyurindrah |
dushchyavanah pritanashalayudhyo'smakam sena avatu pra yutsu ||
verses.en:
Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the pitiless Hero, wild with anger,
Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless, may he protect our armies in our battles.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः ।
देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra asam neta brihaspatirdakshina yajnah pura etu somah |
devasenanamabhibhanjatinam jayantinam maruto yantvagram ||
verses.en:
Indra guide these: Brhaspati precede them, the guerdon, and the sacrifice, and Soma;
And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुतां शर्ध उग्रम् ।
महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya vrishno varunasya rajna adityanam marutam shardha ugram |
mahamanasam bhuvanachyavanam ghosho devanam jayatamudasthat ||
verses.en:
Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts, and Adityas.
Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer high-minded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.

verses.sa:
उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनांसि ।
उद्वृत्रहन्वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः ॥
verses.rom:
uddharshaya maghavannayudhanyutsatvanam mamakanam manamsi |
udvritrahanvajinam vajinanyudrathanam jayatam yantu ghoshah ||
verses.en:
Bristle thou up, O Maghavan, our weapons: excite the spirits of my warring heroes.
Urge on the strong steeds' might, O Vrtra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु ।
अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ उ देवा अवता हवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamindrah samriteshu dhvajeshvasmakam ya ishavasta jayantu |
asmakam vira uttare bhavantvasman u deva avata haveshu ||
verses.en:
May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army.
May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods, protect us in the shout of onset.

verses.sa:
अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि ।
अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
amisham chittam pratilobhayanti grihananganyapve parehi |
abhi prehi nirdaha hritsu shokairandhenamitrastamasa sachantam ||
verses.en:
Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies and depart, O Apva.
Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let our foes abide in utter darkness.

verses.sa:
प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु ।
उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ ॥
verses.rom:
preta jayata nara indro vah sharma yachchhatu |
ugra vah santu bahavo'nadhrishya yathasatha ||
verses.en:
Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure defense.
Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or injure you.

verses.sa:
असावि सोमः पुरुहूत तुभ्यं हरिभ्यां यज्ञमुप याहि तूयम् ।
तुभ्यं गिरो विप्रवीरा इयाना दधन्विर इन्द्र पिबा सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
asavi somah puruhuta tubhyam haribhyam yajnamupa yahi tuyam |
tubhyam giro vipravira iyana dadhanvira indra piba sutasya ||
verses.en:
Soma hath flowed for thee, Invoked of mat Speed to our sacrifice with both thy Coursers.
To thee have streamed the songs or mighty singers, imploring, Indra, drink of our libation.

verses.sa:
अप्सु धूतस्य हरिवः पिबेह नृभिः सुतस्य जठरं पृणस्व ।
मिमिक्षुर्यमद्रय इन्द्र तुभ्यं तेभिर्वर्धस्व मदमुक्थवाहः ॥
verses.rom:
apsu dhutasya harivah pibeha nribhih sutasya jatharam prinasva |
mimikshuryamadraya indra tubhyam tebhirvardhasva madamukthavahah ||
verses.en:
Drink of the juice which men have washed in waters, and fill thee full, O Lord of Tawny Horses.
O Indra, hearer of the laud, with Soma which stones have mixed for thee enhance thy rapture.

verses.sa:
प्रोग्रां पीतिं वृष्ण इयर्मि सत्यां प्रयै सुतस्य हर्यश्व तुभ्यम् ।
इन्द्र धेनाभिरिह मादयस्व धीभिर्विश्वाभिः शच्या गृणानः ॥
verses.rom:
program pitim vrishna iyarmi satyam prayai sutasya haryashva tubhyam |
indra dhenabhiriha madayasva dhibhirvishvabhih shachya grinanah ||
verses.en:
To make thee start, a strong true draught I offer to thee, the Bull, O thou whom Bay Steeds carry.
Here take delight, O Indra, in our voices while thou art hymned with power and all our spirit.

verses.sa:
ऊती शचीवस्तव वीर्येण वयो दधाना उशिज ऋतज्ञाः ।
प्रजावदिन्द्र मनुषो दुरोणे तस्थुर्गृणन्तः सधमाद्यासः ॥
verses.rom:
uti shachivastava viryena vayo dadhana ushija ritajnah |
prajavadindra manusho durone tasthurgrinantah sadhamadyasah ||
verses.en:
O Mighty Indra, through thine aid, thy prowess, obtaining life, zealous, and skilled in Order,
Men in the house who share the sacred banquet stand singing praise that brings them store of children.

verses.sa:
प्रणीतिभिष्टे हर्यश्व सुष्टोः सुषुम्नस्य पुरुरुचो जनासः ।
मंहिष्ठामूतिं वितिरे दधाना स्तोतार इन्द्र तव सूनृताभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pranitibhishte haryashva sushtoh sushumnasya pururucho janasah |
mamhishthamutim vitire dadhana stotara indra tava sunritabhih ||
verses.en:
Through thy directions, Lord of Tawny Coursers, thine who art firm, splendid, and blest, the people
Obtain most liberal aid for their salvation, and praise thee, Indra, through thine excellencies.

verses.sa:
उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवो हरिभ्यां सोमस्य याहि पीतये सुतस्य ।
इन्द्र त्वा यज्ञः क्षममाणमानड् दाश्वाँ अस्यध्वरस्य प्रकेतः ॥
verses.rom:
upa brahmani harivo haribhyam somasya yahi pitaye sutasya |
indra tva yajnah kshamamanamanad dashvan asyadhvarasya praketah ||
verses.en:
Lord of the Bays, come with thy two Bay Horses, come to our prayers, to drink the juice of Soma.
To thee comes sacrifice which thou acceptest: thou, skilled in holy rites, art he who giveth.

verses.sa:
सहस्रवाजमभिमातिषाहं सुतेरणं मघवानं सुवृक्तिम् ।
उप भूषन्ति गिरो अप्रतीतमिन्द्रं नमस्या जरितुः पनन्त ॥
verses.rom:
sahasravajamabhimatishaham suteranam maghavanam suvriktim |
upa bhushanti giro apratitamindram namasya jarituh pananta ||
verses.en:
Him of a thousand powers, subduing foemen, Maghavan praised with hymns and pleased with Soma,-
Even him our songs approach, resistless Indra: the adorations of the singer laud him.

verses.sa:
सप्तापो देवीः सुरणा अमृक्ता याभिः सिन्धुमतर इन्द्र पूर्भित् ।
नवतिं स्रोत्या नव च स्रवन्तीर्देवेभ्यो गातुं मनुषे च विन्दः ॥
verses.rom:
saptapo devih surana amrikta yabhih sindhumatara indra purbhit |
navatim srotya nava cha sravantirdevebhyo gatum manushe cha vindah ||
verses.en:
The way to bliss for Gods and man thou foundest, Indra, seven lovely floods, divine, untroubled,
Wherewith thou, rending forts, didst move the ocean, and nine-and-ninety flowing streams of water.

verses.sa:
अपो महीरभिशस्तेरमुञ्चोऽजागरास्वधि देव एकः ।
इन्द्र यास्त्वं वृत्रतूर्ये चकर्थ ताभिर्विश्वायुस्तन्वं पुपुष्याः ॥
verses.rom:
apo mahirabhishasteramuncho'jagarasvadhi deva ekah |
indra yastvam vritraturye chakartha tabhirvishvayustanvam pupushyah ||
verses.en:
Thou from the curse didst free the mighty Waters, and as their only God didst watch and guard them.
O Indra, cherish evermore thy body with those which thou hast won in quelling Vrtra.

verses.sa:
वीरेण्यः क्रतुरिन्द्रः सुशस्तिरुतापि धेना पुरुहूतमीट्टे ।
आर्दयद्वृत्रमकृणोदु लोकं ससाहे शक्रः पृतना अभिष्टिः ॥
verses.rom:
virenyah kraturindrah sushastirutapi dhena puruhutamitte |
ardayadvritramakrinodu lokam sasahe shakrah pritana abhishtih ||
verses.en:
Heroic power and noble praise is Indra yea, the song worships him invoked of many.
Vrtra he quelled, and gave men room and freedom: Gakra, victorious, hath conquered armies.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghayan, auspicious Indra. best Hero in this fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
कदा वसो स्तोत्रं हर्यत आव श्मशा रुधद्वाः ।
दीर्घं सुतं वाताप्याय ॥
verses.rom:
kada vaso stotram haryata ava shmasha rudhadvah |
dirgham sutam vatapyaya ||
verses.en:
WHEN, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the channel bring the stream.
The juice is ready to ferment.

verses.sa:
हरी यस्य सुयुजा विव्रता वेरर्वन्तानु शेपा ।
उभा रजी न केशिना पतिर्दन् ॥
verses.rom:
hari yasya suyuja vivrata verarvantanu shepa |
ubha raji na keshina patirdan ||
verses.en:
He whose two Bay Steeds harnessed well, swerving, pursue the Bird's tail-plumes,
With Rowing manes, like heaven and earth, he is the Lord with power to give.

verses.sa:
अप योरिन्द्रः पापज आ मर्तो न शश्रमाणो बिभीवान् ।
शुभे यद्युयुजे तविषीवान् ॥
verses.rom:
apa yorindrah papaja a marto na shashramano bibhivan |
shubhe yadyuyuje tavishivan ||
verses.en:
Bereft of skill is Indra, if, like some outwearied man he fears
The sinner, when the Mighty hath prepared himself for victory.

verses.sa:
सचायोरिन्द्रश्चर्कृष आँ उपानसः सपर्यन् ।
नदयोर्विव्रतयोः शूर इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
sachayorindrashcharkrisha an upanasah saparyan |
nadayorvivratayoh shura indrah ||
verses.en:
Indra with these drives round, until he meets with one to worship him:
Indra is Master of the pair who snort and swerve upon their way.

verses.sa:
अधि यस्तस्थौ केशवन्ता व्यचस्वन्ता न पुष्ट्यै ।
वनोति शिप्राभ्यां शिप्रिणीवान् ॥
verses.rom:
adhi yastasthau keshavanta vyachasvanta na pushtyai |
vanoti shiprabhyam shiprinivan ||
verses.en:
Borne onward by the long-maned Steeds who stretch themselves as 'twere for food,
The God who wears the helm defends them with his jaws.

verses.sa:
प्रास्तौदृष्वौजा ऋष्वेभिस्ततक्ष शूरः शवसा ।
ऋभुर्न क्रतुभिर्मातरिश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
prastaudrishvauja rishvebhistataksha shurah shavasa |
ribhurna kratubhirmatarishva ||
verses.en:
The Mighty sang with Lofty Ones: the Hero fashioned with his strength,
Like skillful Matarisvan with his power and might,

verses.sa:
वज्रं यश्चक्रे सुहनाय दस्यवे हिरीमशो हिरीमान् ।
अरुतहनुरद्भुतं न रजः ॥
verses.rom:
vajram yashchakre suhanaya dasyave hirimasho hiriman |
arutahanuradbhutam na rajah ||
verses.en:
The bolt, which pierced at once the vitals of the Dasyu easy to be slain,
With jaw uninjured like the wondrous firmament.

verses.sa:
अव नो वृजिना शिशीह्यृचा वनेमानृचः ।
नाब्रह्मा यज्ञ ऋधग्जोषति त्वे ॥
verses.rom:
ava no vrijina shishihyricha vanemanrichah |
nabrahma yajna ridhagjoshati tve ||
verses.en:
Grind off our sins: with song will we conquer the men who sing no hymns:
Not easily art thou pleased with prayerless sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा यत्ते त्रेतिनी भूद्यज्ञस्य धूर्षु सद्मन् ।
सजूर्नावं स्वयशसं सचायोः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva yatte tretini bhudyajnasya dhurshu sadman |
sajurnavam svayashasam sachayoh ||
verses.en:
When threefold flame burns high for thee, to rest on poles of sacrifice,
Thou with the living joyest in the self-bright Ship.

verses.sa:
श्रिये ते पृश्निरुपसेचनी भूच्छ्रिये दर्विररेपाः ।
यया स्वे पात्रे सिञ्चस उत् ॥
verses.rom:
shriye te prishnirupasechani bhuchchhriye darvirarepah |
yaya sve patre sinchasa ut ||
verses.en:
Thy glory was the speckled cup, thy glory was the flawless scoop.
Wherewith thou pourest into thy receptacle.

verses.sa:
शतं वा यदसुर्य प्रति त्वा सुमित्र इत्थास्तौद्दुर्मित्र इत्थास्तौत् ।
आवो यद्दस्युहत्ये कुत्सपुत्रं प्रावो यद्दस्युहत्ये कुत्सवत्सम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam va yadasurya prati tva sumitra itthastauddurmitra itthastaut |
avo yaddasyuhatye kutsaputram pravo yaddasyuhatye kutsavatsam ||
verses.en:
As hundreds, O Immortal God, have sung to thee, so hath Sumitra, yea, Durmitra praised thee here,
What time thou holpest Kutsa's son, when Dasyus fell, yea, holpest Kutsa's darling when the Dasyus died.

verses.sa:
उभा उ नूनं तदिदर्थयेथे वि तन्वाथे धियो वस्त्रापसेव ।
सध्रीचीना यातवे प्रेमजीगः सुदिनेव पृक्ष आ तंसयेथे ॥
verses.rom:
ubha u nunam tadidarthayethe vi tanvathe dhiyo vastrapaseva |
sadhrichina yatave premajigah sudineva priksha a tamsayethe ||
verses.en:
THIS very thing ye Twain hold as your object: ye weave your songs as skillful men weave garments.
That ye may come united have I waked you: ye spread out food like days of lovely weather.

verses.sa:
उष्टारेव फर्वरेषु श्रयेथे प्रायोगेव श्वात्र्या शासुरेथः ।
दूतेव हि ष्ठो यशसा जनेषु माप स्थातं महिषेवावपानात् ॥
verses.rom:
ushtareva pharvareshu shrayethe prayogeva shvatrya shasurethah |
duteva hi shtho yashasa janeshu mapa sthatam mahishevavapanat ||
verses.en:
Like two plough-bulls ye move along in traces, and seek like eager guests your bidder's banquet.
Ye are like glorious envoys mid the people: like bulls, approach the place where ye are watered.

verses.sa:
साकंयुजा शकुनस्येव पक्षा पश्वेव चित्रा यजुरा गमिष्टम् ।
अग्निरिव देवयोर्दीदिवांसा परिज्मानेव यजथः पुरुत्रा ॥
verses.rom:
sakamyuja shakunasyeva paksha pashveva chitra yajura gamishtam |
agniriva devayordidivamsa parijmaneva yajathah purutra ||
verses.en:
Like the two pinions of a bird, connected, like two choice animals, ye have sought our worship.
Bright as the fire the votary hath kindled, ye sacrifice in many a spot as roamers.

verses.sa:
आपी वो अस्मे पितरेव पुत्रोग्रेव रुचा नृपतीव तुर्यै ।
इर्येव पुष्ट्यै किरणेव भुज्यै श्रुष्टीवानेव हवमा गमिष्टम् ॥
verses.rom:
api vo asme pitareva putrogreva rucha nripativa turyai |
iryeva pushtyai kiraneva bhujyai shrushtivaneva havama gamishtam ||
verses.en:
Ye are our kinsmen, like two sons, two fathers, strong in your splendour and like kings for conquest;
Like rays for our enjoyment, Lords to feed us, ye, like quick bearers, have obeyed our calling.

verses.sa:
वंसगेव पूषर्या शिम्बाता मित्रेव ऋता शतरा शातपन्ता ।
वाजेवोच्चा वयसा घर्म्येष्ठा मेषेवेषा सपर्या पुरीषा ॥
verses.rom:
vamsageva pusharya shimbata mitreva rita shatara shatapanta |
vajevochcha vayasa gharmyeshtha meshevesha saparya purisha ||
verses.en:
You are like two pleasantly moving well-fed (hills) like Mitra and Varuna,
the two bestowers of felicity, veracious, possessors of infinite wealth, happy,
like two horses plump with fodder, abiding in the firmament,
like two rams (are you) to be nourished with sacrificial food, to be cherished (with oblations).

verses.sa:
सृण्येव जर्भरी तुर्फरीतू नैतोशेव तुर्फरी पर्फरीका ।
उदन्यजेव जेमना मदेरू ता मे जराय्वजरं मरायु ॥
verses.rom:
srinyeva jarbhari turpharitu naitosheva turphari parpharika |
udanyajeva jemana maderu ta me jarayvajaram marayu ||
verses.en:
You are like two mad elephants bending their forequarters and smiting the foe,
like the two sons of Nitosa destroying (foes),
and cherishing (friends); you are bright as two water-born (jewels),
do you, who are victorious, (render) my decaying mortal body free from decay.

verses.sa:
पज्रेव चर्चरं जारं मरायु क्षद्मेवार्थेषु तर्तरीथ उग्रा ।
ऋभू नापत्खरमज्रा खरज्रुर्वायुर्न पर्फरत्क्षयद्रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pajreva charcharam jaram marayu kshadmevartheshu tartaritha ugra |
ribhu napatkharamajra kharajrurvayurna parpharatkshayadrayinam ||
verses.en:
Fierce (Asvins), like two powerful (heroes), you enable this moving,
perishable mortal (frame) to cross over to the objects (of its destination) as over water;
extremely strong, like the Rbhus, your chariot, attained its destination swift as the wind,
it pervaded (everywhere), it dispensed riches.

verses.sa:
घर्मेव मधु जठरे सनेरू भगेविता तुर्फरी फारिवारम् ।
पतरेव चचरा चन्द्रनिर्णिङ्मनऋङ्गा मनन्या न जग्मी ॥
verses.rom:
gharmeva madhu jathare saneru bhagevita turphari pharivaram |
patareva chachara chandranirninmanaringa mananya na jagmi ||
verses.en:
With your bellies full of the Soma, like two saucepans, preservers of wealth, destroyers of enemies.
(you are) armed with hatchets, moving like two flying (birds)
with forms like the moon, attaining success through the mind, like two laudable beings,
(you are) approaching (the sacrifice).

verses.sa:
बृहन्तेव गम्भरेषु प्रतिष्ठां पादेव गाधं तरते विदाथः ।
कर्णेव शासुरनु हि स्मराथोऽंशेव नो भजतं चित्रमप्नः ॥
verses.rom:
brihanteva gambhareshu pratishtham padeva gadham tarate vidathah |
karneva shasuranu hi smaratho'msheva no bhajatam chitramapnah ||
verses.en:
Like giants, ye will find firm ground to stand on in depths, like feet for one who fords a shallow.
Like cars ye will attend to him who orders: ye Two enjoy our wondrous work as sharers.

verses.sa:
आरङ्गरेव मध्वेरयेथे सारघेव गवि नीचीनबारे ।
कीनारेव स्वेदमासिष्विदाना क्षामेवोर्जा सूयवसात्सचेथे ॥
verses.rom:
arangareva madhverayethe saragheva gavi nichinabare |
kinareva svedamasishvidana kshamevorja suyavasatsachethe ||
verses.en: Like toiling bees ye bring to us your honey, as bees into the hide that opens downward.

verses.sa:
ऋध्याम स्तोमं सनुयाम वाजमा नो मन्त्रं सरथेहोप यातम् ।
यशो न पक्वं मधु गोष्वन्तरा भूतांशो अश्विनोः काममप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
ridhyama stomam sanuyama vajama no mantram sarathehopa yatam |
yasho na pakvam madhu goshvantara bhutamsho ashvinoh kamamaprah ||
verses.en:
May we increase the laud and gain us vigour: come to our song, ye whom one chariot carries.
Filled be our kine with ripened meath like glory: Bhutamsa hath fulfilled the Asvins' longing.

verses.sa:
आविरभून्महि माघोनमेषां विश्वं जीवं तमसो निरमोचि ।
महि ज्योतिः पितृभिर्दत्तमागादुरुः पन्था दक्षिणाया अदर्शि ॥
verses.rom:
avirabhunmahi maghonamesham vishvam jivam tamaso niramochi |
mahi jyotih pitribhirdattamagaduruh pantha dakshinaya adarshi ||
verses.en:
THESE men's great bounty hath been manifested, and the whole world of life set free from darkness.
Great light hath come, vouchsafed us by the Fathers: apparent is the spacious path of Guerdon.

verses.sa:
उच्चा दिवि दक्षिणावन्तो अस्थुर्ये अश्वदाः सह ते सूर्येण ।
हिरण्यदा अमृतत्वं भजन्ते वासोदाः सोम प्र तिरन्त आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
uchcha divi dakshinavanto asthurye ashvadah saha te suryena |
hiranyada amritatvam bhajante vasodah soma pra tiranta ayuh ||
verses.en:
High up in heaven abide the Guerdon-givers: they who give steeds dwell with the Sun for ever.
They who give gold are blest with life eternal. they who give robes prolong their lives, O Soma.

verses.sa:
दैवी पूर्तिर्दक्षिणा देवयज्या न कवारिभ्यो नहि ते पृणन्ति ।
अथा नरः प्रयतदक्षिणासोऽवद्यभिया बहवः पृणन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
daivi purtirdakshina devayajya na kavaribhyo nahi te prinanti |
atha narah prayatadakshinaso'vadyabhiya bahavah prinanti ||
verses.en:
Not from the niggards-for they give not freely-comes Meed at sacrifice, Gods' satisfaction:
Yea, many men with hands stretched out with Guerdon present their gifts because they dread dishonour.

verses.sa:
शतधारं वायुमर्कं स्वर्विदं नृचक्षसस्ते अभि चक्षते हविः ।
ये पृणन्ति प्र च यच्छन्ति संगमे ते दक्षिणां दुहते सप्तमातरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatadharam vayumarkam svarvidam nrichakshasaste abhi chakshate havih |
ye prinanti pra cha yachchhanti samgame te dakshinam duhate saptamataram ||
verses.en:
These who observe mankind regard oblation as streamy Vayu and light-finding Arka.
They satisfy and give their gifts in synod, and pour in streams the seven-mothered Guerdon.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणावान्प्रथमो हूत एति दक्षिणावान्ग्रामणीरग्रमेति ।
तमेव मन्ये नृपतिं जनानां यः प्रथमो दक्षिणामाविवाय ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinavanprathamo huta eti dakshinavangramaniragrameti |
tameva manye nripatim jananam yah prathamo dakshinamavivaya ||
verses.en:
He who brings Guerdon comes as first invited: chief of the hamlet comes the Guerdon-bearer.
Him I account the ruler of the people who was the first to introduce the Guerdon.

verses.sa:
तमेव ऋषिं तमु ब्रह्माणमाहुर्यज्ञन्यं सामगामुक्थशासम् ।
स शुक्रस्य तन्वो वेद तिस्रो यः प्रथमो दक्षिणया रराध ॥
verses.rom:
tameva rishim tamu brahmanamahuryajnanyam samagamukthashasam |
sa shukrasya tanvo veda tisro yah prathamo dakshinaya raradha ||
verses.en:
They call him Rsi, Brahman, Sama-chanter, reciter of the laud, leader of worship.
The brightly-shining God's three forms he knoweth who first bestowed the sacrificial Guerdon.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणाश्वं दक्षिणा गां ददाति दक्षिणा चन्द्रमुत यद्धिरण्यम् ।
दक्षिणान्नं वनुते यो न आत्मा दक्षिणां वर्म कृणुते विजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinashvam dakshina gam dadati dakshina chandramuta yaddhiranyam |
dakshinannam vanute yo na atma dakshinam varma krinute vijanan ||
verses.en:
Guerdon bestows the horse, bestows the bullock, Guerdon bestows, moreover, gold that Rsisters.
Guerdon gives food which is our life and spirit. He who is wise takes Guerdon for his armour.

verses.sa:
न भोजा मम्रुर्न न्यर्थमीयुर्न रिष्यन्ति न व्यथन्ते ह भोजाः ।
इदं यद्विश्वं भुवनं स्वश्चैतत्सर्वं दक्षिणैभ्यो ददाति ॥
verses.rom:
na bhoja mamrurna nyarthamiyurna rishyanti na vyathante ha bhojah |
idam yadvishvam bhuvanam svashchaitatsarvam dakshinaibhyo dadati ||
verses.en:
The liberal die not, never are they ruined: the liberal suffer neither harm nor trouble.
The light of heaven, the universe about us,-all this doth sacrificial Guerdon give them.

verses.sa:
भोजा जिग्युः सुरभिं योनिमग्रे भोजा जिग्युर्वध्वं या सुवासाः ।
भोजा जिग्युरन्तःपेयं सुराया भोजा जिग्युर्ये अहूताः प्रयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
bhoja jigyuh surabhim yonimagre bhoja jigyurvadhvam ya suvasah |
bhoja jigyurantahpeyam suraya bhoja jigyurye ahutah prayanti ||
verses.en:
First have the liberal gained a fragrant dwelling, and got themselves a bride in fair apparel.
The liberal have obtained their draught of liquor, and conquered those who, unprovoked, assailed them.

verses.sa:
भोजायाश्वं सं मृजन्त्याशुं भोजायास्ते कन्या शुम्भमाना ।
भोजस्येदं पुष्करिणीव वेश्म परिष्कृतं देवमानेव चित्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhojayashvam sam mrijantyashum bhojayaste kanya shumbhamana |
bhojasyedam pushkariniva veshma parishkritam devamaneva chitram ||
verses.en:
They deck the fleet steed for the bounteous giver: the maid adorns herself and waits to meet him.
His home is like a lake with lotus blossoms, like the Gods' palaces adorned and splendid.

verses.sa:
भोजमश्वाः सुष्ठुवाहो वहन्ति सुवृद्रथो वर्तते दक्षिणायाः ।
भोजं देवासोऽवता भरेषु भोजः शत्रून्समनीकेषु जेता ॥
verses.rom:
bhojamashvah sushthuvaho vahanti suvridratho vartate dakshinayah |
bhojam devaso'vata bhareshu bhojah shatrunsamanikeshu jeta ||
verses.en:
Steeds good at draught convey the liberal giver, and lightly rolling moves the car of Guerdon.
Assist, ye Gods, the liberal man in battles: the liberal giver conquers foes in combat.

verses.sa:
किमिच्छन्ती सरमा प्रेदमानड्दूरे ह्यध्वा जगुरिः पराचैः ।
कास्मेहितिः का परितक्म्यासीत्कथं रसाया अतरः पयांसि ॥
verses.rom:
kimichchhanti sarama predamanaddure hyadhva jagurih parachaih |
kasmehitih ka paritakmyasitkatham rasaya atarah payamsi ||
verses.en:
WHAT wish of Sarama hath brought her hither? The path leads far away to distant places.
What charge hast thou for us? Where turns thy journey? How hast thou made thy way o'er Rasa's waters.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य दूतीरिषिता चरामि मह इच्छन्ती पणयो निधीन्वः ।
अतिष्कदो भियसा तन्न आवत्तथा रसाया अतरं पयांसि ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya dutirishita charami maha ichchhanti panayo nidhinvah |
atishkado bhiyasa tanna avattatha rasaya ataram payamsi ||
verses.en:
I come appointed messenger of Indra, seeking your ample stores of wealth, O Panis.
This hath preserved me from the fear of crossing: thus have I made my way o'er Rasa's waters.

verses.sa:
कीदृङ्ङिन्द्रः सरमे का दृशीका यस्येदं दूतीरसरः पराकात् ।
आ च गच्छान्मित्रमेना दधामाथा गवां गोपतिर्नो भवाति ॥
verses.rom:
kidrinnindrah sarame ka drishika yasyedam dutirasarah parakat |
a cha gachchhanmitramena dadhamatha gavam gopatirno bhavati ||
verses.en:
What is that Indra like, what is his aspect whose envoy, Sarama, from afar thou comest?
Let him approach, and we will show him friendship: he shall be made the herdsman of our cattle.

verses.sa:
नाहं तं वेद दभ्यं दभत्स यस्येदं दूतीरसरं पराकात् ।
न तं गूहन्ति स्रवतो गभीरा हता इन्द्रेण पणयः शयध्वे ॥
verses.rom:
naham tam veda dabhyam dabhatsa yasyedam dutirasaram parakat |
na tam guhanti sravato gabhira hata indrena panayah shayadhve ||
verses.en:
I know him safe from harm: but he can punish who sent me hither from afar as envoy.
Him rivers flowing with deep waters bide not. Low will ye be, O Panis, slain by Indra.

verses.sa:
इमा गावः सरमे या ऐच्छः परि दिवो अन्तान्सुभगे पतन्ती ।
कस्त एना अव सृजादयुध्व्युतास्माकमायुधा सन्ति तिग्मा ॥
verses.rom:
ima gavah sarame ya aichchhah pari divo antansubhage patanti |
kasta ena ava srijadayudhvyutasmakamayudha santi tigma ||
verses.en:
These are the kine which, Sarama, thou seekest, flying, O Blest One, to the ends of heaven.
Who will loose these for thee without a battle? Yea, and sharp-pointed are our warlike weapons.

verses.sa:
असेन्या वः पणयो वचांस्यनिषव्यास्तन्वः सन्तु पापीः ।
अधृष्टो व एतवा अस्तु पन्था बृहस्पतिर्व उभया न मृळात् ॥
verses.rom:
asenya vah panayo vachamsyanishavyastanvah santu papih |
adhrishto va etava astu pantha brihaspatirva ubhaya na mrilat ||
verses.en:
Even if your wicked bodies, O ye Panis, were arrow-proof, your words are weak for wounding;
And were the path to you as yet unmastered, Brhaspati in neither case will spare you.

verses.sa:
अयं निधिः सरमे अद्रिबुध्नो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्न्यृष्टः ।
रक्षन्ति तं पणयो ये सुगोपा रेकु पदमलकमा जगन्थ ॥
verses.rom:
ayam nidhih sarame adribudhno gobhirashvebhirvasubhirnyrishtah |
rakshanti tam panayo ye sugopa reku padamalakama jagantha ||
verses.en:
Paved with the rock is this our treasure-chamber; filled full of precious things, of kine, and horses.
These Panis who are watchful keepers guard it. In vain hast thou approached this lonely station.

verses.sa:
एह गमन्नृषयः सोमशिता अयास्यो अङ्गिरसो नवग्वाः ।
त एतमूर्वं वि भजन्त गोनामथैतद्वचः पणयो वमन्नित् ॥
verses.rom:
eha gamannrishayah somashita ayasyo angiraso navagvah |
ta etamurvam vi bhajanta gonamathaitadvachah panayo vamannit ||
verses.en:
Rsis will come inspirited with Soma, Angirases unwearied, and Navagvas.
This stall of cattle will they part among them: then will the Panis wish these words unspoken.

verses.sa:
एवा च त्वं सरम आजगन्थ प्रबाधिता सहसा दैव्येन ।
स्वसारं त्वा कृणवै मा पुनर्गा अप ते गवां सुभगे भजाम ॥
verses.rom:
eva cha tvam sarama ajagantha prabadhita sahasa daivyena |
svasaram tva krinavai ma punarga apa te gavam subhage bhajama ||
verses.en:
Even thus, O Sarama, hast thou come hither, forced by celestial might to make the journey.
Turn thee not back, for thou shalt be our sister: O Blest One, we will give thee of the cattle.

verses.sa:
नाहं वेद भ्रातृत्वं नो स्वसृत्वमिन्द्रो विदुरङ्गिरसश्च घोराः ।
गोकामा मे अच्छदयन्यदायमपात इत पणयो वरीयः ॥
verses.rom:
naham veda bhratritvam no svasritvamindro vidurangirasashcha ghorah |
gokama me achchhadayanyadayamapata ita panayo variyah ||
verses.en:
Brotherhood, sisterhood, I know not either: the dread Angirases and Indra know them.
They seemed to long for kine when I departed. Hence, into distance, be ye gone, O Panis.

verses.sa:
दूरमित पणयो वरीय उद्गावो यन्तु मिनतीरृतेन ।
बृहस्पतिर्या अविन्दन्निगूळ्हाः सोमो ग्रावाण ऋषयश्च विप्राः ॥
verses.rom:
duramita panayo variya udgavo yantu minatirritena |
brihaspatirya avindannigulhah somo gravana rishayashcha viprah ||
verses.en:
Hence, far away, ye Panis! Let the cattle lowing come forth as holy Law commandeth,
Kine which Brhaspati, and Soma, Rsis, sages, and pressing-stones have found when hidden.

verses.sa:
तेऽवदन्प्रथमा ब्रह्मकिल्बिषेऽकूपारः सलिलो मातरिश्वा ।
वीळुहरास्तप उग्रो मयोभूरापो देवीः प्रथमजा ऋतेन ॥
verses.rom:
te'vadanprathama brahmakilbishe'kuparah salilo matarishva |
viluharastapa ugro mayobhurapo devih prathamaja ritena ||
verses.en:
THESE first, the boundless Sea, and Matarisvan, fierce-glowing Fire, the Strong, the Bliss-bestower,
And heavenly Floods, first-born by holy Order, exclaimed against the outrage on a Brahman.

verses.sa:
सोमो राजा प्रथमो ब्रह्मजायां पुनः प्रायच्छदहृणीयमानः ।
अन्वर्तिता वरुणो मित्र आसीदग्निर्होता हस्तगृह्या निनाय ॥
verses.rom:
somo raja prathamo brahmajayam punah prayachchhadahriniyamanah |
anvartita varuno mitra asidagnirhota hastagrihya ninaya ||
verses.en:
King Soma first of all, without reluctance, made restitution of the Brahman's consort.
Mitra and Varuna were the inviters: Agni as Hota; took her hand and led her.

verses.sa:
हस्तेनैव ग्राह्य आधिरस्या ब्रह्मजायेयमिति चेदवोचन् ।
न दूताय प्रह्ये तस्थ एषा तथा राष्ट्रं गुपितं क्षत्रियस्य ॥
verses.rom:
hastenaiva grahya adhirasya brahmajayeyamiti chedavochan |
na dutaya prahye tastha esha tatha rashtram gupitam kshatriyasya ||
verses.en:
The man, her pledge, must by her hand be taken when they have cried, She is a Brahman's consort.
She stayed not for a herald to conduct her: thus is the kingdom of a ruler guarded.

verses.sa:
देवा एतस्यामवदन्त पूर्वे सप्तऋषयस्तपसे ये निषेदुः ।
भीमा जाया ब्राह्मणस्योपनीता दुर्धां दधाति परमे व्योमन् ॥
verses.rom:
deva etasyamavadanta purve saptarishayastapase ye nisheduh |
bhima jaya brahmanasyopanita durdham dadhati parame vyoman ||
verses.en:
Thus spake of her those Gods of old, Seven Rsis who sate them down to their austere devotion:
Dire is a Brahman's wife led home by others: in the supremest heaven she plants confusion.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी चरति वेविषद्विषः स देवानां भवत्येकमङ्गम् ।
तेन जायामन्वविन्दद्बृहस्पतिः सोमेन नीतां जुह्वं न देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmachari charati vevishadvishah sa devanam bhavatyekamangam |
tena jayamanvavindadbrihaspatih somena nitam juhvam na devah ||
verses.en:
The Brahmacari goes engaged in duty: he is a member of the Gods' own body.
Through him Brhaspati obtained his consort, as the Gods gained the ladle brought by Soma.

verses.sa:
पुनर्वै देवा अददुः पुनर्मनुष्या उत ।
राजानः सत्यं कृण्वाना ब्रह्मजायां पुनर्ददुः ॥
verses.rom:
punarvai deva adaduh punarmanushya uta |
rajanah satyam krinvana brahmajayam punardaduh ||
verses.en:
So then the Gods restored her, so men gave the woman back again.
The Kings who kept their promises restored the Brahman's wedded wife,

verses.sa:
पुनर्दाय ब्रह्मजायां कृत्वी देवैर्निकिल्बिषम् ।
ऊर्जं पृथिव्या भक्त्वायोरुगायमुपासते ॥
verses.rom:
punardaya brahmajayam kritvi devairnikilbisham |
urjam prithivya bhaktvayorugayamupasate ||
verses.en:
Having restored the Brahman's wife, and freed them, with Gods' aid, from sin,
They shared the fulness of the earth, and won themselves extended sway.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान्यजसि जातवेदः ।
आ च वह मित्रमहश्चिकित्वान्त्वं दूतः कविरसि प्रचेताः ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho adya manusho durone devo devanyajasi jatavedah |
a cha vaha mitramahashchikitvantvam dutah kavirasi prachetah ||
verses.en:
THOU in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods as God, O Jatavedas.
Observant, bright as Mitra, bring them hither: thou art a sapient and foreknowing envoy.

verses.sa:
तनूनपात्पथ ऋतस्य यानान्मध्वा समञ्जन्स्वदया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमृन्धन्देवत्रा च कृणुह्यध्वरं नः ॥
verses.rom:
tanunapatpatha ritasya yananmadhva samanjansvadaya sujihva |
manmani dhibhiruta yajnamrindhandevatra cha krinuhyadhvaram nah ||
verses.en:
Tanunapat, fair-tongued, with sweet meath balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant.
Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.

verses.sa:
आजुह्वान ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चा याह्यग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ।
त्वं देवानामसि यह्व होता स एनान्यक्षीषितो यजीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
ajuhvana idyo vandyashcha yahyagne vasubhih sajoshah |
tvam devanamasi yahva hota sa enanyakshishito yajiyan ||
verses.en:
Invoked, deserving prayer and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus.
Thou art, O Youthful Lord, the Gods' Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.

verses.sa:
प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोरस्या वृज्यते अग्रे अह्नाम् ।
व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम् ॥
verses.rom:
prachinam barhih pradisha prithivya vastorasya vrijyate agre ahnam |
vyu prathate vitaram variyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||
verses.en:
By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe this earth when dawns are breaking.
Widely it spreads around and far-extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.

verses.sa:
व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया वि श्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः ।
देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः ॥
verses.rom:
vyachasvatirurviya vi shrayantam patibhyo na janayah shumbhamanah |
devirdvaro brihatirvishvaminva devebhyo bhavata suprayanah ||
verses.en:
Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands.
Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy entrance.

verses.sa:
आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने ॥
verses.rom:
a sushvayanti yajate upake ushasanakta sadatam ni yonau |
divye yoshane brihati surukme adhi shriyam shukrapisham dadhane ||
verses.en:
Pouring sweet dews let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, he seated at their station,
Lofty, celestial Dames with gold to deck them. assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै ।
प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
daivya hotara prathama suvacha mimana yajnam manusho yajadhyai |
prachodayanta vidatheshu karu prachinam jyotih pradisha dishanta ||
verses.en:
Come the two first celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship
As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction.

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेत्विळा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती ।
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनं सरस्वती स्वपसः सदन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
a no yajnam bharati tuyametvila manushvadiha chetayanti |
tisro devirbarhiredam syonam sarasvati svapasah sadantu ||
verses.en:
Let Bharati come quickly to our worship, and Ila showing like a human being.
So let Sarasvati and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.

verses.sa:
य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री रूपैरपिंशद्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान्देवं त्वष्टारमिह यक्षि विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ime dyavaprithivi janitri rupairapimshadbhuvanani vishva |
tamadya hotarishito yajiyandevam tvashtaramiha yakshi vidvan ||
verses.en:
Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed to-day God Tvastar, thou who knowest.
Even him who formed these two, the Earth and Heaven the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.

verses.sa:
उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन्देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि ।
वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन ॥
verses.rom:
upavasrija tmanya samanjandevanam patha ritutha havimshi |
vanaspatih shamita devo agnih svadantu havyam madhuna ghritena ||
verses.en:
Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season.
Agni, Vanaspati the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with meath and butter.

verses.sa:
सद्यो जातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञमग्निर्देवानामभवत्पुरोगाः ।
अस्य होतुः प्रदिश्यृतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
sadyo jato vyamimita yajnamagnirdevanamabhavatpurogah |
asya hotuh pradishyritasya vachi svahakritam haviradantu devah ||
verses.en:
Agni, as soon as he was born, made ready the sacrifice, and was the Gods' preceder.
May the Gods cat our offering consecrated according to this true Priest's voice and guidance.

verses.sa:
मनीषिणः प्र भरध्वं मनीषां यथायथा मतयः सन्ति नृणाम् ।
इन्द्रं सत्यैरेरयामा कृतेभिः स हि वीरो गिर्वणस्युर्विदानः ॥
verses.rom:
manishinah pra bharadhvam manisham yathayatha matayah santi nrinam |
indram satyairerayama kritebhih sa hi viro girvanasyurvidanah ||
verses.en:
BRING forth your sacred song ye prudent singers, even as are the thoughts of human beings.
Let us draw Indra with true deeds anear us: he loves our songs, the Hero, and is potent.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि सदसो धीतिरद्यौत्सं गार्ष्टेयो वृषभो गोभिरानट् ।
उदतिष्ठत्तविषेणा रवेण महान्ति चित्सं विव्याचा रजांसि ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya hi sadaso dhitiradyautsam garshteyo vrishabho gobhiranat |
udatishthattavishena ravena mahanti chitsam vivyacha rajamsi ||
verses.en:
The hymn shone brightly from the seat of worship: to the kine came the Bull, the Heifer's Offspring
With mighty bellowing hath he arisen, and hath pervaded even the spacious regions.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः किल श्रुत्या अस्य वेद स हि जिष्णुः पथिकृत्सूर्याय ।
आन्मेनां कृण्वन्नच्युतो भुवद्गोः पतिर्दिवः सनजा अप्रतीतः ॥
verses.rom:
indrah kila shrutya asya veda sa hi jishnuh pathikritsuryaya |
anmenam krinvannachyuto bhuvadgoh patirdivah sanaja apratitah ||
verses.en:
