Indra knows, verily, how to hear our singing, for he, victorious, made a path for Surya.
He made the Cow, and be became the Sovran of Heaven, primeval, matchless, and unshaken.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य व्रतामिनादङ्गिरोभिर्गृणानः ।
पुरूणि चिन्नि तताना रजांसि दाधार यो धरुणं सत्यताता ॥
verses.rom:
indro mahna mahato arnavasya vrataminadangirobhirgrinanah |
puruni chinni tatana rajamsi dadhara yo dharunam satyatata ||
verses.en:
Praised by Angirases, Indra demolished with might the works of the great watery monster
Full many regions, too, hath he pervaded, and by his truth supported earth's foundation.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दिवः प्रतिमानं पृथिव्या विश्वा वेद सवना हन्ति शुष्णम् ।
महीं चिद्द्यामातनोत्सूर्येण चास्कम्भ चित्कम्भनेन स्कभीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
indro divah pratimanam prithivya vishva veda savana hanti shushnam |
mahim chiddyamatanotsuryena chaskambha chitkambhanena skabhiyan ||
verses.en:
The counterpart of heaven and earth is Indra: he knoweth all libations, slayeth Susna.
The vast sky with the Sun hath he extended, and, best otpillars, stayed it with a pillar.

verses.sa:
वज्रेण हि वृत्रहा वृत्रमस्तरदेवस्य शूशुवानस्य मायाः ।
वि धृष्णो अत्र धृषता जघन्थाथाभवो मघवन्बाह्वोजाः ॥
verses.rom:
vajrena hi vritraha vritramastaradevasya shushuvanasya mayah |
vi dhrishno atra dhrishata jaghanthathabhavo maghavanbahvojah ||
verses.en:
The Vrtra-slaver with his bolt felled Vrtra: the magic of the godless, waxen mighty,
Here hast thou, Bold Assailant, boldly conquered. Yea, then thine arms, O Maghavan, were potent.

verses.sa:
सचन्त यदुषसः सूर्येण चित्रामस्य केतवो रामविन्दन् ।
आ यन्नक्षत्रं ददृशे दिवो न पुनर्यतो नकिरद्धा नु वेद ॥
verses.rom:
sachanta yadushasah suryena chitramasya ketavo ramavindan |
a yannakshatram dadrishe divo na punaryato nakiraddha nu veda ||
verses.en:
When the Dawns come attendant upon Surya their rays discover wealth of divers colours.
The Star of heaven is seen as 'twere approaching: none knoweth aught of it as it departeth.

verses.sa:
दूरं किल प्रथमा जग्मुरासामिन्द्रस्य याः प्रसवे सस्रुरापः ।
क्व स्विदग्रं क्व बुध्न आसामापो मध्यं क्व वो नूनमन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
duram kila prathama jagmurasamindrasya yah prasave sasrurapah |
kva svidagram kva budhna asamapo madhyam kva vo nunamantah ||
verses.en:
Far have they gone, the first of all these waters, the waters that flowed forth when Indra sent them.
Where is their spring, and where is their foundation? Where now, ye Waters, is your inmost centre?

verses.sa:
सृजः सिन्धूँरहिना जग्रसानाँ आदिदेताः प्र विविज्रे जवेन ।
मुमुक्षमाणा उत या मुमुच्रेऽधेदेता न रमन्ते नितिक्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
srijah sindhunrahina jagrasanan adidetah pra vivijre javena |
mumukshamana uta ya mumuchre'dhedeta na ramante nitiktah ||
verses.en:
Thou didst free rivers swallowed by the Dragon; and rapidly they set themselves in motion,
Those that were loosed and those that longed for freedom. Excited now to speed they run unresting.

verses.sa:
सध्रीचीः सिन्धुमुशतीरिवायन्सनाज्जार आरितः पूर्भिदासाम् ।
अस्तमा ते पार्थिवा वसून्यस्मे जग्मुः सूनृता इन्द्र पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
sadhrichih sindhumushatirivayansanajjara aritah purbhidasam |
astama te parthiva vasunyasme jagmuh sunrita indra purvih ||
verses.en:
Yearning together they have sped to Sindhu: the Fort-destroyer, praised, of old, hath loved them.
Indra, may thy terrestrial treasures reach us, and our full songs of joy approach thy dwelling.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र पिब प्रतिकामं सुतस्य प्रातःसावस्तव हि पूर्वपीतिः ।
हर्षस्व हन्तवे शूर शत्रूनुक्थेभिष्टे वीर्या प्र ब्रवाम ॥
verses.rom:
indra piba pratikamam sutasya pratahsavastava hi purvapitih |
harshasva hantave shura shatrunukthebhishte virya pra bravama ||
verses.en:
DRINK of the juice, O Indra, at thy plea. sure, for thy first draught is early morn's libation.
Rejoice, that thou mayst slay our foes, O Hero, and we with lauds will tell thy mighty exploits.

verses.sa:
यस्ते रथो मनसो जवीयानेन्द्र तेन सोमपेयाय याहि ।
तूयमा ते हरयः प्र द्रवन्तु येभिर्यासि वृषभिर्मन्दमानः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste ratho manaso javiyanendra tena somapeyaya yahi |
tuyama te harayah pra dravantu yebhiryasi vrishabhirmandamanah ||
verses.en:
Thou hast a car more swift than thought, O Indra; thereon come hither, come to drink the Soma.
Let thy Bay Steeds, thy Stallions, hasten hither, with whom thou comest nigh and art delighted.

verses.sa:
हरित्वता वर्चसा सूर्यस्य श्रेष्ठै रूपैस्तन्वं स्पर्शयस्व ।
अस्माभिरिन्द्र सखिभिर्हुवानः सध्रीचीनो मादयस्वा निषद्य ॥
verses.rom:
haritvata varchasa suryasya shreshthai rupaistanvam sparshayasva |
asmabhirindra sakhibhirhuvanah sadhrichino madayasva nishadya ||
verses.en:
Deck out thy body with the fairest colours, with golden splendour of the Sun adorn it.
O Indra, turn thee hitherward invited by us thy friends; be seated and be joyful.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्यत्ते महिमानं मदेष्विमे मही रोदसी नाविविक्ताम् ।
तदोक आ हरिभिरिन्द्र युक्तैः प्रियेभिर्याहि प्रियमन्नमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tyatte mahimanam madeshvime mahi rodasi naviviktam |
tadoka a haribhirindra yuktaih priyebhiryahi priyamannamachchha ||
verses.en:
O thou whose grandeur in thy festive transports not even these two great worlds have comprehended.
Come, Indra, with thy dear Bay Horses harnessed, come to our dwelling and the food thou lovest.

verses.sa:
यस्य शश्वत्पपिवाँ इन्द्र शत्रूननानुकृत्या रण्या चकर्थ ।
स ते पुरंधिं तविषीमियर्ति स ते मदाय सुत इन्द्र सोमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya shashvatpapivan indra shatrunananukritya ranya chakartha |
sa te puramdhim tavishimiyarti sa te madaya suta indra somah ||
verses.en:
Pressed for thy joyous banquet is the Soma, Soma whereof thou, Indra, ever drinking,
Hast waged unequalled battles with thy foemen, which prompts the mighty flow of thine abundance.

verses.sa:
इदं ते पात्रं सनवित्तमिन्द्र पिबा सोममेना शतक्रतो ।
पूर्ण आहावो मदिरस्य मध्वो यं विश्व इदभिहर्यन्ति देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
idam te patram sanavittamindra piba somamena shatakrato |
purna ahavo madirasya madhvo yam vishva idabhiharyanti devah ||
verses.en:
Found from of old is this thy cup, O Indra: Satakratu, drink therefrom the Soma.
Filled is the beaker with the meath that gladdens, the beaker which all Deities delight in.

verses.sa:
वि हि त्वामिन्द्र पुरुधा जनासो हितप्रयसो वृषभ ह्वयन्ते ।
अस्माकं ते मधुमत्तमानीमा भुवन्सवना तेषु हर्य ॥
verses.rom:
vi hi tvamindra purudha janaso hitaprayaso vrishabha hvayante |
asmakam te madhumattamanima bhuvansavana teshu harya ||
verses.en:
From many a side with proffered entertainment the folk are calling thee, O Mighty Indra.
These our libations shall for thee be richest in sweet meath: drink thereof and find them pleasant.

verses.sa:
प्र त इन्द्र पूर्व्याणि प्र नूनं वीर्या वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि ।
सतीनमन्युरश्रथायो अद्रिं सुवेदनामकृणोर्ब्रह्मणे गाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra ta indra purvyani pra nunam virya vocham prathama kritani |
satinamanyurashrathayo adrim suvedanamakrinorbrahmane gam ||
verses.en:
I will declare thy deeds of old, O Indra, the mighty acts which thou hast first accomplished.
In genuine wrath thou loosenedst the mountain so that the Brahman easily found the cattle.

verses.sa:
नि षु सीद गणपते गणेषु त्वामाहुर्विप्रतमं कवीनाम् ।
न ऋते त्वत्क्रियते किं चनारे महामर्कं मघवञ्चित्रमर्च ॥
verses.rom:
ni shu sida ganapate ganeshu tvamahurvipratamam kavinam |
na rite tvatkriyate kim chanare mahamarkam maghavanchitramarcha ||
verses.en:
Lord of the hosts, amid our bands be seated: they call thee greatest Sage among the sages.
Nothing is done, even far away, without thee: great, wondrous, Maghavan, is the hymn I sing thee.

verses.sa:
अभिख्या नो मघवन्नाधमानान्सखे बोधि वसुपते सखीनाम् ।
रणं कृधि रणकृत्सत्यशुष्माभक्ते चिदा भजा राये अस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
abhikhya no maghavannadhamanansakhe bodhi vasupate sakhinam |
ranam kridhi ranakritsatyashushmabhakte chida bhaja raye asman ||
verses.en:
Aim of our eyes be thou, for we implore thee, O Maghavan, Friend of friends and Lord of treasures.
Fight, Warrior strong in truth, fight thou the battle: give us our share of undivided riches.

verses.sa:
तमस्य द्यावापृथिवी सचेतसा विश्वेभिर्देवैरनु शुष्ममावताम् ।
यदैत्कृण्वानो महिमानमिन्द्रियं पीत्वी सोमस्य क्रतुमाँ अवर्धत ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya dyavaprithivi sachetasa vishvebhirdevairanu shushmamavatam |
yadaitkrinvano mahimanamindriyam pitvi somasya kratuman avardhata ||
verses.en:
THE Heavens and the Earth accordant with all Gods encouraged graciously that vigorous might of his.
When he came showing forth his majesty and power, he drank of Soma juice and waxed exceeding strong.

verses.sa:
तमस्य विष्णुर्महिमानमोजसांशुं दधन्वान्मधुनो वि रप्शते ।
देवेभिरिन्द्रो मघवा सयावभिर्वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अभवद्वरेण्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya vishnurmahimanamojasamshum dadhanvanmadhuno vi rapshate |
devebhirindro maghava sayavabhirvritram jaghanvan abhavadvarenyah ||
verses.en:
This majesty of his Visnu extols and lauds, making the state that gives the meath flow forth with might.
When Indra Maghavan with those who followed him had smitten Vrtra he deserved the choice of Gods.

verses.sa:
वृत्रेण यदहिना बिभ्रदायुधा समस्थिथा युधये शंसमाविदे ।
विश्वे ते अत्र मरुतः सह त्मनावर्धन्नुग्र महिमानमिन्द्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
vritrena yadahina bibhradayudha samasthitha yudhaye shamsamavide |
vishve te atra marutah saha tmanavardhannugra mahimanamindriyam ||
verses.en:
When, bearing warlike weapons, fain to win thee praise, thou meetest Vrtra, yea, the Dragon, for the fight,
Then all the Maruts who were gathered with dice there extolled, O Mighty One, thy powerful majesty.

verses.sa:
जज्ञान एव व्यबाधत स्पृधः प्रापश्यद्वीरो अभि पौंस्यं रणम् ।
अवृश्चदद्रिमव सस्यदः सृजदस्तभ्नान्नाकं स्वपस्यया पृथुम् ॥
verses.rom:
jajnana eva vyabadhata spridhah prapashyadviro abhi paumsyam ranam |
avrishchadadrimava sasyadah srijadastabhnannakam svapasyaya prithum ||
verses.en:
Soon as he sprang to life he forced asunder hosts: forward the Hero looked to manly deed and war.
He cleft the rock, he let concurrent streams flow forth, and with his skillful art stablished the heavens' wide vault.

verses.sa:
आदिन्द्रः सत्रा तविषीरपत्यत वरीयो द्यावापृथिवी अबाधत ।
अवाभरद्धृषितो वज्रमायसं शेवं मित्राय वरुणाय दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
adindrah satra tavishirapatyata variyo dyavaprithivi abadhata |
avabharaddhrishito vajramayasam shevam mitraya varunaya dashushe ||
verses.en:
Indra hath evermore possessed surpassing power: he forced, far from each other, heaven and earth apart.
He hurled impetuous down his iron thunderbolt, a joy to Varuna's and Mitra's worshipper.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यात्र तविषीभ्यो विरप्शिन ऋघायतो अरंहयन्त मन्यवे ।
वृत्रं यदुग्रो व्यवृश्चदोजसापो बिभ्रतं तमसा परीवृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyatra tavishibhyo virapshina righayato aramhayanta manyave |
vritram yadugro vyavrishchadojasapo bibhratam tamasa parivritam ||
verses.en:
Then to the mighty powers of Indra, to his wrath, his the fierce Stormer, loud of voice, they came with speed;
What time the Potent One rent Vrtra with his strength, who held the waters back, whom darkness compassed round.

verses.sa:
या वीर्याणि प्रथमानि कर्त्वा महित्वेभिर्यतमानौ समीयतुः ।
ध्वान्तं तमोऽव दध्वसे हत इन्द्रो मह्ना पूर्वहूतावपत्यत ॥
verses.rom:
ya viryani prathamani kartva mahitvebhiryatamanau samiyatuh |
dhvantam tamo'va dadhvase hata indro mahna purvahutavapatyata ||
verses.en:
Even in the first of those heroic acts which they who strove together came with might to execute,
Deep darkness fell upon the slain, and Indra won by victory the right of being first invoked.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवासो अध वृष्ण्यानि तेऽवर्धयन्सोमवत्या वचस्यया ।
रद्धं वृत्रमहिमिन्द्रस्य हन्मनाग्निर्न जम्भैस्तृष्वन्नमावयत् ॥
verses.rom:
vishve devaso adha vrishnyani te'vardhayansomavatya vachasyaya |
raddham vritramahimindrasya hanmanagnirna jambhaistrishvannamavayat ||
verses.en:
Then all the Gods extolled, with eloquence inspired by draughts of Soma juice, thy deeds of manly might.
As Agni eats the dry food with his tongue, he ate Vrtra, the Dragon, maimed by Indra's deadly dart.

verses.sa:
भूरि दक्षेभिर्वचनेभिरृक्वभिः सख्येभिः सख्यानि प्र वोचत ।
इन्द्रो धुनिं च चुमुरिं च दम्भयञ्छ्रद्धामनस्या शृणुते दभीतये ॥
verses.rom:
bhuri dakshebhirvachanebhirrikvabhih sakhyebhih sakhyani pra vochata |
indro dhunim cha chumurim cha dambhayanchhraddhamanasya shrinute dabhitaye ||
verses.en:
Proclaim his many friendships, met with friendship, made with singers, with the skillful and the eloquent.
Indra, when he subdues Dhuni and Cumuri, lists to Dabhiti for his faithful spirit's sake.

verses.sa:
त्वं पुरूण्या भरा स्वश्व्या येभिर्मंसै निवचनानि शंसन् ।
सुगेभिर्विश्वा दुरिता तरेम विदो षु ण उर्विया गाधमद्य ॥
verses.rom:
tvam purunya bhara svashvya yebhirmamsai nivachanani shamsan |
sugebhirvishva durita tarema vido shu na urviya gadhamadya ||
verses.en:
Give riches manifold with noble horses, to be remembered while my songs address thee.
May we by easy paths pass all our troubles: find us this day a ford wide and extensive.

verses.sa:
घर्मा समन्ता त्रिवृतं व्यापतुस्तयोर्जुष्टिं मातरिश्वा जगाम ।
दिवस्पयो दिधिषाणा अवेषन्विदुर्देवाः सहसामानमर्कम् ॥
verses.rom:
gharma samanta trivritam vyapatustayorjushtim matarishva jagama |
divaspayo didhishana aveshanvidurdevah sahasamanamarkam ||
verses.en:
Two perfect springs of heat pervade the Threefold, and come for their delight is Matarisvan.
Craving the milk of heaven the Gods are present: well do they know the praisesong and the Saman.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो देष्ट्राय निरृतीरुपासते दीर्घश्रुतो वि हि जानन्ति वह्नयः ।
तासां नि चिक्युः कवयो निदानं परेषु या गुह्येषु व्रतेषु ॥
verses.rom:
tisro deshtraya nirritirupasate dirghashruto vi hi jananti vahnayah |
tasam ni chikyuh kavayo nidanam pareshu ya guhyeshu vrateshu ||
verses.en:
The priests beard far away, as they are ordered, serve the three Nirrtis, for well they know them.
Sages have traced the cause that first produced them, dwelling in distant and mysterious chambers.

verses.sa:
चतुष्कपर्दा युवतिः सुपेशा घृतप्रतीका वयुनानि वस्ते ।
तस्यां सुपर्णा वृषणा नि षेदतुर्यत्र देवा दधिरे भागधेयम् ॥
verses.rom:
chatushkaparda yuvatih supesha ghritapratika vayunani vaste |
tasyam suparna vrishana ni shedaturyatra deva dadhire bhagadheyam ||
verses.en:
The Youthful One, well-shaped, with four locks braided, brightened with oil, puts on the ordinances.
Two Birds of mighty power are seated near her, there where the Deities receive their portion.

verses.sa:
एकः सुपर्णः स समुद्रमा विवेश स इदं विश्वं भुवनं वि चष्टे ।
तं पाकेन मनसापश्यमन्तितस्तं माता रेळ्हि स उ रेळ्हि मातरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ekah suparnah sa samudrama vivesha sa idam vishvam bhuvanam vi chashte |
tam pakena manasapashyamantitastam mata relhi sa u relhi mataram ||
verses.en:
One of these Birds hath passed into the sea of air: thence he looks round and views this universal world.
With simple heart I have beheld him from anear: his Mother kisses him and he returns her kiss.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णं विप्राः कवयो वचोभिरेकं सन्तं बहुधा कल्पयन्ति ।
छन्दांसि च दधतो अध्वरेषु ग्रहान्सोमस्य मिमते द्वादश ॥
verses.rom:
suparnam viprah kavayo vachobhirekam santam bahudha kalpayanti |
chhandamsi cha dadhato adhvareshu grahansomasya mimate dvadasha ||
verses.en:
Him with fair wings though only One in nature, wise singers shape, with songs, in many figures.
While they at sacrifices fix the metres, they measure out twelve chalices of Soma.

verses.sa:
षट्त्रिंशाँश्च चतुरः कल्पयन्तश्छन्दांसि च दधत आद्वादशम् ।
यज्ञं विमाय कवयो मनीष ऋक्सामाभ्यां प्र रथं वर्तयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
shattrimshanshcha chaturah kalpayantashchhandamsi cha dadhata advadasham |
yajnam vimaya kavayo manisha riksamabhyam pra ratham vartayanti ||
verses.en:
While they arrange the four and six-and-thirty, and duly order, up to twelve, the measures,
Having disposed the sacrifice thoughtful sages send the Car forward with the Rc and Saman.

verses.sa:
चतुर्दशान्ये महिमानो अस्य तं धीरा वाचा प्र णयन्ति सप्त ।
आप्नानं तीर्थं क इह प्र वोचद्येन पथा प्रपिबन्ते सुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdashanye mahimano asya tam dhira vacha pra nayanti sapta |
apnanam tirtham ka iha pra vochadyena patha prapibante sutasya ||
verses.en:
The Chariot's majesties are fourteen others: seven sages lead it onward with their Voices.
Who will declare to us the ford Apnana, the path whereby they drink first draughts of Soma?

verses.sa:
सहस्रधा पञ्चदशान्युक्था यावद्द्यावापृथिवी तावदित्तत् ।
सहस्रधा महिमानः सहस्रं यावद्ब्रह्म विष्ठितं तावती वाक् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasradha panchadashanyuktha yavaddyavaprithivi tavadittat |
sahasradha mahimanah sahasram yavadbrahma vishthitam tavati vak ||
verses.en:
The fifteen lauds are in a thousand places that is as vast as heaven and earth in measure.
A thousand spots contain the mighty thousand. Vak spreadeth forth as far as Prayer extendeth.

verses.sa:
कश्छन्दसां योगमावेद धीरः को धिष्ण्यां प्रति वाचं पपाद ।
कमृत्विजामष्टमं शूरमाहुर्हरी इन्द्रस्य नि चिकाय कः स्वित् ॥
verses.rom:
kashchhandasam yogamaveda dhirah ko dhishnyam prati vacham papada |
kamritvijamashtamam shuramahurhari indrasya ni chikaya kah svit ||
verses.en:
What sage hath learned the metres' application? Who hath gained Vak, the spirit's aim and object?
Which ministering priest is called eighth Hero? Who then hath tracked the two Bay Steeds of Indra?

verses.sa:
भूम्या अन्तं पर्येके चरन्ति रथस्य धूर्षु युक्तासो अस्थुः ।
श्रमस्य दायं वि भजन्त्येभ्यो यदा यमो भवति हर्म्ये हितः ॥
verses.rom:
bhumya antam paryeke charanti rathasya dhurshu yuktaso asthuh |
shramasya dayam vi bhajantyebhyo yada yamo bhavati harmye hitah ||
verses.en:
Yoked to his chariot-pole there stood the Coursers: they only travel round earth's farthest limits.
These, when their driver in his home is settled, receive the allotted meed of their exertion.

verses.sa:
चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावप्येति धातवे ।
अनूधा यदि जीजनदधा च नु ववक्ष सद्यो महि दूत्यं चरन् ॥
verses.rom:
chitra ichchhishostarunasya vakshatho na yo mataravapyeti dhatave |
anudha yadi jijanadadha cha nu vavaksha sadyo mahi dutyam charan ||
verses.en:
VERILY wondrous is the tender Youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his Mothers' milk.
As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his great errand, suddenly grew strong.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ह नाम धायि दन्नपस्तमः सं यो वना युवते भस्मना दता ।
अभिप्रमुरा जुह्वा स्वध्वर इनो न प्रोथमानो यवसे वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
agnirha nama dhayi dannapastamah sam yo vana yuvate bhasmana data |
abhipramura juhva svadhvara ino na prothamano yavase vrisha ||
verses.en:
Then Agni was his name, most active to bestow, gathering up the trees with his consuming tooth;
Skilled in fair sacrifice, armed with destroying tongue, impetuous as a bull that snorteth in the mead.

verses.sa:
तं वो विं न द्रुषदं देवमन्धस इन्दुं प्रोथन्तं प्रवपन्तमर्णवम् ।
आसा वह्निं न शोचिषा विरप्शिनं महिव्रतं न सरजन्तमध्वनः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo vim na drushadam devamandhasa indum prothantam pravapantamarnavam |
asa vahnim na shochisha virapshinam mahivratam na sarajantamadhvanah ||
verses.en:
Praise him, your God who, bird-like, rests upon a tree, scattering drops of juice and pouring forth his flood,
Speaking aloud with flame as with his lips a priest, and broadening his paths like one of high command.

verses.sa:
वि यस्य ते ज्रयसानस्याजर धक्षोर्न वाताः परि सन्त्यच्युताः ।
आ रण्वासो युयुधयो न सत्वनं त्रितं नशन्त प्र शिषन्त इष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
vi yasya te jrayasanasyajara dhakshorna vatah pari santyachyutah |
a ranvaso yuyudhayo na satvanam tritam nashanta pra shishanta ishtaye ||
verses.en:
Thou Everlasting, whom, far-striding fain to burn, the winds, uninterrupted, never overcome,
They have approached, as warriors eager for the fight, heroic Trita, guiding him to gain his wish.

verses.sa:
स इदग्निः कण्वतमः कण्वसखार्यः परस्यान्तरस्य तरुषः ।
अग्निः पातु गृणतो अग्निः सूरीनग्निर्ददातु तेषामवो नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa idagnih kanvatamah kanvasakharyah parasyantarasya tarushah |
agnih patu grinato agnih surinagnirdadatu teshamavo nah ||
verses.en:
This Agni is the best of Kanvas, Kanvas' Friend, Conqueror of the foe whether afar or near.
May Agni guard the singers, guard the princes well: may Agni grant to us our princes' gracious help.

verses.sa:
वाजिन्तमाय सह्यसे सुपित्र्य तृषु च्यवानो अनु जातवेदसे ।
अनुद्रे चिद्यो धृषता वरं सते महिन्तमाय धन्वनेदविष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
vajintamaya sahyase supitrya trishu chyavano anu jatavedase |
anudre chidyo dhrishata varam sate mahintamaya dhanvanedavishyate ||
verses.en:
Do thou, Supitrya, swiftly following, make thyself the lord of Jatavedas, mightiest of all,
Who surely gives a boon even in thirsty land most powerful, prepared to aid us in the wilds.

verses.sa:
एवाग्निर्मर्तैः सह सूरिभिर्वसु ष्टवे सहसः सूनरो नृभिः ।
मित्रासो न ये सुधिता ऋतायवो द्यावो न द्युम्नैरभि सन्ति मानुषान् ॥
verses.rom:
evagnirmartaih saha suribhirvasu shtave sahasah sunaro nribhih |
mitraso na ye sudhita ritayavo dyavo na dyumnairabhi santi manushan ||
verses.en:
Thus noble Agni with princes and mortal men is lauded, excellent for conquering strength with chiefs,
Men who are well-disposed as friends and true to Law, even as the heavens in majesty surpass mankind.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपात्सहसावन्निति त्वोपस्तुतस्य वन्दते वृषा वाक् ।
त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napatsahasavanniti tvopastutasya vandate vrisha vak |
tvam stoshama tvaya suvira draghiya ayuh prataram dadhanah ||
verses.en:
O Son of Strength, Victorious, with this title Upastuta's most potent voice reveres thee.
Blest with brave sons by thee we will extol thee, and lengthen out the days of our existence.

verses.sa:
इति त्वाग्ने वृष्टिहव्यस्य पुत्रा उपस्तुतास ऋषयोऽवोचन् ।
ताँश्च पाहि गृणतश्च सूरीन्वषड्वषळित्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन्नमो नम इत्यूर्ध्वासो अनक्षन् ॥
verses.rom:
iti tvagne vrishtihavyasya putra upastutasa rishayo'vochan |
tanshcha pahi grinatashcha surinvashadvashalityurdhvaso anakshannamo nama ityurdhvaso anakshan ||
verses.en:
Thus, Agni, have the sons of Vrstihavya, the Rsis, the Upastutas invoked thee.
Protect them, guard the singers and the princes. With Vasat! have they come, with hands uplifted, with their uplifted hands and cries of Glory!

verses.sa:
पिबा सोमं महत इन्द्रियाय पिबा वृत्राय हन्तवे शविष्ठ ।
पिब राये शवसे हूयमानः पिब मध्वस्तृपदिन्द्रा वृषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
piba somam mahata indriyaya piba vritraya hantave shavishtha |
piba raye shavase huyamanah piba madhvastripadindra vrishasva ||
verses.en:
DRINK Soma juice for mighty power and vigour, drink, Strongest One, that thou mayst smite down Vrtra.
Drink thou, invoked, for strength, and riches: drink thou thy fill of meath and pour it down, O Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्य पिब क्षुमतः प्रस्थितस्येन्द्र सोमस्य वरमा सुतस्य ।
स्वस्तिदा मनसा मादयस्वार्वाचीनो रेवते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
asya piba kshumatah prasthitasyendra somasya varama sutasya |
svastida manasa madayasvarvachino revate saubhagaya ||
verses.en:
Drink of the foodful juice stirred into motion, drink what thou choosest of the flowing Soma.
Giver of weal, be joyful in thy spirit, and turn thee hitherward to bless and prosper.

verses.sa:
ममत्तु त्वा दिव्यः सोम इन्द्र ममत्तु यः सूयते पार्थिवेषु ।
ममत्तु येन वरिवश्चकर्थ ममत्तु येन निरिणासि शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
mamattu tva divyah soma indra mamattu yah suyate parthiveshu |
mamattu yena varivashchakartha mamattu yena nirinasi shatrun ||
verses.en:
Let heavenly Soma gladden thee, O Indra, let that effused among mankind delight thee.
Rejoice in that whereby thou gavest freedom, and that whereby thou conquerest thy foemen.

verses.sa:
आ द्विबर्हा अमिनो यात्विन्द्रो वृषा हरिभ्यां परिषिक्तमन्धः ।
गव्या सुतस्य प्रभृतस्य मध्वः सत्रा खेदामरुशहा वृषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
a dvibarha amino yatvindro vrisha haribhyam parishiktamandhah |
gavya sutasya prabhritasya madhvah satra khedamarushaha vrishasva ||
verses.en:
Let Indra come, impetuous, doubly mighty, to the poured juice, the Bull, with two Bay Coursers.
With juices pressed in milk, with meath presented, glut evermore thy bolt, O Foe-destroyer.

verses.sa:
नि तिग्मानि भ्राशयन्भ्राश्यान्यव स्थिरा तनुहि यातुजूनाम् ।
उग्राय ते सहो बलं ददामि प्रतीत्या शत्रून्विगदेषु वृश्च ॥
verses.rom:
ni tigmani bhrashayanbhrashyanyava sthira tanuhi yatujunam |
ugraya te saho balam dadami pratitya shatrunvigadeshu vrishcha ||
verses.en:
Dash down, outflaming their sharp flaming weapons, the strong-holds of the men urged on by demons.
I give thee, Mighty One, great strength and conquest: go, meet thy foes and rend them in the battle.

verses.sa:
व्यर्य इन्द्र तनुहि श्रवांस्योज स्थिरेव धन्वनोऽभिमातीः ।
अस्मद्र्यग्वावृधानः सहोभिरनिभृष्टस्तन्वं वावृधस्व ॥
verses.rom:
vyarya indra tanuhi shravamsyoja sthireva dhanvano'bhimatih |
asmadryagvavridhanah sahobhiranibhrishtastanvam vavridhasva ||
verses.en:
Extend afar the votary's fame and glory, as the firm archer's strength drives off the foeman.
Ranged on our side, grown strong in might that conquers, never defeated, still increase thy body.

verses.sa:
इदं हविर्मघवन्तुभ्यं रातं प्रति सम्राळहृणानो गृभाय ।
तुभ्यं सुतो मघवन्तुभ्यं पक्वोऽद्धीन्द्र पिब च प्रस्थितस्य ॥
verses.rom:
idam havirmaghavantubhyam ratam prati samralahrinano gribhaya |
tubhyam suto maghavantubhyam pakvo'ddhindra piba cha prasthitasya ||
verses.en:
To thee have we presented this oblation: accept it, Sovran Ruler, free from anger.
Juice, Maghavan, for thee is pressed and ripened: eat, Indra, drink of that which stirs to meet thee.

verses.sa:
अद्धीदिन्द्र प्रस्थितेमा हवींषि चनो दधिष्व पचतोत सोमम् ।
प्रयस्वन्तः प्रति हर्यामसि त्वा सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः ॥
verses.rom:
addhidindra prasthitema havimshi chano dadhishva pachatota somam |
prayasvantah prati haryamasi tva satyah santu yajamanasya kamah ||
verses.en:
Eat, Indra, these oblations which approach thee: be pleased with food made ready and with Soma.
With entertainment we receive thee friendly: effectual be the sacrificer's wishes.

verses.sa:
प्रेन्द्राग्निभ्यां सुवचस्यामियर्मि सिन्धाविव प्रेरयं नावमर्कैः ।
अया इव परि चरन्ति देवा ये अस्मभ्यं धनदा उद्भिदश्च ॥
verses.rom:
prendragnibhyam suvachasyamiyarmi sindhaviva prerayam navamarkaih |
aya iva pari charanti deva ye asmabhyam dhanada udbhidashcha ||
verses.en:
I send sweet speech to Indra and to Agni: with hymns I speed it like a boat through waters.
Even thus, the Gods seem moving round about me, the fountains and bestowers of our riches.

verses.sa:
न वा उ देवाः क्षुधमिद्वधं ददुरुताशितमुप गच्छन्ति मृत्यवः ।
उतो रयिः पृणतो नोप दस्यत्युतापृणन्मर्डितारं न विन्दते ॥
verses.rom:
na va u devah kshudhamidvadham dadurutashitamupa gachchhanti mrityavah |
uto rayih prinato nopa dasyatyutaprinanmarditaram na vindate ||
verses.en:
THE Gods have not ordained hunger to be our death: even to the well-fed man comes death in varied shape.
The riches of the liberal never waste away, while he who will not give finds none to comfort him.

verses.sa:
य आध्राय चकमानाय पित्वोऽन्नवान्सन्रफितायोपजग्मुषे ।
स्थिरं मनः कृणुते सेवते पुरोतो चित्स मर्डितारं न विन्दते ॥
verses.rom:
ya adhraya chakamanaya pitvo'nnavansanraphitayopajagmushe |
sthiram manah krinute sevate puroto chitsa marditaram na vindate ||
verses.en:
The man with food in store who, when the needy comes in miserable case begging for bread to eat,
Hardens his heart against him-even when of old he did him service-finds not one to comfort him.

verses.sa:
स इद्भोजो यो गृहवे ददात्यन्नकामाय चरते कृशाय ।
अरमस्मै भवति यामहूता उतापरीषु कृणुते सखायम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa idbhojo yo grihave dadatyannakamaya charate krishaya |
aramasmai bhavati yamahuta utaparishu krinute sakhayam ||
verses.en:
Bounteous is he who gives unto the beggar who comes to him in want of food and feeble.
Success attends him in the shout of battle. He makes a friend of him in future troubles.

verses.sa:
न स सखा यो न ददाति सख्ये सचाभुवे सचमानाय पित्वः ।
अपास्मात्प्रेयान्न तदोको अस्ति पृणन्तमन्यमरणं चिदिच्छेत् ॥
verses.rom:
na sa sakha yo na dadati sakhye sachabhuve sachamanaya pitvah |
apasmatpreyanna tadoko asti prinantamanyamaranam chidichchhet ||
verses.en:
No friend is he who to his friend and comrade who comes imploring food, will offer nothing.
Let him depart-no home is that to rest in-, and rather seek a stranger to support him.

verses.sa:
पृणीयादिन्नाधमानाय तव्यान्द्राघीयांसमनु पश्येत पन्थाम् ।
ओ हि वर्तन्ते रथ्येव चक्रान्यमन्यमुप तिष्ठन्त रायः ॥
verses.rom:
priniyadinnadhamanaya tavyandraghiyamsamanu pashyeta pantham |
o hi vartante rathyeva chakranyamanyamupa tishthanta rayah ||
verses.en:
Let the rich satisfy the poor implorer, and bend his eye upon a longer pathway.
Riches come now to one, now to another, and like the wheels of cars are ever rolling.

verses.sa:
मोघमन्नं विन्दते अप्रचेताः सत्यं ब्रवीमि वध इत्स तस्य ।
नार्यमणं पुष्यति नो सखायं केवलाघो भवति केवलादी ॥
verses.rom:
moghamannam vindate aprachetah satyam bravimi vadha itsa tasya |
naryamanam pushyati no sakhayam kevalagho bhavati kevaladi ||
verses.en:
The foolish man wins food with fruitless labour: that food -I speak the truth- shall be his ruin.
He feeds no trusty friend, no man to love him. All guilt is he who eats with no partaker.

verses.sa:
कृषन्नित्फाल आशितं कृणोति यन्नध्वानमप वृङ्क्ते चरित्रैः ।
वदन्ब्रह्मावदतो वनीयान्पृणन्नापिरपृणन्तमभि ष्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
krishannitphala ashitam krinoti yannadhvanamapa vrinkte charitraih |
vadanbrahmavadato vaniyanprinannapiraprinantamabhi shyat ||
verses.en:
The ploughshare ploughing makes the food that feeds us, and with its feet cuts through the path it follows.
Better the speaking than the silent Brahman: the liberal friend out values him who gives not.

verses.sa:
एकपाद्भूयो द्विपदो वि चक्रमे द्विपात्त्रिपादमभ्येति पश्चात् ।
चतुष्पादेति द्विपदामभिस्वरे सम्पश्यन्पङ्क्तीरुपतिष्ठमानः ॥
verses.rom:
ekapadbhuyo dvipado vi chakrame dvipattripadamabhyeti pashchat |
chatushpadeti dvipadamabhisvare sampashyanpanktirupatishthamanah ||
verses.en:
He with one foot hath far outrun the biped, and the two-footed catches the three-footed.
Four-footed creatures come when bipeds call them, and stand and look where five are met together.

verses.sa:
समौ चिद्धस्तौ न समं विविष्टः सम्मातरा चिन्न समं दुहाते ।
यमयोश्चिन्न समा वीर्याणि ज्ञाती चित्सन्तौ न समं पृणीतः ॥
verses.rom:
samau chiddhastau na samam vivishtah sammatara chinna samam duhate |
yamayoshchinna sama viryani jnati chitsantau na samam prinitah ||
verses.en:
The hands are both alike: their labour differs. The yield of sister milch-kine is unequal.
Twins even differ in their strength and vigour: two, even kinsmen, differ in their bounty.

verses.sa:
अग्ने हंसि न्यत्रिणं दीद्यन्मर्त्येष्वा ।
स्वे क्षये शुचिव्रत ॥
verses.rom:
agne hamsi nyatrinam didyanmartyeshva |
sve kshaye shuchivrata ||
verses.en:
AGNI, refulgent among men thou slayest the devouring fiend,
Bright Ruler in thine own abode.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठसि स्वाहुतो घृतानि प्रति मोदसे ।
यत्त्वा स्रुचः समस्थिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthasi svahuto ghritani prati modase |
yattva sruchah samasthiran ||
verses.en:
Thou springest up when worshipped well the drops of butter are thy joy
When ladies are brought near to thee.

verses.sa:
स आहुतो वि रोचतेऽग्निरीळेन्यो गिरा ।
स्रुचा प्रतीकमज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sa ahuto vi rochate'gnirilenyo gira |
srucha pratikamajyate ||
verses.en:
Honoured with gifts he shines afar, Agni adorable with song:
The dripping ladle balms his face.

verses.sa:
घृतेनाग्निः समज्यते मधुप्रतीक आहुतः ।
रोचमानो विभावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
ghritenagnih samajyate madhupratika ahutah |
rochamano vibhavasuh ||
verses.en:
Agni with honey in his mouth, honoured with gifts, is balmed with oil,
Refulgent in his wealth of light.

verses.sa:
जरमाणः समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन ।
तं त्वा हवन्त मर्त्याः ॥
verses.rom:
jaramanah samidhyase devebhyo havyavahana |
tam tva havanta martyah ||
verses.en:
Praised by our hymns thou kindlest thee, Oblation-bearer, for the Gods
As such do mortals call on thee.

verses.sa:
तं मर्ता अमर्त्यं घृतेनाग्निं सपर्यत ।
अदाभ्यं गृहपतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam marta amartyam ghritenagnim saparyata |
adabhyam grihapatim ||
verses.en:
To that Immortal Agni pay worship with oil, ye mortal men,-
Lord of the house, whom none deceives.

verses.sa:
अदाभ्येन शोचिषाग्ने रक्षस्त्वं दह ।
गोपा ऋतस्य दीदिहि ॥
verses.rom:
adabhyena shochishagne rakshastvam daha |
gopa ritasya didihi ||
verses.en:
O Agni, burn the Raksasas with thine unconquerable flame
Shine guardian of Eternal Law.

verses.sa:
स त्वमग्ने प्रतीकेन प्रत्योष यातुधान्यः ।
उरुक्षयेषु दीद्यत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvamagne pratikena pratyosha yatudhanyah |
urukshayeshu didyat ||
verses.en:
So, Agni, with thy glowing face burn fierce against the female fiends,
Shining among Uruksayas.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा गीर्भिरुरुक्षया हव्यवाहं समीधिरे ।
यजिष्ठं मानुषे जने ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva girbhirurukshaya havyavaham samidhire |
yajishtham manushe jane ||
verses.en:
Uruksayas have kindled thee, Oblation-bearer, thee, with hymns.
Best Worshipper among mankind.

verses.sa:
इति वा इति मे मनो गामश्वं सनुयामिति ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
iti va iti me mano gamashvam sanuyamiti |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
THIS, even this was my resolve, to win a cow, to win a steed:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
प्र वाता इव दोधत उन्मा पीता अयंसत ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
pra vata iva dodhata unma pita ayamsata |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
Like violent gusts of wind the draughts that I have drunk have lifted me
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
उन्मा पीता अयंसत रथमश्वा इवाशवः ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
unma pita ayamsata rathamashva ivashavah |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
The draughts I drank have borne me up, as fleet-foot horses draw a car:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
उप मा मतिरस्थित वाश्रा पुत्रमिव प्रियम् ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
upa ma matirasthita vashra putramiva priyam |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
The hymn hath reached me, like a cow who lows to meet her darling calf:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
अहं तष्टेव वन्धुरं पर्यचामि हृदा मतिम् ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
aham tashteva vandhuram paryachami hrida matim |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
As a wright bends a chariot-seat so round my heart I bend the hymn:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
नहि मे अक्षिपच्चनाच्छान्त्सुः पञ्च कृष्टयः ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
nahi me akshipachchanachchhantsuh pancha krishtayah |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
Not as a mote within the eye count the Five Tribes of men with me:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
नहि मे रोदसी उभे अन्यं पक्षं चन प्रति ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
nahi me rodasi ubhe anyam paksham chana prati |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
The heavens and earth themselves have not grown equal to one half of me
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
अभि द्यां महिना भुवमभीमां पृथिवीं महीम् ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
abhi dyam mahina bhuvamabhimam prithivim mahim |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
I in my grandeur have surpassed the heavens and all this spacious earth
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
हन्ताहं पृथिवीमिमां नि दधानीह वेह वा ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
hantaham prithivimimam ni dadhaniha veha va |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
Aha! this spacious earth will I deposit either here or there
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
ओषमित्पृथिवीमहं जङ्घनानीह वेह वा ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
oshamitprithivimaham janghananiha veha va |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
In one short moment will I smite the earth in fury here or there:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
दिवि मे अन्यः पक्षोऽधो अन्यमचीकृषम् ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
divi me anyah paksho'dho anyamachikrisham |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
One of my flanks is in the sky; I let the other trail below:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि महामहोऽभिनभ्यमुदीषितः ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
ahamasmi mahamaho'bhinabhyamudishitah |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
1, greatest of the Mighty Ones, am lifted to the firmament:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
गृहो याम्यरंकृतो देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहनः ।
कुवित्सोमस्यापामिति ॥
verses.rom:
griho yamyaramkrito devebhyo havyavahanah |
kuvitsomasyapamiti ||
verses.en:
I seek the worshipper's abode; oblation-bearer to the Gods:
Have I not drunk of Soma juice?

verses.sa:
तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो जज्ञ उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः ॥
verses.rom:
tadidasa bhuvaneshu jyeshtham yato jajna ugrastveshanrimnah |
sadyo jajnano ni rinati shatrunanu yam vishve madantyumah ||
verses.en:
IN all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the Mighty Gods, of splendid valour.
As soon as born he overcomes his foemen, be in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.

verses.sa:
वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति ।
अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhanah shavasa bhuryojah shatrurdasaya bhiyasam dadhati |
avyanachcha vyanachcha sasni sam te navanta prabhrita madeshu ||
verses.en:
Grown mighty in his strength, with ample vigour, he as a foe strikes fear into the Dasa,
Eager to win the breathing and the breathless. All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः ।
स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः ॥
verses.rom:
tve kratumapi vrinjanti vishve dviryadete trirbhavantyumah |
svadoh svadiyah svaduna srija samadah su madhu madhunabhi yodhih ||
verses.en:
All concentrate on thee their mental vigour, what time these, twice or thrice, are thine assistants.
Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win. quickly with our meath that meath in battle.

verses.sa:
इति चिद्धि त्वा धना जयन्तं मदेमदे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः ।
ओजीयो धृष्णो स्थिरमा तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन्यातुधाना दुरेवाः ॥
verses.rom:
iti chiddhi tva dhana jayantam mademade anumadanti viprah |
ojiyo dhrishno sthirama tanushva ma tva dabhanyatudhana durevah ||
verses.en:
Therefore in thee too, thou who winnest riches, at every banquet are the sages joyful.
With mightier power, Bold God, extend thy firmness: let not malignant Yatudhanas harm thee.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि ।
चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते शिशामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya vayam shashadmahe raneshu prapashyanto yudhenyani bhuri |
chodayami ta ayudha vachobhih sam te shishami brahmana vayamsi ||
verses.en:
Proudly we put our trust in thee in battles, when we behold great wealth the prize of combat.
I with my words impel thy weapons onward, and sharpen with my prayer thy vital vigour.

verses.sa:
स्तुषेय्यं पुरुवर्पसमृभ्वमिनतममाप्त्यमाप्त्यानाम् ।
आ दर्षते शवसा सप्त दानून्प्र साक्षते प्रतिमानानि भूरि ॥
verses.rom:
stusheyyam puruvarpasamribhvaminatamamaptyamaptyanam |
a darshate shavasa sapta danunpra sakshate pratimanani bhuri ||
verses.en:
Worthy of praises, many-shaped, most skillful, most energetic, Aptya of the Aptyas:
He with his might destroys the seven Danus, subduing many who were deemed his equals.

verses.sa:
नि तद्दधिषेऽवरं परं च यस्मिन्नाविथावसा दुरोणे ।
आ मातरा स्थापयसे जिगत्नू अत इनोषि कर्वरा पुरूणि ॥
verses.rom:
ni taddadhishe'varam param cha yasminnavithavasa durone |
a matara sthapayase jigatnu ata inoshi karvara puruni ||
verses.en:
Thou in that house which thy protection guardeth bestowest wealth, the higher and the lower.
Thou establishest the two much-wandering Mothers, and bringest many deeds to their completion.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवो विवक्तीन्द्राय शूषमग्रियः स्वर्षाः ।
महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजो दुरश्च विश्वा अवृणोदप स्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
ima brahma brihaddivo vivaktindraya shushamagriyah svarshah |
maho gotrasya kshayati svarajo durashcha vishva avrinodapa svah ||
verses.en:
Brhaddiva, the foremost of light-winners, repeats these holy prayers, this strength of Indra.
He rules the great self-luminous fold of cattle, and all the doors of light hath he thrown open.

verses.sa:
एवा महान्बृहद्दिवो अथर्वावोचत्स्वां तन्वमिन्द्रमेव ।
स्वसारो मातरिभ्वरीररिप्रा हिन्वन्ति च शवसा वर्धयन्ति च ॥
verses.rom:
eva mahanbrihaddivo atharvavochatsvam tanvamindrameva |
svasaro mataribhvariraripra hinvanti cha shavasa vardhayanti cha ||
verses.en:
Thus hath Brhaddiva, the great Atharvan, spoken to Indra as himself in person.
The spotless Sisters, they who are his Mothers, with power exalt him and impel him onward.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे भूतस्य जातः पतिरेक आसीत् ।
स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyagarbhah samavartatagre bhutasya jatah patireka asit |
sa dadhara prithivim dyamutemam kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
IN the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created beings.
He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
य आत्मदा बलदा यस्य विश्व उपासते प्रशिषं यस्य देवाः ।
यस्य छायामृतं यस्य मृत्युः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
ya atmada balada yasya vishva upasate prashisham yasya devah |
yasya chhayamritam yasya mrityuh kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandments all the Gods acknowledge -.
The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यः प्राणतो निमिषतो महित्वैक इद्राजा जगतो बभूव ।
य ईशे अस्य द्विपदश्चतुष्पदः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yah pranato nimishato mahitvaika idraja jagato babhuva |
ya ishe asya dvipadashchatushpadah kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
Who by his grandeur hath become Sole Ruler of all the moving world that breathes and slumbers;
He who is Lord of men and Lord of cattle. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यस्येमे हिमवन्तो महित्वा यस्य समुद्रं रसया सहाहुः ।
यस्येमाः प्रदिशो यस्य बाहू कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yasyeme himavanto mahitva yasya samudram rasaya sahahuh |
yasyemah pradisho yasya bahu kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
His, through his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasa his possession:
His arms are these, his are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
येन द्यौरुग्रा पृथिवी च दृळ्हा येन स्वः स्तभितं येन नाकः ।
यो अन्तरिक्षे रजसो विमानः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yena dyaurugra prithivi cha drilha yena svah stabhitam yena nakah |
yo antarikshe rajaso vimanah kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
By him the heavens are strong and earth is steadfast, by him light's realm and sky-vault are supported:
By him the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यं क्रन्दसी अवसा तस्तभाने अभ्यैक्षेतां मनसा रेजमाने ।
यत्राधि सूर उदितो विभाति कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yam krandasi avasa tastabhane abhyaikshetam manasa rejamane |
yatradhi sura udito vibhati kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
To him, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit,
When over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
आपो ह यद्बृहतीर्विश्वमायन्गर्भं दधाना जनयन्तीरग्निम् ।
ततो देवानां समवर्ततासुरेकः कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
apo ha yadbrihatirvishvamayangarbham dadhana janayantiragnim |
tato devanam samavartatasurekah kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
What time the mighty waters came, containing the universal germ, producing Agni,
Thence sprang the Gods' one spirit into being. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
यश्चिदापो महिना पर्यपश्यद्दक्षं दधाना जनयन्तीर्यज्ञम् ।
यो देवेष्वधि देव एक आसीत्कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
yashchidapo mahina paryapashyaddaksham dadhana janayantiryajnam |
yo deveshvadhi deva eka asitkasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
He in his might surveyed the floods containing productive force and generating Worship.
He is the God of gods, and none beside him. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
मा नो हिंसीज्जनिता यः पृथिव्या यो वा दिवं सत्यधर्मा जजान ।
यश्चापश्चन्द्रा बृहतीर्जजान कस्मै देवाय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
ma no himsijjanita yah prithivya yo va divam satyadharma jajana |
yashchapashchandra brihatirjajana kasmai devaya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
Neer may he harm us who is earth's Begetter, nor he whose laws are sure, the heavens' Creator,
He who brought forth the great and lucid waters. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sa:
प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा जातानि परि ता बभूव ।
यत्कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prajapate na tvadetanyanyo vishva jatani pari ta babhuva |
yatkamaste juhumastanno astu vayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en:
Prajapati! thou only comprehendest all these created things, and none beside thee.
Grant us our hearts' desire when we invoke thee: may we have store of riches in possession.

verses.sa:
वसुं न चित्रमहसं गृणीषे वामं शेवमतिथिमद्विषेण्यम् ।
स रासते शुरुधो विश्वधायसोऽग्निर्होता गृहपतिः सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vasum na chitramahasam grinishe vamam shevamatithimadvishenyam |
sa rasate shurudho vishvadhayaso'gnirhota grihapatih suviryam ||
verses.en:
I PRAISE the God of wondrous might like Indra, the lovely pleasant Guest whom all must welcome.
May Agni, Priest and Master of the household, give hero strength and all-sustaining riches.

verses.sa:
जुषाणो अग्ने प्रति हर्य मे वचो विश्वानि विद्वान्वयुनानि सुक्रतो ।
घृतनिर्णिग्ब्रह्मणे गातुमेरय तव देवा अजनयन्ननु व्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
jushano agne prati harya me vacho vishvani vidvanvayunani sukrato |
ghritanirnigbrahmane gatumeraya tava deva ajanayannanu vratam ||
verses.en:
O Agni, graciously accept this song of mine, thou passing-wise who knowest every ordinance.
Enwrapped in holy oil further the course of prayer: the Gods bestow according to thy holy law.

verses.sa:
सप्त धामानि परियन्नमर्त्यो दाशद्दाशुषे सुकृते मामहस्व ।
सुवीरेण रयिणाग्ने स्वाभुवा यस्त आनट् समिधा तं जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
sapta dhamani pariyannamartyo dashaddashushe sukrite mamahasva |
suvirena rayinagne svabhuva yasta anat samidha tam jushasva ||
verses.en:
Immortal, wandering round the seven stations, give, a liberal Giver, to the pious worshipper,
Wealth, Agni, with brave sons and ready for his use: welcome the man who comes with fuel unto thee.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितं हविष्मन्त ईळते सप्त वाजिनम् ।
शृण्वन्तमग्निं घृतपृष्ठमुक्षणं पृणन्तं देवं पृणते सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya ketum prathamam purohitam havishmanta ilate sapta vajinam |
shrinvantamagnim ghritaprishthamukshanam prinantam devam prinate suviryam ||
verses.en:
The seven who bring oblations worship thee, the Strong, the first, the Great Chief Priest, Ensign of sacrifice,
The oil-anointed Bull, Agni who hears, who sends as God full hero strength to him who freely gives.

verses.sa:
त्वं दूतः प्रथमो वरेण्यः स हूयमानो अमृताय मत्स्व ।
त्वां मर्जयन्मरुतो दाशुषो गृहे त्वां स्तोमेभिर्भृगवो वि रुरुचुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam dutah prathamo varenyah sa huyamano amritaya matsva |
tvam marjayanmaruto dashusho grihe tvam stomebhirbhrigavo vi ruruchuh ||
verses.en:
First messenger art thou, meet for election: drink thou thy fill invited to the Anirta,
The Maruts in the votary's house adorned thee; with lauds the Bhrgus gave thee light and glory.

verses.sa:
इषं दुहन्सुदुघां विश्वधायसं यज्ञप्रिये यजमानाय सुक्रतो ।
अग्ने घृतस्नुस्त्रिरृतानि दीद्यद्वर्तिर्यज्ञं परियन्सुक्रतूयसे ॥
verses.rom:
isham duhansudugham vishvadhayasam yajnapriye yajamanaya sukrato |
agne ghritasnustrirritani didyadvartiryajnam pariyansukratuyase ||
verses.en:
Milking the teeming Cow for all-sustaining food. O Wise One, for the worship-loving worshipper,
Thou, Agni, dropping oil, thrice lighting works of Law, showest thy wisdom circling home and sacrifice.

verses.sa:
त्वामिदस्या उषसो व्युष्टिषु दूतं कृण्वाना अयजन्त मानुषाः ।
त्वां देवा महयाय्याय वावृधुराज्यमग्ने निमृजन्तो अध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamidasya ushaso vyushtishu dutam krinvana ayajanta manushah |
tvam deva mahayayyaya vavridhurajyamagne nimrijanto adhvare ||
verses.en:
They who at flushing of this dawn appointed thee their messenger, these men have paid thee reverence.
Gods strengthened thee for work that must be glorified, Agni, while they made butter pure for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा वसिष्ठा अह्वन्त वाजिनं गृणन्तो अग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः ।
रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धारय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva vasishtha ahvanta vajinam grinanto agne vidatheshu vedhasah |
rayasposham yajamaneshu dharaya yuyam pata svastibhih sada nah ||
verses.en:
Arrangers in our synods, Agni, while they sang Vasisistha s sons have called thee down, the Potent One.
Maintain the growth of wealth with men who sacrifice. Ye Gods, preserve us with your blessings evermore.

verses.sa:
अयं वेनश्चोदयत्पृश्निगर्भा ज्योतिर्जरायू रजसो विमाने ।
इममपां संगमे सूर्यस्य शिशुं न विप्रा मतिभी रिहन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
ayam venashchodayatprishnigarbha jyotirjarayu rajaso vimane |
imamapam samgame suryasya shishum na vipra matibhi rihanti ||
verses.en:
SEE, Vena, born in light, hath driven hither, on chariot of the air, the Calves of Prsni.
Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle.

verses.sa:
समुद्रादूर्मिमुदियर्ति वेनो नभोजाः पृष्ठं हर्यतस्य दर्शि ।
ऋतस्य सानावधि विष्टपि भ्राट् समानं योनिमभ्यनूषत व्राः ॥
verses.rom:
samudradurmimudiyarti veno nabhojah prishtham haryatasya darshi |
ritasya sanavadhi vishtapi bhrat samanam yonimabhyanushata vrah ||
verses.en:
Vena draws up his wave from out the ocean. mist-born, the fair one's back is made apparent,
Brightly he shone aloft on Order's summit: the hosts sang glory to their common birthplace.

verses.sa:
समानं पूर्वीरभि वावशानास्तिष्ठन्वत्सस्य मातरः सनीळाः ।
ऋतस्य सानावधि चक्रमाणा रिहन्ति मध्वो अमृतस्य वाणीः ॥
verses.rom:
samanam purvirabhi vavashanastishthanvatsasya matarah sanilah |
ritasya sanavadhi chakramana rihanti madhvo amritasya vanih ||
verses.en:
Full many, lowing to their joint-possession, dwelling together stood the Darling's Mothers.
Ascending to the lofty height of Order, the bands of singers 'sip the sweets of Amrta.

verses.sa:
जानन्तो रूपमकृपन्त विप्रा मृगस्य घोषं महिषस्य हि ग्मन् ।
ऋतेन यन्तो अधि सिन्धुमस्थुर्विदद्गन्धर्वो अमृतानि नाम ॥
verses.rom:
jananto rupamakripanta vipra mrigasya ghosham mahishasya hi gman |
ritena yanto adhi sindhumasthurvidadgandharvo amritani nama ||
verses.en:
Knowing his form, the sages yearned to meet him: they have come nigh to hear the wild Bull's bellow.
Performing sacrifice they reached the river: for the Gandharva found the immortal waters.

verses.sa:
अप्सरा जारमुपसिष्मियाणा योषा बिभर्ति परमे व्योमन् ।
चरत्प्रियस्य योनिषु प्रियः सन्सीदत्पक्षे हिरण्यये स वेनः ॥
verses.rom:
apsara jaramupasishmiyana yosha bibharti parame vyoman |
charatpriyasya yonishu priyah sansidatpakshe hiranyaye sa venah ||
verses.en:
The Apsaras, the Lady, sweetly smiling, supports her Lover in sublimest heaven.
In his Friend's dwelling as a Friend he wanders: he, Vena, rests him on his golden pinion.

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
nake suparnamupa yatpatantam hrida venanto abhyachakshata tva |
hiranyapaksham varunasya dutam yamasya yonau shakunam bhuranyum ||
verses.en:
They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strong-winged bird that mounteth sky-ward;
On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यङ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि ।
वसानो अत्कं सुरभिं दृशे कं स्वर्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo gandharvo adhi nake asthatpratyanchitra bibhradasyayudhani |
vasano atkam surabhim drishe kam svarna nama janata priyani ||
verses.en:
Erect, to heaven hath the Gandharva mounted, pointing at us his many-coloured weapons;
Clad in sweet raiment beautiful to look on, for he, as light, produceth forms that please us.

verses.sa:
द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् ।
भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि ॥
verses.rom:
drapsah samudramabhi yajjigati pashyangridhrasya chakshasa vidharman |
bhanuh shukrena shochisha chakanastritiye chakre rajasi priyani ||
verses.en:
When as a spark he cometh near the ocean, still looking with a vulture's eye to heaven,
His lustre, joying in its own bright splendour, maketh dear glories in the lowest region.

verses.sa:
इमं नो अग्न उप यज्ञमेहि पञ्चयामं त्रिवृतं सप्ततन्तुम् ।
असो हव्यवाळुत नः पुरोगा ज्योगेव दीर्घं तम आशयिष्ठाः ॥
verses.rom:
imam no agna upa yajnamehi panchayamam trivritam saptatantum |
aso havyavaluta nah puroga jyogeva dirgham tama ashayishthah ||
verses.en:
COME to this sacrifice of ours, O Agni, threefold, with seven threads and five divisions.
Be our oblation-bearer and preceder: thou hast lain long enough in during darkness.

verses.sa:
अदेवाद्देवः प्रचता गुहा यन्प्रपश्यमानो अमृतत्वमेमि ।
शिवं यत्सन्तमशिवो जहामि स्वात्सख्यादरणीं नाभिमेमि ॥
verses.rom:
adevaddevah prachata guha yanprapashyamano amritatvamemi |
shivam yatsantamashivo jahami svatsakhyadaranim nabhimemi ||
verses.en:
I come a God foreseeing from the godless to immortality by secret pathways,
While I, ungracious one, desert the gracious, leave mine own friends and seek the kin of strangers.

verses.sa:
पश्यन्नन्यस्या अतिथिं वयाया ऋतस्य धाम वि मिमे पुरूणि ।
शंसामि पित्रे असुराय शेवमयज्ञियाद्यज्ञियं भागमेमि ॥
verses.rom:
pashyannanyasya atithim vayaya ritasya dhama vi mime puruni |
shamsami pitre asuraya shevamayajniyadyajniyam bhagamemi ||
verses.en:
I, looking to the guest of other lineage, have founded many a rule of Law and Order.
I bid farewell to the Great God, the Father, and, for neglect, obtain my share of worship.

verses.sa:
बह्वीः समा अकरमन्तरस्मिन्निन्द्रं वृणानः पितरं जहामि ।
अग्निः सोमो वरुणस्ते च्यवन्ते पर्यावर्द्राष्ट्रं तदवाम्यायन् ॥
verses.rom:
bahvih sama akaramantarasminnindram vrinanah pitaram jahami |
agnih somo varunaste chyavante paryavardrashtram tadavamyayan ||
verses.en:
I tarried many a year within this altar: I leave the Father, for my choice is Indra.
Away pass Agni, Varuna and Soma. Rule ever changes: this I come to favour.

verses.sa:
निर्माया उ त्ये असुरा अभूवन्त्वं च मा वरुण कामयासे ।
ऋतेन राजन्ननृतं विविञ्चन्मम राष्ट्रस्याधिपत्यमेहि ॥
verses.rom:
nirmaya u tye asura abhuvantvam cha ma varuna kamayase |
ritena rajannanritam vivinchanmama rashtrasyadhipatyamehi ||
verses.en:
These Asuras have lost their powers of magic. But thou, O Varuna, if thou dost love me,
O King, discerning truth and right from falsehood, come and be Lord and Ruler of my kingdom.

verses.sa:
इदं स्वरिदमिदास वाममयं प्रकाश उर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
हनाव वृत्रं निरेहि सोम हविष्ट्वा सन्तं हविषा यजाम ॥
verses.rom:
idam svaridamidasa vamamayam prakasha urvantariksham |
hanava vritram nirehi soma havishtva santam havisha yajama ||
verses.en:
Here is the light of heaven, here all is lovely; here there is radiance, here is air's wide region.
Let us two slaughter Vrtra. Forth, O Soma! Thou art oblation: we therewith will serve thee.

verses.sa:
कविः कवित्वा दिवि रूपमासजदप्रभूती वरुणो निरपः सृजत् ।
क्षेमं कृण्वाना जनयो न सिन्धवस्ता अस्य वर्णं शुचयो भरिभ्रति ॥
verses.rom:
kavih kavitva divi rupamasajadaprabhuti varuno nirapah srijat |
kshemam krinvana janayo na sindhavasta asya varnam shuchayo bharibhrati ||
verses.en:
The Sage hath fixed his form by wisdom in the heavens: Varuna with no violence let the waters flow.
Like women-folk, the floods that bring prosperity have you lit his hue and colour as they gleamed and shone.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य ज्येष्ठमिन्द्रियं सचन्ते ता ईमा क्षेति स्वधया मदन्तीः ।
ता ईं विशो न राजानं वृणाना बीभत्सुवो अप वृत्रादतिष्ठन् ॥
verses.rom:
ta asya jyeshthamindriyam sachante ta ima ksheti svadhaya madantih |
ta im visho na rajanam vrinana bibhatsuvo apa vritradatishthan ||
verses.en:
These wait upon his loftiest power and vigour: he dwells in these who triumph in their Godhead;
And they, like people who elect their ruler, have in abhorrence turned away from Vrtra.

verses.sa:
बीभत्सूनां सयुजं हंसमाहुरपां दिव्यानां सख्ये चरन्तम् ।
अनुष्टुभमनु चर्चूर्यमाणमिन्द्रं नि चिक्युः कवयो मनीषा ॥
verses.rom:
bibhatsunam sayujam hamsamahurapam divyanam sakhye charantam |
anushtubhamanu charchuryamanamindram ni chikyuh kavayo manisha ||
verses.en:
They call him Swan, the abhorrent floods' Companion, moving in friendship with celestial Waters.
The poets in their thought have looked on Indra swiftly approaching when Anustup calls him.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिश्चराम्यहमादित्यैरुत विश्वदेवैः ।
अहं मित्रावरुणोभा बिभर्म्यहमिन्द्राग्नी अहमश्विनोभा ॥
verses.rom:
aham rudrebhirvasubhishcharamyahamadityairuta vishvadevaih |
aham mitravarunobha bibharmyahamindragni ahamashvinobha ||
verses.en:
I TRAVEL with the Rudras and the Vasus, with the Adityas and All-Gods I wander.
I hold aloft both Varuna and Mitra, Indra and Agni, and the Pair of Asvins.

verses.sa:
अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम् ।
अहं दधामि द्रविणं हविष्मते सुप्राव्ये यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
aham somamahanasam bibharmyaham tvashtaramuta pushanam bhagam |
aham dadhami dravinam havishmate supravye yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
I cherish and sustain high-swelling Soma, and Tvastar I support, Pusan, and Bhaga.
I load with wealth the zealous sacrificer who pours the juice and offers his oblation

verses.sa:
अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम् ।
तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तीम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham rashtri samgamani vasunam chikitushi prathama yajniyanam |
tam ma deva vyadadhuh purutra bhuristhatram bhuryaveshayantim ||
verses.en:
I am the Queen, the gatherer-up of treasures, most thoughtful, first of those who merit worship.
Thus Gods have stablished me in many places with many homes to enter and abide in.

verses.sa:
मया सो अन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणिति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम् ।
अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रद्धिवं ते वदामि ॥
verses.rom:
maya so annamatti yo vipashyati yah praniti ya im shrinotyuktam |
amantavo mam ta upa kshiyanti shrudhi shruta shraddhivam te vadami ||
verses.en:
Through me alone all eat the food that feeds them,-each man who sees, breathes, hears the word outspoken
They know it not, but yet they dwell beside me. Hear, one and all, the truth as I declare it.

verses.sa:
अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवेभिरुत मानुषेभिः ।
यं कामये तंतमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahameva svayamidam vadami jushtam devebhiruta manushebhih |
yam kamaye tamtamugram krinomi tam brahmanam tamrishim tam sumedham ||
verses.en:
I, verily, myself announce and utter the word that Gods and men alike shall welcome.
I make the man I love exceeding mighty, make him a sage, a Rsi, and a Brahman.

verses.sa:
अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
अहं जनाय समदं कृणोम्यहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
aham rudraya dhanura tanomi brahmadvishe sharave hantava u |
aham janaya samadam krinomyaham dyavaprithivi a vivesha ||
verses.en:
I bend the bow for Rudra that his arrow may strike and slay the hater of devotion.
I rouse and order battle for the people, and I have penetrated Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन्मम योनिरप्स्वन्तः समुद्रे ।
ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानु विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि ॥
verses.rom:
aham suve pitaramasya murdhanmama yonirapsvantah samudre |
tato vi tishthe bhuvananu vishvotamum dyam varshmanopa sprishami ||
verses.en:
On the world's summit I bring forth the Father: my home is in the waters, in the ocean.
Thence I extend o'er all existing creatures, and touch even yonder heaven with my forehead.

verses.sa:
अहमेव वात इव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा ।
परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यैतावती महिना सं बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
ahameva vata iva pra vamyarabhamana bhuvanani vishva |
paro diva para ena prithivyaitavati mahina sam babhuva ||
verses.en:
I breathe a strong breath like the wind and tempest, the while I hold together all existence.
Beyond this wide earth and beyond the heavens I have become so mighty in my grandeur.

verses.sa:
न तमंहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यम् ।
सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयन्ति वरुणो अति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
na tamamho na duritam devaso ashta martyam |
sajoshaso yamaryama mitro nayanti varuno ati dvishah ||
verses.en:
No peril, no severe distress, ye Gods, affects the mortal man,
Whom Aryaman and Mitra lead, and Varima, of one accord, beyond his foes.

verses.sa:
तद्धि वयं वृणीमहे वरुण मित्रार्यमन् ।
येना निरंहसो यूयं पाथ नेथा च मर्त्यमति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
taddhi vayam vrinimahe varuna mitraryaman |
yena niramhaso yuyam patha netha cha martyamati dvishah ||
verses.en:
This very thing do we desire, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
Whereby ye guard the mortal man from sore distress, and lead him safe beyond his foes.

verses.sa:
ते नूनं नोऽयमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
नयिष्ठा उ नो नेषणि पर्षिष्ठा उ नः पर्षण्यति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
te nunam no'yamutaye varuno mitro aryama |
nayishtha u no neshani parshishtha u nah parshanyati dvishah ||
verses.en:
These are, each one, our present helps, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
Best leaders, best deliverers to lead us on and bear as safe beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
यूयं विश्वं परि पाथ वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
युष्माकं शर्मणि प्रिये स्याम सुप्रणीतयोऽति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam vishvam pari patha varuno mitro aryama |
yushmakam sharmani priye syama supranitayo'ti dvishah ||
verses.en:
Ye compass round and guard each man, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
In your dear keeping may we be, ye who are excellent as guides beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
आदित्यासो अति स्रिधो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
उग्रं मरुद्भी रुद्रं हुवेमेन्द्रमग्निं स्वस्तयेऽति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
adityaso ati sridho varuno mitro aryama |
ugram marudbhi rudram huvemendramagnim svastaye'ti dvishah ||
verses.en:
Adityas are beyond all foes,-Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
Strong Rudra with the Marut host, Indra, Agni let us call for weal beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
नेतार ऊ षु णस्तिरो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
अति विश्वानि दुरिता राजानश्चर्षणीनामति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
netara u shu nastiro varuno mitro aryama |
ati vishvani durita rajanashcharshaninamati dvishah ||
verses.en:
These lead us safely over all, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
These who are Kings of living men, over all troubles far away beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
शुनमस्मभ्यमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथ आदित्यासो यदीमहे अति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
shunamasmabhyamutaye varuno mitro aryama |
sharma yachchhantu sapratha adityaso yadimahe ati dvishah ||
verses.en:
May they give bliss to aid us well, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
May the Adityas, when we pray, grant us wide shelter and defense beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
यथा ह त्यद्वसवो गौर्यं चित्पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः ।
एवो ष्वस्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha ha tyadvasavo gauryam chitpadi shitamamunchata yajatrah |
evo shvasmanmunchata vyamhah pra taryagne prataram na ayuh ||
verses.en:
As in this place, O Holy Ones, ye Vasus freed even the Gaud when her feet were fettered.
So free us now from trouble and affliction: and let our life be lengthened still, O Api.

verses.sa:
रात्री व्यख्यदायती पुरुत्रा देव्यक्षभिः ।
विश्वा अधि श्रियोऽधित ॥
verses.rom:
ratri vyakhyadayati purutra devyakshabhih |
vishva adhi shriyo'dhita ||
verses.en:
WITH all her eyes the Goddess Night looks forth approaching many a spot:
She hath put all her glories on.

verses.sa:
ओर्वप्रा अमर्त्या निवतो देव्युद्वतः ।
ज्योतिषा बाधते तमः ॥
verses.rom:
orvapra amartya nivato devyudvatah |
jyotisha badhate tamah ||
verses.en:
Immortal. she hath filled the waste, the Goddess hath filled height and depth:
She conquers darkness with her light.

verses.sa:
निरु स्वसारमस्कृतोषसं देव्यायती ।
अपेदु हासते तमः ॥
verses.rom:
niru svasaramaskritoshasam devyayati |
apedu hasate tamah ||
verses.en:
The Goddess as she comes hath set the Dawn her Sister in her place:
And then the darkness vanishes.

verses.sa:
सा नो अद्य यस्या वयं नि ते यामन्नविक्ष्महि ।
वृक्षे न वसतिं वयः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no adya yasya vayam ni te yamannavikshmahi |
vrikshe na vasatim vayah ||
verses.en:
So favour us this night, O thou whose pathways we have visited
As birds their nest upon the tree.

verses.sa:
नि ग्रामासो अविक्षत नि पद्वन्तो नि पक्षिणः ।
नि श्येनासश्चिदर्थिनः ॥
verses.rom:
ni gramaso avikshata ni padvanto ni pakshinah |
ni shyenasashchidarthinah ||
verses.en:
The villagers have sought their homes, and all that walks and all that flies,
Even the falcons fain for prey.

verses.sa:
यावया वृक्यं वृकं यवय स्तेनमूर्म्ये ।
अथा नः सुतरा भव ॥
verses.rom:
yavaya vrikyam vrikam yavaya stenamurmye |
atha nah sutara bhava ||
verses.en:
Keep off the she-wolf and the wolf, O Urmya, keep the thief away;
Easy be thou for us to pass.

verses.sa:
उप मा पेपिशत्तमः कृष्णं व्यक्तमस्थित ।
उष ऋणेव यातय ॥
verses.rom:
upa ma pepishattamah krishnam vyaktamasthita |
usha rineva yataya ||
verses.en:
Clearly hath she come nigh to me who decks the dark with richest hues:
O Morning, cancel it like debts.

verses.sa:
उप ते गा इवाकरं वृणीष्व दुहितर्दिवः ।
रात्रि स्तोमं न जिग्युषे ॥
verses.rom:
upa te ga ivakaram vrinishva duhitardivah |
ratri stomam na jigyushe ||
verses.en:
These have I brought to thee like kine. O Night, thou Child of Heaven, accept
This laud as for a conqueror.

verses.sa:
ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्वस्तु वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वं पुषेम ।
मह्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रस्त्वयाध्यक्षेण पृतना जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
mamagne varcho vihaveshvastu vayam tvendhanastanvam pushema |
mahyam namantam pradishashchatasrastvayadhyakshena pritana jayema ||
verses.en:
LET me win glory, Agni, in our battles: enkindling thee, may we support our bodies.
May the four regions bend and bow before me: with thee for guardian may we win in combat.

verses.sa:
मम देवा विहवे सन्तु सर्व इन्द्रवन्तो मरुतो विष्णुरग्निः ।
ममान्तरिक्षमुरुलोकमस्तु मह्यं वातः पवतां कामे अस्मिन् ॥
verses.rom:
mama deva vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto vishnuragnih |
mamantarikshamurulokamastu mahyam vatah pavatam kame asmin ||
verses.en:
May all the Gods be on my side in battle, the Maruts led by Indra, Visnu, Agni.
Mine be the middle air's extended region, and may the wind blow favouring these my wishes.

verses.sa:
मयि देवा द्रविणमा यजन्तां मय्याशीरस्तु मयि देवहूतिः ।
दैव्या होतारो वनुषन्त पूर्वेऽरिष्टाः स्याम तन्वा सुवीराः ॥
verses.rom:
mayi deva dravinama yajantam mayyashirastu mayi devahutih |
daivya hotaro vanushanta purve'rishtah syama tanva suvirah ||
verses.en:
May the Gods grant me riches; may the blessing and invocation of the Gods assist me.
Foremost in fight be the divine Invokers: may we, unwounded, have brave heroes round us.

verses.sa:
मह्यं यजन्तु मम यानि हव्याकूतिः सत्या मनसो मे अस्तु ।
एनो मा नि गां कतमच्चनाहं विश्वे देवासो अधि वोचता नः ॥
verses.rom:
mahyam yajantu mama yani havyakutih satya manaso me astu |
eno ma ni gam katamachchanaham vishve devaso adhi vochata nah ||
verses.en:
For me let them present all mine oblations, and let my mind's intention be accomplished.
May I he guiltless of the least transgression: and, all ye Go-is, do ye combine to bless us.

verses.sa:
देवीः षळुर्वीरुरु नः कृणोत विश्वे देवास इह वीरयध्वम् ।
मा हास्महि प्रजया मा तनूभिर्मा रधाम द्विषते सोम राजन् ॥
verses.rom:
devih shalurviruru nah krinota vishve devasa iha virayadhvam |
ma hasmahi prajaya ma tanubhirma radhama dvishate soma rajan ||
verses.en:
Ye six divine Expanses, grant us freedom: here, all ye Gods, acquit yourselves like heroes.
Let us not lose our children or our bodies: let us not benefit the foe, King Soma!

verses.sa:
अग्ने मन्युं प्रतिनुदन्परेषामदब्धो गोपाः परि पाहि नस्त्वम् ।
प्रत्यञ्चो यन्तु निगुतः पुनस्तेऽमैषां चित्तं प्रबुधां वि नेशत् ॥
verses.rom:
agne manyum pratinudanpareshamadabdho gopah pari pahi nastvam |
pratyancho yantu nigutah punaste'maisham chittam prabudham vi neshat ||
verses.en:
Baffling the wrath of our opponents, Agni, guard us as our infallible Protector.
Let these thy foes turn back and seek their houses, and let their thought who watch at home be ruined.

verses.sa:
धाता धातॄणां भुवनस्य यस्पतिर्देवं त्रातारमभिमातिषाहम् ।
इमं यज्ञमश्विनोभा बृहस्पतिर्देवाः पान्तु यजमानं न्यर्थात् ॥
verses.rom:
dhata dhatrinam bhuvanasya yaspatirdevam trataramabhimatishaham |
imam yajnamashvinobha brihaspatirdevah pantu yajamanam nyarthat ||
verses.en:
Lord of the world, Creator of creators the saviour God who overcomes the foeman.
May Gods, Brhaspati, both Asvins shelter from ill this sacrifice and sacrificer.

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचा नो महिषः शर्म यंसदस्मिन्हवे पुरुहूतः पुरुक्षुः ।
स नः प्रजायै हर्यश्व मृळयेन्द्र मा नो रीरिषो मा परा दाः ॥
verses.rom:
uruvyacha no mahishah sharma yamsadasminhave puruhutah purukshuh |
sa nah prajayai haryashva mrilayendra ma no ririsho ma para dah ||
verses.en:
Foodful, and much-invoked, at this our calling may the great Bull vouchsafe us wide protection.
Lord of Bay Coursers, Indra, blew our children: harm us not, give us riot as prey to others.

verses.sa:
ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामहे तान् ।
वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या उपरिस्पृशं मोग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
ye nah sapatna apa te bhavantvindragnibhyamava badhamahe tan |
vasavo rudra aditya uparisprisham mogram chettaramadhirajamakran ||
verses.en:
Let those who are our foemen stay. afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off.
Vasus, Adityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me far-reaching, mighty, thinker, sovran lord.

verses.sa:
नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीं नासीद्रजो नो व्योमा परो यत्।
किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्नम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम् ॥
verses.rom:
nasadasinno sadasittadanim nasidrajo no vyoma paro yat|
kimavarivah kuha kasya sharmannambhah kimasidgahanam gabhiram ||
verses.en:
THEN was not non-existent nor existent: there was no realm of air, no sky beyond it.
What covered in, and where? and what gave shelter? Was water there, unfathomed depth of water?

verses.sa:
न मृत्युरासीदमृतं न तर्हि न रात्र्या अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः।
आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकं तस्माद्धान्यन्न परः किं चनास ॥
verses.rom:
na mrityurasidamritam na tarhi na ratrya ahna asitpraketah|
anidavatam svadhaya tadekam tasmaddhanyanna parah kim chanasa ||
verses.en:
Death was not then, nor was there aught immortal: no sign was there, the day's and night's divider.
That One Thing, breathless, breathed by its own nature: apart from it was nothing whatsoever.

verses.sa:
तम आसीत्तमसा गूळ्हमग्रेऽप्रकेतं सलिलं सर्वमा इदम्।
तुच्छ्येनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत्तपसस्तन्महिनाजायतैकम् ॥
verses.rom:
tama asittamasa gulhamagre'praketam salilam sarvama idam|
tuchchhyenabhvapihitam yadasittapasastanmahinajayataikam ||
verses.en:
Darkness there was: at first concealed in darkness this All was indiscriminate chaos.
All that existed then was void and formless: by the great power of Warmth was born that Unit.

verses.sa:
कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत्।
सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन् हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा ॥
verses.rom:
kamastadagre samavartatadhi manaso retah prathamam yadasit|
sato bandhumasati niravindan hridi pratishya kavayo manisha ||
verses.en:
Thereafter rose Desire in the beginning, Desire, the primal seed and germ of Spirit.
Sages who searched with their heart's thought discovered the existent's kinship in the non-existent.

verses.sa:
तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषामधः स्विदासी३दुपरि स्विदासी३त्।
रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन्त्स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात् ॥
verses.rom:
tirashchino vitato rashmireshamadhah svidasi3dupari svidasi3t|
retodha asanmahimana asantsvadha avastatprayatih parastat ||
verses.en:
Transversely was their severing line extended: what was above it then, and what below it?
There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder

verses.sa:
को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचत्कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः।
अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनेनाथा को वेद यत आबभूव ॥
verses.rom:
ko addha veda ka iha pra vochatkuta ajata kuta iyam visrishtih|
arvagdeva asya visarjanenatha ko veda yata ababhuva ||
verses.en:
Who verily knows and who can here declare it, whence it was born and whence comes this creation?
The Gods are later than this world's production. Who knows then whence it first came into being?

verses.sa:
इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव यदि वा दधे यदि वा न।
यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन्त्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद ॥
verses.rom:
iyam visrishtiryata ababhuva yadi va dadhe yadi va na|
yo asyadhyakshah parame vyomantso anga veda yadi va na veda ||
verses.en:
He, the first origin of this creation, whether he formed it all or did not form it,
Whose eye controls this world in highest heaven, he verily knows it, or perhaps he knows not.

verses.sa:
यो यज्ञो विश्वतस्तन्तुभिस्तत एकशतं देवकर्मेभिरायतः ।
इमे वयन्ति पितरो य आययुः प्र वयाप वयेत्यासते तते ॥
verses.rom:
yo yajno vishvatastantubhistata ekashatam devakarmebhirayatah |
ime vayanti pitaro ya ayayuh pra vayapa vayetyasate tate ||
verses.en:
THE sacrifice drawn out with threads on every side, stretched by a hundred sacred ministers and one,-
This do these Fathers weave who hitherward are come: they sit beside the warp and cry, Weave forth, weave back.

verses.sa:
पुमाँ एनं तनुत उत्कृणत्ति पुमान्वि तत्ने अधि नाके अस्मिन् ।
इमे मयूखा उप सेदुरू सदः सामानि चक्रुस्तसराण्योतवे ॥
verses.rom:
puman enam tanuta utkrinatti pumanvi tatne adhi nake asmin |
ime mayukha upa seduru sadah samani chakrustasaranyotave ||
verses.en:
The Man extends it and the Man unbinds it: even to this vault of heaven hath he outspun, it.
These pegs are fastened to the seat of worship: they made the Sama-hymns their weaving shuttles.

verses.sa:
कासीत्प्रमा प्रतिमा किं निदानमाज्यं किमासीत्परिधिः क आसीत् ।
छन्दः किमासीत्प्रउगं किमुक्थं यद्देवा देवमयजन्त विश्वे ॥
verses.rom:
kasitprama pratima kim nidanamajyam kimasitparidhih ka asit |
chhandah kimasitpraugam kimuktham yaddeva devamayajanta vishve ||
verses.en:
What were the rule, the order and the model? What were the wooden fender and the butter?
What were the hymn, the chant, the recitation, when to the God all Deities paid worship?

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्गायत्र्यभवत्सयुग्वोष्णिहया सविता सं बभूव ।
अनुष्टुभा सोम उक्थैर्महस्वान्बृहस्पतेर्बृहती वाचमावत् ॥
verses.rom:
agnergayatryabhavatsayugvoshnihaya savita sam babhuva |
anushtubha soma ukthairmahasvanbrihaspaterbrihati vachamavat ||
verses.en:
Closely was Gayatri conjoined with Agni, and closely Savitar combined with Usnih.
Brilliant with Ukthas, Soma joined Anustup: Brhaspati's voice by Brhati was aided.

verses.sa:
विराण्मित्रावरुणयोरभिश्रीरिन्द्रस्य त्रिष्टुबिह भागो अह्नः ।
विश्वान्देवाञ्जगत्या विवेश तेन चाकॢप्र ऋषयो मनुष्याः ॥
verses.rom:
viranmitravarunayorabhishririndrasya trishtubiha bhago ahnah |
vishvandevanjagatya vivesha tena chaklipra rishayo manushyah ||
verses.en:
Viraj adhered to Varuna and Mitra: here Tristup day by day was Indra's portion.
Jagati entered all the Gods together: so by this knowledge men were raised to Rsis.

verses.sa:
चाकॢप्रे तेन ऋषयो मनुष्या यज्ञे जाते पितरो नः पुराणे ।
पश्यन्मन्ये मनसा चक्षसा तान्य इमं यज्ञमयजन्त पूर्वे ॥
verses.rom:
chaklipre tena rishayo manushya yajne jate pitaro nah purane |
pashyanmanye manasa chakshasa tanya imam yajnamayajanta purve ||
verses.en:
So by this knowledge men were raised to Rsis, when ancient sacrifice sprang up, our Fathers.
With the mind's eye I think that I behold them who first performed this sacrificial worship.

verses.sa:
सहस्तोमाः सहछन्दस आवृतः सहप्रमा ऋषयः सप्त दैव्याः ।
पूर्वेषां पन्थामनुदृश्य धीरा अन्वालेभिरे रथ्यो न रश्मीन् ॥
verses.rom:
sahastomah sahachhandasa avritah sahaprama rishayah sapta daivyah |
purvesham panthamanudrishya dhira anvalebhire rathyo na rashmin ||
verses.en:
They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and rules, were the Seven Godlike Rsis.
Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up the reins like chariot-drivers.

verses.sa:
अप प्राच इन्द्र विश्वाँ अमित्रानपापाचो अभिभूते नुदस्व ।
अपोदीचो अप शूराधराच उरौ यथा तव शर्मन्मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
apa pracha indra vishvan amitranapapacho abhibhute nudasva |
apodicho apa shuradharacha urau yatha tava sharmanmadema ||
verses.en:
DRIVE all our enemies away, O Indra, the western, mighty Conqueror, and the eastern.
Hero, drive off our northern foes and southern, that we in thy wide shelter may be joyful.

verses.sa:
कुविदङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद्यथा दान्त्यनुपूर्वं वियूय ।
इहेहैषां कृणुहि भोजनानि ये बर्हिषो नमोवृक्तिं न जग्मुः ॥
verses.rom:
kuvidanga yavamanto yavam chidyatha dantyanupurvam viyuya |
ihehaisham krinuhi bhojanani ye barhisho namovriktim na jagmuh ||
verses.en:
What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn removing it in order,
So bring the food of those men, bring it hither, who went not to prepare the grass for worship.

verses.sa:
नहि स्थूर्यृतुथा यातमस्ति नोत श्रवो विविदे संगमेषु ।
गव्यन्त इन्द्रं सख्याय विप्रा अश्वायन्तो वृषणं वाजयन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
nahi sthuryritutha yatamasti nota shravo vivide samgameshu |
gavyanta indram sakhyaya vipra ashvayanto vrishanam vajayantah ||
verses.en:
Men come not with one horse at sacred seasons; thus they obtain no honour in assemblies.
Sages desiring herds of kine and horses strengthen the mighty Indra for his friendship.

verses.sa:
युवं सुराममश्विना नमुचावासुरे सचा ।
विपिपाना शुभस्पती इन्द्रं कर्मस्वावतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam suramamashvina namuchavasure sacha |
vipipana shubhaspati indram karmasvavatam ||
verses.en:
Ye, Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice,
And aided Indra in his work with Namuci of Asura birth.

verses.sa:
पुत्रमिव पितरावश्विनोभेन्द्रावथुः काव्यैर्दंसनाभिः ।
यत्सुरामं व्यपिबः शचीभिः सरस्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक् ॥
verses.rom:
putramiva pitaravashvinobhendravathuh kavyairdamsanabhih |
yatsuramam vyapibah shachibhih sarasvati tva maghavannabhishnak ||
verses.en:
As parents aid a son, both Asvins, Indra, aided thee with their wondrous Powers and wisdom.
When thou, with might. hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvati, O Maghavan, refreshed thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृळीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः ।
बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sutrama svavan avobhih sumriliko bhavatu vishvavedah |
badhatam dvesho abhayam krinotu suviryasya patayah syama ||
verses.en:
Indra is strong to save, rich in assistance may he, possessing all, be kind and gracious.
May he disperse our foes and give us safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.

verses.sa:
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ।
स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मे आराच्चिद्द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु ॥
verses.rom:
tasya vayam sumatau yajniyasyapi bhadre saumanase syama |
sa sutrama svavan indro asme arachchiddveshah sanutaryuyotu ||
verses.en:
May we enjoy his favour, his the Holy may we enjoy his blessed loving kindness.
May this rich Indra, as our good Protector, drive off and keep afar all those who hate us.

verses.sa:
ईजानमिद्द्यौर्गूर्तावसुरीजानं भूमिरभि प्रभूषणि ।
ईजानं देवावश्विनावभि सुम्नैरवर्धताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ijanamiddyaurgurtavasurijanam bhumirabhi prabhushani |
ijanam devavashvinavabhi sumnairavardhatam ||

verses.sa:
ता वां मित्रावरुणा धारयत्क्षिती सुषुम्नेषितत्वता यजामसि ।
युवोः क्राणाय सख्यैरभि ष्याम रक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam mitravaruna dharayatkshiti sushumneshitatvata yajamasi |
yuvoh kranaya sakhyairabhi shyama rakshasah ||

verses.sa:
अधा चिन्नु यद्दिधिषामहे वामभि प्रियं रेक्णः पत्यमानाः ।
दद्वाँ वा यत्पुष्यति रेक्णः सम्वारन्नकिरस्य मघानि ॥
verses.rom:
adha chinnu yaddidhishamahe vamabhi priyam reknah patyamanah |
dadvan va yatpushyati reknah samvarannakirasya maghani ||

verses.sa:
असावन्यो असुर सूयत द्यौस्त्वं विश्वेषां वरुणासि राजा ।
मूर्धा रथस्य चाकन्नैतावतैनसान्तकध्रुक् ॥
verses.rom:
asavanyo asura suyata dyaustvam vishvesham varunasi raja |
murdha rathasya chakannaitavatainasantakadhruk ||

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्स्वेतच्छकपूत एनो हिते मित्रे निगतान्हन्ति वीरान् ।
अवोर्वा यद्धात्तनूष्ववः प्रियासु यज्ञियास्वर्वा ॥
verses.rom:
asminsvetachchhakaputa eno hite mitre nigatanhanti viran |
avorva yaddhattanushvavah priyasu yajniyasvarva ||

verses.sa:
युवोर्हि मातादितिर्विचेतसा द्यौर्न भूमिः पयसा पुपूतनि ।
अव प्रिया दिदिष्टन सूरो निनिक्त रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvorhi mataditirvichetasa dyaurna bhumih payasa puputani |
ava priya didishtana suro ninikta rashmibhih ||

verses.sa:
युवं ह्यप्नराजावसीदतं तिष्ठद्रथं न धूर्षदं वनर्षदम् ।
ता नः कणूकयन्तीर्नृमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः सुमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam hyapnarajavasidatam tishthadratham na dhurshadam vanarshadam |
