ta nah kanukayantirnrimedhastatre amhasah sumedhastatre amhasah ||

prose.en:
1. MAY Dyaus the Lord of lauded wealth, and Earth stand by the man who offers sacrifice,
And may the Asvins, both the Gods, strengthen the worshipper with bliss.

2. As such we honour you, Mitra and Varuna, with hasty zeal, most blest, you who sustain the folk.
So may we, through your friendship for the worshipper, subdue the fiends.

3. And when we seek to win your love and friendship, we who have precious wealth in our possession,
Or when the worshipper augments his riches let not his treasures be shut up

4. That other, Asura! too was born of Heaven. thou art, O Varuna, the King of all men.
The chariot's Lord was well content, forbearing to anger Death by sin so great.
This sin hath Sakaputa here committed. Heroes who fled to their dear friend he slayeth,
When the Steed bringeth down your grace and favour in bodies dear and worshipful.

6. Your Mother Aditi, ye wise, was purified with water even as earth is purified from heaven.
Show love and kindness here below: wash her in rays of heavenly light.

7. Ye Twain have seated you as Lords of Wealth, as one who mounts a car to him who sits upon the pole, upon the wood.
These our disheartened tribes Nrmedhas saved from woe, Sumedhas saved from Woe.

verses.sa:
प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत ।
अभीके चिदु लोककृत्संगे समत्सु वृत्रहास्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
pro shvasmai purorathamindraya shushamarchata |
abhike chidu lokakritsamge samatsu vritrahasmakam bodhi chodita nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
SING strength to Indra that shall set his chariot in the foremost place.
Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encourager. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.

verses.sa:
त्वं सिन्धूँरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिम् ।
अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यं तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
tvam sindhunravasrijo'dharacho ahannahim |
ashatrurindra jajnishe vishvam pushyasi varyam tam tva pari shvajamahe nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to earth.
Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.

verses.sa:
वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः ।
अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघांसति या ते रातिर्ददिर्वसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
vi shu vishva aratayo'ryo nashanta no dhiyah |
astasi shatrave vadham yo na indra jighamsati ya te ratirdadirvasu nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
Destroyed be all malignities and all our enemy's designs.
Thy bolt thou castest, at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth.

verses.sa:
यो न इन्द्राभितो जनो वृकायुरादिदेशति ।
अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि विबाधो असि सासहिर्नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
yo na indrabhito jano vrikayuradideshati |
adhaspadam tamim kridhi vibadho asi sasahirnabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
The robber people round about, Indra, who watch and aim at us,-
Trample them down beneath thy foot; a conquering scatterer art thou.

verses.sa:
यो न इन्द्राभिदासति सनाभिर्यश्च निष्ट्यः ।
अव तस्य बलं तिर महीव द्यौरध त्मना नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
yo na indrabhidasati sanabhiryashcha nishtyah |
ava tasya balam tira mahiva dyauradha tmana nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
Whoso assails us, Indra, be the man a stranger or akin,
Bring down, thyself, his strength although it be as vast as are the heavens.

verses.sa:
वयमिन्द्र त्वायवः सखित्वमा रभामहे ।
ऋतस्य नः पथा नयाति विश्वानि दुरिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
vayamindra tvayavah sakhitvama rabhamahe |
ritasya nah patha nayati vishvani durita nabhantamanyakesham jyaka adhi dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
Close to thy friendship do we cling, O Indra, and depend, or, thee.
Lead us beyond all pain and grief along the path of holy Law.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं सु त्वमिन्द्र तां शिक्ष या दोहते प्रति वरं जरित्रे ।
अच्छिद्रोध्नी पीपयद्यथा नः सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam su tvamindra tam shiksha ya dohate prati varam jaritre |
achchhidrodhni pipayadyatha nah sahasradhara payasa mahi gauh ||
verses.en:
Do thou bestow upon us her, O Indra, who yields according to the singer's longing,
That the great Cow may, with exhaustless udder, pouring a thousand streams, give milk to feed us.

verses.sa:
उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव ।
महान्तं त्वा महीनां सम्राजं चर्षणीनां देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe yadindra rodasi apaprathosha iva |
mahantam tva mahinam samrajam charshaninam devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en:
As, like the Morning, thou hast filled, O Indra, both the earth and heaven.
So as the Mighty One, great King of all the mighty world of men, the Goddess Mother brought thee forth, the Blessed Mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
अव स्म दुर्हणायतो मर्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम् ।
अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ava sma durhanayato martasya tanuhi sthiram |
adhaspadam tamim kridhi yo asman adideshati devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en:
Relax that mortal's stubborn strength whose heart is bent on wickedness.
Trample him down beneath thy feet who watches for and aims at us. The Goddess Mother brought thee forth, the Blessed Mother gave thee life.

verses.sa:
अव त्या बृहतीरिषो विश्वश्चन्द्रा अमित्रहन् ।
शचीभिः शक्र धूनुहीन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ava tya brihatirisho vishvashchandra amitrahan |
shachibhih shakra dhunuhindra vishvabhirutibhirdevi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en:
Shake down, O Slayer of the foe, those great all splendid enemies.
With all thy powers, O Sakra, all thine helps, O Indra, shake them down:

verses.sa:
अव यत्त्वं शतक्रतविन्द्र विश्वानि धूनुषे ।
रयिं न सुन्वते सचा सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ava yattvam shatakratavindra vishvani dhunushe |
rayim na sunvate sacha sahasrinibhirutibhirdevi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en:
As thou, O Satakratu, thou, O Indrv, shakest all things down
As wealth for him who sheds the juice, with thine assistance thousandfold.

verses.sa:
अव स्वेदा इवाभितो विष्वक्पतन्तु दिद्यवः ।
दूर्वाया इव तन्तवो व्यस्मदेतु दुर्मतिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
ava sveda ivabhito vishvakpatantu didyavah |
durvaya iva tantavo vyasmadetu durmatirdevi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en:
Around, on every side like drops of sweat let lightning-flashes fall.
Let all malevolence pass away from us like threads of Darva grass.

verses.sa:
दीर्घं ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः ।
पूर्वेण मघवन्पदाजो वयां यथा यमो देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
dirgham hyankusham yatha shaktim bibharshi mantumah |
purvena maghavanpadajo vayam yatha yamo devi janitryajijanadbhadra janitryajijanat ||
verses.en:
Thou bearest in thine hand a lance like a long hook, great Counsellor!
As with his foremost foot a goat, draw down the branch, O Maghavan.

verses.sa:
नकिर्देवा मिनीमसि नकिरा योपयामसि मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि ।
पक्षेभिरपिकक्षेभिरत्राभि सं रभामहे ॥
verses.rom:
nakirdeva minimasi nakira yopayamasi mantrashrutyam charamasi |
pakshebhirapikakshebhiratrabhi sam rabhamahe ||
verses.en:
Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate: we walk as holy texts command.
Closely we clasp and cling to you, cling to your sides, beneath your arms.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्वृक्षे सुपलाशे देवैः सम्पिबते यमः ।
अत्रा नो विश्पतिः पिता पुराणाँ अनु वेनति ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvrikshe supalashe devaih sampibate yamah |
atra no vishpatih pita puranan anu venati ||
verses.en:
IN the Tree clothed with goodly leaves where Yama drinketh with the Gods,
The Father, Master of the house, tendeth with love our ancient Sires.

verses.sa:
पुराणाँ अनुवेनन्तं चरन्तं पापयामुया ।
असूयन्नभ्यचाकशं तस्मा अस्पृहयं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
puranan anuvenantam charantam papayamuya |
asuyannabhyachakasham tasma asprihayam punah ||
verses.en:
I looked reluctantly on him who cherishes those men of old,
On him who treads that evil path, and then I yearned for this again.

verses.sa:
यं कुमार नवं रथमचक्रं मनसाकृणोः ।
एकेषं विश्वतः प्राञ्चमपश्यन्नधि तिष्ठसि ॥
verses.rom:
yam kumara navam rathamachakram manasakrinoh |
ekesham vishvatah pranchamapashyannadhi tishthasi ||
verses.en:
Thou mountest, though thou dost not see, O Child, the new and wheel-less car
Which thou hast fashioned mentally, one poled but turning every way.

verses.sa:
यं कुमार प्रावर्तयो रथं विप्रेभ्यस्परि ।
तं सामानु प्रावर्तत समितो नाव्याहितम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam kumara pravartayo ratham viprebhyaspari |
tam samanu pravartata samito navyahitam ||
verses.en:
The car which thou hast made to roll hitherward from the Sages, Child!
This hath the Saman followed close, hence, laid together on a ship.

verses.sa:
कः कुमारमजनयद्रथं को निरवर्तयत् ।
कः स्वित्तदद्य नो ब्रूयादनुदेयी यथाभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
kah kumaramajanayadratham ko niravartayat |
kah svittadadya no bruyadanudeyi yathabhavat ||
verses.en:
Who was the father of the child? Who made the chariot roll away?
Who will this day declare to us how the funeral gift was made?

verses.sa:
यथाभवदनुदेयी ततो अग्रमजायत ।
पुरस्ताद्बुध्न आततः पश्चान्निरयणं कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathabhavadanudeyi tato agramajayata |
purastadbudhna atatah pashchannirayanam kritam ||
verses.en:
When the funeral gift was placed, straightway the point of flame appeared.
A depth extended in the front: a passage out was made behind.

verses.sa:
इदं यमस्य सादनं देवमानं यदुच्यते ।
इयमस्य धम्यते नाळीरयं गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
idam yamasya sadanam devamanam yaduchyate |
iyamasya dhamyate nalirayam girbhih parishkritah ||
verses.en:
Here is the seat where Yama dwells, that which is called the Home of Gods:
Here minstrels blow the flute for him here he is glorified with songs.

verses.sa:
केश्यग्निं केशी विषं केशी बिभर्ति रोदसी ।
केशी विश्वं स्वर्दृशे केशीदं ज्योतिरुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
keshyagnim keshi visham keshi bibharti rodasi |
keshi vishvam svardrishe keshidam jyotiruchyate ||
verses.en:
HE with the long loose locks supports Agni, and moisture, heaven, and earth:
He is all sky to look upon: he with long hair is called this light.

verses.sa:
मुनयो वातरशनाः पिशङ्गा वसते मला ।
वातस्यानु ध्राजिं यन्ति यद्देवासो अविक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
munayo vatarashanah pishanga vasate mala |
vatasyanu dhrajim yanti yaddevaso avikshata ||
verses.en:
The Munis, girdled with the wind, wear garments soiled of yellow hue.
They, following the wind's swift course go where the Gods have gone before.

verses.sa:
उन्मदिता मौनेयेन वाताँ आ तस्थिमा वयम् ।
शरीरेदस्माकं यूयं मर्तासो अभि पश्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
unmadita mauneyena vatan a tasthima vayam |
shariredasmakam yuyam martaso abhi pashyatha ||
verses.en:
Transported with our Munihood we have pressed on into the winds:
You therefore, mortal men. behold our natural bodies and no more.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेण पतति विश्वा रूपावचाकशत् ।
मुनिर्देवस्यदेवस्य सौकृत्याय सखा हितः ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshena patati vishva rupavachakashat |
munirdevasyadevasya saukrityaya sakha hitah ||
verses.en:
The Muni, made associate in the holy work of every God,
Looking upon all varied forms flies through the region of the air.

verses.sa:
वातस्याश्वो वायोः सखाथो देवेषितो मुनिः ।
उभौ समुद्रावा क्षेति यश्च पूर्व उतापरः ॥
verses.rom:
vatasyashvo vayoh sakhatho deveshito munih |
ubhau samudrava ksheti yashcha purva utaparah ||
verses.en:
The Steed of Vata, Vayu's friend, the Muni, by the Gods impelled,
In both the oceans hath his home, in eastern and in western sea.

verses.sa:
अप्सरसां गन्धर्वाणां मृगाणां चरणे चरन् ।
केशी केतस्य विद्वान्सखा स्वादुर्मदिन्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
apsarasam gandharvanam mriganam charane charan |
keshi ketasya vidvansakha svadurmadintamah ||
verses.en:
Treading the path of sylvan beasts, Gandharvas, and Apsarases,
He with long locks, who knows the wish, is a sweet most delightful friend

verses.sa:
वायुरस्मा उपामन्थत्पिनष्टि स्मा कुनन्नमा ।
केशी विषस्य पात्रेण यद्रुद्रेणापिबत्सह ॥
verses.rom:
vayurasma upamanthatpinashti sma kunannama |
keshi vishasya patrena yadrudrenapibatsaha ||
verses.en:
Vayu hath churned for him: for him he poundeth things most hard to bend,
When he with long loose locks hath drunk, with Rudra, water from the cup.

verses.sa:
उत देवा अवहितं देवा उन्नयथा पुनः ।
उतागश्चक्रुषं देवा देवा जीवयथा पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
uta deva avahitam deva unnayatha punah |
utagashchakrusham deva deva jivayatha punah ||
verses.en:
YE Gods, raise up once more the man whom ye have humbled and brought low.
O Gods, restore to life again the man who hath committed sin.

verses.sa:
द्वाविमौ वातौ वात आ सिन्धोरा परावतः ।
दक्षं ते अन्य आ वातु परान्यो वातु यद्रपः ॥
verses.rom:
dvavimau vatau vata a sindhora paravatah |
daksham te anya a vatu paranyo vatu yadrapah ||
verses.en:
Two several winds are blowing here, from Sindhu, from a distant land.
May one breathe energy to thee, the other blow disease away.

verses.sa:
आ वात वाहि भेषजं वि वात वाहि यद्रपः ।
त्वं हि विश्वभेषजो देवानां दूत ईयसे ॥
verses.rom:
a vata vahi bheshajam vi vata vahi yadrapah |
tvam hi vishvabheshajo devanam duta iyase ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Wind, blow healing balm, blow all disease away, thou Wind;
For thou who hast all medicine comest as envoy of the Gods.

verses.sa:
आ त्वागमं शंतातिभिरथो अरिष्टतातिभिः ।
दक्षं ते भद्रमाभार्षं परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
a tvagamam shamtatibhiratho arishtatatibhih |
daksham te bhadramabharsham para yakshmam suvami te ||
verses.en:
I am come nigh to thee with balms to give thee rest and keep thee safe.
I bring thee blessed strength, I drive thy weakening malady away.

verses.sa:
त्रायन्तामिह देवास्त्रायतां मरुतां गणः ।
त्रायन्तां विश्वा भूतानि यथायमरपा असत् ॥
verses.rom:
trayantamiha devastrayatam marutam ganah |
trayantam vishva bhutani yathayamarapa asat ||
verses.en:
Here let the Gods deliver him, the Maruts' band deliver him:
All things that be deliver him that he be freed from his disease.

verses.sa:
आप इद्वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः ।
आपः सर्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्ते कृण्वन्तु भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
apa idva u bheshajirapo amivachatanih |
apah sarvasya bheshajistaste krinvantu bheshajam ||
verses.en:
The Waters have their healing power, the Waters drive disease away.
The Waters have a balm for all: let them make medicine for thee.

verses.sa:
हस्ताभ्यां दशशाखाभ्यां जिह्वा वाचः पुरोगवी ।
अनामयित्नुभ्यां त्वा ताभ्यां त्वोप स्पृशामसि ॥
verses.rom:
hastabhyam dashashakhabhyam jihva vachah purogavi |
anamayitnubhyam tva tabhyam tvopa sprishamasi ||
verses.en:
The tongue that leads the voice precedes. Then with our ten-fold branching hands,
With these two chasers of disease we stroke thee with a gentle touch.

verses.sa:
तव त्य इन्द्र सख्येषु वह्नय ऋतं मन्वाना व्यदर्दिरुर्वलम् ।
यत्रा दशस्यन्नुषसो रिणन्नपः कुत्साय मन्मन्नह्यश्च दंसयः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tya indra sakhyeshu vahnaya ritam manvana vyadardirurvalam |
yatra dashasyannushaso rinannapah kutsaya manmannahyashcha damsayah ||
verses.en:
ALLIED with thee in friendship, Indra, these, thy priests, remembering Holy Law, rent Vrtra limb from limb,
When they bestowed the Dawns and let the waters flow, and when thou didst chastise dragons at Kutsa's call.

verses.sa:
अवासृजः प्रस्वः श्वञ्चयो गिरीनुदाज उस्रा अपिबो मधु प्रियम् ।
अवर्धयो वनिनो अस्य दंससा शुशोच सूर्य ऋतजातया गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
avasrijah prasvah shvanchayo girinudaja usra apibo madhu priyam |
avardhayo vanino asya damsasa shushocha surya ritajataya gira ||
verses.en:
Thou sentest forth productive powers, clavest the hills, thou dravest forth the kine, thou drankest pleasant meath.
Thou gavest increase through this Tree's surpassing might. The Sun shone by the hymn that sprang from Holy Law.

verses.sa:
वि सूर्यो मध्ये अमुचद्रथं दिवो विदद्दासाय प्रतिमानमार्यः ।
दृळ्हानि पिप्रोरसुरस्य मायिन इन्द्रो व्यास्यच्चकृवाँ ऋजिश्वना ॥
verses.rom:
vi suryo madhye amuchadratham divo vidaddasaya pratimanamaryah |
drilhani piprorasurasya mayina indro vyasyachchakrivan rijishvana ||
verses.en:
In the mid-way of heaven the Sun unyoked his car: the Arya found a match to meet his Dam foe.
Associate with Rjisvan Indra overthrew the solid forts of Pipru, conjuring Asura.

verses.sa:
अनाधृष्टानि धृषितो व्यास्यन्निधीँरदेवाँ अमृणदयास्यः ।
मासेव सूर्यो वसु पुर्यमा ददे गृणानः शत्रूँरशृणाद्विरुक्मता ॥
verses.rom:
anadhrishtani dhrishito vyasyannidhinradevan amrinadayasyah |
maseva suryo vasu puryama dade grinanah shatrunrashrinadvirukmata ||
verses.en:
He boldly cast down forts which none had e'er assailed: unwearied he destroyed the godless treasure-stores.
Like Sun and Moon he took the stronghold's wealth away, and, praised in song, demolished foes with flashing dart.

verses.sa:
अयुद्धसेनो विभ्वा विभिन्दता दाशद्वृत्रहा तुज्यानि तेजते ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रादबिभेदभिश्नथः प्राक्रामच्छुन्ध्यूरजहादुषा अनः ॥
verses.rom:
ayuddhaseno vibhva vibhindata dashadvritraha tujyani tejate |
indrasya vajradabibhedabhishnathah prakramachchhundhyurajahadusha anah ||
verses.en:
Armed with resistless weapons, with vast power to cleave, the Vrtra-slayer whets his darts and deals fordi wounds.
Bright Usas was afraid of Indra's slaughtering bolt: she went upon her way and left her chariot there.

verses.sa:
एता त्या ते श्रुत्यानि केवला यदेक एकमकृणोरयज्ञम् ।
मासां विधानमदधा अधि द्यवि त्वया विभिन्नं भरति प्रधिं पिता ॥
verses.rom:
eta tya te shrutyani kevala yadeka ekamakrinorayajnam |
masam vidhanamadadha adhi dyavi tvaya vibhinnam bharati pradhim pita ||
verses.en:
These are thy famous exploits, only thine, when thou alone hast left the other bereft of sacrifice.
Thou in the heavens hast set the ordering of the Moons: the Father bears the felly portioned out by thee.

verses.sa:
सूर्यरश्मिर्हरिकेशः पुरस्तात्सविता ज्योतिरुदयाँ अजस्रम् ।
तस्य पूषा प्रसवे याति विद्वान्सम्पश्यन्विश्वा भुवनानि गोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
suryarashmirharikeshah purastatsavita jyotirudayan ajasram |
tasya pusha prasave yati vidvansampashyanvishva bhuvanani gopah ||
verses.en:
SAVITAR, golden-haired, hath lifted eastward, bright With the sunbeams, his eternal lustre;
He in whose energy wise Pusan marches, surveying all existence like a herdsman.

verses.sa:
नृचक्षा एष दिवो मध्य आस्त आपप्रिवान्रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
स विश्वाचीरभि चष्टे घृताचीरन्तरा पूर्वमपरं च केतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
nrichaksha esha divo madhya asta apaprivanrodasi antariksham |
sa vishvachirabhi chashte ghritachirantara purvamaparam cha ketum ||
verses.en:
Beholding men he sits amid the heaven filling the two world-halves and air's wide region.
He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the eastern and the western limit.

verses.sa:
रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां विश्वा रूपाभि चष्टे शचीभिः ।
देव इव सविता सत्यधर्मेन्द्रो न तस्थौ समरे धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
rayo budhnah samgamano vasunam vishva rupabhi chashte shachibhih |
deva iva savita satyadharmendro na tasthau samare dhananam ||
verses.en:
He, root of wealth, the gatherer-up of treasures, looks with his might on every form and figure.
Savitar, like a God whose Law is constant, stands in the battle for the spoil like Indra.

verses.sa:
विश्वावसुं सोम गन्धर्वमापो ददृशुषीस्तदृतेना व्यायन् ।
तदन्ववैदिन्द्रो रारहाण आसां परि सूर्यस्य परिधीँरपश्यत् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvavasum soma gandharvamapo dadrishushistadritena vyayan |
tadanvavaidindro rarahana asam pari suryasya paridhinrapashyat ||
verses.en:
Waters from sacrifice came to the Gandharva Visvavasu, O Soma, when they saw him.
Indra, approaching quickly, marked their going, and looked around upon the Sun's enclosures.

verses.sa:
विश्वावसुरभि तन्नो गृणातु दिव्यो गन्धर्वो रजसो विमानः ।
यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म धियो हिन्वानो धिय इन्नो अव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvavasurabhi tanno grinatu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimanah |
yadva gha satyamuta yanna vidma dhiyo hinvano dhiya inno avyah ||
verses.en:
This song Visvavasu shall sing us, meter of air's mid-realm celestial Gandharva,
That we may know aright both truth and falsehood: may he inspire our thoughts and help our praises.

verses.sa:
सस्निमविन्दच्चरणे नदीनामपावृणोद्दुरो अश्मव्रजानाम् ।
प्रासां गन्धर्वो अमृतानि वोचदिन्द्रो दक्षं परि जानादहीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sasnimavindachcharane nadinamapavrinodduro ashmavrajanam |
prasam gandharvo amritani vochadindro daksham pari janadahinam ||
verses.en:
In the floods' track he found the booty seeker: the rocky cow-pen's doors he threw wide open.
These, the Gandharva told him, Rowed with Amrta. Indra knew well the puissance of the dragons.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो ।
बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे ॥
verses.rom:
agne tava shravo vayo mahi bhrajante archayo vibhavaso |
brihadbhano shavasa vajamukthyam dadhasi dashushe kave ||
verses.en:
AGNI, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams!
Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.

verses.sa:
पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना ।
पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.rom:
pavakavarchah shukravarcha anunavarcha udiyarshi bhanuna |
putro matara vicharannupavasi prinakshi rodasi ubhe ||
verses.en:
With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light.
Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः ।
त्वे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napajjatavedah sushastibhirmandasva dhitibhirhitah |
tve ishah sam dadhurbhurivarpasashchitrotayo vamajatah ||
verses.en:
O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs.
In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.

verses.sa:
इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य ।
स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं क्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rayo amartya |
sa darshatasya vapusho vi rajasi prinakshi sanasim kratum ||
verses.en:
Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God.
Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.

verses.sa:
इष्कर्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तं राधसो महः ।
रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिं रयिम् ॥
verses.rom:
ishkartaramadhvarasya prachetasam kshayantam radhaso mahah |
ratim vamasya subhagam mahimisham dadhasi sanasim rayim ||
verses.en:
To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches un der his control,
Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः ।
श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanam mahisham vishvadarshatamagnim sumnaya dadhire puro janah |
shrutkarnam saprathastamam tva gira daivyam manusha yuga ||
verses.en:
The men have set before them them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy.
Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.

verses.sa:
अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रत्यङ्नः सुमना भव ।
प्र नो यच्छ विशस्पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne achchha vadeha nah pratyannah sumana bhava |
pra no yachchha vishaspate dhanada asi nastvam ||
verses.en:
TURN hither, Agni, speak to us: come to us with a gracious mind.
Enrich us, Master of the house: thou art the Giver of our wealth.

verses.sa:
प्र नो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र भगः प्र बृहस्पतिः ।
प्र देवाः प्रोत सूनृता रायो देवी ददातु नः ॥
verses.rom:
pra no yachchhatvaryama pra bhagah pra brihaspatih |
pra devah prota sunrita rayo devi dadatu nah ||
verses.en:
Let Aryaman vouchsafe us wealth, and Bhaga, and Brhaspati.
Let the Gods give their gifts, and let Sunrta, Goddess, grant us wealth.

verses.sa:
सोमं राजानमवसेऽग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ।
आदित्यान्विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
somam rajanamavase'gnim girbhirhavamahe |
adityanvishnum suryam brahmanam cha brihaspatim ||
verses.en:
We call King Soma to our aid, and Agni with our songs and hymns,
Adityas, Visnu, Surya, and the Brahman Priest Brhaspati.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं सुहवेह हवामहे ।
यथा नः सर्व इज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असत् ॥
verses.rom:
indravayu brihaspatim suhaveha havamahe |
yatha nah sarva ijjanah samgatyam sumana asat ||
verses.en:
Indra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Gods swift to listen, we invoke,
That in the synod all the folk may be benevolent to us.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं बृहस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय ।
वातं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
aryamanam brihaspatimindram danaya chodaya |
vatam vishnum sarasvatim savitaram cha vajinam ||
verses.en:
Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra, and Brhaspati,
Vata, Visnu, Sarasvati and the Strong Courser Savitar.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय ।
त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne agnibhirbrahma yajnam cha vardhaya |
tvam no devatataye rayo danaya chodaya ||
verses.en:
Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifice:
Urge givers to bestow their wealth to aid our service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
अयमग्ने जरिता त्वे अभूदपि सहसः सूनो नह्यन्यदस्त्याप्यम् ।
भद्रं हि शर्म त्रिवरूथमस्ति त आरे हिंसानामप दिद्युमा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagne jarita tve abhudapi sahasah suno nahyanyadastyapyam |
bhadram hi sharma trivaruthamasti ta are himsanamapa didyuma kridhi ||
verses.en:
WITH thee, O Agni, was this singer of the laud: he hath no other kinship, O thou Son of Strength.
Thou givest blessed shelter with a triple guard. Keep the destructive lightning far away from us.

verses.sa:
प्रवत्ते अग्ने जनिमा पितूयतः साचीव विश्वा भुवना न्यृञ्जसे ।
प्र सप्तयः प्र सनिषन्त नो धियः पुरश्चरन्ति पशुपा इव त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
pravatte agne janima pituyatah sachiva vishva bhuvana nyrinjase |
pra saptayah pra sanishanta no dhiyah purashcharanti pashupa iva tmana ||
verses.en:
Thy birth who seekest food is in the falling flood, Agni: as Comrade thou winnest all living things.
Our coursers and our songs shall be victorious: they of themselves advance like one who guards the herd.

verses.sa:
उत वा उ परि वृणक्षि बप्सद्बहोरग्न उलपस्य स्वधावः ।
उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति मा ते हेतिं तविषीं चुक्रुधाम ॥
verses.rom:
uta va u pari vrinakshi bapsadbahoragna ulapasya svadhavah |
uta khilya urvaranam bhavanti ma te hetim tavishim chukrudhama ||
verses.en:
And thou, O Agni, thou of Godlike nature, sparest the stones, while caring up the brushwood.
Then are thy tracks like deserts in the corn-lands. Let us not stir to wrath thy mighty arrow.

verses.sa:
यदुद्वतो निवतो यासि बप्सत्पृथगेषि प्रगर्धिनीव सेना ।
यदा ते वातो अनुवाति शोचिर्वप्तेव श्मश्रु वपसि प्र भूम ॥
verses.rom:
yadudvato nivato yasi bapsatprithageshi pragardhiniva sena |
yada te vato anuvati shochirvapteva shmashru vapasi pra bhuma ||
verses.en:
O'er hills through vales devouring as thou goest, thou partest like an army fain for booty
As when a barber shaves a beard, thou shavest earth when the wind blows on thy flame and fans it.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यस्य श्रेणयो ददृश्र एकं नियानं बहवो रथासः ।
बाहू यदग्ने अनुमर्मृजानो न्यङ्ङुत्तानामन्वेषि भूमिम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratyasya shrenayo dadrishra ekam niyanam bahavo rathasah |
bahu yadagne anumarmrijano nyannuttanamanveshi bhumim ||
verses.en:
Apparent are his lines as he approaches the course is single, but the cars are many,
When, Agni, thou, making thine arms resplendent, advancest o'er the land spread out beneath thee.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शुष्मा जिहतामुत्ते अर्चिरुत्ते अग्ने शशमानस्य वाजाः ।
उच्छ्वञ्चस्व नि नम वर्धमान आ त्वाद्य विश्वे वसवः सदन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
utte shushma jihatamutte archirutte agne shashamanasya vajah |
uchchhvanchasva ni nama vardhamana a tvadya vishve vasavah sadantu ||
verses.en:
Now let thy strength, thy burning flames fly upward, thine energies, O Agni, as thou toilest.
Gape widely, bend thee, waxing in thy vigour: let all the Vasus sit this day beside thee.

verses.sa:
अपामिदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम् ।
अन्यं कृणुष्वेतः पन्थां तेन याहि वशाँ अनु ॥
verses.rom:
apamidam nyayanam samudrasya niveshanam |
anyam krinushvetah pantham tena yahi vashan anu ||
verses.en:
This is the waters' reservoir, the great abode of gathered streams.
Take thou another path than this, and as thou listest walk thereon.

verses.sa:
आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहन्तु पुष्पिणीः ।
ह्रदाश्च पुण्डरीकाणि समुद्रस्य गृहा इमे ॥
verses.rom:
ayane te parayane durva rohantu pushpinih |
hradashcha pundarikani samudrasya griha ime ||
verses.en:
On thy way hitherward and hence let flowery Durva grass spring up
Let there be lakes with lotus blooms. These are the mansions of the flood.

verses.sa:
त्यं चिदत्रिमृतजुरमर्थमश्वं न यातवे ।
कक्षीवन्तं यदी पुना रथं न कृणुथो नवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tyam chidatrimritajuramarthamashvam na yatave |
kakshivantam yadi puna ratham na krinutho navam ||
verses.en:
YE made that Atri, worn with eld, free as a horse to win the goal.
When ye restored to youth and strength Kaksivan like a car renewed,

verses.sa:
त्यं चिदश्वं न वाजिनमरेणवो यमत्नत ।
दृळ्हं ग्रन्थिं न वि ष्यतमत्रिं यविष्ठमा रजः ॥
verses.rom:
tyam chidashvam na vajinamarenavo yamatnata |
drilham granthim na vi shyatamatrim yavishthama rajah ||
verses.en:
Ye freed that Atri like a horse, and brought him newly-born to earth.
Ye loosed him like a firm-tied knot which Gods unsoiled by dust had bound.

verses.sa:
नरा दंसिष्ठवत्रये शुभ्रा सिषासतं धियः ।
अथा हि वां दिवो नरा पुन स्तोमो न विशसे ॥
verses.rom:
nara damsishthavatraye shubhra sishasatam dhiyah |
atha hi vam divo nara puna stomo na vishase ||
verses.en:
Heroes who showed most wondrous power to Atri, strive to win fair songs;
For then, O Heroes of the sky, your hymn of praise shall cease no more.

verses.sa:
चिते तद्वां सुराधसा रातिः सुमतिरश्विना ।
आ यन्नः सदने पृथौ समने पर्षथो नरा ॥
verses.rom:
chite tadvam suradhasa ratih sumatirashvina |
a yannah sadane prithau samane parshatho nara ||
verses.en:
This claims your notice, Bounteous Gods! - oblation, Asvins! and our love,
That ye, O Heroes, in the fight may bring us safe to ample room.

verses.sa:
युवं भुज्युं समुद्र आ रजसः पार ईङ्खितम् ।
यातमच्छा पतत्रिभिर्नासत्या सातये कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam bhujyum samudra a rajasah para inkhitam |
yatamachchha patatribhirnasatya sataye kritam ||
verses.en:
Ye Twain to Bhujyu tossed about in ocean at the region's end,
Nasatyas, with your winged steeds came nigh, and gave him strength to win.

verses.sa:
आ वां सुम्नैः शंयू इव मंहिष्ठा विश्ववेदसा ।
समस्मे भूषतं नरोत्सं न पिप्युषीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
a vam sumnaih shamyu iva mamhishtha vishvavedasa |
samasme bhushatam narotsam na pipyushirishah ||
verses.en:
Come with your joys, most liberal Gods, Lords of all treasures, bringing weal.
Like fresh full waters to a well, so, Heroes come and be with us.

verses.sa:
अयं हि ते अमर्त्य इन्दुरत्यो न पत्यते ।
दक्षो विश्वायुर्वेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam hi te amartya induratyo na patyate |
daksho vishvayurvedhase ||
verses.en:
THIS deathless Indu, like a steed, strong and of full vitality,
Belongs to thee, the Orderer.

verses.sa:
अयमस्मासु काव्य ऋभुर्वज्रो दास्वते ।
अयं बिभर्त्यूर्ध्वकृशनं मदमृभुर्न कृत्व्यं मदम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayamasmasu kavya ribhurvajro dasvate |
ayam bibhartyurdhvakrishanam madamribhurna kritvyam madam ||
verses.en:
Here, by us, for the worshipper, is the wise bolt that works with skill.
It brings the bubbling beverage as a dexterous man brings the effectual strong drink.

verses.sa:
घृषुः श्येनाय कृत्वन आसु स्वासु वंसगः ।
अव दीधेदहीशुवः ॥
verses.rom:
ghrishuh shyenaya kritvana asu svasu vamsagah |
ava didhedahishuvah ||
verses.en:
Impetuous Ahisuva, a bull among cows of his,
looked down upon the restless Hawk.

verses.sa:
यं सुपर्णः परावतः श्येनस्य पुत्र आभरत् ।
शतचक्रं योऽह्यो वर्तनिः ॥
verses.rom:
yam suparnah paravatah shyenasya putra abharat |
shatachakram yo'hyo vartanih ||
verses.en:
That the strong-pinioned Bird hath brought, Child of the Falcon, from afar,
What moves upon a hundred wheels along the female Dragon's path.

verses.sa:
यं ते श्येनश्चारुमवृकं पदाभरदरुणं मानमन्धसः ।
एना वयो वि तार्यायुर्जीवस एना जागार बन्धुता ॥
verses.rom:
yam te shyenashcharumavrikam padabharadarunam manamandhasah |
ena vayo vi taryayurjivasa ena jagara bandhuta ||
verses.en:
Which, fair, unrobbed, the Falcon brought thee in his foot, the red-hued dwelling of the juice;
Through this came vital power which lengthens out our days, and kinship through its help awoke.

verses.sa:
एवा तदिन्द्र इन्दुना देवेषु चिद्धारयाते महि त्यजः ।
क्रत्वा वयो वि तार्यायुः सुक्रतो क्रत्वायमस्मदा सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
eva tadindra induna deveshu chiddharayate mahi tyajah |
kratva vayo vi taryayuh sukrato kratvayamasmada sutah ||
verses.en:
So Indra is by lndu's power; e'en among Gods will it repel great treachery.
Wisdom, Most Sapient One, brings force that lengthens life. May wisdom bring the juice to us.

verses.sa:
इमां खनाम्योषधिं वीरुधं बलवत्तमाम् ।
यया सपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam khanamyoshadhim virudham balavattamam |
yaya sapatnim badhate yaya samvindate patim ||
verses.en:
FROM out the earth I dig this plant, a herb of most effectual power,
Wherewith one quells the rival wife and gains the husband for oneself.

verses.sa:
उत्तानपर्णे सुभगे देवजूते सहस्वति ।
सपत्नीं मे परा धम पतिं मे केवलं कुरु ॥
verses.rom:
uttanaparne subhage devajute sahasvati |
sapatnim me para dhama patim me kevalam kuru ||
verses.en:
Auspicious, with expanded leaves, sent by the Gods, victorious plant,
Blow thou the rival wife away, and make my husband only mine.

verses.sa:
उत्तराहमुत्तर उत्तरेदुत्तराभ्यः ।
अथा सपत्नी या ममाधरा साधराभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
uttarahamuttara uttareduttarabhyah |
atha sapatni ya mamadhara sadharabhyah ||
verses.en:
Stronger am 1, O Stronger One, yea, mightier than the mightier;
And she who is my rival wife is lower than the lowest dames.

verses.sa:
नह्यस्या नाम गृभ्णामि नो अस्मिन्रमते जने ।
परामेव परावतं सपत्नीं गमयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
nahyasya nama gribhnami no asminramate jane |
parameva paravatam sapatnim gamayamasi ||
verses.en:
Her very name I utter not: she takes no pleasure in this man.
Far into distance most remote drive we the rival wife away.

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि सहमानाथ त्वमसि सासहिः ।
उभे सहस्वती भूत्वी सपत्नीं मे सहावहै ॥
verses.rom:
ahamasmi sahamanatha tvamasi sasahih |
ubhe sahasvati bhutvi sapatnim me sahavahai ||
verses.en:
I am the conqueror, and thou, thou also act victorious:
As victory attends us both we will subdue my fellow-wife.

verses.sa:
उप तेऽधां सहमानामभि त्वाधां सहीयसा ।
मामनु प्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु ॥
verses.rom:
upa te'dham sahamanamabhi tvadham sahiyasa |
mamanu pra te mano vatsam gauriva dhavatu patha variva dhavatu ||
verses.en:
I have gained thee for vanquisher, have grasped thee with a stronger spell.
As a cow hastens to her calf, so let thy spirit speed to me, hasten like water on its way.

verses.sa:
अरण्यान्यरण्यान्यसौ या प्रेव नश्यसि ।
कथा ग्रामं न पृच्छसि न त्वा भीरिव विन्दती३ँ ॥
verses.rom:
aranyanyaranyanyasau ya preva nashyasi |
katha gramam na prichchhasi na tva bhiriva vindati3n ||
verses.en:
GODDESS of wild and forest who seemest to vanish from the sight.
How is it that thou seekest not the village? Art thou not afraid?

verses.sa:
वृषारवाय वदते यदुपावति चिच्चिकः ।
आघाटिभिरिव धावयन्नरण्यानिर्महीयते ॥
verses.rom:
vrisharavaya vadate yadupavati chichchikah |
aghatibhiriva dhavayannaranyanirmahiyate ||
verses.en:
What time the grasshopper replies and swells the shrill cicada's voice,
Seeming to sound with tinkling bells, the Lady of the Wood exults.

verses.sa:
उत गाव इवादन्त्युत वेश्मेव दृश्यते ।
उतो अरण्यानिः सायं शकटीरिव सर्जति ॥
verses.rom:
uta gava ivadantyuta veshmeva drishyate |
uto aranyanih sayam shakatiriva sarjati ||
verses.en:
And, yonder, cattle seem to graze, what seems a dwelling-place appears:
Or else at eve the Lady of the Forest seems to free the wains.

verses.sa:
गामङ्गैष आ ह्वयति दार्वङ्गैषो अपावधीत् ।
वसन्नरण्यान्यां सायमक्रुक्षदिति मन्यते ॥
verses.rom:
gamangaisha a hvayati darvangaisho apavadhit |
vasannaranyanyam sayamakrukshaditi manyate ||
verses.en:
Here one is calling to his cow, another there hath felled a tree:
At eve the dweller in the wood fancies that somebody hath screamed.

verses.sa:
न वा अरण्यानिर्हन्त्यन्यश्चेन्नाभिगच्छति ।
स्वादोः फलस्य जग्ध्वाय यथाकामं नि पद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
na va aranyanirhantyanyashchennabhigachchhati |
svadoh phalasya jagdhvaya yathakamam ni padyate ||
verses.en:
The Goddess never slays, unless some murderous enemy approach.
Man eats of savoury fruit and then takes, even as he wills, his rest.

verses.sa:
आञ्जनगन्धिं सुरभिं बह्वन्नामकृषीवलाम् ।
प्राहं मृगाणां मातरमरण्यानिमशंसिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
anjanagandhim surabhim bahvannamakrishivalam |
praham mriganam mataramaranyanimashamsisham ||
verses.en:
Now have I praised the Forest Queen, sweet-scented, redolent of balm,
The Mother of all sylvan things, who tills not but hath stores of food.

verses.sa:
श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्वृत्रं नर्यं विवेरपः ।
उभे यत्त्वा भवतो रोदसी अनु रेजते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
shratte dadhami prathamaya manyave'hanyadvritram naryam viverapah |
ubhe yattva bhavato rodasi anu rejate shushmatprithivi chidadrivah ||
verses.en:
I TRUST in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vrtra and didst work to profit man;
What time the two world-halves fell short of thee in might, and the earth trembled at thy force, O Thunder-anned.

verses.sa:
त्वं मायाभिरनवद्य मायिनं श्रवस्यता मनसा वृत्रमर्दयः ।
त्वामिन्नरो वृणते गविष्टिषु त्वां विश्वासु हव्यास्विष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mayabhiranavadya mayinam shravasyata manasa vritramardayah |
tvaminnaro vrinate gavishtishu tvam vishvasu havyasvishtishu ||
verses.en:
Thou with thy magic powers didst rend the conjurer Vrtra, O Blameless One, with heart that longed for fame.
Heroes elect thee when they battle for the prey, thee in all sacrifices worthy of renown.

verses.sa:
ऐषु चाकन्धि पुरुहूत सूरिषु वृधासो ये मघवन्नानशुर्मघम् ।
अर्चन्ति तोके तनये परिष्टिषु मेधसाता वाजिनमह्रये धने ॥
verses.rom:
aishu chakandhi puruhuta surishu vridhaso ye maghavannanashurmagham |
archanti toke tanaye parishtishu medhasata vajinamahraye dhane ||
verses.en:
God Much-invoked, take pleasure in these princes here, who, thine exalters, Maghavan, have come to wealth.
In synods, when the rite succeeds, they hymn the Strong for sons and progeny and riches undisturbed.

verses.sa:
स इन्नु रायः सुभृतस्य चाकनन्मदं यो अस्य रंह्यं चिकेतति ।
त्वावृधो मघवन्दाश्वध्वरो मक्षू स वाजं भरते धना नृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa innu rayah subhritasya chakananmadam yo asya ramhyam chiketati |
tvavridho maghavandashvadhvaro makshu sa vajam bharate dhana nribhih ||
verses.en:
That man shall find delight in well-protected wealth whose care provides for him the quick-sought joyous draught.
Bringing oblations, strengthened Maghavan, by thee, he swiftly wins the spoil with heroes in the fight.

verses.sa:
त्वं शर्धाय महिना गृणान उरु कृधि मघवञ्छग्धि रायः ।
त्वं नो मित्रो वरुणो न मायी पित्वो न दस्म दयसे विभक्ता ॥
verses.rom:
tvam shardhaya mahina grinana uru kridhi maghavanchhagdhi rayah |
tvam no mitro varuno na mayi pitvo na dasma dayase vibhakta ||
verses.en:
Now for our band, O Maghavan, when lauded, make ample room with might, and grant us riches.
Magician thou, our Varuna and Mitra, deal food to us, O Wondrous, as Dispenser.

verses.sa:
सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा ससवांसश्च तुविनृम्ण वाजम् ।
आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य चाकन्त्मना तना सनुयाम त्वोताः ॥
verses.rom:
sushvanasa indra stumasi tva sasavamsashcha tuvinrimna vajam |
a no bhara suvitam yasya chakantmana tana sanuyama tvotah ||
verses.en:
WHEN we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty.
Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer.

verses.sa:
ऋष्वस्त्वमिन्द्र शूर जातो दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः ।
गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्सु बिभृमसि प्रस्रवणे न सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
rishvastvamindra shura jato dasirvishah suryena sahyah |
guha hitam guhyam gulhamapsu bibhrimasi prasravane na somam ||
verses.en:
Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Surya overcome the Dasa races.
As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters.

verses.sa:
अर्यो वा गिरो अभ्यर्च विद्वानृषीणां विप्रः सुमतिं चकानः ।
ते स्याम ये रणयन्त सोमैरेनोत तुभ्यं रथोळ्ह भक्षैः ॥
verses.rom:
aryo va giro abhyarcha vidvanrishinam viprah sumatim chakanah |
te syama ye ranayanta somairenota tubhyam ratholha bhakshaih ||
verses.en:
Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Rsis' prayer, thyself a Singer
May we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्मेन्द्र तुभ्यं शंसि दा नृभ्यो नृणां शूर शवः ।
तेभिर्भव सक्रतुर्येषु चाकन्नुत त्रायस्व गृणत उत स्तीन् ॥
verses.rom:
ima brahmendra tubhyam shamsi da nribhyo nrinam shura shavah |
tebhirbhava sakraturyeshu chakannuta trayasva grinata uta stin ||
verses.en:
These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero.
Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवमिन्द्र शूर पृथ्या उत स्तवसे वेन्यस्यार्कैः ।
आ यस्ते योनिं घृतवन्तमस्वारूर्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्रवयन्त वक्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi havamindra shura prithya uta stavase venyasyarkaih |
a yaste yonim ghritavantamasvarurmirna nimnairdravayanta vakvah ||
verses.en:
Listen to Prthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya,
Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.

verses.sa:
सविता यन्त्रैः पृथिवीमरम्णादस्कम्भने सविता द्यामदृंहत् ।
अश्वमिवाधुक्षद्धुनिमन्तरिक्षमतूर्ते बद्धं सविता समुद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
savita yantraih prithivimaramnadaskambhane savita dyamadrimhat |
ashvamivadhukshaddhunimantarikshamaturte baddham savita samudram ||
verses.en:
SAVITAR fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven steadfast where no prop supported.
Savitar milked, as 'twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden.

verses.sa:
यत्रा समुद्र स्कभितो व्यौनदपां नपात्सविता तस्य वेद ।
अतो भूरत आ उत्थितं रजोऽतो द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra samudra skabhito vyaunadapam napatsavita tasya veda |
ato bhurata a utthitam rajo'to dyavaprithivi aprathetam ||
verses.en:
Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o'erflowed its limit.
Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded.

verses.sa:
पश्चेदमन्यदभवद्यजत्रममर्त्यस्य भुवनस्य भूना ।
सुपर्णो अङ्ग सवितुर्गरुत्मान्पूर्वो जातः स उ अस्यानु धर्म ॥
verses.rom:
pashchedamanyadabhavadyajatramamartyasya bhuvanasya bhuna |
suparno anga saviturgarutmanpurvo jatah sa u asyanu dharma ||
verses.en:
Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy.
First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever.

verses.sa:
गाव इव ग्रामं यूयुधिरिवाश्वान्वाश्रेव वत्सं सुमना दुहाना ।
पतिरिव जायामभि नो न्येतु धर्ता दिवः सविता विश्ववारः ॥
verses.rom:
gava iva gramam yuyudhirivashvanvashreva vatsam sumana duhana |
patiriva jayamabhi no nyetu dharta divah savita vishvavarah ||
verses.en:
As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling,
As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यस्तूपः सवितर्यथा त्वाङ्गिरसो जुह्वे वाजे अस्मिन् ।
एवा त्वार्चन्नवसे वन्दमानः सोमस्येवांशुं प्रति जागराहम् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyastupah savitaryatha tvangiraso juhve vaje asmin |
eva tvarchannavase vandamanah somasyevamshum prati jagaraham ||
verses.en:
Like the Angirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement:
So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.

verses.sa:
समिद्धश्चित्समिध्यसे देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन ।
आदित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिर्न आ गहि मृळीकाय न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
samiddhashchitsamidhyase devebhyo havyavahana |
adityai rudrairvasubhirna a gahi mrilikaya na a gahi ||
verses.en:
THOU, bearer of oblations, though kindled, art kindled for the Gods.
With the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, come to us: to show us favour come to us.

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि ।
मर्तासस्त्वा समिधान हवामहे मृळीकाय हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
imam yajnamidam vacho jujushana upagahi |
martasastva samidhana havamahe mrilikaya havamahe ||
verses.en:
Come hither and accept with joy this sacrifice and hymn of ours.
O kindled God, we mortals are invoking thee, calling on thee to show us grace.

verses.sa:
त्वामु जातवेदसं विश्ववारं गृणे धिया ।
अग्ने देवाँ आ वह नः प्रियव्रतान्मृळीकाय प्रियव्रतान् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamu jatavedasam vishvavaram grine dhiya |
agne devan a vaha nah priyavratanmrilikaya priyavratan ||
verses.en:
I laud thee Jatavedas, thee Lord of all blessings, with my song.
Agni, bring hitherward the Gods whose Laws we love, whose laws we love, to show us grace.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवो देवानामभवत्पुरोहितोऽग्निं मनुष्या ऋषयः समीधिरे ।
अग्निं महो धनसातावहं हुवे मृळीकं धनसातये ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdevo devanamabhavatpurohito'gnim manushya rishayah samidhire |
agnim maho dhanasatavaham huve mrilikam dhanasataye ||
verses.en:
Agni the God was made the great High-Priest of Gods, Rsis have kindled Agni, men of mortal mould.
Agni I invocate for winning ample wealth. kindly disposed for winning wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्निरत्रिं भरद्वाजं गविष्ठिरं प्रावन्नः कण्वं त्रसदस्युमाहवे ।
अग्निं वसिष्ठो हवते पुरोहितो मृळीकाय पुरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
agniratrim bharadvajam gavishthiram pravannah kanvam trasadasyumahave |
agnim vasishtho havate purohito mrilikaya purohitah ||
verses.en:
Atri and Bharadvaja and Gavisthira, Kanva and Trasadasyu, in our fight he helped.
On Agni calls Vasistha, even the household priest, the household priest to win his grace.

verses.sa:
श्रद्धयाग्निः समिध्यते श्रद्धया हूयते हविः ।
श्रद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि वचसा वेदयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shraddhayagnih samidhyate shraddhaya huyate havih |
shraddham bhagasya murdhani vachasa vedayamasi ||
verses.en:
By Faith is Agni kindled, through Faith is oblation offered up.
We celebrate with praises Faith upon the height of happiness.

verses.sa:
प्रियं श्रद्धे ददतः प्रियं श्रद्धे दिदासतः ।
प्रियं भोजेषु यज्वस्विदं म उदितं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
priyam shraddhe dadatah priyam shraddhe didasatah |
priyam bhojeshu yajvasvidam ma uditam kridhi ||
verses.en:
Bless thou the man who gives, O Faith; Faith, bless the man who fain would give.
Bless thou the liberal worshippers: bless thou the word that I have said.

verses.sa:
यथा देवा असुरेषु श्रद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे ।
एवं भोजेषु यज्वस्वस्माकमुदितं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
yatha deva asureshu shraddhamugreshu chakrire |
evam bhojeshu yajvasvasmakamuditam kridhi ||
verses.en:
Even as the Deities maintained Faith in the mighty Asuras,
So make this uttered wish of mine true for the liberal worshippers.

verses.sa:
श्रद्धां देवा यजमाना वायुगोपा उपासते ।
श्रद्धां हृदय्ययाकूत्या श्रद्धया विन्दते वसु ॥
verses.rom:
shraddham deva yajamana vayugopa upasate |
shraddham hridayyayakutya shraddhaya vindate vasu ||
verses.en:
Guarded by Vayu, Gods and men who sacrifice draw near to Faith.
Man winneth Faith by yearnings of the heart, and opulence by Faith.

verses.sa:
श्रद्धां प्रातर्हवामहे श्रद्धां मध्यंदिनं परि ।
श्रद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि श्रद्धे श्रद्धापयेह नः ॥
verses.rom:
shraddham pratarhavamahe shraddham madhyamdinam pari |
shraddham suryasya nimruchi shraddhe shraddhapayeha nah ||
verses.en:
Faith in the early morning, Faith at noonday will we invocate,
Faith at the setting of the Sun. O Faith, endow us with belief.

verses.sa:
शास इत्था महाँ अस्यमित्रखादो अद्भुतः ।
न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन ॥
verses.rom:
shasa ittha mahan asyamitrakhado adbhutah |
na yasya hanyate sakha na jiyate kada chana ||
verses.en:
A MIGHTY Governor art thou, Wondrous, Destroyer of the foe,
Whose friend is never done to death, and never, never overcome.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी ।
वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः ॥
verses.rom:
svastida vishaspatirvritraha vimridho vashi |
vrishendrah pura etu nah somapa abhayamkarah ||
verses.en:
Lord of the clan, who brings us bliss, Strong, Warrior, Slayer of the fiend,
May India, Soma-drinker, go before us, Bull who gives us peace.

verses.sa:
वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज ।
वि मन्युमिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नमित्रस्याभिदासतः ॥
verses.rom:
vi raksho vi mridho jahi vi vritrasya hanu ruja |
vi manyumindra vritrahannamitrasyabhidasatah ||
verses.en:
Drive Raksasas and foes away, break thou in pieces Vrtra's jaws:
O Vrtra-slaying Indra, quell the foeman's wrath who threatens us.

verses.sa:
वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः ।
यो अस्माँ अभिदासत्यधरं गमया तमः ॥
verses.rom:
vi na indra mridho jahi nicha yachchha pritanyatah |
yo asman abhidasatyadharam gamaya tamah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us:
Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury.

verses.sa:
अपेन्द्र द्विषतो मनोऽप जिज्यासतो वधम् ।
वि मन्योः शर्म यच्छ वरीयो यवया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
apendra dvishato mano'pa jijyasato vadham |
vi manyoh sharma yachchha variyo yavaya vadham ||
verses.en:
Baffle the foeman's plan, ward off his weapon who would conquer us.
Give shelter from his furious wrath, and keep his murdering dart afar.

verses.sa:
ईङ्खयन्तीरपस्युव इन्द्रं जातमुपासते ।
भेजानासः सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
inkhayantirapasyuva indram jatamupasate |
bhejanasah suviryam ||
verses.en:
SWAYING about, the Active Ones came nigh to Indra at his birth,
And shared his great heroic might.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः ।
त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra baladadhi sahaso jata ojasah |
tvam vrishanvrishedasi ||
verses.en:
Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra is thy birth:
Thou, Mighty One, art strong indeed.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्रासि वृत्रहा व्यन्तरिक्षमतिरः ।
उद्द्यामस्तभ्ना ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindrasi vritraha vyantarikshamatirah |
uddyamastabhna ojasa ||
verses.en:
Thou art the Vrtra-slayer, thou, Indra, hast spread the firmament:
Thou hast with might upheld the heavens.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र सजोषसमर्कं बिभर्षि बाह्वोः ।
वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra sajoshasamarkam bibharshi bahvoh |
vajram shishana ojasa ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, bearest in thine arms the lightning that accords with thee,
Whetting thy thunderbolt with might.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि विश्वा जातान्योजसा ।
स विश्वा भुव आभवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindrabhibhurasi vishva jatanyojasa |
sa vishva bhuva abhavah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, art preeminent over all creatures in thy might:
Thou hast pervaded every place.

verses.sa:
सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते ।
येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
soma ekebhyah pavate ghritameka upasate |
yebhyo madhu pradhavati tanshchidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en:
FOR some is Soma purified, some sit by sacrificial oil:
To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये स्वर्ययुः ।
तपो ये चक्रिरे महस्ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
tapasa ye anadhrishyastapasa ye svaryayuh |
tapo ye chakrire mahastanshchidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en:
Invincible through Fervour, those whom Fervour hath advanced to heaven,
Who showed great Fervour in their lives, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
ये युध्यन्ते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये तनूत्यजः ।
ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
ye yudhyante pradhaneshu shuraso ye tanutyajah |
ye va sahasradakshinastanshchidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en:
The heroes who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away,
Or who give guerdon thousandfold, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
ये चित्पूर्व ऋतसाप ऋतावान ऋतावृधः ।
पितॄन्तपस्वतो यम ताँश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
ye chitpurva ritasapa ritavana ritavridhah |
pitrintapasvato yama tanshchidevapi gachchhatat ||
verses.en:
Yea, the first followers of Law, Law's pure and holy strengtheners,
The Fathers, Yama! Fervour-moved, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायन्ति सूर्यम् ।
ऋषीन्तपस्वतो यम तपोजाँ अपि गच्छतात् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasranithah kavayo ye gopayanti suryam |
rishintapasvato yama tapojan api gachchhatat ||
verses.en:
Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun,
The Rsis, Yama! Fervour-moved, even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
अरायि काणे विकटे गिरिं गच्छ सदान्वे ।
शिरिम्बिठस्य सत्वभिस्तेभिष्ट्वा चातयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
arayi kane vikate girim gachchha sadanve |
shirimbithasya satvabhistebhishtva chatayamasi ||
verses.en:
ARAYI, one-eyed limping hag, fly, ever-screeching, to the hill.
We frighten thee away with these, the heroes of Sirimbitha.

verses.sa:
चत्तो इतश्चत्तामुतः सर्वा भ्रूणान्यारुषी ।
अराय्यं ब्रह्मणस्पते तीक्ष्णशृङ्गोदृषन्निहि ॥
verses.rom:
chatto itashchattamutah sarva bhrunanyarushi |
arayyam brahmanaspate tikshnashringodrishannihi ||
verses.en:
Scared from this place and that is she, destroyer of each germ unborn.
Go, sharp-horned Brahmanaspti and drive Arayi far away.

verses.sa:
अदो यद्दारु प्लवते सिन्धोः पारे अपूरुषम् ।
तदा रभस्व दुर्हणो तेन गच्छ परस्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ado yaddaru plavate sindhoh pare apurusham |
tada rabhasva durhano tena gachchha parastaram ||
verses.en:
Yon log that floats without a man to guide it on the river's edge,-
Seize it, thou thing with hideous jaws, and go thou far away thereon.

verses.sa:
यद्ध प्राचीरजगन्तोरो मण्डूरधाणिकीः ।
हता इन्द्रस्य शत्रवः सर्वे बुद्बुदयाशवः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha prachirajagantoro manduradhanikih |
hata indrasya shatravah sarve budbudayashavah ||
verses.en:
When, foul with secret stain and spot, ye hastened onward to the breast,
All Indra's enemies were slain and passed away like froth and foam.

verses.sa:
परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमहृषत ।
देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ आ दधर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
parime gamaneshata paryagnimahrishata |
deveshvakrata shravah ka iman a dadharshati ||
verses.en:
These men have led about the cow, have duly carried Agni round,
And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them with success?

verses.sa:
अग्निं हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु ।
तेन जेष्म धनंधनम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hinvantu no dhiyah saptimashumivajishu |
tena jeshma dhanamdhanam ||
verses.en:
LET songs of ours speed Agni forth like a fleet courser in the race,
And we will win each prize through him.

verses.sa:
यया गा आकरामहे सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या ।
तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yaya ga akaramahe senayagne tavotya |
tam no hinva maghattaye ||
verses.en:
Agni the dart whereby we gain kine for ourselves with help from thee,-
That send us for the gain of wealth.

verses.sa:
आग्ने स्थूरं रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
अङ्धि खं वर्तया पणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne sthuram rayim bhara prithum gomantamashvinam |
andhi kham vartaya panim ||
verses.en:
O Agni, bring us wealth secure, vast wealth in horses and in kine:
Oil thou the socket, turn the wheel.

verses.sa:
अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ।
दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
agne nakshatramajarama suryam rohayo divi |
dadhajjyotirjanebhyah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, thou hast made the Sun, Eternal Star, to mount the sky,
Bestowing light on living men.

verses.sa:
अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् ।
बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
agne keturvishamasi preshthah shreshtha upasthasat |
bodha stotre vayo dadhat ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, art the people's light, best, dearest, seated in thy shrine:
Watch for the singer, give him life.

verses.sa: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः ॥
verses.rom: ima nu kam bhuvana sishadhamendrashcha vishve cha devah ||
verses.en: WE will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection.

verses.sa: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह चीकॢपाति ॥
verses.rom: yajnam cha nastanvam cha prajam chadityairindrah saha chiklipati ||
verses.en: Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra form together with Adityas.

verses.sa: आदित्यैरिन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्माकं भूत्वविता तनूनाम् ॥
verses.rom: adityairindrah sagano marudbhirasmakam bhutvavita tanunam ||
verses.en: With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies.

verses.sa: हत्वाय देवा असुरान्यदायन्देवा देवत्वमभिरक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.rom: hatvaya deva asuranyadayandeva devatvamabhirakshamanah ||
verses.en: As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,

verses.sa: प्रत्यञ्चमर्कमनयञ्छचीभिरादित्स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् ॥
verses.rom: pratyanchamarkamanayanchhachibhiraditsvadhamishiram paryapashyan ||
verses.en: Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो नो दिवस्पातु वातो अन्तरिक्षात् ।
अग्निर्नः पार्थिवेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
suryo no divaspatu vato antarikshat |
agnirnah parthivebhyah ||
verses.en:
MAY Surya guard us out of heaven, and Vata from the firmament,
And Agni from terrestrial spots.

verses.sa:
जोषा सवितर्यस्य ते हरः शतं सवाँ अर्हति ।
पाहि नो दिद्युतः पतन्त्याः ॥
verses.rom:
josha savitaryasya te harah shatam savan arhati |
pahi no didyutah patantyah ||
verses.en:
Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased:
From failing lightning keep us safe.

verses.sa:
चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः ।
चक्षुर्धाता दधातु नः ॥
verses.rom:
chakshurno devah savita chakshurna uta parvatah |
chakshurdhata dadhatu nah ||
verses.en:
May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight;
May the Creator give us sight.

verses.sa:
चक्षुर्नो धेहि चक्षुषे चक्षुर्विख्यै तनूभ्यः ।
सं चेदं वि च पश्येम ॥
verses.rom:
chakshurno dhehi chakshushe chakshurvikhyai tanubhyah |
sam chedam vi cha pashyema ||
verses.en:
Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see:
May we survey, discern this world.

verses.sa:
सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ।
वि पश्येम नृचक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
susamdrisham tva vayam prati pashyema surya |
vi pashyema nrichakshasah ||
verses.en:
Thus, Surya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold,
See clearly with the eyes of men.

verses.sa:
उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदयं मामको भगः ।
अहं तद्विद्वला पतिमभ्यसाक्षि विषासहिः ॥
verses.rom:
udasau suryo agadudayam mamako bhagah |
aham tadvidvala patimabhyasakshi vishasahih ||
verses.en:
YON Sun hath mounted up, and this my happy fate hate mounted high.
I knowing this, as conqueror have won my husband for mine own.

verses.sa:
अहं केतुरहं मूर्धाहमुग्रा विवाचनी ।
ममेदनु क्रतुं पतिः सेहानाया उपाचरेत् ॥
verses.rom:
aham keturaham murdhahamugra vivachani |
mamedanu kratum patih sehanaya upacharet ||
verses.en:
I am the banner and the head, a mighty arbitress am I:
I am victorious, and my Lord shall be submissive to my will.

verses.sa:
मम पुत्राः शत्रुहणोऽथो मे दुहिता विराट् ।
उताहमस्मि संजया पत्यौ मे श्लोक उत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
mama putrah shatruhano'tho me duhita virat |
utahamasmi samjaya patyau me shloka uttamah ||
verses.en:
My Sons are slayers of the foe, my Daughter is a ruling Queen:
I am victorious: o'er my Lord my song of triumph is supreme.

verses.sa:
येनेन्द्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः ।
इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्ना किलाभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yenendro havisha kritvyabhavaddyumnyuttamah |
idam tadakri deva asapatna kilabhuvam ||
verses.en:
Oblation, that which Indra gave and thus grew glorious and most high,-
This have I offered, O ye Gods, and rid me of each rival wife.

verses.sa:
असपत्ना सपत्नघ्नी जयन्त्यभिभूवरी ।
आवृक्षमन्यासां वर्चो राधो अस्थेयसामिव ॥
verses.rom:
asapatna sapatnaghni jayantyabhibhuvari |
avrikshamanyasam varcho radho astheyasamiva ||
verses.en:
Destroyer of the rival wife, Sole Spouse, victorious, conqueror,
The others' glory have I seized as 'twere the wealth of weaker Dames.

verses.sa:
समजैषमिमा अहं सपत्नीरभिभूवरी ।
यथाहमस्य वीरस्य विराजानि जनस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
samajaishamima aham sapatnirabhibhuvari |
yathahamasya virasya virajani janasya cha ||
verses.en:
I have subdued as conqueror these rivals, these my fellow-wives,
That I may hold imperial sway over this Hero and the folk.

verses.sa:
तीव्रस्याभिवयसो अस्य पाहि सर्वरथा वि हरी इह मुञ्च ।
इन्द्र मा त्वा यजमानासो अन्ये नि रीरमन्तुभ्यमिमे सुतासः ॥
verses.rom:
tivrasyabhivayaso asya pahi sarvaratha vi hari iha muncha |
indra ma tva yajamanaso anye ni riramantubhyamime sutasah ||
verses.en:
TASTE this strong draught enriched with offered viands: with all thy chariot here unyoke thy Coursers.
Let not those other sacrificers stay thee, Indra: these juices shed for thee are ready.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं सुतास्तुभ्यमु सोत्वासस्त्वां गिरः श्वात्र्या आ ह्वयन्ति ।
इन्द्रेदमद्य सवनं जुषाणो विश्वस्य विद्वाँ इह पाहि सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam sutastubhyamu sotvasastvam girah shvatrya a hvayanti |
indredamadya savanam jushano vishvasya vidvan iha pahi somam ||
verses.en:
Thine is the juice effused, thine are the juices yet to be pressed: our resonant songs invite thee.
O Indra, pleased to-day with this libation, come, thou who knowest all and drink the Soma.

verses.sa:
य उशता मनसा सोममस्मै सर्वहृदा देवकामः सुनोति ।
न गा इन्द्रस्तस्य परा ददाति प्रशस्तमिच्चारुमस्मै कृणोति ॥
verses.rom:
ya ushata manasa somamasmai sarvahrida devakamah sunoti |
na ga indrastasya para dadati prashastamichcharumasmai krinoti ||
verses.en:
Whoso, devoted to the God, effuses Soma for him with yearning heart and spirit,-
Never doth Indra give away his cattle: for him he makes the lovely Soma famous.

verses.sa:
अनुस्पष्टो भवत्येषो अस्य यो अस्मै रेवान्न सुनोति सोमम् ।
निररत्नौ मघवा तं दधाति ब्रह्मद्विषो हन्त्यनानुदिष्टः ॥
verses.rom:
anuspashto bhavatyesho asya yo asmai revanna sunoti somam |
niraratnau maghava tam dadhati brahmadvisho hantyananudishtah ||
verses.en:
He looks with loving favour on the mortal who, like a rich man, pours for him the Soma.
Maghavan in his bended arm supports him: he slays, unasked, the men who hate devotion.

verses.sa:
अश्वायन्तो गव्यन्तो वाजयन्तो हवामहे त्वोपगन्तवा उ ।
आभूषन्तस्ते सुमतौ नवायां वयमिन्द्र त्वा शुनं हुवेम ॥
verses.rom:
ashvayanto gavyanto vajayanto havamahe tvopagantava u |
abhushantaste sumatau navayam vayamindra tva shunam huvema ||
verses.en:
We call on thee to come to us, desirous of goods and spoil, of cattle, and of horses.
For thy new love and favour are we present: let us invoke thee, Indra, as our welfare.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात् ।
ग्राहिर्जग्राह यदि वैतदेनं तस्या इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनम् ॥
verses.rom:
munchami tva havisha jivanaya kamajnatayakshmaduta rajayakshmat |
grahirjagraha yadi vaitadenam tasya indragni pra mumuktamenam ||
verses.en:
FOR life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption;
Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.

verses.sa:
यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरन्तिकं नीत एव ।
तमा हरामि निरृतेरुपस्थादस्पार्षमेनं शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
yadi kshitayuryadi va pareto yadi mrityorantikam nita eva |
tama harami nirriterupasthadasparshamenam shatasharadaya ||
verses.en:
Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already,
Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षेण शतशारदेन शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम् ।
शतं यथेमं शरदो नयातीन्द्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrakshena shatasharadena shatayusha havishaharshamenam |
shatam yathemam sharado nayatindro vishvasya duritasya param ||
verses.en:
With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him,
That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.

verses.sa:
शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्ताञ्छतमु वसन्तान् ।
शतमिन्द्राग्नी सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषेमं पुनर्दुः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam jiva sharado vardhamanah shatam hemantanchhatamu vasantan |
shatamindragni savita brihaspatih shatayusha havishemam punarduh ||
verses.en:
Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters.
Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Brhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!

verses.sa:
आहार्षं त्वाविदं त्वा पुनरागाः पुनर्नव ।
सर्वाङ्ग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च तेऽविदम् ॥
verses.rom:
aharsham tvavidam tva punaragah punarnava |
sarvanga sarvam te chakshuh sarvamayushcha te'vidam ||
verses.en:
So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed.
Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणाग्निः संविदानो रक्षोहा बाधतामितः ।
अमीवा यस्ते गर्भं दुर्णामा योनिमाशये ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanagnih samvidano rakshoha badhatamitah |
amiva yaste garbham durnama yonimashaye ||
verses.en:
MAY Agni, yielding to our prayer, the Raksas-slayer, drive away
The malady of evil name that hath beset thy labouring womb.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गर्भममीवा दुर्णामा योनिमाशये ।
अग्निष्टं ब्रह्मणा सह निष्क्रव्यादमनीनशत् ॥
verses.rom:
yaste garbhamamiva durnama yonimashaye |
agnishtam brahmana saha nishkravyadamaninashat ||
verses.en:
Agni, concurring in the prayer, drive off the eater of the flesh,
The malady of evil name that hath attacked thy babe and womb.

verses.sa:
यस्ते हन्ति पतयन्तं निषत्स्नुं यः सरीसृपम् ।
जातं यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yaste hanti patayantam nishatsnum yah sarisripam |
jatam yaste jighamsati tamito nashayamasi ||
verses.en:
That which destroys the sinking germ, the settled, moving embryo,
That which will kill the babe at birth, even this will we drive far away.

verses.sa:
यस्त ऊरू विहरत्यन्तरा दम्पती शये ।
योनिं यो अन्तरारेळ्हि तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yasta uru viharatyantara dampati shaye |
yonim yo antararelhi tamito nashayamasi ||
verses.en:
That which divides thy legs that it may lie between the married pair,
That penetrates and licks thy side, even this will we exterminate.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा भ्राता पतिर्भूत्वा जारो भूत्वा निपद्यते ।
प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yastva bhrata patirbhutva jaro bhutva nipadyate |
prajam yaste jighamsati tamito nashayamasi ||
verses.en:
What rests by thee in borrowed form of brother, lover, or of lord,
And would destroy thy Progeny, even this will we exterminate.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा स्वप्नेन तमसा मोहयित्वा निपद्यते ।
प्रजां यस्ते जिघांसति तमितो नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yastva svapnena tamasa mohayitva nipadyate |
prajam yaste jighamsati tamito nashayamasi ||
verses.en:
That which through sleep or darkness hath deceived thee and lies down by thee,
And will destroy thy progeny, even this will we exterminate.

verses.sa:
अक्षीभ्यां ते नासिकाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां छुबुकादधि ।
यक्ष्मं शीर्षण्यं मस्तिष्काज्जिह्वाया वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
akshibhyam te nasikabhyam karnabhyam chhubukadadhi |
yakshmam shirshanyam mastishkajjihvaya vi vrihami te ||
verses.en:
FROM both thy nostrils, from thine eyes, from both thine ears and from thy chin,
Forth from thy head and brain and tongue I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa:
ग्रीवाभ्यस्त उष्णिहाभ्यः कीकसाभ्यो अनूक्यात् ।
यक्ष्मं दोषण्यमंसाभ्यां बाहुभ्यां वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
grivabhyasta ushnihabhyah kikasabhyo anukyat |
yakshmam doshanyamamsabhyam bahubhyam vi vrihami te ||
verses.en:
From the neck-tendons and the neck, from the breast-bones and from the spine,
From shoulders, upper, lower arms, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa:
आन्त्रेभ्यस्ते गुदाभ्यो वनिष्ठोर्हृदयादधि ।
यक्ष्मं मतस्नाभ्यां यक्नः प्लाशिभ्यो वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
antrebhyaste gudabhyo vanishthorhridayadadhi |
yakshmam matasnabhyam yaknah plashibhyo vi vrihami te ||
verses.en:
From viscera and all within, forth from the rectum, from the heart,
From kidneys, liver, and from spleen, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa:
ऊरुभ्यां ते अष्ठीवद्भ्यां पार्ष्णिभ्यां प्रपदाभ्याम् ।
यक्ष्मं श्रोणिभ्यां भासदाद्भंससो वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
urubhyam te ashthivadbhyam parshnibhyam prapadabhyam |
yakshmam shronibhyam bhasadadbhamsaso vi vrihami te ||
verses.en:
From thighs, from knee-caps, and from heels, and from the forepart of the feet,
From hips from stomach, and from groin I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa:
मेहनाद्वनंकरणाल्लोमभ्यस्ते नखेभ्यः ।
यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
mehanadvanamkaranallomabhyaste nakhebhyah |
yakshmam sarvasmadatmanastamidam vi vrihami te ||
verses.en:
From what is voided from within, and from thy hair, and from they nails,
From all thyself from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa:
अङ्गादङ्गाल्लोम्नोलोम्नो जातं पर्वणिपर्वणि ।
यक्ष्मं सर्वस्मादात्मनस्तमिदं वि वृहामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
angadangallomnolomno jatam parvaniparvani |
yakshmam sarvasmadatmanastamidam vi vrihami te ||
verses.en:
From every member, every hair, disease that comes in every joint,
From all thyself, from top to toe, I drive thy malady away.

verses.sa:
अपेहि मनसस्पतेऽप क्राम परश्चर ।
परो निरृत्या आ चक्ष्व बहुधा जीवतो मनः ॥
verses.rom:
apehi manasaspate'pa krama parashchara |
paro nirritya a chakshva bahudha jivato manah ||
verses.en:
AVAUNT, thou Master of the mind Depart, and vanish far away.
Look on Destruction far from hence. The live man's mind is manifold.

verses.sa:
भद्रं वै वरं वृणते भद्रं युञ्जन्ति दक्षिणम् ।
भद्रं वैवस्वते चक्षुर्बहुत्रा जीवतो मनः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram vai varam vrinate bhadram yunjanti dakshinam |
bhadram vaivasvate chakshurbahutra jivato manah ||
verses.en:
A happy boon do men elect, a mighty blessing they obtain.
Bliss with Vaivasvata they see. The live man's mind seeks many a place.

verses.sa:
यदाशसा निःशसाभिशसोपारिम जाग्रतो यत्स्वपन्तः ।
अग्निर्विश्वान्यप दुष्कृतान्यजुष्टान्यारे अस्मद्दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
yadashasa nihshasabhishasoparima jagrato yatsvapantah |
agnirvishvanyapa dushkritanyajushtanyare asmaddadhatu ||
verses.en:
If by address, by blame, by imprecation we have committed sin, awake or sleeping,
All hateful acts of ours, all evil doings may Agni bear away to distant places.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभिद्रोहं चरामसि ।
प्रचेता न आङ्गिरसो द्विषतां पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra brahmanaspate'bhidroham charamasi |
pracheta na angiraso dvishatam patvamhasah ||
verses.en:
When, Indra, Brahmanaspati, our deeds are wrongful and unjust,
May provident Angirasa prevent our foes from troubling, us.

verses.sa:
अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम् ।
जाग्रत्स्वप्नः संकल्पः पापो यं द्विष्मस्तं स ऋच्छतु यो नो द्वेष्टि तमृच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
ajaishmadyasanama chabhumanagaso vayam |
jagratsvapnah samkalpah papo yam dvishmastam sa richchhatu yo no dveshti tamrichchhatu ||
verses.en:
We have prevailed this day and won: we are made free from sin and guilt.
Ill thoughts, that visit us awake or sleeping, seize the man we hate, yea, seize the man who hateth us.

verses.sa:
देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिच्छन्दूतो निरृत्या इदमाजगाम ।
तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
devah kapota ishito yadichchhanduto nirritya idamajagama |
tasma archama krinavama nishkritim sham no astu dvipade sham chatushpade ||
verses.en:
GODS, whatsoe'er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction,
For that let us sing hymns and make atonement. Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहेषु ।
अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नो वृणक्तु ॥
verses.rom:
shivah kapota ishito no astvanaga devah shakuno griheshu |
agnirhi vipro jushatam havirnah pari hetih pakshini no vrinaktu ||
verses.en:
Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, ye Gods, within our dwelling.
May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the Missile borne on wings avoid us.

verses.sa:
हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्र्यां पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने ।
शं नो गोभ्यश्च पुरुषेभ्यश्चास्तु मा नो हिंसीदिह देवाः कपोतः ॥
verses.rom:
hetih pakshini na dabhatyasmanashtryam padam krinute agnidhane |
sham no gobhyashcha purushebhyashchastu ma no himsidiha devah kapotah ||
verses.en:
Let not the Arrow that hath wings distract us: beside the fire-place, on the hearth it settles.
May it bring welfare to our men and cattle: here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear to harm us.

verses.sa:
यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतद्यत्कपोतः पदमग्नौ कृणोति ।
यस्य दूतः प्रहित एष एतत्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
yaduluko vadati moghametadyatkapotah padamagnau krinoti |
yasya dutah prahita esha etattasmai yamaya namo astu mrityave ||
verses.en:
The screeching of the owl is ineffective and when beside the fire the Dove hath settled,
To him who sent it hither as an envoy, to him be reverence paid, to Death, to Yama.

verses.sa:
ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयध्वम् ।
संयोपयन्तो दुरितानि विश्वा हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्र पतात्पतिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
richa kapotam nudata pranodamisham madantah pari gam nayadhvam |
samyopayanto duritani vishva hitva na urjam pra patatpatishthah ||
verses.en:
Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing, bring ye hither food and cattle,
Barring the way against all grief and trouble. Let the swift bird fly forth and leave us vigour.

verses.sa:
ऋषभं मा समानानां सपत्नानां विषासहिम् ।
हन्तारं शत्रूणां कृधि विराजं गोपतिं गवाम् ॥
verses.rom:
rishabham ma samananam sapatnanam vishasahim |
hantaram shatrunam kridhi virajam gopatim gavam ||
verses.en:
MAKE me a bull among my peers, make me my rivals, conqueror:
Make me the slayer of my foes, a sovran ruler, lord of kine

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि सपत्नहेन्द्र इवारिष्टो अक्षतः ।
अधः सपत्ना मे पदोरिमे सर्वे अभिष्ठिताः ॥
verses.rom:
ahamasmi sapatnahendra ivarishto akshatah |
adhah sapatna me padorime sarve abhishthitah ||
verses.en:
I am my rivals' slayer, like Indra unwounded and unhurt,
And all these enemies of mine are vanquished and beneath my feet.

verses.sa:
अत्रैव वोऽपि नह्याम्युभे आर्त्नी इव ज्यया ।
वाचस्पते नि षेधेमान्यथा मदधरं वदान् ॥
verses.rom:
atraiva vo'pi nahyamyubhe artni iva jyaya |
vachaspate ni shedhemanyatha madadharam vadan ||
verses.en:
Here, verily, I bind you fast, as the two bow-ends with the string.
Press down these men, O Lord of Speech, that they may humbly speak to me.

verses.sa:
अभिभूरहमागमं विश्वकर्मेण धाम्ना ।
आ वश्चित्तमा वो व्रतमा वोऽहं समितिं ददे ॥
verses.rom:
abhibhurahamagamam vishvakarmena dhamna |
a vashchittama vo vratama vo'ham samitim dade ||
verses.en:
Hither I came as conqueror with mighty all-effecting power,
And I have mastered all your thought, your synod, and your holy work.

verses.sa:
योगक्षेमं व आदायाहं भूयासमुत्तम आ वो मूर्धानमक्रमीम् ।
अधस्पदान्म उद्वदत मण्डूका इवोदकान्मण्डूका उदकादिव ॥
verses.rom:
yogakshemam va adayaham bhuyasamuttama a vo murdhanamakramim |
adhaspadanma udvadata manduka ivodakanmanduka udakadiva ||
verses.en:
May I be highest, having gained your strength in war, your skill in peace
my feet have trodden on your heads.
Speak to me from beneath my feet, as frogs from out the water croak, as frogs from out the water croak.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदमिन्द्र परि षिच्यते मधु त्वं सुतस्य कलशस्य राजसि ।
त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरामु नस्कृधि त्वं तपः परितप्याजयः स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyedamindra pari shichyate madhu tvam sutasya kalashasya rajasi |
tvam rayim puruviramu naskridhi tvam tapah paritapyajayah svah ||
verses.en:
THIS pleasant meath, O Indra, is effused for thee: thou art the ruling Lord of beaker and of juice.
Bestow upon us wealth with many hero sons: thou, having glowed with Fervour, worthest heavenly light.

verses.sa:
स्वर्जितं महि मन्दानमन्धसो हवामहे परि शक्रं सुताँ उप ।
इमं नो यज्ञमिह बोध्या गहि स्पृधो जयन्तं मघवानमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
svarjitam mahi mandanamandhaso havamahe pari shakram sutan upa |
imam no yajnamiha bodhya gahi spridho jayantam maghavanamimahe ||
verses.en:
Let us call Sakra to libations here effused, winner of light who joyeth in the potent juice.
Mark well this sacrifice of ours and come to us: we pray to Maghavan the Vanquisher of hosts.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य धर्मणि बृहस्पतेरनुमत्या उ शर्मणि ।
तवाहमद्य मघवन्नुपस्तुतौ धातर्विधातः कलशाँ अभक्षयम् ॥
verses.rom:
somasya rajno varunasya dharmani brihaspateranumatya u sharmani |
tavahamadya maghavannupastutau dhatarvidhatah kalashan abhakshayam ||
verses.en:
By royal Soma's and by Varuna's decree, under Brhaspati's and Anumati's guard,
This day by thine authority, O Maghavan, Maker, Disposer thou! have I enjoyed the jars.

verses.sa:
प्रसूतो भक्षमकरं चरावपि स्तोमं चेमं प्रथमः सूरिरुन्मृजे ।
सुते सातेन यद्यागमं वां प्रति विश्वामित्रजमदग्नी दमे ॥
verses.rom:
prasuto bhakshamakaram charavapi stomam chemam prathamah surirunmrije |
sute satena yadyagamam vam prati vishvamitrajamadagni dame ||
verses.en:
1, too, urged on, have had my portion, in the bowl, and as first Prince I drew forth this my hymn of praise,
When with the prize I came unto the flowing juice, O Visvamitra, Jamadagni, to your home.

verses.sa:
वातस्य नु महिमानं रथस्य रुजन्नेति स्तनयन्नस्य घोषः ।
दिविस्पृग्यात्यरुणानि कृण्वन्नुतो एति पृथिव्या रेणुमस्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
vatasya nu mahimanam rathasya rujanneti stanayannasya ghoshah |
divisprigyatyarunani krinvannuto eti prithivya renumasyan ||
verses.en:
O THE Wind's chariot, O its power and glory! Crashing it goes and hath a voice of thunder.
It makes the regions red and touches heaven, and as it moves the dust of earth is scattered.

verses.sa:
सं प्रेरते अनु वातस्य विष्ठा ऐनं गच्छन्ति समनं न योषाः ।
ताभिः सयुक्सरथं देव ईयतेऽस्य विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा ॥
verses.rom:
sam prerate anu vatasya vishtha ainam gachchhanti samanam na yoshah |
tabhih sayuksaratham deva iyate'sya vishvasya bhuvanasya raja ||
verses.en:
Along the traces of the Wind they hurry, they come to him as dames to an assembly.
Borne on his car with these for his attendants, the God speeds forth, the universe's Monarch.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षे पथिभिरीयमानो न नि विशते कतमच्चनाहः ।
अपां सखा प्रथमजा ऋतावा क्व स्विज्जातः कुत आ बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshe pathibhiriyamano na ni vishate katamachchanahah |
apam sakha prathamaja ritava kva svijjatah kuta a babhuva ||
verses.en:
Travelling on the paths of air's mid region, no single day doth he take rest or slumber.
Holy and earliest-born, Friend of the waters, where did he spring and from what region came he?

verses.sa:
आत्मा देवानां भुवनस्य गर्भो यथावशं चरति देव एषः ।
घोषा इदस्य शृण्विरे न रूपं तस्मै वाताय हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
atma devanam bhuvanasya garbho yathavasham charati deva eshah |
ghosha idasya shrinvire na rupam tasmai vataya havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
Germ of the world, the Deities' vital spirit, this God moves ever as his will inclines him.
His voice is heard, his shape is ever viewless. Let us adore this Wind with our oblation.

verses.sa:
मयोभूर्वातो अभि वातूस्रा ऊर्जस्वतीरोषधीरा रिशन्ताम् ।
पीवस्वतीर्जीवधन्याः पिबन्त्ववसाय पद्वते रुद्र मृळ ॥
verses.rom:
mayobhurvato abhi vatusra urjasvatiroshadhira rishantam |
pivasvatirjivadhanyah pibantvavasaya padvate rudra mrila ||
verses.en:
MAY the wind blow upon our Cows with healing: may they eat herbage full of vigorous juices.
May they drink waters rich in life and fatness: to food that moves on feet be gracious, Rudra.

verses.sa:
याः सरूपा विरूपा एकरूपा यासामग्निरिष्ट्या नामानि वेद ।
या अङ्गिरसस्तपसेह चक्रुस्ताभ्यः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
yah sarupa virupa ekarupa yasamagnirishtya namani veda |
ya angirasastapaseha chakrustabhyah parjanya mahi sharma yachchha ||
verses.en:
Like-coloured, various-hued, or single-coloured, whose names through sacrifice are known to Agni,
Whom the Angirases produced by Fervour, vouchsafe to these, Parjanya, great protection.

verses.sa:
या देवेषु तन्वमैरयन्त यासां सोमो विश्वा रूपाणि वेद ।
ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः प्रजावतीरिन्द्र गोष्ठे रिरीहि ॥
verses.rom:
ya deveshu tanvamairayanta yasam somo vishva rupani veda |
ta asmabhyam payasa pinvamanah prajavatirindra goshthe ririhi ||
verses.en:
Those who have offered to the Gods their bodies, whose varied forms are all well known to Soma,-
Those grant us in our cattle-pen, O Indra, with their full streams of milk and plenteous offspring.

verses.sa:
