प्रजापतिर्मह्यमेता रराणो विश्वैर्देवैः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
शिवाः सतीरुप नो गोष्ठमाकस्तासां वयं प्रजया सं सदेम ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatirmahyameta rarano vishvairdevaih pitribhih samvidanah |
shivah satirupa no goshthamakastasam vayam prajaya sam sadema ||
verses.en:
Prajapati, bestowing these upon me, one-minded with all Gods and with the Fathers,
Hath to our cow-pen brought auspicious cattle: so may we own the offspring they will bear us.

verses.sa:
विभ्राड्बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम् ।
वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पुपोष पुरुधा वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
vibhradbrihatpibatu somyam madhvayurdadhadyajnapatavavihrutam |
vatajuto yo abhirakshati tmana prajah puposha purudha vi rajati ||
verses.en:
MAY the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled meath, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life;
He who, wind-urged, in person guards our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shines o'er many a land.

verses.sa:
विभ्राड्बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मन्दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितम् ।
अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा ॥
verses.rom:
vibhradbrihatsubhritam vajasatamam dharmandivo dharune satyamarpitam |
amitraha vritraha dasyuhantamam jyotirjajne asuraha sapatnaha ||
verses.en:
Radiant, as high Truth, cherished, best at winning strength, Truth based upon the statute that supports the heavens,
He rose, a light, that kills Vrtras and enemies, best slayer of the Dasyus, Asuras, and foes.

verses.sa:
इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् ।
विश्वभ्राड्भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam shreshtham jyotisham jyotiruttamam vishvajiddhanajiduchyate brihat |
vishvabhradbhrajo mahi suryo drisha uru paprathe saha ojo achyutam ||
verses.en:
This light, the best of lights, supreme, all-conquering, winner of riches, is exalted with high laud.
All-lighting, radiant, mighty as the Sun to see, he spreadeth wide unfailing victory and strength.

verses.sa:
विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्वरगच्छो रोचनं दिवः ।
येनेमा विश्वा भुवनान्याभृता विश्वकर्मणा विश्वदेव्यावता ॥
verses.rom:
vibhrajanjyotisha svaragachchho rochanam divah |
yenema vishva bhuvananyabhrita vishvakarmana vishvadevyavata ||
verses.en:
Beaming forth splendour with thy light, thou hast attained heaven's lustrous realm.
By thee were brought together all existing things, possessor of all Godhead, All-effecting God.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यमिटतो रथमिन्द्र प्रावः सुतावतः ।
अशृणोः सोमिनो हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tyamitato rathamindra pravah sutavatah |
ashrinoh somino havam ||
verses.en:
FOR Ita's sake who pressed the juice, thou, Indra, didst protect his car,
And hear the Soma-giver's call.

verses.sa:
त्वं मखस्य दोधतः शिरोऽव त्वचो भरः ।
अगच्छः सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam makhasya dodhatah shiro'va tvacho bharah |
agachchhah somino griham ||
verses.en:
Thou from his skin hast borne the head of the swift-moving combatant,
And sought the Soma-pourer's home.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यमिन्द्र मर्त्यमास्त्रबुध्नाय वेन्यम् ।
मुहुः श्रथ्ना मनस्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tyamindra martyamastrabudhnaya venyam |
muhuh shrathna manasyave ||
verses.en:
Venya, that mortal man, hast thou, for Astrabudhna the devout,
O Indra, many a time set free.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यमिन्द्र सूर्यं पश्चा सन्तं पुरस्कृधि ।
देवानां चित्तिरो वशम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam tyamindra suryam pashcha santam puraskridhi |
devanam chittiro vasham ||
verses.en:
Bring, Indra, to the east again that Sun who now is in the west,
Even against the will of Gods.

verses.sa: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्तनिं यदूधभिः ॥
verses.rom: a yahi vanasa saha gavah sachanta vartanim yadudhabhih ||
verses.en: WITH all thy beauty come: the kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.

verses.sa: आ याहि वस्व्या धिया मंहिष्ठो जारयन्मखः सुदानुभिः ॥
verses.rom: a yahi vasvya dhiya mamhishtho jarayanmakhah sudanubhih ||
verses.en: Come with kind thoughts, most liberal, rousing the warrior's hymn of praise, with bounteous ones,

verses.sa: पितुभृतो न तन्तुमित्सुदानवः प्रति दध्मो यजामसि ॥
verses.rom: pitubhrito na tantumitsudanavah prati dadhmo yajamasi ||
verses.en: As nourishers we tie the thread, and, liberal with our bounty, offer sacrifice.

verses.sa: उषा अप स्वसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता ॥
verses.rom: usha apa svasustamah sam vartayati vartanim sujatata ||
verses.en: Dawn drives away her Sister's gloom, and, through her excellence, makes her retrace her path.

verses.sa:
आ त्वाहार्षमन्तरेधि ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलिः ।
विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधि भ्रशत् ॥
verses.rom:
a tvaharshamantaredhi dhruvastishthavichachalih |
vishastva sarva vanchhantu ma tvadrashtramadhi bhrashat ||
verses.en:
BE with us; I have chosen thee: stand steadfast and immovable.
Let all the people wish for thee let not thy kingship fall away.

verses.sa:
इहैवैधि माप च्योष्ठाः पर्वत इवाविचाचलिः ।
इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस्तिष्ठेह राष्ट्रमु धारय ॥
verses.rom:
ihaivaidhi mapa chyoshthah parvata ivavichachalih |
indra iveha dhruvastishtheha rashtramu dharaya ||
verses.en:
Be even here; fall not away be like a mountain unremoved.
Stand steadfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्रो अदीधरद्ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा ।
तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवत्तस्मा उ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
imamindro adidharaddhruvam dhruvena havisha |
tasmai somo adhi bravattasma u brahmanaspatih ||
verses.en:
This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by strong oblation's power.
May Soma speak a benison, and Brahmanaspati, on him.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा द्यौर्ध्रुवा पृथिवी ध्रुवासः पर्वता इमे ।
ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगद्ध्रुवो राजा विशामयम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva dyaurdhruva prithivi dhruvasah parvata ime |
dhruvam vishvamidam jagaddhruvo raja vishamayam ||
verses.en:
Firm is the sky and firm the earth, and steadfast also are these hills.
Steadfast is all this living world, and steadfast is this King of men.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवं ते राजा वरुणो ध्रुवं देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
ध्रुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां ध्रुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvam te raja varuno dhruvam devo brihaspatih |
dhruvam ta indrashchagnishcha rashtram dharayatam dhruvam ||
verses.en:
Steadfast, may Varuna the King, steadfast, the God Brhaspati,
Steadfast, may Indra, steadfast too, may Agni keep thy steadfast reign.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषाभि सोमं मृशामसि ।
अथो त इन्द्रः केवलीर्विशो बलिहृतस्करत् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvam dhruvena havishabhi somam mrishamasi |
atho ta indrah kevalirvisho balihritaskarat ||
verses.en:
On constant Soma let us think with constant sacrificial gift
And then may Indra make the clans bring tribute unto thee alone.

verses.sa:
अभीवर्तेन हविषा येनेन्द्रो अभिवावृते ।
तेनास्मान्ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभि राष्ट्राय वर्तय ॥
verses.rom:
abhivartena havisha yenendro abhivavrite |
tenasmanbrahmanaspate'bhi rashtraya vartaya ||
verses.en:
WITH offering for success in fight whence Indra was victorious.
With this, O Brahmanaspati, let us attain to royal sway.

verses.sa:
अभिवृत्य सपत्नानभि या नो अरातयः ।
अभि पृतन्यन्तं तिष्ठाभि यो न इरस्यति ॥
verses.rom:
abhivritya sapatnanabhi ya no aratayah |
abhi pritanyantam tishthabhi yo na irasyati ||
verses.en:
Subduing those who rival us, subduing all malignities,
Withstand the man who menaces, withstand the man who angers us.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा देवः सविताभि सोमो अवीवृतत् ।
अभि त्वा विश्वा भूतान्यभीवर्तो यथाससि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva devah savitabhi somo avivritat |
abhi tva vishva bhutanyabhivarto yathasasi ||
verses.en:
Soma and Savitar the God have made thee a victorious King
All elements have aided thee, to make thee general conqueror.

verses.sa:
येनेन्द्रो हविषा कृत्व्यभवद्द्युम्न्युत्तमः ।
इदं तदक्रि देवा असपत्नः किलाभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yenendro havisha kritvyabhavaddyumnyuttamah |
idam tadakri deva asapatnah kilabhuvam ||
verses.en:
Oblation, that which Indra. gave and thus grew glorious and most high,-
This have I offered, Gods! and hence now, verily, am rivalless.

verses.sa:
असपत्नः सपत्नहाभिराष्ट्रो विषासहिः ।
यथाहमेषां भूतानां विराजानि जनस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
asapatnah sapatnahabhirashtro vishasahih |
yathahamesham bhutanam virajani janasya cha ||
verses.en:
Slayer of rivals, rivalless, victorious, with royal sway,
Over these beings may I rule, may I be Sovran of the folk.

verses.sa:
प्र वो ग्रावाणः सविता देवः सुवतु धर्मणा ।
धूर्षु युज्यध्वं सुनुत ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo gravanah savita devah suvatu dharmana |
dhurshu yujyadhvam sunuta ||
verses.en:
MAY Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you according to the Law:
Be harnessed to the shafts, and press.

verses.sa:
ग्रावाणो अप दुच्छुनामप सेधत दुर्मतिम् ।
उस्राः कर्तन भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
gravano apa duchchhunamapa sedhata durmatim |
usrah kartana bheshajam ||
verses.en:
Stones, drive calamity away, drive ye away malevolence:
Make ye the Cows our medicine.

verses.sa:
ग्रावाण उपरेष्वा महीयन्ते सजोषसः ।
वृष्णे दधतो वृष्ण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
gravana upareshva mahiyante sajoshasah |
vrishne dadhato vrishnyam ||
verses.en:
Of one accord the upper Stones, giving the Bull his bull-like strength,
Look down with pride on those below.

verses.sa:
ग्रावाणः सविता नु वो देवः सुवतु धर्मणा ।
यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
gravanah savita nu vo devah suvatu dharmana |
yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
May Savitar the God, O Stones, stir you as Law commands for him
Who sacrifices, pouring juice.

verses.sa:
प्र सूनव ऋभूणां बृहन्नवन्त वृजना ।
क्षामा ये विश्वधायसोऽश्नन्धेनुं न मातरम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra sunava ribhunam brihannavanta vrijana |
kshama ye vishvadhayaso'shnandhenum na mataram ||
verses.en:
WITH hymns of praise their sons have told aloud the Rbhus' mighty deeds.
Who, all-supporting, have enjoyed the earth as, twere a mother cow.

verses.sa:
प्र देवं देव्या धिया भरता जातवेदसम् ।
हव्या नो वक्षदानुषक् ॥
verses.rom:
pra devam devya dhiya bharata jatavedasam |
havya no vakshadanushak ||
verses.en:
Bring forth the God with song divine, being Jatavedas hitherward,
To bear our gifts at once to heaven.

verses.sa:
अयमु ष्य प्र देवयुर्होता यज्ञाय नीयते ।
रथो न योरभीवृतो घृणीवाञ्चेतति त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu shya pra devayurhota yajnaya niyate |
ratho na yorabhivrito ghrinivanchetati tmana ||
verses.en:
He here, a God-devoted Priest, led forward comes to sacrifice.
Like a car covered for the road, he, glowing, knows, himself, the way.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निरुरुष्यत्यमृतादिव जन्मनः ।
सहसश्चित्सहीयान्देवो जीवातवे कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagnirurushyatyamritadiva janmanah |
sahasashchitsahiyandevo jivatave kritah ||
verses.en:
This Agni rescues from distress, as 'twere from the Immortal Race,
A God yet mightier than strength, a God who hath been made for life.

verses.sa:
पतंगमक्तमसुरस्य मायया हृदा पश्यन्ति मनसा विपश्चितः ।
समुद्रे अन्तः कवयो वि चक्षते मरीचीनां पदमिच्छन्ति वेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
patamgamaktamasurasya mayaya hrida pashyanti manasa vipashchitah |
samudre antah kavayo vi chakshate marichinam padamichchhanti vedhasah ||
verses.en:
THE sapient with their spirit and their mind behold the Bird adorned with all an Asura's magic might.
Sages observe him in the ocean's inmost depth: the wise disposers seek the station of his rays.

verses.sa:
पतंगो वाचं मनसा बिभर्ति तां गन्धर्वोऽवदद्गर्भे अन्तः ।
तां द्योतमानां स्वर्यं मनीषामृतस्य पदे कवयो नि पान्ति ॥
verses.rom:
patamgo vacham manasa bibharti tam gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antah |
tam dyotamanam svaryam manishamritasya pade kavayo ni panti ||
verses.en:
The flying Bird bears Speech within his spirit: erst the Gandharva in the womb pronounced it:
And at the seat of sacrifice the sages cherish this radiant, heavenly-bright invention.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् ।
स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
apashyam gopamanipadyamanama cha para cha pathibhishcharantam |
sa sadhrichih sa vishuchirvasana a varivarti bhuvaneshvantah ||
verses.en:
I saw the Herdsman, him who never resteth, approaching and departing on his pathways.
He, clothed in gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sa:
त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहावानं तरुतारं रथानाम् ।
अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजमाशुं स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम ॥
verses.rom:
tyamu shu vajinam devajutam sahavanam tarutaram rathanam |
arishtanemim pritanajamashum svastaye tarkshyamiha huvema ||
verses.en:
THIS very mighty one whom Gods commission, the Conqueror of cars, ever triumphant,
Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarksya for our weal will we call hither.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्येव रातिमाजोहुवानाः स्वस्तये नावमिवा रुहेम ।
उर्वी न पृथ्वी बहुले गभीरे मा वामेतौ मा परेतौ रिषाम ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyeva ratimajohuvanah svastaye navamiva ruhema |
urvi na prithvi bahule gabhire ma vametau ma paretau rishama ||
verses.en:
As though we offered up our gifts to Indra, may we ascend. him as a ship. for safety.
Like the two wide worlds, broad, deep far-extended, may we be safe both when he comes and leaves you.

verses.sa:
सद्यश्चिद्यः शवसा पञ्च कृष्टीः सूर्य इव ज्योतिषापस्ततान ।
सहस्रसाः शतसा अस्य रंहिर्न स्मा वरन्ते युवतिं न शर्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
sadyashchidyah shavasa pancha krishtih surya iva jyotishapastatana |
sahasrasah shatasa asya ramhirna sma varante yuvatim na sharyam ||
verses.en:
He who with might the Five Lands hath pervaded, like Surya with his lustre, and the waters-
His strength wins hundreds, thousands none avert it, as the young maid repelleth not her lover.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठताव पश्यतेन्द्रस्य भागमृत्वियम् ।
यदि श्रातो जुहोतन यद्यश्रातो ममत्तन ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthatava pashyatendrasya bhagamritviyam |
yadi shrato juhotana yadyashrato mamattana ||
verses.en:
Now lift ye up yourselves and look on Indra's seasonable share.
If it be ready, offer it; unready, ye have been remise.

verses.sa:
श्रातं हविरो ष्विन्द्र प्र याहि जगाम सूरो अध्वनो विमध्यम् ।
परि त्वासते निधिभिः सखायः कुलपा न व्राजपतिं चरन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
shratam haviro shvindra pra yahi jagama suro adhvano vimadhyam |
pari tvasate nidhibhih sakhayah kulapa na vrajapatim charantam ||
verses.en:
Oblation is prepared: come to us, Indra; the Sun hath travelled over half his journey.
Friends with their stores are sitting round thee waiting like lords of clans for the tribe's wandering chieftain.

verses.sa:
श्रातं मन्य ऊधनि श्रातमग्नौ सुश्रातं मन्ये तदृतं नवीयः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य दध्नः पिबेन्द्र वज्रिन्पुरुकृज्जुषाणः ॥
verses.rom:
shratam manya udhani shratamagnau sushratam manye tadritam naviyah |
madhyamdinasya savanasya dadhnah pibendra vajrinpurukrijjushanah ||
verses.en:
Dressed in the udder and on fire, I fancy; well-dressed, I fancy, is this recent present.
Drink, Indra, of the curd of noon's libation with favour, Thunderer, thou whose deeds are mighty.

verses.sa:
प्र ससाहिषे पुरुहूत शत्रूञ्ज्येष्ठस्ते शुष्म इह रातिरस्तु ।
इन्द्रा भर दक्षिणेना वसूनि पतिः सिन्धूनामसि रेवतीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra sasahishe puruhuta shatrunjyeshthaste shushma iha ratirastu |
indra bhara dakshinena vasuni patih sindhunamasi revatinam ||
verses.en:
O MUCH-INVOKED, thou hast subdued thy foemen: thy might is loftiest; here display thy bounty.
In thy right hand, O Indra, bring us treasures: thou art the Lord of rivers filled with riches.

verses.sa:
मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्था परस्याः ।
सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून्ताळ्हि वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
verses.rom:
mrigo na bhimah kucharo girishthah paravata a jagantha parasyah |
srikam samshaya pavimindra tigmam vi shatruntalhi vi mridho nudasva ||
verses.en:
Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance.
Whetting thy bold and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्षत्रमभि वाममोजोऽजायथा वृषभ चर्षणीनाम् ।
अपानुदो जनममित्रयन्तमुरुं देवेभ्यो अकृणोरु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra kshatramabhi vamamojo'jayatha vrishabha charshaninam |
apanudo janamamitrayantamurum devebhyo akrinoru lokam ||
verses.en:
Thou, mighty Indra, sprangest into being as strength for lovely lordship o'er the people.
Thou drovest off the folk who were unfriendly, and to the Gods thou gavest room and freedom.

verses.sa:
प्रथश्च यस्य सप्रथश्च नामानुष्टुभस्य हविषो हविर्यत् ।
धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णो रथंतरमा जभारा वसिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
prathashcha yasya saprathashcha namanushtubhasya havisho haviryat |
dhaturdyutanatsavitushcha vishno rathamtarama jabhara vasishthah ||
verses.en:
VASISTHA mastered the Rathantara, took it from radiant Dhatar, Savitar, and Visnu,
Oblation, portion of fourfold oblation, known by the names of Saprathas and Prathas.

verses.sa:
अविन्दन्ते अतिहितं यदासीद्यज्ञस्य धाम परमं गुहा यत् ।
धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोर्भरद्वाजो बृहदा चक्रे अग्नेः ॥
verses.rom:
avindante atihitam yadasidyajnasya dhama paramam guha yat |
dhaturdyutanatsavitushcha vishnorbharadvajo brihada chakre agneh ||
verses.en:
These sages found what lay remote and hidden, the sacrifice's loftiest secret essence.
From radiant Dhatar, Savitar, and Visnu, from Agni, Bharadvaja brought the Brhat.

verses.sa:
तेऽविन्दन्मनसा दीध्याना यजु ष्कन्नं प्रथमं देवयानम् ।
धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोरा सूर्यादभरन्घर्ममेते ॥
verses.rom:
te'vindanmanasa didhyana yaju shkannam prathamam devayanam |
dhaturdyutanatsavitushcha vishnora suryadabharangharmamete ||
verses.en:
They found with mental eyes the earliest Yajus, a pathway to the Gods, that had descended.
From radiant Dhitar, Savitar, and Visnu, from Surya did these sages bring the Gharma.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नयतु दुर्गहा तिरः पुनर्नेषदघशंसाय मन्म ।
क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirnayatu durgaha tirah punarneshadaghashamsaya manma |
kshipadashastimapa durmatim hannatha karadyajamanaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
BRHASPATI lead us safely over troubless and turn his evil thought against the sinner;
Repel the curse, and drive away ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort!

verses.sa:
नराशंसो नोऽवतु प्रयाजे शं नो अस्त्वनुयाजो हवेषु ।
क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
narashamso no'vatu prayaje sham no astvanuyajo haveshu |
kshipadashastimapa durmatim hannatha karadyajamanaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
May Naratarhsa aid us at Prayaja: blest be our Anuyaja at invokings.
May he repel the curse, and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.

verses.sa:
तपुर्मूर्धा तपतु रक्षसो ये ब्रह्मद्विषः शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
tapurmurdha tapatu rakshaso ye brahmadvishah sharave hantava u |
kshipadashastimapa durmatim hannatha karadyajamanaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
May he whose head is flaming burn the demons, haters of prayer, so that the arrow slay them.
May he repel the curse and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं त्वा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसो विभूतम् ।
इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकाम ॥
verses.rom:
apashyam tva manasa chekitanam tapaso jatam tapaso vibhutam |
iha prajamiha rayim raranah pra jayasva prajaya putrakama ||
verses.en:
I SAW thee meditating in thy spirit what sprang from Fervour and hath thence developed.
Bestowing offspring here, bestowing riches, spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं त्वा मनसा दीध्यानां स्वायां तनू ऋत्व्ये नाधमानाम् ।
उप मामुच्चा युवतिर्बभूयाः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकामे ॥
verses.rom:
apashyam tva manasa didhyanam svayam tanu ritvye nadhamanam |
upa mamuchcha yuvatirbabhuyah pra jayasva prajaya putrakame ||
verses.en:
I saw thee pondering in thine heart, and praying that in due time thy body might be fruitful.
Come as a youthful woman, rise to meet me: spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.

verses.sa:
अहं गर्भमदधामोषधीष्वहं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः ।
अहं प्रजा अजनयं पृथिव्यामहं जनिभ्यो अपरीषु पुत्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
aham garbhamadadhamoshadhishvaham vishveshu bhuvaneshvantah |
aham praja ajanayam prithivyamaham janibhyo aparishu putran ||
verses.en:
In plants and herbs, in all existent beings I have deposited the germ of increase.
All progeny on earth have I engendered, and sons in women who will be hereafter.

verses.sa:
विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु ।
आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuryonim kalpayatu tvashta rupani pimshatu |
a sinchatu prajapatirdhata garbham dadhatu te ||
verses.en:
MAY Visnu form and mould the womb, may Tvastar duly shape the forms,
Prajapati infuse the stream, and Dhatar lay the germ for thee.

verses.sa:
गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति ।
गर्भं ते अश्विनौ देवावा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ॥
verses.rom:
garbham dhehi sinivali garbham dhehi sarasvati |
garbham te ashvinau devava dhattam pushkarasraja ||
verses.en:
O Sinivali, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvati:
May the Twain Gods bestow the germ, the Asvins crowned with lotuses.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी अरणी यं निर्मन्थतो अश्विना ।
तं ते गर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayi arani yam nirmanthato ashvina |
tam te garbham havamahe dashame masi sutave ||
verses.en:
That which the Asvins Twain rub forth with the attrition-sticks of gold,-
That germ of thine we invocate, that in the tenth month thou mayst bear.

verses.sa:
महि त्रीणामवोऽस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः ।
दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य ॥
verses.rom:
mahi trinamavo'stu dyuksham mitrasyaryamnah |
duradharsham varunasya ||
verses.en:
GREAT, unassailable must he the heavenly favour of' Three Gods,
Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

verses.sa:
नहि तेषाममा चन नाध्वसु वारणेषु ।
ईशे रिपुरघशंसः ॥
verses.rom:
nahi teshamama chana nadhvasu varaneshu |
ishe ripuraghashamsah ||
verses.en:
O'er these, neither at home nor yet abroad or pathways that are Strange,
The evil-minded foe hath power

verses.sa:
यस्मै पुत्रासो अदितेः प्र जीवसे मर्त्याय ।
ज्योतिर्यच्छन्त्यजस्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai putraso aditeh pra jivase martyaya |
jyotiryachchhantyajasram ||
verses.en: Nor over him, the man on whom the Sons of Aditi bestow Eternal light that he may live.

verses.sa:
वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे ।
प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
vata a vatu bheshajam shambhu mayobhu no hride |
pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en:
FILLING our hearts with health and joy, may Vata breathe his balm on us
May he prolong our days of life.

verses.sa:
उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा ।
स नो जीवातवे कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
uta vata pitasi na uta bhratota nah sakha |
sa no jivatave kridhi ||
verses.en:
Thou art our Father, Vata, yea, thou art a Brother and a friend,
So give us strength that we may live.

verses.sa:
यददो वात ते गृहेऽमृतस्य निधिर्हितः ।
ततो नो देहि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
yadado vata te grihe'mritasya nidhirhitah |
tato no dehi jivase ||
verses.en:
The store of Amrta laid away yonder, O Vata, in thine home,-
Give us thereof that we may live.

verses.sa:
प्राग्नये वाचमीरय वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
pragnaye vachamiraya vrishabhaya kshitinam |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en:
To Agni send I forth my song, to him the Bull of all the folk:
So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yah parasyah paravatastiro dhanvatirochate |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en:
Who from the distance far away shines brilliantly across the wastes:
So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वति वृषा शुक्रेण शोचिषा ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yo rakshamsi nijurvati vrisha shukrena shochisha |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en:
The Bull with brightly-gleaming flame who utterly consumes the fiends
So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishvabhi vipashyati bhuvana sam cha pashyati |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en:
Who looks on all existing things and comprehends them with his view:
So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya pare rajasah shukro agnirajayata |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en:
Resplendent Agni, who was born in farthest region of the air:
So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
प्र नूनं जातवेदसमश्वं हिनोत वाजिनम् ।
इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.rom:
pra nunam jatavedasamashvam hinota vajinam |
idam no barhirasade ||
verses.en:
Now send ye Jatavedas forth, send hitherward the vigorous Steed
To seat him on our sacred grass.

verses.sa:
अस्य प्र जातवेदसो विप्रवीरस्य मीळ्हुषः ।
महीमियर्मि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya pra jatavedaso vipravirasya milhushah |
mahimiyarmi sushtutim ||
verses.en:
I raise the lofty eulogy of Jatavedas, raining boons,
With sages for his hero band.

verses.sa:
या रुचो जातवेदसो देवत्रा हव्यवाहनीः ।
ताभिर्नो यज्ञमिन्वतु ॥
verses.rom:
ya rucho jatavedaso devatra havyavahanih |
tabhirno yajnaminvatu ||
verses.en:
With flames of Jatavedas which carry oblation to the Gods,
May he promote our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः ।
पितरं च प्रयन्स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam gauh prishnirakramidasadanmataram purah |
pitaram cha prayansvah ||
verses.en:
THIS spotted Bull hath come, and sat before the Mother in the east,
Advancing to his Father heaven.

verses.sa:
अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती ।
व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम् ॥
verses.rom:
antashcharati rochanasya pranadapanati |
vyakhyanmahisho divam ||
verses.en:
Expiring when he draws his breath, she moves along the lucid spheres:
The Bull shines out through all the sky.

verses.sa:
त्रिंशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतंगाय धीयते ।
प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः ॥
verses.rom:
trimshaddhama vi rajati vakpatamgaya dhiyate |
prati vastoraha dyubhih ||
verses.en:
Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it rules supreme through thirty realms
Throughout the days at break of morn.

verses.sa:
ऋतं च सत्यं चाभीद्धात्तपसोऽध्यजायत ।
ततो रात्र्यजायत ततः समुद्रो अर्णवः ॥
verses.rom:
ritam cha satyam chabhiddhattapaso'dhyajayata |
tato ratryajayata tatah samudro arnavah ||
verses.en:
FROM Fervour kindled to its height Eternal Law and Truth were born:
Thence was the Night produced, and thence the billowy flood of sea arose.

verses.sa:
समुद्रादर्णवादधि संवत्सरो अजायत ।
अहोरात्राणि विदधद्विश्वस्य मिषतो वशी ॥
verses.rom:
samudradarnavadadhi samvatsaro ajayata |
ahoratrani vidadhadvishvasya mishato vashi ||
verses.en:
From that same billowy flood of sea the Year was afterwards produced,
Ordainer of the days nights, Lord over all who close the eye.

verses.sa:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् ।
दिवं च पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षमथो स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
suryachandramasau dhata yathapurvamakalpayat |
divam cha prithivim chantarikshamatho svah ||
verses.en:
Dhatar, the great Creator, then formed in due order Sun and Moon.
He formed in order Heaven and Earth, the regions of the air, and light.

verses.sa:
संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ ।
इळस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर ॥
verses.rom:
samsamidyuvase vrishannagne vishvanyarya a |
ilaspade samidhyase sa no vasunya bhara ||
verses.en:
THOU, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend.
Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled in libation's place

verses.sa:
सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।
देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥
verses.rom:
sam gachchhadhvam sam vadadhvam sam vo manamsi janatam |
deva bhagam yatha purve samjanana upasate ||
verses.en:
Assemble, speak together: let your minds be all of one accord,
As ancient Gods unanimous sit down to their appointed share.

verses.sa:
समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् ।
समानं मन्त्रमभि मन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom:
samano mantrah samitih samani samanam manah saha chittamesham |
samanam mantramabhi mantraye vah samanena vo havisha juhomi ||
verses.en:
The place is common, common the assembly, common the mind, so be their thought united.
A common purpose do I lay before you, and worship with your general oblation.

verses.sa:
समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः ।
समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
verses.rom:
samani va akutih samana hridayani vah |
samanamastu vo mano yatha vah susahasati ||
verses.en:
One and the same be your resolve, and be your minds of one accord.
United be the thoughts of all that all may happily agree.
